IGUI_Machinery_Error_DrumFull_Concrete.cn: 搅拌筒已满. 请先装满几个桶.
IGUI_Machinery_Error_DrumFull_Concrete.en: The drum is full. Fill some buckets first.

IGUI_Machinery_Error_NoWater.ch: 這項作業的水量不足. 汙水也可計入.
IGUI_Machinery_Error_NoWater.cn: 此作业的水量不足. 污水也计入.
IGUI_Machinery_Error_NoWater.en: There is not enough water for this job. Tainted water counts.

IGUI_Machinery_Operation_fillCarvedConcr.ch: 從攪拌桶倒出一桶拌好的混凝土, 裝進一個空的雕刻木桶.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_fillCarvedConcr.cn: 从搅拌筒倒出一桶拌好的混凝土, 装进一个空的雕刻木桶.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_fillCarvedConcr.en: Pour one bucket of mixed concrete out of the drum into an empty carved wooden bucket.

IGUI_Machinery_Operation_fillConcreteBuc.ch: 從攪拌桶倒出一桶拌好的混凝土, 裝進一個空的金屬桶. 木桶與鍛造桶不適用: 遊戲本體沒有對應的混凝土桶, 它們會變回普通的金屬桶.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_fillConcreteBuc.cn: 从搅拌筒倒出一桶拌好的混凝土, 装进一个空的金属桶. 木桶和锻造桶不适用: 游戏本体没有对应的混凝土桶, 它们会变回普通的金属桶.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_fillConcreteBuc.en: Pour one bucket of mixed concrete out of the drum into an empty metal bucket. Wooden and forged buckets are not accepted: the base game has no concrete bucket for them, so they would come back as a plain metal bucket.

IGUI_Machinery_Operation_grindLatheTool_.ch: 用四分之一鋼棒磨出一套全新的車床刀具.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_grindLatheTool_.cn: 用四分之一钢棒磨出一套全新的车床刀具.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_grindLatheTool_.en: Grind a fresh lathe tool set out of a steel bar quarter.

IGUI_Machinery_Operation_mixConcreteBatc.ch: 將一袋混凝土粉與水拌合, 成品先存放在攪拌桶裡, 等有桶可裝時再倒出.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_mixConcreteBatc.cn: 将一袋混凝土粉与水拌合, 成品先存放在搅拌筒里, 等有桶可装时再倒出.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_mixConcreteBatc.en: Mix one bag of concrete powder with water and hold the result in the drum until there is a bucket to pour it into.

IGUI_Machinery_Operation_regrindDrillBit.ch: 把磨損的鑽頭重新磨利. 每次重磨都會永久磨掉一些金屬, 因此可恢復的狀態上限每次都會下降一點.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_regrindDrillBit.cn: 把磨损的钻头重新磨利. 每次重磨都会永久磨掉一些金属, 因此可恢复的状态上限每次都会下降一点.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_regrindDrillBit.en: Resharpen a worn drill bit set. Each pass takes metal off for good, so the condition it can be brought back to drops a little every time.

IGUI_Machinery_Operation_regrindLatheToo.ch: 把磨損的車床刀具重新磨利. 每次重磨都會永久磨掉一些金屬, 因此可恢復的狀態上限每次都會下降一點.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_regrindLatheToo.cn: 把磨损的车床刀具重新磨利. 每次重磨都会永久磨掉一些金属, 因此可恢复的状态上限每次都会下降一点.
IGUI_Machinery_Operation_regrindLatheToo.en: Regrind a worn lathe tool set. Each pass takes metal off for good, so the condition it can be brought back to drops a little every time.

IGUI_Machinery_Requirement_WaterAmount.ch: 水: 可用 %1 L / 需 %2 L
IGUI_Machinery_Requirement_WaterAmount.cn: 水: 可用 %1 L / 需 %2 L

IGUI_Machinery_Slot_WaterHint.ch: 把裝水的容器拖到這裡就能加水. 汙水也行, 混凝土不挑. 攪拌機也會從你身上攜帶的容器, 以及兩格內任何裝有水的東西取水, 所以旁邊放一個集水器就能直接供水.
IGUI_Machinery_Slot_WaterHint.cn: 把装水的容器拖到这里就能加水. 污水也行, 混凝土不挑. 搅拌机还会从你携带的容器, 以及两格内任何装有水的东西取水, 所以旁边放一个集水器就能直接供水.
IGUI_Machinery_Slot_WaterHint.en: Drag a container of water here to fill the tank. Tainted water works too - concrete does not care. The mixer also draws from containers you are carrying and from anything holding water within two tiles, so a rain collector beside it feeds it directly.

IGUI_Machinery_UseWorldMachine_Tooltip.ch: 透過機械設備面板來操作這個%1. 物件本身不會有任何改變, 也照原樣繼續運作.
IGUI_Machinery_UseWorldMachine_Tooltip.cn: 通过机械设备面板来操作这个%1. 物体本身不会有任何改变, 也照原样继续运行.
IGUI_Machinery_UseWorldMachine_Tooltip.en: Run this %1 through the Machinery panel. Nothing about the object is changed, and it keeps working as before.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_AutoHide_Tooltip.ch: 面板平時保持隱藏, 只在你追蹤的技能獲得經驗值時出現, 之後再次隱藏.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_AutoHide_Tooltip.cn: 面板平时保持隐藏, 仅在你追踪的技能获得经验值时出现, 随后再次隐藏.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_AutoHide_Tooltip.en: The panel stays hidden and appears only when you earn XP in a skill you follow, then hides again.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_HideMod_Tooltip.cn: 从游戏中移除面板和经验值图标.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_HideMod_Tooltip.en: Removes the panel and the XP icon from the game.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ResetPos_Tooltip.ch: 還原面板的預設位置與大小.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ResetPos_Tooltip.cn: 恢复面板的默认位置和大小.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ResetPos_Tooltip.en: Restores the default position and size of the panel.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_TextColor_Tooltip.ch: 套用於技能名稱、等級與經驗值數字.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_TextColor_Tooltip.cn: 应用于技能名称、等级和经验值数字.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_TextColor_Tooltip.en: Applies to the skill name, the level and the XP numbers.

IGUI_CM_FurnitureDropRedirect.cn: 3D 摆放 — 选择位置 (GLB 模型, 非图标).

IGUI_CM_FurniturePlaceHintDesc.en: Opens the 3D cursor (GLB mesh). Do not floor-drop — that was the flat 2D icon. The scratcher should tower over the bed. Your cat sleeps on the bed and scratches the pole.
IGUI_CM_FurniturePlaceHintDesc.ch: 開啟 3D 游標 (GLB 網格). 請勿直接丟到地上 — 那是舊的平面 2D 圖示. 貓抓柱應該高聳於貓床之上. 你的貓會睡在床上並抓柱子.
IGUI_CM_FurniturePlaceHintDesc.cn: 打开 3D 光标 (GLB 网格). 请勿直接丢到地上 — 那是旧的平面 2D 图标. 猫抓柱应该高耸于猫床之上. 你的猫会睡在床上并抓柱子.

IGUI_CM_TestNapApplied.en: Cat reached the bed — rendering client applied the pose (animation state: %1).
IGUI_CM_TestNapApplied.ch: 貓已抵達貓床 — 渲染端已套用姿勢 (動畫狀態: %1).
IGUI_CM_TestNapApplied.cn: 猫已抵达猫床 — 渲染端已应用姿势 (动画状态: %1).

IGUI_CM_TestNapGoing.en: Cat is going to the cat bed.

IGUI_CM_TestNapOk.en: Cat reached the bed — nap pose requested on the rendering client.
IGUI_CM_TestNapOk.ch: 貓已抵達貓床 — 已向渲染端請求小睡姿勢.
IGUI_CM_TestNapOk.cn: 猫已抵达猫床 — 已向渲染端请求小睡姿势.

IGUI_CM_TestNapPending.en: Cat reached the bed — pose request received; waiting for the cat on the rendering client.
IGUI_CM_TestNapPending.ch: 貓已抵達貓床 — 已收到姿勢請求; 正在渲染端等待貓咪.
IGUI_CM_TestNapPending.cn: 猫已抵达猫床 — 已收到姿势请求; 正在渲染端等待猫咪.

IGUI_CM_TestScratchGoing.en: Cat is going to the scratcher.

IGUI_CM_TestScratchNone.en: No cat scratcher nearby (or no free tile beside it).
IGUI_CM_TestScratchNone.ch: 附近沒有貓抓柱 (或旁邊沒有空格子).
IGUI_CM_TestScratchNone.cn: 附近没有猫抓柱 (或旁边没有空格子).

IGUI_CM_TestScratchOk.en: Cat reached the scratcher — scratch pose requested on the rendering client.
IGUI_CM_TestScratchOk.ch: 貓已抵達貓抓柱 — 已向渲染端請求抓撓姿勢.
IGUI_CM_TestScratchOk.cn: 猫已抵达猫抓柱 — 已向渲染端请求抓挠姿势.

IGUI_CM_UnstuckFail.en: Could not rescue that cat right now.

IGUI_CM_UnstuckOk.en: Your cat was rescued and placed nearby.
IGUI_CM_UnstuckOk.ch: 你的貓已被解救並安置在附近.
IGUI_CM_UnstuckOk.cn: 你的猫已被解救并安置在附近.

IGUI_CM_ZombieWake.en: Your cat woke you — zombies nearby!
IGUI_CM_ZombieWake.ch: 你的貓把你叫醒了 — 附近有殭屍!
IGUI_CM_ZombieWake.cn: 你的猫把你叫醒了 — 附近有僵尸!

IGUI_ExtractionMode_RaidBoundaryVehicleU.en: RAID BOUNDARY [VEHICLES WILL BE LEFT BEHIND]
IGUI_ExtractionMode_RaidBoundaryVehicleU.ch: 突襲邊界 [車輛將被遺留]
IGUI_ExtractionMode_RaidBoundaryVehicleU.cn: 突袭边界 [车辆将被遗留]

IGUI_ExtractionMode_RaidRoadsBlockedPers.ch: [道路封鎖] 車輛無法撤離
IGUI_ExtractionMode_RaidRoadsBlockedPers.cn: [道路封锁] 车辆无法撤离

IGUI_ExtractionMode_RoadsBlockedVehicleA.en: SURVIVORS ONLY! THIS VEHICLE AND ALL CARGO WILL BE ABANDONED.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_RoadsBlockedVehicleA.ch: 僅倖存者可撤離! 此車輛與所有貨物將被遺留.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_RoadsBlockedVehicleA.cn: 仅幸存者可撤离! 此车辆与所有货物将被遗留.

IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc_cat.en: Full watch over the whole sentinel range. A quiet growl for distant or few zombies; a loud hiss for close, many or visible ones, and that hiss can draw zombies (the trade-off). The default.
IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc_cat.ch: 對整個哨兵範圍進行全面警戒. 對遠處或少數殭屍發出低聲咆哮; 對靠近, 大量或視野內的殭屍大聲嘶叫, 這種嘶叫會引來殭屍 (這是代價). 這是預設模式.
IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc_cat.cn: 对整个哨兵范围进行全面警戒. 对远处或少数僵尸发出低声咆哮; 对靠近, 大量或视野内的僵尸大声嘶叫, 这种嘶叫会引来僵尸 (这是代价). 这是默认模式.

IGUI_PD_AlertGroup_cat.en: Your %1 hisses! A group of zombies!
IGUI_PD_AlertGroup_cat.ch: 你的 %1 發出嘶叫! 有一群殭屍!
IGUI_PD_AlertGroup_cat.cn: 你的 %1 发出嘶叫! 有一群僵尸!

IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc_cat.en: Stealth watch: only a small nearby ring, and never more than a quiet growl and a halo, no loud hiss, no noise that draws zombies. A discreet heads-up that won't give away your position.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc_cat.ch: 隱蔽警戒: 僅在近距離小範圍內警戒, 且最多只會發出低聲咆哮和頭頂提示, 絕不大聲嘶叫, 不會發出引來殭屍的噪音. 這是一種不會暴露你位置的隱蔽警告.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc_cat.cn: 隐蔽警戒: 仅在近距离小范围内警戒, 且最多只会发出低声咆哮和头顶提示, 绝不大声嘶叫, 不会发出引来僵尸的噪音. 这是一种不会暴露你位置的隐蔽警告.

IGUI_PD_BadFood_cat.en: Bad for cats. Eating this makes it sick and breaks its trust.
IGUI_PD_BadFood_cat.ch: 對貓有害, 吃了會生病並失去對你的信任.
IGUI_PD_BadFood_cat.cn: 对猫有害, 吃了会生病并失去对你的信任.

IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc_cat.en: When on, your %1 tracks small game while following you and, once trained enough, chases it down: killing rodents and rabbits for you. Hunting is a rural activity (you find game in forests and the countryside, not in town). The cost is symmetric: the cat leaves your side and is exposed, the chase can draw zombies, it can wander off, and hunting works up an appetite. Off by default; toggle it per cat.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc_cat.ch: 開啟後, 你的 %1 會在跟隨你時追蹤小型獵物, 並在訓練足夠後追逐獵物: 為你獵殺齧齒動物和兔子. 狩獵是鄉村活動 (獵物在森林和鄉間, 不在城鎮). 代價是對等的: 貓會離開你身邊並暴露自己, 追逐可能引來殭屍, 牠可能走丟, 而且狩獵會讓牠食慾大增. 預設關閉, 可對每隻貓單獨開關.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc_cat.cn: 开启后, 你的 %1 会在跟随你时追踪小型猎物, 并在训练足够后追逐猎物: 为你猎杀啮齿动物和兔子. 狩猎是乡村活动 (猎物在森林和乡间, 不在城镇). 代价是对等的: 猫会离开你身边并暴露自己, 追逐可能引来僵尸, 它可能走丢, 而且狩猎会让它食欲大增. 默认关闭, 可对每只猫单独开关.

IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData_cat.en: No record yet, visit this cat once
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData_cat.ch: 暫無紀錄, 請先與這隻貓互動一次
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData_cat.cn: 暂无记录, 请先与这只猫互动一次

IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_cat.en: Your cat is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_cat.ch: 你的貓走了. 悲傷壓在你心上, 只能隨時間慢慢淡去.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_cat.cn: 你的猫走了. 悲伤压在你心上, 只能随时间慢慢淡去.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc_cat.en: Your cat is hungry. Feed it before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc_cat.ch: 你的貓餓了. 在牠的生命值開始受損前餵食吧.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc_cat.cn: 你的猫饿了. 在它的生命值开始受损前喂食吧.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc_cat.en: You slept soundly with your cat curled up beside you. For a while you feel calm and rested: panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc_cat.ch: 你的貓蜷在身邊, 你睡得很安穩. 一段時間內你感到平靜且精力充沛 - 恐慌, 壓力, 悲傷和無聊感消散得更快, 疲勞也更慢.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc_cat.cn: 你的猫蜷在身边, 你睡得很安稳. 一段时间内你感到平静且精力充沛 - 恐慌, 压力, 悲伤和无聊感消散得更快, 疲劳也更慢.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc_cat.en: You fed it something cats shouldn't eat. Your cat is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc_cat.ch: 你餵了貓不該吃的東西 - 你的貓中毒了, 感覺不適.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc_cat.cn: 你喂了猫不该吃的东西 - 你的猫中毒了, 感觉不适.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc_cat.en: Your cat is thirsty. Give it water before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc_cat.ch: 你的貓渴了. 在牠的生命值開始受損前餵水吧.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc_cat.cn: 你的猫渴了. 在它的生命值开始受损前喂水吧.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc_cat.en: Your cat is weak: it has gone a long time without protein. It obeys less.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc_cat.ch: 你的貓虛弱了: 牠已經很久沒攝取蛋白質, 服從性會下降.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc_cat.cn: 你的猫虚弱了: 它已经很久没摄取蛋白质, 服从性会下降.

IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip_cat.en: Kittens that never grow up? Wish real life had that toggle :D
IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip_cat.ch: 永遠長不大的幼貓? 真希望現實生活也有這個開關 :D
IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip_cat.cn: 永远长不大的幼猫? 真希望现实生活也有这个开关 :D

IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata_cat.en: There is no record of that cat to call it back.
IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata_cat.ch: 沒有該貓的紀錄, 無法召回.
IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata_cat.cn: 没有该猫的记录, 无法召回.

IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc_cat.en: The cat yowls on purpose to pull zombies toward itself, then falls back to you. It costs stress, and the horde goes for the cat.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc_cat.ch: 貓會刻意嚎叫把殭屍引向自己, 然後退回到你身邊. 代價是壓力上升, 而且屍群會衝向貓.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc_cat.cn: 猫会刻意嚎叫把僵尸引向自己, 然后退回到你身边. 代价是压力上升, 而且尸群会冲向猫.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc_cat.en: Hold an item and the cat memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc_cat.ch: 手持一件物品讓貓記住它. 之後你每次睡覺時, 牠會自己出門尋找, 並可能帶回一件收進馱袋. 每天一次, 物品越稀有花的時間越久. 需要馱袋.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc_cat.cn: 手持一件物品让猫记住它. 之后你每次睡觉时, 它会自己出门寻找, 并可能带回一件收进驮袋. 每天一次, 物品越稀有花的时间越久. 需要驮袋.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem_cat.en: Hold the item you want the cat to look for.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem_cat.ch: 請手持你想讓貓尋找的物品.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem_cat.cn: 请手持你想让猫寻找的物品.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc_cat.en: The cat forgets what it was looking for and stops going out while you sleep.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc_cat.ch: 貓會忘記原本要找的東西, 你睡覺時也不再出門.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc_cat.cn: 猫会忘记原本要找的东西, 你睡觉时也不再出门.

IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc_cat.en: Send the cat to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc_cat.ch: 派貓前往指定地格並在該處待命.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc_cat.cn: 派猫前往指定地格并在该处待命.

IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick_cat.en: Click where to send the cat. Right click cancels.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick_cat.ch: 點選要派貓前往的位置. 右鍵取消.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick_cat.cn: 点击要派猫前往的位置. 右键取消.

IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc_cat.en: Hold an item and the cat memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc_cat.ch: 手持一件物品讓貓記住它的氣味. 之後只要附近有同樣的物品, 牠就會提醒你並前往該物品所在處.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc_cat.cn: 手持一件物品让猫记住它的气味. 之后只要附近有同样的物品, 它就会提醒你并前往该物品所在处.

IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem_cat.en: Hold the item you want the cat to smell.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem_cat.ch: 請手持你想讓貓嗅聞的物品.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem_cat.cn: 请手持你想让猫嗅闻的物品.

IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc_cat.en: The cat forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc_cat.ch: 貓會忘記記住的氣味, 也不再為此提醒你.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc_cat.cn: 猫会忘记记住的气味, 也不再为此提醒你.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_OverPlayer_Tooltip.en: The numbers rise over your character instead of over the panel. They still appear while the panel is folded away.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_OverPlayer_Tooltip.ch: 數字會從角色頭上往上飄, 而不是從面板上方. 面板收合時數字照樣會出現.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_OverPlayer_Tooltip.cn: 数字会从角色头顶往上飘, 而不是从面板上方. 面板收起时数字照样会出现.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ReplaceVanillaXp.ch: 取代遊戲原本的經驗值文字
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ReplaceVanillaXp.cn: 替换游戏原本的经验值文字

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ReplaceVanillaXp_Tooltip.en: Turns off the game crafting XP texts and replaces every radio and TV notice with ours: Neat arrow and lettering above your head, with the skill icon when it is a skill.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ReplaceVanillaXp_Tooltip.ch: 關閉遊戲原本的製作經驗值文字, 並把收音機與電視的所有提示換成我們的樣式: 頭頂上的 Neat 箭頭與文字, 若是技能則附上技能圖示.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ReplaceVanillaXp_Tooltip.cn: 关闭游戏原本的制作经验值文字, 并把收音机和电视的所有提示换成我们的样式: 头顶上的 Neat 箭头和文字, 如果是技能则附上技能图标.

IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_Stack_Tooltip.en: When several skills gain XP at once, up to three panels appear, one below the other.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_Stack_Tooltip.ch: 多個技能同時獲得經驗值時, 最多會出現三個面板, 一個接一個往下排.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_Stack_Tooltip.cn: 多个技能同时获得经验值时, 最多会出现三个面板, 一个接一个往下排.

IGUI_GS_AddonUninstallConsequences.en: The peripheral will no longer be installed in this terminal. Its module is returned to your inventory and the uninstall disk is kept.
IGUI_GS_AddonUninstallConsequences.ch: 該周邊裝置將不再安裝在這台終端機上. 它的模組會歸還到你的物品欄, 解除安裝磁碟則會保留.
IGUI_GS_AddonUninstallConsequences.cn: 该外设将不再安装在这台终端上. 其模块会返回你的物品栏, 卸载磁盘则会保留.

IGUI_GS_AdminDeleteNetworkConsequences.en: This permanently removes its permissions, member list, zones and registry data. Physical terminals are not deleted, but terminals still linked to this network become unlinked and must be linked to a new or existing network. This cannot be undone.
IGUI_GS_AdminDeleteNetworkConsequences.ch: 這會永久移除它的權限、成員清單、區域與登記資料. 實體終端機不會被刪除, 但仍連結到此網路的終端機會變成未連結, 必須重新連結到新網路或現有網路. 此操作無法復原.
IGUI_GS_AdminDeleteNetworkConsequences.cn: 这会永久移除其权限、成员列表、区域和注册数据. 实体终端不会被删除, 但仍关联到此网络的终端会变为未关联, 必须关联到新网络或现有网络. 此操作无法撤销.

IGUI_GS_ApplyAllChangesTooltip.en: Save name, priority, and notes together on the server.
IGUI_GS_ApplyAllChangesTooltip.ch: 在伺服器上一併儲存名稱、優先順序與備註.
IGUI_GS_ApplyAllChangesTooltip.cn: 在服务器上一并保存名称、优先级和备注.

IGUI_GS_BlockedDeniedMessage.en: This terminal is installed, but you do not have permission to use its network.
IGUI_GS_BlockedDeniedMessage.ch: 這台終端機已安裝, 但你沒有使用其網路的權限.
IGUI_GS_BlockedDeniedMessage.cn: 这台终端已安装, 但你没有使用其网络的权限.

IGUI_GS_BlockedDeniedNextStep.en: Ask the network owner or an administrator for access.
IGUI_GS_BlockedDeniedNextStep.ch: 請向網路所有者或管理員申請存取權限.
IGUI_GS_BlockedDeniedNextStep.cn: 请向网络所有者或管理员申请访问权限.

IGUI_GS_BlockedInstallMessage.en: A free computer ready for terminal installation was detected.
IGUI_GS_BlockedInstallMessage.ch: 已偵測到一台可用於安裝終端機的空閒電腦.
IGUI_GS_BlockedInstallMessage.cn: 已检测到一台可用于安装终端的空闲电脑.

IGUI_GS_BlockedMissingMessage.en: The old record was retired. Place or obtain a computer to install a new terminal.
IGUI_GS_BlockedMissingMessage.ch: 舊紀錄已停用. 請放置或取得一台電腦以安裝新終端機.
IGUI_GS_BlockedMissingMessage.cn: 旧记录已停用. 请放置或获取一台电脑以安装新终端.

IGUI_GS_BlockedMissingTitle.ch: 找不到已註冊的終端機

IGUI_GS_BlockedNoTerminalMessage.en: Approach an installed terminal or prepare a free computer to install one.
IGUI_GS_BlockedNoTerminalMessage.ch: 走近已安裝的終端機, 或準備一台空閒電腦來安裝一台.
IGUI_GS_BlockedNoTerminalMessage.cn: 走近已安装的终端, 或准备一台空闲电脑来安装一台.

IGUI_GS_BlockedRecoverMessage.en: This terminal is installed. You can recover your previous access to this network.
IGUI_GS_BlockedRecoverMessage.ch: 這台終端機已安裝. 你可以恢復先前對此網路的存取權限.
IGUI_GS_BlockedRecoverMessage.cn: 这台终端已安装. 你可以恢复此前对此网络的访问权限.

IGUI_GS_BlockedRecoverTitle.ch: 可恢復先前的存取權限
IGUI_GS_BlockedRecoverTitle.cn: 可恢复此前的访问权限

IGUI_GS_BlockedRemoteMessage.en: No compatible antenna for this network is within tablet range.
IGUI_GS_BlockedRemoteMessage.ch: 平板範圍內沒有此網路的相容天線.
IGUI_GS_BlockedRemoteMessage.cn: 平板范围内没有此网络的兼容天线.

IGUI_GS_BlockedRemoteNextStep.en: Move closer to a network antenna or install a higher-level TabletLink.
IGUI_GS_BlockedRemoteNextStep.ch: 請靠近網路天線, 或安裝更高階的 TabletLink.
IGUI_GS_BlockedRemoteNextStep.cn: 请靠近网络天线, 或安装更高级的 TabletLink.

IGUI_GS_BlockedVacantMessage.en: This network has no active owner and you can claim it.
IGUI_GS_BlockedVacantMessage.ch: 此網路目前沒有生效中的所有者, 你可以認領它.
IGUI_GS_BlockedVacantMessage.cn: 此网络当前没有活动的所有者, 你可以认领它.

IGUI_GS_EditorRulesHint.en: Start with a broad category. Refine by subcategory or exact item and combine conditions when needed.
IGUI_GS_EditorRulesHint.ch: 先從大分類開始. 需要時再用子分類或確切物品細化, 並組合多個條件.
IGUI_GS_EditorRulesHint.cn: 先从大类开始. 需要时再用子分类或确切物品细化, 并组合多个条件.

IGUI_GS_MemberEditorLeaveConsequences.en: You will lose your access. If you are the owner, ownership passes to another admin or member; if none is available, the network is left without an owner.
IGUI_GS_MemberEditorLeaveConsequences.ch: 你將失去存取權限. 如果你是所有者, 所有權會轉移給其他管理員或成員; 若沒有可轉移的人, 此網路將變成無主.
IGUI_GS_MemberEditorLeaveConsequences.cn: 你将失去访问权限. 如果你是所有者, 所有权会转移给其他管理员或成员; 若没有可转移的人, 该网络将变为无所有者.

IGUI_GS_NativeAuditBusyMsg.en: A catalog audit is already running - wait for it to finish.
IGUI_GS_NativeAuditBusyMsg.ch: 已有目錄稽核正在執行 - 請等它完成.
IGUI_GS_NativeAuditBusyMsg.cn: 已有目录审核正在运行 - 请等它完成.

IGUI_GS_NativeAuditFailedMsg.en: The catalog audit failed unexpectedly - check the server log.
IGUI_GS_NativeAuditFailedMsg.ch: 目錄稽核意外失敗 - 請檢視伺服器日誌.
IGUI_GS_NativeAuditFailedMsg.cn: 目录审核意外失败 - 请查看服务器日志.

IGUI_GS_NativeAuditSummary.en: Audit done in {1}ms - {2} types, {3} pending, {4} unclassified, {5} invalid paths. Full report: {6}
IGUI_GS_NativeAuditSummary.ch: 稽核於 {1} 毫秒內完成 - {2} 種類型, {3} 待處理, {4} 未分類, {5} 個無效路徑. 完整報告: {6}
IGUI_GS_NativeAuditSummary.cn: 审核在 {1} 毫秒内完成 - {2} 种类型, {3} 待处理, {4} 未分类, {5} 个无效路径. 完整报告: {6}

IGUI_GS_NativeCorpusBusyMsg.en: A corpus validation is already running - wait for it to finish.
IGUI_GS_NativeCorpusBusyMsg.ch: 已有語料庫驗證正在執行 - 請等它完成.
IGUI_GS_NativeCorpusBusyMsg.cn: 已有语料库验证正在运行 - 请等它完成.

IGUI_GS_NativeCorpusFailedMsg.en: The corpus validation failed unexpectedly - check the server log.
IGUI_GS_NativeCorpusFailedMsg.ch: 語料庫驗證意外失敗 - 請檢視伺服器日誌.
IGUI_GS_NativeCorpusFailedMsg.cn: 语料库验证意外失败 - 请查看服务器日志.

IGUI_GS_NetworkIncidentTip.en: {1} container issue(s) in Network. Open Network to review them.
IGUI_GS_NetworkIncidentTip.ch: 網路中有 {1} 個容器問題. 請開啟網路分頁檢視.
IGUI_GS_NetworkIncidentTip.cn: 网络中有 {1} 个容器问题. 请打开网络选项卡查看.

IGUI_GS_NoFilterMatches.en: No items match the current filters.
IGUI_GS_NoFilterMatches.ch: 沒有物品符合目前的篩選條件.
IGUI_GS_NoFilterMatches.cn: 没有物品符合当前的筛选条件.

IGUI_GS_NodeExcludeConsequences.en: It will no longer participate in deposits or withdrawals. Its network record, rules and physical objects are retained.
IGUI_GS_NodeExcludeConsequences.ch: 它將不再參與存入或取出. 它的網路紀錄、規則與實體物件都會保留.
IGUI_GS_NodeExcludeConsequences.cn: 它将不再参与存入或取出. 其网络记录、规则和实体物体都会保留.

IGUI_GS_NodeExtendToZoneConsequences.en: Names, labels, priority and physical contents will not change.
IGUI_GS_NodeExtendToZoneConsequences.ch: 名稱、標籤、優先順序與實體內容都不會改變.
IGUI_GS_NodeExtendToZoneConsequences.cn: 名称、标签、优先级和实体内容都不会改变.

IGUI_GS_NodeExtendToZoneQuestion.en: Replace the acceptance protocol of {1} other containers in zone '{2}' with this container's rules?
IGUI_GS_NodeExtendToZoneQuestion.ch: 用這個容器的規則取代區域 '{2}' 中其他 {1} 個容器的接受協定?
IGUI_GS_NodeExtendToZoneQuestion.cn: 用该容器的规则替换区域 '{2}' 中其他 {1} 个容器的接受协议?

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindAmbiguous.en: Several matching replacement containers were found. Select the intended one; nothing is moved until you confirm it.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindAmbiguous.ch: 找到多個符合的替換容器. 請選擇你要的那一個; 在你確認之前不會移動任何東西.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindAmbiguous.cn: 找到多个匹配的替换容器. 请选择你想要的那一个; 在你确认之前不会移动任何东西.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindCandidateTooltip.en: Server-authoritative compatible destination. It is highlighted in the world.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindCandidateTooltip.ch: 伺服器認定的相容目標. 它會在遊戲世界中醒目顯示.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindCandidateTooltip.cn: 服务器认定的兼容目标. 它会在世界中高亮显示.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConfirm.en: Rebind '{1}' to '{2}'? Its rules and coverage move once; physical containers stay unchanged.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConfirm.ch: 將 '{1}' 重新綁定到 '{2}'? 它的規則與覆蓋範圍會一次性轉移; 實體容器不會改變.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConfirm.cn: 将 '{1}' 重新绑定到 '{2}'? 其规则和覆盖范围会一次性转移; 实体容器不会改变.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConflict.en: A new container was found in the same place, but its type or sprite differs. Nothing was moved: keep or remove the old configuration, then configure the new container if desired.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConflict.ch: 在同一位置找到了新容器, 但它的類型或貼圖不同. 沒有移動任何東西: 你可以保留或移除舊設定, 然後視需要設定新容器.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConflict.cn: 在同一位置找到了新容器, 但其类型或贴图不同. 没有移动任何东西: 你可以保留或移除旧配置, 然后按需配置新容器.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConsequences.en: Its rules and coverage move once; physical containers stay unchanged.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConsequences.ch: 它的規則與覆蓋範圍會一次性轉移; 實體容器不會改變.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindConsequences.cn: 其规则和覆盖范围会一次性转移; 实体容器不会改变.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindRejected.en: That replacement container is not a unique clean discovery in this network.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindRejected.ch: 那個替換容器在此網路中並不是唯一且乾淨的新發現.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindRejected.cn: 那个替换容器在此网络中并不是唯一且干净的新发现.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindSourceOnline.en: This container is still online. Nothing was moved.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindSourceOnline.ch: 這個容器仍處於連線狀態. 沒有移動任何東西.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindSourceOnline.cn: 这个容器仍然在线. 没有移动任何东西.

IGUI_GS_NodeRebindTooltip.en: Ask the server to find recent matching replacements. If there is more than one, it highlights them and requires your choice.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindTooltip.ch: 請伺服器尋找近期符合的替換容器. 若有多個, 它會醒目顯示並要求你選擇.
IGUI_GS_NodeRebindTooltip.cn: 请服务器查找近期匹配的替换容器. 若有多个, 它会高亮显示并要求你选择.

IGUI_GS_NodeReboundMsg.en: Container configuration rebound to the new discovery.
IGUI_GS_NodeReboundMsg.ch: 容器設定已重新綁定到新發現的容器.
IGUI_GS_NodeReboundMsg.cn: 容器配置已重新绑定到新发现的容器.

IGUI_GS_NodeRecoveryBody.en: The previous container is no longer available. A new container in the same position may inherit its saved configuration.
IGUI_GS_NodeRecoveryBody.ch: 先前的容器已無法使用. 位於同一位置的新容器可以繼承它已儲存的設定.
IGUI_GS_NodeRecoveryBody.cn: 先前的容器已不可用. 位于同一位置的新容器可以继承其已保存的配置.

IGUI_GS_NodeRemoveConsequences.en: This removes the network record and configuration for the container. The physical container and its objects remain intact.
IGUI_GS_NodeRemoveConsequences.ch: 這會移除該容器的網路紀錄與設定. 實體容器及其中的物件保持完好.

IGUI_CyesPushDoors_ForcedOpeningKey_Tool.en: Click, then press exactly two inputs. Keyboard keys and middle or extra mouse buttons are valid; left and right click are reserved. Default: Alt + E. It works on normal and double doors blocked by an excessive zombie crowd or a stronger valid PvP player.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_ForcedOpeningKey_Tool.ch: 點選後, 按下剛好兩個輸入鍵. 鍵盤按鍵與滑鼠中鍵或額外按鍵皆可使用; 滑鼠左鍵與右鍵不可使用. 預設值: Alt + E. 它適用於被過多殭屍或力量更強的有效 PvP 玩家擋住的普通門與雙開門.
IGUI_CyesPushDoors_ForcedOpeningKey_Tool.cn: 点击后, 按下正好两个输入键. 键盘按键以及鼠标中键或额外按键均可使用; 鼠标左键和右键不可使用. 默认值: Alt + E. 它适用于被过多僵尸或力量更强的有效 PvP 玩家挡住的普通门与双开门.

IGUI_GS_AdminMembersHelp.en: Select a member to view their identity and manage their access.

IGUI_GS_AdminMembersHelp.cn: 选择一名成员即可查看其标识信息并管理访问权限.

IGUI_GS_AdminNetworkActionsHelp.en: Releasing ownership leaves the network vacant. Deleting removes its logical record, never physical objects.
IGUI_GS_AdminNetworkActionsHelp.ch: 解除所有權會讓網路變成無主狀態. 刪除只會移除它的邏輯紀錄, 絕不會移除實體物件.
IGUI_GS_AdminNetworkActionsHelp.cn: 解除所有权会让网络变成无主状态. 删除只会移除其逻辑记录, 绝不会移除实体物体.

IGUI_GS_AdminSelectedNetworkHelp.en: Select a network; the selection is preserved when data refreshes.

IGUI_GS_AdminSelectedNetworkHelp.cn: 选择一个网络; 数据刷新时会保留当前的选择.

IGUI_GS_SuccessionBody.en: If you die, the network becomes ownerless. A member with access can claim it.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionBody.ch: 若你死亡, 此網路會變成無主狀態. 具有存取權限的成員可以認領它.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionBody.cn: 若你死亡, 该网络会变成无主状态. 拥有访问权限的成员可以认领它.

IGUI_GS_SuccessionHeaderHelp.en: Succession preserves a way to recover the network if its current owner dies.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionHeaderHelp.ch: 繼承機制會保留一條途徑, 讓目前的所有者死亡後仍能取回此網路.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionHeaderHelp.cn: 继承机制会保留一条途径, 让当前所有者死亡后仍能收回该网络.

IGUI_GS_SuccessionNoBackupHelp.en: No other member can claim the network if its owner dies.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionNoBackupHelp.ch: 若所有者死亡, 沒有其他成員能認領此網路.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionNoBackupHelp.cn: 若所有者死亡, 没有其他成员能认领该网络.

IGUI_GS_SuccessionNoBackupTooltip.en: No other members: if you die, this network will remain ownerless until an authorized identity can recover it.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionNoBackupTooltip.ch: 沒有其他成員: 若你死亡, 此網路會一直處於無主狀態, 直到有獲得授權的身分能將它取回.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionNoBackupTooltip.cn: 没有其他成员: 若你死亡, 该网络会一直处于无主状态, 直到有获得授权的身份能将它收回.

IGUI_GS_SuccessionTooltip.en: If you die, the network becomes ownerless. A successor with access can claim it; your own account retains priority to recover access.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionTooltip.ch: 若你死亡, 此網路會變成無主狀態. 具有存取權限的繼承者可以認領它; 你自己的帳號保有優先取回存取權限的權利.
IGUI_GS_SuccessionTooltip.cn: 若你死亡, 该网络会变成无主状态. 拥有访问权限的继承者可以认领它; 你自己的账号保有优先收回访问权限的权利.

IGUI_Breed_cat_barley._note: 新鍵落 sources/own_translations.json entries.IG_UI.json.IGUI_Breed_cat_barley（As1 未收錄，build 於 corpus 載入後合入）；已核對 own/As1 衍生/_unsorted/sources/ch/cn_overrides/unshipped 皆無此鍵，attribution_index 與全庫 sources/en 掃描顯示單一 owner（無 owner 衝突），且不在 vanilla_keys scoped_keys/keys 基準內（零本體覆寫）。CompanionCat 上游自帶 CH/CN 翻譯檔（本機 Workshop 副本 D:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/workshop/content/108600/3791294616/mods/CompanionCat/42/media/lua/shared/Translate/{CH,CN}/IG_UI.json），本批 6 個新毛色鍵在上游 CH/CN 已有官方值，且與我方既有 24 鍵譯法一致（tuxedo 上游 CH「賓士貓」＝我方 sources/ch 值；As1 CN「奶牛猫」亦與上游 CN 相同），故逐鍵採用上游原值以避免我方與 mod 自帶檔在全域字串表互相覆寫時出現兩種譯名。Barley Cat：查上游 Definitions/animal/CatDefinitions.lua:42 僅定義 name=cat_barley/texture=Cat_Barley，無顏色語意；實際貼圖 textures/Body/Cat_Barley.png 為黑底＋大塊奶油白斑（非大麥色系），判定 Barley 為專名而非顏色詞，故採音譯「巴利貓/巴利猫」（與上游 CH/CN 一致）。

IGUI_BoteBR_CombustivelAcabou.en: The engine sputtered and died... out of fuel.
IGUI_BoteBR_CombustivelAcabou.ch: 引擎噗噗幾聲就熄火了… 沒燃料了.
IGUI_BoteBR_CombustivelAcabou.cn: 发动机噗噗几声就熄火了… 没燃料了.
IGUI_BoteBR_CombustivelAcabou._note: 新增。engine 台灣用引擎、大陸用发动机（見 own ContextMenu_SimpleSuppressors_StopEngine）; 省略號沿用 As1 BoteBR 既有值的全角「…」（IGUI_BoteBR_PickedUp）。

IGUI_BoteBR_FalhaTransferir._note: 新增。transfer 沿用 own Tooltip_SimpleSuppressors_EngineOil「轉移液體/转移液体」; petrol→汽油。

IGUI_BoteBR_FillAll._note: 新增。選單動作句, 不加句點（同 As1 IGUI_BoteBR_PickUp「收起划艇」）。

IGUI_BoteBR_HUD_Empty._note: 新增。HUD 燃料量標示, EN 為全大寫單詞, 取最短可讀字。

IGUI_BoteBR_HUD_Low._note: 新增。HUD 低量警示; 括號與半角格式比照 EN "(LOW)"。

IGUI_BoteBR_LeaveHelm._note: 新增。與 TakeHelm「掌舵」成對; helm 沿用 As1 Tooltip_BoteBR_Trawler「在船艙內掌舵」。

IGUI_BoteBR_NivelCombustivel._note: 新增。L 台灣寫公升、大陸寫升（見 own Tooltip_SimpleSuppressors_EngineOil「1 公升」/「1 升」）; %1 %2 token 原樣保留。

IGUI_BoteBR_PareAntes.en: I can't do that while at the helm. Better stop the boat first.
IGUI_BoteBR_PareAntes.ch: 我在掌舵時沒辦法這麼做. 最好先把船停下來.
IGUI_BoteBR_PareAntes.cn: 我在掌舵时没办法这么做. 最好先把船停下来.
IGUI_BoteBR_PareAntes._note: 新增。第一人稱口語沿用 As1 IGUI_BoteBR_NeedShore「我得先划到離岸更近的地方.」。

IGUI_BoteBR_PlaceMetal._note: 新增。句式沿用 As1 IGUI_BoteBR_Place「將划艇放到水上」、PlaceTrawler「將漁船放到水上」; crab boat 對應新物品 Base.BoteBR_Metal。

IGUI_BoteBR_Recipiente._note: 新增。fluid container 沿用 own Tooltip_SimpleSuppressors_EngineOil 的「液體」用字。

IGUI_BoteBR_RecipienteCheio._note: 新增。句式沿用 own ContextMenu_SimpleSuppressors 系「容器已滿」用字。

IGUI_BoteBR_RecipienteSumiu.en: That container is no longer available.
IGUI_BoteBR_RecipienteSumiu._note: 新增。no longer available 指容器中途消失（被拿走/銷毀）。

IGUI_BoteBR_Refuel._note: 新增。與 own ContextMenu_SimpleSuppressors_TopUpOil「補充機油」一致的補充句式。

IGUI_BoteBR_SemCombustivel.en: The tank is empty. I need petrol.
IGUI_BoteBR_SemCombustivel.ch: 油箱空了. 我需要汽油.
IGUI_BoteBR_SemCombustivel.cn: 油箱空了. 我需要汽油.

IGUI_BoteBR_SemRecipiente.en: I don't have a suitable fluid container.
IGUI_BoteBR_SemRecipiente.ch: 我沒有合適的液體容器.
IGUI_BoteBR_SemRecipiente.cn: 我没有合适的液体容器.

IGUI_BoteBR_Sifonado.ch: 已抽出 %1 公升. 船隻燃料: %2 / %3 公升
IGUI_BoteBR_Sifonado.cn: 已抽出 %1 升. 船只燃料: %2 / %3 升
IGUI_BoteBR_Sifonado._note: 新增。與 IGUI_BoteBR_NivelCombustivel 同單位與句式; 三個 token 原樣保留。

IGUI_BoteBR_Siphon._note: 新增。與 IGUI_BoteBR_Sifonado「已抽出」同動詞族。

IGUI_BoteBR_StartEngine._note: 新增。沿用 own IGUI_SimpleSuppressors_OilDrained「發動引擎前請先補充.」/「启动发动机前请先补充.」的兩岸分工。

IGUI_BoteBR_StopEngine._note: 新增。沿用 own ContextMenu_SimpleSuppressors_StopEngine「保養前請先關閉引擎」/「保养前请先关闭发动机」。

IGUI_BoteBR_TanqueCheio.en: The boat's fuel tank is full.

IGUI_BoteBR_TanqueVazio.en: The boat's fuel tank is empty.

IGUI_PD_Breed_catbarley._note: 新鍵落 sources/own_translations.json entries.IG_UI.json.IGUI_PD_Breed_catbarley（As1 未收錄，build 於 corpus 載入後合入）；已核對 own/As1 衍生/_unsorted/sources/ch/cn_overrides/unshipped 皆無此鍵，attribution_index 與全庫 sources/en 掃描顯示單一 owner（無 owner 衝突），且不在 vanilla_keys scoped_keys/keys 基準內（零本體覆寫）。與 IGUI_Breed_cat_barley 為同一毛色的寵物面板鍵（上游 EN 同字串），值保持一致。CompanionCat 上游自帶 CH/CN 翻譯檔（本機 Workshop 副本 D:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/workshop/content/108600/3791294616/mods/CompanionCat/42/media/lua/shared/Translate/{CH,CN}/IG_UI.json），本批 6 個新毛色鍵在上游 CH/CN 已有官方值，且與我方既有 24 鍵譯法一致（tuxedo 上游 CH「賓士貓」＝我方 sources/ch 值；As1 CN「奶牛猫」亦與上游 CN 相同），故逐鍵採用上游原值以避免我方與 mod 自帶檔在全域字串表互相覆寫時出現兩種譯名。Barley Cat：查上游 Definitions/animal/CatDefinitions.lua:42 僅定義 name=cat_barley/texture=Cat_Barley，無顏色語意；實際貼圖 textures/Body/Cat_Barley.png 為黑底＋大塊奶油白斑（非大麥色系），判定 Barley 為專名而非顏色詞，故採音譯「巴利貓/巴利猫」（與上游 CH/CN 一致）。

IGUI_BSOS_SmokerDryingStatus.ch: 儲備燃料: %1 分鐘   煙燻爐: %2
IGUI_BSOS_SmokerDryingStatus.cn: 储备燃料: %1 分钟   烟熏炉: %2

IGUI_BSOS_SmokerRainDryingSlowdown.en: Outdoors and raining: herb drying is slowed.
IGUI_BSOS_SmokerRainDryingSlowdown.ch: 位於室外且正在下雨: 香草乾燥速度變慢.
IGUI_BSOS_SmokerRainDryingSlowdown.cn: 位于室外且正在下雨: 香草干燥速度变慢.

IGUI_BSOS_SmokerRainSlowdown.en: Outdoors and raining: smoking is slowed.
IGUI_BSOS_SmokerRainSlowdown.ch: 位於室外且正在下雨: 煙燻速度變慢.
IGUI_BSOS_SmokerRainSlowdown.cn: 位于室外且正在下雨: 烟熏速度变慢.

IGUI_BSOS_SmokerStatus.ch: 燃料: %1 分鐘   煙燻爐: %2
IGUI_BSOS_SmokerStatus.cn: 燃料: %1 分钟   烟熏炉: %2

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_AirCombat.en: There's dangerous activity overhead... I should get under cover.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_AirCombat.ch: 頭頂上有危險的活動… 我該找掩護躲起來.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_AirCombat.cn: 头顶上有危险的活动… 我该找掩护躲起来.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_AirUnsafe.en: That air doesn't feel right... I should cover up and find shelter.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_AirUnsafe.ch: 這空氣感覺不對勁… 我該摀住口鼻, 找地方避難.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_AirUnsafe.cn: 这空气感觉不对劲… 我该捂住口鼻, 找地方避难.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Broadcast.en: That transmission doesn't sound right... I should stay alert.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Broadcast.ch: 那段通訊聽起來不太對勁… 我該保持警覺.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Broadcast.cn: 那段通讯听起来不太对劲… 我该保持警觉.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Crash.en: That sounded like something went down... I should stay away from the impact area.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Crash.ch: 聽起來像是有東西墜落了… 我該遠離墜落區域.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Crash.cn: 听起来像是有东西坠落了… 我该远离坠落区域.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_DangerClose.en: It's getting closer... I need cover now!
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_DangerClose.ch: 它越來越近了… 我現在就需要掩護!
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_DangerClose.cn: 它越来越近了… 我现在就需要掩护!

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Ended.ch: 它正在遠離… 暫時是這樣.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Ended.cn: 它正在远离… 暂时是这样.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Generic.en: Something is happening out there... I should stay alert.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Generic.ch: 外面正在發生某些事… 我該保持警覺.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Generic.cn: 外面正在发生某些事… 我该保持警觉.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Interference.en: Something is disrupting everything... I can't rely on electronics right now.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Interference.ch: 有東西正在干擾一切… 我現在沒辦法依賴電子設備.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Interference.cn: 有东西正在干扰一切… 我现在没办法依赖电子设备.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Observed.en: Something keeps circling the area... I shouldn't remain exposed.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Observed.ch: 有東西一直在這片區域上空盤旋… 我不該繼續暴露在外.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Observed.cn: 有东西一直在这片区域上空盘旋… 我不该继续暴露在外.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_PermanentCessation.en: The helicopter flights have stopped... I don't think they're coming back.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_PermanentCessation.ch: 直升機的飛行已經停止了… 我想它們不會再回來了.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_PermanentCessation.cn: 直升机的飞行已经停止了… 我想它们不会再回来了.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Resources.en: They're operating nearby... I should secure what supplies I have.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Resources.ch: 他們正在附近行動… 我該確保手上的物資安全.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Resources.cn: 他们正在附近行动… 我该确保手上的物资安全.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Smoke.en: A thick cloud is moving in... I need shelter and a clear way out.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Smoke.ch: 一片濃厚的雲霧正在逼近… 我需要遮蔽處和一條暢通的退路.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_Smoke.cn: 一片浓厚的云雾正在逼近… 我需要遮蔽处和一条畅通的退路.

IGUI_HTT_Opt_Audio_Desc.en: Adjusts local playback volume for HTT event sounds. Does not change zombie attraction noise.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_Audio_Desc.ch: 調整 HTT 事件音效的本機播放音量. 不會改變吸引殭屍的噪音.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_Audio_Desc.cn: 调整 HTT 事件音效的本地播放音量. 不会改变吸引僵尸的噪音.

IGUI_HTT_Opt_EffectVolume_tt.en: Additional client-local volume control for explosions, weapons, voices, scans, and other event effects.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_EffectVolume_tt.ch: 針對爆炸、武器、語音、掃描以及其他事件效果的額外本機音量控制.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_EffectVolume_tt.cn: 针对爆炸、武器、语音、扫描以及其他事件效果的额外本地音量控制.

IGUI_HTT_Opt_EventVolume_tt.en: Master client-local volume. 100% uses the new half-volume baseline and multiplies the rotor and effect controls.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_EventVolume_tt.ch: 本機主音量. 100%% 代表使用新的半音量基準, 並與旋翼和效果音量控制相乘.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_EventVolume_tt.cn: 本地主音量. 100%% 代表使用新的半音量基准, 并与旋翼和效果音量控制相乘.

IGUI_HTT_Opt_RotorVolume_tt.en: Additional client-local volume control for rotors, flybys, and helicopter presence tracks.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_RotorVolume_tt.ch: 針對旋翼、飛掠以及直升機臨場音軌的額外本機音量控制.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_RotorVolume_tt.cn: 针对旋翼、飞掠以及直升机临场音轨的额外本地音量控制.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BombardmentEnd.en: The impacts have stopped... any fires they left behind may still be dangerous.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BombardmentEnd.ch: 落彈停止了… 它們留下的火勢可能仍然危險.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BombardmentEnd.cn: 落弹停止了… 它们留下的火势可能仍然危险.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BombardmentStart.en: I can hear markers and distant impacts... nearby areas are being hit; I need to avoid the explosions and fire.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BombardmentStart.ch: 我聽得見標記彈和遠處的落彈… 附近區域正在遭受打擊; 我必須避開爆炸和火.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BombardmentStart.cn: 我听得见标记弹和远处的落弹… 附近区域正在遭受打击; 我必须避开爆炸和火.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BroadcastEnd.en: The transmission ended... the noise and the dead it drew may remain.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BroadcastEnd.ch: 通訊結束了… 噪音和它引來的死者可能還在.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BroadcastEnd.cn: 通讯结束了… 噪音和它引来的死者可能还在.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BroadcastStart.en: That voice from the air is drawing attention across the area... the noise may bring more of the dead.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BroadcastStart.ch: 空中傳來的那個聲音正在吸引整片區域的注意… 這些噪音可能會引來更多死者.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_BroadcastStart.cn: 空中传来的那个声音正在吸引整片区域的注意… 这些噪音可能会引来更多死者.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_CrashEnd.en: I can't hear any more air activity... the impact site will keep drawing trouble.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_CrashEnd.ch: 我再也聽不到任何空中的動靜了… 墜落地點還是會不斷招來麻煩.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_CrashEnd.cn: 我再也听不到任何空中的动静了… 坠落地点还是会不断招来麻烦.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_CrashStart.en: Something large just went down... that crash will draw the dead toward the impact area.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_CrashStart.ch: 有個大傢伙剛剛墜落了… 那場墜毀會把死者引向墜落區域.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_CrashStart.cn: 有个大家伙刚刚坠落了… 那场坠毁会把死者引向坠落区域.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_FuelEnd.en: The operation is over... I should check how much fuel remains in the nearby pumps.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_FuelEnd.ch: 行動結束了… 我該去看看附近的加油機裡還剩多少燃料.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_FuelEnd.cn: 行动结束了… 我该去看看附近的加油机里还剩多少燃料.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_FuelStart.en: That helicopter is operating over the gas stations... the pumps may not keep all their fuel.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_FuelStart.ch: 那架直升機正在加油站上空作業… 加油機裡的燃料可能保不住了.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_FuelStart.cn: 那架直升机正在加油站上空作业… 加油机里的燃料可能保不住了.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileActive.en: They're firing at me now! I need to break their line of sight and find solid cover.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileActive.ch: 他們現在正朝我開火! 我得切斷他們的視線, 找到堅固的掩護.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileActive.cn: 他们现在正朝我开火! 我得切断他们的视线, 找到坚固的掩护.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileEnd.en: It's finally moving away... it seems to have stopped hunting me.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileEnd.ch: 它終於遠離了… 看來它已經不再追獵我了.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileEnd.cn: 它终于远离了… 看来它已经不再追猎我了.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileStart.en: That helicopter is tracking my movements... if it opens fire, a roof and solid walls will be my best option.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileStart.ch: 那架直升機正在追蹤我的行動… 如果它開火, 有屋頂和堅固牆壁的地方會是我最好的選擇.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_HostileStart.cn: 那架直升机正在追踪我的行动… 如果它开火, 有屋顶和坚固墙壁的地方会是我最好的选择.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_IncendiaryEnd.en: The incendiary pass is over... but the fires it left may keep spreading.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_IncendiaryEnd.ch: 燃燒彈的掃射結束了… 但它留下的火勢可能還會繼續蔓延.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_IncendiaryEnd.cn: 燃烧弹的扫射结束了… 但它留下的火势可能还会继续蔓延.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_IncendiaryStart.en: That flight is leaving pockets of fire behind... I need to stay away from the smoke and anything that starts burning.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_IncendiaryStart.ch: 那趟飛行一路留下一處處火點… 我必須遠離濃煙和任何開始燃燒的東西.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_IncendiaryStart.cn: 那趟飞行一路留下一处处火点… 我必须远离浓烟和任何开始燃烧的东西.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_InterferenceEnd.en: The interference is fading... the equipment should begin responding again.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_InterferenceEnd.ch: 干擾正在減弱… 設備應該會重新有反應了.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_InterferenceEnd.cn: 干扰正在减弱… 设备应该会重新有反应了.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_InterferenceStart.en: That pulse disrupted the equipment... lights, radios, and watches may fail until it passes.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_InterferenceStart.ch: 那道脈衝干擾了設備… 在它過去之前, 燈具、無線電和手錶都可能失靈.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_InterferenceStart.cn: 那道脉冲干扰了设备… 在它过去之前, 灯具、无线电和手表都可能失灵.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SmokeEnd.en: They're no longer deploying smoke... the cloud will still take time to clear.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SmokeEnd.ch: 他們不再施放煙霧了… 這片雲霧還是需要一段時間才會散去.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SmokeEnd.cn: 他们不再施放烟雾了… 这片云雾还是需要一段时间才会散去.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SmokeStart.en: They're deploying a smoke screen... visibility will drop; I need to remember a clear route out.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SmokeStart.ch: 他們正在施放煙幕… 能見度會下降; 我得記住一條暢通的撤離路線.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SmokeStart.cn: 他们正在施放烟幕… 能见度会下降; 我得记住一条畅通的撤离路线.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SniperSupportEnd.en: The precise shots have stopped... the path should be a little clearer now.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SniperSupportEnd.ch: 那些精準的射擊停止了… 現在路上應該會稍微乾淨一些.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SniperSupportEnd.cn: 那些精准的射击停止了… 现在路上应该会稍微干净一些.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SniperSupportStart.en: Those isolated shots are dropping nearby zombies... someone seems to be clearing a path for me.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SniperSupportStart.ch: 那些零星的槍聲正在放倒附近的殭屍… 似乎有人在替我清出一條路.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SniperSupportStart.cn: 那些零星的枪声正在放倒附近的僵尸… 似乎有人在替我清出一条路.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SupportEnd.en: The supporting bursts are moving away... at least they should have thinned the zombies around me.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SupportEnd.ch: 支援的連射正在遠離… 至少它們應該已經削減了我周圍的殭屍數量.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SupportEnd.cn: 支援的连射正在远离… 至少它们应该已经削减了我周围的僵尸数量.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SupportStart.en: Those bursts are coming from the air and dropping zombies near me... they don't seem to be firing at survivors.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SupportStart.ch: 那些連射是從空中打來的, 正在放倒我附近的殭屍… 他們似乎不會朝倖存者開火.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SupportStart.cn: 那些连射是从空中打来的, 正在放倒我附近的僵尸… 他们似乎不会朝幸存者开火.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SurveillanceEnd.en: It stopped circling... I hope it lost my trail.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SurveillanceEnd.ch: 它不再盤旋了… 希望它跟丟了我的行蹤.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SurveillanceEnd.cn: 它不再盘旋了… 希望它跟丢了我的行踪.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SurveillanceStart.en: That aircraft isn't just passing by... it's watching the area and seems to be following my movements.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SurveillanceStart.ch: 那架飛行器不只是路過而已… 它正在監視這片區域, 而且似乎在跟隨我的行動.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_SurveillanceStart.cn: 那架飞行器不只是路过而已… 它正在监视这片区域, 而且似乎在跟随我的行动.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicActive.en: The cloud is here... I need to stay indoors and keep my breathing covered.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicActive.ch: 雲霧已經到了… 我得待在室內, 並且遮住口鼻呼吸.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicActive.cn: 云雾已经到了… 我得待在室内, 并且遮住口鼻呼吸.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicEnd.en: The cloud is starting to disperse... I'll wait indoors a little longer before breathing easy.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicEnd.ch: 雲霧開始散開了… 我還是在室內多等一會兒再放心呼吸.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicEnd.cn: 云雾开始散开了… 我还是在室内多等一会儿再放心呼吸.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicStart.en: That helicopter is releasing something... the air is about to turn dangerous; I need a sealed interior and breathing protection.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicStart.ch: 那架直升機正在釋放某種東西… 空氣即將變得危險; 我需要一個密閉的室內空間和呼吸防護.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_ToxicStart.cn: 那架直升机正在释放某种东西… 空气即将变得危险; 我需要一个密闭的室内空间和呼吸防护.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_UAVEnd.en: The buzzing is moving away... it looks like the sweep of this area is over.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_UAVEnd.ch: 嗡嗡聲正在遠離… 看來對這片區域的掃描結束了.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_UAVEnd.cn: 嗡嗡声正在远离… 看来对这片区域的扫描结束了.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_UAVStart.en: That buzzing is scanning the area... I should turn on my long-range radio.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_UAVStart.ch: 那陣嗡嗡聲正在掃描這片區域… 我該打開我的長程無線電.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_UAVStart.cn: 那阵嗡嗡声正在扫描这片区域… 我该打开我的远程无线电.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_VehicleStrikeEnd.en: The attack on the vehicle is over... they probably left it disabled.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_VehicleStrikeEnd.ch: 對那輛車的攻擊結束了… 他們大概已經讓它動彈不得了.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_VehicleStrikeEnd.cn: 对那辆车的攻击结束了… 他们大概已经让它动弹不得了.

IGUI_HTT_EventHint_VehicleStrikeStart.en: Those bursts are aimed at a nearby military vehicle, not me... I should avoid getting close while the attack continues.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_VehicleStrikeStart.ch: 那些連射瞄準的是附近的一輛軍用車輛, 不是我… 在攻擊持續期間, 我應該避免靠近.
IGUI_HTT_EventHint_VehicleStrikeStart.cn: 那些连射瞄准的是附近的一辆军用车辆, 不是我… 在攻击持续期间, 我应该避免靠近.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BalatroidResetBod.cn: 当前这轮挑战及其中的小丑牌与金钱都会消失. 此操作无法撤销.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkDartsJoin3.en: Three darts is all I need.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkDartsLose2.cn: 今晚怎么投都中不了双倍区.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkHoldemBeat1.ch: 又是在河牌圈. 當然囉.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkHoldemBeat1.cn: 又是在河牌圈. 当然了.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkPoolBeat1.en: I do not believe that went in.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkPoolBeat1.cn: 我不敢相信那颗球进了.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_BarkPoolLose2.cn: 球偏掉了. 每次都会偏.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBalatroidBui.en: Between blinds, spend money in the shop to improve the run. Jokers change scoring and other effects; planet cards improve hand levels. Inspect an item's description and price before buying. Deck choice and unlocked stakes change later runs. This game is beta; its server setting controls whether it is available.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBalatroidBui.ch: 在盲注之間, 可以在商店花錢強化本輪挑戰. 小丑牌會改變計分與其他效果; 星球牌可以提升牌型等級. 購買前先看清楚物品的說明與價格. 牌組選擇與已解鎖的賭注等級會影響之後的每輪挑戰. 本遊戲為測試版; 是否可以遊玩由伺服器設定決定.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBalatroidBui.cn: 在盲注之间, 可以在商店花钱强化本轮挑战. 小丑牌会改变计分与其他效果; 星球牌可以提升牌型等级. 购买前先看清楚物品的说明与价格. 牌组选择与已解锁的赌注等级会影响之后的每轮挑战. 本游戏为测试版; 是否可以游玩由服务器设置决定.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBalatroidPla.en: Select cards to form a poker hand, then play them to score chips multiplied by mult. Discard to replace selected cards. Hands and discards are limited, so reach the blind's target before your hands run out. Read each blind's rule before committing: boss effects can change what works.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBalatroidPla.ch: 選擇手牌組成撲克牌型, 再打出去, 得分是籌碼乘上倍率. 棄牌可以換掉選取的牌. 出牌次數與棄牌次數都有限, 要在出牌次數用完之前達到該盲注的目標分數. 出手前先讀過每個盲注的規則: 首領盲注的效果會改變哪些打法有用.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBalatroidPla.cn: 选择手牌组成扑克牌型, 再打出去, 得分是筹码乘上倍率. 弃牌可以换掉选取的牌. 出牌次数与弃牌次数都有限, 要在出牌次数用完之前达到该盲注的目标分数. 出手前先读过每个盲注的规则: 首领盲注的效果会改变哪些打法有用.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackAct.en: Hit takes a card. Stand keeps your total. With two cards and enough chips, Double adds a matching bet, takes one card, then stands. Split separates two cards of the same rank into two hands with matching bets. You can split once. Each resulting hand plays separately. Disabled controls explain why an action is unavailable.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackAct.ch: 要牌會再拿一張牌. 停牌則保留目前的點數. 在只有兩張牌且籌碼足夠時, 加倍會補上等額的賭注, 再拿一張牌, 然後停牌. 分牌會把兩張同點數的牌拆成兩副手牌, 各下等額的賭注. 分牌只能做一次. 拆出來的每副手牌分開進行. 無法按下的按鈕會說明該動作為何不能使用.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackAct.cn: 要牌会再拿一张牌. 停牌则保留目前的点数. 在只有两张牌且筹码足够时, 加倍会补上等额的赌注, 再拿一张牌, 然后停牌. 分牌会把两张同点数的牌拆成两副手牌, 各下等额的赌注. 分牌只能做一次. 拆出来的每副手牌分开进行. 无法按下的按钮会说明该动作为何不能使用.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackPay.en: Going over 21 is a bust and loses the bet. A winning ordinary hand pays even money; a natural blackjack pays 3:2. A push returns your bet. Example: a winning 10-chip ordinary bet returns 20 chips in total, including the original 10. The shared card-room bankroll remains with your character when records are enabled.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackPay.ch: 超過 21 點就是爆牌, 賭注輸掉. 一般手牌獲勝時以 1 賠 1 支付; 天生的二十一點則賠 3:2. 平手會退還你的賭注. 舉例: 一般下注 10 枚籌碼並獲勝, 總共拿回 20 枚, 其中包含原本的 10 枚. 啟用紀錄時, 共用的牌室資金會跟著你的角色保存.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackPay.cn: 超过 21 点就是爆牌, 赌注输掉. 一般手牌获胜时以 1 赔 1 支付; 天生的二十一点则赔 3:2. 平手会退还你的赌注. 举例: 一般下注 10 枚筹码并获胜, 总共拿回 20 枚, 其中包含原本的 10 枚. 启用记录时, 共用的牌室资金会跟着你的角色保存.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackSta.en: Choose a bet, then deal when every seated player has bet or chosen to sit out. Each hand plays against the dealer. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Number cards use their number; face cards are 10. An Ace counts as 11 when that fits, otherwise 1. The dealer stands on 17, including soft 17.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackSta.ch: 先選好賭注, 等每位入座的玩家都下注或選擇這局不玩之後再發牌. 每副手牌都是跟莊家對決. 在不超過 21 點的前提下, 讓點數比莊家更接近 21. 數字牌按牌面數字計算; 人頭牌算 10 點. A 在不會超過時算 11 點, 否則算 1 點. 莊家到 17 點就停牌, 軟 17 也一樣.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideBlackjackSta.cn: 先选好赌注, 等每位入座的玩家都下注或选择这局不玩之后再发牌. 每副手牌都是跟庄家对决. 在不超过 21 点的前提下, 让点数比庄家更接近 21. 数字牌按牌面数字计算; 人头牌算 10 点. A 在不会超过时算 11 点, 否则算 1 点. 庄家到 17 点就停牌, 软 17 也一样.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideCheckersMove.en: Select a counter, then a highlighted diagonal square, or drag the counter onto it. Ordinary counters move toward the far edge. To capture, jump over an opposing counter into the empty square beyond it. If a capture is available, a jump is required. Continue with the same counter when another jump is available.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideCheckersMove.ch: 先選取一枚棋子, 再選擇醒目提示的斜角格, 或把棋子拖到該格. 一般棋子只能朝對面底線的方向前進. 要吃子就跳過對方的棋子, 落到它後面的空格. 只要有子可吃, 就必須跳吃. 同一枚棋子還有下一次跳吃時, 要用它繼續跳.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideCheckersMove.cn: 先选取一枚棋子, 再选择醒目提示的斜角格, 或把棋子拖到该格. 一般棋子只能朝对面底线的方向前进. 要吃子就跳过对方的棋子, 落到它后面的空格. 只要有子可吃, 就必须跳吃. 同一枚棋子还有下一次跳吃时, 要用它继续跳.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideCheckersWinB.en: Reach the far edge to become a king. Kings can move and jump in both directions. Win when the opponent has no counters or no legal move. The two sides use blue and red counters. Add a bot for a solo game.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideCheckersWinB.ch: 棋子走到對面底線就會升為王棋. 王棋可以朝兩個方向移動與跳吃. 對手沒有棋子, 或沒有合法走法時就獲勝. 雙方分別使用藍色與紅色棋子. 想一個人玩可以加入電腦玩家.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideCheckersWinB.cn: 棋子走到对面底线就会升为王棋. 王棋可以朝两个方向移动与跳吃. 对手没有棋子, 或没有合法走法时就获胜. 双方分别使用蓝色与红色棋子. 想一个人玩可以加入电脑玩家.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessEndBody.en: Check means your king is attacked: the next move must remove the check. Checkmate means the king is in check with no legal reply, and loses. Stalemate means the player to move has no legal move but is not in check, and draws. Add a bot to play alone. Resign concedes the game; a draw offer needs the opponent's agreement.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessEndBody.ch: 將軍表示你的王正被攻擊: 下一步必須解除將軍. 將死表示王被將軍而且沒有任何合法應手, 該方落敗. 逼和表示輪到走棋的一方沒有合法走法, 但並未被將軍, 棋局判為和局. 想一個人玩可以加入電腦玩家. 認輸就是放棄這盤棋, 直接判對手獲勝; 提和需要對手同意.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessEndBody.cn: 将军表示你的王正被攻击: 下一步必须解除将军. 将死表示王被将军而且没有任何合法应手, 该方落败. 逼和表示轮到走棋的一方没有合法走法, 但并未被将军, 棋局判为和局. 想一个人玩可以加入电脑玩家. 认输就是放弃这盘棋, 直接判对手获胜; 提和需要对手同意.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessMoveBod.en: Select your piece, then a legal highlighted square, or drag the piece onto it. Rooks move along ranks or files. Bishops move diagonally. Queens do both. These pieces cannot jump over others. Knights move two squares in one direction and one across, and can jump. Kings move one square and cannot enter an attacked square.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessMoveBod.ch: 先選取自己的棋子, 再選擇醒目提示的合法格子, 或把棋子拖到該格. 車沿著橫列或直行移動. 象走斜線. 后兩種走法都可以. 這些棋子都不能越過其他棋子. 馬先朝一個方向走兩格, 再橫向走一格, 而且可以跳過棋子. 王每次走一格, 也不能走進被攻擊的格子.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessMoveBod.cn: 先选取自己的棋子, 再选择醒目提示的合法格子, 或把棋子拖到该格. 车沿着横排或纵列移动. 象走斜线. 后两种走法都可以. 这些棋子都不能越过其他棋子. 马先朝一个方向走两格, 再横向走一格, 而且可以跳过棋子. 王每次走一格, 也不能走进被攻击的格子.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessPawnsBo.en: Pawns move one square forward into an empty square, or two from their starting square if both are clear. They capture one square diagonally forward. A pawn on the far rank promotes. En passant captures a pawn immediately after its two-square advance. Castling moves the king and rook together: move the king two squares toward the rook, or onto the rook itself. Neither may have moved, and the king cannot castle out of, through, or into check.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessPawnsBo.ch: 兵每次往前走一格到空格; 若還在起始格且前面兩格都沒有棋子, 也可以一次走兩格. 兵吃子是走斜前方一格. 走到對面底線的兵可以升變. 吃過路兵只能在對方的兵剛走完兩格之後立刻進行. 王車易位會同時移動王和車: 把王朝車的方向移動兩格, 或直接移到車所在的格子上. 兩者都必須還沒移動過, 而且王不能在被將軍時易位, 也不能經過或走進被攻擊的格子.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideChessPawnsBo.cn: 兵每次往前走一格到空格; 若还在起始格且前面两格都没有棋子, 也可以一次走两格. 兵吃子是走斜前方一格. 走到对面底线的兵可以升变. 吃过路兵只能在对方的兵刚走完两格之后立刻进行. 王车易位会同时移动王和车: 把王朝车的方向移动两格, 或直接移到车所在的格子上. 两者都必须还没移动过, 而且王不能在被将军时易位, 也不能经过或走进被攻击的格子.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideConnect4Play.en: Choose a column to drop one counter into its lowest empty space. Players alternate turns. Connect four of your counters horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win. A full column cannot accept another counter. A full board with no winner is a draw. Add a bot to play alone.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideConnect4Play.ch: 選一欄投入一枚棋子, 棋子會落到該欄最低的空位. 雙方輪流下. 讓自己的四枚棋子連成橫線, 直線或斜線就獲勝. 已經投滿的一欄不能再投入棋子. 棋盤投滿卻沒有人連成四子就是和局. 想一個人玩可以加入電腦玩家.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideConnect4Play.cn: 选一列投入一枚棋子, 棋子会落到该列最低的空位. 双方轮流下. 让自己的四枚棋子连成横线, 竖线或斜线就获胜. 已经投满的一列不能再投入棋子. 棋盘投满却没有人连成四子就是和局. 想一个人玩可以加入电脑玩家.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideDartsFinishB.en: Subtract each score from your remaining total. Win by reaching exactly zero with a double; the centre bull counts as a double. Going below zero, leaving one, or reaching zero without a double busts the turn and restores its starting score. Example: with 40 left, double 20 wins. Your character's condition can affect accuracy.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideDartsFinishB.ch: 每次的得分都會從你剩下的總分裡扣掉. 必須以雙倍區剛好扣到零才算獲勝; 中心牛眼也算雙倍. 扣到低於零, 只剩 1 分, 或是沒用雙倍就歸零, 本回合都算爆鏢, 分數會退回本回合開始時的數字. 舉例: 剩 40 分時, 打中 20 的雙倍區就獲勝. 角色的身體狀況會影響準度.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideDartsFinishB.cn: 每次的得分都会从你剩下的总分里扣掉. 必须以双倍区刚好扣到零才算获胜; 中心牛眼也算双倍. 扣到低于零, 只剩 1 分, 或是没用双倍就归零, 本回合都算爆镖, 分数会退回本回合开始时的数字. 举例: 剩 40 分时, 打中 20 的双倍区就获胜. 角色的身体状况会影响准度.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideDartsThrowBo.en: Each player starts at 501. Flick upward on the board to throw. For a keyboard throw, focus the board, choose the target, then use the throw control. Each turn has three darts. A single scores the number, the narrow outer ring scores double, and the inner ring scores triple. The outer bull is 25; the centre bull is 50.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideDartsThrowBo.ch: 每位玩家都從 501 分開始. 在鏢靶上往上快速滑動就能投擲. 用鍵盤投擲時, 先把焦點移到鏢靶, 選好目標, 再使用投擲按鈕. 每個回合有三支鏢. 單倍區得該區的分數, 外側的窄環算雙倍, 內側的窄環算三倍. 外圈牛眼是 25 分; 中心牛眼是 50 分.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideDartsThrowBo.cn: 每位玩家都从 501 分开始. 在镖盘上往上快速滑动就能投掷. 用键盘投掷时, 先把焦点移到镖盘, 选好目标, 再使用投掷按钮. 每个回合有三支镖. 单倍区得该区的分数, 外侧的窄环算双倍, 内侧的窄环算三倍. 外圈牛眼是 25 分; 中心牛眼是 50 分.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemBetsBo.en: Check passes without adding chips when nothing is owed. Call matches the current bet. Raise increases it. Fold gives up this hand and chips already committed. All-in commits your remaining stack. Side pots keep a short stack eligible only for the chips it has matched. Blinds are forced opening bets based on the table stake.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemBetsBo.ch: 沒有需要跟的注時, 過牌就是不加籌碼直接讓過. 跟注是補到目前的注額. 加注則是把注額提高. 棄牌會放棄這手牌以及已經投入的籌碼. 全押是把剩下的籌碼全部投入. 有邊池時, 籌碼較少的玩家只能贏到他有跟到的那部分籌碼. 盲注是依牌桌注額強制投入的開局下注.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemBetsBo.cn: 没有需要跟的注时, 过牌就是不加筹码直接让过. 跟注是补到目前的注额. 加注则是把注额提高. 弃牌会放弃这手牌以及已经投入的筹码. 全押是把剩下的筹码全部投入. 有边池时, 筹码较少的玩家只能赢到他有跟到的那部分筹码. 盲注是依牌桌注额强制投入的开局下注.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemExampl.en: If the current bet is 10 and you have already put in 4 this betting round, calling adds 6. A raise makes the total to match larger; the action control shows its amount. Chips committed in earlier rounds are already in the pot. Read the amount before confirming an action. Cashing out through Leave returns the chips still in your stack.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemExampl.ch: 如果目前的注額是 10, 而你在這一輪下注已經投入 4, 跟注就再補 6. 加注會讓要跟的總額變大; 按鈕上會顯示金額. 前幾輪投入的籌碼已經在底池裡. 確認動作之前先看清楚金額. 用離開結算時, 會把你籌碼堆裡剩下的籌碼換回來.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemExampl.cn: 如果目前的注额是 10, 而你在这一轮下注已经投入 4, 跟注就再补 6. 加注会让要跟的总额变大; 按钮上会显示金额. 前几轮投入的筹码已经在底池里. 确认动作之前先看清楚金额. 用离开结算时, 会把你筹码堆里剩下的筹码换回来.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemHandsB.en: Straight flush: five consecutive cards of one suit. Four of a kind. Full house: three of one rank and two of another. Flush: five of one suit. Straight: five consecutive ranks. Three of a kind. Two pair. One pair. High card. A royal flush is the highest straight flush. An Ace can be low in A-2-3-4-5. Equal categories compare their ranks and remaining kickers; equal hands split the pot.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemHandsB.ch: 同花順: 同一花色的五張連續牌. 四條. 葫蘆: 三張同點數加上另一點數的一對. 同花: 同一花色的五張牌. 順子: 五張連續點數. 三條. 兩對. 一對. 高牌. 皇家同花順是最大的同花順. A 在 A-2-3-4-5 裡可以當最小的牌. 牌型相同時比較點數與其餘的踢腳牌; 完全相同的牌型平分底池.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemHandsB.cn: 同花顺: 同一花色的五张连续牌. 四条. 葫芦: 三张同点数加上另一点数的一对. 同花: 同一花色的五张牌. 顺子: 五张连续点数. 三条. 两对. 一对. 高牌. 皇家同花顺是最大的同花顺. A 在 A-2-3-4-5 里可以当最小的牌. 牌型相同时比较点数与其余的踢脚牌; 完全相同的牌型平分底池.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemStartB.en: Buy in and seat at least two players, including bots if wanted. Each player gets two private cards. Five shared cards appear in stages: three on the flop, one on the turn, one on the river. Your best five-card hand can use any combination of your cards and the shared cards. Win at showdown, or make every opponent fold.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemStartB.ch: 先買入並讓至少兩位玩家入座, 需要的話也可以加入電腦玩家. 每位玩家會拿到兩張底牌. 五張公共牌分階段發出: 翻牌圈三張, 轉牌圈一張, 河牌圈一張. 你的最佳五張牌可以任意搭配自己的牌與公共牌. 在攤牌時獲勝, 或是讓每位對手都棄牌.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideHoldemStartB.cn: 先买入并让至少两位玩家入座, 需要的话也可以加入电脑玩家. 每位玩家会拿到两张底牌. 五张公共牌分阶段发出: 翻牌圈三张, 转牌圈一张, 河牌圈一张. 你的最佳五张牌可以任意搭配自己的牌与公共牌. 在摊牌时获胜, 或是让每位对手都弃牌.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuidePoolControls.en: Right-drag on the felt to aim. Use the wheel for power, then click or press Space to shoot. Arrow keys adjust aim and power. Ctrl + wheel changes spin. With ball in hand, choose a clear spot for the cue ball before shooting.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuidePoolControls.ch: 在檯面上按住右鍵拖曳來瞄準. 用滾輪調整力道, 再點選或按空白鍵擊球. 方向鍵可以微調瞄準與力道. Ctrl + 滾輪可以改變旋球. 拿到自由球時, 先為母球選一個沒有阻礙的位置再擊球.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuidePoolControls.cn: 在台面上按住右键拖曳来瞄准. 用滚轮调整力道, 再点击或按空格键击球. 方向键可以微调瞄准与力道. Ctrl + 滚轮可以改变旋球. 拿到自由球时, 先为母球选一个没有阻碍的位置再击球.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuidePoolRulesBod.en: In 8-Ball, clear your group, then pocket the 8-ball legally. In 9-Ball, hit the lowest numbered ball first; legally pocketing the 9 wins. The rules chip names the active rules. Standard 8-Ball requires a called ball and pocket. Casual 8-Ball removes ordinary called shots. A scratch is a foul. Read the table's foul message before the next shot.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuidePoolRulesBod.ch: 8 號球玩法要先清光自己那一組的球, 再合規地把 8 號球打進. 9 號球玩法必須先碰到號碼最小的球; 合規地打進 9 號球就獲勝. 規則標籤會顯示目前採用的規則. 標準 8 號球玩法必須指定球和球袋. 休閒 8 號球玩法取消了一般擊球的指定. 母球落袋算犯規. 下一桿之前先看清楚球檯的犯規訊息.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuidePoolRulesBod.cn: 8 球玩法要先清光自己那一组的球, 再合规地把 8 号球打进. 9 球玩法必须先碰到号码最小的球; 合规地打进 9 号球就获胜. 规则标签会显示目前采用的规则. 标准 8 球玩法必须指定球和球袋. 休闲 8 球玩法取消了一般击球的指定. 母球落袋算犯规. 下一杆之前先看清楚球桌的犯规信息.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideSolitaireMov.en: Move cards between columns in descending order with alternating red and black suits. A valid sequence can move together. Only a king can fill an empty column. Build the four suit foundations from Ace to King. Drag a card, or select it and then select a highlighted destination.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideSolitaireMov.ch: 在各牌列之間搬牌時, 點數要由大到小, 而且紅黑花色交替. 排好的一串牌可以整組一起搬. 空出來的牌列只有 K 能填. 四個基礎牌堆要依花色從 A 疊到 K. 可以直接拖曳牌, 也可以先選取牌, 再選擇醒目提示的目標位置.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideSolitaireMov.cn: 在各牌列之间搬牌时, 点数要由大到小, 而且红黑花色交替. 排好的一串牌可以整组一起搬. 空出来的牌列只有 K 能填. 四个基础牌堆要依花色从 A 叠到 K. 可以直接拖曳牌, 也可以先选取牌, 再选择醒目提示的目标位置.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideSolitaireSto.en: Select the face-down stock to draw. Only the top waste card is available. The draw-one or draw-three setting controls each draw; the stock can cycle. Undo reverses a move. New Deal replaces the current game and asks before discarding unfinished play.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideSolitaireSto.ch: 點選蓋著的儲備牌堆就能抽牌. 廢牌堆只有最上面那張可以用. 每次抽牌的張數由抽 1 張或抽 3 張的設定決定; 儲備牌堆可以重新循環. 撤銷可以還原上一步. 重新發牌會取代目前這一局, 並在放棄尚未完成的牌局之前先詢問.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideSolitaireSto.cn: 点击盖着的储备牌堆就能抽牌. 废牌堆只有最上面那张可以用. 每次抽牌的张数由抽 1 张或抽 3 张的设置决定; 储备牌堆可以重新循环. 撤销可以还原上一步. 重新发牌会取代目前这一局, 并在放弃尚未完成的牌局之前先询问.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideTimeNote.en: Reading does not pause the table or its turn clock.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideTimeNote.ch: 閱讀說明不會讓這一桌或回合計時暫停.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideTimeNote.cn: 阅读说明不会让这一桌或回合计时暂停.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideWordleCluesB.en: Green means the letter is in the correct position. Yellow means the letter is elsewhere. Grey means that copy of the letter is not needed. Repeated letters are counted: if a guess has two copies and only one is marked, do not assume the answer contains both.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideWordleCluesB.ch: 綠色表示這個字母位置正確. 黃色表示這個字母在別的位置. 灰色表示這一個字母用不到. 重複的字母是分開計算的: 如果一次猜測裡有兩個相同的字母, 卻只有一個被標示, 不要就此認定答案裡兩個都有.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideWordleCluesB.cn: 绿色表示这个字母位置正确. 黄色表示这个字母在别的位置. 灰色表示这一个字母用不到. 重复的字母是分开计算的: 如果一次猜测里有两个相同的字母, 却只有一个被标示, 不要就此认定答案里两个都有.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideWordleGuessB.en: Enter a five-letter word with the keyboard or letter buttons, then submit it. You have six accepted guesses. An incomplete guess or a word outside the accepted list does not use a row. Backspace removes the last letter before submission.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideWordleGuessB.ch: 用鍵盤或字母按鈕輸入一個五個字母的單字, 然後送出. 你有六次有效的猜測. 沒填滿的猜測, 或不在收錄清單內的單字, 都不會用掉一行. 送出之前可以用退格鍵刪掉最後一個字母.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_GuideWordleGuessB.cn: 用键盘或字母按钮输入一个五个字母的单词, 然后提交. 你有六次有效的猜测. 没填满的猜测, 或不在收录列表内的单词, 都不会用掉一行. 提交之前可以用退格键删掉最后一个字母.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_HouseStakeGranted.en: The house added $%1 so you can play another hand.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_HouseStakeGranted.ch: 賭場補給你 $%1, 讓你可以再玩一局.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_HouseStakeGranted.cn: 赌场补给你 $%1, 让你可以再玩一局.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MinigamesTip.en: Everything you can start or watch at this spot.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MinigamesTip.ch: 你在這個地點可以開始或觀看的所有項目.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MinigamesTip.cn: 你在这个地点可以开始或观看的所有项目.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodBalatroid.en: One more hand. You needed this.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodBalatroid.cn: 再打一手. 你正需要这个.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodBlackjack.cn: 玩上几局让你放松下来.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodCheckers.en: A few jumps lift your mood.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodCheckers.cn: 几次跳吃让心情好了起来.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodChess.en: The next move keeps your mind busy.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodChess.cn: 思考下一步棋让脑袋忙个不停.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodConnect4.en: A quick game breaks the routine.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodConnect4.ch: 快快玩上一局, 打破一成不變.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodConnect4.cn: 快快玩上一局, 打破一成不变.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodDarts.ch: 三鏢下來, 腦袋清爽多了.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodDarts.cn: 三镖下来, 脑袋清爽多了.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodHoldem.en: Cards on the table. Nothing else on your mind.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodHoldem.ch: 牌都攤在桌上. 腦中再無雜念.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodHoldem.cn: 牌都摊在桌上. 脑中再无杂念.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_MoodPool.en: A good rack takes the edge off.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_RefuseASecondPlay.cn: 需要先有第二位玩家加入.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_RefuseAnswerTheDr.en: Answer the draw offer you were given first.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_RefuseAnswerTheDr.ch: 請先回應你收到的和局提議.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_RefuseAnswerTheDr.cn: 请先回应你收到的和局提议.

IGUI_PlayableMinigames_RefuseBalatroidRu.en: Balatroid run ended: score did not reach the blind.
IGUI_PlayableMinigames_RefuseBalatroidRu.ch: Balatroid 本輪挑戰結束: 分數未達到盲注要求.

IGUI_HTT_PhotosensitivityWarning.en:
PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING
Helicopter Event Expansion Framework includes bright flashes
and sudden changes in screen brightness.
These effects may trigger seizures in people
with photosensitive epilepsy.
You can disable flash events in the sandbox settings.
IGUI_HTT_PhotosensitivityWarning.ch:
光敏感警告
Helicopter Event Expansion Framework 包含強烈閃光
以及螢幕亮度的突然變化.
這些效果可能會使光敏感性癲癇患者
誘發癲癇發作.
你可以在沙盒設定中停用閃光事件.
IGUI_HTT_PhotosensitivityWarning.cn:
光敏警告
Helicopter Event Expansion Framework 包含强烈闪光
以及屏幕亮度的突然变化.
这些效果可能会使光敏性癫痫患者
诱发癫痫发作.
你可以在沙盒设置中禁用闪光事件.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsBlocked.en: Move players, animals and vehicles away from the lift positions before showing the lifts.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsBlocked.ch: 顯示升降機前, 請先將玩家、動物與車輛移離升降機所在的位置.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsBlocked.cn: 显示举升机前, 请先将玩家、动物和车辆移离举升机所在的位置.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsLocked.en: Unlock the garage before changing its vehicle lifts.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsLocked.ch: 變更車輛升降機前, 請先解鎖車庫.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsLocked.cn: 更改车辆举升机前, 请先解锁车库.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsNotLoaded.en: Wait for the hideout garage to finish loading.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsNotLoaded.ch: 請等待藏身點車庫載入完成.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_GarageLiftsNotLoaded.cn: 请等待藏身点车库加载完成.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cold_storage_C.en: This will work. The seal is intact and the insulation has not been damaged. I can clean it out and have it ready if Vance actually finds something worth transporting. I am starting to understand what he is working toward. I just hope he knows what he is doing.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cold_storage_C.ch: 這個能用. 密封完好, 隔熱層也沒有損壞. 我可以把它清洗乾淨備著, 萬一萬斯真的找到值得運送的東西就能派上用場. 我開始明白他在朝什麼目標努力了. 只希望他知道自己在做什麼.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cold_storage_C.cn: 这个能用. 密封完好, 隔热层也没有损坏. 我可以把它清洗干净备着, 万一万斯真的找到值得运送的东西就能派上用场. 我开始明白他在朝什么目标努力了. 只希望他知道自己在做什么.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cold_storage_F.en: Vance asked how we would transport a biological sample without ruining it. For once, he asked a sensible question. We need a proper medical transport cooler, something meant for blood, tissue, or temperature-sensitive medication. The children's medical facility in Riverside should have one. Find me one that is still in usable condition.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cold_storage_F.ch: 萬斯問我們要怎麼運送生物樣本才不會把它弄壞. 難得他問了個合理的問題. 我們需要一個正規的醫療運輸冷藏箱, 專門用來裝血液、組織或對溫度敏感的藥物. 河畔鎮的兒童醫療機構應該會有. 幫我找一個還能用的來.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cold_storage_F.cn: 万斯问我们要怎么运送生物样本才不会把它弄坏. 难得他问了个合理的问题. 我们需要一个正规的医疗运输冷藏箱, 专门用来装血液、组织或对温度敏感的药物. 河畔镇的儿童医疗机构应该会有. 帮我找一个还能用的来.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_containment_Co.en: That's better. Scouts are seeing fewer groups on the roads and the larger packs are starting to break apart. Whatever Vance found in those prison records has Graves and Layne interested, so I figure it must be important. If his research is going somewhere, I will keep the dead from getting in the way.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_containment_Co.ch: 好多了. 偵察兵在路上看到的屍群變少了, 較大的屍群也開始散開. 不管萬斯在那些監獄記錄裡發現了什麼, 都讓格雷夫斯和萊恩很感興趣, 所以我想那一定很重要. 如果他的研究真能有所進展, 我會讓那些活屍別來礙事.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_containment_Co.cn: 好多了. 侦察兵在路上看到的尸群变少了, 较大的尸群也开始散开. 不管万斯在那些监狱记录里发现了什么, 都让格雷夫斯和莱恩很感兴趣, 所以我想那一定很重要. 如果他的研究真能有所进展, 我会让那些活尸别来碍事.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_containment_Fl.en: Heard you went poking around the penitentiary. Trips like that stir up more dead than people realize. Engines, gunshots, doors opening, people moving through places that have been quiet for weeks. My scouts are seeing groups drifting onto our usual routes. Take fifty of them down before those groups start joining together. Better to deal with them now than wait for a herd.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_containment_Fl.ch: 聽說你去監獄那邊探了探. 那種行程驚動的活屍比大家以為的還多. 引擎聲、槍聲、開門聲, 還有人穿過那些安靜了好幾週的地方. 我的偵察兵發現有屍群正遊蕩到我們平常走的路線上. 趁那些屍群還沒匯聚起來, 放倒五十隻. 現在處理掉, 總比等它們聚成一大波屍潮再應付好.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_containment_Fl.cn: 听说你去监狱那边探了探. 那种行程惊动的活尸比大家以为的还多. 引擎声、枪声、开门声, 还有人穿过那些安静了好几周的地方. 我的侦察兵发现有尸群正游荡到我们平常走的路线上. 趁那些尸群还没汇聚起来, 放倒五十只. 现在处理掉, 总比等它们聚成一大波尸潮再应付好.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_court_with_dea.en: Keller kept copies of almost everything. Transfer orders, patient numbers, internal messages. Most of it is routine, but this is not. During the first days of the quarantine, several infected patients were transferred to Knox Penitentiary under military supervision. They used the prison infirmary as an isolation ward. If the medical records are still there, they may contain observations from some of the earliest known cases.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_court_with_dea.ch: 凱勒幾乎把所有東西都留了副本. 轉移命令、病人編號、內部訊息. 大部分都是例行公事, 但這份不是. 在隔離開始的頭幾天, 有幾名受感染的病人在軍方監督下被轉移到諾克斯監獄. 他們把監獄醫務室當成隔離病房. 如果醫療記錄還在那裡, 裡面可能有對一些已知最早病例的觀察記錄.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_court_with_dea.cn: 凯勒几乎把所有东西都留了副本. 转移命令、病人编号、内部消息. 大部分都是例行公事, 但这份不是. 在隔离开始的头几天, 有几名受感染的病人在军方监督下被转移到诺克斯监狱. 他们把监狱医务室当成隔离病房. 如果医疗记录还在那里, 里面可能有对一些已知最早病例的观察记录.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_court_with_dea.en: The name on that manifest is Aaron Keller, I know that name... He was investigating transport records and patient transfers during the containment operation. He worked at the Court of Justice in Rosewood. That area was packed with people before the outbreak and it will be worse now. Learn to move quietly before you go in. I need whatever notes Keller left behind, not a trail of dead leading straight back to you.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_court_with_dea.ch: 那份轉移清單上的名字是亞倫·凱勒, 這名字我知道… 封鎖行動期間, 他在調查運輸記錄和病人轉移. 他在羅斯伍德的法院工作. 疫情爆發前那一帶就擠滿了人, 現在只會更糟. 進去之前先學會安靜地行動. 我要的是凱勒留下的筆記, 不是一路跟著你回來的活屍.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_court_with_dea.cn: 那份转移清单上的名字是亚伦·凯勒, 这名字我知道… 封锁行动期间, 他在调查运输记录和病人转移. 他在罗斯伍德的法院工作. 疫情爆发前那一带就挤满了人, 现在只会更糟. 进去之前先学会安静地行动. 我要的是凯勒留下的笔记, 不是一路跟着你回来的活尸.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cross_referenc.en: There. The shipment numbers match the records from Rosewood. It passed through Ekron and was assigned to Aaron Keller, one of the logistics staff attached to the containment program. The delivery address listed here is in Rosewood. If Keller kept copies of anything he was working on, his residence is the next place to look.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cross_referenc.ch: 找到了. 貨運編號和羅斯伍德的記錄吻合. 這批貨經過以革倫, 被分派給亞倫·凱勒, 他是隸屬於封鎖計畫的後勤人員之一. 這裡列出的收貨地址在羅斯伍德. 如果凱勒有把經手的工作留下副本, 下一個該找的地方就是他的住處.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cross_referenc.cn: 找到了. 货运编号和罗斯伍德的记录吻合. 这批货经过以革伦, 被分派给亚伦·凯勒, 他是隶属于封锁计划的后勤人员之一. 这里列出的收货地址在罗斯伍德. 如果凯勒有把经手的工作留下副本, 下一个该找的地方就是他的住处.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cross_referenc.en: Mercer's ledger confirms that research material was being moved through civilian channels. One of the shipments was supposed to go to someone in Ekron, and there should have been a transfer manifest with it. If everything collapsed before it was delivered, there is a good chance the paperwork is still sitting in the post office. Check there and bring me the manifest. Bring a couple of notebooks and pens too. I want a paper copy of whatever I can reconstruct.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cross_referenc.ch: 默瑟的帳本證實, 研究材料一直透過民間管道運送. 其中一批貨本來要送到以革倫的某個人手上, 應該還附有一份轉移清單. 如果一切在送達前就崩潰了, 那些文件很可能還擱在郵局裡. 去那裡看看, 把清單帶回來給我. 順便帶幾本筆記本和幾支筆. 不管我能重建出什麼, 我都想留一份紙本.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_cross_referenc.cn: 默瑟的账本证实, 研究材料一直通过民间渠道运送. 其中一批货本来要送到以革伦的某个人手上, 应该还附有一份转移清单. 如果一切在送达前就崩溃了, 那些文件很可能还搁在邮局里. 去那里看看, 把清单带回来给我. 顺便带几本笔记本和几支笔. 不管我能重建出什么, 我都想留一份纸质副本.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_keeping_them_r.en: Good. That gives us enough equipment to handle the most common roadside problems. I have people checking the vehicles now and pulling anything that is likely to fail. Keeping them running means longer supply runs and fewer soldiers walking home. We are going to need that range soon.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_keeping_them_r.ch: 很好. 這些裝備足以應付最常見的路邊故障. 我已經派人檢查車輛, 把任何可能出問題的零件先拆下來. 讓車子保持運轉, 就代表補給行程能跑得更遠, 走路回來的士兵也會更少. 我們很快就會需要那樣的行動範圍.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_keeping_them_r.cn: 很好. 这些装备足以应付最常见的路边故障. 我已经派人检查车辆, 把任何可能出问题的零件先拆下来. 让车子保持运转, 就意味着补给行程能跑得更远, 走路回来的士兵也会更少. 我们很快就会需要那样的行动范围.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_keeping_them_r.en: I have vehicles, but no motor pool worth the name. Tires are going flat, parts are wearing out, and every vehicle we lose cuts down how far my people can operate. Learn enough basic mechanics to handle routine repairs and bring me a jack, lug wrench, and tire pump. If we intend to keep expanding our supply routes, I need those vehicles running.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_keeping_them_r.ch: 我有車, 但沒有一個稱得上像樣的車輛保修場. 輪胎一直漏氣, 零件不斷磨損, 我們每損失一輛車, 我的人能行動的範圍就縮小一些. 去學會足以應付日常維修的基本技工知識, 再給我帶千斤頂、輪胎扳手和輪胎打氣筒來. 如果我們要繼續擴大補給路線, 我需要那些車能跑.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_keeping_them_r.cn: 我有车, 但没有一个称得上像样的车辆保养场. 轮胎一直漏气, 零件不断磨损, 我们每损失一辆车, 我的人能行动的范围就缩小一些. 去学会足以应付日常维修的基本技工知识, 再给我带千斤顶、轮胎扳手和轮胎打气筒来. 如果我们要继续扩大补给路线, 我需要那些车能跑.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_observation_wa.en: These are the records. Most of the patients followed the same pattern, but not all of them. Three were exposed at roughly the same time. Two deteriorated quickly. The third remained coherent much longer than expected. The doctors noticed it too. They took repeated blood samples and sent them somewhere else for testing. The samples are gone, but the records tell us where they went. We have another lead.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_observation_wa.ch: 就是這些記錄. 大部分病人都遵循相同的模式, 但不是全部. 有三個人大約在同一時間接觸到感染源. 其中兩人很快就惡化了. 第三個人保持清醒的時間比預期長得多. 醫生們也注意到了. 他們反覆抽取血樣, 送到別處化驗. 樣本已經不在了, 但記錄告訴了我們它們的去向. 我們又有新線索了.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_observation_wa.cn: 就是这些记录. 大部分病人都遵循相同的模式, 但不是全部. 有三个人大约在同一时间接触到感染源. 其中两人很快就恶化了. 第三个人保持清醒的时间比预期长得多. 医生们也注意到了. 他们反复抽取血样, 送到别处化验. 样本已经不在了, 但记录告诉了我们它们的去向. 我们又有新线索了.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_observation_wa.en: Keller's notes confirm that the military used Knox Penitentiary to hold infected patients during the early quarantine. The prison already had walls, cells, guards, and an infirmary, so it made an effective isolation site. I need the medical records from that ward. Do not waste time clearing the whole prison. Get into the medical or administrative area, find the quarantine records, and get out.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_observation_wa.ch: 凱勒的筆記證實, 軍方在隔離初期曾利用諾克斯監獄收容受感染的病人. 那座監獄本來就有圍牆、牢房、警衛和醫務室, 很適合當作隔離場所. 我需要那間病房的醫療記錄. 別浪費時間清空整座監獄. 進到醫療區或行政區, 找到隔離記錄, 然後就出來.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_observation_wa.cn: 凯勒的笔记证实, 军方在隔离初期曾利用诺克斯监狱收容受感染的病人. 那座监狱本来就有围墙、牢房、警卫和医务室, 很适合当作隔离场所. 我需要那间病房的医疗记录. 别浪费时间清空整座监狱. 进到医疗区或行政区, 找到隔离记录, 然后就出来.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_paper_trail_Co.en: These are his. Personnel lists, transfer dates, sample numbers... he copied more than I expected. The important part is the transfers. My team was told the work had stopped, but these records say otherwise. Someone kept moving research material after the program was shut down. I need to find out where it went.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_paper_trail_Co.ch: 這些是他的. 人員名單、轉移日期、樣本編號… 他抄下來的比我預期的還多. 重點在於那些轉移. 我的團隊被告知研究已經停止, 但這些記錄顯示並非如此. 計畫被中止之後, 仍有人持續搬運研究材料. 我得查出它們被送到哪裡去了.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_paper_trail_Co.cn: 这些是他的. 人员名单、转移日期、样本编号… 他抄下来的比我预期的还多. 重点在于那些转移. 我的团队被告知研究已经停止, 但这些记录显示并非如此. 计划被中止之后, 仍有人持续搬运研究材料. 我得查出它们被送到哪里去了.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_paper_trail_Fl.en: One of my colleagues tried to get out of Rosewood before the quarantine locked everything down. The police picked him up after he started talking about restricted research and contaminated samples. If they processed him normally, whatever he was carrying should still be in the evidence room at Rosewood PD. Find those documents and bring them to me. I need to know what he managed to copy.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_paper_trail_Fl.ch: 我有個同事試圖在隔離封死一切之前逃出羅斯伍德. 他開始談論機密研究和受汙染的樣本後, 就被警察抓走了. 如果他們照正常程序處理, 他身上帶的東西應該還放在羅斯伍德警察局的證物室裡. 找到那些文件, 帶來給我. 我需要知道他設法抄走了什麼.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_paper_trail_Fl.cn: 我有个同事试图在隔离封死一切之前逃出罗斯伍德. 他开始谈论机密研究和受污染的样本后, 就被警察抓走了. 如果他们照正常程序处理, 他身上带的东西应该还放在罗斯伍德警察局的证物室里. 找到那些文件, 带来给我. 我需要知道他设法抄走了什么.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_riverside_patr.en: That helped. My people made it into the commercial district and came back with a decent haul. There are still plenty of dead in Riverside, but twenty-five fewer makes the streets a little easier to move through. Keep chipping away at them.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_riverside_patr.ch: 這有幫助. 我的人進到了商業區, 帶回了不少收穫. 河畔鎮裡還有很多活屍, 但少了二十五隻, 街上就好走一些了. 繼續一點一點削減它們.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_riverside_patr.cn: 这有帮助. 我的人进到了商业区, 带回了不少收获. 河畔镇里还有很多活尸, 但少了二十五只, 街上就好走一些了. 继续一点一点削减它们.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_riverside_patr.en: Riverside is filling up with the dead. My scavengers are trying to work the commercial district, but every trip gets harder as more of them wander in from the neighborhoods. Get into town and put down twenty-five. That should give my people enough room to work without fighting their way through every block.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_riverside_patr.ch: 河畔鎮裡的活屍越來越多. 我的搜刮隊想在商業區搜刮, 但隨著越來越多活屍從住宅區晃進來, 每一趟都變得更難. 進城放倒二十五隻. 這樣應該能讓我的人有足夠的空間做事, 不必每條街都得殺出一條路.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_riverside_patr.cn: 河畔镇里的活尸越来越多. 我的搜刮队想在商业区搜刮, 但随着越来越多活尸从住宅区晃进来, 每一趟都变得更难. 进城放倒二十五只. 这样应该能让我的人有足够的空间做事, 不必每条街都得杀出一条路.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_steady_hands_C.en: Good. You know enough now to clean a wound, stop the bleeding, and close it without making things worse. These supplies will help with the more serious injuries coming through here. Keep practicing. The next time you get hurt out there, knowing what to do may be what gets you home.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_steady_hands_C.ch: 很好. 你現在懂得夠多了, 能清理傷口、止血並縫合, 而不會把情況弄得更糟. 這些物資能幫忙處理送到這裡的重傷. 繼續練習. 下次你在外面受傷時, 知道該怎麼做, 也許就是讓你活著回家的關鍵.
IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_steady_hands_C.cn: 很好. 你现在懂得够多了, 能清理伤口、止血并缝合, 而不会把情况弄得更糟. 这些物资能帮忙处理送到这里的重伤. 继续练习. 下次你在外面受伤时, 知道该怎么做, 也许就是让你活着回家的关键.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_steady_hands_F.en: The supplies you have brought me have helped, but I am treating injuries that take more than clean bandages to fix. Deep cuts, broken glass, gunshots, all of it. I cannot be the only person around here who knows how to close a wound. Get some practice treating injuries and bring me more suturing supplies and disinfectant. You need to be able to take care of yourself when nobody else can.

IGUI_ExtractionMode_Quest_steady_hands_F.cn: 你带来的物资帮了大忙, 但我现在治疗的伤势光靠干净的绷带已经不够了. 深层割伤、碎玻璃、枪伤, 什么都有. 这附近不能只有我一个人会缝合伤口. 去练习处理伤势, 再多带些缝合用品和消毒剂给我. 在没人能帮你的时候, 你得有能力照顾自己.

IGUI_PhunZones_Pvp_tooltip.en: Whether players can hurt each other here. Off makes this a safe zone. Leave it unset unless you mean it - as soon as any zone is set to on, everywhere else on the map becomes safe. Needs the server option PVP to be on, and applies to staff too: the check is on the tile, not the player. Off also stops explosives and fire working here, on zombies as well as players - that is the game's own rule for safe zones, not ours
IGUI_PhunZones_Pvp_tooltip.ch: 玩家在此是否能互相傷害. 關閉則此處成為安全區. 除非確定需要, 否則請保持未設定 - 只要任何區域設為開啟, 地圖上其他所有地方都會變成安全區. 需要伺服器選項 PVP 為開啟, 且對管理人員同樣適用: 檢查的是地格, 而非玩家. 關閉時, 爆裂物與火焰在此處也會失效, 對殭屍和玩家皆然 - 這是遊戲本身對安全區的規則, 並非本模組所訂
IGUI_PhunZones_Pvp_tooltip.cn: 玩家在此是否能互相伤害. 关闭则此处成为安全区. 除非确定需要, 否则请保持未设置 - 只要任何区域设为开启, 地图上其他所有地方都会变成安全区. 需要服务器选项 PVP 为开启, 且对管理人员同样适用: 检查的是地块, 而非玩家. 关闭时, 爆炸物和火焰在此处也会失效, 对僵尸和玩家都是如此 - 这是游戏本身对安全区的规则, 并非本模组所定
