IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.ch: 每次呼吸都在摩擦作痛. 固定胸部.
IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.cn: 每次呼吸都在摩擦作痛. 固定胸部.

IGUI_CU_Why_sepsis.en: The infection is in the blood.

IGUI_CU_Why_septic_shock.en: Everything is shutting down at once.

IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.en: The muscles are locking. It started in a dirty wound.
IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.ch: 肌肉正在僵直. 起因是骯髒的傷口.
IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.cn: 肌肉正在僵直. 起因是肮脏的伤口.

IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.en: Requires the Project A-Life NPCs mod. Block Spawns stops A-Life NPCs spawning in this zone; any that walk in, such as friendly ones, are left alone. A-Life NPCs are never moved or removed by the Zeds setting
IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.ch: 需要 Project A-Life NPCs 模組. 「阻止生成」會讓 A-Life NPC 不在此區域生成; 自行走進來的 NPC (例如友善的 NPC) 則不受影響. 「殭屍」設定永遠不會移出或移除 A-Life NPC
IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.cn: 需要 Project A-Life NPCs 模组. “阻止生成”会阻止 A-Life NPC 在此区域生成; 自行走进来的 NPC (例如友好的 NPC) 则不受影响. “僵尸”设置永远不会移出或移除 A-Life NPC

IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.en: Colour of this zone's outline on the player's map and minimap, e.g. #FF8000 or 255,128,0. Leave empty for no outline
IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.ch: 此區域在玩家地圖與小地圖上的外框顏色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空則不顯示外框
IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.cn: 此区域在玩家地图和小地图上的轮廓颜色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空则不显示轮廓

IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.en: Colour this zone is shaded with on the player's map and minimap, e.g. #FF8000 or 255,128,0. Leave empty for no shading
IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.ch: 此區域在玩家地圖與小地圖上的填充顏色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空則不填色
IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.cn: 此区域在玩家地图和小地图上的填充颜色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空则不填充

IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.en: How opaque the map fill is, from 0 (invisible) to 100 (solid). Defaults to 30 when a fill colour is set
IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.ch: 地圖填色的不透明程度, 從 0 (完全透明) 到 100 (完全不透明). 設定填充顏色時預設為 30
IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.cn: 地图填充的不透明程度, 从 0 (完全透明) 到 100 (完全不透明). 设置填充颜色时默认为 30

IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_MoveSpawn.ch: 生成時移出 (允許遊蕩進入)
IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_MoveSpawn.cn: 生成时移出 (允许游荡进入)

IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_RemoveSpawn.ch: 生成時移除 (允許遊蕩進入)
IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_RemoveSpawn.cn: 生成时移除 (允许游荡进入)

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.en: Manage saved marks. Equip this grimoire and set Recall active to travel.
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.ch: 管理已儲存的標記. 裝備這本魔法書並將「召回」設為啟用即可傳送.
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.cn: 管理已保存的标记. 装备这本魔法书并将“召回”设为激活即可传送.

IGUI_RNPC_06a04b96.en: You don't have any recruits yet.

IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.en: Armed locals. They patrol the back roads and set up checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.ch: 武裝的當地人. 他們在鄉間小路巡邏, 還設了檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.cn: 武装的当地人. 他们在乡间小路巡逻, 还设了检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.en: Regular people trying to get by. They scavenge, board up and trade.
IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.ch: 努力活下去的普通人. 他們搜刮物資、封堵門窗, 也做交易.
IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.cn: 努力活下去的普通人. 他们搜刮物资、封堵门窗, 也做交易.

IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.en: On their own. They camp out, scavenge and keep to themselves.
IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.ch: 獨來獨往. 他們在野外紮營、搜刮物資, 不跟別人打交道.
IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.cn: 独来独往. 他们在野外扎营、搜刮物资, 不跟别人打交道.

IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.en: No jobs yet. Ask a faction for work.
IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.ch: 還沒有任何委託. 去找陣營要工作吧.
IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.cn: 还没有任何委托. 去找派系要活儿干吧.

IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.en: Hostile. They hold a base and rob whoever they can.
IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.ch: 敵對. 他們佔據一處據點, 能搶誰就搶誰.
IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.cn: 敌对. 他们占据一处据点, 能抢谁就抢谁.

IGUI_RNPC_33097578.en: Not yet. We need to know you better first.
IGUI_RNPC_33097578.ch: 還不行. 我們得先多了解你一點.
IGUI_RNPC_33097578.cn: 还不行. 我们得先多了解你一点.

IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.en: Their base got raided a day or two ago.
IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.ch: 他們的據點一兩天前被襲擊了.
IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.cn: 他们的据点一两天前被袭击了.

IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.en: Then swear to it, and you are one of us. We look after our own.
IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.ch: 那就發誓吧, 你就是我們的一份子了. 我們會照顧自己人.
IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.cn: 那就发誓吧, 你就是我们的一员了. 我们会照顾自己人.

IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.en: Go in peace. You cannot come back for a while.
IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.ch: 平安地走吧. 你暫時不能回來.
IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.cn: 平安地走吧. 你暂时不能回来.

IGUI_RNPC_4ff2d227.en: Just back from a raid on %1.

IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.en: One of our own turned on us %1. We threw them out.
IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.ch: %1 我們自己人背叛了我們. 我們把那人趕出去了.
IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.cn: %1 我们自己人背叛了我们. 我们把那人赶出去了.

IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.en: A cult out in the country. They think the world was judged.
IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.ch: 鄉下的一個邪教. 他們認為世界已經受了審判.
IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.cn: 乡下的一个邪教. 他们认为世界已经受到了审判.

IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.en: You left us. It is too soon to come back.
IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.ch: 你離開了我們. 現在回來還太早.
IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.cn: 你离开了我们. 现在回来还太早.

IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.en: The %1 need %2. Take these to any of their people. Do not sell them.
IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.ch: %1 需要 %2. 把這些交給他們任何一個人. 不准賣掉.
IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.cn: %1 需要 %2. 把这些交给他们任何一个人. 不许卖掉.

IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.en: That order is switched off on this server.
IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.ch: 此伺服器已停用這項命令.
IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.cn: 此服务器已禁用这项命令.

IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.en: You kept your word. Here is your pay.
IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.ch: 你信守了承諾. 這是你的報酬.
IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.cn: 你信守了承诺. 这是你的报酬.

IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.en: Our people keep dying near %1. Go and look, then come back and tell us what you saw.
IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.ch: 我們的人一直在 %1 附近送命. 去看看, 然後回來告訴我們你看到了什麼.
IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.cn: 我们的人一直在 %1 附近送命. 去看看, 然后回来告诉我们你看到了什么.

IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.en: There's a big group of the dead near %1. Put down %2 of them and come back.
IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.ch: %1 附近有一大群行屍. 解決掉其中 %2 隻再回來.
IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.cn: %1 附近有一大群行尸. 干掉其中 %2 只再回来.

IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.en: Welcome. We look after our own.
IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.ch: 歡迎. 我們會照顧自己人.
IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.cn: 欢迎. 我们会照顾自己人.

IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.en: Hungry. Their group is low on food.
IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.ch: 餓著肚子. 他們的團體糧食不足.
IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.cn: 饿着肚子. 他们的团体粮食不足.

IGUI_RNPC_9085f622.ch: 被咬了. 看起來病了.
IGUI_RNPC_9085f622.cn: 被咬了. 看起来病了.

IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.en: The dead are gathering near %1. Put down %2 of them, then come back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.ch: 死者正在 %1 附近聚集. 解決其中 %2 個, 然後回來找我們.
IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.cn: 死者正在 %1 附近聚集. 解决其中 %2 个, 然后回来找我们.

IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.en: They set ambushes where the traffic is and make you pay to pass.
IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.ch: 他們在人來人往的地方設埋伏, 要你付錢才放行.
IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.cn: 他们在人来人往的地方设埋伏, 要你付钱才能通过.

IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.en: That's theirs. Thank you. Here's your pay.
IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.ch: 這是那人的東西. 謝謝你. 這是你的報酬.
IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.cn: 这是那人的东西. 谢谢你. 这是你的报酬.

IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.en: From the %1? Thank you. Tell them we are grateful.
IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.ch: %1 送來的? 謝謝你. 替我們轉達感謝.
IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.cn: %1 送来的? 谢谢你. 替我们转达感谢.

IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.en: What's left of the county police. They patrol and run checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.ch: 縣警察的殘部. 他們負責巡邏, 也管檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.cn: 县警察的残部. 他们负责巡逻, 也管检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.en: You are one of us, and we trust you.
IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.ch: 你是我們的一份子, 我們信任你.
IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.cn: 你是我们的一员, 我们信任你.

IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.en: You brought it back to us. Bless you.
IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.ch: 你把它帶回來給我們了. 願主保佑你.
IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.cn: 你把它带回来给我们了. 愿主保佑你.

IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.en: They loot the towns and trade what they find, mostly tools and parts.
IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.ch: 他們搜刮城鎮, 拿找到的東西去交易, 大多是工具和零件.
IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.cn: 他们搜刮城镇, 拿找到的东西去交易, 大多是工具和零件.

IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.en: The %1 are short on %2. Take these to any of their people, and don't sell them.
IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.ch: %1 缺 %2. 把這些交給他們任何一個人, 別拿去賣.
IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.cn: %1 缺 %2. 把这些交给他们任何一个人, 别拿去卖.

IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.en: %1 died out near %2. Their %3 should still be on the body. Bring it back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.ch: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 應該還在屍體上. 把它帶回來給我們.
IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.cn: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 应该还在尸体上. 把它带回来给我们.

IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.en: %1 died near %2. Their %3 is still with the body. Please bring it back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.ch: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 還在遺體身邊. 請把它帶回來給我們.
IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.cn: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 还在遗体身边. 请把它带回来给我们.

IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.en: Farmers out in the country. They grow food and patrol the back roads.
IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.ch: 鄉下的農夫. 他們種糧食, 也在鄉間小路巡邏.
IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.cn: 乡下的农民. 他们种粮食, 也在乡间小路巡逻.

IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.en: Doctors and nurses. They treat people and are always low on medicine.
IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.ch: 醫生和護士. 他們替人治療, 藥品總是不夠用.
IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.cn: 医生和护士. 他们给人治病, 药品总是不够用.

IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.en: The %1 sold us out %2. We don't trust them anymore.
IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.ch: %1 %2 出賣了我們. 我們不再信任他們了.
IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.cn: %1 %2 出卖了我们. 我们不再信任他们了.

IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.en: Fine. Go on, then. Don't come back for a while.
IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.ch: 好. 那就走吧. 這陣子別回來.
IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.cn: 好. 那就走吧. 这阵子别回来.

IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.en: %1 of the %2 led the raid on us. Find them and kill them.
IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.ch: %2 的 %1 帶頭襲擊了我們. 找到那傢伙, 殺了他.
IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.cn: %2 的 %1 带头袭击了我们. 找到那家伙, 杀了他.

IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.en: You're one of them, and they trust you.
IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.ch: 你是他們的一份子, 他們信任你.
IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.cn: 你是他们的一员, 他们信任你.

IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.en: %1 of the %2 led the raid on us. We want them dead. Find them.
IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.ch: %2 的 %1 帶頭襲擊了我們. 我們要那傢伙的命. 把人找出來.
IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.cn: %2 的 %1 带头袭击了我们. 我们要那家伙的命. 把人找出来.

IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.en: Firefighters still working out of their station. They help people out.
IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.ch: 仍以消防隊為據點工作的消防員. 他們會幫人一把.
IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.cn: 仍以消防站为据点工作的消防员. 他们会帮人一把.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.en: Set five pieces of scrap wood along the frame, then bind every joint with duct tape.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.ch: 把五塊廢木材沿著框架擺好, 再用大力膠帶纏緊每個接合處.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.cn: 把五块废木材沿着框架摆好, 再用管道胶带缠紧每个接合处.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.en: Take hold of a piece and drag it onto its place on the frame. It snaps in when it is close.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.ch: 抓住一塊木材, 拖曳到框架上對應的位置. 靠得夠近時就會自動卡上.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.cn: 抓住一块木材, 拖到框架上对应的位置. 靠得够近时就会自动卡上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.en: Once all five are in, hold on a joint and work the mouse up and down over it to wind the tape on.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.ch: 五塊都放好後, 在接合處按住滑鼠並上下來回移動, 把膠帶纏上去.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.cn: 五块都放好后, 在接合处按住鼠标并上下来回移动, 把胶带缠上去.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.en: Every joint takes about the same: wind until it is done, then the next.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.ch: 每個接合處所需的工夫都差不多: 纏到好為止, 再換下一個.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.cn: 每个接合处所需的功夫都差不多: 缠到好为止, 再换下一个.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.en: Yanking tears the tape and loses what was wound; straying off the joint sticks it to nothing. A sloppy job starts the prosthetic part worn.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.ch: 猛拉會扯破膠帶, 已纏好的部分也會白費; 偏離接合處, 膠帶就黏不到東西. 做得馬虎, 義肢一開始就會帶有磨損.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.cn: 猛拉会扯破胶带, 已缠好的部分也会白费; 偏离接合处, 胶带就粘不到东西. 做得马虎, 假肢一开始就会带有磨损.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_FallsApart.en: It falls apart in your hands.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.en: Drag each piece of scrap wood onto its place along the frame.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.ch: 把每塊廢木材拖曳到框架上對應的位置.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.cn: 把每块废木材拖到框架上对应的位置.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.en: Then wind tape round every joint: hold, and work up and down over it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.ch: 然後在每個接合處纏上膠帶: 按住, 並在上面上下來回移動.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.cn: 然后在每个接合处缠上胶带: 按住, 并在上面上下来回移动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.en: Hold on a joint, and work up and down.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.ch: 按住一個接合處, 上下來回移動.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.cn: 按住一个接合处, 上下来回移动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NotThere.en: That is not where it goes.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.en: All the pieces are in. Now the tape.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.ch: 木材都放好了. 接下來纏膠帶.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.cn: 木材都放好了. 接下来缠胶带.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_TakeAPiece.en: Take hold of a piece of wood.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Torn.ch: 輕一點 - 膠帶扯破了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Torn.cn: 轻一点 - 胶带扯破了.

IGUI_CU_Stump_Crude.ch: %1已截肢: 已裝上木製義肢 (剩餘 %2%%)
IGUI_CU_Stump_Crude.cn: %1已截肢: 已装上木制假肢 (剩余 %2%%)

IGUI_GGS_AimBlurSwitchTooltip.cn: 通过光学瞄具瞄准时, 使周边视野变暗并柔化.

IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.en: Shows scope reticle marks and the moving aim marker.

IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.cn: 显示瞄准镜的准星标记与移动的瞄准标记.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultContentEna.cn: 若已安装私密成人附加模组, 允许其场景入口与成人场景后续影响.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_ChildrenEnabled.en: Allows child actor, child presentation, child needs, and child care/follow systems.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_ChildrenEnabled.ch: 允許兒童角色、兒童外觀呈現、兒童需求與兒童照護/跟隨系統.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_ChildrenEnabled.cn: 允许儿童角色、儿童外观呈现、儿童需求与儿童照顾/跟随系统.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.en: Client overrides for save Sandbox defaults. Use Sandbox default to return control to the save.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.ch: 客戶端覆寫存檔的沙盒預設值. 選擇「使用沙盒預設值」即可將控制權交還給存檔.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.en: Allows desire scoring, attraction item bonuses, hygiene-attraction signals, and scanner/scorer bonuses.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.ch: 允許慾望評分、吸引力物品加成、衛生吸引力訊號與掃描/評分加成.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.cn: 允许欲望评分、吸引力物品加成、卫生吸引力信号与扫描/评分加成.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.en: Allows family emotion hub, effect ledger, bond mood/stress/panic adjustments, and scene bonding effects.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.ch: 允許家庭情緒中樞、效果紀錄、羈絆的情緒/壓力/恐慌調整與場景羈絆效果.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.cn: 允许家庭情绪中枢、效果记录、羁绊的情绪/压力/恐慌调整与场景羁绊效果.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.en: Allows related context actions such as protection, lactation aid, and attraction/hygiene bonus item actions.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.ch: 允許相關的右鍵動作, 例如避孕措施、泌乳輔助, 以及吸引力/衛生加成物品動作.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.cn: 允许相关的右键动作, 例如避孕措施、泌乳辅助, 以及吸引力/卫生加成物品动作.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.en: Allows newborn creation and BabyCare infant systems. Existing baby items are not deleted.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.ch: 允許產生新生兒與嬰兒照護系統. 既有的嬰兒物品不會被刪除.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.cn: 允许生成新生儿与婴儿护理系统. 现有的婴儿物品不会被删除.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.en: Allows private-scene conception attempts. Requires adult content and pregnancy.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.ch: 允許在私密場景中嘗試受孕. 需要啟用成人內容與懷孕.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.cn: 允许在私密场景中尝试受孕. 需要启用成人内容与怀孕.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyDialogu.en: Choose where brief private-scene reactions appear.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyDialogu.ch: 選擇私密場景的簡短反應要在哪種模式下顯示.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyDialogu.cn: 选择私密场景的简短反应要在哪种模式下显示.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyPresent.en: Choose on-screen animation or an implied privacy card. Gameplay effects remain active in both modes.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyPresent.ch: 選擇以畫面動畫呈現, 或以隱私卡片暗示帶過. 兩種模式下遊戲效果都會照常生效.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyPresent.cn: 选择以画面动画呈现, 或以隐私卡片暗示带过. 两种模式下游戏效果都会照常生效.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_LactationEnable.en: Allows lactation state, milk updates, and baby-care milk handoff.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_LactationEnable.ch: 允許泌乳狀態、乳汁更新與嬰兒照護的乳汁交接.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_LactationEnable.cn: 允许泌乳状态、乳汁更新与婴儿护理的乳汁交接.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_MatureDialogueE.en: Allows private-scene dialogue when adult content is enabled.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_MatureDialogueE.ch: 啟用成人內容時, 允許私密場景對話.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_MatureDialogueE.cn: 启用成人内容时, 允许私密场景对话.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PregnancyEnable.en: Allows pregnancy state, support, loop tools, and pregnancy-to-birth bridges.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PregnancyEnable.ch: 允許懷孕狀態、懷孕支援、循環工具與懷孕到生產的銜接.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PregnancyEnable.cn: 允许怀孕状态、怀孕支持、循环工具与怀孕到分娩的衔接.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PrivateHygieneE.en: Allows private-scene hygiene, dirty-hands, and cleanup consequences.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PrivateHygieneE.ch: 允許私密場景的衛生、髒手與清理後續影響.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_PrivateHygieneE.cn: 允许私密场景的卫生、脏手与清理后续影响.

IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_dalmatian.en: An attentive companion often found around schools and universities. While selected as your active companion, it grants 5% extra XP for every skill. Balanced scent and obedience, with a light bite and modest carrying capacity.

IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_dalmatian.cn: 专注的伙伴, 常出现在学校和大学周围. 被选为你当前的同伴时, 所有技能都能额外获得 5%% 经验值. 嗅觉与服从性均衡, 咬合力较弱, 负重能力一般.

IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Pacesetter_desc.en: Your active Dalmatian companion grants 5% extra XP for all skills, including Strength and Fitness. Switching or dismissing the dog ends the bonus.

IGUI_KBW_SelectPiece.en: Select a piece to see its requirements.
IGUI_KBW_SelectPiece.ch: 選取一個構件以檢視其需求.

IGUI_KBW_SupplyShortageHelp.en: Check Supplies for missing materials, tools, or skills. You can build a ready piece individually.
IGUI_KBW_SupplyShortageHelp.ch: 請在「物資」中檢視缺少的材料, 工具或技能. 已就緒的構件可以單獨建造.
IGUI_KBW_SupplyShortageHelp.cn: 请在“物资”中查看缺少的材料, 工具或技能. 已就绪的构件可以单独建造.

IGUI_KBW_SupplySources.en: Carried supplies, nearby ground, and gather containers. Shared ingredients are allocated across the plan; paths and access are checked when building.
IGUI_KBW_SupplySources.ch: 身上攜帶的物資, 附近地面及收集容器. 共用材料會在整個規劃中分配; 建造時會檢查路徑與能否取用.

IGUI_KBW_UnloadedSupplies.en: Some gather-area tiles are not loaded. Supplies there could not be counted.
IGUI_KBW_UnloadedSupplies.ch: 部分收集區域的格子尚未載入. 無法計算那裡的物資.
IGUI_KBW_UnloadedSupplies.cn: 部分收集区域的格子尚未加载. 无法统计那里的物资.

IGUI_KBW_WindowFitHelp.en: Requires a matching window opening. Right-click an empty frame and choose "Find doors/windows for this opening".
IGUI_KBW_WindowFitHelp.ch: 需要相符的窗戶開口. 在空的框架上按右鍵並選擇「尋找適合此開口的門/窗」.
IGUI_KBW_WindowFitHelp.cn: 需要匹配的窗户洞口. 右键点击空框架并选择“查找适合此洞口的门/窗”.

IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.en: Requires The Mutants mod. Percentage (0-100, decimals allowed) of zombies that become this mutant when they spawn in this zone. Leave empty to use the sandbox setting; 0 stops this mutant spawning here. Mutants that wander in from elsewhere are not affected
IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.ch: 需要 The Mutants 模組. 在此區域生成的殭屍中, 會變成此種變異體的百分比 (0-100, 可用小數). 留空則使用沙盒設定; 設為 0 則此變異體不會在此生成. 從其他地方遊蕩進來的變異體不受影響
IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.cn: 需要 The Mutants 模组. 在此区域生成的僵尸中, 会变成此种变异体的百分比 (0-100, 可用小数). 留空则使用沙盒设置; 设为 0 则此变异体不会在此生成. 从其他地方游荡进来的变异体不受影响

IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.cn: 他们的心脏还在跳 - 电击没有用.

IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.en: Feel your way down the track to the bullet
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.ch: 沿著彈道摸索, 找到子彈
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.cn: 沿着弹道摸索, 找到子弹

IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.en: Down the track to the bullet - watch the film
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.ch: 沿著彈道往下找到子彈 - 注意看內部畫面
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.cn: 沿着弹道往下找到子弹 - 注意看内部画面

IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.en: Still breathing. Someone beside you can bring you round.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.ch: 還有呼吸. 身旁有人就能把你喚醒.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.cn: 还有呼吸. 身边有人就能把你唤醒.

IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.en: Left alone, you will come to for a few minutes - stop the bleeding then.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.ch: 若無人在旁, 你會短暫清醒幾分鐘 - 趁那時止血.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.cn: 如果身边没人, 你会短暂清醒几分钟 - 趁那时止血.

IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.en: You come to - stop the bleeding!
IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.ch: 你醒過來了 - 快止血!
IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.cn: 你醒过来了 - 快止血!

IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.en: Their heart has stopped. Each shock costs a charge, and each one after the first is less likely to work.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.ch: 對方心跳已停止. 每次電擊會消耗一格電量, 而第一次之後的每次電擊成功率都會降低.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.cn: 他们的心跳已停止. 每次电击会消耗一格电量, 而第一次之后的每次电击成功率都会降低.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.en: Their heart has stopped. Compressions buy time and rarely restart it; a defibrillator is the real way back.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.ch: 對方心跳已停止. 按壓能爭取時間, 但很少能讓心臟重新跳動; 電擊器才是真正的救命手段.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.cn: 他们的心跳已停止. 按压能争取时间, 但很少能让心脏重新跳动; 除颤器才是真正的救命手段.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.en: Only once nothing is bleeding. Gets them on their feet for about an hour; it does not put any blood back.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.ch: 須先止住所有出血. 能讓對方起身行動約一小時; 但不會補回任何血液.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.cn: 必须先止住所有出血. 能让他们站起来活动约一小时; 但不会补回任何血液.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.en: They come along the ground behind you. No running, and it wears you out fast; raising a weapon, stairs and cars make you let go.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.ch: 對方會被你拖在地上走. 無法奔跑, 而且體力消耗很快; 舉起武器, 上下樓梯或上車都會讓你放手.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.cn: 他们会被你拖着在地上走. 无法奔跑, 而且体力消耗很快; 举起武器, 上下楼梯或上车都会让你松手.

IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.en: The bullet is too deep in the tissue - pack the wound and take antibiotics.
IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.ch: 子彈卡在組織深處 - 填塞傷口並服用抗生素.
IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.cn: 子弹卡在组织深处 - 填塞伤口并服用抗生素.

IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.en: You don't stitch a gunshot wound - flush it and pack it.
IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.ch: 槍傷不能縫合 - 要沖洗後再填塞.
IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.cn: 枪伤不能缝合 - 要冲洗后再填塞.

IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.en: The wound has closed - the packing comes away.
IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.ch: 傷口已癒合 - 填塞物脫落了.
IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.cn: 伤口已愈合 - 填塞物脱落了.

IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.en: They are still bleeding - stop it first.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.ch: 對方仍在流血 - 先止血.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.cn: 他们还在流血 - 先止血.

IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.en: The heart is still stopped. Keep going.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.ch: 心臟仍未恢復跳動. 繼續.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.cn: 心脏仍未恢复跳动. 继续.

IGUI_Wounds_TamponadeNeed.en: Requires a bandage or ripped sheets

IGUI_Wounds_TowTaken.en: Someone else already has hold of them.
IGUI_Wounds_TowTaken.ch: 已經有其他人抓著對方了.
IGUI_Wounds_TowTaken.cn: 已经有其他人抓着他们了.

IGUI_Wounds_TowWeapon.en: You let go to take up your weapon.
IGUI_Wounds_TowWeapon.ch: 你為了舉起武器而放手.
IGUI_Wounds_TowWeapon.cn: 你为了举起武器而松手.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimCut.en: Cut along the edge of the dead tissue
IGUI_Wounds_TrimCut.ch: 沿著壞死組織的邊緣切
IGUI_Wounds_TrimCut.cn: 沿着坏死组织的边缘切

IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.en: Pick the cut strips out with the tip of the blade
IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.ch: 用刀尖挑出切下的組織條
IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.cn: 用刀尖挑出切下的组织条

IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.en: No tweezers - the edge will not hold still.
IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.ch: 沒有鑷子 - 邊緣固定不住.
IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.cn: 没有镊子 - 边缘固定不住.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimSlip.en: The blade slips off the edge.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.en: Snip along the edge of the dead tissue
IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.ch: 沿著壞死組織的邊緣剪
IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.cn: 沿着坏死组织的边缘剪

IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingDesc.en: Runs a concealed pipe tree from the tile you clicked to every sink, toilet and washer in the building, climbing to other floors through the walls. Costs %1 Iron Pipe(s) per fixture connected, taken when the work starts; a fixture it cannot reach is refunded. Pipes you already laid are reused, never built over. Pipe laid this way gives nothing back when dismantled.
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingDesc.ch: 從你點選的格子鋪設一套暗埋的樹狀管線, 通往建築內的每個水槽, 馬桶和洗衣機, 並穿過牆壁延伸到其他樓層. 每接通一個用水裝置消耗 %1 根鐵管, 於開工時扣除; 無法接通的用水裝置所耗的鐵管會退還. 你已鋪設的水管會被重複利用, 絕不會在上面重複建造. 以此方式鋪設的水管拆除時不會返還任何材料.
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingDesc.cn: 从你点击的格子铺设一套暗埋的树状管线, 通往建筑内的每个水槽, 马桶和洗衣机, 并穿过墙壁延伸到其他楼层. 每接通一个用水设备消耗 %1 根金属管, 在开工时扣除; 无法接通的用水设备所耗的金属管会退还. 你已铺设的水管会被重复利用, 绝不会在其上重复建造. 以此方式铺设的水管拆除时不会返还任何材料.

IGUI_KBW_GuideMagazinesBody.en: <IMAGE:media/ui/craftingMenus/BuildProperty_Book_16.png,20,20> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Unlocking buildables <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Many buildables must be learned before they can be built. Read the matching magazine - such as Fine Wood Working, The Family Handyman, Old House Journal, Architectural Digest, Popular Mechanics, Home Mechanix, Projects In Metal, the Flooring Guide or the Decoration Guide - or reach the higher skill level the recipe allows instead. In Skills & Knowledge, select the knowledge row to see which magazine teaches it. <LINE> <LINE> Locked recipes are hidden until learned. All qualities shows them so you can see what a magazine unlocks, but they still cannot be built until you know them; the server checks the same rule. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Where to find them <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Magazines turn up in bookshops, libraries, magazine racks and mechanic shelves. Each one teaches one group of recipes, for example dressers, doors and windows, wooden floors, lighting or bathroom appliances. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Building components <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Appliances and plumbing use Refrigerant Bottles, Refrigerator Compressors, Plastic Sheets, Insulation Foam, Small Rubber Tubes, Thin Copper Pipe and Rubber Seals. They are found in tool and electronics stores and tool crates. Cut a Plastic Sheet into small sheets with scissors, make a Small Rubber Tube from a rubber hose, and assemble a Refrigerator Compressor from sheet metal, electronics scrap, electric wire, screws and thin copper pipe.
IGUI_KBW_GuideMagazinesBody.ch: <IMAGE:media/ui/craftingMenus/BuildProperty_Book_16.png,20,20> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 解鎖可建造物 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 許多可建造物必須先學會才能建造. 請閱讀對應的雜誌, 例如《精細木工》, 《家庭雜工》, 《老房子期刊》, 《建築文摘》, 《大眾機械》, 《居家機工》, 《金屬工藝》, 《地板指南》或《裝飾指南》, 或者改為達到該配方所允許的較高技能等級. 在「技能與知識」中選取知識列, 即可檢視由哪本雜誌教授. <LINE> <LINE> 鎖定的配方在學會前會隱藏. 「所有品質」會將它們顯示出來, 讓你知道雜誌會解鎖哪些內容, 但在學會之前仍然無法建造; 伺服器也會檢查同樣的規則. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 在哪裡找到雜誌 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 雜誌會出現在書店, 圖書館, 雜誌架和修車廠貨架上. 每本雜誌教授一組配方, 例如五斗櫃, 門窗, 木地板, 照明或浴室設備. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 建造零件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 電器和管線會用到冷媒瓶, 冰箱壓縮機, 塑膠布, 隔熱泡棉, 小橡膠管, 細銅管和橡膠密封圈. 這些可以在五金行, 電子產品店和工具箱中找到. 用剪刀將塑膠布剪成小塊塑膠布, 用橡膠軟管製作小橡膠管, 並用鋼板, 電子廢料, 電線, 螺絲和細銅管組裝冰箱壓縮機.
IGUI_KBW_GuideMagazinesBody.cn: <IMAGE:media/ui/craftingMenus/BuildProperty_Book_16.png,20,20> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 解锁可建造物 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 许多可建造物必须先学会才能建造. 请阅读对应的杂志, 例如《精细木工》, 《家庭杂工》, 《老房子期刊》, 《建筑文摘》, 《大众机械》, 《居家机工》, 《金属工艺》, 《地板指南》或《装饰指南》, 或者改为达到该配方所允许的更高技能等级. 在“技能与知识”中选择知识行, 即可查看由哪本杂志教授. <LINE> <LINE> 锁定的配方在学会之前会被隐藏. “所有品质”会将它们显示出来, 让你了解杂志会解锁哪些内容, 但在学会之前仍然无法建造; 服务器也会检查同样的规则. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 在哪里找到杂志 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 杂志会出现在书店, 图书馆, 杂志架和修车铺货架上. 每本杂志教授一组配方, 例如五斗柜, 门窗, 木地板, 照明或浴室设备. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 建造零件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 电器和管道会用到制冷剂瓶, 冰箱压缩机, 塑料布, 隔热泡沫, 小橡胶管, 细铜管和橡胶密封圈. 这些可以在五金店, 电子产品店和工具箱中找到. 用剪刀将塑料布剪成小块塑料布, 用橡胶软管制作小橡胶管, 并用金属板, 电子废料, 电线, 螺丝和细铜管组装冰箱压缩机.

IGUI_KBW_GuidePlanningToolsBody.en: <H2> Adding pieces <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Choose a piece in the planning catalogue, select Add to plan and click in the world. Walls drag in a line and floors fill a dragged rectangle.  <LINE> Quickbar: the numbered bar at the bottom of the screen saves the current catalogue selection with its stage, variant, material and finish. Click an empty slot to save it, click a filled slot or press 1-9 to place it, and right-click a slot to replace or clear it.  <LINE> Pipette: in the Pieces tab, select Pipette and hover a planned ghost or a built piece in the world. The piece that would be picked is outlined and named; when several share a tile, the rotate key steps through them. Click to keep planning with exactly that piece - recipe, variant, material, direction and paint, plaster or wallpaper - without searching the catalogue. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Editing the plan <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Select ghosts: drag a box to select planned pieces; hold Shift to add to the selection. Ctrl-click and Shift-click in the Pieces list select several pieces too.  <LINE> Delete selected, or the Delete key, removes every selected ghost at once.  <LINE> Erase tool removes the planned piece outlined on the tile you click, the top one at first. When several share a tile, the rotate key steps down through them.  <LINE> Move blueprint shows the whole plan under the cursor and moves it where you click.  <LINE> Stop tool puts away whichever planning tool is in your hand. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> A red ghost explains itself. <POPRGB> <SPACE> Hold the cursor over the spot to read why: another planned piece in the way, outside the plan's range, a missing frame or earlier stage, or no permission.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePlanningToolsBody.ch: <H2> 新增構件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 在規劃目錄中選擇一個構件, 選擇「加入規劃」, 然後在世界中點選. 牆壁會沿直線拖曳放置, 地板則會填滿拖曳出的矩形.  <LINE> 快捷欄: 畫面底部的編號欄會儲存目前的目錄選取, 包括其階段, 變體, 材質和飾面. 點選空槽位即可儲存, 點選已儲存的槽位或按 1-9 即可放置, 按右鍵點選槽位則可取代或清除.  <LINE> 滴管工具: 在構件分頁中選擇「滴管工具」, 然後將游標停在世界中的已規劃幽靈或已建造構件上. 將被選取的構件會顯示外框和名稱; 當同一格上有多個構件時, 旋轉鍵可逐一切換. 點選即可沿用完全相同的構件繼續規劃, 包括配方, 變體, 材質, 方向以及油漆, 灰泥或壁紙, 不必在目錄中搜尋. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 編輯規劃 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 選取幽靈: 拖曳出方框即可選取已規劃的構件; 按住 Shift 可加入選取範圍. 在構件清單中按住 Ctrl 或 Shift 點選, 也可以選取多個構件.  <LINE> 「移除所選」或 Delete 鍵會一次移除所有選取的幽靈.  <LINE> 擦除工具會移除你點選的格子上以外框標示的已規劃構件, 起初是最上層的那個. 當同一格上有多個構件時, 旋轉鍵可往下逐一切換.  <LINE> 移動藍圖會在游標下顯示整個規劃, 並將它移到你點選的位置.  <LINE> 停止工具會收起你手上正在使用的任何規劃工具. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 紅色幽靈會說明原因. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 將游標停在該位置即可檢視原因: 有其他已規劃的構件擋住, 超出規劃範圍, 缺少框架或前一個階段, 或沒有權限.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePlanningToolsBody.cn: <H2> 添加构件 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 在规划目录中选择一个构件, 选择“添加到规划”, 然后在世界中点击. 墙壁会沿直线拖动放置, 地板则会填满拖出的矩形.  <LINE> 快捷栏: 屏幕底部的编号栏会保存当前的目录选择, 包括其阶段, 变体, 材质和饰面. 点击空槽位即可保存, 点击已保存的槽位或按 1-9 即可放置, 右键点击槽位则可替换或清除.  <LINE> 吸管工具: 在构件标签页中选择“吸管工具”, 然后将鼠标悬停在世界中的已规划幽灵或已建造构件上. 将被选取的构件会显示轮廓和名称; 当同一格上有多个构件时, 旋转键可逐个切换. 点击即可使用完全相同的构件继续规划, 包括配方, 变体, 材质, 方向以及油漆, 灰泥或壁纸, 无需在目录中搜索. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 编辑规划 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 选择幽灵: 拖出方框即可选择已规划的构件; 按住 Shift 可添加到当前选择. 在构件列表中按住 Ctrl 或 Shift 点击, 也可以选择多个构件.  <LINE> “移除所选”或 Delete 键会一次性移除所有选中的幽灵.  <LINE> 擦除工具会移除你点击的格子上以轮廓标示的已规划构件, 起初是最上层的那个. 当同一格上有多个构件时, 旋转键可向下逐个切换.  <LINE> 移动蓝图会在鼠标下显示整个规划, 并将其移动到你点击的位置.  <LINE> 停止工具会收起你手中正在使用的任何规划工具. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 红色幽灵会说明原因. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 将鼠标悬停在该位置即可查看原因: 有其他已规划的构件挡住, 超出规划范围, 缺少框架或前一阶段, 或没有权限.

IGUI_KBW_GuidePreviewBody.en: <H2> World preview settings <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> In the Plans tab, World preview settings choose how ghosts are drawn: Blueprint tint, Original textures or Solid preview (100%). Show the selected level only, the selected level with faded neighbours, the selected level and below, or all levels, and hide roofs, planned walls or room zones while you work inside a building. These settings change only what you see and are kept per player. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Preview layout <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Preview layout opens the whole plan in its own window. Switch between Isometric and Top-down, move between floors, toggle the grid, use Fit, zoom with the mouse wheel and drag to pan. The top-down view draws walls on the edge they stand on, floors as filled squares, objects as blocks and roofs hatched, with north up; rooms keep their colours and the gather area has a green outline.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePreviewBody.ch: <H2> 世界預覽設定 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在規劃分頁中, 世界預覽設定可選擇幽靈的繪製方式: 藍圖色調, 原始紋理或實體預覽 (100%%). 你可以只顯示所選樓層, 顯示所選樓層並淡化相鄰樓層, 顯示所選樓層及以下樓層, 或顯示所有樓層; 在建築內工作時, 也可以隱藏屋頂, 已規劃的牆壁或房間區域. 這些設定只會改變你看到的畫面, 並會依玩家分別保存. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 預覽佈局 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 預覽佈局會在獨立視窗中開啟整個規劃. 你可以在等距視角與俯視之間切換, 在樓層間移動, 開關網格, 使用「符合視窗」, 用滑鼠滾輪縮放, 以及拖曳平移. 俯視檢視會將牆壁畫在其所在的邊上, 地板畫成填滿的方格, 物件畫成方塊, 屋頂以斜線標示, 並以北方朝上; 房間會保留各自的顏色, 收集區域則有綠色外框.
IGUI_KBW_GuidePreviewBody.cn: <H2> 世界预览设置 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在规划标签页中, 世界预览设置可选择幽灵的绘制方式: 蓝图色调, 原始纹理或实体预览 (100%%). 你可以只显示所选楼层, 显示所选楼层并淡化相邻楼层, 显示所选楼层及以下楼层, 或显示所有楼层; 在建筑内工作时, 还可以隐藏屋顶, 已规划的墙壁或房间区域. 这些设置只会改变你看到的画面, 并按玩家分别保存. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 预览布局 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 预览布局会在单独的窗口中打开整个规划. 你可以在等距视角和俯视之间切换, 在楼层之间移动, 开关网格, 使用“适应窗口”, 用鼠标滚轮缩放, 以及拖动平移. 俯视视图会将墙壁绘制在其所在的边上, 地板绘制为填充的方格, 物体绘制为方块, 屋顶以斜线标示, 并以北方朝上; 房间会保留各自的颜色, 收集区域则有绿色轮廓.

IGUI_KBW_GuideRoofsBody.en: <H2> Roofs without guesswork <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> Select a room in the Rooms tab and open Roof helper. Neighbouring rooms on the same level are roofed together, and a room under an upper storey is roofed against that wall. The helper lists every roof that fits - flat, shed, lean-to, gable, hip and cross-gable - as small shaded 3D models, best first, with the recommended one marked. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Choosing a roof <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Roof family and pitch: the roof tiles and their slope, 30 or 45 degrees.  <LINE> Gable walls and Gable finish: the end walls, in any variant their family shares and in paint, plaster, plaster with paint or wallpaper where every piece accepts it.  <LINE> Overhang, Maximum rise, Start level offset, Ceiling deck and Eaves fine-tune the roof.  <LINE> Hover a layout to see it in the world in its real tiles, click to choose it, then select Add preview to blueprint. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> The roof is added as ordinary planned pieces, so it is built, erased and checked like any other ghost. Shallow sheets, roof trim and tents are placed by hand from the catalogue. <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> At 45 degrees the north and west slopes are hidden by the camera. <POPRGB> <SPACE> The ceiling deck keeps those tiles dry, as in vanilla buildings; at 30 degrees every side is built.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoofsBody.ch: <H2> 屋頂不必靠猜 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房間分頁中選擇一個房間, 然後開啟屋頂助手. 同一樓層上相鄰的房間會一起加上屋頂, 而位於上層樓下方的房間會以靠著該面牆的方式加上屋頂. 助手會列出所有適合的屋頂, 包括平頂, 單坡式, 依附單坡式, 山牆式, 四坡式和交叉山牆式, 並以小型陰影 3D 模型呈現, 最佳的排在最前面, 並標示出建議的那一個. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 選擇屋頂 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 屋頂家族與坡度: 屋頂瓦片及其坡度, 30 或 45 度.  <LINE> 山牆與山牆飾面: 兩端的端牆, 可使用其家族共有的任何變體, 並可在每個構件都支援時使用油漆, 灰泥, 灰泥加油漆或壁紙.  <LINE> 出簷, 最大升高, 起始樓層偏移, 天花板層和屋簷可微調屋頂.  <LINE> 將游標停在某個佈局上, 即可在世界中以實際瓦片檢視, 點選即可選用, 然後選擇「將預覽加入藍圖」. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 屋頂會以一般的已規劃構件加入, 因此其建造, 擦除和檢查方式與其他幽靈相同. 緩坡屋面, 屋頂飾條和帳篷需從目錄中手動放置. <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 在 45 度時, 北側與西側坡面會被鏡頭擋住而隱藏. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 天花板層會讓這些格子保持乾燥, 與原版建築相同; 在 30 度時, 每一側都會建造.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoofsBody.cn: <H2> 屋顶无需猜测 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房间标签页中选择一个房间, 然后打开屋顶助手. 同一楼层上相邻的房间会一起加盖屋顶, 而位于上层楼下方的房间会以倚靠该面墙的方式加盖屋顶. 助手会列出所有合适的屋顶, 包括平顶, 单坡式, 依附单坡式, 山墙式, 四坡式和交叉山墙式, 并以带阴影的小型 3D 模型呈现, 最佳的排在最前面, 并标出推荐的那一个. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 选择屋顶 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 屋顶家族与坡度: 屋顶瓦片及其坡度, 30 或 45 度.  <LINE> 山墙与山墙饰面: 两端的端墙, 可使用其家族共有的任何变体, 并可在每个构件都支持时使用油漆, 灰泥, 灰泥加油漆或壁纸.  <LINE> 出檐, 最大升高, 起始楼层偏移, 天花板层和檐口可微调屋顶.  <LINE> 将鼠标悬停在某个布局上, 即可在世界中以实际瓦片查看, 点击即可选用, 然后选择“将预览添加到蓝图”. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 屋顶会作为普通的已规划构件添加, 因此其建造, 擦除和检查方式与其他幽灵相同. 缓坡屋面, 屋顶饰条和帐篷需要从目录中手动放置. <LINE> <LINE>  <PUSHRGB:0.88,0.78,0.40> 在 45 度时, 北侧和西侧坡面会被镜头遮挡而隐藏. <POPRGB> <SPACE> 天花板层会让这些格子保持干燥, 与原版建筑相同; 在 30 度时, 每一侧都会建造.

IGUI_KBW_GuideRoomsBody.en: <H2> Drawing rooms <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> In the Rooms tab, type a name, pick a colour, select Draw room and drag a rectangle on the planning level. Rooms mark out spaces, show as coloured outlines and give the Roof helper its footprint. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> Any shape <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> Extend room: select a room and drag a rectangle that touches or overlaps it to add a wing; repeat for L, T, U or irregular shapes.  <LINE> Cut from room: select a room and drag an area to clear it out, for notches, holes or trimming a side. A room cut down to nothing is removed.  <LINE> Update room saves a new name or colour, Delete room removes the selected room, and Erase room removes the room on the tile you click. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> Rooms are planning marks only: they do not build walls or floors by themselves.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoomsBody.ch: <H2> 繪製房間 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房間分頁中輸入名稱, 選擇顏色, 選擇「繪製房間」, 然後在規劃樓層上拖曳出一個矩形. 房間用來劃分空間, 會以彩色外框顯示, 並為屋頂助手提供佔地範圍. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 任意形狀 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 延伸房間: 選擇一個房間, 然後拖曳出與其相接或重疊的矩形, 即可加上一個側翼; 重複此操作可做出 L 形, T 形, U 形或不規則形狀.  <LINE> 從房間切除: 選擇一個房間, 然後拖曳出要清除的區域, 可用於做出凹口, 開洞或修整某一側. 被切到完全不剩的房間會被移除.  <LINE> 「更新房間」會儲存新的名稱或顏色, 「刪除房間」會移除所選的房間, 「擦除房間」則會移除你點選的格子上的房間. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 房間只是規劃標記: 它們本身不會建造牆壁或地板.
IGUI_KBW_GuideRoomsBody.cn: <H2> 绘制房间 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> 在房间标签页中输入名称, 选择颜色, 选择“绘制房间”, 然后在规划楼层上拖出一个矩形. 房间用于划分空间, 会以彩色轮廓显示, 并为屋顶助手提供占地范围. <LINE> <LINE>  <H2> 任意形状 <TEXT> <LINE> <LINE> <INDENT:18> 扩展房间: 选择一个房间, 然后拖出与其相接或重叠的矩形, 即可添加一个侧翼; 重复此操作可做出 L 形, T 形, U 形或不规则形状.  <LINE> 从房间切除: 选择一个房间, 然后拖出要清除的区域, 可用于做出凹口, 开洞或修整某一侧. 被切得一点不剩的房间会被移除.  <LINE> “更新房间”会保存新的名称或颜色, “删除房间”会移除所选房间, “擦除房间”则会移除你点击的格子上的房间. <INDENT:0> <LINE> <LINE> 房间只是规划标记: 它们本身不会建造墙壁或地板.

IGUI_KBW_RoofHelp.en: Every layout is drawn as a small model; the shading shows which way each slope faces. Hover a layout to see it in the world in its real tiles, click to choose it. Each card previews the real tile: use its arrows, the mouse wheel or a click on it to switch roof family, gable walls and gable finish (painted, wallpapered or plastered where the material allows it). At 45° the north and west slopes are hidden by the camera, so the ceiling deck keeps those tiles dry; at 30° both sides are built. End walls use the gable material and follow the exact slope of the roof. Only families the helper can lay out by itself are listed; shallow sheets, roof trim and tents are placed from the catalogue.
IGUI_KBW_RoofHelp.ch: 每種佈局都以小模型呈現; 陰影表示各坡面的朝向. 將滑鼠停在佈局上, 即可在遊戲世界中以實際格子檢視, 點選即可選用. 每張卡片都會預覽實際格子: 使用其箭頭, 滑鼠滾輪或點選卡片, 即可切換屋頂家族, 山牆與山牆飾面 (材料允許時可選塗漆, 壁紙或灰泥). 在 45° 時, 北側與西側坡面會被鏡頭遮住, 因此由天花板層讓這些格子保持乾燥; 在 30° 時兩側都會建造. 端牆使用山牆材料, 並完全貼合屋頂的坡度. 只會列出屋頂助手能自行鋪排的家族; 緩坡板片, 屋頂飾條與帳篷需從目錄放置.
IGUI_KBW_RoofHelp.cn: 每种布局都以小模型呈现; 阴影表示各坡面的朝向. 将鼠标悬停在布局上, 即可在游戏世界中以实际格子查看, 点击即可选择. 每张卡片都会预览实际格子: 使用其箭头, 鼠标滚轮或点击卡片, 即可切换屋顶家族, 山墙和山墙饰面 (材料允许时可选涂漆, 墙纸或抹灰). 在 45° 时, 北侧和西侧坡面会被镜头遮挡, 因此由天花板层保持这些格子干燥; 在 30° 时两侧都会建造. 端墙使用山墙材料, 并精确贴合屋顶的坡度. 只会列出屋顶助手能自行布置的家族; 缓坡板片, 屋顶饰条和帐篷需从目录中放置.

IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_BuildDesc.en: Builds every case in the scope, one at a time: supplies requirements (or uses what you carry), finds a valid square and stacks prerequisites there (frames, support walls, barricade targets), builds instantly or walks over and builds, applies wall finishes and coverings, then verifies objects, consumption and finishes. Kept pieces get their own spaced slot sized to their footprint.
IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_BuildDesc.ch: 逐一建造範圍內的每個測試案例: 提供需求物品 (或使用你身上攜帶的物品), 找到有效的格子並在那裡疊放前置構件 (框架, 支撐牆, 路障目標), 瞬間建造或走過去建造, 套用牆面飾面與覆蓋物, 然後驗證物件, 消耗與飾面. 保留的構件會各自獲得一個依佔地大小配置且彼此間隔的位置.
IGUI_KBW_TestSuite_BuildDesc.cn: 逐一建造范围内的每个测试用例: 提供需求物品 (或使用你随身携带的物品), 找到有效的格子并在那里叠放前置构件 (框架, 支撑墙, 路障目标), 瞬间建造或走过去建造, 应用墙面饰面和覆盖物, 然后验证物品, 消耗和饰面. 保留的构件会各自获得一个按占地大小划定且彼此间隔的位置.

IGUI_ALifeUI_084ac3af41e772e9.en: APPEARANCE: choose skin tone, hair and beard, then build up to six outfit sets, A to F. Tick Enable this set for spawning on every set you want used; only ticked sets are picked. A set can be limited to a season (Any season, Spring only, Summer only, Autumn only or Winter only). In its season a seasonal set replaces the any-season sets. The season follows the outdoor temperature when the NPC is dressed and again while it lives (the date only picks spring or autumn between 4 and 22 C).
IGUI_ALifeUI_084ac3af41e772e9.ch: APPEARANCE: 選擇膚色、髮型與鬍子, 接著最多建立六套服裝組合 (A 到 F). 在每套想使用的組合上勾選允許此套生成 (Enable this set for spawning); 只有勾選的組合會被選取. 每套組合都可限定季節 (不限季節 Any season、僅春季 Spring only、僅夏季 Summer only、僅秋季 Autumn only 或僅冬季 Winter only). 在對應季節中, 季節限定組合會取代不限季節的組合. 季節依NPC換裝當下的室外溫度判定, 並在其存活期間持續重新判定 (只有在 4 到 22 C 之間時, 才由日期決定是春季還是秋季).
IGUI_ALifeUI_084ac3af41e772e9.cn: APPEARANCE: 选择肤色、发型和胡子, 然后最多创建六套服装套装 (A 到 F). 在每套想使用的套装上勾选允许此套生成 (Enable this set for spawning); 只有勾选的套装才会被选中. 每套套装都可限定季节 (不限季节 Any season、仅春季 Spring only、仅夏季 Summer only、仅秋季 Autumn only 或仅冬季 Winter only). 在对应季节中, 季节限定套装会取代不限季节的套装. 季节依据NPC换装时的室外温度判定, 并在其存活期间持续重新判定 (只有在 4 到 22 C 之间时, 才由日期决定是春季还是秋季).

IGUI_ALifeUI_180cd1824a9aa234.en: On by default. Adds an A-Life Radio entry to the right-click menu of any radio or walkie-talkie, and a button in the radio window. It opens one panel with your standing, the people who told you where they live, what you heard on the air and notes from your base. Off removes the entries at once, no restart.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2bd66d18593d26c4.en: LOADOUT: pick a PRIMARY firearm, a SIDEARM and a MELEE / BELT weapon the same way, with up to four random choices each. AMMUNITION is counted in whole magazines, not loose rounds. Infinite ammunition removes the reload limit, and Drop magazines on death with its chance controls what can be looted. FIREARM ATTACHMENTS sets scopes, sights and other parts.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2bd66d18593d26c4.ch: LOADOUT: 用同樣的方式選擇 PRIMARY 槍械、SIDEARM 與 MELEE / BELT 武器, 每項最多可設四個隨機選項. AMMUNITION 以整個彈匣計算, 而非散裝子彈. 無限彈藥 (Infinite ammunition) 會取消裝填限制, 死亡時掉落彈匣 (Drop magazines on death) 及其機率則決定能搜刮到什麼. FIREARM ATTACHMENTS 用來設定瞄準鏡、準星與其他配件.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2bd66d18593d26c4.cn: LOADOUT: 用同样的方式选择 PRIMARY 枪械、SIDEARM 和 MELEE / BELT 武器, 每项最多可设四个随机选项. AMMUNITION 以整个弹匣计算, 而非散装子弹. 无限弹药 (Infinite ammunition) 会取消装填限制, 死亡时掉落弹匣 (Drop magazines on death) 及其概率则决定能搜刮到什么. FIREARM ATTACHMENTS 用于设置瞄准镜、准星和其他配件.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2e9da2a3439dd8de.en: On by default. The Creator leaves out clothing and loadout lines that only repeat the default value, so the NPC file is a third of the size and opens much faster. The file is rewritten this way on your next save, and the old copy is kept next to it as a backup. Older files still load. Turn it off to write every line again.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2e9da2a3439dd8de.ch: 預設開啟. 編輯器會省略只重複預設值的服裝與配備行, 讓NPC檔案縮小為原本的三分之一, 開啟速度也快得多. 下次儲存時檔案會以這種方式重寫, 舊檔則保留在旁邊作為備份. 舊檔案仍可載入. 關閉此項即可再次寫入每一行.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2e9da2a3439dd8de.cn: 默认开启. 编辑器会省略只重复默认值的服装和装备行, 让NPC文件缩小为原来的三分之一, 打开速度也快得多. 下次保存时文件会以这种方式重写, 旧文件则保留在旁边作为备份. 旧文件仍可加载. 关闭此项即可再次写入每一行.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2eadefaf4c99a38e.en: Pick a faction, then press + NEW MEMBER in the MEMBER PRESETS column. The new preset is selected and ready to edit. DUPLICATE NPC is the quickest way to make a variation of a member you already like. The arrow buttons above the editor step through the members and save first. The search box and the ALL, RANGED, MELEE and ISSUES buttons help with long rosters.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2eadefaf4c99a38e.ch: 選擇一個陣營, 然後在 MEMBER PRESETS 欄按 + NEW MEMBER. 新預設會被選取, 可以直接編輯. 想做出某個滿意成員的變化版本, 最快的方法是 DUPLICATE NPC. 編輯區上方的箭頭按鈕會先儲存, 再切換到其他成員. 名單很長時, 可以利用搜尋框以及 ALL、RANGED、MELEE 與 ISSUES 按鈕.
IGUI_ALifeUI_2eadefaf4c99a38e.cn: 选择一个阵营, 然后在 MEMBER PRESETS 栏按 + NEW MEMBER. 新预设会被选中, 可以直接编辑. 想制作某个满意成员的变体, 最快的方法是 DUPLICATE NPC. 编辑区上方的箭头按钮会先保存, 再切换到其他成员. 名单很长时, 可以利用搜索框以及 ALL、RANGED、MELEE 和 ISSUES 按钮.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2f8a969721c18a23.en: On by default. The Creator writes your NPC in the background in small slices, so closing it or switching NPC never freezes the game. Turn it off only if saving misbehaves: the old save, which can take a long time on a big NPC list, comes back.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2f8a969721c18a23.cn: 默认开启. 编辑器会在后台分成小段写入你的NPC, 因此关闭编辑器或切换NPC时游戏不会卡住. 只有在保存出问题时才关闭: 关闭后会恢复旧的保存方式, NPC列表很长时可能要花很久.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3c353126289d06dc.en: BEHAVIOR tab: Behavior profile is the complete baseline package of priorities, engagement style and allowed abilities, and the summary under it spells out what it does. Primary doctrine adds one specialist role: None, Leader, Gunner, Medic, Sniper, Stealth or Ambusher. Combat ready decides whether the NPC starts out armed and prepared (Default, Yes, No or Mixed).
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c353126289d06dc.ch: BEHAVIOR 分頁: 行為設定 (Behavior profile) 是一整套基礎配置, 包含優先順序、交戰風格與允許的能力, 下方的摘要會說明它的作用. 主要準則 (Primary doctrine) 會增加一種專長角色: 無 (None)、領導者 (Leader)、槍手 (Gunner)、醫護兵 (Medic)、狙擊手 (Sniper)、潛行者 (Stealth) 或伏擊者 (Ambusher). 戰鬥就緒 (Combat ready) 決定NPC一出現是否就已武裝並做好準備 (預設 Default、是 Yes、否 No 或混合 Mixed).
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c353126289d06dc.cn: BEHAVIOR 标签页: 行为设定 (Behavior profile) 是一整套基础配置, 包含优先级、交战风格和允许的能力, 下方的摘要会说明它的作用. 主要准则 (Primary doctrine) 会增加一种专长角色: 无 (None)、领导者 (Leader)、枪手 (Gunner)、医疗兵 (Medic)、狙击手 (Sniper)、潜行者 (Stealth) 或伏击手 (Ambusher). 战斗就绪 (Combat ready) 决定NPC一出现是否就已武装并做好准备 (默认 Default、是 Yes、否 No 或混合 Mixed).

IGUI_ALifeUI_3c8878222267fffa.en: Class (IDENTITY tab) decides who the Fear of the dead ability affects: Civilian members, and less easily Rescue and Worker members, leave distant zombies alone and run as a group when too many close in, while Police, Military and Criminal members stay steady. IGUI_ALifeUI_5a2f708d0e1ea818.en: Closing the Creator or switching member never waits for a save: the NPC keeps being written in the background and the main menu says Saving NPC... until it is done. SAVING - RETRY WHEN SAVED means something that needs the finished file (SAVE NOW, new, copy, delete, export or sync) was held back to protect your edits. Nothing is lost. Wait for the label to change to SAVED and then do it again.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5a2f708d0e1ea818.ch: 關閉編輯器或切換成員時都不會等待儲存完成: NPC會在背景持續寫入, 主選單會顯示「Saving NPC...」直到完成. SAVING - RETRY WHEN SAVED 表示某個需要完整檔案的操作 (SAVE NOW、新增、複製、刪除、匯出或同步) 為了保護你的編輯而暫緩執行. 不會遺失任何東西. 等標籤變成 SAVED 後再操作一次即可.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5a2f708d0e1ea818.cn: 关闭编辑器或切换成员时都不会等待保存完成: NPC会在后台持续写入, 主菜单会显示“Saving NPC...”直到完成. SAVING - RETRY WHEN SAVED 表示某个需要完整文件的操作 (SAVE NOW、新建、复制、删除、导出或同步) 为了保护你的编辑而暂缓执行. 不会丢失任何东西. 等标签变成 SAVED 后再操作一次即可.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5ca26f6171dfa616.en: MODULES tab (NPC ABILITIES): every ability can be Inherit, On or Off. Inherit uses the faction setting; On and Off apply to this NPC only. The abilities are grouped as ORDERS, DANGER RESPONSE, COMBAT MOVEMENT, SURVIVAL & ROUTINE and OUTLAW CONDUCT. RESET ALL TO INHERIT clears this NPC's overrides, and APPLY ABILITIES TO FACTION applies this NPC's ability choices to the whole faction.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5ca26f6171dfa616.ch: MODULES 分頁 (NPC ABILITIES): 每項能力都可設為繼承 (Inherit)、開啟 (On) 或關閉 (Off). 繼承會沿用陣營設定; 開啟與關閉只套用於此NPC. 能力分為 ORDERS、DANGER RESPONSE、COMBAT MOVEMENT、SURVIVAL & ROUTINE 與 OUTLAW CONDUCT 幾組. RESET ALL TO INHERIT 會清除此NPC的覆寫設定, APPLY ABILITIES TO FACTION 則會把此NPC的能力選擇套用到整個陣營.
IGUI_ALifeUI_5ca26f6171dfa616.cn: MODULES 标签页 (NPC ABILITIES): 每项能力都可设为继承 (Inherit)、开启 (On) 或关闭 (Off). 继承会沿用阵营设置; 开启和关闭只应用于此NPC. 能力分为 ORDERS、DANGER RESPONSE、COMBAT MOVEMENT、SURVIVAL & ROUTINE 和 OUTLAW CONDUCT 几组. RESET ALL TO INHERIT 会清除此NPC的覆盖设置, APPLY ABILITIES TO FACTION 则会把此NPC的能力选择应用到整个阵营.

IGUI_ALifeUI_613538e43b8e972d.en: On the faction list, DUPLICATE FACTION copies a faction with all its NPCs and DELETE removes the selected one after asking. COPY CODE turns a faction into a share code you can paste to a friend or on Discord, and LOAD CODE adds a faction from a code in your clipboard. RESET FACTIONS TO DEFAULT puts the built-in factions back as shipped and keeps the ones you made.
IGUI_ALifeUI_613538e43b8e972d.ch: 在陣營清單中, DUPLICATE FACTION 會複製陣營及其所有NPC, DELETE 會在確認後刪除所選陣營. COPY CODE 會把陣營轉成分享碼, 可以貼給朋友或貼到 Discord 上. LOAD CODE 則會用剪貼簿中的代碼新增陣營. RESET FACTIONS TO DEFAULT 會把內建陣營恢復為原始狀態, 並保留你自己建立的陣營.
IGUI_ALifeUI_613538e43b8e972d.cn: 在阵营列表中, DUPLICATE FACTION 会复制阵营及其所有NPC, DELETE 会在确认后删除所选阵营. COPY CODE 会把阵营转换为分享码, 可以发给朋友或贴到 Discord 上. LOAD CODE 则会用剪贴板中的代码添加阵营. RESET FACTIONS TO DEFAULT 会将内置阵营恢复为原始状态, 并保留你自己创建的阵营.

IGUI_ALifeUI_624fae1f0f5bd3e1.en: There are three views. BY FACTION has a row for every other faction: leave a row on Default to use the inherited stance, or set it yourself. BY FOLDER sets one stance toward every faction in a folder (see Folders). BY PROFESSION sets the stance toward the player depending on the player's profession.
IGUI_ALifeUI_624fae1f0f5bd3e1.ch: 共有三種檢視方式. 「依陣營」為每個其他陣營各列一行: 將該列保持為「預設」即沿用繼承的態度, 或自行設定. 「依資料夾」對資料夾內的所有陣營設定同一態度 (見「資料夾」). 「依職業」依玩家的職業設定對玩家的態度.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFloatingAutoClose_To.en:
Closes a floating bag window when you walk away from where the bag is: on the floor, inside a crate or on a corpse.

Bags you carry never close. Pinned windows close too.

Off: windows stay open until you close them.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFloatingAutoClose_To.ch:
當你走離背包所在的位置時, 自動關閉該浮動背包視窗: 地上、箱子裡或屍體上的背包.

你身上攜帶的背包永遠不會關閉. 已固定的視窗也會關閉.

關閉: 視窗會保持開啟, 直到你自行關閉.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFloatingAutoClose_To.cn:
当你走离背包所在的位置时, 自动关闭该浮动背包窗口: 地上、箱子里或尸体上的背包.

你身上携带的背包永远不会关闭. 已固定的窗口也会关闭.

关闭: 窗口会保持打开, 直到你自行关闭.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsIconRotation_Tooltip.en:
Draws item sprites with the rotation, scale and anchor tuned for the mod, so tools, clothes and bottles sit nicely in their cells.

On (default): tuned sprites.

Off: plain sprites, only the footprint size applies. Slightly faster to render.

This is a per-machine visual setting; each player chooses their own.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsIconRotation_Tooltip.ch:
以針對本模組調校過的旋轉、縮放與錨點繪製物品圖示, 讓工具、衣服和瓶子在格子中擺得整齊好看.

開啟 (預設): 調校過的圖示.

關閉: 一般圖示, 只套用占位尺寸. 算繪稍快.

這是各電腦獨立的視覺設定; 每位玩家可自行選擇.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsIconRotation_Tooltip.cn:
以针对本模组调整过的旋转、缩放与锚点绘制物品图标, 让工具、衣服和瓶子在格子中摆得整齐美观.

开启 (默认): 调整过的图标.

关闭: 普通图标, 只应用占位尺寸. 渲染稍快.

这是各电脑独立的视觉设置; 每位玩家可自行选择.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemInfo_Tooltip.en:
Shows extra info inside each item: the ammo count of magazines.

Off: items show only their icon, as before.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemInfo_Tooltip.ch:
在每個物品內顯示額外資訊: 彈匣的彈藥數量.

關閉: 物品只顯示圖示, 與之前相同.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemInfo_Tooltip.cn:
在每个物品内显示额外信息: 弹匣的弹药数量.

关闭: 物品只显示图标, 与之前相同.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemWeight_Tooltip.en:
Shows each item's weight in its top-right corner; for a pile, the total of the pile.

Needs Item info on. Turn off for slightly faster rendering.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemWeight_Tooltip.ch:
在每個物品的右上角顯示其重量; 若是一疊物品, 則顯示整疊的總重.

需開啟「物品資訊」. 關閉可讓算繪稍快.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsItemWeight_Tooltip.cn:
在每个物品的右上角显示其重量; 若是一叠物品, 则显示整叠的总重.

需开启“物品信息”. 关闭可让渲染稍快.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiLootCorpsesOnly.en:
Shows several containers at once only for corpses. Crates, shelves, fridges and the floor show just the one you selected.

The 'Max World Containers' limit still applies to the corpses. Better performance in bases full of containers.

Needs 'Show all loot containers' on.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiLootCorpsesOnly.ch:
只有屍體會同時顯示多個容器. 箱子、貨架、冰箱和地面只顯示你選取的那一個.

「世界容器上限」仍會套用到屍體. 在滿是容器的基地中效能更佳.

需開啟「顯示所有戰利品容器」.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiLootCorpsesOnly.cn:
只有尸体会同时显示多个容器. 箱子、货架、冰箱和地面只显示你选中的那一个.

“世界容器上限”仍会应用于尸体. 在满是容器的基地中性能更佳.

需开启“显示所有战利品容器”.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTextShadow_Tooltip.en:
Draws a dark shadow under the small texts inside items (weight, ammo, stack count) so they read better over bright sprites.

Off (default): plain text. On: each text is drawn twice, which costs some FPS.

This is a per-machine visual setting.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTextShadow_Tooltip.ch:
在物品內的小字 (重量, 彈藥, 堆疊數量) 下方繪製深色陰影, 讓它們在明亮的圖示上更容易閱讀.

關閉 (預設): 一般文字. 開啟: 每段文字都會繪製兩次, 會消耗一些 FPS.

這是各電腦獨立的視覺設定.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTextShadow_Tooltip.cn:
在物品内的小字 (重量, 弹药, 堆叠数量) 下方绘制深色阴影, 让它们在明亮的图标上更容易阅读.

关闭 (默认): 普通文字. 开启: 每段文字都会绘制两次, 会消耗一些 FPS.

这是各电脑独立的视觉设置.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTopBar_Tooltip.en:
Reserves a bar above the inventory and loot grids for search, category filter and auto-sort.

Off: the grids use the full height, as before.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTopBar_Tooltip.ch:
在物品欄與戰利品網格上方保留一列, 用於搜尋、類別篩選與自動整理.

關閉: 網格使用完整高度, 與之前相同.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsTopBar_Tooltip.cn:
在物品栏与战利品网格上方预留一栏, 用于搜索、类别筛选与自动整理.

关闭: 网格使用完整高度, 与之前相同.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick.ch: 物品選單附帶 3D 預覽
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick.cn: 物品菜单附带 3D 预览

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick_.en:
Opening an item's context menu (right click) also shows a 3D preview of the item and its tooltip next to the menu. The menu itself is the game's own.

On by default. Off: only the normal menu. The Inspect (3D) mouse action works either way and shows just the 3D view and tooltip, without the menu.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick_.ch:
開啟物品的右鍵選單 (右鍵點選) 時, 也會在選單旁顯示該物品的 3D 預覽及其提示框. 選單本身是遊戲原有的.

預設開啟. 關閉: 只顯示一般選單. 滑鼠動作「檢視 (3D)」不論開啟與否都能使用, 且只顯示 3D 視圖與提示框, 不含選單.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsInspectOnRightClick_.cn:
打开物品的右键菜单 (右键点击) 时, 也会在菜单旁显示该物品的 3D 预览及其提示框. 菜单本身是游戏原有的.

默认开启. 关闭: 只显示普通菜单. 鼠标动作“查看 (3D)”无论开启与否都能使用, 且只显示 3D 视图和提示框, 不含菜单.

IGUI_DD_MN_ls_SmellGood_0_2.en: Nearby players are not put off by your smell.

IGUI_DD_MN_ls_SmellGood_0_2.cn: 附近的玩家不会因你的气味而反感.

IGUI_DD_MN_ls_TaughtSkill_0_1.cn: 在它消退前, 你无法再教任何人.

IGUI_DD_MN_ls_Uncomfortable_0_1.en: Slightly raises stress, unhappiness and discomfort.
IGUI_DD_MN_ls_Uncomfortable_0_1.ch: 略微提高壓力、憂鬱與不適.
IGUI_DD_MN_ls_Uncomfortable_0_1.cn: 略微提高压力、忧郁和不适.

IGUI_DD_MN_ls_WasTaughtSkill_0_1.en: The skill you were taught earns more XP.
IGUI_DD_MN_ls_WasTaughtSkill_0_1.ch: 被傳授的技能可獲得更多經驗值.
IGUI_DD_MN_ls_WasTaughtSkill_0_1.cn: 被传授的技能可获得更多经验值.

IGUI_DD_MN_ls_Zen_0_1.en: Exercise, yoga and meditation earn more XP.
IGUI_DD_MN_ls_Zen_0_1.ch: 健身、瑜伽與冥想可獲得更多經驗值.

IGUI_DD_MN_pk42_adrenalinefrenzy_3_1.cn: 近战伤害随连杀数提升.

IGUI_DD_MN_pk42_adrenalinefrenzy_3_2.cn: 仅在狂暴持续期间有效.

IGUI_DD_MN_pk42_adrenalinefrenzy_4_1.en: Melee damage at its peak for this streak.
IGUI_DD_MN_pk42_adrenalinefrenzy_4_1.ch: 近戰傷害已達此連殺的峰值.
IGUI_DD_MN_pk42_adrenalinefrenzy_4_1.cn: 近战伤害已达到本次连杀的峰值.

IGUI_DD_MN_worgrimed_3_1.en: Starting to make you ill, where the sandbox option allows.
IGUI_DD_MN_worgrimed_3_1.ch: 若沙盒選項允許, 開始讓你生病.
IGUI_DD_MN_worgrimed_3_1.cn: 若沙盒选项允许, 开始让你生病.

IGUI_DD_MN_worgrimed_4_1.en: Making you ill, where the sandbox option allows.

IGUI_DD_MN_worgrimed_4_1.cn: 若沙盒选项允许, 正在让你生病.

IGUI_DD_Modifiers_tooltip.en: The numbers for what the moodle does to you at the level you are hovering.
IGUI_DD_Modifiers_tooltip.ch: 游標所指等級下, 該狀態對你造成之影響的數值.
IGUI_DD_Modifiers_tooltip.cn: 鼠标悬停的等级下, 该状态对你产生影响的数值.

IGUI_DD_MoodleBullets_tooltip.en: Marks the heading with a dash and every entry with a star, the way the trait tooltips read.
IGUI_DD_MoodleBullets_tooltip.ch: 在標題前加上破折號、每個項目前加上星號, 與特質工具提示的寫法相同.
IGUI_DD_MoodleBullets_tooltip.cn: 在标题前加上短横线、每个条目前加上星号, 与特质工具提示的格式相同.

IGUI_DD_MoodleCentre_tooltip.en: Puts the name in the middle of the box and leaves everything under it where it was.
IGUI_DD_MoodleCentre_tooltip.ch: 將名稱置於框內中央, 下方內容則維持原位.
IGUI_DD_MoodleCentre_tooltip.cn: 将名称放在框的中央, 下方内容保持原位.

IGUI_DD_MoodleDescription_tooltip.en: The line under the moodle name saying what that level of it means.
IGUI_DD_MoodleDescription_tooltip.ch: 狀態名稱下方說明該等級含義的那行文字.
IGUI_DD_MoodleDescription_tooltip.cn: 状态名称下方说明该等级含义的那行文字.

IGUI_DD_MoodleIndent_tooltip.en: Steps every entry in from the heading above it.
IGUI_DD_MoodleIndent_tooltip.ch: 讓每個項目相對於上方標題向內縮排.
IGUI_DD_MoodleIndent_tooltip.cn: 让每个条目相对上方标题向内缩进.

IGUI_DD_MoodleLeft_tooltip.en: Moodle tooltips read right to left by default, since they sit against the right edge of the screen.
IGUI_DD_MoodleLeft_tooltip.ch: 狀態圖示的工具提示預設靠右對齊, 因為它們緊貼著螢幕右側邊緣.
IGUI_DD_MoodleLeft_tooltip.cn: 状态图标的工具提示默认右对齐, 因为它们紧贴屏幕右侧边缘.

IGUI_DD_MoodleNotes_tooltip.en: Written lines for what a moodle does that no single number covers.
IGUI_DD_MoodleNotes_tooltip.ch: 以文字說明狀態中無法用單一數值表達的效果.
IGUI_DD_MoodleNotes_tooltip.cn: 用文字说明状态中无法用单一数值表达的效果.

IGUI_DD_MoodleThresholds_tooltip.en: Where each moodle level starts, such as hunger above 45%%, at the top of the Modifiers list.
IGUI_DD_MoodleThresholds_tooltip.ch: 在「數值修正」清單頂端顯示各狀態等級的起點, 例如「飢餓高於 45%%」.
IGUI_DD_MoodleThresholds_tooltip.cn: 在“数值修正”列表顶部显示各状态等级的起点, 例如“饥饿高于 45%%”.

IGUI_DD_MoodleTooltips_tooltip.en: Off, the game and your other mods draw moodle tooltips as usual. On, vanilla moodles need Moodles in lua and modded ones Moodle Framework.
IGUI_DD_MoodleTooltips_tooltip.ch: 關閉時, 遊戲與你的其他模組照常繪製狀態圖示工具提示. 開啟時, 原版狀態需要 Moodles in Lua, 模組狀態需要模組狀態框架 (Moodle Framework).
IGUI_DD_MoodleTooltips_tooltip.cn: 关闭时, 游戏和你的其他模组照常绘制状态图标工具提示. 开启时, 原版状态需要 Moodles in Lua, 模组状态需要模组状态框架 (Moodle Framework).

IGUI_DD_Own_tooltip.en: On, every skill, trait and occupation this mod has written a line for uses that line, so the wording is the same throughout and no numbers are quoted that a rebalance mod may have changed. Off, the game's own description is used wherever there is one, and this mod only fills in the blanks.
IGUI_DD_Own_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 凡是本模組有撰寫說明的技能、特質與職業都會改用該說明, 讓用語前後一致, 也不會引用可能已被平衡調整模組改動的數值. 關閉時, 只要遊戲本身有說明就沿用, 本模組只補上缺少的部分.
IGUI_DD_Own_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 凡是本模组写有说明的技能、特质和职业都会改用该说明, 使措辞前后一致, 也不会引用可能已被平衡调整模组改动的数值. 关闭时, 只要游戏本身有说明就沿用, 本模组只补充缺失的部分.

IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.ch: 能接線並修理任何電器.
IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.cn: 能给任何电器接线并修理.

IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.en: Builds the things that bang, burn and make noise.
IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.ch: 打造會爆炸、燃燒、發出噪音的東西.
IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.cn: 制造会爆炸、燃烧、发出噪音的东西.

IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.en: Fells trees, and moves easily through the woods.
IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.ch: 伐木, 並能在林間輕鬆穿行.
IGUI_DD_P_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.cn: 伐木, 并能在林间轻松穿行.

IGUI_DD_P_base_burgerflipper.en: Short-order cook out of a fast food kitchen.
IGUI_DD_P_base_burgerflipper.ch: 速食店廚房出身的快餐廚師.
IGUI_DD_P_base_burgerflipper.cn: 快餐店后厨出身的快手厨师.

IGUI_DD_P_base_burglar.en: Makes a living getting into places that are locked.
IGUI_DD_P_base_burglar.ch: 靠潛入上鎖的地方維生.
IGUI_DD_P_base_burglar.cn: 靠潜入上锁的地方谋生.

IGUI_DD_P_base_carpenter.en: Builds and repairs things out of wood.

IGUI_DD_P_base_carpenter.cn: 用木头建造和修理各种东西.

IGUI_DD_P_base_constructionworker.en: Used to heavy work on building sites.

IGUI_DD_P_base_doctor.en: Trained in medicine and the treatment of injuries.

IGUI_DD_P_base_doctor.cn: 受过医学和伤病治疗训练.

IGUI_DD_P_base_electrician.en: Wires and repairs anything electrical, and can run a generator.
IGUI_DD_P_base_electrician.ch: 能接線並修理任何電器, 也會操作發電機.
IGUI_DD_P_base_electrician.cn: 能给任何电器接线并修理, 还会使用发电机.

IGUI_DD_P_base_engineer.en: Builds the things that bang and burn, and can run a generator.
IGUI_DD_P_base_engineer.ch: 打造會爆炸和燃燒的東西, 也會操作發電機.

IGUI_DD_P_base_farmer.en: Works the land for a living.

IGUI_DD_P_base_fireofficer.en: Trained to work fast and hard in an emergency.
IGUI_DD_P_base_fireofficer.ch: 受過在緊急狀況下迅速而賣力工作的訓練.
IGUI_DD_P_base_fireofficer.cn: 受过在紧急情况下迅速卖力工作的训练.

IGUI_DD_P_base_fisherman.en: Takes paying guests out onto the water.

IGUI_DD_P_base_fitnessinstructor.en: Spends the working day exercising, and coaching others through it.
IGUI_DD_P_base_fitnessinstructor.ch: 整個工作日都在健身, 並指導他人完成訓練.
IGUI_DD_P_base_fitnessinstructor.cn: 整个工作日都在锻炼, 并指导别人完成训练.

IGUI_DD_P_base_lumberjack.en: Fells trees, moves easily through the woods, and tires less from the chopping.
IGUI_DD_P_base_lumberjack.ch: 伐木, 能在林間輕鬆穿行, 砍伐時也較不易疲勞.
IGUI_DD_P_base_lumberjack.cn: 伐木, 能在林间轻松穿行, 砍伐时也不易疲劳.

IGUI_DD_P_base_mechanics.en: Knows every car on the roads of Kentucky.

IGUI_DD_P_base_mechanics.cn: 熟悉肯塔基州路上的每一辆车.

IGUI_DD_P_base_metalworker.en: Cuts and welds metal for a living.

IGUI_DD_P_base_metalworker.cn: 靠切割和焊接金属为生.

IGUI_DD_P_base_nurse.en: Trained to care for the sick and the injured.

IGUI_DD_P_base_nurse.cn: 受过护理病人和伤员的训练.

IGUI_DD_P_base_parkranger.en: Knows the backcountry, and moves through it quickly.

IGUI_DD_P_base_parkranger.cn: 熟悉荒野地带, 并能快速穿行其中.

IGUI_DD_P_base_policeofficer.en: Trained with a sidearm, and used to confrontation.

IGUI_DD_P_base_policeofficer.cn: 受过手枪训练, 也习惯正面冲突.

IGUI_DD_P_base_repairman.en: Fixes and maintains things around the house.
IGUI_DD_P_base_repairman.ch: 修理並維護家中各種東西.
IGUI_DD_P_base_repairman.cn: 修理和维护家里的各种东西.

IGUI_DD_P_base_securityguard.en: Paid to patrol, and to keep watch.

IGUI_DD_P_base_smither.ch: 在鍛造爐與鐵砧前加工金屬.
IGUI_DD_P_base_smither.cn: 在锻造炉和铁砧前加工金属.

IGUI_DD_P_base_tailor.en: Cuts and stitches cloth for a living.

IGUI_DD_P_base_unemployed.en: No trade to speak of, and the free points to build one.
IGUI_DD_P_base_unemployed.ch: 沒什麼一技之長, 但有多餘的點數可以自己培養.
IGUI_DD_P_base_unemployed.cn: 没什么一技之长, 但有富余的点数自己培养.

IGUI_DD_P_base_veteran.en: Has been to war, and come back from it.
IGUI_DD_P_base_veteran.ch: 上過戰場, 也活著回來了.
IGUI_DD_P_base_veteran.cn: 上过战场, 也活着回来了.

IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_ascetic.en: Lives simply, off whatever the land provides.
IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_ascetic.ch: 生活簡樸, 靠大地提供的一切維生.
IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_ascetic.cn: 生活简朴, 靠大地提供的一切过活.

IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_convict.en: Learned to look after themselves on the inside.
IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_convict.ch: 在牢裡學會了照顧自己.
IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_convict.cn: 在牢里学会了照顾自己.

IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_hunter.en: Takes paying guests out into the woods after game.
IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_hunter.ch: 帶付費客人進入山林狩獵.
IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_hunter.cn: 带付费客人进山林打猎.

IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_mailman.en: Walks a long round, every day, in any weather.

IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_mailman.cn: 每天不论天气如何, 都要走完漫长的路线.

IGUI_DD_P_expandedprofessions_paramedic.en: First on the scene, trained to keep people alive until the hospital.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_1.cn: 更大的鱼会上钩, 钓到垃圾的次数也会减少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_2.en: The line takes more strain before it snaps, and the cast lands closer to where you aimed.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_2.ch: 釣線能承受更大拉力才會斷, 拋竿也更接近你瞄準的位置.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_2.cn: 钓线能承受更大拉力才会断, 抛竿落点也更接近你瞄准的位置.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_3.en: Bait survives a catch more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_3.ch: 釣到魚後, 誘餌更常保留下來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fishing_3.cn: 钓到鱼后, 鱼饵更常保留下来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_1.en: Endurance drains slower and comes back faster.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_1.ch: 耐力消耗變慢, 恢復變快.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_1.cn: 耐力消耗更慢, 恢复更快.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_2.en: Swings and shoves come out faster.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_3.en: Climbing, falling and hard work take less out of you, and a zombie's grip is easier to shake off.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_3.ch: 攀爬、跌落與粗重工作對你的消耗更少, 殭屍的抓握也更容易掙脫.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_3.cn: 攀爬、摔落和重活对你的消耗更少, 僵尸的抓握也更容易挣脱.

IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_4.en: Left untrained for long, it slowly loses XP and can drop a level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_4.ch: 長時間不訓練會逐漸流失經驗值, 甚至可能降一級.
IGUI_DD_SE_Fitness_4.cn: 长时间不训练会逐渐流失经验值, 甚至可能掉一级.

IGUI_DD_SE_FlintKnapping_1.en: Knapping a flake more often leaves a usable sharpened stone behind as well.
IGUI_DD_SE_FlintKnapping_1.ch: 敲製石片時, 更常額外留下一塊可用的鋒利燧石片.
IGUI_DD_SE_FlintKnapping_1.cn: 敲制石片时, 更常额外留下一块可用的锋利碎石.

IGUI_DD_SE_Glassmaking_1.en: Nothing but the recipes. It decides what you can melt and shape, not how well it comes out.
IGUI_DD_SE_Glassmaking_1.ch: 只影響配方. 它決定你能熔化並塑形什麼, 而非成品好壞.
IGUI_DD_SE_Glassmaking_1.cn: 只影响配方. 它决定你能熔化和塑形什么, 而不是成品好坏.

IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_1.en: An animal's state reads more clearly when you inspect it.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_1.ch: 檢查動物時, 能更清楚得知其狀態.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_1.cn: 检查动物时, 能更清楚地了解其状态.

IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_2.en: Handling one hurts and stresses it less.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_2.ch: 處理動物時對牠造成的傷害與壓力更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Husbandry_2.cn: 处理动物时对它造成的伤害和压力更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_1.en: Butchering, skinning and hanging a human body each unlock a level at a time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_1.ch: 屠宰、剝皮與吊掛人類屍體的動作會逐級解鎖, 每級一項.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_1.cn: 屠宰、剥皮和吊挂人类尸体的动作会逐级解锁, 每级一项.

IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_2.en: Only a character with the Psychopath trait can gain it.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_2.ch: 只有具備「精神病態者」特質的角色才能獲得.
IGUI_DD_SE_Insanity_2.cn: 只有拥有“精神病态者”特质的角色才能获得.

IGUI_DD_SE_LGUHunting_1.en: Watching a tree for game takes less time with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_LGUHunting_1.ch: 每升一級, 在樹旁守候獵物所需的時間都會縮短.
IGUI_DD_SE_LGUHunting_1.cn: 每升一级, 在树旁守候猎物所需的时间都会缩短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Lightfoot_1.en: Your footsteps carry less far, at any pace.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lightfoot_1.ch: 無論以何種速度移動, 腳步聲都傳得更近.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lightfoot_1.cn: 无论以什么速度移动, 脚步声都传得更近.

IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_2.en: Forcing a stubborn lock works more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_2.ch: 強行撬開難搞的鎖更容易成功.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_2.cn: 强行撬开难缠的锁更容易成功.

IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_3.en: The odds on screen stay hidden until the middle levels.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_3.ch: 到中等等級前, 畫面上不會顯示成功率.
IGUI_DD_SE_Lockpicking_3.cn: 到中等等级之前, 屏幕上不会显示成功率.

IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_1.en: Swings land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_1.ch: 揮擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_1.cn: 挥击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_3.en: Swings still speed up with every level, but the extra reach and the endurance saving only go to axes, spears and long blunt weapons.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_3.ch: 每升一級揮擊仍會加快, 但額外攻擊距離與耐力節省只適用於斧頭、長矛與長棍類武器.
IGUI_DD_SE_LongBlade_3.cn: 每升一级挥击仍会加快, 但额外攻击距离和耐力节省只适用于斧头、长矛和长棍类武器.

IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_1.en: Weapons lose condition less often, and half your level in the weapon's own skill counts towards this as well.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_1.ch: 武器較不容易耐久下降, 且你在該武器所屬技能等級的一半也會計入.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_1.cn: 武器更不容易掉耐久, 你在该武器对应技能等级的一半也会计入.

IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_2.en: Sharpening chips the blade less often, and a repair fails less often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_2.ch: 磨刀時較少崩口, 修理也較少失敗.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_2.cn: 磨刀时更少崩口, 修理也更少失败.

IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_3.en: Trained by hitting things with a weapon, not by fixing one.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_3.ch: 靠用武器打東西來訓練, 而不是靠修理武器.
IGUI_DD_SE_Maintenance_3.cn: 靠用武器打东西来训练, 而不是靠修理武器.

IGUI_DD_SE_Masonry_1.en: The build menu offers a better-made version of a brick or stone wall as you climb.
IGUI_DD_SE_Masonry_1.ch: 隨著等級提升, 建造選單會提供更精良的磚牆或石牆.
IGUI_DD_SE_Masonry_1.cn: 随着等级提升, 建造菜单会提供做工更好的砖墙或石墙.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_1.en: Parts come off and go back on in better condition.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_1.ch: 拆裝零件時能保持更好的耐久.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_1.cn: 拆装零件时能保持更好的耐久.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_2.en: Engine repairs, headlight adjustment and the harder vehicles each need a level before you can touch them.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_2.ch: 引擎維修、頭燈調整及較難處理的車輛, 都需要達到一定等級才能動手.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mechanics_2.cn: 引擎维修、车头灯调整和较难处理的车辆, 都需要达到一定等级才能动手.

IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_1.en: A session sheds more stress the higher it is.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_1.ch: 技能越高, 每次冥想消除的壓力越多.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_1.cn: 技能越高, 每次冥想消除的压力越多.

IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_2.en: Deeper techniques open up as it rises, and a bag on your back stops getting in the way.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_2.ch: 隨著技能提升會解鎖更深入的技巧, 背上的包包也不再礙事.
IGUI_DD_SE_Meditation_2.cn: 随着技能提升会解锁更深的技巧, 背上的包也不再碍事.

IGUI_DD_SE_MetalWelding_1.en: The build menu offers a better-made version of a metal wall, fence or frame as you climb.
IGUI_DD_SE_MetalWelding_1.ch: 隨著等級提升, 建造選單會提供更精良的金屬牆、圍欄或框架.
IGUI_DD_SE_MetalWelding_1.cn: 随着等级提升, 建造菜单会提供做工更好的金属墙、围栏或框架.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_1.en: Strength cuts the swings too, half as much per level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_1.ch: 力量也能減少揮擊次數, 每級效果為一半.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_1.cn: 力量也能减少挥击次数, 每级效果减半.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_2.en: A tile costs the same endurance either way, spread over fewer swings.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_2.ch: 挖一格的總耐力消耗不變, 只是分攤在更少的揮擊上.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_2.cn: 挖一格的总耐力消耗不变, 只是分摊到更少的挥击上.

IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_3.en: Never fewer than a third of a tile's swings, or two.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_3.ch: 揮擊次數最少不低於該格原本次數的三分之一, 也不少於兩次.
IGUI_DD_SE_Mining_3.cn: 挥击次数最少不低于该格原本次数的三分之一, 也不少于两次.

IGUI_DD_SE_Music_1.en: Playing sheds more boredom and unhappiness.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_1.ch: 演奏能消除更多無聊與憂鬱.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_1.cn: 演奏能消除更多无聊和忧郁.

IGUI_DD_SE_Music_2.en: Songs can be learned early on, and high up a song can no longer be fumbled for lack of skill.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_2.ch: 低等級就能學歌, 等級高時不會再因技術不足而演奏失誤.
IGUI_DD_SE_Music_2.cn: 低等级就能学歌, 等级高时不会再因技术不足而演奏失误.

IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_1.en: Moving in a combat stance is faster with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_1.ch: 每升一級, 戰鬥姿態下的移動都會更快.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_1.cn: 每升一级, 战斗姿态下的移动都会更快.

IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_2.en: Climbing a fence scratches you less often, and you trip and fall less.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_2.ch: 翻越圍欄時較少被刮傷, 絆倒與跌倒也更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Nimble_2.cn: 翻越围栏时更少被刮伤, 绊倒和摔倒也更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_1.en: The search radius widens with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_1.ch: 每升一級, 搜尋半徑都會擴大.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_1.cn: 每升一级, 搜寻半径都会扩大.

IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_2.en: Icons take less time to move, so a sweep covers more ground.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_2.ch: 圖示移動所需時間更短, 一次搜尋能涵蓋更大範圍.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_2.cn: 图标移动所需时间更短, 一次搜寻能覆盖更大范围.

IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_3.en: More categories and rarer finds come into reach as it rises.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_3.ch: 隨著技能提升, 可搜到更多類別與更稀有的物品.
IGUI_DD_SE_PlantScavenging_3.cn: 随着技能提升, 能搜到更多类别和更稀有的物品.

IGUI_DD_SE_Pottery_1.en: Nothing but the recipes. It decides what you can throw and fire.
IGUI_DD_SE_Pottery_1.ch: 只影響配方. 它決定你能拉坯與燒製什麼.
IGUI_DD_SE_Pottery_1.cn: 只影响配方. 它决定你能拉坯和烧制什么.

IGUI_DD_SE_ProstFamiliarity_1.en: While a prosthesis is worn this adds to the amputation skill for that limb, cutting the time penalty further.
IGUI_DD_SE_ProstFamiliarity_1.ch: 穿戴義肢時, 此技能會加到該肢體的截肢技能上, 進一步減少時間懲罰.
IGUI_DD_SE_ProstFamiliarity_1.cn: 佩戴假肢时, 该技能会加到该肢体的截肢技能上, 进一步减少时间惩罚.

IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_1.en: Every reload, rack and magazine fill takes less time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_1.ch: 裝填、上膛與裝填彈匣所需時間都會縮短.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_1.cn: 装填、上膛和压弹匣所需时间都会缩短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_2.en: Trained by loading guns and filling magazines by hand.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_2.ch: 靠手動裝填槍械與彈匣來訓練.
IGUI_DD_SE_Reloading_2.cn: 靠手动装填枪械和弹匣来训练.

IGUI_DD_SE_Science_1.en: Researching a recipe or a specimen takes less time.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_1.ch: 研究配方或標本所需時間更短.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_1.cn: 研究配方或标本所需时间更短.

IGUI_DD_SE_Science_2.en: Every other skill earns a little extra experience while this one is high.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_2.ch: 此技能等級高時, 其他所有技能都能多獲得一些經驗值.
IGUI_DD_SE_Science_2.cn: 该技能等级高时, 其他所有技能都能多获得一些经验值.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_1.en: Every action is slower once that side is missing a limb, and this claws the time back.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_1.ch: 一旦該側缺少肢體, 所有動作都會變慢, 這項技能能把時間補回來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_1.cn: 一旦该侧缺少肢体, 所有动作都会变慢, 这项技能能把时间追回来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_2.en: Trained simply by living with the amputation.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_2.ch: 只要帶著截肢生活就能訓練.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_L_2.cn: 只要带着截肢生活就能训练.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_1.en: Every action is slower once that side is missing a limb, and this claws the time back.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_1.ch: 一旦該側缺少肢體, 所有動作都會變慢, 這項技能能把時間補回來.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_1.cn: 一旦该侧缺少肢体, 所有动作都会变慢, 这项技能能把时间追回来.

IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_2.en: Trained simply by living with the amputation.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_2.ch: 只要帶著截肢生活就能訓練.
IGUI_DD_SE_Side_R_2.cn: 只要带着截肢生活就能训练.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_1.en: Stabs land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_1.ch: 刺擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_1.cn: 刺击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_3.en: The knife is left behind in the jaw less often after an instant kill.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_3.ch: 一擊必殺後, 刀子較少卡在下顎裡.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlade_3.cn: 一击必杀后, 刀子更少卡在下颚里.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_1.en: Swings land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_1.ch: 揮擊更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_1.cn: 挥击更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_3.en: Swings still speed up with every level, but the extra reach and the endurance saving only go to axes, spears and long blunt weapons.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_3.ch: 每升一級揮擊仍會加快, 但額外攻擊距離與耐力節省只適用於斧頭、長矛與長棍類武器.
IGUI_DD_SE_SmallBlunt_3.cn: 每升一级挥击仍会加快, 但额外攻击距离和耐力节省只适用于斧头、长矛和长棍类武器.

IGUI_DD_SE_Sneak_1.en: Zombies take longer to spot you while crouched.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sneak_1.ch: 蹲伏時殭屍需要更久才能發現你.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sneak_1.cn: 蹲伏时僵尸需要更久才能发现你.

IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_1.en: Thrusts land more often and crit more often.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_1.ch: 突刺更常命中, 也更常暴擊.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_1.cn: 突刺更常命中, 也更常暴击.

IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_2.en: Hits do more damage, and from the middle levels the spear reaches further.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_2.ch: 攻擊傷害更高, 從中等等級起, 長矛的攻擊距離更遠.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_2.cn: 攻击伤害更高, 从中等等级起, 长矛的攻击距离更远.

IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_3.en: Thrusts get faster with every level, and cost less endurance near the top.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_3.ch: 每升一級突刺都會更快, 接近頂級時耐力消耗也更少.
IGUI_DD_SE_Spear_3.cn: 每升一级突刺都会更快, 接近满级时耐力消耗也更少.

IGUI_DD_SE_Sprinting_1.en: Plain running speed, and nothing else.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sprinting_1.ch: 單純的跑步速度, 沒有其他效果.
IGUI_DD_SE_Sprinting_1.cn: 单纯的跑步速度, 没有其他效果.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_1.en: Every melee hit does more damage and every shove pushes harder.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_1.ch: 每次近戰攻擊傷害更高, 每次推開也更有力.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_1.cn: 每次近战攻击伤害更高, 每次推搡也更有力.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_2.en: You can carry more before the weight starts slowing you down.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_2.ch: 能背負更多東西才會被重量拖慢.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_2.cn: 能背更多东西才会被重量拖慢.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_3.en: Muscle strain builds slower and a zombie's grip is easier to break.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_3.ch: 肌肉拉傷累積更慢, 殭屍的抓握也更容易掙脫.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_3.cn: 肌肉拉伤累积更慢, 僵尸的抓握也更容易挣脱.

IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_4.en: Left untrained for long, it slowly loses XP and can drop a level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_4.ch: 長時間不訓練會逐漸流失經驗值, 甚至可能降一級.
IGUI_DD_SE_Strength_4.cn: 长时间不训练会逐渐流失经验值, 甚至可能掉一级.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_1.en: A patch adds more scratch and bite protection with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_1.ch: 每升一級, 補丁提供的抗刮傷與抗咬傷防護都會增加.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_1.cn: 每升一级, 补丁提供的防刮伤和防咬伤保护都会增加.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_2.en: Past the upper levels, matching fabric mends a hole outright instead of leaving a patch behind.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_2.ch: 達到高等級後, 使用相同布料可直接補好破洞, 而不是留下補丁.
IGUI_DD_SE_Tailoring_2.cn: 达到高等级后, 用相同布料能直接补好破洞, 而不是留下补丁.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tracking_1.en: Fainter tracks become readable, and the ones you can read turn up more often.

IGUI_DD_SE_Tracking_1.cn: 能辨认更模糊的踪迹, 能辨认的踪迹也更常出现.

IGUI_DD_SE_Trapping_1.en: Traps catch more often, whatever the bait and wherever they sit.
IGUI_DD_SE_Trapping_1.ch: 不論使用何種誘餌、設在何處, 陷阱都更常捕到獵物.
IGUI_DD_SE_Trapping_1.cn: 不论用什么诱饵、放在哪里, 陷阱都更常捕到猎物.

IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_1.en: Everything you build gets more health with every level.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_1.ch: 每升一級, 你建造的一切都會更耐久.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_1.cn: 每升一级, 你建造的一切都会更耐久.

IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_2.en: Building takes less time, and the hammering carries less far.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_2.ch: 建造所需時間更短, 敲擊聲也傳得更近.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_2.cn: 建造所需时间更短, 敲击声也传得更近.

IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_3.en: Barricading is quicker and the barricade holds longer.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_3.ch: 加固更快, 加固也更持久.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_3.cn: 加固更快, 加固也更持久.

IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_4.en: The build menu offers a better-made version of a wall, fence or piece of furniture as you climb.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_4.ch: 隨著等級提升, 建造選單會提供更精良的牆、圍欄或家具.
IGUI_DD_SE_Woodwork_4.cn: 随着等级提升, 建造菜单会提供做工更好的墙、围栏或家具.

IGUI_DD_S_AMReloading.en: Handloading your own ammunition at a reloading bench.
IGUI_DD_S_AMReloading.ch: 在彈藥復裝台自製彈藥.

IGUI_DD_S_Aiming.en: Shots land more often and hit harder.
IGUI_DD_S_Aiming.ch: 射擊更常命中, 威力也更大.
IGUI_DD_S_Aiming.cn: 射击更常命中, 威力也更大.

IGUI_DD_S_Art.en: Sculpting and painting go faster, and bigger canvases open up.
IGUI_DD_S_Art.ch: 雕塑與繪畫更快, 並可使用更大的畫布.
IGUI_DD_S_Art.cn: 雕塑和绘画更快, 并可使用更大的画布.

IGUI_DD_S_Axe.en: Faster, harder axe swings, and less muscle strain from them.
IGUI_DD_S_Axe.ch: 斧頭揮擊更快、更重, 造成的肌肉拉傷也更少.
IGUI_DD_S_Axe.cn: 斧头挥击更快、更有力, 造成的肌肉拉伤也更少.

IGUI_DD_S_Blacksmith.en: Forges metal parts and tools at an anvil.
IGUI_DD_S_Blacksmith.ch: 在鐵砧上鍛造金屬零件與工具.
IGUI_DD_S_Blacksmith.cn: 在铁砧上锻造金属零件和工具.

IGUI_DD_S_Blunt.en: Faster, harder swings with long blunt weapons, and less muscle strain from them.
IGUI_DD_S_Blunt.ch: 長棍類武器揮擊更快、更重, 造成的肌肉拉傷也更少.
IGUI_DD_S_Blunt.cn: 长棍类武器挥击更快、更有力, 造成的肌肉拉伤也更少.

IGUI_DD_S_Butchering.en: Cleaner cuts and better meat off a carcass.
IGUI_DD_S_Butchering.ch: 切割更俐落, 能從屠體取得更好的肉.
IGUI_DD_S_Butchering.cn: 切割更利落, 能从胴体取得更好的肉.

IGUI_DD_S_Carving.en: Whittles small wooden pieces, and finer ones as it rises.
IGUI_DD_S_Carving.ch: 削製小型木件, 技能提升後能做得更精細.
IGUI_DD_S_Carving.cn: 削制小型木件, 技能提升后能做得更精细.

IGUI_DD_S_Cleaning.en: Scrubbing blood and dirt away goes faster and uses less product.
IGUI_DD_S_Cleaning.ch: 刷洗血跡與髒汙更快, 清潔用品也用得更少.
IGUI_DD_S_Cleaning.cn: 刷洗血迹和污垢更快, 清洁用品也用得更少.

IGUI_DD_S_Cooking.en: Makes food more nourishing and better tasting, and opens up harder dishes.
IGUI_DD_S_Cooking.ch: 讓食物更營養、更美味, 並解鎖更難的菜餚.
IGUI_DD_S_Cooking.cn: 让食物更有营养、更美味, 并解锁更难的菜肴.

IGUI_DD_S_Dancing.en: Fewer stumbles and fumbles while dancing.
IGUI_DD_S_Dancing.ch: 跳舞時絆腳與失誤更少.
IGUI_DD_S_Dancing.cn: 跳舞时绊脚和失误更少.

IGUI_DD_S_Doctor.en: Reads injuries more clearly and treats them better.
IGUI_DD_S_Doctor.ch: 更清楚判讀傷勢, 治療效果也更好.
IGUI_DD_S_Doctor.cn: 更清楚地判断伤势, 治疗效果也更好.

IGUI_DD_S_Electricity.en: Wires up and repairs electrical devices, generators included.
IGUI_DD_S_Electricity.ch: 為電氣設備接線與修理, 包括發電機.
IGUI_DD_S_Electricity.cn: 为电气设备接线和修理, 包括发电机.

IGUI_DD_S_Farming.en: Tells you more about a crop's state. Trained by harvesting what you planted.
IGUI_DD_S_Farming.ch: 能得知更多農作物狀態. 靠收穫自己種的作物來訓練.
IGUI_DD_S_Farming.cn: 能了解更多作物状态. 靠收获自己种的作物来训练.

IGUI_DD_S_Fishing.en: Catches more and bigger fish, and wears out tackle more slowly.
IGUI_DD_S_Fishing.ch: 釣到更多、更大的魚, 釣具磨損也更慢.
IGUI_DD_S_Fishing.cn: 钓到更多、更大的鱼, 钓具磨损也更慢.

IGUI_DD_S_Fitness.en: Faster swings, better climbing, and slower to tire.
IGUI_DD_S_Fitness.ch: 揮擊更快、攀爬更好, 也更不容易累.
IGUI_DD_S_Fitness.cn: 挥击更快、攀爬更好, 也更不容易累.

IGUI_DD_S_FlintKnapping.en: Chips stone into tools and cutting edges.
IGUI_DD_S_FlintKnapping.ch: 把石頭敲製成工具與刃口.
IGUI_DD_S_FlintKnapping.cn: 把石头敲制成工具和刃口.

IGUI_DD_S_Husbandry.en: Tells you more about an animal's state, and gets more out of it.
IGUI_DD_S_Husbandry.ch: 能得知更多動物狀態, 也能從牠身上獲得更多.
IGUI_DD_S_Husbandry.cn: 能了解更多动物状态, 也能从它身上获得更多.

IGUI_DD_S_Insanity.en: How comfortable you have grown with doing terrible things.
IGUI_DD_S_Insanity.ch: 你對做出可怕之事已習慣到什麼程度.
IGUI_DD_S_Insanity.cn: 你对做出可怕之事已经习惯到什么程度.

IGUI_DD_S_LGUHunting.en: Reading the woods and waiting game out.
IGUI_DD_S_LGUHunting.ch: 看懂山林, 耐心等候獵物現身.
IGUI_DD_S_LGUHunting.cn: 读懂山林, 耐心等待猎物现身.

IGUI_DD_S_Lightfoot.ch: 無論以何種速度移動, 腳步聲都更輕.
IGUI_DD_S_Lightfoot.cn: 无论以什么速度移动, 脚步声都更轻.

IGUI_DD_S_Lockpicking.en: Picking door and vehicle locks without snapping the pick.
IGUI_DD_S_Lockpicking.ch: 撬開門鎖與車鎖, 且不折斷撬鎖工具.
IGUI_DD_S_Lockpicking.cn: 撬开门锁和车锁, 而不折断撬锁工具.

IGUI_DD_S_LongBlade.en: Long blades land more often and cut deeper.
IGUI_DD_S_LongBlade.ch: 長刀更常命中, 砍得也更深.
IGUI_DD_S_LongBlade.cn: 长刀更常命中, 砍得也更深.

IGUI_DD_S_Maintenance.en: Weapons chip and break more slowly. Trained by fighting with them.
IGUI_DD_S_Maintenance.ch: 武器崩損與損壞得更慢. 靠用武器戰鬥來訓練.
IGUI_DD_S_Maintenance.cn: 武器磨损和损坏得更慢. 靠用武器战斗来训练.

IGUI_DD_S_Masonry.en: Lays brick and stone, and builds sturdier walls as it rises.
IGUI_DD_S_Masonry.ch: 砌磚砌石, 技能提升後能建造更堅固的牆.
IGUI_DD_S_Masonry.cn: 砌砖砌石, 技能提升后能建造更坚固的墙.

IGUI_DD_S_Mechanics.en: Vehicle parts come off and go back on in better condition.
IGUI_DD_S_Mechanics.ch: 拆裝車輛零件時能保持更好的耐久.
IGUI_DD_S_Mechanics.cn: 拆装车辆零件时能保持更好的耐久.

IGUI_DD_S_Meditation.en: Meditating sheds more stress, and the techniques deepen as it rises.
IGUI_DD_S_Meditation.ch: 冥想能消除更多壓力, 技巧也會隨技能提升而深化.
IGUI_DD_S_Meditation.cn: 冥想能消除更多压力, 技巧也会随技能提升而深化.

IGUI_DD_S_MetalWelding.en: Cuts and welds metal into barricades and frames.
IGUI_DD_S_MetalWelding.ch: 切割並焊接金屬, 做成加固物與框架.
IGUI_DD_S_MetalWelding.cn: 切割并焊接金属, 做成加固物和框架.

IGUI_DD_S_Mining.en: Digs through rock and earth in fewer swings.
IGUI_DD_S_Mining.ch: 以更少的揮擊挖穿岩石與泥土.
IGUI_DD_S_Mining.cn: 用更少的挥击挖穿岩石和泥土.

IGUI_DD_S_Music.en: Playing an instrument sheds boredom and unhappiness, and fumbles get rarer.
IGUI_DD_S_Music.ch: 演奏樂器能消除無聊與憂鬱, 失誤也更少.
IGUI_DD_S_Music.cn: 演奏乐器能消除无聊和忧郁, 失误也更少.

IGUI_DD_S_Nimble.en: Faster movement in a combat stance, and quieter with it.
IGUI_DD_S_Nimble.ch: 戰鬥姿態下移動更快, 也更安靜.
IGUI_DD_S_Nimble.cn: 战斗姿态下移动更快, 也更安静.

IGUI_DD_S_PlantScavenging.en: Finds more and better in search mode, over a wider radius and across more categories.
IGUI_DD_S_PlantScavenging.ch: 在搜尋模式中找到更多、更好的物品, 搜尋半徑更大, 類別也更多.
IGUI_DD_S_PlantScavenging.cn: 在搜索模式中找到更多、更好的物品, 搜寻半径更大, 类别也更多.

IGUI_DD_S_ProstFamiliarity.en: Getting used to a prosthetic limb.

IGUI_DD_S_Reloading.en: Loading guns and filling magazines takes less time. Trained by doing it.
IGUI_DD_S_Reloading.ch: 裝填槍械與填裝彈匣更省時. 透過實際操作來練習.

IGUI_DD_S_Science.en: Research goes faster, and everything else you learn sticks a little better.
IGUI_DD_S_Science.ch: 研究速度更快, 學習其他事物的成效也略有提升.
IGUI_DD_S_Science.cn: 研究更快, 学习其他东西的效果也稍有提升.

IGUI_DD_S_Side_L.en: Living with an amputation on the left side of the body.
IGUI_DD_S_Side_L.ch: 適應身體左側截肢後的生活.
IGUI_DD_S_Side_L.cn: 适应身体左侧截肢后的生活.

IGUI_DD_S_Side_R.en: Living with an amputation on the right side of the body.

IGUI_DD_S_Side_R.cn: 适应身体右侧截肢后的生活.

IGUI_DD_S_SmallBlade.en: Knives land more often and cut deeper, and stay in your hand after a jaw stab.

IGUI_DD_S_SmallBlunt.cn: 短钝器更容易命中, 打击也更重.

IGUI_DD_S_Sneak.en: Zombies notice you later while crouched, and your steps are quieter.
IGUI_DD_S_Sneak.ch: 蹲伏時殭屍較晚察覺你, 腳步聲也更輕.

IGUI_DD_S_Spear.en: Faster, harder spear thrusts, and less muscle strain from them.
IGUI_DD_S_Spear.ch: 長矛刺擊更快、更有力, 造成的肌肉拉傷也更少.

IGUI_DD_S_Strength.en: Harder hits, more knockback, a higher carry limit, and less muscle strain.

IGUI_DD_S_Tailoring.en: Better clothing repairs, and thicker padding against bites and scratches.

IGUI_DD_S_Trapping.en: Traps catch more often, and better traps become buildable.

IGUI_DD_S_Woodwork.en: Builds wooden furniture and structures, and sturdier ones as it rises.
IGUI_DD_S_Woodwork.ch: 建造木製家具與結構, 等級越高越堅固.
IGUI_DD_S_Woodwork.cn: 建造木制家具和结构, 等级越高越坚固.

IGUI_DD_SkillDescription_tooltip.en: The line of prose describing what the skill governs.

IGUI_DD_Skills_tooltip.en: The starting skill levels granted, one line per skill.

IGUI_DD_Skills_tooltip.cn: 给予的初始技能等级, 每个技能一行.

IGUI_DD_T_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.en: Used to trouble, and cheered up by winning a fight.

IGUI_DD_T_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.ch: 長途步行時, 飢餓、口渴與疲勞累積較少.

IGUI_DD_T_SimpleOverhaulTraitsAndOccupat.en: Catches colds easily, and turns faster once infected.

IGUI_DD_T_amicrazy_grounded.en: Keeps a grip on reality longer, and gets more out of beta blockers.
