IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description.en: Skill at pressing must, fermenting and bottling. Higher levels unlock new recipes and the wine you bottle comes out at a better grade. <LINE> Bottling and salvaging also require the Distiller's Notebook to have been read; the skill alone is not enough.
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description.ch: 壓榨果漿、發酵與裝瓶的技能. 等級越高會解鎖新配方, 你裝瓶的葡萄酒品級也會更好. <LINE> 裝瓶與補救配方另外需要讀過蒸餾師筆記; 只有技能還不夠.
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description.cn: 压榨果浆、发酵与装瓶的技能. 等级越高会解锁新配方, 你装瓶的葡萄酒品级也会更好. <LINE> 装瓶与补救配方还需要读过蒸馏师笔记; 仅凭技能还不够.

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description1.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 1 - Bottling <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Draw a fermented batch into a container and get Table Wine. <LINE> You can ferment apple must and bottle Cider. <LINE> Requires the Distiller's Notebook; the skill alone is not enough. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description1.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 1 - 裝瓶 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 將已發酵的批次接到容器中, 得到佐餐葡萄酒. <LINE> 可發酵蘋果漿並將蘋果酒裝瓶. <LINE> 需要蒸餾師筆記; 只有技能還不夠. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description1.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 1 - 装瓶 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 将已发酵的批次接到容器中, 得到佐餐葡萄酒. <LINE> 可发酵苹果浆并将苹果酒装瓶. <LINE> 需要蒸馏师笔记; 仅凭技能还不够. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description10.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 10 - Master's hand <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Barrel and still batches you start take a further 15%% less time. <LINE> Barrel 36.7 h, still 6.8 h. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description10.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 10 - 大師之手 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的發酵桶與蒸餾器批次再減少 15%% 的所需時間. <LINE> 發酵桶 36.7 小時, 蒸餾器 6.8 小時. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description10.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 10 - 大师之手 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的发酵桶与蒸馏器批次再减少 15%% 的所需时间. <LINE> 发酵桶 36.7 小时, 蒸馏器 6.8 小时. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description2.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 2 - Salvage and beer <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Turn a spoiled liquid into vinegar with fruit and sugar. <LINE> Bottle the raw beer from the barrel into Table Beer. <LINE> Bottling opens for vermouth, sherry and port. <LINE> All of them require the Distiller's Notebook. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description2.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 2 - 補救與啤酒 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 用水果和糖把變質的液體變成醋. <LINE> 將發酵桶中的啤酒原液裝瓶成佐餐啤酒. <LINE> 開放香艾酒、雪利酒與波特酒的裝瓶. <LINE> 以上全都需要蒸餾師筆記. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description2.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 2 - 补救与啤酒 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 用水果和糖把变质的液体变成醋. <LINE> 将发酵桶中的啤酒原液装瓶成佐餐啤酒. <LINE> 开放味美思、雪利酒与波特酒的装瓶. <LINE> 以上全都需要蒸馏师笔记. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description3.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 3 - Select grade <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> The wine you bottle comes out as Select Wine and the beer as Select Beer: more calories, better morale, a little stronger. <LINE> Bottling unlocks for raki, vodka, raw spirit, whiskey, rum, gin and tequila. <LINE> The first upgrade slot on your stations opens. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description3.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 3 - 精選品級 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的葡萄酒會成為精選葡萄酒, 啤酒會成為精選啤酒: 卡路里更多、更能提振心情、酒精也稍強一些. <LINE> 解鎖拉克酒、伏特加、蒸餾原酒、威士忌、蘭姆酒、琴酒與龍舌蘭酒的裝瓶. <LINE> 你的工作臺開放第一個升級槽. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description3.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 3 - 精选品级 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的葡萄酒会成为精选葡萄酒, 啤酒会成为精选啤酒: 卡路里更多、更能提振心情、酒劲也稍强一些. <LINE> 解锁拉克酒、伏特加、蒸馏原酒、威士忌、朗姆酒、金酒与龙舌兰酒的装瓶. <LINE> 你的工作站开放第一个升级槽. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description4.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 4 - Faster fermentation <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Barrel batches you start take 10%% less time: 43.2 h instead of 48 h. <LINE> You can bottle mead. <LINE> You can bottle champagne. <LINE> You can build a Bottle Rack for the cellar. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description4.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 4 - 加快發酵 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的發酵桶批次所需時間減少 10%%: 由 48 小時縮短為 43.2 小時. <LINE> 可將蜂蜜酒裝瓶. <LINE> 可將香檳裝瓶. <LINE> 可為酒窖製作酒瓶架. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description4.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 4 - 加快发酵 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的发酵桶批次所需时间减少 10%%: 由 48 小时缩短为 43.2 小时. <LINE> 可将蜂蜜酒装瓶. <LINE> 可将香槟装瓶. <LINE> 可为酒窖制作酒瓶架. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description5.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 5 - Select grade for spirits <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> The raki you bottle comes out as Select Raki. <LINE> Vodka, whiskey, rum, cider, vermouth, sherry, port, champagne, curaçao, gin, coffee liqueur and tequila have no grades; their quality is born in the cellar. <LINE> The mead you bottle comes out as Mead (Select). <LINE> You can bottle liqueur, curaçao and coffee liqueur. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description5.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 5 - 烈酒精選品級 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的拉克酒會成為精選拉克酒. <LINE> 伏特加、威士忌、蘭姆酒、蘋果酒、香艾酒、雪利酒、波特酒、香檳、庫拉索酒、琴酒、咖啡利口酒與龍舌蘭酒沒有品級; 它們的品質在酒窖中成就. <LINE> 你裝瓶的蜂蜜酒會成為蜂蜜酒 (精選). <LINE> 可將利口酒、庫拉索酒與咖啡利口酒裝瓶. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description5.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 5 - 烈酒精选品级 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的拉克酒会成为精选拉克酒. <LINE> 伏特加、威士忌、朗姆酒、苹果酒、味美思、雪利酒、波特酒、香槟、库拉索酒、金酒、咖啡利口酒与龙舌兰酒没有品级; 它们的质量在酒窖中成就. <LINE> 你装瓶的蜂蜜酒会成为蜂蜜酒 (精选). <LINE> 可将利口酒、库拉索酒与咖啡利口酒装瓶. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description6.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 6 - Temperature tolerance <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> A barrel batch you start keeps working 2 °C colder and 2 °C hotter. <LINE> The window becomes 10-32 °C instead of 12-30 °C. <LINE> The second upgrade slot on your stations opens. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description6.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 6 - 溫度耐受 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的發酵桶批次在低 2 °C 與高 2 °C 的環境下仍能繼續運作. <LINE> 溫度區間由 12-30 °C 擴大為 10-32 °C. <LINE> 你的工作臺開放第二個升級槽. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description6.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 6 - 温度耐受 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的发酵桶批次在低 2 °C 与高 2 °C 的环境下仍能继续运行. <LINE> 温度区间由 12-30 °C 扩大为 10-32 °C. <LINE> 你的工作站开放第二个升级槽. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description7.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 7 - Master's work <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> The wine you bottle comes out as Master's Wine and the beer as Master's Beer. <LINE> The best grade the fermenting branch can reach. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description7.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 7 - 大師手藝 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的葡萄酒會成為大師級葡萄酒, 啤酒會成為大師級啤酒. <LINE> 這是發酵分支能達到的最高品級. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description7.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 7 - 大师手艺 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的葡萄酒会成为大师级葡萄酒, 啤酒会成为大师级啤酒. <LINE> 这是发酵分支能达到的最高品级. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description8.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 8 - Master's work in spirits <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> The raki you bottle comes out as Master's Raki. <LINE> The mead you bottle comes out as Mead (Master's). <LINE> The best grade the distilling branch can reach. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description8.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 8 - 烈酒大師手藝 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的拉克酒會成為大師級拉克酒. <LINE> 你裝瓶的蜂蜜酒會成為蜂蜜酒 (大師級). <LINE> 這是蒸餾分支能達到的最高品級. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description8.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 8 - 烈酒大师手艺 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的拉克酒会成为大师级拉克酒. <LINE> 你装瓶的蜂蜜酒会成为蜂蜜酒 (大师级). <LINE> 这是蒸馏分支能达到的最高品级. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description9.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Level 9 - Still yield <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> A still batch you start gives 3.5 litres instead of 3. <LINE> The third upgrade slot on your stations opens. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description9.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 9 - 蒸餾器產量 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的蒸餾器批次產出 3.5 公升, 而非 3 公升. <LINE> 你的工作臺開放第三個升級槽. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_Brewing_Description9.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 9 - 蒸馏器产量 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的蒸馏器批次产出 3.5 升, 而不是 3 升. <LINE> 你的工作站开放第三个升级槽. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description.en: Şıra ezme, mayalanma ve şişeleme becerisi. Seviye yükseldikçe yeni tarifler açılır ve şişelediğin şarap daha iyi bir kademeden çıkar. <LINE> Şişeleme ve kurtarma tarifleri ayrıca Çilingir Defteri'ni okumuş olmayı ister; beceri tek başına yetmez.
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description.ch: 壓榨果漿、發酵與裝瓶的技能. 等級越高會解鎖新配方, 你裝瓶的葡萄酒品級也會更好. <LINE> 裝瓶與補救配方另外需要讀過蒸餾師筆記; 只有技能還不夠.
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description.cn: 压榨果浆、发酵与装瓶的技能. 等级越高会解锁新配方, 你装瓶的葡萄酒品级也会更好. <LINE> 装瓶与补救配方还需要读过蒸馏师笔记; 仅凭技能还不够.

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description1.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 1 - Şişeleme <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Mayalanmış partiyi kaba çekip Şarap (Sofralık) elde edersin. <LINE> Elma şırasını mayalandırıp Elma Şarabı şişeleyebilirsin. <LINE> Çilingir Defteri şart; beceri tek başına yetmez. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description1.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 1 - 裝瓶 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 將已發酵的批次接到容器中, 得到佐餐葡萄酒. <LINE> 可發酵蘋果漿並將蘋果酒裝瓶. <LINE> 需要蒸餾師筆記; 只有技能還不夠. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description1.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 1 - 装瓶 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 将已发酵的批次接到容器中, 得到佐餐葡萄酒. <LINE> 可发酵苹果浆并将苹果酒装瓶. <LINE> 需要蒸馏师笔记; 仅凭技能还不够. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description10.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 10 - Usta eli <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Senin başlattığın fıçı ve imbik partilerinin süresi ayrıca %%15 kısalır. <LINE> Fıçı 36,7 sa, imbik 6,8 sa. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description10.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 10 - 大師之手 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的發酵桶與蒸餾器批次再減少 15%% 的所需時間. <LINE> 發酵桶 36.7 小時, 蒸餾器 6.8 小時. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description10.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 10 - 大师之手 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的发酵桶与蒸馏器批次再减少 15%% 的所需时间. <LINE> 发酵桶 36.7 小时, 蒸馏器 6.8 小时. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description2.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 2 - Kurtarma ve bira <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Bozulmuş bir sıvıyı meyve ve şekerle sirkeye çevirirsin. <LINE> Fıçıdaki ham birayı şişeleyip Bira (Sofralık) elde edersin. <LINE> Şişeleme kapısı üçe daha açılır: Vermut Şişele, Şeri Şişele, Port Şarabı Şişele. <LINE> Hepsi Çilingir Defteri ister. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description2.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 2 - 補救與啤酒 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 用水果和糖把變質的液體變成醋. <LINE> 將發酵桶中的啤酒原液裝瓶成佐餐啤酒. <LINE> 裝瓶再開放三種: 香艾酒裝瓶、雪利酒裝瓶、波特酒裝瓶. <LINE> 以上全都需要蒸餾師筆記. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description2.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 2 - 补救与啤酒 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 用水果和糖把变质的液体变成醋. <LINE> 将发酵桶中的啤酒原液装瓶成佐餐啤酒. <LINE> 装瓶再开放三种: 味美思装瓶、雪利酒装瓶、波特酒装瓶. <LINE> 以上全都需要蒸馏师笔记. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description3.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 3 - Seçme kademe <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Şişelediğin şarap Şarap (Seçme), bira Bira (Seçme) olur: daha çok kalori, daha çok moral, biraz daha sert. <LINE> Şişeleme kapısı yediye çıkar: Rakı Şişele, Votka Şişele, Suma Şişele, Viski Şişele, Rom Şişele, Cin Şişele, Tekila Şişele. <LINE> İstasyonların birinci geliştirme yuvası açılır. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description3.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 3 - 精選品級 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的葡萄酒會成為精選葡萄酒, 啤酒會成為精選啤酒: 卡路里更多、更能提振心情、酒精也稍強一些. <LINE> 裝瓶擴充到七種: 拉克酒裝瓶、伏特加裝瓶、蒸餾原酒裝瓶、威士忌裝瓶、蘭姆酒裝瓶、琴酒裝瓶、龍舌蘭酒裝瓶. <LINE> 你的工作臺開放第一個升級槽. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description3.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 3 - 精选品级 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的葡萄酒会成为精选葡萄酒, 啤酒会成为精选啤酒: 卡路里更多、更能提振心情、酒劲也稍强一些. <LINE> 装瓶扩充到七种: 拉克酒装瓶、伏特加装瓶、蒸馏原酒装瓶、威士忌装瓶、朗姆酒装瓶、金酒装瓶、龙舌兰酒装瓶. <LINE> 你的工作站开放第一个升级槽. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description4.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 4 - Hızlı mayalanma <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Senin başlattığın fıçı partileri %%10 daha kısa sürer: 48 sa yerine 43,2 sa. <LINE> Bal şarabı şişeleyebilirsin. <LINE> Şampanya şişeleyebilirsin. <LINE> Mahzen için Şişe Rafı yapabilirsin. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description4.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 4 - 加快發酵 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的發酵桶批次所需時間減少 10%%: 由 48 小時縮短為 43.2 小時. <LINE> 可將蜂蜜酒裝瓶. <LINE> 可將香檳裝瓶. <LINE> 可為酒窖製作酒瓶架. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description4.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 4 - 加快发酵 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的发酵桶批次所需时间减少 10%%: 由 48 小时缩短为 43.2 小时. <LINE> 可将蜂蜜酒装瓶. <LINE> 可将香槟装瓶. <LINE> 可为酒窖制作酒瓶架. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description5.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 5 - Damıtıkta seçme kademe <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Şişelediğin rakı Rakı (Seçme) olur. <LINE> Votka, viski, rom, elma şarabı, vermut, şeri, port şarabı, şampanya, curaçao, cin, kahve likörü ve tekila kademesizdir; kaliteleri mahzende doğar. <LINE> Şişelediğin bal şarabı Bal Şarabı (Seçme) olur. <LINE> Likör, curaçao ve kahve likörü şişeleyebilirsin. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description5.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 5 - 烈酒精選品級 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的拉克酒會成為精選拉克酒. <LINE> 伏特加、威士忌、蘭姆酒、蘋果酒、香艾酒、雪利酒、波特酒、香檳、庫拉索酒、琴酒、咖啡利口酒與龍舌蘭酒沒有品級; 它們的品質在酒窖中成就. <LINE> 你裝瓶的蜂蜜酒會成為蜂蜜酒 (精選). <LINE> 可將利口酒、庫拉索酒與咖啡利口酒裝瓶. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description5.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 5 - 烈酒精选品级 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的拉克酒会成为精选拉克酒. <LINE> 伏特加、威士忌、朗姆酒、苹果酒、味美思、雪利酒、波特酒、香槟、库拉索酒、金酒、咖啡利口酒与龙舌兰酒没有品级; 它们的质量在酒窖中成就. <LINE> 你装瓶的蜂蜜酒会成为蜂蜜酒 (精选). <LINE> 可将利口酒、库拉索酒与咖啡利口酒装瓶. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description6.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 6 - Sıcaklık toleransı <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Senin başlattığın fıçı partisi 2 °C daha soğukta ve 2 °C daha sıcakta da işler. <LINE> Pencere 12-30 °C yerine 10-32 °C olur. <LINE> İstasyonların ikinci geliştirme yuvası açılır. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description6.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 6 - 溫度耐受 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的發酵桶批次在低 2 °C 與高 2 °C 的環境下仍能繼續運作. <LINE> 溫度區間由 12-30 °C 擴大為 10-32 °C. <LINE> 你的工作臺開放第二個升級槽. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description6.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 6 - 温度耐受 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的发酵桶批次在低 2 °C 与高 2 °C 的环境下仍能继续运行. <LINE> 温度区间由 12-30 °C 扩大为 10-32 °C. <LINE> 你的工作站开放第二个升级槽. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description7.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 7 - Usta işi <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Şişelediğin şarap Şarap (Usta İşi), bira Bira (Usta İşi) olur. <LINE> Mayalanma kolunun en iyi kademesi. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description7.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 7 - 大師手藝 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的葡萄酒會成為大師級葡萄酒, 啤酒會成為大師級啤酒. <LINE> 這是發酵分支能達到的最高品級. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description7.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 7 - 大师手艺 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的葡萄酒会成为大师级葡萄酒, 啤酒会成为大师级啤酒. <LINE> 这是发酵分支能达到的最高品级. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description8.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 8 - Damıtıkta usta işi <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Şişelediğin rakı Rakı (Usta İşi) olur. <LINE> Şişelediğin bal şarabı Bal Şarabı (Usta İşi) olur. <LINE> Damıtma kolunun en iyi kademesi. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description8.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 8 - 烈酒大師手藝 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你裝瓶的拉克酒會成為大師級拉克酒. <LINE> 你裝瓶的蜂蜜酒會成為蜂蜜酒 (大師級). <LINE> 這是蒸餾分支能達到的最高品級. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description8.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 8 - 烈酒大师手艺 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你装瓶的拉克酒会成为大师级拉克酒. <LINE> 你装瓶的蜂蜜酒会成为蜂蜜酒 (大师级). <LINE> 这是蒸馏分支能达到的最高品级. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description9.en: <RGB:1,1,0>Seviye 9 - İmbik verimi <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> Senin başlattığın imbik partisi 3 litre yerine 3,5 litre verir. <LINE> İstasyonların üçüncü geliştirme yuvası açılır. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description9.ch: <RGB:1,1,0>等級 9 - 蒸餾器產量 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你開始的蒸餾器批次產出 3.5 公升, 而非 3 公升. <LINE> 你的工作臺開放第三個升級槽. <INDENT:0>
IGUI_perks_İçki Yapımı_Description9.cn: <RGB:1,1,0>等级 9 - 蒸馏器产量 <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> <INDENT:10> 你开始的蒸馏器批次产出 3.5 升, 而不是 3 升. <LINE> 你的工作站开放第三个升级槽. <INDENT:0>

IGUI_ALJ_BaseManager_QuartersStoresTip.en: On: your residents take guns, ammo and clothes from ANY container in this base's quarters (the buildings and rooms marked Quarters), including your own gear and what other players keep there. Never the Main building or the grounds, and never a container marked as a store of other kinds. Marked stores are used first, and they count in the stores. What goes back (old weapons, store clothes, rounds brought home) still goes to a marked store of its kind, and into a quarters container only when the base has none.
IGUI_ALJ_BaseManager_QuartersStoresTip.ch: 開啟: 你的居民會從這個基地宿舍 (標記為宿舍的建築與房間) 的「任何」容器拿取槍枝、彈藥與衣物, 包括你自己的裝備以及其他玩家存放在那裡的東西. 絕不會動主建築或場地, 也絕不會動被標記為其他類型倉庫的容器. 優先使用已標記的倉庫, 這些容器也會計入倉庫. 送回的東西 (舊武器、倉庫衣物、帶回來的子彈) 仍會送到同類型的已標記倉庫, 只有在基地沒有這類倉庫時才放進宿舍容器.
IGUI_ALJ_BaseManager_QuartersStoresTip.cn: 开启: 你的居民会从这个基地宿舍 (标记为宿舍的建筑和房间) 的“任何”容器拿取枪支、弹药和衣物, 包括你自己的装备以及其他玩家存放在那里的东西. 绝不会动主建筑或场地, 也绝不会动被标记为其他类型仓库的容器. 优先使用已标记的仓库, 这些容器也会计入仓库. 送回的东西 (旧武器、仓库衣物、带回来的子弹) 仍会送到同类型的已标记仓库, 只有在基地没有这类仓库时才放进宿舍容器.

IGUI_ALJ_BaseManager_StoresTip.en: Mark containers as stores by kind: weapons, ammo, food, medical, tools, materials. What the crew brings home goes to the store of its kind (rounds as loose rounds for their guns, when there's a Weapons store too), and each job takes from its own. A gun handed out from a Weapons store takes only rounds that fit it.

IGUI_ALJ_Hostile_Tip.en: On: your faction's people (residents and parties out) treat every player outside your faction as an enemy. They attack on sight and their tags show red to those players. Your faction's members are never targets, nor are players in ghost mode, invisible or with their PvP safety on. Safehouses and non-PvP zones still protect players, and nobody is attacked while the server's PvP is off.
IGUI_ALJ_Hostile_Tip.ch: 開啟: 你陣營的人 (居民與外出的隊伍) 會把陣營外的每位玩家都當成敵人. 他們一見到就攻擊, 而且在那些玩家眼中他們的標籤會顯示為紅色. 你陣營的成員永遠不會成為目標, 處於幽靈模式、隱形或開啟 PvP 安全模式的玩家也不會. 安全屋與非 PvP 區域仍會保護玩家, 而伺服器關閉 PvP 時任何人都不會遭到攻擊.
IGUI_ALJ_Hostile_Tip.cn: 开启: 你阵营的人 (居民和外出的队伍) 会把阵营外的每位玩家都当成敌人. 他们一见到就攻击, 并且在那些玩家眼中他们的标签会显示为红色. 你阵营的成员永远不会成为目标, 处于幽灵模式、隐身或开启 PvP 安全模式的玩家也不会. 安全屋和非 PvP 区域仍会保护玩家, 而服务器关闭 PvP 时任何人都不会遭到攻击.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_NoStore.en: %1 (medic) has no Medical store to work from. Mark one at the base.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_NotHurt.cn: 你没有需要医护兵处理的伤.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Off.en: Medic rounds are switched off in this world.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Off.ch: 此世界已關閉醫護巡診.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Off.cn: 此世界已关闭医护巡诊.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_OutOf.en: %1 (medic) is out of supplies: the Medical store needs %2.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_OutOf.cn: %1 (医护兵) 物资用完了: 医疗仓库需要 %2.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkComing.en: Hang on, I'll get %1 over here.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkComing.cn: 撑着点, 我去叫 %1 过来.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkNoMedic.ch: 我們的醫護兵不在. 抱歉.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkNoMedic.cn: 我们的医护兵不在. 抱歉.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkOnIt.en: Right here. Hold still, let me see.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkOnIt.ch: 我在這. 別動, 讓我看看.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_TalkOnIt.cn: 我在这. 别动, 让我看看.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Treat_2.en: Alright, let's get you patched up.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Treat_2.ch: 好, 我來幫你處理傷口.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Treat_2.cn: 好, 我来帮你处理伤口.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Treat_3.ch: 放輕鬆. 會有點刺痛.
IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Treat_3.cn: 放轻松. 会有点刺痛.

IGUI_ALJ_Medic_Treat_4.en: Let me take a look at that.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_1.en: Watch where you swing. You nearly took one of ours out {when}.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_1.ch: 揮的時候看清楚. 你{when}差點撂倒我們一個人.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_1.cn: 挥的时候看清楚. 你{when}差点撂倒我们一个人.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_2.en: Easy with that thing. Heard about {place}.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_2.ch: 那玩意兒小心點. 我聽說了{place}的事.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_2.cn: 那玩意儿小心点. 我听说了{place}的事.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_3.en: Next time, aim at the dead ones, yeah?
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_3.ch: 下次瞄準死人打, 好嗎?
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Clumsy_3.cn: 下次瞄准死人打, 好吗?

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_1.en: You're the one who left supplies with us near {place}. That meant something.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_1.ch: 你就是在{place}附近留物資給我們的人. 那對我們意義重大.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_1.cn: 你就是在{place}附近给我们留物资的人. 那对我们意义重大.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_2.en: Thanks for what you dropped off {when}. We put it to use.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_2.ch: 謝謝你{when}送來的東西. 我們都用上了.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_2.cn: 谢谢你{when}送来的东西. 我们都用上了.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_3.en: Folks are still talking about what you left us near {place}.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_3.ch: 大家還在談論你在{place}附近留給我們的東西.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Gave_3.cn: 大家还在谈论你在{place}附近留给我们的东西.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_1.en: You're the one who stood with us. Anything you need, you ask.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_1.ch: 你是跟我們並肩作戰過的人. 需要什麼儘管開口.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_1.cn: 你是跟我们并肩作战过的人. 需要什么尽管开口.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_2.en: Hey, it's you. We haven't forgotten.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_2.ch: 嘿, 是你啊. 我們沒忘.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_2.cn: 嘿, 是你啊. 我们没忘.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_3.en: Good to see you again. You did right by us.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_3.ch: 很高興再見到你. 你待我們不薄.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupGrateful_3.cn: 很高兴再见到你. 你待我们不薄.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupWronged_1.en: You. We remember what you did.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupWronged_1.ch: 是你. 我們記得你做過什麼.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupWronged_1.cn: 是你. 我们记得你做过什么.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_GroupWronged_3.en: You've got nerve showing your face here.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_1.en: You stepped in near {place}. We don't forget that.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_1.ch: 你在{place}附近出手幫過忙. 我們不會忘記.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_1.cn: 你在{place}附近出手帮过忙. 我们不会忘记.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_2.en: Heard you helped some of ours {when}. Appreciated.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_2.ch: 聽說你{when}幫過我們的人. 感謝.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_2.cn: 听说你{when}帮过我们的人. 感谢.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_3.en: You're alright. Saw what you did near {place}.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_3.ch: 你人不錯. 我看到你在{place}附近做的事了.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_Helped_3.cn: 你人不错. 我看到你在{place}附近做的事了.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_1.en: Heard you roughed up some of ours near {place}. Walk careful.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_1.ch: 聽說你在{place}附近修理過我們的人. 走路小心點.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_1.cn: 听说你在{place}附近修理过我们的人. 走路小心点.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_2.en: You're the one who got rough with our people {when}.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_2.ch: 你就是{when}對我們的人動粗的傢伙.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_2.cn: 你就是{when}对我们的人动粗的家伙.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_3.ch: 冷靜點. 我們聽說了{place}的事.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_HurtOurs_3.cn: 冷静点. 我们听说了{place}的事.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_KilledOurs_1.en: Word is you killed one of ours near {place}. Give me one reason.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_KilledOurs_1.ch: 聽說你在{place}附近殺了我們一個人. 給我一個理由.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_KilledOurs_1.cn: 听说你在{place}附近杀了我们一个人. 给我一个理由.

IGUI_ALJ_Memory_KilledOurs_3.en: You've got blood of ours on your hands. Keep your distance.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_KilledOurs_3.ch: 你手上沾著我們的人的血. 離遠一點.
IGUI_ALJ_Memory_KilledOurs_3.cn: 你手上沾着我们的人的血. 离远一点.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Friend_1.en: You spared me. My crew talked it over - we'd stand with you.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Friend_1.ch: 你饒了我一命. 我的隊伍商量過了 - 我們願意跟你站在一起.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Friend_1.cn: 你饶了我一命. 我的队伍商量过了 - 我们愿意跟你站在一起.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Friend_2.en: Still breathing thanks to you. Need people? We're in.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Friend_2.ch: 多虧你我還活著. 需要人手嗎? 算我們一份.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Friend_2.cn: 多亏你我还活着. 需要人手吗? 算我们一份.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_1.en: You let me go back there. I won't forget it.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_1.ch: 那時你放了我一馬. 我不會忘記.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_1.cn: 那时你放了我一马. 我不会忘记.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_2.en: Hey, it's you. Thanks for... you know. Here, take this.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_2.ch: 嘿, 是你啊. 謝謝你…你知道的. 來, 這給你.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_2.cn: 嘿, 是你啊. 谢谢你…你知道的. 来, 这个给你.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_3.en: You could have shot me. Here - for letting me walk.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_3.ch: 你本來可以開槍打我的. 拿著 - 謝謝你放我走.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Grateful_3.cn: 你本来可以开枪打我的. 拿着 - 谢谢你放我走.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Revenge_1.en: You should have finished me when you had the chance.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Revenge_1.ch: 你當初有機會就該解決我.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Revenge_1.cn: 你当初有机会就该解决我.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Revenge_2.ch: 還記得我嗎? 我朋友可都記得.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Revenge_2.cn: 还记得我吗? 我朋友可都记得.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Warned_1.en: You! You took everything I had.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Warned_1.ch: 是你! 你搶走了我的一切.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Warned_1.cn: 是你! 你抢走了我的一切.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Warned_2.en: I remember you. Everyone's heard what you did.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Warned_2.ch: 我記得你. 大家都聽說你幹了什麼.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_Warned_2.cn: 我记得你. 大家都听说你干了什么.

IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_WordCameBack.en: Word came back from %1, the one you let go: their crew would join you if you asked.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_WordCameBack.ch: 你放走的 %1 傳回消息: 只要你開口, 他們的隊伍就會加入你.
IGUI_ALJ_Mercy_WordCameBack.cn: 你放走的 %1 传回消息: 只要你开口, 他们的队伍就会加入你.

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_CardTip_patrol.ch: 清理基地周邊區域 (4-8 小時)
IGUI_ALJ_Missions_CardTip_patrol.cn: 清理基地周边区域 (4-8 小时)

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_CardTip_scavenge.cn: 带回食物、弹药、材料 (12-24 小时)

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_GoodsLost.cn: : 货品随他们一起损失了

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_HuntResult.cn: : %1 - 击杀 %2 人, 仍有 %3 人在外

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_NoRecent.en: No mission has come back yet.

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_NoRoutines.ch: 沒有例行任務. 在派出前勾選「每天」即可設定.
IGUI_ALJ_Missions_NoRoutines.cn: 没有例行任务. 在派出前勾选“每天”即可设置.

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_NobodyOut.en: Nobody is out on a mission.

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_WhoOtherBase.en: Picks a new party here instead of the one at %1
IGUI_ALJ_Missions_WhoOtherBase.ch: 在這裡另選一隊, 取代 %1 的那一隊
IGUI_ALJ_Missions_WhoOtherBase.cn: 在这里另选一队, 取代 %1 的那一队

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_WhyFull.en: Up to %1 go on a mission

IGUI_ALJ_Missions_WhyKind.en: Pick a kind of mission first

IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowDebug.en: Show debug entries in the right-click menu
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowDebug.ch: 在右鍵選單中顯示除錯項目
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowDebug.cn: 在右键菜单中显示调试项目

IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowDebug_tooltip.en: Shows Debug (admin) at the bottom of the [A-Life Jimmy] menu where you may have it (admins in multiplayer; in single player a -debug game, a test world or the sandbox option Debug menu in single player). Off hides those testing tools for you only, handy with a mod that shows the right-click menu as one flat list.
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowDebug_tooltip.ch: 在你有權使用時, 於 [A-Life Jimmy] 選單底部顯示「除錯 (管理員)」 (多人模式中的管理員; 單人模式則為 -debug 遊戲、測試世界或開啟沙盒選項「單人模式除錯選單」). 關閉時僅對你隱藏這些測試工具, 搭配把右鍵選單顯示成單一平面清單的 MOD 時很方便.
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowDebug_tooltip.cn: 在你有权使用时, 于 [A-Life Jimmy] 菜单底部显示“调试 (管理员)” (多人模式中的管理员; 单人模式则为 -debug 游戏、测试世界或开启沙盒选项“单人模式调试菜单”). 关闭时仅对你隐藏这些测试工具, 搭配把右键菜单显示成单一平铺列表的 MOD 时很方便.

IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowMenu.ch: 顯示 [A-Life Jimmy] 右鍵選單
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowMenu.cn: 显示 [A-Life Jimmy] 右键菜单

IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowMenu_tooltip.en: Off hides the [A-Life Jimmy] entry of your right-click menu, Debug (admin) included, for you only. Trade, Medical Check and the other entries outside it stay; the people button in the sidebar still opens your faction window. If the host turned the menu off in the sandbox settings, this cannot bring it back.
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowMenu_tooltip.ch: 關閉時僅對你隱藏右鍵選單中的 [A-Life Jimmy] 項目, 包括「除錯 (管理員)」. 交易、醫療檢查與其他不在其中的項目仍會保留; 側邊欄的人員按鈕仍可開啟你的陣營視窗. 若房主已在沙盒設定中關閉此選單, 這裡無法讓它恢復.
IGUI_ALJ_ModOptions_ShowMenu_tooltip.cn: 关闭时仅对你隐藏右键菜单中的 [A-Life Jimmy] 选项, 包括“调试 (管理员)”. 交易、医疗检查和其他不在其中的选项仍会保留; 侧边栏的人员按钮仍可打开你的阵营窗口. 如果房主已在沙盒设置中关闭此菜单, 这里无法让它恢复.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_ActTest.ch: 動畫測試定身 (Jeem, 除錯)
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ActTest.cn: 动画测试定身 (Jeem, 调试)

IGUI_ALJ_Module_ActTestHelp.en: Holds an NPC still while an admin's animation test plays on them. Does nothing otherwise.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ActTestHelp.ch: 管理員對NPC播放動畫測試時, 讓該NPC保持不動. 其他時候不起作用.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ActTestHelp.cn: 管理员对NPC播放动画测试时, 让该NPC保持不动. 其他时候不起作用.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_CaptiveHelp.en: An NPC who surrendered to a player stays where they gave up (defending themselves if attacked); one who refuses or is let go runs off.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_CaptiveHelp.ch: 向玩家投降的NPC會待在投降的地方 (遭攻擊時會自衛); 拒絕或被放走的NPC則會跑掉.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_CaptiveHelp.cn: 向玩家投降的NPC会待在投降的地方 (遭到攻击时会自卫); 拒绝或被放走的NPC则会跑掉.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_DressWoundsHelp.en: A bleeding NPC who isn't fighting bandages the wound with their own kit, even on guard or under orders; with nothing left they call for help when someone could come or hear them. A resident fighting zombies stops to do it once none is close. One dressing per wound.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_DressWoundsHelp.ch: 未在戰鬥中的流血NPC會用自己的裝備包紮傷口, 即使正在警戒或聽命行事也一樣; 若已無物可用, 當有人能趕來或聽見時他們會呼救. 正在對付殭屍的居民會在附近沒有殭屍時停下來包紮. 每個傷口包紮一次.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_DressWoundsHelp.cn: 未在战斗中的流血NPC会用自己的装备包扎伤口, 即使正在警戒或听命行事也一样; 如果已无物可用, 当有人能赶来或听见时他们会呼救. 正在对付僵尸的居民会在附近没有僵尸时停下来包扎. 每个伤口包扎一次.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_HoldForHelpHelp.en: A resident defending their base who can't win yet stands their ground and calls for help instead of backing off, but only when another resident can come, and never with a zombie or an enemy on them or on one of their people (then they fight); the base's other residents come running, and once there are enough of them they go in together.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_HoldForHelpHelp.ch: 防守基地的居民若暫時打不贏, 會堅守原地呼叫支援而不是後退, 但僅限於有其他居民能趕來時, 且自己或自己人正遭殭屍或敵人纏住時絕不會這麼做 (此時會直接戰鬥); 基地的其他居民會趕來, 人數足夠後便一起進攻.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_HoldForHelpHelp.cn: 防守基地的居民如果暂时打不赢, 会坚守原地呼叫支援而不是后退, 但仅限于有其他居民能赶来时, 且自己或自己人正被僵尸或敌人缠住时绝不会这么做 (此时会直接战斗); 基地的其他居民会赶来, 人数足够后便一起进攻.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_KeepDistanceHelp.en: A hostile NPC who judges a fight not worth starting (the odds, how armed you look, how aggressive they are) backs off out of sight and watches instead of standing around. Come close and they fight.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_KeepDistanceHelp.ch: 判斷不值得開戰 (考量勝算、你看起來的武裝程度、他們的攻擊性) 的敵對NPC會退到視線外觀察, 而不是站在原地. 你一靠近他們就會開打.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_KeepDistanceHelp.cn: 判断不值得开战 (考量胜算、你看起来的武装程度、他们的攻击性) 的敌对NPC会退到视线外观察, 而不是站在原地. 你一靠近他们就会开打.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_KeepOutHelp.en: Someone who lingers in a player base's grounds without belonging there walks back out, and picks somewhere else to go.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_KeepOutHelp.ch: 不屬於玩家基地卻在其場地內逗留的人會走出去, 並另選地方前往.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_KeepOutHelp.cn: 不属于玩家基地却在其场地内逗留的人会走出去, 并另选地方前往.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_MarkedOutHelp.en: Someone who walks in through an open door or window marked No trespassing or Private without being allowed there walks straight back out.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_MarkedOutHelp.ch: 未獲准而從標記為「禁止擅入」或「私人」的開啟門窗走進來的人, 會直接走回去.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_MarkedOutHelp.cn: 未获准而从标记为“禁止擅入”或“私人”的开启门窗走进来的人, 会直接走回去.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_MedicRoundsHelp.en: A resident medic walks over to whoever at their base needs patching up, and to players who call for them, and treats them with what's in the base's Medical store.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_MedicRoundsHelp.ch: 居民醫護兵會走向基地中需要治療的人以及呼叫他們的玩家, 並用基地醫療倉庫中的物資進行治療.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_MedicRoundsHelp.cn: 居民医护兵会走向基地中需要治疗的人以及呼叫他们的玩家, 并用基地医疗仓库中的物资进行治疗.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_ResidentDayHelp.en: With the Residents' day plan setting on, a resident plays their part of the day where they're sent: in their sleep window (or a nap when they're worn out) they sit down beside their bed and doze, the rest of their free time they sit on the floor in their room and relax, and they get up when it ends or danger comes. Off, or with the setting off, they sit in A-Life's pose instead.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ResidentDayHelp.ch: 開啟「居民日常作息」設定時, 居民會在被派往的地方度過自己的一天: 在睡眠時段 (或累壞時小睡) 他們會坐在床邊打盹, 其餘自由時間則坐在房間地板上放鬆, 時段結束或危險來臨時便起身. 關閉此項或關閉該設定時, 他們改用 A-Life 的坐姿.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ResidentDayHelp.cn: 开启“居民日常作息”设置时, 居民会在被派往的地方度过自己的一天: 在睡眠时段 (或累坏时小睡) 他们会坐在床边打盹, 其余自由时间则坐在房间地板上放松, 时段结束或危险来临时便起身. 关闭此项或关闭该设置时, 他们改用 A-Life 的坐姿.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_ResidentPostHelp.en: Residents walk to and keep their guard post, job or resting spot; off duty they sit. Your orders and missions come first.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ResidentPostHelp.ch: 居民會走到並守在自己的崗哨、工作或休息地點; 下哨時會坐下. 你的命令與任務優先.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_ResidentPostHelp.cn: 居民会走到并守在自己的岗哨、工作或休息地点; 下哨时会坐下. 你的命令和任务优先.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_RestAtPostHelp.en: A tired resident guard sits down at their post; they get up to fight.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_RestAtPostHelp.ch: 疲倦的居民警衛會在崗位上坐下; 需要戰鬥時會起身.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_RestAtPostHelp.cn: 疲倦的居民警卫会在岗位上坐下; 需要战斗时会起身.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_TendWoundedHelp.en: When a crewmate or fellow resident calls for help, the nearest one with a bandage (a medic first) goes over and dresses their wound.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_TendWoundedHelp.ch: 隊友或同住的居民呼救時, 離得最近且有繃帶的人 (醫護兵優先) 會過去替他們包紮傷口.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_TendWoundedHelp.cn: 队友或同住的居民呼救时, 离得最近且有绷带的人 (医护兵优先) 会过去为他们包扎伤口.

IGUI_ALJ_Module_TraderHelp.en: A trader on a visit to a player base walks to their spot outside the grounds, stands there (stopping to face anyone who comes close), and walks off when the visit is over.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_TraderHelp.ch: 來訪玩家基地的商人會走到場地外的定點站著 (有人靠近時會停下來面向對方), 來訪結束後離開.
IGUI_ALJ_Module_TraderHelp.cn: 来访玩家基地的商人会走到场地外的定点站着 (有人靠近时会停下来面向对方), 来访结束后离开.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_2.en: I can hear them... in my head.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_2.ch: 我聽得到他們…在我腦子裡.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_2.cn: 我听得到他们…在我脑子里.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_3.en: It's spreading. I can feel it.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_3.ch: 它在擴散. 我感覺得到.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_3.cn: 它在扩散. 我感觉得到.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_4.en: Don't let me turn. Promise me.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_4.ch: 別讓我變成那樣. 答應我.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Delirious_4.cn: 别让我变成那样. 答应我.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Drunk_1.ch: 我沒事. 我完全沒事.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Drunk_1.cn: 我没事. 我完全没事.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Drunk_2.en: Is the ground moving or is it me?
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Drunk_2.ch: 是地在動, 還是我在晃?
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Drunk_2.cn: 是地在动, 还是我在晃?

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Drunk_4.cn: 再来一杯我就要唱歌了.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Feverish_2.en: Why is it so cold? ...Or is it hot?

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Feverish_3.en: My arm... where it bit me... it's throbbing.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Feverish_3.ch: 我的手臂…被咬的地方…一陣陣抽痛.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Feverish_3.cn: 我的手臂…被咬的地方…一阵阵抽痛.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Grief_3.en: It should have been me, not %1.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Grief_3.ch: 該死的應該是我, 不是 %1.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Grief_3.cn: 该死的应该是我, 不是 %1.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Hungry_3.en: When did I last eat? I can't remember.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Hungry_3.ch: 我上次吃東西是什麼時候? 我想不起來了.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Hungry_3.cn: 我上次吃东西是什么时候? 我想不起来了.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Hungry_4.en: Anyone got a can of something?

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Pain_2.en: I need something for the pain.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Pain_3.ch: 啊, 這傷口痛死我了.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Pain_3.cn: 啊, 这伤口痛死我了.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Pain_4.en: I can't move it without it hurting.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Parched_3.en: My head's pounding. I need a drink.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Parched_3.ch: 我頭痛欲裂. 我需要喝點東西.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Parched_3.cn: 我头痛欲裂. 我需要喝点东西.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Parched_4.en: If I don't drink soon, I'm done.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Queasy_1.en: That smell is turning my stomach.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Queasy_3.en: Can we get away from the bodies?
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Queasy_3.ch: 我們能離那些屍體遠一點嗎?
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Queasy_3.cn: 我们能离那些尸体远一点吗?

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Queasy_4.ch: 噁. 我嘴裡都是那個味道.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Queasy_4.cn: 呕. 我嘴里都是那个味道.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Sick_2.en: I think I'm going to be sick.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_1.ch: 我快餓死了. 說真的.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_1.cn: 我快饿死了. 说真的.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_2.en: I can't keep going without food.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_2.ch: 沒有食物我撐不下去了.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_2.cn: 没有食物我撑不下去了.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_3.ch: 拜託, 隨便什麼吃的都好…
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_3.cn: 求你了, 随便什么吃的都好…

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Starving_4.en: I'm so hungry I can't think straight.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Stressed_1.en: I can't do this much longer.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Stressed_3.ch: 一點聲響都會嚇我一跳.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Stressed_3.cn: 一点声响都会吓我一跳.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Thirsty_1.en: I could use a drink of water.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Thirsty_2.ch: 我嘴巴乾得像沙子一樣.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Thirsty_2.cn: 我嘴巴干得像沙子一样.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Thirsty_4.en: I'd kill for something to drink.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Thirsty_4.ch: 只要有喝的, 要我做什麼都行.
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Thirsty_4.cn: 只要有喝的, 要我做什么都行.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Tired_1.en: I need to sit down for a minute.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Tired_2.en: I can barely keep my eyes open.

IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Tired_3.en: When do we get some rest?
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Tired_3.ch: 我們什麼時候才能休息?
IGUI_ALJ_MoodleLine_Tired_3.cn: 我们什么时候才能休息?

IGUI_ALJ_Person_Given.ch: 已給予: %1 (尚未看到他們拿著)
IGUI_ALJ_Person_Given.cn: 已给予: %1 (尚未看到他们拿着)

IGUI_ALJ_Person_NeedsNone.cn: 未追踪 (需求功能已关闭, 或尚无他们的信息)

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleAutoOff.cn: %1 (此处已关闭自动排班: 职务供“填补空缺”使用)

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleLockedRole.en: Locked: planned by you (%1 when unlocked)
