IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleLockedRole.cn: 已锁定: 由你规划 (解锁后为%1)

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleNone.en: No schedule yet: the base deals them in within a minute
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleNone.ch: 尚未排班: 基地會在一分鐘內將其排入
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleNone.cn: 尚未排班: 基地会在一分钟内将其排入

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleNoneOff.en: No schedule (Auto-schedule is off here): pick their cells above, or Fill the gaps
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleNoneOff.ch: 沒有排班 (此處已關閉自動排班): 在上方選擇其格子, 或使用「填補空缺」
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoleNoneOff.cn: 没有排班 (此处已关闭自动排班): 在上方选择其格子, 或使用“填补空缺”

IGUI_ALJ_Person_Rounds.en: Rounds on them: %1 loaded + %2 in reserve
IGUI_ALJ_Person_Rounds.ch: 身上子彈: 已裝填 %1 發 + 備用 %2 發
IGUI_ALJ_Person_Rounds.cn: 身上子弹: 已装填 %1 发 + 备用 %2 发

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsInf.en: Rounds on them: never runs out
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsInf.ch: 身上子彈: 永不耗盡
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsInf.cn: 身上子弹: 永不耗尽

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsLoaded.ch: 身上子彈: 已裝填 %1 發
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsLoaded.cn: 身上子弹: 已装填 %1 发

IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsUnknown.en: Rounds on them: not known yet
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsUnknown.ch: 身上子彈: 尚不清楚
IGUI_ALJ_Person_RoundsUnknown.cn: 身上子弹: 尚不清楚

IGUI_ALJ_Person_TrainNoShift.en: They are training but have no Train shift: the training stands still until a cell says Train.
IGUI_ALJ_Person_TrainNoShift.ch: 他們正在訓練但沒有「訓練」班次: 在某格排入「訓練」之前, 訓練進度會停滯.
IGUI_ALJ_Person_TrainNoShift.cn: 他们正在训练但没有“训练”班次: 在某格排入“训练”之前, 训练进度会停滞.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_AlarmUp.en: %1: alarm's up! All %2 at home are on their feet.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_AlarmUp.ch: %1: 警報響了! 基地裡 %2 人全都起來了.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_AlarmUp.cn: %1: 警报响了! 基地里 %2 人全都起来了.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Close.en: %1: we're close. Look out for us.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Close.ch: %1: 我們快到了. 留意我們.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Close.cn: %1: 我们快到了. 留意我们.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Coming.en: %1: copy. %2 on the way to you, about %3 minutes.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Coming.ch: %1: 收到. %2 正前往你那裡, 約 %3 分鐘.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Coming.cn: %1: 收到. %2 正前往你那里, 约 %3 分钟.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Disabled.en: Calling your people by radio is switched off on this server.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Disabled.ch: 此伺服器已關閉用無線電呼叫你的人.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Disabled.cn: 此服务器已关闭用无线电呼叫你的人.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Holding.en: %1: copy, holding the base. All %2 at home are up.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Holding.ch: %1: 收到, 固守基地. 基地裡 %2 人全都起來了.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Holding.cn: %1: 收到, 坚守基地. 基地里 %2 人全都起来了.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NewsAlarm.en: %1 sounded the alarm over the radio.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NewsAlarm.ch: %1 透過無線電拉響了警報.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NewsAlarm.cn: %1 通过无线电拉响了警报.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoBases.en: None of your bases has anyone living there to answer.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoBases.ch: 你的基地都沒有人住, 無人能回應.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoBases.cn: 你的基地都没有人住, 无人能回应.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoPower.en: The radio has no power: put a battery in it, or give it electricity.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoPower.ch: 無線電沒有電: 裝入電池, 或為它供電.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoPower.cn: 无线电没有电: 装入电池, 或为它供电.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoRadio.en: No working two-way radio to call on.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoRadio.ch: 沒有可用的雙向無線電可以呼叫.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoRadio.cn: 没有可用的双向无线电可以呼叫.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Nobody.en: %1: nobody answers. Nobody is at home (%2 out).
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Nobody.ch: %1: 無人回應. 基地沒有人 (%2 人外出).
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Nobody.cn: %1: 无人回应. 基地没有人 (%2 人外出).

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NobodyFree.en: %1: nobody free to send. The guards are holding their posts.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NobodyFree.ch: %1: 沒有空閒的人可派. 警衛都在堅守崗位.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NobodyFree.cn: %1: 没有空闲的人可派. 警卫都在坚守岗位.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoneOut.ch: %1: 你呼叫的人都沒有外出.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NoneOut.cn: %1: 你呼叫的人都没有外出.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NotTwoWay.en: This radio only receives: calling your people needs a two-way radio, like a walkie-talkie or a ham radio.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NotTwoWay.ch: 這台無線電只能接收: 呼叫你的人需要雙向無線電, 例如對講機或業餘無線電臺.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NotTwoWay.cn: 这台无线电只能接收: 呼叫你的人需要双向无线电, 例如对讲机或无线电台.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NotYours.en: %1 isn't your base: nobody there answers you.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NotYours.ch: %1 不是你的基地: 那裡沒有人會回應你.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_NotYours.cn: %1 不是你的基地: 那里没有人会回应你.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_OutOfRadioRange.en: Out of range: the base is %1 tiles away and this radio reaches %2.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_OutOfRadioRange.ch: 超出範圍: 基地在 %1 格外, 這台無線電只能傳到 %2 格.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_OutOfRadioRange.cn: 超出范围: 基地在 %1 格外, 这台无线电只能传到 %2 格.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_OutOfRange.en: %1: only static. The base is %2 tiles away and the call reaches %3.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_OutOfRange.ch: %1: 只有雜訊. 基地在 %2 格外, 呼叫只能傳到 %3 格.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_OutOfRange.cn: %1: 只有杂音. 基地在 %2 格外, 呼叫只能传到 %3 格.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Status.en: %1 here. %2 at home: %3 on a post, %4 asleep. %5 out.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Status.ch: 這裡是 %1. 基地有 %2 人: %3 人在崗位上, %4 人在睡覺. %5 人外出.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_Status.cn: 这里是 %1. 基地有 %2 人: %3 人在岗位上, %4 人在睡觉. %5 人外出.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipAlarm.en: Everyone at home is woken and on alert for 15 minutes, as when the base alarm goes off.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipAlarm.ch: 基地裡所有人都會被叫醒並戒備 15 分鐘, 和基地警報響起時一樣.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipAlarm.cn: 基地里所有人都会被叫醒并戒备 15 分钟, 和基地警报响起时一样.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipHold.en: Everyone at home gets up and holds where they are for an hour.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipHold.ch: 基地裡所有人都會起身, 在原地堅守一小時.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipHold.cn: 基地里所有人都会起身, 在原地坚守一小时.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipHome.en: Whoever you called over the radio from this base stops following you and heads home.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipHome.ch: 你透過無線電從這個基地叫來的人會停止跟隨你並返回基地.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipHome.cn: 你通过无线电从这个基地叫来的人会停止跟随你并返回基地.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipStandDown.en: Ends the alarm or the hold now. A real threat at the base raises the alarm again.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipStandDown.ch: 立即結束警報或固守狀態. 若基地出現真正的威脅, 會再次拉響警報.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TipStandDown.cn: 立即结束警报或坚守状态. 如果基地出现真正的威胁, 会再次拉响警报.

IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TooFarFromRadio.en: Stand next to the radio to use it.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TooFarFromRadio.ch: 站在無線電旁邊才能使用.
IGUI_ALJ_Radio_TooFarFromRadio.cn: 站在无线电旁边才能使用.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_BaseAlarm_Expect.en: Sleepers wake, arm themselves and head for the trouble together. Guards stay on their posts. The News says why everyone got up.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_BaseAlarm_Expect.ch: 睡著的人會醒來, 拿起武器一起前往出事地點. 警衛留在崗位上. 「消息」中會說明大家為何起身.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_BaseAlarm_Expect.cn: 睡着的人会醒来, 拿起武器一起前往出事地点. 警卫留在岗位上. “消息”中会说明大家为何起身.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_BaseAlarm_Todo.en: At night, with residents asleep at the base, bring hostiles close to the base (Set it up sets the clock to night and spawns three hostile people 30 tiles west of the base, coming for it). Watch the residents, then read the News tab.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_BaseAlarm_Todo.ch: 在夜晚居民於基地熟睡時, 把敵人引到基地附近 (「布置」會把時間調到夜晚, 並在基地西方 30 格處生成三名朝基地而來的敵對人員). 觀察居民的反應, 然後閱讀「消息」分頁.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_BaseAlarm_Todo.cn: 在夜晚居民在基地熟睡时, 把敌人引到基地附近 (“布置”会把时间调到夜晚, 并在基地西边 30 格处生成三名朝基地而来的敌对人员). 观察居民的反应, 然后阅读“消息”标签页.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Beds_Expect.en: Each walks to their own bed, gets in and lies down. Their task says Asleep only once they're lying in bed. Talking to a sleeper gets them up.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Beds_Expect.ch: 每個人都會走到自己的床邊, 上床躺下. 只有在躺到床上後, 其目前活動才會顯示「睡覺中」. 和睡著的人交談會讓他起身.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Beds_Expect.cn: 每个人都会走到自己的床边, 上床躺下. 只有在躺到床上后, 其当前活动才会显示“睡觉中”. 和睡着的人交谈会让他起身.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Beds_Todo.en: Spend a night at the base (Residents sleep in beds on). Watch residents when their sleep time comes and check their task in My people > People. Then talk to one who is asleep.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Beds_Todo.ch: 在基地過一晚 (開啟「居民睡在床上」). 在居民的睡覺時間到來時觀察他們, 並在「我的人員 > 人員」中檢查其目前活動. 然後和一名睡著的人交談.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Beds_Todo.cn: 在基地过一晚 (开启“居民睡在床上”). 在居民的睡觉时间到来时观察他们, 并在“我的人员 > 人员”中检查其当前活动. 然后和一名睡着的人交谈.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Caffeine_Expect.en: They take it, and the tiredness on their sheet goes down.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Caffeine_Expect.ch: 他們會收下, 資料頁上的疲勞值會下降.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Caffeine_Expect.cn: 他们会收下, 资料页上的疲劳值会下降.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Caffeine_Todo.en: Find a tired resident (Set it up makes the one nearest you very tired) and note their tiredness on their sheet in My people. Give them coffee, tea or Vitamins (Caffeine wakes tired NPCs on).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Caffeine_Todo.ch: 找一名疲勞的居民 (「布置」會讓離你最近的居民非常疲勞), 並在「我的人員」中記下其資料頁上的疲勞值. 給他們咖啡、茶或咖啡因藥丸 (開啟「咖啡因讓疲勞的NPC清醒」).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Caffeine_Todo.cn: 找一名疲劳的居民 (“布置”会让离你最近的居民非常疲劳), 并在“我的人员”中记下其资料页上的疲劳值. 给他们咖啡、茶或维生素 (开启“咖啡因让疲劳的NPC清醒”).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_CreatorNames_Expec.en: The NPC shows the name you set, not a random one.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_CreatorNames_Expec.ch: NPC會顯示你設定的名字, 而不是隨機名字.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_CreatorNames_Expec.cn: NPC会显示你设置的名字, 而不是随机名字.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_CreatorNames_Todo.en: In A-Life's NPC Creation panel, make a preset set to Set name with a name you pick, and spawn an NPC from it (A-Life 1.4).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_CreatorNames_Todo.ch: 在 A-Life 的 NPC 建立面板 (NPC Creation) 中, 建立一個預設, 將 NPC名字設為指定名字 (Set name) 並填入你選的名字, 再用它生成一名NPC (A-Life 1.4).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_CreatorNames_Todo.cn: 在 A-Life 的 NPC 创建面板 (NPC Creation) 中, 创建一个预设, 将 NPC名字设为指定名字 (Set name) 并填入你选的名字, 再用它生成一名NPC (A-Life 1.4).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_DoorTrader_Expect.en: They knock. While the door is shut there is only A-Life's Talk to button and its door talk, with no Let's trade. With the door open and you near them a Trade button appears beside Talk to, and Let's trade is in the door talk. With Cinematic the trade grid opens inside the conversation, with Classic beside it. Back returns to the talk. Invited in, they come inside and trading works there too.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_DoorTrader_Expect.ch: 他們會敲門. 門關著時, 只有 A-Life 的「交談」按鈕與它的門口對話, 沒有「來交易吧」. 門打開且你在他們附近時, 「交談」旁會出現「交易」按鈕, 門口對話中也會有「來交易吧」. 選擇電影式時, 交易網格會在對話中開啟; 選擇經典時則在對話旁開啟. 「返回」會回到對話. 邀請他們進門後, 他們會進到屋內, 在那裡也能交易.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_DoorTrader_Expect.cn: 他们会敲门. 门关着时, 只有 A-Life 的“交谈”按钮和它的门口对话, 没有“来交易吧”. 门打开且你在他们附近时, “交谈”旁会出现“交易”按钮, 门口对话中也会有“来交易吧”. 选择电影式时, 交易网格会在对话中打开; 选择经典时则在对话旁打开. “返回”会回到对话. 邀请他们进门后, 他们会进到屋内, 在那里也能交易.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_DoorTrader_Todo.en: Wait at your base for a trader to knock (Set it up sends some now). With the door shut, talk to them through it. Then open the door, stand near them and trade (the Trade button, or Let's trade in the talk), then Back. Then invite them in and trade again inside. Try both of A-Life's talk window styles (Cinematic and Classic, in its menu).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_DoorTrader_Todo.ch: 在基地等商人來敲門 (「布置」會立即派一些過來). 門關著時, 隔著門和他們交談. 接著打開門, 站在他們附近進行交易 (用「交易」按鈕, 或對話中的「來交易吧」), 然後按「返回」. 再邀請他們進門, 在屋內再交易一次. 兩種 A-Life 對話視窗樣式都要試試 (電影式與經典, 在其選單中).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_DoorTrader_Todo.cn: 在基地等商人来敲门 (“布置”会立即派一些过来). 门关着时, 隔着门和他们交谈. 接着打开门, 站在他们附近进行交易 (用“交易”按钮, 或对话中的“来交易吧”), 然后点“返回”. 再邀请他们进门, 在屋内再交易一次. 两种 A-Life 对话窗口样式都要试试 (电影式和经典, 在其菜单中).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Escort_Expect.en: They keep up with you instead of falling far behind: they walk on behind you without stopping every few steps, run to catch up and keep running until they are close, and stop a step or two short of you when you stop.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Escort_Expect.ch: 他們會跟上你, 而不是遠遠落後: 他們會在你身後持續行走, 不會每走幾步就停下; 會跑步追上並持續跑到靠近你為止; 你停下時, 他們會停在離你一兩步的地方.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Escort_Expect.cn: 他们会跟上你, 而不是远远落后: 他们会在你身后持续行走, 不会每走几步就停下; 会跑步追上并持续跑到靠近你为止; 你停下时, 他们会停在离你一两步的地方.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Escort_Todo.en: Have a resident or companion follow you. Walk a long straight line, then run and sprint for a while round a few corners, and stop now and then.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Escort_Todo.ch: 讓一名居民或同伴跟隨你. 先沿長直線行走, 再跑步與衝刺一段時間並轉過幾個彎, 不時停下來.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Escort_Todo.cn: 让一名居民或同伴跟随你. 先沿长直线行走, 再跑步和冲刺一段时间并转过几个弯, 不时停下来.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Expect.en: One click fills in the base: grounds around the house, the house as the Main building, and its bedrooms.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Expect.ch: 一鍵就會填好基地: 房屋周圍的場地、將房屋設為主建築, 以及其臥室.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Expect.cn: 一键就会填好基地: 房屋周围的场地、将房屋设为主建筑, 以及其卧室.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Title.ch: 以我的房子建立新基地
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Title.cn: 以我的房子建立新基地

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Todo.en: Go to the house you live in. Open My people > Bases, click + New base, then From my house.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Todo.ch: 前往你住的房子. 開啟「我的人員 > 基地」, 點選「+ 新基地」, 再點選「從我的房子」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_HouseBase_Todo.cn: 前往你住的房子. 打开“我的人员 > 基地”, 点击“+ 新基地”, 再点击“从我的房子”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Expect.en: The News and the notes show in that client's language, not in English.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Expect.ch: 「消息」與筆記會以該客戶端的語言顯示, 而不是英文.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Expect.cn: “消息”和备注会以该客户端的语言显示, 而不是英文.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Title.ch: 每位玩家看到自己語言的訊息
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Title.cn: 每位玩家看到自己语言的消息

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Todo.en: On a server, run one client in another language (Russian or Italian). Let something happen at the base, then read the News tab and the notes that client gets.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Todo.ch: 在伺服器上, 用另一種語言 (俄文或義大利文) 執行一個客戶端. 讓基地發生一些事, 然後閱讀該客戶端收到的「消息」分頁與通知.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Languages_Todo.cn: 在服务器上, 用另一种语言 (俄语或意大利语) 运行一个客户端. 让基地发生一些事, 然后阅读该客户端收到的“消息”标签页和通知.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Expect.en: No error popups and no errors in the console while loading or after. Every section of My people opens and shows its content.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Expect.ch: 載入期間與載入後都沒有錯誤彈出視窗, 主控台也沒有錯誤. 「我的人員」的每個區塊都能開啟並顯示內容.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Expect.cn: 加载期间和加载后都没有错误弹窗, 控制台也没有错误. “我的人员”的每个区块都能打开并显示内容.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Title.ch: 重新啟動後能正常載入
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Title.cn: 重新启动后能正常加载

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Todo.en: Quit the game completely, start it again and load a save (don't just go back to the main menu and load). Then open My people and click every section.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Todo.ch: 完全關閉遊戲, 重新啟動後載入存檔 (不要只是回到主選單再載入). 然後開啟「我的人員」並點選每個區塊.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Load_Todo.cn: 完全退出游戏, 重新启动后加载存档 (不要只是回到主菜单再加载). 然后打开“我的人员”并点击每个区块.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_LostResidents_Expe.en: They're back at the base at once. Without the button, a missing resident turns up after about five minutes while you're near the base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_LostResidents_Expe.ch: 他們立刻回到基地. 不用這個按鈕時, 你在基地附近約五分鐘後, 失蹤的居民也會出現.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_LostResidents_Expe.cn: 他们马上回到基地. 不用这个按钮的话, 你待在基地附近大约五分钟后, 失踪的居民也会冒出来.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_LostResidents_Todo.en: Find a resident My people shows at home who isn't there. Open their sheet's Actions menu and choose Bring them home...
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_LostResidents_Todo.ch: 找一位「我的人員」顯示在基地, 但實際不在的居民. 開啟其頁面的「動作」選單, 選擇「帶他們回基地…」
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_LostResidents_Todo.cn: 找一位“我的人员”显示在基地, 但实际不在的居民. 打开其页面的“动作”菜单, 选择“带他们回基地…”

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NewOptions_Expect.en: All six are there, each with a tooltip: Residents use flashlights, No zombies appear inside your base, Residents sleep in beds, Caffeine wakes tired NPCs, Residents talk like they live with you, Your people don't mind your aim.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NewOptions_Expect.ch: 六個選項都在, 各有提示說明: 居民使用手電筒, 基地內不會出現殭屍, 居民睡在床上, 咖啡因讓疲勞的NPC清醒, 居民像同住家人般交談, 自己人不介意你瞄準.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NewOptions_Expect.cn: 六个选项都在, 每个都带提示: 居民使用手电筒, 基地内不会出现僵尸, 居民睡在床上, 咖啡因让疲劳的NPC清醒, 居民像同住家人般交谈, 自己人不介意你瞄准.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NewOptions_Todo.en: Look through the Jeem Extension sandbox pages (when making a world, or in the admin's sandbox options).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NewOptions_Todo.ch: 瀏覽 Jeem 擴充的沙盒頁面 (建立世界時, 或在管理員的沙盒選項中).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NewOptions_Todo.cn: 浏览 Jeem 扩展的沙盒页面 (创建世界时, 或在管理员的沙盒选项中).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NightDetails_Expec.en: Nobody has a flashlight on indoors at the base. Sleepers stay quiet. Residents walk around your crops, not over them.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NightDetails_Expec.ch: 基地室內沒有人開著手電筒. 睡覺的人保持安靜. 居民會繞過你的作物, 不會踩過去.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NightDetails_Expec.cn: 基地室内没有人开着手电筒. 睡觉的人保持安静. 居民会绕过你的作物, 不会踩过去.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NightDetails_Todo.en: Spend a night at the base and watch the residents: indoors, asleep, and outside near your crops.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NightDetails_Todo.ch: 在基地過一夜, 觀察居民: 在室內, 睡著時, 以及在戶外靠近你的作物時.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NightDetails_Todo.cn: 在基地过一夜, 观察居民: 在室内, 睡着时, 以及在户外靠近你的作物时.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Expect.en: Nobody raises a gun at you as you pass.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Expect.ch: 你經過時沒有人舉槍對著你.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Expect.cn: 你经过时没有人举枪对着你.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Title.en: No guns raised as you walk past

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Todo.en: Walk close past residents who are sitting and residents who are asleep, military ones too, with and without a weapon in your hands.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Todo.ch: 近距離走過坐著的居民與睡著的居民 (包括軍人居民), 手上拿武器與不拿武器各試一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_NoGunRaise_Todo.cn: 近距离走过坐着的居民和睡着的居民 (包括军人居民), 手上拿武器和不拿武器各试一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Rearm_Expect.en: Once dry, they fetch ammo from the store (opening the boxes) and draw their gun again.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Rearm_Expect.ch: 子彈打光後, 他們會從倉庫拿彈藥 (打開彈藥盒), 再次拔槍.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Rearm_Expect.cn: 子弹打完以后, 他们会去仓库取弹药 (拆开弹药盒), 重新拔枪.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Rearm_Todo.en: Put boxes of ammo for a resident's gun in an Ammo store. Let the resident shoot their gun dry in a fight.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Rearm_Todo.ch: 把居民槍枝用的彈藥盒放進彈藥倉庫. 讓該居民在戰鬥中把槍裡的子彈打光.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_Rearm_Todo.cn: 把居民枪支用的弹药盒放进弹药仓库. 让该居民在战斗中把枪里的子弹打光.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Expec.en: No introductions and no Who are you? - they know you. The Home tab answers with real details: how they're doing, what they're on, the base's news.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Expec.ch: 沒有自我介紹, 也沒有「你是誰?」- 他們認識你. 「首頁」分頁會回答實際的細節: 他們過得如何, 正在做什麼, 基地的消息.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Expec.cn: 没有自我介绍, 也没有“你是谁?” - 他们认识你. “首页”标签页会回答实际的细节: 他们过得如何, 正在做什么, 基地的消息.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Title.en: Residents talk like they live with you
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Title.ch: 居民像同住家人般交談
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Title.cn: 居民像同住家人般交谈

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Todo.en: Talk to one of your residents (Residents talk like they live with you on). Look through what they say, then open the Home tab.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Todo.ch: 和你的一位居民交談 (開啟「居民像同住家人般交談」). 看看他們說了什麼, 然後開啟「首頁」分頁.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_ResidentTalk_Todo.cn: 和你的一位居民交谈 (开启“居民像同住家人般交谈”). 看看他们说了什么, 然后打开“首页”标签页.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_StoreSwap_Expect.en: Only C ends up on them; A and B are back in the stores. Their Also carries list doesn't change along the way.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_StoreSwap_Expect.ch: 最後他們身上只有 C; A 和 B 回到倉庫. 過程中他們的「另外攜帶」清單不會改變.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_StoreSwap_Expect.cn: 最后他们身上只有 C; A 和 B 回到仓库. 过程中他们的“另外携带”列表不会改变.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_StoreSwap_Todo.en: On a server, with a resident on screen, pick weapon A from the stores on their People sheet, then B, then C (let each one arrive).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_StoreSwap_Todo.ch: 在伺服器上, 讓一位居民在畫面中, 在其「人員」頁面從倉庫選武器 A, 接著選 B, 再選 C (每次都等武器送到).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_StoreSwap_Todo.cn: 在服务器上, 让一位居民在画面中, 在其“人员”页面从仓库选武器 A, 接着选 B, 再选 C (每次都等武器送到).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TowerGuard_Expect.en: The guard stays up there and shoots at the enemies from the post.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TowerGuard_Expect.ch: 警衛留在上面, 從崗位向敵人開火.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TowerGuard_Expect.cn: 警卫待在上面, 从岗位上朝敌人开枪.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TowerGuard_Todo.en: Post a guard on an upper floor that's open on top (a watchtower, a roof, a balcony). Then get a fight going near the base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TowerGuard_Todo.ch: 在高於地面層且上方開放的樓層 (瞭望塔, 屋頂, 陽台) 安排一名警衛. 然後在基地附近引發一場戰鬥.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TowerGuard_Todo.cn: 在高于地面层且顶部敞开的楼层 (瞭望塔, 屋顶, 阳台) 安排一名警卫. 然后在基地附近挑起一场战斗.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Expect.en: The trade opens both times (inside the Cinematic window, beside the Classic one), and closing it takes you back to the talk.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Expect.ch: 兩次都能開啟交易 (電影式視窗中在視窗內, 經典視窗則在旁邊), 關閉後會回到對話.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Expect.cn: 两次都能打开交易 (电影式窗口中在窗口内, 经典窗口则在旁边), 关闭后会回到对话.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Title.en: Let's trade with an ordinary NPC

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Todo.en: Talk to a friendly NPC who isn't a trader and choose Let's trade. Do it once with A-Life's Cinematic talk window and once with Classic.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Todo.ch: 和一位不是商人的友善NPC交談, 選擇「來交易吧」. 用 A-Life 的電影式對話視窗試一次, 經典視窗再試一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_071_TradeTalk_Todo.cn: 和一位不是商人的友善NPC交谈, 选择“来交易吧”. 用 A-Life 的电影式对话窗口试一次, 经典窗口再试一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Expect.en: Near them: a note says they gave your kit back and it's in your inventory. Far away: the resident's kit goes into the base's stores (a weapon into the Weapons store) and a note says so.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Expect.ch: 在他們附近: 通知說他們已歸還你的裝備, 裝備在你的物品欄中. 離得很遠: 居民的裝備會放進基地倉庫 (武器放進武器倉庫), 並有通知說明.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Expect.cn: 在他们附近: 通知会说他们已把装备还给你, 装备就在你的物品栏里. 离得很远: 居民的装备会存进基地仓库 (武器存进武器仓库), 同时有通知提示.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Title.en: Kit comes back when the escort ends
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Title.ch: 護送結束時裝備會歸還
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Title.cn: 护送结束时装备会归还

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Todo.en: Lend something to a follower, then tell them to stop following (or let the order run out) and wait about a quarter of an hour of game time near them. Then do it again with a resident and walk far away before the follow ends.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Todo.ch: 借東西給一名跟隨者, 然後叫他們停止跟隨 (或讓命令時間結束), 在他們附近等大約遊戲時間一刻鐘. 然後對一位居民再做一次, 並在跟隨結束前走得遠遠的.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipAuto_Todo.cn: 借点东西给一名跟随者, 然后让他们停止跟随 (或者等命令到期), 在他们附近等大约游戏内一刻钟. 然后对一位居民再来一次, 并在跟随结束前走得远远的.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Expect.en: They hold the gun at once, the jacket shows on them, and the gun, jacket and food are listed as lent on their side; the rounds don't show (they went into the gun's spare rounds). No price is asked and your standing doesn't change.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Expect.ch: 他們立刻拿著槍, 外套穿在身上, 槍, 外套和食物在他們那一側列為借出; 子彈不會顯示 (已放進槍的備用彈藥). 不收任何費用, 你的信譽也不會改變.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Expect.cn: 他们立刻拿着枪, 外套穿在身上, 枪, 外套和食物在他们那一侧列为借出; 子弹不会显示 (已放进枪的备用弹药). 不收任何费用, 你的信誉也不会改变.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Title.en: Equip a follower for a trip
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Title.ch: 為外出的跟隨者準備裝備
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Title.cn: 为外出的跟随者准备装备

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Todo.en: Have a resident follow you. Right-click them > Equip (their name)... Move a gun and a box of its rounds, a jacket and a can of food into the Lend basket and press Equip.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Todo.ch: 讓一位居民跟隨你. 右鍵點選他們 > 裝備 (他們的名字)… 把一把槍與一盒對應子彈, 一件外套與一罐食物移到「借出」籃, 再按「裝備」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipLend_Todo.cn: 让一位居民跟随你. 右键点击他们 > 装备 (他们的名字)… 把一把枪和一盒对应子弹, 一件外套和一罐食物移到“借出”篮, 再按“装备”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Expect.en: The weapon leaves their hands within a minute when you take it back, for the other player too, and doesn't come back when they reappear. You hold exactly one, a moment after taking it back, worn as much as they wore it.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Expect.ch: 你收回武器後一分鐘內, 武器就會離開他們手上 (另一位玩家看到的也一樣), 他們重新出現時也不會再拿著. 收回後片刻, 你手上剛好只有一把, 磨損程度與他們使用的一樣.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Expect.cn: 你收回武器后一分钟内, 武器就会离开他们手上 (另一位玩家看到的也一样), 他们重新出现时也不会再拿着. 收回后片刻, 你手上刚好只有一把, 磨损程度和他们使用的一样.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Title.ch: 多人遊戲中借出的武器
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Title.cn: 多人游戏中借出的武器

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Todo.en: On a server, lend a melee weapon to a follower, let them fight with it for a while, take it back, then walk away until they're out of sight and come back. Ask another player to watch them.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Todo.ch: 在伺服器上, 借一把近戰武器給跟隨者, 讓他們用它戰鬥一陣子, 收回後走遠直到看不見他們, 再走回來. 請另一位玩家幫忙看著他們.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipMp_Todo.cn: 在服务器上, 借一把近战武器给跟随者, 让他们用它战斗一阵子, 收回后走远直到看不见他们, 再走回来. 请另一位玩家帮忙看着他们.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTake_Expect.en: The gun comes back as it was (its condition and the rounds loaded in it), then the rest you lent; the jacket comes off them (the escorting resident's too). Their own things are dimmed and can't be moved. A base weapon store pick doesn't swap out a weapon you lent while it's lent.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTake_Expect.ch: 槍會原樣歸還 (狀態與裝填的子彈), 接著是你借出的其他東西; 外套會從他們身上脫下 (護送中的居民也一樣). 他們自己的東西會變暗, 無法移動. 基地武器倉庫的挑選不會在借出期間換掉你借出的武器.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTake_Expect.cn: 枪会原样归还 (状态和装填的子弹), 接着是你借出的其他东西; 外套会从他们身上脱下 (护送中的居民也一样). 他们自己的东西会变暗, 无法移动. 基地武器仓库的挑选不会在借出期间换掉你借出的武器.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTake_Todo.en: Open Equip on them again. Move the gun into Take back and press Equip. Then press Return kit. Try to move one of their own weapons too. Then call a resident to you with a radio's Come to me, lend them a jacket and take it back while they're with you.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTake_Todo.ch: 再次對他們開啟「裝備」. 把槍移到「收回」, 按「裝備」. 接著按「歸還裝備」. 也試著移動他們自己的武器. 然後用無線電的「到我這裡來」叫一位居民過來, 借他們一件外套, 並在他們和你在一起時收回.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTake_Todo.cn: 再次对他们打开“装备”. 把枪移到“收回”, 按“装备”. 接着按“归还装备”. 也试着移动他们自己的武器. 然后用无线电的“到我这里来”叫一位居民过来, 借他们一件外套, 并在他们和你在一起时收回.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTalk_Expect.en: They answer and the Equip window opens (inside the talk window with A-Life 1.4's Cinematic window). Someone who isn't yours and isn't following you says no.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTalk_Expect.ch: 他們會回答, 並開啟「裝備」視窗 (在 A-Life 1.4 的電影式視窗中, 會在對話視窗內). 不是你的人, 也沒有跟隨你的人會拒絕.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTalk_Expect.cn: 他们会回答, 并打开“装备”窗口 (在 A-Life 1.4 的电影式窗口中, 会在对话窗口内). 不是你的人, 也没有跟随你的人会拒绝.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTalk_Todo.en: Talk to a resident and pick Gear up for this. on the Home tab. Then talk to a companion who isn't a resident while they follow you: it's on the Supplies tab.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTalk_Todo.ch: 和一位居民交談, 在「首頁」分頁選「準備好裝備.」. 然後在一位不是居民的同伴跟隨你時和他們交談: 選項在「物資」分頁.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EquipTalk_Todo.cn: 和一位居民交谈, 在“首页”标签页选“准备好装备.”. 然后在一位不是居民的同伴跟随你时和他们交谈: 选项在“物资”标签页.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EscortCallBack_Exp.en: Called back. shows, their status stops saying Escorting and they head back to their post. The entry isn't there for someone not escorting you.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EscortCallBack_Exp.ch: 顯示「已召回.」, 他們的狀態不再顯示「護送中」, 並返回自己的崗位. 沒有在護送你的人不會出現這個項目.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EscortCallBack_Exp.cn: 显示“已召回.”, 他们的状态不再显示“护送中”, 并返回自己的岗位. 没有在护送你的人不会出现这个项目.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EscortCallBack_Tod.en: With someone escorting you (My people > Escort me), right-click them > [A-Life Jimmy] > their name > Call back.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EscortCallBack_Tod.ch: 在有人護送你時 (我的人員 > 護送我), 右鍵點選他們 > [A-Life Jimmy] > 他們的名字 > 召回.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_EscortCallBack_Tod.cn: 在有人护送你时 (我的人员 > 护送我), 右键点击他们 > [A-Life Jimmy] > 他们的名字 > 召回.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupDisarm_Expec.en: Any spare weapons they carried lie at their feet. When you come back they're still empty-handed (bare hands), not holding a new weapon.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupDisarm_Expec.ch: 他們攜帶的備用武器都掉在腳邊. 你回來時他們仍然空手 (赤手空拳), 沒有拿著新武器.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupDisarm_Expec.cn: 他们携带的备用武器都掉在脚边. 你回来时他们仍然空手 (赤手空拳), 没有拿着新武器.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupDisarm_Todo.en: After taking someone's weapons (Q, or the talk window), look at their feet, then walk away until they're off screen (60 tiles or more) and come back to them.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupDisarm_Todo.ch: 收走某人的武器後 (按 Q 或用對話視窗), 看看他們腳邊, 然後走遠直到他們離開畫面 (60 格以上), 再回到他們身邊.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupDisarm_Todo.cn: 收走某人的武器后 (按 Q 或用对话窗口), 看看他们脚边, 然后走远直到他们离开画面 (60 格以上), 再回到他们身边.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Expect.en: First Q: you shout to drop the weapon and their weapons land in your inventory. Second Q: you shout to empty their pockets, their things land in your inventory and a few seconds later they run off. Further away, they ask you to come closer instead.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Expect.ch: 第一次按 Q: 你大喊要對方放下武器, 他們的武器落入你的物品欄. 第二次按 Q: 你大喊要對方掏空口袋, 他們的東西落入你的物品欄, 幾秒後他們逃走. 距離較遠時, 他們會改要你靠近一點.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Expect.cn: 第一次按 Q: 你大喊要对方放下武器, 他们的武器落入你的物品栏. 第二次按 Q: 你大喊要对方掏空口袋, 他们的东西落入你的物品栏, 几秒后他们逃走. 距离较远时, 他们会改为让你靠近一点.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Title.ch: Q: 先武器, 再口袋
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Title.cn: Q: 先武器, 再口袋

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Todo.en: With someone holding their hands up for you, close their talk window, step right up to them (3 tiles or closer), keep aiming and tap Q, wait 3 seconds, then tap Q again (within 6 seconds: once searched, they run off soon after).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Todo.ch: 在有人對你舉起雙手時, 關閉他們的對話視窗, 走到他們面前 (3 格以內), 持續瞄準並按一下 Q, 等 3 秒, 再按一次 Q (6 秒內: 搜身後他們很快就會逃走).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupFrisk_Todo.cn: 在有人对你举起双手时, 关闭他们的对话窗口, 走到他们面前 (3 格以内), 持续瞄准并按一下 Q, 等 3 秒, 再按一次 Q (6 秒内: 搜身后他们很快就会逃走).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupKilled_Expec.en: The console shows 'mercy: ... killed ... after they surrendered'; their faction standing drops and their squad swears revenge.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupKilled_Expec.ch: 主控台顯示 'mercy: ... killed ... after they surrendered'; 你在他們陣營中的信譽下降, 他們的小隊誓言復仇.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupKilled_Expec.cn: 控制台显示 'mercy: ... killed ... after they surrendered'; 你在他们阵营中的信誉下降, 他们的小队誓言复仇.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupKilled_Todo.en: Hold up someone from a squad and shoot them while their hands are up.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupKilled_Todo.ch: 脅迫某個小隊的成員, 並在他們舉手時開槍射擊.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupKilled_Todo.cn: 胁迫某个小队里的成员, 趁他们举着手时开枪打他们.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupMercy_Expect.en: The console shows 'hold-ups (1.4): ... let ... go (at_ease)' and a 'mercy: ... (kind): ...' line, and later 'mercy: ...'s release of ... came to: ...'. A good outcome raises their crew's standing; the friend outcome brings a notice.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupMercy_Expect.ch: 主控台顯示 'hold-ups (1.4): ... let ... go (at_ease)' 與一行 'mercy: ... (kind): ...', 稍後顯示 'mercy: ...'s release of ... came to: ...'. 好的結果會提高你在他們隊伍中的信譽; 結果是成為朋友時會跳出通知.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupMercy_Expect.cn: 控制台显示 'hold-ups (1.4): ... let ... go (at_ease)' 和一行 'mercy: ... (kind): ...', 稍后显示 'mercy: ...'s release of ... came to: ...'. 好的结果会提高你在他们队伍中的信誉; 结果是成为朋友时会弹出通知.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupMercy_Todo.en: Hold someone up (Q, or Hands up in the talk window), take nothing, then choose Lower your hands in their talk window. Wait half a game hour or walk 40 tiles off.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupMercy_Todo.ch: 脅迫某人 (按 Q, 或在對話視窗選「舉起手來」), 什麼都不拿, 然後在他們的對話視窗選「把手放下」. 等遊戲時間半小時, 或走開 40 格.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupMercy_Todo.cn: 胁迫某人 (按 Q, 或在对话窗口选“举起手来”), 什么都不拿, 然后在他们的对话窗口选“把手放下”. 等游戏时间半小时, 或走开 40 格.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupModes_Expect.en: Talk window only: Q is just the game's shout. Ours: our own hold-up (a hands-up roll, Right-click them to deal with them). The old option Our hold-ups on A-Life 1.4 is gone.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupModes_Expect.ch: 僅限對話視窗: Q 只是遊戲本身的大喊. 我們的版本: 我們自己的脅迫 (擲骰決定是否舉手, 右鍵點選他們來處置). 舊選項「A-Life 1.4 上使用我們的脅迫」已移除.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupModes_Expect.cn: 仅限对话窗口: Q 只是游戏本身的大喊. 我们的版本: 我们自己的胁迫 (掷骰决定是否举手, 右键点击他们来处置). 旧选项“A-Life 1.4 上使用我们的胁迫”已移除.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupModes_Todo.en: In the sandbox options (Jeem Extension - HOLD-UPS) set Hold-ups on A-Life 1.4 to Talk window only and tap Q while aiming at an NPC; then set it to Ours and do the same.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupModes_Todo.ch: 在沙盒選項 (Jeem 擴充 - 脅迫) 中把「A-Life 1.4 的脅迫」設為「僅限對話視窗」, 瞄準NPC時按 Q; 然後設為「我們的版本」再做一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupModes_Todo.cn: 在沙盒选项 (Jeem 扩展 - 胁迫) 中把“A-Life 1.4 的胁迫”设为“仅限对话窗口”, 瞄准NPC时按 Q; 然后设为“我们的版本”再做一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Expect.en: You shout a hands-up line at once and they answer with an A-Life line. If they put their hands up (crew-mates nearby may too), A-Life's talk window opens with them on its Orders tab, showing the captive orders (weapons, pockets, get out, lower your hands); a joypad can pick them straight away. Q again while it is open shouts again (they keep their hands up) and opens no second window. If they refuse or a fight starts, no window opens.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Expect.ch: 你立刻喊出一句要對方舉手的台詞, 對方以 A-Life 的台詞回應. 如果他們舉起雙手 (附近的隊友也可能跟著舉手), A-Life 的對話視窗會開啟並停在「命令」分頁, 顯示俘虜命令 (武器, 口袋, 滾開, 把手放下); 手把可以直接選取. 視窗開啟時再按 Q 會再喊一次 (他們維持舉手), 不會開第二個視窗. 如果他們拒絕或爆發戰鬥, 就不會開啟視窗.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Expect.cn: 你立刻喊出一句让对方举手的台词, 对方以 A-Life 的台词回应. 如果他们举起双手 (附近的队友也可能跟着举手), A-Life 的对话窗口会打开并停在“命令”标签页, 显示俘虏命令 (武器, 口袋, 滚开, 把手放下); 手柄可以直接选择. 窗口打开时再按 Q 会再喊一次 (他们保持举手), 不会打开第二个窗口. 如果他们拒绝或爆发战斗, 就不会打开窗口.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Title.en: Q: hands up, then the talk window on Orders (A-Life 1.4)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Title.ch: Q: 舉起手來, 然後對話視窗停在「命令」 (A-Life 1.4)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Title.cn: Q: 举起手来, 然后对话窗口停在“命令” (A-Life 1.4)

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Todo.en: On A-Life 1.4 with the default options, aim a gun at a neutral NPC within 6 tiles and tap Q (the shout key). If they put their hands up, keep aiming and tap Q again while their talk window is open. Try it once in each talk window style (Classic and Cinematic, A-Life's options), and once with a joypad if you have one.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Todo.ch: 在使用預設選項的 A-Life 1.4 上, 持槍瞄準 6 格內的中立NPC並按 Q (大喊鍵). 如果他們舉起雙手, 持續瞄準, 並在他們的對話視窗開啟時再按一次 Q. 每種對話視窗樣式各試一次 (經典與電影式, 在 A-Life 的選項中), 有手把的話再用手把試一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupQ_Todo.cn: 在使用默认选项的 A-Life 1.4 上, 持枪瞄准 6 格内的中立NPC并按 Q (大喊键). 如果他们举起双手, 持续瞄准, 并在他们的对话窗口打开时再按一次 Q. 每种对话窗口样式各试一次 (经典和电影式, 在 A-Life 的选项中), 有手柄的话再用手柄试一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Expe.en: After the refusal their crew treats you as hostile (their tag or talk window shows it), as our own hold-ups always did.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Expe.ch: 被拒絕後, 他們的隊伍會把你視為敵對 (他們的標籤或對話視窗會顯示), 就像我們自己的脅迫一向如此.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Expe.cn: 被拒绝后, 他们的队伍会把你视为敌对 (他们的标签或对话窗口会显示), 就像我们自己的胁迫一向如此.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Titl.en: A refused hold-up leaves a grudge

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Todo.en: Try Q (or Hands up) on police or soldiers until one refuses without starting a fight.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Todo.ch: 對警察或士兵按 Q (或「舉起手來」), 直到有人拒絕但沒有引發戰鬥.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRefused_Todo.cn: 对警察或士兵按 Q (或“举起手来”), 直到有人拒绝但没有引发战斗.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRobbed_Expec.en: They run off a few seconds later; the console shows 'hold-ups (1.4): ... go (flee)' and 'mercy: ... (harsh): ...'. No error popups.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRobbed_Expec.ch: 他們幾秒後逃走; 主控台顯示 'hold-ups (1.4): ... go (flee)' 與 'mercy: ... (harsh): ...'. 沒有錯誤彈出視窗.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRobbed_Expec.cn: 他们几秒后逃走; 控制台显示 'hold-ups (1.4): ... go (flee)' 和 'mercy: ... (harsh): ...'. 没有错误弹窗.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRobbed_Todo.en: Hold someone up and choose Empty your pockets in the talk window (or Hand it over on someone not yet held). Let them run off.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRobbed_Todo.ch: 脅迫某人, 在對話視窗選「把口袋掏空」 (對尚未被脅迫的人則選「交出來」). 讓他們逃走.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_HoldupRobbed_Todo.cn: 胁迫某人, 在对话窗口选“把口袋掏空” (对尚未被胁迫的人则选“交出来”). 让他们逃走.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Expect.en: The medic treats the one inside but doesn't go out to the one outside until the alarm is over.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Expect.ch: 醫護兵會治療室內的那位, 但要等警報解除後才會出去治療室外的那位.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Expect.cn: 医护兵会治疗屋里的那位, 但要等警报解除以后才会出门治疗外面那位.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Title.ch: 基地警報期間保持安全
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Title.cn: 基地警报期间保持安全

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Todo.en: Raise the base alarm (zombies at a building) while one resident is wounded outside and another inside.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Todo.ch: 在一位居民於室外受傷, 另一位於室內受傷時, 拉響基地警報 (殭屍出現在建築物旁).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicAlarm_Todo.cn: 在一名居民在室外受伤, 另一名在室内受伤时, 拉响基地警报 (让僵尸出现在建筑物旁).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Expect.en: A note says the medic is on the way; they come to you and treat your wounds one by one (bandaged, disinfected, stitched as needed), with a note for each, then a note that you're patched up. The entry isn't there when you aren't hurt.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Expect.ch: 通知說醫護兵正在趕來; 他們會來到你身邊, 逐一治療你的傷口 (視需要包紮, 消毒, 縫合), 每處都有通知, 最後通知你已處理好傷勢. 你沒受傷時不會出現這個項目.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Expect.cn: 通知会说医护兵正在赶来; 他们会走到你身边, 逐个处理你的伤口 (按需包扎, 消毒, 缝合), 每处都会提示, 最后提示你的伤已处理完毕. 你没受伤时不会出现这个选项.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Title.ch: 呼叫醫護兵來治療自己
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Title.cn: 呼叫医护兵来治疗自己

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Todo.en: Get hurt yourself (a fall, a scratch, a cut), then right-click and pick Call the medic. Stand still and watch your Health panel.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Todo.ch: 讓自己受傷 (摔落, 刮傷, 割傷), 然後按右鍵選「呼叫醫護兵」. 站著別動, 看著你的健康面板.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicCall_Todo.cn: 让自己受伤 (摔落, 刮伤, 割伤), 然后按右键选“呼叫医护兵”. 站着别动, 看着你的健康面板.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Expect.en: Once the fight is over the medic goes to the downed one first, helps them up (a dressing leaves the store) and then sees to the rest.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Expect.ch: 戰鬥一結束, 醫護兵會先去找倒地的人, 扶他們起來 (倉庫會少一份敷料), 再處理其他人.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Expect.cn: 战斗一结束, 医护兵会先去找倒地的人, 把他们扶起来 (仓库里会少一份敷料), 再去照顾其他人.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Title.en: Downed people are helped up first

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Todo.en: On A-Life 1.4, let a resident be knocked down in a fight at the base while another one is lightly hurt, with dressings in the Medical store.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Todo.ch: 在 A-Life 1.4 上, 讓一位居民在基地的戰鬥中被打倒, 另一位受輕傷, 醫療倉庫裡要有敷料.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicDowned_Todo.cn: 在 A-Life 1.4 上, 让一名居民在基地的战斗中被打倒, 另一名受点轻伤, 医疗仓库里需要备有敷料.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicMp_Expect.en: The medic walks and treats the same as in single player; the Medical store shows the items gone on both clients, and your own Health panel shows what the medic did to you.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicMp_Expect.ch: 醫護兵的行走與治療和單人遊戲相同; 兩個客戶端的醫療倉庫都顯示物品已消耗, 你自己的健康面板也顯示醫護兵對你做了哪些處理.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicMp_Expect.cn: 医护兵的行走和治疗与单人游戏相同; 两个客户端的医疗仓库都显示物品已消耗, 你自己的健康面板也显示医护兵对你做了哪些处理.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicMp_Todo.en: On a server, with the medic run by another player's game, repeat the first and third steps from both clients.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicMp_Todo.ch: 在伺服器上, 由另一位玩家的遊戲控制醫護兵, 從兩個客戶端重複第一與第三個步驟.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicMp_Todo.cn: 在服务器上, 由另一位玩家的游戏控制医护兵, 从两个客户端重复第一和第三个步骤.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOption_Expect.en: No medic walks over to the wounded, Call the medic isn't on the right-click menu, and Medic! isn't offered in conversations. Residents still bandage themselves and call for help as before.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOption_Expect.ch: 沒有醫護兵會走向傷者, 右鍵選單沒有「呼叫醫護兵」, 對話中也不會出現「醫護兵!」. 居民仍會像以前一樣自己包紮並呼救.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOption_Expect.cn: 没有医护兵会走向伤者, 右键菜单没有“呼叫医护兵”, 对话中也不会出现“医护兵!”. 居民仍会像以前一样自己包扎并呼救.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOption_Todo.en: Turn off the sandbox option Resident medics make rounds and load the world again.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOption_Todo.ch: 關閉沙盒選項「居民醫護兵巡診」, 然後重新載入世界.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOption_Todo.cn: 关闭沙盒选项“居民医护兵巡诊”, 然后重新加载世界.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOut_Expect.en: The medic doesn't walk over. A note says they're out of supplies and what the store needs; without a store, a note says to mark one. Each shows once, not over and over.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOut_Expect.ch: 醫護兵不會走過去. 通知會說他們沒有物資了, 以及倉庫需要什麼; 沒有倉庫時, 通知會要你標記一個. 每則只顯示一次, 不會一再出現.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOut_Expect.cn: 医护兵不会走过去. 通知会说他们没有物资了, 以及仓库需要什么; 没有仓库时, 通知会让你标记一个. 每条只显示一次, 不会反复出现.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOut_Todo.en: Empty the Medical store and get a resident wounded. Then remove the Medical store mark and do it again.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOut_Todo.ch: 清空醫療倉庫並讓一位居民受傷. 然後移除醫療倉庫標記, 再做一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicOut_Todo.cn: 把医疗仓库清空, 再让一名居民受伤. 然后去掉医疗仓库标记, 再来一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicTalk_Expect.en: The resident says they'll get the medic, who then comes; the medic answers they're right here; not hurt, they say you look alright. Talking to someone who doesn't live at your base gets A-Life's own answer.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicTalk_Expect.ch: 居民會說他們去找醫護兵, 接著醫護兵就會來; 醫護兵本人會回答他們就在這裡; 沒受傷時, 他們會說你看起來沒事. 和不住在你基地的人交談時, 會得到 A-Life 自己的回答.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicTalk_Expect.cn: 居民会说他们去找医护兵, 接着医护兵就会来; 医护兵本人会回答他们就在这里; 没受伤时, 他们会说你看起来没事. 和不住在你基地的人交谈时, 会得到 A-Life 自己的回答.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicTalk_Todo.en: While hurt, talk to one of your residents (not the medic) and pick Medic!. Then try it with the medic, and once when you're not hurt.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicTalk_Todo.ch: 受傷時, 和你的一位居民 (不是醫護兵) 交談並選「醫護兵!」. 然後對醫護兵試一次, 再在你沒受傷時試一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicTalk_Todo.cn: 受伤时, 和你的一位居民 (不是医护兵) 交谈并选“医护兵!”. 然后对医护兵试一次, 再在你没受伤时试一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Expect.en: Within a few seconds the medic walks over (runs to someone bleeding), says a line and treats one thing every few seconds, the bleeding first. The items leave the Medical store, and Medical Check on the patient shows the wounds dressed, stitched or splinted. Then the medic goes back to what they were doing.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Expect.ch: 幾秒內醫護兵就會走過來 (遇到流血的人會用跑的), 說一句台詞, 每隔幾秒處理一項傷勢, 先處理流血. 物品會從醫療倉庫扣除, 對傷者使用「醫療檢查」會看到傷口已包紮, 縫合或上了夾板. 之後醫護兵會回去做原本的事.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Expect.cn: 几秒内医护兵就会走过来 (遇到流血的人会跑过去), 说一句台词, 每隔几秒处理一项伤势, 先处理流血. 物品会从医疗仓库扣除, 对伤者使用“医疗检查”会看到伤口已包扎, 缝合或上了夹板. 之后医护兵会回去做原本的事.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Title.en: A medic treats the wounded at the base
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Title.ch: 醫護兵在基地治療傷者
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Title.cn: 医护兵在基地治疗伤者

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Todo.en: At a base with a resident who has the Medic specialty and a Medical store holding bandages, disinfectant, a suture needle, tweezers and a splint, get another resident wounded (zombies, or a scratch from you) and stay close.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Todo.ch: 在有一位具「醫護兵」專長的居民, 且醫療倉庫存有繃帶, 消毒劑, 縫合針, 鑷子和夾板的基地, 讓另一位居民受傷 (殭屍, 或被你刮傷), 並待在附近.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_MedicWalk_Todo.cn: 在有一位具有“医护兵”专长的居民, 且医疗仓库存有绷带, 消毒剂, 缝合针, 镊子和夹板的基地, 让另一位居民受伤 (僵尸, 或被你刮伤), 并待在附近.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Expect.en: The point buttons move Remembered and the standing by that much. After Clear opinions, From people is back to 0 for that faction (it can take until the window is opened again).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Expect.ch: 點數按鈕會讓「陣營記憶」和信譽變動相應的數值. 按「清除好感度」後, 該陣營的「來自成員」會歸 0 (可能要等到重新開啟視窗).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Expect.cn: 点数按钮会让“阵营记忆”和信誉变动相应的数值. 按“清除好感度”后, 该阵营的“来自成员”会归 0 (可能要等到重新打开窗口).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Title.ch: 管理員工具列仍可正常運作
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Title.cn: 管理员工具栏仍能正常运行

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Todo.en: Admin: on a faction, use the +10 and -10 buttons, then Clear opinions, then reopen Reputation.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Todo.ch: 管理員: 對一個陣營使用 +10 與 -10 按鈕, 然後按「清除好感度」, 再重新開啟「聲望」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepAdmin_Todo.cn: 管理员: 对一个阵营使用 +10 和 -10 按钮, 然后按“清除好感度”, 再重新打开“声望”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Expect.en: From people has gone down a few points (the one you hit and their crew think less of you). Remembered hasn't moved because of the hit.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Expect.ch: 「來自成員」下降了幾點 (被你打的人與他們的隊伍對你的評價變差). 「陣營記憶」沒有因為這一擊而變動.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Expect.cn: “来自成员”下降了几点 (被你打的人和他们的队伍对你的评价变差). “阵营记忆”没有因为这一击而变动.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Title.en: A hit counts through their people
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Title.ch: 攻擊會經由其成員計入
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Title.cn: 攻击会通过其成员计入

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Todo.en: Note a neutral faction's numbers in Reputation (not your own people). Hit one of its members once, back off, wait a few seconds and open Reputation again.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Todo.ch: 在「聲望」中記下一個中立陣營的數值 (不是你自己的人). 打該陣營的一名成員一下, 後退, 等幾秒, 再次開啟「聲望」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHit_Todo.cn: 在“声望”中记下一个中立阵营的数值 (不是你自己的人). 打该阵营的一名成员一下, 后退, 等几秒, 再次打开“声望”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Expe.en: They don't attack you and you can talk to them. The faction reads Friendly, with From people near 0 (their opinions were set to the level and count as part of it).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Expe.ch: 他們不會攻擊你, 你也能和他們交談. 該陣營顯示為友善, 「來自成員」接近 0 (他們的好感度已設為該等級, 並計入其中).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Expe.cn: 他们不会攻击你, 你也能和他们交谈. 该阵营显示为友善, “来自成员”接近 0 (他们的好感度已设为该等级, 并计入其中).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Titl.en: A faction hostile to strangers can be made friendly
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Titl.ch: 對陌生人敵對的陣營可以變為友善
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Titl.cn: 对陌生人敌对的阵营可以变为友善

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Todo.en: Admin: in Reputation's admin bar pick a faction that attacks strangers (raiders, bandits), Set my standing to Friendly, then walk up to its people.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Todo.ch: 管理員: 在「聲望」的管理員工具列選一個會攻擊陌生人的陣營 (掠奪者, 強盜), 把「設定我的信譽」設為友善, 然後走向該陣營的人.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepHostile_Todo.cn: 管理员: 在“声望”的管理员工具栏选一个会攻击陌生人的阵营 (掠夺者, 强盗), 把“设置我的信誉”设为友善, 然后走向该阵营的人.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Expect.en: The standing is the same as before: what the crew who left thought of you has moved from From people to Remembered.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Expect.ch: 信譽和之前相同: 離開的隊伍對你的評價已從「來自成員」移到「陣營記憶」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Expect.cn: 信誉和之前相同: 离开的队伍对你的评价已从“来自成员”移到“阵营记忆”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Title.ch: 成員離開後善意仍會保留
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Title.cn: 成员离开后善意仍会保留

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Todo.en: Get on good terms with a crew of a faction until From people shows a few points (help them fight zombies, give gifts). Then press Set it up (it notes your standings, and keeps them through a reload), walk far away until the crew is gone, or quit and load the save, and open Reputation.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Todo.ch: 和某陣營的一支隊伍打好關係, 直到「來自成員」顯示幾點 (幫他們打殭屍, 送禮物). 然後按「布置」 (它會記下你的信譽, 重新載入後仍保留), 走遠直到那支隊伍消失, 或退出後載入存檔, 再開啟「聲望」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepKept_Todo.cn: 和某阵营的一支队伍搞好关系, 直到“来自成员”显示几点 (帮他们打僵尸, 送礼物). 然后按“布置” (它会记下你的信誉, 重新加载后仍保留), 走远直到那支队伍消失, 或退出后加载存档, 再打开“声望”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOff_Expect.en: There is no breakdown line under a faction, and no standing jumped: what people felt is now part of Remembered. Standing works as it did before.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOff_Expect.ch: 陣營底下沒有細目行, 信譽也沒有突然跳動: 成員的觀感現在已併入「陣營記憶」. 信譽的運作和以前一樣.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOff_Expect.cn: 阵营下面没有明细行, 信誉也没有突然跳动: 成员的观感现在已并入“阵营记忆”. 信誉机制仍与以前相同.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOff_Todo.en: In the sandbox options (Jeem Extension - REPUTATION) turn One reputation off, load the save and open Reputation.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOff_Todo.ch: 在沙盒選項 (Jeem 擴充 - 聲望) 中關閉「統一聲望」, 載入存檔並開啟「聲望」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOff_Todo.cn: 在沙盒选项 (Jeem 扩展 - 声望) 中关闭“统一声望”, 加载存档并打开“声望”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOldSave_Expe.en: Every faction reads the same standing as before the update. From people starts at 0 and Remembered holds your old points; it moves only with what happens from now on.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOldSave_Expe.ch: 每個陣營的信譽都和更新前相同. 「來自成員」從 0 開始, 「陣營記憶」保有你原本的點數; 之後只會隨著今後發生的事變動.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOldSave_Expe.cn: 每个阵营的信誉都和更新前相同. “来自成员”从 0 开始, “阵营记忆”保留你原来的点数; 之后只会随着今后发生的事变动.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOldSave_Todo.en: Load a save made with an earlier version on A-Life 1.4 where you already have standing with some factions, and open Reputation. Then Run test.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOldSave_Todo.ch: 載入一個在 A-Life 1.4 上用舊版建立, 且你已和部分陣營有信譽的存檔, 開啟「聲望」. 然後按「執行測試」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepOldSave_Todo.cn: 加载一个在 A-Life 1.4 上用旧版创建, 且你已和部分阵营有信誉的存档, 打开“声望”. 然后按“运行测试”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Expect.en: The first line under the faction says how much of its standing comes from its people, how much the faction remembers and how much from rumours. The number beside the bar is those three added up, and the list of its people follows.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Expect.ch: 陣營底下第一行會說明它的信譽有多少來自其成員, 多少是陣營記得的, 多少來自傳聞. 進度條旁的數字是這三者的總和, 接著列出該陣營的成員.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Expect.cn: 阵营下面第一行会说明它的信誉有多少来自其成员, 多少是阵营记得的, 多少来自传闻. 进度条旁的数字是这三者的总和, 接着列出该阵营的成员.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Title.en: One reputation: what your standing is made of (A-Life 1.4)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Title.ch: 統一聲望: 你的信譽由什麼組成 (A-Life 1.4)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Title.cn: 统一声望: 你的信誉由什么组成 (A-Life 1.4)

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Todo.en: On A-Life 1.4, open My people > Reputation and click the name of a faction you have dealt with to open it.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Todo.ch: 在 A-Life 1.4 上, 開啟「我的人員 > 聲望」, 點選你打過交道的陣營名稱來展開它.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_OneRepParts_Todo.cn: 在 A-Life 1.4 上, 打开“我的人员 > 声望”, 点击你打过交道的阵营名称来展开它.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Expect.en: They answer with their names and the minutes, later say they're close, then appear out of sight about 40 tiles away and walk up to follow you. The guards stayed at their posts. After Head home they stop following and go back to the base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Expect.ch: 他們會報上名字與所需分鐘數, 稍後說他們快到了, 接著在約 40 格外的視線外出現, 走過來跟隨你. 警衛留在崗位上. 按「回基地」後, 他們停止跟隨並返回基地.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Expect.cn: 他们会报上名字和所需分钟数, 稍后说他们快到了, 接着在约 40 格外的视线外出现, 走过来跟随你. 警卫留在岗位上. 按“回基地”后, 他们停止跟随并返回基地.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Title.ch: 無線電: 到我這裡來
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Title.cn: 无线电: 到我这里来

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Todo.en: A few hundred tiles from the base, call Come to me > Send 2 people. Stay where you are and wait the minutes they give (sleeping or fast-forward is fine). Afterwards call Head home.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Todo.ch: 在距離基地幾百格處, 呼叫「到我這裡來 > 派 2 人」. 待在原地, 等他們給的分鐘數 (睡覺或快轉都可以). 之後呼叫「回基地」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioCome_Todo.cn: 在距离基地几百格处, 呼叫“到我这里来 > 派 2 人”. 待在原地, 等他们给的分钟数 (睡觉或快进都可以). 之后呼叫“回基地”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioMp_Expect.en: Your bases don't show up for them. The people you call come to you, not to them. Each player sees the chatter in their own language.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioMp_Expect.ch: 他們看不到你的基地. 你呼叫的人會來到你身邊, 而不是他們身邊. 每位玩家看到的無線電通話都是自己的語言.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioMp_Expect.cn: 他们看不到你的基地. 你呼叫的人会赶到你身边, 而不是他们那边. 每位玩家看到的无线电通话都是各自的语言.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioMp_Todo.en: On a server, a second player who doesn't live at your base opens Call your people on their walkie-talkie. You call Come to me from far away.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioMp_Todo.ch: 在伺服器上, 讓不住在你基地的第二位玩家用他們的對講機開啟「呼叫你的人」. 你從遠處呼叫「到我這裡來」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioMp_Todo.cn: 在服务器上, 让不住在你基地的第二位玩家用他们的对讲机打开“呼叫你的人”. 你从远处呼叫“到我这里来”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioOrders_Expect.en: On the alarm everyone at home gets up, sleepers included, and the News says you sounded it over the radio. After Stand down they go back to what they were doing within a few minutes. Hold the base gets everyone up where they are, and they stay up for about an hour.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioOrders_Expect.ch: 警報一響, 所有在基地的人都會起來, 包括睡著的人, 「消息」也會說你用無線電拉響了警報. 按「解除戒備」後, 他們會在幾分鐘內回去做原本的事. 「固守基地」會讓所有人就地起身, 並保持清醒約一小時.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RadioStatus_Todo.cn: 在有人住在基地的情况下, 带着一台已开启且有电池的对讲机走到几百格外. 右键点击它 > 呼叫你的人 > 状态汇报 (所有基地). 然后关闭无线电, 再右键点击一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RelayCensus_Title.cn: 居民不再是管理员生成

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_ResOrders_Todo.en: Talk to one of your residents and open the Orders tab. Pick Follow me, walk a bit, talk again and pick Wait here, then Back to work. Start an escort (My people > Escort me), talk to them and pick That's all, head back.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_ResOrders_Todo.ch: 和你的一位居民交談並開啟「命令」分頁. 選「跟我來」, 走一小段, 再交談並選「在這裡等」, 然後選「回去工作」. 開始護送 (我的人員 > 護送我), 和他們交談並選「就這樣, 回去吧.」.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtBox_Expect.cn: 东西从容器中消失了; 袋子还在, 里面的东西也都在. 交易窗口显示基地在他们那里有信用额度, 信用额度会补足差额, 让他们接受这笔交易.

Then open the Trade window and ask for something worth a little more than you offer.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtBox_Todo.ch: 在「交易貨品」容器中放幾樣他們想要的東西 (交易視窗會列出他們最想收購的物品), 再放一個裝了東西的袋子, 走到 3 格外並等遊戲時間 10 分鐘. 然後開啟交易視窗, 要一樣價值比你出價略高的東西.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtShop_Todo.en: Let's trade with the trader. Buy something and pay with something as good as new (a full can, a tool in good condition). Come back after the sandbox's restock hours (24 by default).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtShop_Todo.ch: 對商人選「來交易吧」. 買一樣東西, 用近乎全新的東西付款 (滿的罐頭, 狀態良好的工具). 過了沙盒的補貨時數 (預設 24) 後再回來.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtShop_Todo.cn: 对商人选“来交易吧”. 买一样东西, 用近乎全新的东西付款 (满的罐头, 状态良好的工具). 过了沙盒的补货时数 (默认 24) 后再回来.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStall_Expect.en: By day (on the schedule: their Free and Guard shifts) they stand beside the Trade goods container and the hover says Trading at the stall; at night they go to bed. With the alarm they leave the stall like everyone else and come back after.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStall_Expect.ch: 白天 (依排班表: 他們的自由時間與警戒班次) 他們站在「交易貨品」容器旁, 懸停顯示「在攤位交易」; 晚上他們上床睡覺. 警報響起時他們會和其他人一樣離開攤位, 之後再回來.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStall_Expect.cn: 白天 (按排班表: 他们的自由时间和警戒班次) 他们站在“交易货品”容器旁, 悬停显示“在摊位交易”; 晚上他们上床睡觉. 警报响起时他们会和其他人一样离开摊位, 之后再回来.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStall_Todo.en: Mark a container in the base as Store > Trade goods. Watch the trader by day and at night (wait or sleep through), and sound the base alarm once.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStall_Todo.ch: 把基地中的一個容器標記為「倉庫 > 交易貨品」. 白天與夜間觀察商人 (等待或睡過去), 並拉響一次基地警報.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStall_Todo.cn: 把基地中的一个容器标记为“仓库 > 交易货品”. 白天和夜间观察商人 (等待或睡过去), 并拉响一次基地警报.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Expect.en: They agree. A News line says they moved in and set up a stall, the base has 10 supplies less, and their guards walk off. The trader is in My people as a resident and walks into the base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Expect.ch: 他們同意了. 「消息」會有一行說他們搬進來並擺了攤位, 基地少了 10 物資, 他們的警衛則離開. 商人會以居民身分出現在「我的人員」中, 並走進基地.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Expect.cn: 他们同意了. “消息”会有一行说他们搬进来并摆了摊位, 基地少了 10 物资, 他们的警卫则离开. 商人会以居民身份出现在“我的人员”中, 并走进基地.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Title.en: A trader stays at your base

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Todo.en: Have a base with quarters, a free bed in them and at least 10 supplies. Use Set it up (or wait for a visit). Trade with the trader once (on A-Life 1.4 with its opinion on: get them to like you instead, a gift helps), make sure their faction is friendly with you, then talk to the trader: Would you stay with us?
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Todo.ch: 準備一個有宿舍, 宿舍裡有空床, 且至少有 10 物資的基地. 按「布置」 (或等商人來訪). 和商人交易一次 (在開啟好感度的 A-Life 1.4 上: 改為讓他們喜歡你, 送禮有幫助), 確認他們的陣營對你友善, 然後對商人說: 你願意留下來跟我們一起嗎?
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtStay_Todo.cn: 准备一个有宿舍, 宿舍里有空床, 且至少有 10 物资的基地. 按“布置” (或等商人来访). 和商人交易一次 (在开启好感度的 A-Life 1.4 上: 改为让他们喜欢你, 送礼有帮助), 确认他们的阵营对你友善, 然后对商人说: 你愿意留下来跟我们一起吗?

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtSurplus_Expect.en: Up to 10 things an hour leave the Food store, never taking it under 20, and the base's credit with them grows. After Stop nothing more leaves.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtSurplus_Expect.ch: 每小時最多有 10 樣東西離開食物倉庫, 庫存不會低於 20, 基地在他們那裡的信用額度會增加. 按「停止」後就不會再有東西離開.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtSurplus_Expect.cn: 每小时最多有 10 样东西离开食物仓库, 库存不会低于 20, 基地在他们那里的信用额度会增加. 按“停止”后就不会再有东西离开.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtSurplus_Todo.en: Put more than 20 food items in a Food store. Tell the trader: Sell what we can spare. Stay away from the store for an hour, then tell them: Stop selling our stores.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtSurplus_Todo.ch: 在食物倉庫中放超過 20 件食物. 對商人說: 把我們用不到的賣掉. 離倉庫遠一點待一小時, 然後對他們說: 別再賣倉庫的東西了.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_RtSurplus_Todo.cn: 往食物仓库里放超过 20 件食物. 对商人说: 把我们用不到的卖掉. 离仓库远一点待上一小时, 然后对他们说: 别再卖仓库的东西了.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Expect.en: Cinematic: the grid goes and the talk rows come back. Classic: the Trade window closes and the talk window is in front. From the right-click: the Trade window closes and the conversation opens with them (standing close enough to talk). The window's X only closes it.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Expect.ch: 電影式: 網格消失, 對話列回來. 經典: 交易視窗關閉, 對話視窗在最前面. 從右鍵選單: 交易視窗關閉, 並開啟和他們的對話 (要站得夠近才能交談). 視窗的 X 只會關閉視窗.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Expect.cn: 电影式: 网格消失, 对话行回来. 经典: 交易窗口关闭, 对话窗口在最前面. 从右键菜单: 交易窗口关闭, 并打开和他们的对话 (要站得够近才能交谈). 窗口的 X 只会关闭窗口.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Title.en: Back to talk from the grid

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Todo.en: Open the trade grid from the conversation and press Back to talk (Cinematic and Classic). Then close the conversation, right-click the NPC > Trade with..., and press Back to talk there.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Todo.ch: 從對話開啟交易網格, 按「返回對話」 (電影式與經典). 然後關閉對話, 右鍵點選NPC > 和…交易, 並在那裡按「返回對話」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkBack_Todo.cn: 从对话打开交易网格, 按“返回对话” (电影式和经典). 然后关闭对话, 右键点击NPC > 和…交易, 并在那里按“返回对话”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkQuick_Expect.en: Your own people and followers: Equip beside Leave, which says Gear up for this. and opens the Equip grid (inside the Cinematic window, beside the Classic one). A neutral or friendly NPC: Trade, which says Let's trade. and opens the trade grid. Someone hostile: no button, Leave the whole row. The button looks like the window's own and is greyed while they answer.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkQuick_Expect.ch: 自己人與跟隨者: 「離開」旁有「裝備」, 會說「準備好裝備.」並開啟裝備網格 (電影式在視窗內, 經典則在旁邊). 中立或友善NPC: 「交易」, 會說「來交易吧.」並開啟交易網格. 敵對的人: 沒有按鈕, 「離開」占滿整列. 按鈕外觀和視窗原有的一樣, 在他們回答時呈灰色.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkQuick_Expect.cn: 自己人和跟随者: “离开”旁有“装备”, 会说“准备好装备.”并打开装备网格 (电影式在窗口内, 经典则在旁边). 中立或友善NPC: “交易”, 会说“来交易吧.”并打开交易网格. 敌对的人: 没有按钮, “离开”占满整行. 按钮外观和窗口原有的一样, 在他们回答时呈灰色.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkQuick_Todo.en: Talk to a resident or someone following you, in the Cinematic and then the Classic talk window (A-Life's menu: talk style). Then talk to a neutral or friendly NPC, then a hostile one. Click the button beside Leave each time it's there.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkQuick_Todo.ch: 在電影式, 然後在經典對話視窗 (A-Life 選單: 對話樣式) 中, 和一位居民或跟隨你的人交談. 然後和一位中立或友善NPC交談, 再和一位敵對NPC交談. 每次有按鈕時, 點選「離開」旁的按鈕.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TalkQuick_Todo.cn: 在电影式, 然后在经典对话窗口 (A-Life 菜单: 对话样式) 中, 和一位居民或跟随你的人交谈. 然后和一位中立或友善NPC交谈, 再和一位敌对NPC交谈. 每次有按钮时, 点击“离开”旁的按钮.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Expec.en: What they'd trade comes first, then their weapon, the clothes they wear, their bag and ID card greyed with (not for trade); hovering one says why, and it never goes into the basket. The tool shows greyed at once, given or traded to them; food you gave isn't listed. The trade itself works as before.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Expec.ch: 他們會交易的東西排在最前面, 接著是武器, 身上穿的衣服, 包包和身分證, 呈灰色並標示 (不可交易); 懸停在其中一項上會說明原因, 而且它絕不會進入交易籃. 工具不論是給他們或和他們交易, 都會立刻顯示為灰色; 你給的食物不會列出. 交易本身和以前一樣運作.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Expec.cn: 他们会交易的东西排在最前面, 接着是武器, 身上穿的衣服, 包和身份证, 呈灰色并标示 (不可交易); 悬停在其中一项上会说明原因, 而且它绝不会进入交易篮. 工具不论是给他们还是和他们交易, 都会立刻显示为灰色; 你给的食物不会列出. 交易本身仍与以前相同.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Title.en: The Trade window shows everything they carry
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Title.ch: 交易視窗會顯示他們攜帶的所有東西
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Title.cn: 交易窗口会显示他们携带的所有东西

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Todo.en: Open the Trade window with an armed NPC who isn't one of yours. Look at their side, hover a greyed row and try to add it to the basket. Then give them a tool (not food), and trade them something for one of their things.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Todo.ch: 和一位不是你的人, 且持有武器的NPC開啟交易視窗. 檢視他們那一側, 懸停在呈灰色的列上, 並試著把它加入交易籃. 然後給他們一件工具 (不是食物), 再用你的東西和他們交易換取他們的一樣東西.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_073_TradeBlocked_Todo.cn: 和一位不是你的人, 且持有武器的NPC打开交易窗口. 查看他们那一侧, 悬停在呈灰色的行上, 并试着把它加入交易篮. 然后给他们一件工具 (不是食物), 再用你的东西和他们交易换取他们的一样东西.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AllDone.en: Run all done: %1 passed, %2 failed, %3 left for you.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AllDone.ch: 全部執行完成: %1 項合格, %2 項失敗, %3 項留給你.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AllDone.cn: 全部运行完成: %1 项通过, %2 项失败, %3 项留给你.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AllProgress.ch: 全部執行: 第 %1 項, 共 %2 項 - %3
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AllProgress.cn: 全部运行: 第 %1 项, 共 %2 项 - %3

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AutoWhySetup.en: its Set it up changes the world: Set it up there, then Run test (Run all runs it too on a test save)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AutoWhySetup.ch: 它的「布置」會改變世界: 先在那裡按「布置」, 再按「執行測試」 (在測試存檔上「全部執行」也會執行它)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AutoWhySetup.cn: 它的“布置”会改变世界: 先在那里按“布置”, 再按“运行测试” (在测试存档上“全部运行”也会运行它)

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AutoWhyYou.en: its test needs you to do the step: Run test there
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AutoWhyYou.ch: 它的測試需要你親自完成步驟: 在那裡按「執行測試」
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_AutoWhyYou.cn: 它的测试需要你亲自完成步骤: 在那里按“运行测试”

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Busy.en: Something is still running: wait for it, or press Stop.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Busy.ch: 仍有項目在執行中: 請等它完成, 或按「停止」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Busy.cn: 仍有项目在运行中: 请等它完成, 或按“停止”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Alarm.en: the alarm is up for the residents at home, the News has the alarm line, and nobody it's up for still lies asleep.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Alarm.ch: 在基地的居民已進入警報狀態, 「消息」有警報那一行, 而且已進入警報狀態的人沒有人還躺著睡覺.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Alarm.cn: 在基地的居民已进入警报状态, “消息”有警报那一行, 而且已进入警报状态的人没有人还躺着睡觉.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Beds.en: residents in their sleep time lie asleep on their own bed, and nobody's task says Asleep before they lie down.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Beds.ch: 處於睡眠時段的居民躺在自己的床上睡覺, 而且沒有人在躺下前目前活動就顯示「睡眠中」.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Beds.cn: 处于睡眠时段的居民躺在自己的床上睡觉, 而且没有人在躺下前当前活动就显示“睡眠中”.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Caffeine.en: the resident made tired is at least 10 points less tired.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Caffeine.ch: 被弄得疲勞的居民疲勞至少減少 10 點.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Caffeine.cn: 被弄累的居民疲劳至少降低了 10 点.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_CreatorName.en: an NPC near you from a Set name preset shows that name.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_CreatorName.ch: 你附近一個由「指定名字」預設生成的NPC會顯示該名字.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_CreatorName.cn: 你附近一个由“指定名字”预设生成的NPC会显示该名字.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Disarmed.en: whoever you disarmed near you is still empty-handed.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Disarmed.ch: 你附近被你繳械的人仍然空手.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Disarmed.cn: 你附近被你缴械的人仍然空手.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_EquipBack.en: someone seen carrying kit you lent is near you without it, and nobody near you still carries any (run it once while they still carry it, or the lend step's test first).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_EquipBack.ch: 曾被看到攜帶你借出裝備的人在你附近且已不帶著它, 你附近也沒有人還帶著任何借出裝備 (先在他們還帶著時執行一次, 或先執行借出步驟的測試).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_EquipBack.cn: 曾被看到携带你借出装备的人在你附近且已不带着它, 你附近也没有人还带着任何借出装备 (先在他们还带着时运行一次, 或先运行借出步骤的测试).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_EquipLent.en: someone near you carries kit you lent them.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_EquipLent.ch: 你附近有人攜帶你借給他們的裝備.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_EquipLent.cn: 你附近有人携带你借给他们的装备.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Escort.en: whoever follows you stays within 8 tiles most of the time while you walk at least 20 tiles.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Escort.ch: 在你至少走 20 格的期間, 跟隨你的人大部分時間都待在 8 格內.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Escort.cn: 在你走了至少 20 格的过程中, 跟随你的人大多数时候都在 8 格以内.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Features.en: every feature that's switched on installed, with no missing hook or error (here and on the server).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Features.ch: 每個已開啟的功能都已安裝, 沒有缺少掛鉤或錯誤 (本機與伺服器上皆然).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Features.cn: 每个已开启的功能都已安装, 没有缺少挂钩或错误 (本地和服务器上都是).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_HouseBase.en: your nearest base has grounds, a Main building and quarters.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_HouseBase.ch: 你最近的基地有場地, 主建築與宿舍.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_HouseBase.cn: 你最近的基地有场地, 主建筑和宿舍.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Lost.en: everyone your nearest base lists at home is at the base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Lost.ch: 你最近的基地列為在基地的每個人都在基地.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_Lost.cn: 你最近的基地中列为在家的每个人都在基地里.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_MedicMe.en: more of your body is bandaged than at Set it up.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_MedicMe.ch: 你身上包紮的部位比按「布置」時更多.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_MedicMe.cn: 你身上包扎的部位比按“布置”时更多.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_MedicTreated.en: the resident wounded at Set it up has more wounds treated than before.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_MedicTreated.ch: 按「布置」時受傷的居民, 已治療的傷口比之前多.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_MedicTreated.cn: 按“布置”时受伤的居民, 已治疗的伤口比之前多.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_NightLights.en: at night no resident near you keeps a flashlight on inside one of their base's buildings (on its floor), asleep or sitting.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_NightLights.ch: 夜間, 你附近的居民在自己基地的建築物內 (對應樓層)、睡著或坐著時, 都不會開著手電筒.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_NightLights.cn: 夜间, 你附近的居民在自己基地的建筑物内 (对应楼层)、睡着或坐着时, 都不会开着手电筒.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_NoAim.en: no resident near you turns on you while you walk past them.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_NoAim.ch: 你走過居民身邊時, 附近沒有居民對你做出敵對舉動.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_NoAim.cn: 你走过居民身边时, 附近没有居民对你做出敌对举动.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_OneRepCarried.en: on the loaded older save, one reputation is on and every faction's standing is its three parts added up.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_OneRepCarried.ch: 在載入的舊存檔上, 統一聲望已開啟, 而且每個陣營的信譽都是其三個部分的總和.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Check_OneRepCarried.cn: 在加载的旧存档上, 统一声望已开启, 而且每个阵营的信誉都是其三个部分的总和.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_SetupSent.en: Asked the server: its note says what it did.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_SetupSent.ch: 已向伺服器請求: 它的備註會說明做了什麼.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_SetupSent.cn: 已向服务器发出请求: 它的备注会说明做了什么.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Away.en: Teleports you 300 tiles east of your nearest base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Away.ch: 將你傳送到最近基地以東 300 格處.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Away.cn: 将你传送到最近基地以东 300 格处.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_CallMedic.en: Calls the medic to you, as the right-click Call the medic does.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_CallMedic.ch: 把醫護兵叫到你身邊, 效果與右鍵選單的「呼叫醫護兵」相同.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_CallMedic.cn: 把医护兵叫到你身边, 效果与右键菜单的“呼叫医护兵”相同.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Calm.en: Removes the hostile group the release check spawned and ends the base alarm at your nearest base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Calm.ch: 移除新版檢查生成的敵對團體, 並解除你最近基地的警報.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Calm.cn: 移除新版检查生成的敌对团体, 并解除你最近基地的警报.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_CreatorNpc.en: Spawns an NPC from your first NPC Creation preset set to Set name (none: in single player, a preset made for the test, gone again after it), near you outside any base, and waits for them.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_CreatorNpc.ch: 在你附近、任何基地之外, 從你第一個名字設為 指定名字 (Set name) 的NPC建立 (NPC Creation) 預設生成一名NPC (若沒有: 在單人模式中會建立一個測試用預設, 測試結束後移除), 並等待對方抵達.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_CreatorNpc.cn: 在你附近、任何基地之外, 用你第一个名字设为 指定名字 (Set name) 的NPC创建 (NPC Creation) 预设生成一名NPC (若没有: 在单人模式中会创建一个测试用预设, 测试结束后删除), 并等待对方到达.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Day.en: Sets the clock to 10:00 (traders' hours, the stall's day).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Day.ch: 將時間調到 10:00 (商人營業時段, 攤位的白天).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Day.cn: 将时间调到 10:00 (商人营业时段, 摊位的白天).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_DownResident.en: Knocks down another resident near you (A-Life 1.4's downed state).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_DownResident.ch: 將你附近的另一名居民擊倒 (A-Life 1.4 的倒地狀態).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_DownResident.cn: 将你附近的另一名居民击倒 (A-Life 1.4 的倒地状态).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_DryGun.en: Empties the gun of the resident with one nearest you, puts boxes of its rounds in the base's Ammo store (none: the first store holds ammo too), and lets their next top-up come at once.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_DryGun.ch: 清空離你最近、持有槍械的居民的槍, 將盒裝的對應子彈放進基地的彈藥倉庫 (若沒有: 第一個倉庫也存放彈藥), 並讓該名居民的下一次補給立即到來.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_DryGun.cn: 清空离你最近、持有枪械的居民的枪, 将盒装的对应子弹放进基地的弹药仓库 (若没有: 第一个仓库也存放弹药), 并让该居民的下一次补给立即到来.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_EquipKit.en: Gives you a loaded pistol, a box of its rounds, a jacket and a can of beans to lend.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_EquipKit.ch: 給你一把已上膛的手槍、一盒對應子彈、一件夾克和一個黃豆罐頭, 用來借出.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_EquipKit.cn: 给你一把已上膛的手枪、一盒对应子弹、一件夹克和一个黄豆罐头, 用于借出.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Follow.en: The resident nearest you starts following you.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Follow.ch: 離你最近的居民開始跟隨你.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Follow.cn: 离你最近的居民开始跟随你.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Gun.en: Gives you a loaded pistol and a box of its rounds.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Gun.ch: 給你一把已上膛的手槍和一盒對應子彈.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Gun.cn: 给你一把已上膛的手枪和一盒对应子弹.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Home.en: Teleports you to your nearest base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Home.ch: 將你傳送到最近的基地.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Home.cn: 将你传送到最近的基地.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Hostiles.en: Spawns three hostile people 30 tiles outside your nearest base, coming for it.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Hostiles.ch: 在你最近基地外 30 格處生成三名敵對人員, 朝基地進逼.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Hostiles.cn: 在你最近基地外 30 格处生成三名敌对人员, 朝基地逼近.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_MakeMedic.en: Makes a resident at your nearest base its medic (A-Life's Medic specialty).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_MakeMedic.ch: 讓你最近基地的一名居民成為醫護兵 (A-Life 的醫護兵專長).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_MakeMedic.cn: 让你最近基地的一名居民成为医护兵 (A-Life 的医护兵专长).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_MedicalStore.en: Puts bandages, disinfectant, suture needles, tweezers and a splint in your nearest base's Medical store (none: the first store holds medical goods too).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_MedicalStore.ch: 在你最近基地的醫療倉庫放入繃帶、消毒劑、縫合針、鑷子和夾板 (若沒有: 第一個倉庫也存放醫療貨品).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_MedicalStore.cn: 在你最近基地的医疗仓库放入绷带、消毒剂、缝合针、镊子和夹板 (若没有: 第一个仓库也存放医疗物品).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_NeutralNpc.en: Spawns one neutral NPC near you, outside any base (A-Life spawns nobody inside one), and waits for them to arrive.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_NeutralNpc.ch: 在你附近、任何基地之外生成一名中立NPC (A-Life 不會在基地內生成任何人), 並等待對方抵達.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_NeutralNpc.cn: 在你附近、任何基地之外生成一名中立NPC (A-Life 不会在基地内生成任何人), 并等待对方到达.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Quarters.en: Makes the rooms with beds in your nearest base's Main building its quarters, if it has none, and gives the residents their beds.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Quarters.ch: 若你最近的基地還沒有宿舍, 就把主建築中有床的房間設為宿舍, 並為居民分配床位.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Quarters.cn: 若你最近的基地还没有宿舍, 就把主建筑中有床的房间设为宿舍, 并为居民分配床位.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Radio.en: Gives you a military walkie-talkie, switched on, with a battery.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Radio.ch: 給你一具已開機、裝有電池的軍用對講機.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Radio.cn: 给你一部已开机、装有电池的军用对讲机.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_RepSnapshot.en: Notes your standing with every faction (kept through quitting and loading), for the test to compare. Press it once you're where the step starts.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_RepSnapshot.ch: 記下你與每個陣營的信譽 (退出並讀檔後仍保留), 供測試比對. 到達該步驟的起點後再按下.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_RepSnapshot.cn: 记下你与每个阵营的信誉 (退出并读档后仍保留), 供测试比对. 到达该步骤的起点后再按下.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Standing.en: Gives you some standing with the faction of the nearest NPC who isn't yours (else any faction), with the admin nudge.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Standing.ch: 透過管理員微調, 讓你在最近一名非己方NPC的陣營 (否則為任一陣營) 中獲得一些信譽.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Standing.cn: 通过管理员微调, 让你在最近一名非己方NPC的阵营 (否则为任意阵营) 中获得一些信誉.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_TestBase.en: Builds the test base around the building you stand in (Main, quarters, posts, stores) and brings in a crew who move in (the scenario test's setup; a test save).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_TestBase.ch: 在你所在的建築周圍建立測試基地 (主建築、宿舍、崗哨、倉庫), 並帶來一支入住的隊伍 (情境測試的布置; 測試用存檔).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_TestBase.cn: 在你所在的建筑周围建立测试基地 (主建筑、宿舍、岗哨、仓库), 并带来一支入住的队伍 (情景测试的布置; 测试用存档).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Tired.en: Makes the resident nearest you very tired and notes how tired (Self-test > Undo self-test changes puts it back).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Tired.ch: 讓離你最近的居民變得非常疲勞, 並記下疲勞程度 (自我測試 > 復原自我測試變更 可還原).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Tired.cn: 让离你最近的居民变得非常疲劳, 并记下疲劳程度 (自检 > 撤销自检更改 可还原).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_ToNeutral.en: Puts you beside the neutral NPC the setup before spawned.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_ToNeutral.ch: 把你放到上一個布置步驟生成的中立NPC旁邊.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_ToNeutral.cn: 把你放到上一个布置步骤生成的中立NPC旁边.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_TraderStay.en: Waits for the visiting party's trader, and has them stay at your nearest base as if they'd said yes (a bed made for them if it's full). Without a Trade goods store their stall is in the Main building.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_TraderStay.ch: 等待來訪隊伍的商人抵達, 並讓對方如同答應了一般留在你最近的基地 (若床位已滿會為其準備一張床). 若沒有交易貨品倉庫, 攤位會設在主建築內.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_TraderStay.cn: 等待来访队伍的商人到达, 并让对方如同答应了一般留在你最近的基地 (若床位已满会为其准备一张床). 若没有交易货品仓库, 摊位会设在主建筑内.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Traders.en: Sends a trader party to your nearest base now.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Traders.ch: 立刻派一支商人隊前往你最近的基地.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Traders.cn: 立刻派一支商人队前往你最近的基地.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Vitamins.ch: 給你維他命 (咖啡因藥丸).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Vitamins.cn: 给你维生素 (咖啡因药丸).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_WoundResident.en: Gives the resident nearest you (not the medic) a cut on an arm (with A-Life 1.4's own wounds: single player only).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_WoundResident.ch: 讓離你最近的居民 (醫護兵除外) 手臂受一道割傷 (使用 A-Life 1.4 本身的傷口: 僅限單人模式).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_WoundResident.cn: 让离你最近的居民 (医护兵除外) 手臂受一道割伤 (使用 A-Life 1.4 自身的伤口: 仅限单人模式).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Zombies.en: Spawns six zombies a few tiles from you. Stand in a base building first.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Zombies.ch: 在離你幾格處生成六隻殭屍. 請先站在基地建築內.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_Setup_Zombies.cn: 在离你几格处生成六只僵尸. 请先站在基地建筑内.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_SpawnFailed.en: A-Life took the request but nobody came: %1
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_SpawnFailed.ch: A-Life 接受了請求, 但沒有人出現: %1
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_SpawnFailed.cn: A-Life 接受了请求, 但没有人出现: %1

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_StepOfHidden.ch: 第 %1 / %2 步 (已隱藏 %3 個已完成步驟)
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_StepOfHidden.cn: 第 %1 / %2 步 (已隐藏 %3 个已完成步骤)

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestBaseFailed.en: The test base didn't come together: see Zomboid/Lua/%1.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestBaseFailed.ch: 測試基地沒有建成: 請檢視 Zomboid/Lua/%1.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestBaseFailed.cn: 测试基地没有建成: 请查看 Zomboid/Lua/%1.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestFailed.en: Automatic test failed (marked AUTO FAIL, what it saw is the note).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestFailed.ch: 自動測試失敗 (標記為 自動失敗, 觀察到的情況寫在備註).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestFailed.cn: 自动测试失败 (标记为 自动失败, 观察到的情况写在备注).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestNotSetUp.en: Not set up: what the test needs isn't there (marked NOT SET UP, the reason is the note). Use Set it up or do the step by hand, then run it again.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestNotSetUp.ch: 尚未布置: 測試需要的條件不存在 (標記為 尚未布置, 原因寫在備註). 請使用「布置」或手動完成這個步驟, 然後再執行一次.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestNotSetUp.cn: 尚未布置: 测试所需的条件不存在 (标记为 尚未布置, 原因写在备注). 请使用“布置”或手动完成这个步骤, 然后再运行一次.

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestPassed.en: Automatic test passed (marked AUTO PASS, what it saw is the note).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestPassed.ch: 自動測試合格 (標記為 自動合格, 觀察到的情況寫在備註).
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TestPassed.cn: 自动测试通过 (标记为 自动通过, 观察到的情况写在备注).

IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TraderNotYet.en: No trader of a visiting party has arrived at your nearest base.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TraderNotYet.ch: 尚無來訪隊伍的商人抵達你最近的基地.
IGUI_ALJ_RelCheck_TraderNotYet.cn: 尚无来访队伍的商人到达你最近的基地.

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Last_RumorBad.ch: 聽到不好的傳聞 (逐漸淡去)
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Last_RumorBad.cn: 听到不好的传闻 (逐渐淡去)

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Last_RumorGood.ch: 聽到關於你的好話 (逐漸淡去)
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Last_RumorGood.cn: 听到关于你的好话 (逐渐淡去)

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Note.en: A crew can feel differently from its faction: see the person's tag.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Note.ch: 隊伍對你的看法可能與其陣營不同: 請看該人的標籤.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Note.cn: 队伍对你的看法可能与其阵营不同: 请看此人的标签.

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Parts.ch: 來自成員 %1, 陣營記憶 %2, 來自傳聞 %3
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_Parts.cn: 来自成员 %1, 阵营记忆 %2, 来自传闻 %3

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PeopleLoading.ch: 正在查詢你打過交道的人…
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PeopleLoading.cn: 正在查询你打过交道的人…

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PeopleNone.en: Nobody of theirs you've dealt with is still around.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PeopleNone.ch: 你打過交道的他們的人, 已經沒有人還在了.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PeopleNone.cn: 你打过交道的他们的人, 已经一个都不在了.

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PersonForgetConfirm.en: %1 forgets what they thought of you and goes back to how they'd see you anyway. This can't be undone.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PersonForgetConfirm.ch: %1 會忘記對你的看法, 回到原本會怎麼看你的狀態. 此操作無法復原.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PersonForgetConfirm.cn: %1 会忘记对你的看法, 回到原本对你的看法. 此操作无法撤销.

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PersonForgetTip.en: They forget what they thought of you and go back to how they'd see you anyway.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PersonForgetTip.ch: 對方會忘記對你的看法, 回到原本會怎麼看你的狀態.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_PersonForgetTip.cn: 对方会忘记对你的看法, 回到原本对你的看法.

IGUI_ALJ_Rep_ResetTip.en: Resets this mod's standing with every faction and crew to where it started (an admin's reset also clears people's opinions of the player). A-Life's own overall reputation and faction standing stay: admins reset those with Reset A-Life... in the admin bar.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_ResetTip.ch: 將本 MOD 與每個陣營和隊伍的信譽重設回初始值 (管理員的重設也會清除人們對玩家的好感度). A-Life 本身的整體聲望與陣營信譽不受影響: 管理員可在管理列用 重設 A-Life… 來重設.
IGUI_ALJ_Rep_ResetTip.cn: 将本 MOD 与每个阵营和队伍的信誉重置回初始值 (管理员的重置也会清除人们对玩家的好感度). A-Life 自身的整体声望和阵营信誉不受影响: 管理员可在管理栏用 重置 A-Life… 来重置.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerBusy.ch: 現在不行, 我在打架!
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerBusy.cn: 现在不行, 我在战斗!

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerHeld.en: I've got other orders right now.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerNo.en: You're not the one I take orders from.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerTooMany.en: You've got enough people on your heels already.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerTooMany.ch: 跟著你的人已經夠多了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_AnswerTooMany.cn: 跟着你的人已经够多了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_EscortEndTip.en: Ends the escort, as Call back in My people: they go back to their post, and lent kit comes back as Equip says.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_EscortEndTip.ch: 結束護送, 效果同 我的人員 中的 召回: 他們會回到自己的崗位, 借出的裝備依 裝備 的設定收回.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_EscortEndTip.cn: 结束护送, 效果同 我的人员 中的 召回: 他们会回到自己的岗位, 借出的装备按 装备 的设置收回.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_FollowTip.en: They come with you for a few hours (as follow me), then go back to their post.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_FollowTip.ch: 對方會跟著你幾個小時 (等同 跟我來), 然後回到自己的崗位.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_FollowTip.cn: 对方会跟着你几个小时 (等同 跟我来), 然后回到自己的岗位.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_HomeTip.en: Your order ends: they walk back to their base.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_HomeTip.ch: 你的命令結束: 對方會走回自己的基地.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_HomeTip.cn: 你的命令结束: 对方会走回自己的基地.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_WaitTip.en: They wait where they stand for a few hours. On an escort, they leave it and wait here; the others keep escorting you.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_WaitTip.ch: 對方會在原地等待幾個小時. 若正在護送, 對方會脫隊在此等候; 其他人繼續護送你.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_WaitTip.cn: 对方会在原地等待几个小时. 若正在护送, 对方会离队在此等候; 其他人继续护送你.

IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_WorkTip.en: Your order ends: they go back to what their day says.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_WorkTip.ch: 你的命令結束: 對方會回到當天的日程.
IGUI_ALJ_ResOrders_WorkTip.cn: 你的命令结束: 对方会回到当天的日程.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_BroughtByYou_1.en: You're the one who brought me in, %1. I haven't forgotten.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_BroughtByYou_1.ch: 是你把我帶進來的, %1. 我沒忘.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_BroughtByYou_2.cn: 是你让我在这里有个容身之处, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_ChoiceNewsTip.cn: 基地最近发生的事: 突袭、死亡、出任务归来的人、商人、仓库见底.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_ChoiceOpinionTip.cn: 对方用自己的话说出对你的看法.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_ChoiceSinceTip.cn: 对方在这里住了多久, 以及从哪里来.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingFree_1.en: Nothing much. It's my free time.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingFree_1.ch: 沒什麼. 現在是我的自由時間.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingFree_1.cn: 没什么. 现在是我的自由时间.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingFree_2.en: Taking a breather, %1. Shift's not on yet.
