IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingFree_2.cn: 喘口气而已, %1. 还没轮到我的班.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingGuard_1.en: Guard duty. Eyes on the dark.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingGuard_1.ch: 警戒執勤. 盯著黑暗.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingGuard_1.cn: 警戒执勤. 盯着黑暗.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingGuard_2.ch: 盯著來路, %1. 目前沒動靜.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingGuard_2.cn: 盯着来路, %1. 目前没动静.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingNothing_2.en: Not much right now. Got something for me?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingNothing_2.ch: 現在沒什麼事. 有事要我做嗎?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingNothing_2.cn: 现在没什么事. 有事要我做吗?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingSleep_1.ch: 老實說, 我現在應該在睡覺.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingSleep_1.cn: 说实话, 我现在应该在睡觉.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingSleep_2.en: This is my sleep shift, %1. Trying to rest.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingSleep_2.ch: 現在是我的睡眠班, %1. 正想休息.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingSleep_2.cn: 现在是我的睡眠班, %1. 正想休息.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlarm_1.en: We've got an alarm. Keeping my eyes open.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlarm_1.ch: 警報響了. 我在保持警戒.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlarm_1.cn: 警报响了. 我正保持警惕.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlarm_2.ch: 警報拉響了, %1. 打起精神.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlarm_2.cn: 警报拉响了, %1. 打起精神.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlert_1.en: There's a zombie inside. Dealing with it.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlert_1.ch: 裡面有隻殭屍. 我在處理.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlert_1.cn: 里面有只僵尸. 我在处理.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlert_2.en: Clearing out a zombie. Give me a second.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlert_2.ch: 在清掉一隻殭屍. 給我一秒.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskAlert_2.cn: 在清理一只僵尸. 给我一秒.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyCarry_1.en: Hauling a body to the pile.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyCarry_1.ch: 把一具屍體拖到屍堆去.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyCarry_1.cn: 把一具尸体拖到尸堆去.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyCarry_2.en: Taking this one out. Not pretty.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyCarry_2.ch: 把這個搬出去. 不太好看.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyCarry_2.cn: 把这个搬出去. 不太好看.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyGet_1.en: Going to deal with a body.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskBodyGet_2.en: Someone has to move the dead.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskCleanup_1.ch: 清理勤務. 總得有人做.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskCleanup_1.cn: 清理勤务. 总得有人做.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskEscort_2.en: Sticking with you. That's the job.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskEscort_2.ch: 跟著你. 這就是我的工作.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskEscort_2.cn: 跟着你. 这就是我的活儿.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskExercise_2.en: Working out. Got to stay strong.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskExercise_2.ch: 在健身. 得保持強壯.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskExercise_2.cn: 在锻炼. 得保持强壮.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskFetch_1.en: Fetching a weapon from the store.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskFetch_2.en: Getting kitted out at the store.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskGuard_2.en: On watch, %1. All quiet so far.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskGuard_2.ch: 站哨中, %1. 目前一切平靜.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskGuard_2.cn: 站岗中, %1. 目前一切平静.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskMeal_2.en: Eating. There's enough to go round.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskMeal_2.ch: 在吃飯. 吃的夠大家分.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskMeal_2.cn: 在吃饭. 吃的够大家分.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskMissionOut_2.en: About to set off on a job.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskOvertime_1.en: Still on guard. My relief hasn't shown up.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskOvertime_1.ch: 還在警戒. 接班的人還沒來.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskOvertime_1.cn: 还在警戒. 接班的人还没来.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskOvertime_2.en: Staying on a bit past my watch.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskOvertime_2.ch: 站哨時間過了, 再多守一會兒.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskOvertime_2.cn: 站岗时间过了, 再多守一会儿.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskPatrol_2.en: On patrol. Checking the fence line.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskRelax_1.en: Off duty. Just taking it easy.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskRelax_1.ch: 下哨休息. 放鬆一下.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskRelax_1.cn: 下岗休息. 放松一下.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskRelieving_1.en: On my way to take over a post.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskSleep_2.ch: 在休息. 現在是我的睡覺時間.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskSleep_2.cn: 在休息. 现在是我的睡觉时间.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskTrain_1.en: Training. Trying to get better at this.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskTrain_1.ch: 在訓練. 想把這個練好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskTrain_1.cn: 在训练. 想把这个练好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskTrain_2.en: Practising, %1. Want to pull my weight.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskTrain_2.cn: 在练习, %1. 不想拖大家后腿.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskWork_1.ch: 在工作. %2 有很多事要做.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTaskWork_1.cn: 在干活. %2 有很多事要做.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrain_1.en: Training. Trying to get better at this.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrain_1.ch: 在訓練. 想把這個練好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrain_1.cn: 在训练. 想把这个练好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrain_2.en: Practising, %1. Want to pull my weight.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrain_2.ch: 在練習, %1. 不想拖累大家.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrain_2.cn: 在练习, %1. 不想拖大家后腿.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrip_1.en: Out on a trip. Back as soon as we can.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrip_1.ch: 外出中. 會盡快回來.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrip_1.cn: 外出中. 会尽快回来.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingTrip_2.en: Away from %2 for now. On the job.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingWork_1.en: Work shift. Things don't fix themselves around here.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingWork_1.ch: 工作班. 這裡的東西可不會自己修好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingWork_1.cn: 工作班. 这里的东西可不会自己修好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingWork_2.ch: 在工作, %1. %2 有很多事要做.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_DoingWork_2.cn: 在干活, %1. %2 有很多事要做.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FarewellTrained_1.ch: 明白. 我會守在這裡.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FarewellTrained_1.cn: 明白. 我会守在这里.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FarewellTrained_3.en: Copy that. See you back at %2.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_3.en: I'll be here. Not like I've got anywhere else to be.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_3.ch: 我會在這裡. 反正我也沒別的地方可去.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_3.cn: 我会在这里. 反正我也没别的地方可去.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_4.en: Go on, then. Come back in one piece.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_4.ch: 那就去吧. 平安回來.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_4.cn: 那就去吧. 平安回来.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_5.en: Later, %1. Door's always open for you.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_5.ch: 回頭見, %1. 這裡永遠歡迎你.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Farewell_5.cn: 回头见, %1. 这里永远欢迎你.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromFactionTitle_1.en: Before this I was with %4. My job there: %5.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromFactionTitle_1.ch: 在這之前我待在 %4. 我在那裡的工作: %5.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromFactionTitle_1.cn: 在这之前我待在 %4. 我在那里的工作: %5.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromFactionTitle_2.en: I came over from %4. %5, that was me.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromFactionTitle_2.ch: 我是從 %4 過來的. %5, 那就是我.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromFactionTitle_2.cn: 我是从 %4 过来的. %5, 那就是我.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromRoad_1.en: Before that, the road. Just me and the road.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromRoad_1.ch: 在那之前就是在路上. 只有我和這條路.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_FromRoad_1.cn: 在那之前就是在路上. 只有我和这条路.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackRough_1.en: Back already? Good. Was getting bored.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackRough_1.ch: 這麼快就回來了? 很好. 我正無聊呢.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackRough_1.cn: 这么快就回来了? 很好. 我正无聊呢.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackTrained_1.en: Good to have you back, %1. Perimeter's holding.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackTrained_1.ch: 歡迎回來, %1. 防線守得住.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackTrained_1.cn: 欢迎回来, %1. 防线守得住.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackTrained_2.ch: 歡迎回來. 這一區一直很平靜.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBackTrained_2.cn: 欢迎回来. 这一片一直很平静.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBack_1.en: Hey, %1. Good to see you back at %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBack_1.ch: 嘿, %1. 很高興看到你回到 %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBack_1.cn: 嘿, %1. 很高兴看到你回到 %2.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetBack_3.en: %1. Glad you made it back in one piece.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_1.en: Oh, %1! Hi. I was hoping you'd come by.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_1.ch: 喔, %1! 嗨. 我正希望你會過來.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_1.cn: 哦, %1! 嗨. 我正盼着你过来呢.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_2.en: %1, hey! It's, um, it's good you're here.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_2.ch: %1, 嘿! 那個, 嗯, 你在這裡真好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_2.cn: %1, 嘿! 那个, 嗯, 你在这儿真好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_3.en: Hi, %1. I'm still getting used to this place. In a good way.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_3.ch: 嗨, %1. 我還在適應這個地方. 是好的那種.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetFresh_3.cn: 嗨, %1. 我还在适应这个地方. 是好的那种.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_1.en: Boss. Nobody's tried anything stupid today.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_1.ch: 老大. 今天沒人幹傻事.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_1.cn: 老大. 今天没人干蠢事.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_3.en: Yo, %1. Keeping the riff-raff out of %2, like you asked.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_3.ch: 喲, %1. 照你說的, 不讓閒雜人等進 %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_3.cn: 哟, %1. 照你说的, 不让闲杂人等进 %2.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_4.ch: 老大. 目前還算安靜.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetRough_4.cn: 老大. 目前还算安静.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetTrained_1.en: %1. All quiet at %2, nothing to report.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetTrained_1.ch: %1. %2 一切平靜, 沒有狀況.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetTrained_1.cn: %1. %2 一切平静, 没有情况.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_GreetTrained_3.en: %1. Standing by if you need me.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_1.en: %1! Everything's quiet here, more or less.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_2.en: There you are, %1. Pull up a crate.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_2.ch: 你來啦, %1. 拉個箱子坐吧.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_2.cn: 你来啦, %1. 拉个箱子坐吧.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_3.en: Morning, noon or night, it's good to see a friendly face. Hey, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_3.ch: 不管早上、中午還是晚上, 看到友善的面孔總是好事. 嘿, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_3.cn: 不管早上、中午还是晚上, 看到友善的面孔总是好事. 嘿, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_4.ch: 嘿, 你. 需要什麼嗎, %1?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Greet_4.cn: 嘿, 你. 需要什么吗, %1?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_1.en: Our group? That's us, %1. The people of %2. You're the one calling the shots.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_1.ch: 我們的團體? 就是我們啊, %1. %2 的人. 你是發號施令的那個.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_1.cn: 我们的团体? 就是我们啊, %1. %2 的人. 你是发号施令的那个.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_2.en: You're asking me who's in charge? You are, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_2.ch: 你問我誰是老大? 是你啊, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_2.cn: 你问我谁是老大? 是你啊, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_3.en: It's just us here at %2. Small, but we've got each other.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_3.ch: %2 這裡就只有我們. 人不多, 但我們互相扶持.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_3.cn: %2 这里就只有我们. 人不多, 但我们互相扶持.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_4.en: You know everyone as well as I do, %1. Better, probably.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_4.ch: 你跟我一樣認識每個人, %1. 大概比我還熟.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_4.cn: 你跟我一样认识每个人, %1. 大概比我还熟.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_5.en: We answer to you, %1. That's how it works here.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_5.ch: 我們聽你的, %1. 這裡就是這樣運作的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Group_5.cn: 我们听你的, %1. 这里就是这么运转的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Helped_3.en: That's the second time you've had my back. I won't forget it.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Helped_3.ch: 這是你第二次挺我了. 我不會忘記的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Helped_3.cn: 这是你第二次挺我了. 我不会忘记的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Helped_5.en: I knew I could count on you, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_1.en: I'm bitten, %1. You know what that means.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_1.ch: 我被咬了, %1. 你知道這代表什麼.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_1.cn: 我被咬了, %1. 你知道这意味着什么.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_2.en: Don't... don't look at me like that. I know. I'm bit.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_2.ch: 別… 別那樣看我. 我知道. 我被咬了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_2.cn: 别… 别那样看我. 我知道. 我被咬了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_3.en: It's burning, %1. The bite. I don't have long, do I?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_3.ch: 好燙, %1. 這個咬傷. 我撐不了多久了, 對吧?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingBitten_3.cn: 火辣辣的, %1. 这个咬伤. 我撑不了多久了, 对吧?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFineRough_1.en: Fine. Nothing a quiet day can't fix.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFineRough_1.ch: 還行. 沒什麼是安靜的一天治不好的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFineRough_1.cn: 还行. 没什么是安静的一天治不好的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFineRough_2.en: Still breathing, boss. That's a good day.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFineRough_2.ch: 還有氣, 老大. 這就算是好日子了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFineRough_2.cn: 还喘着气, 老大. 这就算是好日子了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_1.en: I'm good, %1. Fed, rested, nothing hurts. Can't ask for more these days.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_1.ch: 我很好, %1. 吃飽了, 休息夠了, 哪裡都不痛. 這年頭不能要求更多了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_1.cn: 我很好, %1. 吃饱了, 歇够了, 哪儿都不疼. 这年头不能要求更多了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_2.en: Holding up fine. %2 treats me alright.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_2.ch: 撐得還不錯. %2 待我不薄.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_2.cn: 撑得还不错. %2 待我不薄.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_3.en: Not bad at all. Thanks for asking, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_3.ch: 一點也不差. 謝謝關心, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_3.cn: 一点也不差. 谢谢关心, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_4.en: Better than I've been in a long while, honestly.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_4.ch: 老實說, 比我很久以來都好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingFine_4.cn: 说实话, 比我很久以来都好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_1.en: I keep thinking about %4. I can't believe they're gone.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_1.ch: 我一直在想 %4. 真不敢相信人已經不在了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_1.cn: 我一直在想 %4. 真不敢相信人已经不在了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_2.ch: 不太好, %1. 自從 %4 之後就不好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_2.cn: 不太好, %1. 自从 %4 之后就不好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_3.en: %4 should still be here. That's all I can think about.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_3.ch: %4 應該還在的. 我滿腦子都是這件事.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingGrief_3.cn: %4 应该还在的. 我满脑子都是这件事.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_1.en: Honestly? Starving. Is there anything left in the stores?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_1.ch: 老實說? 餓壞了. 倉庫裡還有剩什麼嗎?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_1.cn: 说实话? 饿坏了. 仓库里还剩什么吗?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_2.en: My stomach's been growling all day, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_3.en: Could use a proper meal. Or any meal.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_3.ch: 真想好好吃一頓. 或者隨便吃一頓也好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHungry_3.cn: 真想好好吃一顿. 或者随便吃一顿也行.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_1.en: It hurts, %1. I could use some bandages.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_1.ch: 好痛, %1. 我需要一些繃帶.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_1.cn: 好疼, %1. 我需要一些绷带.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_2.en: Took a beating. Someone should look at this.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_2.ch: 被打得很慘. 得有人來看看.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_2.cn: 被打得很惨. 得有人来看看.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_3.en: I'm hurt. Not dying, but it's bad.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_3.ch: 我受傷了. 死不了, 但傷得不輕.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingHurt_3.cn: 我受伤了. 死不了, 但伤得不轻.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_1.en: I feel awful. Something I ate, maybe.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_1.ch: 我覺得好難受. 也許是吃壞了什麼.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_1.cn: 我觉得好难受. 也许是吃坏了什么.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_2.ch: 不太好, %1. 我的胃在翻攪.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_2.cn: 不太好, %1. 我的胃在翻腾.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_3.en: I'm sick. Just need to rest it off, I hope.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_3.ch: 我生病了. 希望休息一下就好.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingSick_3.cn: 我生病了. 希望歇一歇就好.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_1.en: On edge. Every noise out there sets me off.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_1.ch: 神經緊繃. 外面一點聲響都會讓我嚇一跳.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_1.cn: 神经紧绷. 外面一点动静都会吓我一跳.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_2.en: I keep thinking about what's past the fence, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_2.ch: 我一直在想圍籬外面有什麼, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_2.cn: 我一直在想围栏外面有什么, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_3.en: Nervous. It's been a lot lately.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_3.ch: 很緊張. 最近發生太多事了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingStressed_3.cn: 很紧张. 最近发生太多事了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_1.en: I'm parched. Is there clean water around?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_1.ch: 我渴死了. 附近有乾淨的水嗎?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_1.cn: 我渴死了. 附近有干净的水吗?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_2.en: Could really do with a drink of water, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_3.en: Throat's like sandpaper. We need water.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_3.ch: 喉嚨乾得像砂紙. 我們需要水.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingThirsty_3.cn: 喉咙干得像砂纸. 我们需要水.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingTired_1.en: Dead on my feet, %1. I need some sleep.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingTired_1.ch: 累得站著都能睡著, %1. 我需要睡一下.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingTired_1.cn: 累得站着都能睡着, %1. 我需要睡一会儿.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingTired_3.en: I'll be fine once I've had a few hours in a bed.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingTired_3.ch: 只要在床上躺幾個小時我就沒事了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_HoldingTired_3.cn: 只要在床上躺几个小时我就没事了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_2.ch: 就是這裡, %1. %2 現在就是家.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_2.cn: 就是这里, %1. %2 现在就是家.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_3.en: I sleep under the same roof as you. Not much of a secret.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_3.ch: 我跟你睡在同一個屋簷下. 這不算什麼秘密.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_3.cn: 我跟你睡在同一个屋檐下. 这不算什么秘密.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_4.en: This is it. %2. Not fancy, but it's ours.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_4.ch: 就是這裡. %2. 不豪華, 但是是我們的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_4.cn: 就是这里. %2. 不豪华, 但是是我们的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_5.en: Wherever you lot are, I suppose. Right now that's %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_5.ch: 你們在哪我就在哪吧. 現在是 %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Home_5.cn: 你们在哪我就在哪吧. 现在是 %2.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_1.en: Join you? %1, I already live here.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_1.ch: 加入你? %1, 我已經住在這裡了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_1.cn: 加入你? %1, 我已经住在这里了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_2.en: I'm already with you. Have been since I moved into %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_2.ch: 我已經跟著你了. 從我搬進 %2 就是了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_2.cn: 我已经跟着你了. 从我搬进 %2 就是了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_3.en: Ha. You don't need to ask, I'm one of yours.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_3.ch: 哈. 你不用問, 我是你的人.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_3.cn: 哈. 你不用问, 我是你的人.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_4.en: Where else would I go? I'm with you, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_4.ch: 我還能去哪? 我跟著你, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Join_4.cn: 我还能去哪? 我跟着你, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_1.en: %1, it's me. %3. We live under the same roof.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_1.ch: %1, 是我啊. %3. 我們住在同一個屋簷下.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_1.cn: %1, 是我啊. %3. 我们住在同一个屋檐下.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_3.en: Come on, %1. It's %3. You don't need introductions here.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_3.ch: 拜託, %1. 是 %3 啦. 在這裡不用自我介紹.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_3.cn: 拜托, %1. 是 %3 啦. 在这里不用自我介绍.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_4.ch: 我們見過的, %1. 很多次了. %3.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Known_4.cn: 我们见过的, %1. 很多次了. %3.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsHungry_1.en: Only news is the stores. We're running low on food, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsHungry_1.ch: 唯一的消息就是倉庫. 我們的食物快不夠了, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsHungry_1.cn: 唯一的消息就是仓库. 我们的食物快不够了, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsHungry_2.en: People are hungry. The food store's nearly bare.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsHungry_2.ch: 大家都很餓. 食物倉庫快空了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsHungry_2.cn: 大家都很饿. 食物仓库快空了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_1.ch: 很平靜. 沒什麼好說的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_1.cn: 很平静. 没什么好说的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_2.ch: 沒什麼新鮮事, %1. 平靜就是好事.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_2.cn: 没什么新鲜事, %1. 平静就是好事.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_3.en: Same as yesterday. That's good news, around here.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_3.ch: 跟昨天一樣. 在這裡, 這就是好消息.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsQuiet_3.cn: 跟昨天一样. 在这儿, 这就是好消息.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsTwo_2.en: Let me think. %4 Other than that: %5

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsTwo_3.en: Here's what I've got. %4 And before that: %5
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsTwo_3.ch: 我知道的是這些. %4 在那之前: %5
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_NewsTwo_3.cn: 我知道的是这些. %4 在那之前: %5

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_1.en: You want the truth? I don't trust you, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_1.ch: 你想聽實話? 我不信任你, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_1.cn: 你想听实话? 我不信任你, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_2.en: Don't push it. I'm only here because I've nowhere else.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_2.ch: 別逼我. 我會待在這裡只是因為無處可去.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_2.cn: 别逼我. 我待在这里只是因为无处可去.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_3.en: You've done me wrong, %1. I haven't forgotten.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_3.ch: 你虧待過我, %1. 我沒忘.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionBad_3.cn: 你亏待过我, %1. 我没忘.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_1.en: Honestly? You could treat people better, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_1.ch: 老實說? 你可以對人好一點, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_1.cn: 说实话? 你可以对人好一点, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_2.en: We've had our moments. I'm still here, though.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_2.ch: 我們之間有過一些摩擦. 不過我還在這裡.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_2.cn: 我们之间有过一些摩擦. 不过我还在这里.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionCool_3.en: I'm not thrilled with you right now.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_1.ch: 你還不錯, %1. 我們處得來.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_1.cn: 你还不错, %1. 我们处得来.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_2.en: No complaints. You keep this place going.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_2.ch: 沒什麼好抱怨的. 這地方是你撐起來的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_2.cn: 没什么好抱怨的. 这地方是你撑起来的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_3.en: No complaints from me, %1. So far so good.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_3.ch: 我沒什麼好抱怨的, %1. 目前為止都不錯.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionFine_3.cn: 我没什么好抱怨的, %1. 目前为止都不错.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_1.ch: 我喜歡你, %1. 你人不錯.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_1.cn: 我喜欢你, %1. 你人不错.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_2.en: You've been good to me. I trust you.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_2.ch: 你一直對我很好. 我信任你.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_2.cn: 你一直对我很好. 我信任你.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_3.en: Straight answer? You're one of the good ones.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_3.ch: 說真的? 你是好人之一.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGood_3.cn: 说真的? 你是好人之一.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_1.ch: 老實說? 不管去哪我都會跟著你, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_1.cn: 说实话? 不管去哪我都会跟着你, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_2.en: You're the reason this place works, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_2.ch: 這地方能運作都是因為你, %1.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_2.cn: 这地方能运转都是因为你, %1.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_3.en: Best thing that's happened to me since it all went to hell. You and %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_3.ch: 自從世界變成地獄以來, 這是我遇過最好的事. 你和 %2.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_OpinionGreat_3.cn: 自从世界变成地狱以来, 这是我遇到过最好的事. 你和 %2.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Passing_3.en: Watch your step, %1, I just swept that.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Passing_3.ch: 小心腳下, %1, 我剛掃過那裡.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Passing_3.cn: 当心脚下, %1, 我刚扫过那里.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Passing_5.en: Don't mind me, just passing through.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Passing_5.ch: 別管我, 我只是路過.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Passing_5.cn: 别管我, 我只是路过.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_1.en: Plans? Keep %2 standing, keep us fed. Same as you.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_1.ch: 計畫? 守住 %2, 讓大家吃飽. 跟你一樣.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_1.cn: 计划? 守住 %2, 让大家吃饱. 跟你一样.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_2.en: I'm not going anywhere, %1. This is where I'm needed.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_2.ch: 我哪裡都不去, %1. 這裡需要我.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_2.cn: 我哪儿都不去, %1. 这里需要我.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_3.en: Whatever you need from me. That's the plan.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_3.ch: 你需要我做什麼都行. 這就是我的計畫.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_3.cn: 你需要我做什么都行. 这就是我的计划.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_4.en: Get through tonight, then tomorrow. Here, with you lot.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_4.ch: 撐過今晚, 再撐過明天. 就在這裡, 和你們一起.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_4.cn: 撑过今晚, 再撑过明天. 就在这里, 和你们一起.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_5.en: Hold this place. Maybe make it a bit nicer while we're at it.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_5.ch: 守住這個地方. 順便把它弄得好一點.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Plans_5.cn: 守住这个地方. 顺便把它弄得好一点.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Alarm.en: We had an alarm a while back.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Alarm.ch: 不久前我們這裡響過警報.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Alarm.cn: 不久前我们这里响过警报.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Bitten.en: %1 got bitten. They're going to turn.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Bitten.ch: %1 被咬了. 就要屍變了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Bitten.cn: %1 被咬了. 就要尸变了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Caffeine.en: %1 needed something to stay awake on watch.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Caffeine.ch: %1 站哨時需要點東西提神.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Caffeine.cn: %1 站岗时需要点东西提神.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Evicted.en: %1 had to leave. There wasn't room.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Evicted.ch: 有 %1 人不得不離開. 沒有空間了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Evicted.cn: 有 %1 人不得不离开. 没有地方了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Left.en: %1 of ours packed up and left.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Left.ch: 我們有 %1 個人收拾行李離開了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_Left.cn: 我们有 %1 个人收拾行李离开了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_MissionLost.en: A party we sent out never came back.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_MissionLost.ch: 我們派出去的一隊人再也沒回來.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_MissionLost.cn: 我们派出去的一队人再也没回来.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_MissionOut.en: %1 of ours went out on a trip.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_MissionOut.ch: 我們有 %1 個人外出了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_MissionOut.cn: 我们有 %1 个人外出了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_RaidHeld.en: Raiders hit us, and we beat them off.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_RaidHeld.ch: 掠奪者來襲, 被我們打退了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_RaidHeld.cn: 掠夺者来袭, 被我们打退了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderAllDead.en: The traders from %1 were all killed.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderAllDead.ch: 來自 %1 的商人全數遇害.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderAllDead.cn: 来自 %1 的商人全部遇害.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderFled.en: The traders from %1 got attacked and ran off.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderFled.ch: 來自 %1 的商人遭到攻擊, 逃走了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderFled.cn: 来自 %1 的商人遭到攻击, 逃走了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderKilled.en: One of the traders from %1 got killed.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderKilled.ch: 來自 %1 的一名商人被殺了.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderKilled.cn: 来自 %1 的一名商人被杀了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderLeft.en: The traders from %1 have moved on.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Said_TraderLeft.cn: 来自 %1 的商人已经离开了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene1_2.en: Twice. Back one sticks, needs oil.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene1_2.cn: 查了两次. 后门会卡, 要上油.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene1_3.en: I'll have a look at it in the morning.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene2_3.cn: 别找我, 上次是我去的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene3_1.en: It's almost peaceful here, some nights.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene3_1.cn: 有些晚上, 这里几乎算得上平静.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene3_3.ch: 好啦. 這裡糟透了. 滿意了吧?
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene3_3.cn: 好啦. 这里糟透了. 满意了吧?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene4_1.en: Who left the light on in the back?

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene4_3.en: It's always 'wasn't me' in this place.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene4_3.ch: 在這地方永遠都是「不是我」.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene4_3.cn: 在这地方永远都是“不是我”.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene5_2.en: Better than on the road, that's for sure.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene5_2.ch: 比睡在路上好多了, 這是肯定的.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene5_2.cn: 比睡在路上好多了, 这是肯定的.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene5_3.en: Same. Four walls make a difference.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene5_3.ch: 我也是. 有四面牆就是不一樣.
IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene5_3.cn: 我也是. 有四面墙就是不一样.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene6_1.en: Heard something by the fence earlier.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene6_1.cn: 刚才听到围栏那边有动静.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene6_2.en: Probably a stray one. Keep an eye out.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Scene6_2.cn: 大概是只落单的. 多留意.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_SinceDays_2.en: Must be %4 days, give or take.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_SinceDays_3.cn: 在 %2 待了 %4 天. 感觉更久.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_SinceLong_1.en: A while now. I've stopped counting.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_SinceLong_1.cn: 有一阵子了. 我已经不数了.

IGUI_ALJ_ResTalk_Thanks_1.cn: 别客气, %1. 我们在这里互相照应.

IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpAmbusher.en: Takes a hidden position, holds fire, and attacks when the target walks within about 7 tiles.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpAmbusher.ch: 佔據隱蔽位置, 按兵不動, 等目標走進約 7 格內才發動攻擊.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpAmbusher.cn: 占据隐蔽位置, 按兵不动, 等目标走进约 7 格内才发动攻击.

IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpLeader.en: Holds the group together, deploys it when trouble shows up and rallies it after losses. Orders never slow their own shooting. If the leader dies, the others scatter for a while.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpLeader.ch: 讓團體保持團結, 遇到麻煩時展開部署, 傷亡後重新集結. 下達命令不會拖慢自己的射擊. 若班長陣亡, 其他人會潰散一段時間.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpLeader.cn: 让团体保持团结, 遇到麻烦时展开部署, 伤亡后重新集结. 下达命令不会拖慢自己的射击. 若班长阵亡, 其他人会溃散一段时间.

IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpMedic.en: After a fight, runs to wounded crewmates within 25 tiles and bandages them (back to at least 65 percent health, limp and bleeding gone). Goes to anyone downed first: a downed NPC bleeds out in about 10 seconds. Gets 4 bandages and 2 alcohol wipes each time they appear. Only while both are on screen.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpMedic.ch: 戰鬥結束後, 跑向 25 格內受傷的隊友並為其包紮 (恢復到至少百分之 65 的生命值, 消除跛行與流血). 會優先救助倒地的人: 倒地的NPC約 10 秒就會失血而死. 每次出現時獲得 4 捲繃帶和 2 片酒精溼巾. 僅在雙方都位於畫面內時生效.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpMedic.cn: 战斗结束后, 跑向 25 格内受伤的队友并为其包扎 (恢复到至少百分之 65 的生命值, 消除跛行和流血). 会优先救助倒地的人: 倒地的NPC约 10 秒就会失血而死. 每次出现时获得 4 卷绷带和 2 片酒精湿巾. 仅在双方都位于画面内时生效.

IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpSniper.en: Keeps about 16 tiles from the target, backs off when the fight closes in, and fires deliberate single shots. Needs a gun: give them a rifle.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpSniper.ch: 與目標保持約 16 格距離, 戰鬥逼近時後撤, 並謹慎地單發射擊. 需要槍: 給對方一把步槍.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpSniper.cn: 与目标保持约 16 格距离, 战斗逼近时后撤, 并谨慎地单发射击. 需要枪: 给对方一把步枪.

IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpStealth.en: Shadows a target from behind while sneaking and opens with a backstab for double damage. Best with a melee weapon.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpStealth.ch: 潛行時從背後尾隨目標, 以背刺開場造成雙倍傷害. 最適合搭配近戰武器.
IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyHelpStealth.cn: 潜行时从背后尾随目标, 以背刺开场造成双倍伤害. 最适合搭配近战武器.

IGUI_ALJ_Residents_SpecialtyShortAmbushe.cn: 躲藏起来, 敌人靠近时突袭

IGUI_BBP_Access_TipUnlockAll.en: Unlock everything. Staff roles are kept.
IGUI_BBP_Access_TipUnlockAll.ch: 全部解鎖. 管理人員角色設定會保留.
IGUI_BBP_Access_TipUnlockAll.cn: 全部解锁. 管理人员角色设置会保留.

IGUI_BBP_AdminOnly.en: Blueprints are limited to admins on this server right now.
IGUI_BBP_AdminOnly.ch: 此伺服器目前僅限管理員使用藍圖.
IGUI_BBP_AdminOnly.cn: 此服务器目前仅限管理员使用蓝图.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_ConfirmRemove.en: Remove everything %1 built with this blueprint (%2 pieces) and its rooms? Items stored in its furniture go with it. This cannot be undone.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_ConfirmRemove.ch: 要移除 %1 用此藍圖建造的所有內容 (%2 個構件) 及其房間嗎? 存放在其傢俱中的物品也會一併移除. 此操作無法復原.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_ConfirmRemove.cn: 要移除 %1 用此蓝图建造的所有内容 (%2 个构件) 及其房间吗? 存放在其家具中的物品也会一并移除. 此操作无法撤销.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_ConfirmSweep.en: Remove everything %1 built with BBP that connects to this spot, and its rooms? Items stored in its furniture go with it. This cannot be undone.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_ConfirmSweep.ch: 要移除 %1 用 BBP 建造且與此處相連的所有內容及其房間嗎? 存放在其傢俱中的物品也會一併移除. 此操作無法復原.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_ConfirmSweep.cn: 要移除 %1 用 BBP 建造且与此处相连的所有内容及其房间吗? 存放在其家具中的物品也会一并移除. 此操作无法撤销.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_NotLoaded.en: %1 tiles of it are not loaded on the server. Use Go to first, then remove.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_NotLoaded.ch: 其中 %1 個圖塊未在伺服器上載入. 請先使用「前往」, 再移除.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_NotLoaded.cn: 其中 %1 个图块未在服务器上加载. 请先使用“前往”, 再移除.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_NothingHere.en: Nothing built with BBP on that tile.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_NothingHere.ch: 該圖塊上沒有用 BBP 建造的東西.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_NothingHere.cn: 该图块上没有用 BBP 建造的东西.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_Removed.ch: 已移除 %1 個物件與 %2 個房間.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_Removed.cn: 已移除 %1 个物体和 %2 个房间.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_RoomsKept.en: %1 room(s) kept: they are part of a map building.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_RoomsKept.ch: 保留了 %1 個房間: 它們屬於地圖上的建築.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_RoomsKept.cn: 保留了 %1 个房间: 它们属于地图上的建筑.

IGUI_BBP_Admin_SweepEdge.en: Part of it is outside the loaded area. Go closer and remove again.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_SweepEdge.ch: 有部分位於已載入範圍外. 請靠近後再移除一次.
IGUI_BBP_Admin_SweepEdge.cn: 有部分位于已加载范围外. 请靠近后再移除一次.

IGUI_BBP_BeginHint.en: Click to start building here. %1: rotate, Esc: cancel
IGUI_BBP_BeginHint.ch: 點選以在此開始建造. %1: 旋轉, Esc: 取消
IGUI_BBP_BeginHint.cn: 点击以在此开始建造. %1: 旋转, Esc: 取消

IGUI_BBP_BeginHintNoRotate.en: Click to start building here. Esc: cancel
IGUI_BBP_BeginHintNoRotate.ch: 點選以在此開始建造. Esc: 取消
IGUI_BBP_BeginHintNoRotate.cn: 点击以在此开始建造. Esc: 取消

IGUI_BBP_BeginWithBlocked.en: %1 pieces are on blocked ground: %2. The server may refuse this spot.
IGUI_BBP_BeginWithBlocked.ch: %1 個構件位於受阻的地面: %2. 伺服器可能會拒絕此位置.
IGUI_BBP_BeginWithBlocked.cn: %1 个构件位于受阻的地面: %2. 服务器可能会拒绝此位置.

IGUI_BBP_Blocked_bigFurniture.ch: 被 %1 的大型傢俱擋住.
IGUI_BBP_Blocked_bigFurniture.cn: 被 %1 的大型家具挡住.

IGUI_BBP_Blocked_solid.ch: 被 %1 的實心物體擋住.
IGUI_BBP_Blocked_solid.cn: 被 %1 的实心物体挡住.

IGUI_BBP_BuilderBlocked.ch: 建造已暫停. 仍缺少: %1
IGUI_BBP_BuilderBlocked.cn: 建造已暂停. 仍缺少: %1

IGUI_BBP_BuilderCannotReach.en: Can't find %1 for a piece; leaving it for now.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderCannotReach.ch: 有構件找不到%1; 暫時略過.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderCannotReach.cn: 有构件找不到%1; 暂时跳过.

IGUI_BBP_BuilderPieceFailed.en: A piece could not be built (%1); leaving it for now.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderPieceFailed.ch: 有一個構件無法建造 (%1), 暫時略過.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderPieceFailed.cn: 有一个构件无法建造 (%1), 暂时跳过.

IGUI_BBP_BuilderSkipping.en: No %1 nearby; skipping the pieces that need it.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderSkipping.ch: 附近沒有 %1, 略過需要它的構件.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderSkipping.cn: 附近没有 %1, 跳过需要它的构件.

IGUI_BBP_BuilderStaging.en: Too much to carry in one go; piling the materials beside it.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderStaging.ch: 一次搬不完, 先把材料堆在旁邊.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderStaging.cn: 一次搬不完, 先把材料堆在旁边.

IGUI_BBP_BuilderTooHeavy.en: No %1 without getting hurt; drop some weight. Skipping that piece for now.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderTooHeavy.ch: 在不受傷的情況下沒有%1; 請減輕負重. 暫時略過該構件.
IGUI_BBP_BuilderTooHeavy.cn: 在不受伤的情况下没有%1; 请减轻负重. 暂时跳过该构件.

IGUI_BBP_CancelOrphanedPieces.en: Construction cancelled. %1 already-built pieces were left standing.
IGUI_BBP_CancelOrphanedPieces.ch: 已取消施工. %1 個已建好的構件仍保留在原處.
IGUI_BBP_CancelOrphanedPieces.cn: 已取消施工. %1 个已建好的构件仍保留在原处.

IGUI_BBP_ClearAreaWarn.en: Building will remove the trees, grass and rocks inside the footprint
IGUI_BBP_ClearAreaWarn.ch: 建造時會移除佔地範圍內的樹木、草和石頭
IGUI_BBP_ClearAreaWarn.cn: 建造时会移除占地范围内的树木、草和石头

IGUI_BBP_ClickHitWindow.en: That click landed on a window (%1). Click on the ground instead.
IGUI_BBP_ClickHitWindow.ch: 那次點選落在視窗上 (%1). 請改為點選地面.
IGUI_BBP_ClickHitWindow.cn: 那次点击落在窗口上 (%1). 请改为点击地面.

IGUI_BBP_CopiedNoRotate.en: A copied building cannot be rotated

IGUI_BBP_CursorOffWorld.en: The cursor is not over the world. Move it onto the ground and click again.
IGUI_BBP_CursorOffWorld.ch: 游標不在遊戲世界上. 請移到地面上再點選一次.
IGUI_BBP_CursorOffWorld.cn: 光标不在游戏世界上. 请移到地面上再点击一次.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessRowLocked.ch: 僅限管理人員, 由 %1 鎖定
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessRowLocked.cn: 仅限管理人员, 由 %1 锁定

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSaveFailed.en: The server could NOT save player access. See the server console.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSaveFailed.ch: 伺服器「無法」儲存玩家權限. 請檢視伺服器主控台.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSaveFailed.cn: 服务器“无法”保存玩家权限. 请查看服务器控制台.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSaved.en: Server saved player access: %1 tile sprites staff-only.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSaved.ch: 伺服器已儲存玩家權限: %1 個圖塊僅限管理人員.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSaved.cn: 服务器已保存玩家权限: %1 个图块仅限管理人员.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSent.en: Player access sent to the server: %1 tile sprites staff-only.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSent.ch: 玩家權限已傳送至伺服器: %1 個圖塊僅限管理人員.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessSent.cn: 玩家权限已发送至服务器: %1 个图块仅限管理人员.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessUnconfirmed.en: The server never confirmed player access, so it was NOT saved. Try again.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessUnconfirmed.ch: 伺服器始終未確認玩家權限, 因此「沒有」儲存. 請再試一次.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_AccessUnconfirmed.cn: 服务器始终未确认玩家权限, 因此“没有”保存. 请再试一次.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_EmptyHidden.en: Nothing to show: %1 tile(s) here are hidden. Tick "Show hidden" to edit them.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_EmptyHidden.ch: 沒有可顯示的內容: 此處有 %1 個圖塊已隱藏. 勾選「顯示隱藏圖塊」即可編輯.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_EmptyHidden.cn: 没有可显示的内容: 此处有 %1 个图块已隐藏. 勾选“显示隐藏图块”即可编辑.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_ModeTip_access.en: Choose what players without a staff role may build: whole building kits, categories, types or materials.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_ModeTip_access.ch: 選擇沒有管理人員角色的玩家可以建造什麼: 整個建築套組、分類、類型或材質.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_ModeTip_access.cn: 选择没有管理人员角色的玩家可以建造什么: 整个建筑套组、分类、类型或材质.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_ModeTip_tiles.en: Sort, hide and flag tiles, and set access on single tiles.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_ModeTip_tiles.ch: 排序、隱藏和標記圖塊, 並設定單一圖塊的權限.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_ModeTip_tiles.cn: 排序、隐藏和标记图块, 并设置单个图块的权限.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_RulesSay_open.ch: 規則: 所有人都可建造
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_RulesSay_open.cn: 规则: 所有人都可建造

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_SaveFailed.en: Catalog config could NOT be written to disk. See the console.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_SaveFailed.ch: 型錄設定「無法」寫入磁碟. 請檢視主控台.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_SaveFailed.cn: 目录配置“无法”写入磁盘. 请查看控制台.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_StatusHint.en: - click a row to tick it, shift-click for a range
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_StatusHint.ch: - 點選一列以勾選, Shift+點選可勾選範圍
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_StatusHint.cn: - 点击一行以勾选, Shift+点击可勾选范围

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessAllow.en: Every player may build the selected tiles, even when a locked kit, category, type or material covers them.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessAllow.ch: 所有玩家都可建造選取的圖塊, 即使有已鎖定的套組、分類、類型或材質涵蓋它們.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessAllow.cn: 所有玩家都可建造选取的图块, 即使有已锁定的套组、分类、类型或材质涵盖它们.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessDefault.en: Drop the per-tile setting, so the Player access rules decide.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessDefault.ch: 移除單一圖塊的設定, 交由「玩家權限」規則決定.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessDefault.cn: 移除单个图块的设置, 交由“玩家权限”规则决定.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessFilter.en: Show every tile, only the tiles players cannot build, the exceptions, or the tiles of one building kit.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessFilter.ch: 顯示所有圖塊、僅玩家無法建造的圖塊、例外, 或某個建築套組的圖塊.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessFilter.cn: 显示所有图块、仅玩家无法建造的图块、例外, 或某个建筑套组的图块.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessLock.en: Only staff may build the selected tiles.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessLock.ch: 只有管理人員可以建造選取的圖塊.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipAccessLock.cn: 只有管理人员可以建造选取的图块.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipApply.en: Save every change. Tile edits are written to this computer's catalog file; player access goes to the server and applies to everyone at once.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipApply.ch: 儲存所有變更. 圖塊編輯會寫入這台電腦的型錄檔案; 玩家權限會送至伺服器, 並立即套用到所有人.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipApply.cn: 保存所有更改. 图块编辑会写入这台电脑的目录文件; 玩家权限会发送至服务器, 并立即应用到所有人.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipClose.en: Close the configurator. Unsaved changes are saved first.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipClose.ch: 關閉設定器. 未儲存的變更會先儲存.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipClose.cn: 关闭配置器. 未保存的更改会先保存.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipEave.en: Mark the selected tiles as roof eaves (awnings and skirts). Suppresses the ground-floor roof warning and places them as overhangs.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipEave.ch: 將選取的圖塊標記為屋簷 (遮雨棚與裙板). 這會抑制一樓屋頂警告, 並以出簷方式放置.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipEave.cn: 将选取的图块标记为屋檐 (雨篷和裙板). 这会抑制一楼屋顶警告, 并以挑檐方式放置.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipExport.en: Copy the selected sprite names to the clipboard.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipExport.ch: 將選取的圖塊名稱複製到剪貼簿.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipExport.cn: 将选取的图块名称复制到剪贴板.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupAssign.en: Put the selected tiles into the chosen group. They then share one slot in the build menu, picked through the variant flyout.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupAssign.ch: 將選取的圖塊放入所選群組. 之後它們會共用建造選單中的一個欄位, 經由變體彈出選單挑選.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupAssign.cn: 将选取的图块放入所选分组. 之后它们会共用建造菜单中的一个栏位, 通过变体弹出菜单挑选.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupCombo.en: The variant group the buttons on this row act on.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupCombo.ch: 此列按鈕所作用的變體群組.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupCombo.cn: 此行按钮所作用的变体分组.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupDelete.en: Delete the chosen group. Its tiles go back to having their own slots.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupDelete.ch: 刪除所選群組. 其中的圖塊會恢復為各自獨立的欄位.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupDelete.cn: 删除所选分组. 其中的图块会恢复为各自独立的栏位.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupLabel.en: Name the selected tiles inside their group ("Blue", "Weathered"), shown in the variant flyout.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupLabel.ch: 為選取的圖塊在群組內命名 (「藍色」、「風化」), 會顯示在變體彈出選單中.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupLabel.cn: 为选取的图块在分组内命名 (“蓝色”、“风化”), 会显示在变体弹出菜单中.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupNew.en: Create a group from the selected tiles.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupNew.ch: 以選取的圖塊建立群組.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupNew.cn: 用选取的图块创建分组.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupRemove.en: Take the selected tiles out of whatever group they are in, giving each its own slot again.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupRemove.ch: 將選取的圖塊移出所屬群組, 讓每個圖塊重新擁有自己的欄位.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupRemove.cn: 将选取的图块移出所属分组, 让每个图块重新拥有自己的栏位.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupRep.en: Use the first selected tile as the group's thumbnail in the build menu.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupRep.ch: 以第一個選取的圖塊作為該群組在建造選單中的縮圖.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupRep.cn: 以第一个选取的图块作为该分组在建造菜单中的缩略图.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupSelect.en: Tick every tile already in the chosen group, so you can relabel or ungroup them without hunting for them.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupSelect.ch: 勾選所選群組中已有的所有圖塊, 方便重新標籤或解除群組, 不必逐一尋找.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipGroupSelect.cn: 勾选所选分组中已有的所有图块, 方便重新标签或取消分组, 不必逐一寻找.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipHide.en: Remove the selected tiles from the build menu. They stay in the catalog and can be brought back with Unhide.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipHide.ch: 從建造選單移除選取的圖塊. 它們仍保留在建築型錄中, 可用「在建造選單顯示」恢復.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipHide.cn: 从建造菜单移除选取的图块. 它们仍保留在建造目录中, 可用“在建造菜单显示”恢复.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipMaterialFilter.en: Show only one material in this category.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipMaterialFilter.ch: 在此分類中只顯示一種材質.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipMaterialFilter.cn: 在此分类中只显示一种材质.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipMoveTo.en: Move the selected tiles to this category.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipMoveTo.ch: 將選取的圖塊移到此分類.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipMoveTo.cn: 将选取的图块移到此分类.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipReset.en: Drop every override on the selected tiles and let the auto-classifier decide again.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipReset.ch: 移除選取圖塊上的所有覆寫設定, 交由自動分類重新決定.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipReset.cn: 移除选取图块上的所有覆盖设置, 交由自动分类重新决定.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipRug.en: Mark the selected tiles as rugs, so they lay on top of an existing floor instead of replacing it.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipRug.ch: 將選取的圖塊標記為地毯, 使其鋪在現有地板上, 而不是取代地板.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipRug.cn: 将选取的图块标记为地毯, 使其铺在现有地板上, 而不是替换地板.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipSetMaterial.en: Set this material on the selected tiles.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipSetMaterial.ch: 將此材質設定到選取的圖塊.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipSetMaterial.cn: 将此材质设置到选取的图块.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipSetType.en: Set this type on the selected tiles.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipSetType.ch: 將此類型設定到選取的圖塊.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipSetType.cn: 将此类型设置到选取的图块.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipTypeFilter.en: Show only one type in this category.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipTypeFilter.ch: 在此分類中只顯示一種類型.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipTypeFilter.cn: 在此分类中只显示一种类型.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipUnhide.en: Put the selected tiles back in the build menu.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipUnhide.ch: 將選取的圖塊放回建造選單.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_TipUnhide.cn: 将选取的图块放回建造菜单.

IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_VersionMismatch.en: Override file was written for a different mod version; ignored.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_VersionMismatch.ch: 覆寫檔案是為其他模組版本所寫, 已忽略.
IGUI_BBP_DebugTool_VersionMismatch.cn: 覆盖文件是为其他模组版本所写, 已忽略.

IGUI_BBP_EasyBuildDisabled.en: Easy Build is disabled in sandbox options.
IGUI_BBP_EasyBuildDisabled.ch: 沙盒設定中已停用簡易建造.
IGUI_BBP_EasyBuildDisabled.cn: 沙盒设置中已禁用简易建造.

IGUI_BBP_EditorFailedToOpen.en: The editor failed to open. See console.txt for the error.

IGUI_EW_adv_electrical.cn: 雷击即将来临. 不要停留在空旷处.

IGUI_EW_adv_flood.en: Rising water. Water may reach rooftops. Move upstairs or to higher ground and stay out of the current.
IGUI_EW_adv_flood.ch: 水位上漲. 水可能淹到屋頂. 請移到樓上或高處, 並遠離水流.
IGUI_EW_adv_flood.cn: 水位上涨. 洪水可能漫过屋顶. 请转移到楼上或高处, 并远离水流.

IGUI_EW_adv_hail.en: Stay indoors. A helmet or umbrella will protect you outside.
IGUI_EW_adv_hail.ch: 請待在室內. 在戶外時, 頭盔或雨傘可以保護你.
IGUI_EW_adv_hail.cn: 请待在室内. 在户外时, 头盔或雨伞能保护你.

IGUI_EW_adv_heatwave.en: Extreme heat. Drink water and stay out of the sun.
IGUI_EW_adv_heatwave.ch: 酷熱. 多喝水並避開日曬.
IGUI_EW_adv_heatwave.cn: 酷热. 多喝水并避免日晒.

IGUI_EW_adv_radiation.en: Fallout! Shelter indoors. Gas mask, NBC mask or hazmat suit required outside.
IGUI_EW_adv_radiation.ch: 放射性落塵! 請在室內避難. 外出必須配戴防毒面具、NBC 面罩或穿化學防護服.
IGUI_EW_adv_radiation.cn: 放射性尘埃! 请在室内避难. 外出必须佩戴防毒面具、NBC面罩或穿化学防护服.

IGUI_EW_adv_tornado.en: Take shelter in a sturdy building away from windows. Do not outrun it on foot in the open.
IGUI_EW_adv_tornado.ch: 請躲進堅固的建築物並遠離窗戶. 不要在空曠處徒步試圖跑贏它.
IGUI_EW_adv_tornado.cn: 请躲进坚固的建筑物并远离窗户. 不要在空旷处徒步试图跑过它.

IGUI_EW_adv_wildfire.en: A wildfire is spreading through the area with the wind. Get clear of trees and grass, cover your mouth and do not get caught downwind.
IGUI_EW_adv_wildfire.ch: 野火正隨風在此區蔓延. 遠離樹木與草地, 遮住口鼻, 別被困在下風處.
IGUI_EW_adv_wildfire.cn: 野火正随风在该区域蔓延. 远离树木和草地, 遮住口鼻, 不要被困在下风处.

IGUI_WaterPipesSensorInvert.en: Invert: switch on at the maximum and off at the minimum
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorInvert.ch: 反轉: 達到上限時開啟, 達到下限時關閉
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorInvert.cn: 反转: 达到上限时开启, 达到下限时关闭

IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noCrop.en: Nothing to measure: plant something here
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noCrop.ch: 沒有可量測的對象: 請在這裡種植作物
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noCrop.cn: 没有可测量的对象: 请在这里种植作物

IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noEdge.en: Between the two: waiting for it to reach either end
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noEdge.ch: 介於上下限之間: 等待達到其中一端
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noEdge.cn: 介于上下限之间: 等待达到其中一端

IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMax.en: Between the two: holds until it reaches the maximum
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMax.ch: 介於上下限之間: 維持現狀直到達到上限
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMax.cn: 介于上下限之间: 保持现状直到达到上限

IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMin.en: Between the two: holds until it reaches the minimum
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMin.ch: 介於上下限之間: 維持現狀直到達到下限
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMin.cn: 介于上下限之间: 保持现状直到达到下限

IGUI_WaterPipesSensorSelecting.en: Click a valve to link or unlink it. Esc to finish.
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorSelecting.ch: 點選閥門即可連結或取消連結. 按 Esc 結束.
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorSelecting.cn: 点击阀门即可关联或取消关联. 按 Esc 结束.

IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_noSensor.en: The sensor is gone, or you are too far from it
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_noSensor.ch: 感測器已不存在, 或你離它太遠
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_noSensor.cn: 传感器已不存在, 或你离它太远

IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_noValve.en: There is no valve there any more

IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_outOfRange.en: That valve is too far from the sensor

IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_safehouse.en: That valve is in a safehouse you are not a member of
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_safehouse.ch: 該閥門位在你未加入的安全屋內
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_safehouse.cn: 该阀门位于你未加入的安全屋内

IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_sensorSafeh.en: That sensor is in a safehouse you are not a member of
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_sensorSafeh.ch: 該感測器位在你未加入的安全屋內
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_sensorSafeh.cn: 该传感器位于你未加入的安全屋内

IGUI_WaterPipesValveLinked.en: Driven by %1 moisture sensor(s): it opens while any of them gives a signal.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveLinked.ch: 由 %1 個濕度感測器控制: 只要其中任一個發出訊號就會開啟.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveLinked.cn: 由 %1 个湿度传感器控制: 只要其中任意一个发出信号就会打开.

IGUI_WaterPipesValveSwitchOff.en: Switched off by hand: it stays closed whatever the sensors say.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveSwitchOff.ch: 已手動關閉: 無論感測器狀態如何都會保持關閉.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveSwitchOff.cn: 已手动关闭: 无论传感器状态如何都会保持关闭.

IGUI_WaterPipesValveWaiting.en: Switched on, but no sensor is giving a signal, so it stays closed.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveWaiting.ch: 已開啟, 但沒有任何感測器發出訊號, 因此仍保持關閉.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveWaiting.cn: 已开启, 但没有任何传感器发出信号, 因此仍保持关闭.

IGUI_GridInv_NoRoomToTake.en: No room to take it out

IGUI_GridInv_StackQtyTooltip.en: Quantity to take. Selected items always go; the rest is filled from the top of the list. Shift = 10 at a time.
IGUI_GridInv_StackQtyTooltip.ch: 要取出的數量. 已選取的物品一定會取出; 其餘從清單頂端依序補足. Shift = 一次 10 個.
IGUI_GridInv_StackQtyTooltip.cn: 要取出的数量. 已选中的物品一定会取出; 其余从列表顶部依次补足. Shift = 一次 10 个.

IGUI_StackPicker_HintSelected.en: %1 selected + %2 from the top of the list
IGUI_StackPicker_HintSelected.ch: 已選取 %1 個 + 清單頂端 %2 個
IGUI_StackPicker_HintSelected.cn: 已选中 %1 个 + 列表顶部 %2 个

IGUI_StackPicker_HintTop.en: %1 from the top of the list

IGUI_StackPicker_TakePile.ch: 取出 %1 個成為新的一堆
IGUI_StackPicker_TakePile.cn: 取出 %1 个作为新的一堆

IGUI_AreaTasks_AddTrapBaitDescription.en: Add the chosen carried bait to empty traps in the selected area, using native bait rules and portions. Existing bait and catches are left alone.
IGUI_AreaTasks_AddTrapBaitDescription.ch: 依原版的誘餌規則與用量, 將選定的隨身誘餌放進選定區域內的空陷阱. 已有的誘餌與獵物不會被動到.
IGUI_AreaTasks_AddTrapBaitDescription.cn: 按原版的诱饵规则和用量, 将选定的随身诱饵放入选定区域内的空陷阱. 已有的诱饵和猎物保持不动.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CheckTrapDescription.en: Collect catches from the selected traps using the native Check Trap action. Empty traps are skipped. Stops after a live catch so you can store or put it down.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CheckTrapDescription.ch: 使用原版陷阱的「檢查」動作收取選定陷阱中的獵物. 空陷阱會跳過. 捕獲活的獵物後會停止, 讓你先把牠收好或放下.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CheckTrapDescription.cn: 使用原版陷阱的“检查”动作收取选定陷阱中的猎物. 空陷阱会被跳过. 捕获活的猎物后会停止, 以便你将其存放或放下.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ChooseItemSource.en: Point at a source container or vehicle storage access area.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ChooseItemSource.ch: 請將游標指向來源容器或車輛儲物空間的存取區域.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ChooseItemSource.cn: 指向来源容器或车辆储物空间的存取区域.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ChooseVehicleStorage.en: Point at a vehicle storage access area.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ChooseVehicleStorage.ch: 請將游標指向車輛儲物空間的存取區域.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ChooseVehicleStorage.cn: 指向车辆储物空间的存取区域.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseStorageFailed.en: Corpse storage was not confirmed. Work stopped.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseStorageFailed.ch: 無法確認屍體已存入. 任務已停止.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseStorageFailed.cn: 无法确认尸体已存入. 任务已停止.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseStorageUnavailable.en: The selected storage moved, cannot be accessed, or has no room for another corpse.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseStorageUnavailable.ch: 選定的儲物空間已移動、無法存取, 或沒有空間再放一具屍體.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseStorageUnavailable.cn: 选定的储物空间已移动、无法访问, 或没有空间再放一具尸体.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseTrashFailed.en: The trash container was not emptied. Work stopped.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseTrashFailed.ch: 垃圾桶未被清空. 任務已停止.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseTrashFailed.cn: 垃圾桶未被清空. 任务已停止.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseTrashUnavailable.en: The selected trash container cannot be used, or the server has disabled Trash Delete All.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseTrashUnavailable.ch: 選定的垃圾桶無法使用, 或伺服器已停用垃圾桶的「全部銷毀」 (TrashDeleteAll).
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpseTrashUnavailable.cn: 选定的垃圾桶无法使用, 或服务器已禁用垃圾桶的“全部销毁” (TrashDeleteAll).

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToContainerDescrip.en: Drag human corpses from the selected area into a container that accepts them.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToContainerDescrip.ch: 將選定區域內的人類屍體拖進可容納屍體的容器.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToContainerDescrip.cn: 将选定区域内的人类尸体拖入可容纳尸体的容器.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToTrashDescription.en: Drag each selected human corpse into a trash container, then permanently delete all its contents after each deposit.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToTrashDescription.ch: 將選取範圍內的每具人類屍體拖進垃圾桶, 每放入一具後就永久銷毀垃圾桶內的所有內容物.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToTrashDescription.cn: 将选中范围内的每具人类尸体拖入垃圾桶, 每放入一具后就永久销毁垃圾桶内的所有物品.

IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToVehicleDescripti.en: Drag human corpses into suitable storage at a vehicle access area. Open the storage door first.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToVehicleDescripti.ch: 將人類屍體拖進車輛存取區域處合適的儲物空間. 請先打開儲物空間的艙門.
IGUI_AreaTasks_CorpsesToVehicleDescripti.cn: 将人类尸体拖入车辆存取区域处合适的储物空间. 请先打开储物空间的舱门.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemContainerFull.en: The selected container has no room for the remaining items.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemContainerFull.ch: 選定的容器沒有空間放下剩餘物品.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemContainerFull.cn: 选定的容器没有空间容纳剩余物品.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemDestinationsFull.en: None of the selected storage can accept the remaining items.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemDestinationsFull.ch: 選定的儲物空間都放不下剩餘物品.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemDestinationsFull.cn: 选定的储物空间均无法容纳剩余物品.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemDestinationsUnavailab.en: The selected storage destinations moved, disappeared, or cannot be accessed.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemDestinationsUnavailab.ch: 選定的儲物目的地已移動、消失或無法存取.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemDestinationsUnavailab.cn: 选定的储物目的地已移动、消失或无法访问.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemSourceUnavailable.en: The selected item source moved, disappeared, or cannot be accessed.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemSourceUnavailable.ch: 選定的物品來源已移動、消失或無法存取.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemSourceUnavailable.cn: 选定的物品来源已移动、消失或无法访问.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemTransferFailed.en: The item transfer did not complete. Work stopped.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemTransferFailed.ch: 物品轉移未完成. 任務已停止.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ItemTransferFailed.cn: 物品转移未完成. 任务已停止.

IGUI_AreaTasks_MoveItemsToContainerDescr.en: Move selected items into a container. Undelivered items stay in your inventory. Leave Unwanted items behind.
IGUI_AreaTasks_MoveItemsToContainerDescr.ch: 把選取的物品移進容器. 未送達的物品會留在你的物品欄. 標記為「不想要」的物品會留在原地.
IGUI_AreaTasks_MoveItemsToContainerDescr.cn: 将选中的物品移入容器. 未送达的物品会留在你的物品栏中. 标记为“不想要”的物品会留在原地.

IGUI_AreaTasks_NoItemDestinations.en: No eligible item destinations in that area.
IGUI_AreaTasks_NoItemDestinations.ch: 該區域內沒有符合條件的物品目的地.
IGUI_AreaTasks_NoItemDestinations.cn: 该区域内没有符合条件的物品目的地.

IGUI_AreaTasks_NoItemSources.en: No eligible item sources in that area.
IGUI_AreaTasks_NoItemSources.ch: 該區域內沒有符合條件的物品來源.
IGUI_AreaTasks_NoItemSources.cn: 该区域内没有符合条件的物品来源.

IGUI_AreaTasks_PutDownTrapCatch.en: Put down or store the animal or heavy item in your hands before checking another trap.
IGUI_AreaTasks_PutDownTrapCatch.ch: 請先放下或收好手上的動物或重物, 才能檢查下一個陷阱.
IGUI_AreaTasks_PutDownTrapCatch.cn: 请先放下或收好手中的动物或重物, 再检查下一个陷阱.

IGUI_AreaTasks_RequiresTrapBait.en: Requires usable bait in carried inventory.
IGUI_AreaTasks_RequiresTrapBait.ch: 需要隨身攜帶可用的誘餌.
IGUI_AreaTasks_RequiresTrapBait.cn: 需要随身携带可用的诱饵.

IGUI_AreaTasks_SameItemContainer.en: Choose a destination that does not include the source container.
IGUI_AreaTasks_SameItemContainer.ch: 請選擇不包含來源容器的目的地.
IGUI_AreaTasks_SameItemContainer.cn: 请选择不包含来源容器的目的地.

IGUI_AreaTasks_SelectedTrapBaitUnavailab.en: The chosen bait is no longer available in carried inventory.
IGUI_AreaTasks_SelectedTrapBaitUnavailab.ch: 隨身物品中已沒有所選的誘餌.
IGUI_AreaTasks_SelectedTrapBaitUnavailab.cn: 所选诱饵在随身物品栏中已不可用.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ToContainersDescription.en: Move selected items into containers in a second area, filling suitable storage in turn. Includes stacked containers.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ToContainersDescription.ch: 把選取的物品移進第二個區域內的容器, 依序填滿合適的儲物空間. 包括疊放的容器.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ToContainersDescription.cn: 将选中的物品移入第二个区域内的容器, 依次填满合适的储物空间. 包括堆叠的容器.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ToVehicleDescription.en: Move selected items into cargo storage at a vehicle access point. Open the storage door first. Undelivered items stay in your inventory.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ToVehicleDescription.ch: 把選取的物品移進車輛存取點的載貨空間. 請先打開儲物空間的艙門. 未送達的物品會留在你的物品欄.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ToVehicleDescription.cn: 将选中的物品移入车辆存取点的载货空间. 请先打开储物空间的舱门. 未送达的物品会留在你的物品栏中.

IGUI_AreaTasks_ToVehiclesDescription.en: Move selected items into vehicle storage in a second area, filling suitable storage in turn. Open storage doors first.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ToVehiclesDescription.ch: 把選取的物品移進第二個區域內的車輛儲物空間, 依序填滿合適的儲物空間. 請先打開儲物空間的艙門.
IGUI_AreaTasks_ToVehiclesDescription.cn: 将选中的物品移入第二个区域内的车辆储物空间, 依次填满合适的储物空间. 请先打开储物空间的舱门.

IGUI_AreaTasks_TrapActionFailed.en: The trap action was not confirmed. Work stopped.
IGUI_AreaTasks_TrapActionFailed.ch: 無法確認陷阱動作已完成. 任務已停止.
IGUI_AreaTasks_TrapActionFailed.cn: 无法确认陷阱动作已完成. 任务已停止.

IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleStorageFull.en: The selected vehicle storage has no room for the remaining items.
IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleStorageFull.ch: 選定的車輛儲物空間沒有空間放下剩餘物品.
IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleStorageFull.cn: 选定的车辆储物空间没有空间容纳剩余物品.

IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleStorageUnavailable.en: The selected vehicle storage moved, disappeared, or cannot be accessed.
IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleStorageUnavailable.ch: 選定的車輛儲物空間已移動、消失或無法存取.
IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleStorageUnavailable.cn: 选定的车辆储物空间已移动、消失或无法访问.

IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleTransferFailed.en: The vehicle storage transfer did not complete. Undelivered items remain in your inventory.
IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleTransferFailed.ch: 車輛儲物空間的轉移未完成. 未送達的物品仍在你的物品欄中.
IGUI_AreaTasks_VehicleTransferFailed.cn: 向车辆储物空间的转移未完成. 未送达的物品仍在你的物品栏中.

IGUI_BCPack_Options.ch: Backcountry 全地形車: 新車輛
IGUI_BCPack_Options.cn: Backcountry 全地形越野车: 新车辆

IGUI_BCPack_OptionsHelp.en: Engine sound volume for each vehicle in this pack. It also follows the game's own Sound and Vehicle engine volume, and the server's sandbox setting.
IGUI_BCPack_OptionsHelp.ch: 本包每輛車的引擎音量. 同時也會受遊戲本身的「遊戲音量」與「車輛引擎音量」, 以及伺服器的沙盒設定影響.
IGUI_BCPack_OptionsHelp.cn: 本包中每辆车的引擎音量. 同时也会受游戏自身的“游戏音量”和“车辆引擎音量”, 以及服务器的沙盒设置影响.

IGUI_BCQuad_OptionsHelp.en: Engine sound volume for each vehicle in this pack. It also follows the game's own Sound and Vehicle engine volume, and the server's sandbox setting.
IGUI_BCQuad_OptionsHelp.ch: 本包每輛車的引擎音量. 同時也會受遊戲本身的「遊戲音量」與「車輛引擎音量」, 以及伺服器的沙盒設定影響.
IGUI_BCQuad_OptionsHelp.cn: 本包中每辆车的引擎音量. 同时也会受游戏自身的“游戏音量”和“车辆引擎音量”, 以及服务器的沙盒设置影响.

IGUI_VehicleNameBCQuadHeavy.cn: 重型多用途全地形越野车

IGUI_MFS_InspectResetViewTooltip.en: Restore the opening view, pan and zoom. Saved attachment positions are unchanged.
IGUI_MFS_InspectResetViewTooltip.ch: 恢復初始的視角、平移與縮放. 已儲存的配件位置不會改變.
IGUI_MFS_InspectResetViewTooltip.cn: 恢复初始的视角、平移和缩放. 已保存的配件位置不会改变.

IGUI_MFS_InspectViewControls.en: Drag: rotate | Shift + drag: pan | Mouse wheel: zoom
IGUI_MFS_InspectViewControls.ch: 拖曳: 旋轉 | Shift + 拖曳: 平移 | 滑鼠滾輪: 縮放
IGUI_MFS_InspectViewControls.cn: 拖动: 旋转 | Shift + 拖动: 平移 | 鼠标滚轮: 缩放

IGUI_RNPC_038df411.en: Your move. Make it a smart one.
IGUI_RNPC_038df411.ch: 換你了. 想清楚再動.
IGUI_RNPC_038df411.cn: 该你了. 想清楚再动.

IGUI_RNPC_089838e5.en: Should find a roof till this passes.
IGUI_RNPC_089838e5.cn: 得找个有屋顶的地方, 等雨过去.

IGUI_RNPC_0e5ae826.en: We've barely got enough for us.

IGUI_RNPC_1021c28e.en: One coming up on your left!

IGUI_RNPC_1d61426a.en: Not much. Kept my head down.
IGUI_RNPC_1d61426a.ch: 沒什麼. 我一直低調行事.
IGUI_RNPC_1d61426a.cn: 没什么. 我一直低着头没惹事.

IGUI_RNPC_20a0b561.ch: 轉身走開. 我是認真的.
IGUI_RNPC_20a0b561.cn: 转身走开. 我是认真的.

IGUI_RNPC_21ae3b50.en: Wish I could. We're going hungry too.
IGUI_RNPC_21ae3b50.ch: 我也想幫. 但我們自己也在挨餓.
IGUI_RNPC_21ae3b50.cn: 我也想帮. 但我们自己也在挨饿.

IGUI_RNPC_21f2c883.en: A few of them about, here and there. Nothing bunched up.
IGUI_RNPC_21f2c883.ch: 附近零零星星有幾隻. 沒有聚成一群.
IGUI_RNPC_21f2c883.cn: 附近零零星星有几只. 没有扎堆.

IGUI_RNPC_2545c0a3.en: Hang on. You got anything to spare?
IGUI_RNPC_2545c0a3.ch: 等等. 你有多的東西嗎?
IGUI_RNPC_2545c0a3.cn: 等等. 你有多余的东西吗?

IGUI_RNPC_26a2f4ca.en: If you're one of ours, I'm sorry.
IGUI_RNPC_26a2f4ca.ch: 如果你是我們的人, 對不起.
IGUI_RNPC_26a2f4ca.cn: 如果你是我们的人, 对不起.

IGUI_RNPC_27074a69.en: NPCs shown on your world map again.
IGUI_RNPC_27074a69.ch: 你的世界地圖上已重新顯示NPC.
IGUI_RNPC_27074a69.cn: 你的世界地图上已重新显示NPC.

IGUI_RNPC_2a2ea2e8.en: Something was out by the fence last night.

IGUI_RNPC_2b50b4ab.en: Hide NPCs on my world map
IGUI_RNPC_2b50b4ab.ch: 在我的世界地圖上隱藏NPC
IGUI_RNPC_2b50b4ab.cn: 在我的世界地图上隐藏NPC

IGUI_RNPC_2c748661.en: One or two wandering about. Nothing we can't handle.
IGUI_RNPC_2c748661.ch: 有一兩隻在附近晃. 我們應付得來.
IGUI_RNPC_2c748661.cn: 有一两只在附近晃. 我们应付得来.

IGUI_RNPC_2e2490aa.en: We don't have to do this.
IGUI_RNPC_2e2490aa.cn: 我们没必要走到这一步.

IGUI_RNPC_2eb34205.en: If you found this, I didn't make it back. Tell them I tried.
IGUI_RNPC_2eb34205.ch: 如果你看到這張紙, 代表我沒能回去. 告訴他們我盡力了.
IGUI_RNPC_2eb34205.cn: 如果你看到这张纸, 说明我没能回去. 告诉他们我尽力了.

IGUI_RNPC_307ddc94.en: They're short of %1. Right-click one of them to share, or walk on.
IGUI_RNPC_307ddc94.ch: 他們缺 %1. 右鍵點選其中一人來分享物資, 或直接走開.
IGUI_RNPC_307ddc94.cn: 他们缺 %1. 右键点击其中一人来分享物资, 或者直接走开.

IGUI_RNPC_367d6cf7.en: Thought you'd get away with it?

IGUI_RNPC_3cd941af.cn: 求你了. 我伤得很重.

IGUI_RNPC_3d9f7ae6.ch: 你血流得到處都是. 拿去.
IGUI_RNPC_3d9f7ae6.cn: 你血流得到处都是. 拿着.

IGUI_RNPC_45495975.en: We should find somewhere for the night.

IGUI_RNPC_4db000e8.ch: 天亮了. 我們出發吧.
IGUI_RNPC_4db000e8.cn: 天亮了. 咱们出发吧.

IGUI_RNPC_4dfc6e44.ch: 我們要被淋成落湯雞了.
IGUI_RNPC_4dfc6e44.cn: 我们要被淋成落汤鸡了.

IGUI_RNPC_521174af.en: I keep hearing them at night.
IGUI_RNPC_521174af.ch: 我晚上一直聽到它們的聲音.
IGUI_RNPC_521174af.cn: 我晚上老听到它们的动静.

IGUI_RNPC_52825724.ch: 拿去. 壓住傷口別放.
IGUI_RNPC_52825724.cn: 拿着. 一直按住伤口.

IGUI_RNPC_53767fd4.en: Hey... you got a bandage? Anything?
IGUI_RNPC_53767fd4.ch: 嘿… 你有繃帶嗎? 什麼都好?
IGUI_RNPC_53767fd4.cn: 嘿… 你有绷带吗? 什么都行?

IGUI_RNPC_5410f8dc.en: Seen many of the dead around here?
IGUI_RNPC_5410f8dc.ch: 這附近有看到很多行屍嗎?
IGUI_RNPC_5410f8dc.cn: 你在这附近见过很多行尸吗?

IGUI_RNPC_57be47aa.ch: 今天外面有什麼狀況嗎?
IGUI_RNPC_57be47aa.cn: 今天外面有什么情况吗?

IGUI_RNPC_58490608.en: Stay close. Can't see a thing out here.
IGUI_RNPC_58490608.ch: 跟緊點. 這裡什麼都看不見.
IGUI_RNPC_58490608.cn: 跟紧点. 这儿什么都看不见.

IGUI_RNPC_5c5a2e06.ch: 我什麼都不剩了, 抱歉.
IGUI_RNPC_5c5a2e06.cn: 我什么都不剩了, 抱歉.

IGUI_RNPC_5de8f8b2.en: Could use a hand here. I'm hurt.
IGUI_RNPC_5de8f8b2.ch: 這裡需要幫忙. 我受傷了.
IGUI_RNPC_5de8f8b2.cn: 这边需要帮忙. 我受伤了.

IGUI_RNPC_5e695144.ch: 保持距離. 我要走了.
IGUI_RNPC_5e695144.cn: 保持距离. 我这就走.

IGUI_RNPC_616c4b6d.ch: 別慌… 你左邊有一隻.
IGUI_RNPC_616c4b6d.cn: 别慌… 你左边有一只.

IGUI_RNPC_6540c42c.en: Been on the road a while. Couldn't tell you what's out there now.
IGUI_RNPC_6540c42c.ch: 我在路上走了好一陣子. 現在外面什麼狀況我也說不準.
IGUI_RNPC_6540c42c.cn: 我在路上走了好一阵子. 现在外面什么情况我也说不准.

IGUI_RNPC_655b00cc.en: You got anything for this? Anything at all?
IGUI_RNPC_655b00cc.ch: 你有什麼能處理這個的嗎? 什麼都好?
IGUI_RNPC_655b00cc.cn: 你有什么能处理这个的吗? 什么都行?

IGUI_RNPC_662c341a.en: More to the %1. I'd stay clear of there.
IGUI_RNPC_662c341a.ch: %1邊還有更多. 我會離那邊遠一點.
IGUI_RNPC_662c341a.cn: %1边还有更多. 换我就离那边远点.

IGUI_RNPC_675f2b3b.en: Movement on your right. Not a walker.
IGUI_RNPC_675f2b3b.ch: 你右邊有動靜. 不是行屍.
IGUI_RNPC_675f2b3b.cn: 你右边有动静. 不是行尸.

IGUI_RNPC_6868a2f7.ch: 嘿. 你要買還是要賣?
IGUI_RNPC_6868a2f7.cn: 嘿. 你是要买还是要卖?

IGUI_RNPC_6e947bd2.en: Turn around, one's right behind you!
IGUI_RNPC_6e947bd2.ch: 轉身, 有一隻就在你後面!
IGUI_RNPC_6e947bd2.cn: 转身, 有一只就在你身后!

IGUI_RNPC_71f8e643.en: Hey. You trading? We won't be here long.
IGUI_RNPC_71f8e643.ch: 嘿. 要交易嗎? 我們待不久.
IGUI_RNPC_71f8e643.cn: 嘿. 要交易吗? 我们待不了多久.

IGUI_RNPC_7ef93686.en: Don't turn fast. One's behind you.
IGUI_RNPC_7ef93686.ch: 別突然轉身. 有一隻在你後面.
IGUI_RNPC_7ef93686.cn: 别猛转身. 有一只在你后面.

IGUI_RNPC_805bd098.ch: 我是 %1. 我是 %2 的人.
IGUI_RNPC_805bd098.cn: 我是 %1. 我是 %2 的人.

IGUI_RNPC_819fcf50.en: Wish I could. We've got nothing.
IGUI_RNPC_819fcf50.ch: 我也想幫. 但我們什麼都沒有.
IGUI_RNPC_819fcf50.cn: 我也想帮. 但我们什么都没有.

IGUI_RNPC_82eb29d0.en: Show NPCs on my world map
IGUI_RNPC_82eb29d0.ch: 在我的世界地圖上顯示NPC
IGUI_RNPC_82eb29d0.cn: 在我的世界地图上显示NPC

IGUI_RNPC_83ee981e.en: Quiet. There's a bunch of them.

IGUI_RNPC_8493609e.en: There's a bunch of them %1 of here, %2.

IGUI_RNPC_876f9e3f.en: Got stuff to trade, if you've got the cash.
IGUI_RNPC_876f9e3f.ch: 我有東西可以交易, 只要你有錢.
IGUI_RNPC_876f9e3f.cn: 我有东西可以交易, 只要你有钱.

IGUI_RNPC_89efb5b4.en: Lower it, friend. There's more of us.
IGUI_RNPC_89efb5b4.ch: 放下吧, 朋友. 我們不只一個人.
IGUI_RNPC_89efb5b4.cn: 放下吧, 朋友. 我们可不止一个人.

IGUI_RNPC_8ac4775f.ch: 拿去. 別跟其他人說.
IGUI_RNPC_8ac4775f.cn: 拿着. 别跟其他人说.

IGUI_RNPC_8cdc40d9.en: Nobody has to get hurt here.

IGUI_RNPC_8dab6d54.en: NPCs hidden on your world map.
IGUI_RNPC_8dab6d54.ch: 你的世界地圖上已隱藏NPC.
IGUI_RNPC_8dab6d54.cn: 你的世界地图上已隐藏NPC.

IGUI_RNPC_8dfe7c2b.en: Too many of them. Let's go.

IGUI_RNPC_8f50df4c.cn: 东西不多, 但你吃吧.

IGUI_RNPC_903dc5e5.en: Got a load here, if you're buying.
IGUI_RNPC_903dc5e5.ch: 要買的話, 我這裡貨很多.
IGUI_RNPC_903dc5e5.cn: 要买的话, 我这儿货多着呢.

IGUI_RNPC_982d2152.en: I know. I'll go look tomorrow.
IGUI_RNPC_982d2152.ch: 我知道. 我明天去找找.
IGUI_RNPC_982d2152.cn: 我知道. 我明天去找找.

IGUI_RNPC_a2b585d8.en: They're spread out. A couple this way, a couple that way.
IGUI_RNPC_a2b585d8.ch: 它們很分散. 這邊幾隻, 那邊幾隻.
IGUI_RNPC_a2b585d8.cn: 它们很分散. 这边几只, 那边几只.

IGUI_RNPC_a2c2e65d.en: Nothing close. Been a quiet stretch, knock on wood.
IGUI_RNPC_a2c2e65d.ch: 附近沒有. 安靜好一陣子了, 但願別破功.
IGUI_RNPC_a2c2e65d.cn: 附近没有. 消停好一阵子了, 但愿别出事.

IGUI_RNPC_a2f92ad7.en: Whoever reads this: keep moving. Don't stay here.
IGUI_RNPC_a2f92ad7.ch: 不管是誰讀到這張紙: 繼續走. 別待在這裡.
IGUI_RNPC_a2f92ad7.cn: 不管是谁读到这张纸: 继续走. 别待在这儿.

IGUI_RNPC_a3beeb1b.en: Writing it down so somebody remembers.
IGUI_RNPC_a3beeb1b.ch: 寫下來, 好讓有人記得.
IGUI_RNPC_a3beeb1b.cn: 写下来, 好让有人记得.

IGUI_RNPC_a82c263d.ch: 它們從四面八方過來了.
IGUI_RNPC_a82c263d.cn: 它们从四面八方过来了.

IGUI_RNPC_ad4d224e.en: Night's coming. I don't like being out in it.
IGUI_RNPC_ad4d224e.ch: 天要黑了. 我不喜歡在外面過夜.
IGUI_RNPC_ad4d224e.cn: 天快黑了. 我不喜欢晚上待在外面.

IGUI_RNPC_adb909df.en: You look half starved. Take this.
IGUI_RNPC_adb909df.ch: 你看起來快餓壞了. 拿去.
IGUI_RNPC_adb909df.cn: 你看着快饿坏了. 拿着.

IGUI_RNPC_b5d10556.en: Movement on your left. Not a walker.
IGUI_RNPC_b5d10556.ch: 你左邊有動靜. 不是行屍.
IGUI_RNPC_b5d10556.cn: 你左边有动静. 不是行尸.

IGUI_RNPC_b7488daf.en: That's a crowd. We should move.
IGUI_RNPC_b7488daf.ch: 那是一大群. 我們該走了.
IGUI_RNPC_b7488daf.cn: 那是一大群. 我们该走了.

IGUI_RNPC_b7f3a95d.en: Two of us. Think about it.
IGUI_RNPC_b7f3a95d.ch: 我們有兩個人. 你自己想想.
IGUI_RNPC_b7f3a95d.cn: 我们有两个人. 你自己掂量掂量.

IGUI_RNPC_baeabd6d.en: Just a straggler or two. Nothing to lose sleep over.
IGUI_RNPC_baeabd6d.ch: 就一兩隻落單的. 不值得擔心到睡不著.
IGUI_RNPC_baeabd6d.cn: 就一两只落单的. 不值得为这个睡不着觉.

IGUI_RNPC_bbb03bfa.en: %1 is badly hurt. With a bandage in your bag you can patch them up (right-click near them).
IGUI_RNPC_bbb03bfa.ch: %1 傷得很重. 背包裡有繃帶的話就能替對方包紮 (右鍵點選對方附近).
IGUI_RNPC_bbb03bfa.cn: %1 伤得很重. 背包里有绷带的话就能给对方包扎 (右键点击对方附近).

IGUI_RNPC_c0fb9989.cn: 你昨晚听到那动静了吗?

IGUI_RNPC_c1af243d.en: Keep down. Too many to fight.
IGUI_RNPC_c1af243d.ch: 壓低. 太多了, 打不過.
IGUI_RNPC_c1af243d.cn: 压低. 太多了, 打不过.

IGUI_RNPC_c1f5fb2e.en: Quiet around here. Haven't seen one in a while.
IGUI_RNPC_c1f5fb2e.ch: 這附近很安靜. 好一陣子沒看到半隻了.
IGUI_RNPC_c1f5fb2e.cn: 这附近很安静. 好一阵子没见到一只了.

IGUI_RNPC_c57f1ba6.ch: 物資照這樣撐不了多久.
IGUI_RNPC_c57f1ba6.cn: 物资照这样撑不了多久.

IGUI_RNPC_c823c8a2.en: I'm backing off. Don't follow me.
IGUI_RNPC_c823c8a2.ch: 我要退了. 別跟過來.
IGUI_RNPC_c823c8a2.cn: 我这就退. 别跟过来.

IGUI_RNPC_cb9cf7b3.en: Wait. We're in a bad way here.
IGUI_RNPC_cb9cf7b3.ch: 等等. 我們現在情況很糟.
IGUI_RNPC_cb9cf7b3.cn: 等等. 我们现在情况很糟.

IGUI_RNPC_d1daa697.ch: 其他地方差不多都清空了.
IGUI_RNPC_d1daa697.cn: 其他地方基本都没有了.

IGUI_RNPC_d296e474.ch: 嘿, 你. 我們需要幫忙.
IGUI_RNPC_d296e474.cn: 嘿, 你. 我们需要帮忙.

IGUI_RNPC_d692e3ec.ch: 別慌… 你右邊有一隻.
IGUI_RNPC_d692e3ec.cn: 别慌… 你右边有一只.

IGUI_RNPC_d8ccdaf0.en: Don't walk off. Just hear me out.
IGUI_RNPC_d8ccdaf0.cn: 别走. 先听我把话说完.

IGUI_RNPC_dc17f6ad.ch: 別就這樣走過去. 拜託.
IGUI_RNPC_dc17f6ad.cn: 别就这么走过去. 求你了.

IGUI_RNPC_dee679de.en: Passing through with stuff to trade. Want a look?
IGUI_RNPC_dee679de.ch: 路過這裡, 有東西可以交易. 要看看嗎?
IGUI_RNPC_dee679de.cn: 路过这儿, 有东西可以交易. 要看看吗?

IGUI_RNPC_df6bc7df.ch: 抱歉. 我們自己都不夠.
IGUI_RNPC_df6bc7df.cn: 抱歉. 我们自己都不够.

IGUI_RNPC_e033d303.en: There's a bunch of them coming.

IGUI_RNPC_e742b482.en: Trading post's open. Come take a look.
IGUI_RNPC_e742b482.ch: 交易站開張了. 來看看吧.
IGUI_RNPC_e742b482.cn: 交易站开张了. 来看看吧.

IGUI_RNPC_ea439196.ch: 我會去. 只是不是今晚.
IGUI_RNPC_ea439196.cn: 我会去的. 只是不是今晚.

IGUI_RNPC_eac61656.en: Good. Let's keep it that way.

IGUI_RNPC_ec1e3318.en: We're out. Nothing to give you.
IGUI_RNPC_ec1e3318.ch: 我們沒了. 沒東西能給你.
IGUI_RNPC_ec1e3318.cn: 我们没了. 没东西能给你.

IGUI_RNPC_f0dea8f8.en: Somebody needs to go out for supplies.

IGUI_RNPC_faf2f33f.en: Come on over. We don't bite.
IGUI_RNPC_faf2f33f.ch: 過來吧. 我們不咬人.
IGUI_RNPC_faf2f33f.cn: 过来吧. 我们不咬人.

IGUI_RNPC_fe8c5271.en: One coming up on your right!
