Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_IndoorSmo.ch: 焊接面罩防護
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_IndoorSmo.cn: 焊工面罩防护

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_IndoorSmo.ch: 配戴焊接面罩可降低的暴露量.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_IndoorSmo.cn: 佩戴焊工面罩可降低的暴露量.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainHerbD.ch: 雨天香草乾燥速度倍率
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainHerbD.cn: 雨天香草干燥速度倍率

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainHerbD.en: Progress speed for outdoor herb drying while raining. Lower values mean rain slows drying more.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainHerbD.ch: 下雨時室外香草乾燥的進度速度. 數值越低表示雨勢對乾燥的減速越明顯.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainHerbD.cn: 下雨时室外香草干燥的进度速度. 数值越低表示雨势对干燥的减速越明显.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainSlows.en: When enabled, active outdoor Barrel Smokers process food more slowly while it is raining.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainSlows.ch: 啟用後, 下雨時室外運作中的桶式煙燻爐處理食物的速度會變慢.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainSlows.cn: 启用后, 下雨时室外运作中的桶式烟熏炉处理食物的速度会变慢.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainSmoki.en: Progress speed for outdoor Barrel Smokers while raining. Lower values mean rain slows smoking more.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainSmoki.ch: 下雨時室外桶式煙燻爐的進度速度. 數值越低表示雨勢對煙燻的減速越明顯.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RainSmoki.cn: 下雨时室外桶式烟熏炉的进度速度. 数值越低表示雨势对烟熏的减速越明显.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequireSk.en: Require Metalworking skill to build smokers
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequireSk.ch: 建造煙燻爐需要金工技能
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequireSk.cn: 建造烟熏炉需要金工技能

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequireSk.en: When disabled, players can build Barrel Smokers without meeting the Metalworking level requirement.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequireSk.ch: 停用後, 玩家無須達到金工等級要求即可建造桶式煙燻爐.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequireSk.cn: 停用后, 玩家无须达到金工等级要求即可建造桶式烟熏炉.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequiredM.en: Metalworking level required when skill requirements are enabled.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequiredM.ch: 啟用技能要求時所需的金工等級.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_RequiredM.cn: 启用技能要求时所需的金工等级.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.cn: 烟熏大脑效果持续时间

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.en: In-game minutes the Smoked Brain sound effect can continue after being eaten. Set to 0 to disable the effect.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.ch: 食用後, 煙燻腦音效可持續的遊戲內分鐘數. 設為 0 可停用該效果.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.cn: 食用后, 烟熏大脑音效可持续的游戏内分钟数. 设为 0 可停用该效果.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.en: In-game minutes between Smoked Brain sound bursts while the effect is active.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.ch: 效果持續期間, 兩次煙燻腦音效之間的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.cn: 效果持续期间, 两次烟熏大脑音效之间的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.en: How far zombies can hear each Smoked Brain sound burst.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.ch: 殭屍可聽見每次煙燻腦音效的距離.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedBra.cn: 僵尸可听见每次烟熏大脑音效的距离.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedFoo.en: When enabled, smoked outputs are configured to be effectively non-perishable.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedFoo.ch: 啟用後, 煙燻產物會被設定為實質上不會腐壞.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokedFoo.cn: 启用后, 烟熏产物会被设定为实质上不会腐坏.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerCha.en: Maximum number of food entries tracked in a smoker's virtual chamber.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerCha.ch: 煙燻爐虛擬煙燻室可追蹤的食物項目數量上限.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerCha.cn: 烟熏炉虚拟烟熏室可追踪的食物项目数量上限.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerFue.en: Higher values make each fuel item burn longer in smokers.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerFue.ch: 數值越高, 每件燃料在煙燻爐中燃燒的時間越長.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerFue.cn: 数值越高, 每件燃料在烟熏炉中燃烧的时间越长.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerMax.en: Maximum fuel time a smoker can hold. Default fuel values are tuned around logs lasting 60 minutes and planks lasting 15 minutes.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerMax.ch: 煙燻爐可儲存的燃料時間上限. 預設燃料數值是以原木維持 60 分鐘, 木板維持 15 分鐘為基準調整的.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokerMax.cn: 烟熏炉可储存的燃料时间上限. 默认燃料数值是以原木维持 60 分钟, 木板维持 15 分钟为基准调整的.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingCo.ch: 每件煙燻食物的烹飪經驗值
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingCo.cn: 每件烟熏食物的烹饪经验值

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingCo.en: Cooking XP awarded for each food item that finishes smoking. Set to 0 to award no XP.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingCo.ch: 每件完成煙燻的食物所給予的烹飪經驗值. 設為 0 則不給予經驗值.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingCo.cn: 每件完成烟熏的食物所给予的烹饪经验值. 设为 0 则不给予经验值.

Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingDu.en: In-game hours required to turn raw food into smoked food.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingDu.ch: 將生食變成煙燻食物所需的遊戲內小時數.
Sandbox_BadSadsOutbreakSmokers_SmokingDu.cn: 将生食变成烟熏食物所需的游戏内小时数.

Sandbox_BalancePreset_tooltip.en: Quickly applies a tuned set of values for toxic and attack events.
Sandbox_BalancePreset_tooltip.ch: 快速套用一組針對毒氣與攻擊事件調校過的數值.
Sandbox_BalancePreset_tooltip.cn: 快速应用一组针对毒气与攻击事件调校过的数值.

Sandbox_DefaultEventDurationHours_toolti.en: Default duration in game hours when HTT starts an event.
Sandbox_DefaultEventDurationHours_toolti.ch: HTT 啟動事件時的預設持續時間, 以遊戲內小時計.
Sandbox_DefaultEventDurationHours_toolti.cn: HTT 启动事件时的默认持续时间, 以游戏内小时计.

Sandbox_DisableEventsDuringSleep_tooltip.en: When enabled, automatic event starts and toxic ambient loops are paused while players are sleeping or time is fast-forwarded.
Sandbox_DisableEventsDuringSleep_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 當玩家正在睡覺或時間快轉時, 事件的自動啟動與毒氣環境音循環都會暫停.
Sandbox_DisableEventsDuringSleep_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 当玩家正在睡觉或时间快进时, 事件的自动启动与毒气环境音循环都会暂停.

Sandbox_EnableEventAirBombardment_toolti.en: Allows the air bombardment helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventAirBombardment_toolti.ch: 允許空中轟炸直升機事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventAirBombardment_toolti.cn: 允许空中轰炸直升机事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventCharacterHints_toolti.en: When enabled, each player's character gives brief, ambiguous warnings and survival suggestions as synchronized events develop. The active event is never named directly.
Sandbox_EnableEventCharacterHints_toolti.ch: 啟用後, 隨著同步事件的發展, 每位玩家的角色會給出簡短、含糊的警告與生存建議. 進行中的事件永遠不會被直接點名.
Sandbox_EnableEventCharacterHints_toolti.cn: 启用后, 随着同步事件的发展, 每位玩家的角色会给出简短、含糊的警告与生存建议. 进行中的事件永远不会被直接点名.

Sandbox_EnableEventDownedHeli_tooltip.en: Allows the downed helicopter crash event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventDownedHeli_tooltip.ch: 允許直升機墜毀事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventDownedHeli_tooltip.cn: 允许直升机坠毁事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventEMIInterference_toolt.en: Allows the electromagnetic interference (EMI) event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventEMIInterference_toolt.ch: 允許電磁干擾 (EMI) 事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventEMIInterference_toolt.cn: 允许电磁干扰 (EMI) 事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventFuelReclamation_toolt.en: Allows the fuel reclamation helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventFuelReclamation_toolt.ch: 允許燃料回收直升機事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventFuelReclamation_toolt.cn: 允许燃料回收直升机事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventHostileAttack_tooltip.en: Allows the hostile helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventHostileAttack_tooltip.ch: 允許敵襲直升機事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventHostileAttack_tooltip.cn: 允许敌袭直升机事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventIncendiarySweep_toolt.en: Allows the incendiary sweep event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventIncendiarySweep_toolt.ch: 允許燃燒掃蕩事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventIncendiarySweep_toolt.cn: 允许燃烧扫荡事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventMilitaryVehicleStrike.en: Allows the military vehicle strike helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventMilitaryVehicleStrike.ch: 允許直升機打擊軍用車輛事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventMilitaryVehicleStrike.cn: 允许直升机打击军用车辆事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventPropagandaBroadcast_t.en: Allows the propaganda broadcast event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventPropagandaBroadcast_t.ch: 允許宣傳廣播事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventPropagandaBroadcast_t.cn: 允许宣传广播事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventSmokeCurtainEvent_too.en: Allows the smoke curtain event to run.

Sandbox_EnableEventSniperCover_tooltip.en: Allows the sniper cover event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSniperCover_tooltip.ch: 允許狙擊掩護事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventSniperCover_tooltip.cn: 允许狙击掩护事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventSupportAttack_tooltip.en: Allows the support attack helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSupportAttack_tooltip.ch: 允許空中支援直升機事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventSupportAttack_tooltip.cn: 允许空中支援直升机事件运行.

Sandbox_EnableEventSurveillanceEvent_too.en: Allows the surveillance event to run.

Sandbox_EnableEventToxic_tooltip.en: Allows the toxic helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventToxic_tooltip.ch: 允許毒氣直升機事件執行.
Sandbox_EnableEventToxic_tooltip.cn: 允许毒气直升机事件执行.

Sandbox_EnableEventUAVScan_tooltip.en: Allows the UAV scan event to run and broadcast zombie density reports by radio.
Sandbox_EnableEventUAVScan_tooltip.ch: 允許無人機掃描事件執行, 並透過無線電廣播殭屍密度報告.
Sandbox_EnableEventUAVScan_tooltip.cn: 允许无人机扫描事件执行, 并通过无线电广播僵尸密度报告.

Sandbox_EnableFixedDailyEventHour_toolti.en: When enabled, automatic HTT events ignore cooldowns and try to start once every in-game day at the fixed hour below.
Sandbox_EnableFixedDailyEventHour_toolti.ch: 啟用後, 自動 HTT 事件會忽略冷卻時間, 並在每個遊戲日的下列固定時刻嘗試啟動一次.
Sandbox_EnableFixedDailyEventHour_toolti.cn: 启用后, 自动 HTT 事件会忽略冷却时间, 并在每个游戏日的下列固定时刻尝试启动一次.

Sandbox_EnableGradualEventCessation_tool.en: Gradually increases intervals and lowers event probability until one final event occurs and helicopter events stop permanently.
Sandbox_EnableGradualEventCessation_tool.ch: 逐漸拉長間隔並降低事件機率, 直到發生最後一次事件, 之後直升機事件永久停止.
Sandbox_EnableGradualEventCessation_tool.cn: 逐渐拉长间隔并降低事件概率, 直到发生最后一次事件, 之后直升机事件永久停止.

Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk.ch: 啟用燃燒掃蕩玩家風險
Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk.cn: 启用燃烧扫荡玩家风险

Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk_.en: If enabled, incendiary sweeps can land in a reduced but still safe range near players; players are never directly targeted.
Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk_.ch: 啟用後, 燃燒掃蕩可落在玩家附近縮減但仍安全的範圍內; 玩家永遠不會被直接鎖定為目標.
Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk_.cn: 启用后, 燃烧扫荡可落在玩家附近缩减但仍安全的范围内; 玩家永远不会被直接锁定为目标.

Sandbox_EnableMod_tooltip.en: Master switch for this mod. If disabled, HTT will not start events.
Sandbox_EnableMod_tooltip.ch: 本模組的總開關. 停用後, HTT 不會啟動任何事件.
Sandbox_EnableMod_tooltip.cn: 本模组的总开关. 停用后, HTT 不会启动任何事件.

Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown.ch: 隨機冷卻時間至最大值
Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown.cn: 随机冷却时间至最大值

Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown_toolti.en: When enabled, each vanilla-triggered HTT event uses a random cooldown between 6 hours and the value configured in Time Between Events.
Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown_toolti.ch: 啟用後, 每個由原版觸發的 HTT 事件會採用介於 6 小時與事件間隔時間所設定數值之間的隨機冷卻時間.
Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown_toolti.cn: 启用后, 每个由原版触发的 HTT 事件会采用介于 6 小时与事件间隔时间所设定数值之间的随机冷却时间.

Sandbox_EnableVanillaHelicopterHook_tool.en: When enabled, a vanilla helicopter activation can trigger one HTT event while the vanilla helicopter keeps running.
Sandbox_EnableVanillaHelicopterHook_tool.ch: 啟用後, 原版直升機啟動時可觸發一次 HTT 事件, 且原版直升機會繼續運作.
Sandbox_EnableVanillaHelicopterHook_tool.cn: 启用后, 原版直升机启动时可触发一次 HTT 事件, 且原版直升机会继续运作.

Sandbox_EventCessationTimeRange_tooltip.en: The server rolls and persists a cessation date within the selected period.
Sandbox_EventCessationTimeRange_tooltip.ch: 伺服器會在所選期間內隨機決定停止日期, 並儲存該日期.
Sandbox_EventCessationTimeRange_tooltip.cn: 服务器会在所选期间内随机决定停止日期, 并保存该日期.

Sandbox_EventCooldownHours_tooltip.en: In-game hours between vanilla-triggered HTT events. Valid range: 6 to 168. If random cooldown is enabled, this value becomes the upper bound of the random range.
Sandbox_EventCooldownHours_tooltip.ch: 由原版觸發的 HTT 事件之間相隔的遊戲內小時數. 有效範圍: 6 至 168. 若已啟用隨機冷卻時間, 此數值會成為隨機範圍的上限.
Sandbox_EventCooldownHours_tooltip.cn: 由原版触发的 HTT 事件之间相隔的游戏内小时数. 有效范围: 6 至 168. 若已启用随机冷却时间, 此数值会成为随机范围的上限.

Sandbox_EventWeightHostileAttack_tooltip.en: Relative chance weight for the hostile helicopter attack event.
Sandbox_EventWeightHostileAttack_tooltip.ch: 敵對直升機攻擊事件的相對機率權重.
Sandbox_EventWeightHostileAttack_tooltip.cn: 敌对直升机攻击事件的相对几率权重.

Sandbox_EventWeightSupportAttack_tooltip.en: Relative chance weight for the support attack event.
Sandbox_EventWeightSupportAttack_tooltip.ch: 空中支援攻擊事件的相對機率權重.
Sandbox_EventWeightSupportAttack_tooltip.cn: 空中支援攻击事件的相对几率权重.

Sandbox_EventWeightToxic_tooltip.en: Relative chance weight for the toxic event.
Sandbox_EventWeightToxic_tooltip.ch: 毒氣事件的相對機率權重.
Sandbox_EventWeightToxic_tooltip.cn: 毒气事件的相对几率权重.

Sandbox_EventZombieAttractionRadiusPerce.en: Multiplies the tile radius of event sounds that attract zombies. 100 keeps the original range; 500 gives five times the range and is the default. Range: 0-500. 50 halves it and 0 disables this attraction. Audible volume is unchanged.
Sandbox_EventZombieAttractionRadiusPerce.ch: 將吸引殭屍的事件音效半徑 (格數) 乘上倍率. 100 維持原本範圍; 500 為五倍範圍, 也是預設值. 範圍: 0-500. 50 會減半, 0 則停用此吸引效果. 實際聽見的音量不變.
Sandbox_EventZombieAttractionRadiusPerce.cn: 将吸引僵尸的事件音效半径 (格数) 乘上倍率. 100 保持原有范围; 500 为五倍范围, 也是默认值. 范围: 0-500. 50 会减半, 0 则禁用此吸引效果. 实际听到的音量不变.

Sandbox_FixedDailyEventHour_tooltip.en: In-game hour used by the fixed daily scheduler. Example: 9.50 = 09:30.
Sandbox_FixedDailyEventHour_tooltip.ch: 固定每日排程器使用的遊戲內時刻. 範例: 9.50 = 09:30.
Sandbox_FixedDailyEventHour_tooltip.cn: 固定每日调度器使用的游戏内时刻. 示例: 9.50 = 09:30.

Sandbox_FuelReclamationDrainPercent_tool.en: Fuel percentage drained from loaded gas pumps when the fuel reclamation helicopter completes extraction.
Sandbox_FuelReclamationDrainPercent_tool.ch: 燃料回收直升機完成抽取時, 從已載入的加油機抽走的燃料百分比.
Sandbox_FuelReclamationDrainPercent_tool.cn: 燃料回收直升机完成抽取时, 从已加载的加油机抽走的燃料百分比.

Sandbox_HostileAttackHitChance_tooltip.en: Chance that a hostile burst lands a hit. Rolled once per burst.
Sandbox_HostileAttackHitChance_tooltip.ch: 敵方連射命中的機率. 每次連射判定一次.
Sandbox_HostileAttackHitChance_tooltip.cn: 敌方连射命中的几率. 每次连射判定一次.

Sandbox_MilitaryVehicleStrikeChance_tool.en: Chance that the military vehicle strike event will execute the attack when a valid military vehicle is found.
Sandbox_MilitaryVehicleStrikeChance_tool.ch: 軍用車輛打擊事件找到符合條件的軍用車輛時, 執行攻擊的機率.
Sandbox_MilitaryVehicleStrikeChance_tool.cn: 军用车辆打击事件找到符合条件的军用车辆时, 执行攻击的概率.

Sandbox_ToxicDamageCurvePower_tooltip.en: Damage curve exponent: higher values are gentler at low exposure and harsher near max.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageCurvePower_tooltip.ch: 傷害曲線的指數: 數值越高, 低暴露量時越平緩, 接近最大值時越嚴苛.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageCurvePower_tooltip.cn: 伤害曲线的指数: 数值越高, 低暴露量时越平缓, 接近最大值时越严苛.

Sandbox_ToxicDamageMinPerMinute_tooltip.en: Minimum per-minute toxic player damage once exposure passes the damage threshold.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageMinPerMinute_tooltip.ch: 暴露量超過傷害門檻後, 對玩家造成的每分鐘最低毒氣傷害.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageMinPerMinute_tooltip.cn: 暴露量超过伤害阈值后, 对玩家造成的每分钟最低毒气伤害.

Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu.ch: 完全暴露時毒氣傷害/分鐘
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu.cn: 完全暴露时毒气伤害/分钟

Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu.en: Base player health damage per minute when toxic exposure is at 100%%.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu.ch: 毒氣暴露量為 100%% 時, 玩家每分鐘受到的基礎生命值傷害.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu.cn: 毒气暴露量为 100%% 时, 玩家每分钟受到的基础生命值伤害.

Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick.ch: 毒氣對殭屍每次更新傷害
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick.cn: 毒气对僵尸每次更新伤害

Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick_tooltip.en: Legacy zombie toxic damage per tick. Player toxic damage uses the per-minute options below.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick_tooltip.ch: 舊版的每次更新殭屍毒氣傷害. 玩家的毒氣傷害使用下方的每分鐘選項.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick_tooltip.cn: 旧版的每次更新僵尸毒气伤害. 玩家的毒气伤害使用下方的每分钟选项.

Sandbox_ToxicDamagePreset_tooltip.en: Applies preset toxic damage/exposure and tick pacing values for quick balancing.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePreset_tooltip.ch: 套用預設的毒氣傷害/暴露量與更新間隔數值, 以便快速調整平衡.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePreset_tooltip.cn: 应用预设的毒气伤害/暴露量与更新间隔数值, 以便快速调整平衡.

Sandbox_ToxicEventDurationHours_tooltip.en: Duration in game hours used by toxic helicopter events. Other events still use Event Duration Hours.
Sandbox_ToxicEventDurationHours_tooltip.ch: 毒氣直升機事件採用的持續時間, 以遊戲內小時計. 其他事件仍使用事件持續小時數.
Sandbox_ToxicEventDurationHours_tooltip.cn: 毒气直升机事件采用的持续时间, 以游戏内小时计. 其他事件仍使用事件持续小时数.

Sandbox_ToxicExposureGainPerMin_tooltip.en: How fast toxic exposure builds per minute while unprotected.
Sandbox_ToxicExposureGainPerMin_tooltip.ch: 未受防護時, 毒氣暴露量每分鐘累積的速度.
Sandbox_ToxicExposureGainPerMin_tooltip.cn: 未受防护时, 毒气暴露量每分钟累积的速度.

Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx.ch: 毒氣額外傷害/分鐘 (最大)
Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx.cn: 毒气额外伤害/分钟 (最大)

Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx.en: Small extra per-minute damage when exposure is very high (>= 90%%).
Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx.ch: 暴露量非常高 (>= 90%%) 時, 每分鐘追加的少量額外傷害.
Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx.cn: 暴露量非常高 (>= 90%%) 时, 每分钟追加的少量额外伤害.

Sandbox_ToxicFilterMaxWearPercentPerEven.ch: 每次事件濾芯最大損耗 (%%)
Sandbox_ToxicFilterMaxWearPercentPerEven.cn: 每次事件滤芯最大损耗 (%%)

Sandbox_ToxicFilterMaxWearPercentPerEven.en: Wear limit for the same filter during one toxic event. The default prevents one new filter from being exhausted by a single event.
Sandbox_ToxicFilterMaxWearPercentPerEven.ch: 同一個濾芯在單次毒氣事件中的損耗上限. 預設值可避免一個全新濾芯被單一事件耗盡.
Sandbox_ToxicFilterMaxWearPercentPerEven.cn: 同一个滤芯在单次毒气事件中的损耗上限. 默认值可避免一个全新滤芯被单一事件耗尽.

Sandbox_ToxicFilterWearPercentPerHour_to.en: Percentage of a full gas-mask filter or air tank consumed per hour of direct gas exposure.
Sandbox_ToxicFilterWearPercentPerHour_to.ch: 直接暴露於毒氣時, 每小時消耗的完整防毒面具濾芯或氣瓶百分比.
Sandbox_ToxicFilterWearPercentPerHour_to.cn: 直接暴露于毒气时, 每小时消耗的完整防毒面具滤芯或气瓶百分比.

Sandbox_ToxicMaskMinHealth.ch: 具備呼吸防護時的最低生命值
Sandbox_ToxicMaskMinHealth.cn: 具备呼吸防护时的最低生命值

Sandbox_ToxicMaskMinHealth_tooltip.en: Toxic gas will not reduce health below this value while a recognized mask, respirator, or cloth face covering is worn.
Sandbox_ToxicMaskMinHealth_tooltip.ch: 穿戴可辨識的面具, 呼吸器或布質面罩時, 毒氣不會將生命值降到此數值以下.
Sandbox_ToxicMaskMinHealth_tooltip.cn: 穿戴可辨识的面具, 呼吸器或布质面罩时, 毒气不会将生命值降到此数值以下.

Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage.ch: 舊版毒氣最大生命值傷害
Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage.cn: 旧版毒气最大生命值伤害

Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage_too.en: Legacy compatibility value. Prefer the per-minute toxic damage options below.
Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage_too.ch: 舊版相容性數值. 建議改用下方的每分鐘毒氣傷害選項.
Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage_too.cn: 旧版兼容性数值. 建议改用下方的每分钟毒气伤害选项.

Sandbox_ToxicTickSeconds_tooltip.en: Seconds between each toxic damage/exposure server tick.
Sandbox_ToxicTickSeconds_tooltip.ch: 伺服器每次更新毒氣傷害/暴露量之間的秒數.
Sandbox_ToxicTickSeconds_tooltip.cn: 服务器每次更新毒气伤害/暴露量之间的秒数.

Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents.en: Use Vanilla Rotor In HTT Events
Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents.ch: 在 HTT 事件中使用原版旋翼聲
Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents.cn: 在 HTT 事件中使用原版旋翼声

Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents_to.en: Applies only to legacy audio. New audio always uses Rotor-Chop.
Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents_to.ch: 僅適用於舊版音效. 新版音效一律使用 Rotor-Chop.
Sandbox_UseVanillaRotorSoundsInEvents_to.cn: 仅适用于旧版音效. 新版音效始终使用 Rotor-Chop.

Sandbox_VanillaHookTriggerChance_tooltip.en: Chance (0-100) that a vanilla helicopter trigger starts an HTT event.
Sandbox_VanillaHookTriggerChance_tooltip.ch: 原版直升機觸發時啟動 HTT 事件的機率 (0-100).
Sandbox_VanillaHookTriggerChance_tooltip.cn: 原版直升机触发时启动 HTT 事件的几率 (0-100).

Sandbox_PlayablePool_CasualCallRules.ch: 休閒 8 號球規則 (不需指定球)
Sandbox_PlayablePool_CasualCallRules.cn: 休闲 8 号球规则 (无需指定球)

Sandbox_PlayablePool_CasualCallRules_too.en: Drops the call-shot conventions from 8-ball: pocketing one of your own balls keeps the table (the opponent's balls alone do not), a mixed drop still takes a group, and clearing your group plus the 8 on one legal shot wins. Scratches, wrong-group hits, and illegal breaks are still fouls. Off means standard rules.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_CasualCallRules_too.ch: 取消 8 號球的指定球慣例: 打進自己的球才能繼續擊球 (只打進對手的球不算), 一桿同時打進不同球組的球仍可取得一個球組, 在同一次合法擊球中清光自己的球組再加上 8 號球即獲勝. 母球落袋, 擊中錯誤球組, 以及不合法的開球仍算犯規. 關閉代表使用標準規則.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_CasualCallRules_too.cn: 取消 8 号球的指定球惯例: 打进自己的球才能继续击球 (只打进对手的球不算), 一杆同时打进不同球组的球仍可取得一个球组, 在同一次合法击球中清光自己的球组再加上 8 号球即获胜. 母球落袋, 击中错误球组, 以及不合法的开球仍算犯规. 关闭代表使用标准规则.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_DisconnectGraceSeco.en: Keep a disconnected player's seat and chips for this long. Default: 120 seconds. Rejoining within this time restores the seat.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_DisconnectGraceSeco.ch: 斷線玩家的座位與籌碼會保留這段時間. 預設: 120 秒. 在這段時間內重新加入可恢復座位.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_DisconnectGraceSeco.cn: 掉线玩家的座位与筹码会保留这段时间. 默认: 120 秒. 在这段时间内重新加入可恢复座位.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableBlackjack_too.en: Offer Blackjack at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableBlackjack_too.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供二十一點. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableBlackjack_too.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供二十一点. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableCheckers_tool.en: Offer Checkers at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableCheckers_tool.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供西洋跳棋. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableCheckers_tool.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供西洋跳棋. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableChess_tooltip.en: Offer Chess at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableChess_tooltip.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供西洋棋. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableChess_tooltip.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供国际象棋. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableConnect4_tool.en: Offer Connect 4 at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableConnect4_tool.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供四子棋. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableConnect4_tool.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供四子棋. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableDarts501_tool.en: Offer Darts 501 at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableDarts501_tool.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供飛鏢 501. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableDarts501_tool.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供飞镖 501. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableHoldem_toolti.en: Offer Texas Hold'em at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableHoldem_toolti.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供德州撲克. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableHoldem_toolti.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供德州扑克. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableRecords_toolt.en: Saves a per-character record of games played, won and lost, the shared card-room chip balance used by Hold'em and blackjack, and Balatroid stake unlocks. This is the only thing Playable Pool writes into a save; turn it off and the card room uses table-only chips and nothing is stored. Live games are never saved either way.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableRecords_toolt.ch: 為每個角色儲存對局場次, 勝場與敗場的紀錄, 德州撲克與二十一點共用的牌室籌碼餘額, 以及 Balatroid 的賭注等級解鎖. 這是可遊玩的撞球唯一寫入存檔的東西; 關閉後牌室只使用該桌專用的籌碼, 什麼都不會被儲存. 無論哪種情況, 進行中的對局都不會被存檔.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableRecords_toolt.cn: 为每个角色保存对局场次, 胜场与败场的记录, 德州扑克与二十一点共用的牌室筹码余额, 以及 Balatroid 的赌注等级解锁. 这是可玩的台球唯一写入存档的东西; 关闭后牌室只使用该桌专用的筹码, 什么都不会被保存. 无论哪种情况, 进行中的对局都不会被存档.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableSolitaire_too.en: Offer Solitaire at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableSolitaire_too.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供紙牌接龍. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableSolitaire_too.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供纸牌接龙. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableWordle_toolti.en: Offer Wordle at its game surface. When disabled, the menu explains which setting blocks it, and the host refuses to start, join, or watch it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableWordle_toolti.ch: 在對應的遊戲檯面提供 Wordle. 停用時, 選單會說明是哪項設定擋下它, 主機也會拒絕開始, 加入或觀看它.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_EnableWordle_toolti.cn: 在对应的游戏台面提供 Wordle. 停用时, 菜单会说明是哪项设置挡下它, 主机也会拒绝开始, 加入或观看它.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_HouseStake_tooltip.en: When a seated player has too few chips to buy in and no chips committed at any table, top up their bankroll to this amount or the table minimum, whichever is higher. Default: 50. Set 0 to disable.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_HouseStake_tooltip.ch: 當入座玩家的籌碼少到無法買入, 且在任何牌桌上都沒有投入籌碼時, 把他的資金補到這個數額或該桌最低買入, 取兩者較高者. 預設: 50. 設為 0 可停用.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_HouseStake_tooltip.cn: 当入座玩家的筹码少到无法买入, 且在任何牌桌上都没有投入筹码时, 把其资金补到这个数额或该桌最低买入, 取两者较高者. 默认: 50. 设为 0 可停用.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_ParkedSessionMinute.ch: 全員離席時的桌台保留時間 (分鐘)
Sandbox_PlayablePool_ParkedSessionMinute.cn: 全员离席时的桌台保留时间 (分钟)

Sandbox_PlayablePool_ParkedSessionMinute.en: Release the equipment when every human seat has been parked for this long. Default: 2 minutes. A solo game stays available while its living owner remains nearby.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_ParkedSessionMinute.ch: 當所有真人座位都離席達到這段時間後, 釋放該遊戲器材. 預設: 2 分鐘. 單人遊戲只要它還活著的擁有者待在附近, 就會一直保留.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_ParkedSessionMinute.cn: 当所有真人座位都离席达到这段时间后, 释放该游戏器材. 默认: 2 分钟. 单人游戏只要它还活着的拥有者待在附近, 就会一直保留.

Sandbox_PlayablePool_TurnTimeoutSeconds_.en: Turn time limit when at least two humans are seated. A timeout folds in Hold'em, stands in blackjack, skips darts, gives ball in hand in pool, or loses a board game on time. The clock is visible. Solo games and games against bots have no turn clock. Set 0 to disable.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_TurnTimeoutSeconds_.ch: 至少有兩名真人入座時的回合時間限制. 逾時在德州撲克算棄牌, 在二十一點算停牌, 在飛鏢算跳過, 在撞球則交出自由球, 在桌上遊戲則判超時落敗. 計時會顯示出來. 單人遊戲以及對戰電腦玩家的遊戲沒有回合計時. 設為 0 可停用.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_TurnTimeoutSeconds_.cn: 至少有两名真人入座时的回合时间限制. 超时在德州扑克算弃牌, 在二十一点算停牌, 在飞镖算跳过, 在台球则交出自由球, 在桌上游戏则判超时落败. 计时会显示出来. 单人游戏以及对战电脑玩家的游戏没有回合计时. 设为 0 可停用.

Sandbox_EnableEventFlashbang_tooltip.en: Flashes every 12 seconds briefly whiten the vision of players outdoors within range. Interiors protect against new flashes.
Sandbox_EnableEventFlashbang_tooltip.ch: 每 12 秒一次的閃光會讓範圍內位於戶外的玩家視野短暫變白. 待在室內可免受新的閃光影響.
Sandbox_EnableEventFlashbang_tooltip.cn: 每 12 秒一次的闪光会让范围内位于户外的玩家视野短暂变白. 待在室内可免受新的闪光影响.

Sandbox_EnableEventSleepGas_tooltip.en: Purple gas causes intense drowsiness and temporary endurance loss outdoors. Players recover the gas effect on leaving the cloud. Does not force sleep.
Sandbox_EnableEventSleepGas_tooltip.ch: 紫色氣體會在戶外造成強烈睏意與暫時的耐力流失. 玩家離開氣體雲後即可從氣體效果中恢復. 不會強制入睡.
Sandbox_EnableEventSleepGas_tooltip.cn: 紫色气体会在户外造成强烈困意和暂时的耐力流失. 玩家离开气体云后即可从气体效果中恢复. 不会强制入睡.

Sandbox_EnableEventZombieRepellent_toolt.en: A helicopter drives nearby zombies away from its followed player.
Sandbox_EnableEventZombieRepellent_toolt.ch: 直升機會把附近的殭屍從它跟隨的玩家身邊驅離.
Sandbox_EnableEventZombieRepellent_toolt.cn: 直升机会把附近的僵尸从它跟随的玩家身边驱离.

Sandbox_FlashBlindSeconds_tooltip.en: Seconds of temporary white vision, including the gradual fade. Worn sunglasses halve this duration.
Sandbox_FlashBlindSeconds_tooltip.ch: 視野暫時變白的秒數, 包含逐漸淡出的時間. 配戴太陽眼鏡可使持續時間減半.
Sandbox_FlashBlindSeconds_tooltip.cn: 视野暂时变白的秒数, 包括逐渐淡出的时间. 佩戴太阳镜可使持续时间减半.

Sandbox_FlashRadius_tooltip.en: Outdoor flash exposure radius in tiles.
Sandbox_FlashRadius_tooltip.ch: 戶外閃光暴露半徑, 單位為格.
Sandbox_FlashRadius_tooltip.cn: 户外闪光暴露半径, 单位为格.

Sandbox_RepellentRadius_tooltip.en: Radius in tiles around the followed player. Only loaded zombies can be redirected.
Sandbox_RepellentRadius_tooltip.ch: 以被跟隨玩家為中心的半徑, 單位為格. 只有已載入的殭屍會被引導離開.
Sandbox_RepellentRadius_tooltip.cn: 以被跟随玩家为中心的半径, 单位为格. 只有已加载的僵尸会被引导离开.

Sandbox_SleepGasRadius_tooltip.en: Outdoor gas exposure radius in tiles. Indoors and leaving this radius allow recovery. Masks slow fatigue and endurance loss; filters wear 25% faster than the base toxic gas rate, with the same per-event limit.
Sandbox_SleepGasRadius_tooltip.ch: 戶外氣體暴露半徑, 單位為格. 待在室內或離開此半徑即可恢復. 面具可減緩疲勞與耐力流失; 濾芯的消耗速度比基礎毒氣速率快 25%%, 每次事件的上限相同.
Sandbox_SleepGasRadius_tooltip.cn: 户外气体暴露半径, 单位为格. 待在室内或离开此半径即可恢复. 面具可减缓疲劳和耐力流失; 滤芯的消耗速度比基础毒气速率快 25%%, 每次事件的上限相同.

Sandbox_ToxicGasRadius_tooltip.en: Toxic gas exposure radius in tiles. Range: 10-100; default: 18. Applies to players and zombies.
Sandbox_ToxicGasRadius_tooltip.ch: 毒氣暴露半徑, 單位為格. 範圍: 10-100; 預設: 18. 對玩家與殭屍皆適用.
Sandbox_ToxicGasRadius_tooltip.cn: 毒气暴露半径, 单位为格. 范围: 10-100; 默认: 18. 对玩家和僵尸均适用.

Sandbox_UseLegacyEventSounds_tooltip.en: Restores the original sounds and event sequences. Disabled: 30-second Rotor-Chop warning, then event audio alongside a continuous rotor. New events always use the new audio.
Sandbox_UseLegacyEventSounds_tooltip.ch: 恢復原本的音效與事件流程. 停用時: 先有 30 秒的旋翼拍打聲預警, 接著事件音效會與持續的旋翼聲一同播放. 新事件一律使用新音效.
Sandbox_UseLegacyEventSounds_tooltip.cn: 恢复原本的音效和事件流程. 禁用时: 先有 30 秒的旋翼拍打声预警, 随后事件音效会与持续的旋翼声一同播放. 新事件始终使用新音效.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AllowPlayerDeathC.en: Allow Players to Choose Vanilla Death
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AllowPlayerDeathC.ch: 允許玩家選擇原版死亡
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AllowPlayerDeathC.cn: 允许玩家选择原版死亡

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AllowPlayerDeathC.en: Allow each player to choose Use Vanilla Death in Options > Mods > Extraction Mode. Players who leave it unchecked follow Death Handling above, including its equipment-loss rules. Changes take effect in the hideout before readying up. Disabled: everyone follows Death Handling. Applies everywhere, including hideouts and Admin Kill User.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AllowPlayerDeathC.ch: 允許每位玩家在 選項 > 模組 > 撤離模式 中選擇「使用原版死亡」. 未勾選的玩家依照上方的「死亡處理」, 包含其裝備損失規則. 變更須在就緒前於藏身點內才會生效. 停用時: 所有人都依照「死亡處理」. 適用於所有地點, 包含藏身點與管理員擊殺玩家.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AllowPlayerDeathC.cn: 允许每位玩家在 选项 > 模组 > 撤离模式 中选择“使用原版死亡”. 未勾选的玩家遵循上方的“死亡处理”, 包括其装备损失规则. 更改需在就绪前于藏身点内才会生效. 禁用时: 所有人都遵循“死亡处理”. 适用于所有地点, 包括藏身点和管理员击杀玩家.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AmbientSprinterPe.en:
Only applies when vanilla zombie speed settings are unchanged.

Percentage of regular zombies that can be sprinters after the first seven game days.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AmbientSprinterPe.ch:
僅在原版殭屍速度設定未更改時適用.

開局前七個遊戲天數過後, 一般殭屍中可能成為衝刺殭屍的百分比.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AmbientSprinterPe.cn:
仅在原版僵尸速度设置未更改时适用.

最初七个游戏日之后, 普通僵尸中可能成为跑者的百分比.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditGroupMaximu.en:
Requires optional NPC attack integration and Bandit Attack Chance per Window above 0.

Largest group requested by a regular attack using the selected provider, limited by usable faction profiles and safe tiles. NPC horde replacements use separate size settings.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditGroupMaximu.ch:
需要選用的 NPC 攻擊整合, 且「每個時窗的匪徒攻擊機率」大於 0.

使用所選來源模組的一般攻擊所要求的最大小隊規模, 實際規模受可用的陣營設定檔與安全地塊限制. NPC 替換屍潮使用另外的規模設定.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditGroupMaximu.cn:
需要可选的 NPC 攻击集成, 且“匪徒攻击窗口概率”大于 0.

使用所选来源模组的普通攻击所请求的最大小队规模, 实际规模受可用的派系配置和安全地块限制. NPC 替换尸潮使用单独的规模设置.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditGroupMinimu.en:
Requires optional NPC attack integration and Bandit Attack Chance per Window above 0.

Smallest group requested by a regular attack using the selected provider, limited by usable faction profiles and safe tiles. NPC horde replacements use separate size settings.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditGroupMinimu.ch:
需要選用的 NPC 攻擊整合, 且「每個時窗的匪徒攻擊機率」大於 0.

使用所選來源模組的一般攻擊所要求的最小小隊規模, 實際規模受可用的陣營設定檔與安全地塊限制. NPC 替換屍潮使用另外的規模設定.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditGroupMinimu.cn:
需要可选的 NPC 攻击集成, 且“匪徒攻击窗口概率”大于 0.

使用所选来源模组的普通攻击所请求的最小小队规模, 实际规模受可用的派系配置和安全地块限制. NPC 替换尸潮使用单独的规模设置.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeGroupM.en: Largest base NPC group that replaces a zombie horde, using the selected provider. Escalating Horde Waves scales this size from 20%% to 200%%. A-Life respects native population capacity, can reuse faction profiles, and caps each replacement at 32 NPCs.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeGroupM.ch: 使用所選來源模組替換殭屍屍潮時的最大基礎 NPC 小隊規模. 「遞增屍潮波次」會把此規模從 20%% 縮放到 200%%. A-Life 會遵守原生人口容量, 可重複使用陣營設定檔, 且每次替換最多 32 名 NPC.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeGroupM.cn: 使用所选来源模组替换僵尸尸潮时的最大基础 NPC 小队规模. “递增尸潮波次”会把此规模从 20%% 缩放到 200%%. A-Life 会遵守原生人口容量, 可重复使用派系配置, 且每次替换最多 32 名 NPC.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeGroupM.en: Smallest base NPC group that replaces a zombie horde, using the selected provider. Escalating Horde Waves scales this size from 20%% to 200%%. A-Life respects native population capacity, can reuse faction profiles, and caps each replacement at 32 NPCs.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeGroupM.ch: 使用所選來源模組替換殭屍屍潮時的最小基礎 NPC 小隊規模. 「遞增屍潮波次」會把此規模從 20%% 縮放到 200%%. A-Life 會遵守原生人口容量, 可重複使用陣營設定檔, 且每次替換最多 32 名 NPC.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BanditHordeGroupM.cn: 使用所选来源模组替换僵尸尸潮时的最小基础 NPC 小队规模. “递增尸潮波次”会把此规模从 20%% 缩放到 200%%. A-Life 会遵守原生人口容量, 可重复使用派系配置, 且每次替换最多 32 名 NPC.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BaseDailyTownChoi.en:
Only applies to Coop | Single Hideout before the Comm Array upgrade is installed.

Number of regular raid destinations offered each game day.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BaseDailyTownChoi.ch:
僅適用於「合作 | 單一藏身點」, 且尚未安裝通訊陣列升級時.

每個遊戲日提供的一般突襲目的地數量.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BaseDailyTownChoi.cn:
仅适用于“合作 | 单一藏身点”, 且尚未安装通讯阵列升级时.

每个游戏日提供的普通突袭目的地数量.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BoardingWindowSec.en: How long the helicopter waits for players to board before leaving, in real seconds.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BoardingWindowSec.ch: 直升機在離開前等待玩家登機的時間, 以現實秒數計.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_BoardingWindowSec.cn: 直升机在离开前等待玩家登机的时间, 以现实秒数计.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_CommArrayDailyTow.en:
Requires Coop | Single Hideout and the Comm Array hideout upgrade.

Number of regular raid destinations offered each game day. Replaces Daily Raid Destinations Before Comm Array.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_CommArrayDailyTow.ch:
需要「合作 | 單一藏身點」與通訊陣列藏身點升級.

每個遊戲日提供的一般突襲目的地數量. 取代「通訊陣列前的每日突襲目的地」.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_CommArrayDailyTow.cn:
需要“合作 | 单一藏身点”和通讯阵列藏身点升级.

每个游戏日提供的普通突袭目的地数量. 取代“通讯阵列前的每日突袭目的地”.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_CommArrayHelicopt.en:
Requires the Comm Array hideout upgrade.

How long the extraction helicopter takes to arrive after a flare, in real seconds. Replaces Base Helicopter Arrival.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_CommArrayHelicopt.ch:
需要通訊陣列藏身點升級.

發射訊號彈後撤離直升機抵達所需的時間, 以現實秒數計. 取代「基礎直升機抵達時間」.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_CommArrayHelicopt.cn:
需要通讯阵列藏身点升级.

发射信号弹后撤离直升机到达所需的时间, 以现实秒数计. 取代“基础直升机到达时间”.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_DebugLogging_tool.en: Enables extra troubleshooting logs and Extraction Mode debug tools. Multiplayer debug actions remain restricted to authorized admins.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_DebugLogging_tool.ch: 啟用額外的疑難排解日誌與撤離模式除錯工具. 多人遊戲的除錯動作仍僅限授權的管理員使用.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_DebugLogging_tool.cn: 启用额外的故障排查日志和撤离模式调试工具. 多人游戏的调试操作仍仅限授权的管理员使用.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EnableLocationRef.en:
Restocks locations after the chosen number of completed raids, once all players leave. Other refresh settings control food, bodies, blood, and zombies.

Items stored in ordinary map containers are lost. Hideouts, safehouses, moved or player-built storage, and vehicle cargo are protected. Buildings are not repaired.

Keep vanilla loot respawn disabled when using this option.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EnableLocationRef.ch:
在完成所選數量的突襲後, 待所有玩家離開, 便會為地點重新補貨. 其他刷新設定控制食物, 屍體, 血跡與殭屍.

存放在一般地圖容器中的物品會遺失. 藏身點, 安全屋, 移動過或玩家建造的儲物空間, 以及車輛貨物都受到保護. 建築物不會被修復.

使用此選項時, 請保持原版戰利品重生為停用.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EnableLocationRef.cn:
在完成所选数量的突袭后, 待所有玩家离开, 便会为地点重新补货. 其他刷新设置控制食物、尸体、血迹和僵尸.

存放在普通地图容器中的物品会丢失. 藏身点、安全屋、移动过或玩家建造的储物空间以及车辆货物都受到保护. 建筑不会被修复.

使用此选项时, 请保持原版物资重生为禁用.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionHordeSp.en:
Requires Easier Extractions to be off and Initial Flare Response Zombies per Player to be above 0.

Approximate distance from the flare caller where extraction response zombies appear, in tiles.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionHordeSp.ch:
需要「更輕鬆的撤離」為關閉, 且「每位玩家初始訊號彈引來的殭屍數量」大於 0.

撤離回應殭屍出現的位置與訊號彈發射者之間的大約距離, 單位為格.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionHordeSp.cn:
需要关闭“更简单的撤离”, 且“每位玩家初始信号枪引来的僵尸数量”大于 0.

撤离响应僵尸出现的位置与信号弹发射者之间的大致距离, 单位为格.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionRadius_.en: How close you must be to an extraction site to call the helicopter, measured in tiles.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionRadius_.ch: 你必須距離撤離點多近才能呼叫直升機, 單位為格.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ExtractionRadius_.cn: 你必须距离撤离点多近才能呼叫直升机, 单位为格.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorFuelPerD.en: Base fuel used per game day while the hideout generator runs. Upgrades and power use can change the final amount.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorFuelPerD.ch: 藏身點發電機運轉時每個遊戲日消耗的基礎燃料. 升級與用電量會改變最終數值.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorFuelPerD.cn: 藏身点发电机运转时每个游戏日消耗的基础燃料. 升级和用电量会改变最终数值.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorTankCapa.en: Maximum fuel the hideout generator can hold.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorTankCapa.ch: 藏身點發電機可容納的最大燃料量.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorTankCapa.cn: 藏身点发电机可容纳的最大燃料量.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorTransfer.en: Maximum fuel added each time you refuel the hideout generator.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorTransfer.ch: 每次為藏身點發電機加油時加入的最大燃料量.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_GeneratorTransfer.cn: 每次为藏身点发电机加油时添加的最大燃料量.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HelicopterArrival.en:
Applies when the Comm Array upgrade is not installed.

How long the extraction helicopter takes to arrive after a flare, in real seconds.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HelicopterArrival.ch:
適用於尚未安裝通訊陣列升級時.

發射訊號彈後撤離直升機抵達所需的時間, 以現實秒數計.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HelicopterArrival.cn:
适用于尚未安装通讯阵列升级时.

发射信号弹后撤离直升机到达所需的时间, 以现实秒数计.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutClutterCou.en: Number of clutter items placed in a newly prepared hideout. Set to 0 for no clutter. Does not change existing hideout clutter.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutClutterCou.ch: 在新整備的藏身點中放置的雜物數量. 設為 0 則不放置雜物. 不會改變既有藏身點的雜物.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutClutterCou.cn: 在新准备的藏身点中放置的杂物数量. 设为 0 则不放置杂物. 不会改变现有藏身点的杂物.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutHeatingRad.en:
Requires the Heating hideout upgrade and generator power.

How far heat spreads from hideout heating sources, in tiles.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutHeatingRad.ch:
需要暖氣藏身點升級與發電機供電.

熱量從藏身點供暖來源擴散的距離, 單位為格.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutHeatingRad.cn:
需要供暖藏身点升级和发电机供电.

热量从藏身点供暖源扩散的距离, 单位为格.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutInfectionC.en: Limits Knox infection to this percentage while you are inside a hideout. Infection can progress again when you leave. This does not cure it.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutInfectionC.ch: 你在藏身點內時, 諾克斯感染會被限制在此百分比. 離開後感染會再次惡化. 這不會治癒感染.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HideoutInfectionC.cn: 你在藏身点内时, 诺克斯感染会被限制在此百分比. 离开后感染会再次恶化. 这不会治愈感染.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeDelayMaximum.en:
Normal Raids only. Free Roam uses a 24-hour interval plus the Intel Center bonus.

Longest starting delay before the first raid horde, in game hours. Set this and Minimum Horde Delay to the same value for a fixed starting delay.

Vehicles and hideout upgrades can change the arrival time.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeDelayMaximum.ch:
僅限一般突襲. 自由漫遊改用 24 小時間隔, 再加上情報中心的加成.

第一波突襲屍潮出現前的最長起始延遲, 單位為遊戲內小時. 將此項與「屍潮最短延遲」設為相同數值, 即可獲得固定的起始延遲.

車輛與藏身點升級可能會改變抵達時間.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeDelayMaximum.cn:
仅限普通突袭. 自由漫游改用 24 小时间隔, 再加上情报中心的加成.

第一波突袭尸潮出现前的最大起始延迟, 单位为游戏内小时. 将此项与“尸潮最小延迟”设为相同数值, 即可获得固定的起始延迟.

车辆和藏身点升级可能会改变到达时间.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeDelayMinimum.en:
Normal Raids only. Free Roam uses a 24-hour interval plus the Intel Center bonus.

Shortest starting delay before the first raid horde, in game hours. The delay is randomly chosen between this value and Maximum Horde Delay.

Vehicles and hideout upgrades can change the arrival time.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeDelayMinimum.ch:
僅限一般突襲. 自由漫遊改用 24 小時間隔, 再加上情報中心的加成.

第一波突襲屍潮出現前的最短起始延遲, 單位為遊戲內小時. 延遲會在此數值與「屍潮最長延遲」之間隨機決定.

車輛與藏身點升級可能會改變抵達時間.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeDelayMinimum.cn:
仅限普通突袭. 自由漫游改用 24 小时间隔, 再加上情报中心的加成.

第一波突袭尸潮出现前的最小起始延迟, 单位为游戏内小时. 延迟会在此数值与“尸潮最大延迟”之间随机决定.

车辆和藏身点升级可能会改变到达时间.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSize_tooltip.en: Number of zombies in a full raid horde. With Escalating Horde Waves enabled, each of the five waves uses a percentage of this amount (20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, then 200%%), and waves after the fifth use 100%%.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSize_tooltip.ch: 一整波突襲屍潮的殭屍數量. 啟用「遞增屍潮波次」時, 五個波次會依序使用此數量的 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%% 與 200%%, 第五波之後的波次則使用 100%%.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSize_tooltip.cn: 一整波突袭尸潮的僵尸数量. 启用“递增尸潮波次”时, 五个波次会依次使用该数量的 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%% 和 200%%, 第五波之后的波次则使用 100%%.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSpawnRadius_.en: Approximate distance from players where raid horde zombies appear, in tiles. Larger values give more distance before they reach you.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSpawnRadius_.ch: 突襲屍潮殭屍出現位置與玩家之間的大約距離, 單位為格. 數值越大, 它們抵達你身邊前的距離越遠.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSpawnRadius_.cn: 突袭尸潮僵尸出现位置与玩家之间的大致距离, 单位为格. 数值越大, 它们到达你身边前的距离越远.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSprinterPerc.en:
Only applies when vanilla zombie speed settings are unchanged.

Percentage of raid horde zombies that can be sprinters. Escalating Horde Waves increases this chance in later waves.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSprinterPerc.ch:
僅在原版殭屍速度設定未更改時適用.

突襲屍潮殭屍中可能成為衝刺殭屍的百分比. 「遞增屍潮波次」會在後續波次提高此機率.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_HordeSprinterPerc.cn:
仅在原版僵尸速度设置未更改时适用.

突袭尸潮僵尸中可能成为跑者的百分比. “递增尸潮波次”会在后续波次提高此概率.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_InsertionClearRad.en: Distance around the insertion point cleared of zombies when players arrive, in tiles. Larger values give players more clear space on arrival.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_InsertionClearRad.ch: 玩家抵達時, 抵達點周圍清除殭屍的距離, 單位為格. 數值越大, 玩家抵達時的淨空範圍越大.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_InsertionClearRad.cn: 玩家抵达时, 抵达点周围清除僵尸的距离, 单位为格. 数值越大, 玩家抵达时的清空范围越大.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_IntelHordeDelayBo.en:
Requires the Intel Center hideout upgrade.

Extra time before the first raid horde, in game hours. In Free Roam, this is also added to every 24-hour repeat interval. Default +3 means a 27-hour wait before each Free Roam major horde.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_IntelHordeDelayBo.ch:
需要情報中心藏身點升級.

第一波突襲屍潮出現前額外增加的時間, 單位為遊戲內小時. 在自由漫遊中, 這也會加到每次 24 小時的重複間隔上. 預設 +3 表示每次自由漫遊大型屍潮前要等 27 小時.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_IntelHordeDelayBo.cn:
需要情报中心藏身点升级.

第一波突袭尸潮出现前额外增加的时间, 单位为游戏内小时. 在自由漫游中, 这也会加到每次 24 小时的重复间隔上. 默认 +3 表示每次自由漫游大型尸潮前要等 27 小时.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_IntelInsertionCle.en:
Requires the Intel Center hideout upgrade.

Extra tiles added to Insertion Zombie Clear Radius.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_IntelInsertionCle.ch:
需要情報中心藏身點升級.

額外加到「抵達點殭屍清除半徑」的格數.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_IntelInsertionCle.cn:
需要情报中心藏身点升级.

额外加到“抵达点僵尸清除半径”的格数.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshAf.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh.

Completed raids before a location refreshes. Set to 1 to refresh after every raid. Raids count whether players extract or die. A shared rotating raid counts once for all teams.

New deployments wait until the refresh finishes. Louisville uses Louisville Refresh After Raids.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshAf.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」.

地點刷新前需完成的突襲次數. 設為 1 則每次突襲後都刷新. 無論玩家撤離或死亡, 突襲都會計入. 共享的輪換突襲對所有隊伍只計算一次.

新的部署會等待刷新完成. 路易斯維爾使用「路易斯維爾幾次突襲後刷新」.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshAf.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”.

地点刷新前需完成的突袭次数. 设为 1 则每次突袭后都刷新. 无论玩家撤离还是死亡, 突袭都会计入. 共享的轮换突袭对所有队伍只计算一次.

新的部署会等待刷新完成. 路易斯维尔使用“路易斯维尔几次突袭后刷新”.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshBl.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh.

Removes blood when a location refreshes.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshBl.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」.

地點刷新時清除血跡.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshBl.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”.

地点刷新时清除血迹.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshCo.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh.

Removes existing zombie and animal bodies, including their items, when a location refreshes. Player bodies remain unless Remove Player Corpses on Location Refresh is also enabled.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshCo.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」.

地點刷新時清除既有的殭屍與動物屍體, 包含其身上的物品. 除非同時啟用「地點刷新時清除玩家屍體」, 否則玩家屍體會保留.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshCo.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”.

地点刷新时清除现有的僵尸和动物尸体, 包括其身上的物品. 除非同时启用“地点刷新时清除玩家尸体”, 否则玩家尸体会保留.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshFr.ch: 地點刷新時補充新鮮食物
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshFr.cn: 地点刷新时补充新鲜食物

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshFr.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh.

Food added by a location refresh starts fresh, then spoils normally.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshFr.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」.

地點刷新加入的食物一開始是新鮮的, 之後照常腐壞.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshFr.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”.

地点刷新添加的食物一开始是新鲜的, 之后照常腐坏.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshLo.ch: 路易斯維爾幾次突襲後刷新
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshLo.cn: 路易斯维尔几次突袭后刷新

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshLo.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh.

Completed raids before Louisville refreshes. Louisville and Grand Ohio Mall count together. Refreshing waits until all players leave.

Louisville Airport and Louisville Checkpoint use Refresh After Raids instead.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshLo.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」.

路易斯維爾刷新前需完成的突襲次數. 路易斯維爾與大俄亥俄購物中心合併計算. 刷新會等待所有玩家離開.

路易斯維爾機場與路易斯維爾檢查站改用「幾次突襲後刷新」.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshLo.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”.

路易斯维尔刷新前需完成的突袭次数. 路易斯维尔与大俄亥俄购物中心合并计算. 刷新会等待所有玩家离开.

路易斯维尔机场和路易斯维尔检查站改用“几次突袭后刷新”.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshPl.en: Remove Player Corpses on Location Refresh
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshPl.ch: 地點刷新時清除玩家屍體
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshPl.cn: 地点刷新时清除玩家尸体

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshPl.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh and Remove Corpses on Location Refresh.

Also removes player bodies and all items on them when a location refreshes.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshPl.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」與「地點刷新時清除屍體」.

地點刷新時一併清除玩家屍體及其身上的所有物品.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshPl.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”和“地点刷新时清除尸体”.

地点刷新时一并清除玩家尸体及其身上的所有物品.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh and Refresh Zombie Population.

How many regular zombies return during a refresh. 100%% follows the map and your zombie population settings. 200%% doubles that amount. Set to 0 to add none.

Does not affect raid hordes.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」與「刷新殭屍數量」.

刷新時會回來多少一般殭屍. 100%% 依照地圖與你的殭屍數量設定. 200%% 則加倍. 設為 0 則不加入任何殭屍.

不影響突襲屍潮.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”和“刷新僵尸数量”.

刷新时会回来多少普通僵尸. 100%% 遵循地图和你的僵尸数量设置. 200%% 则加倍. 设为 0 则不添加任何僵尸.

不影响突袭尸潮.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.ch: 刷新殭屍數量 (耗用大量 CPU)
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.cn: 刷新僵尸数量 (占用大量 CPU)

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.en:
Requires Enable Location Refresh.

Replenishes regular zombies when a location refreshes. Killed zombies stay depleted until the next refresh.

Changes happen away from players. Raid hordes, reanimated players, and supported NPCs are left alone. May reduce performance.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.ch:
需要「啟用地點刷新」.

地點刷新時補充一般殭屍. 被擊殺的殭屍在下次刷新前不會補回.

變更會在遠離玩家處進行. 突襲屍潮, 重新復活的玩家與受支援的 NPC 不受影響. 可能降低效能.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_LocationRefreshZo.cn:
需要“启用地点刷新”.

地点刷新时补充普通僵尸. 被击杀的僵尸在下次刷新前不会补回.

变更会在远离玩家处进行. 突袭尸潮、复活的玩家和受支持的 NPC 不受影响. 可能降低性能.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_MedicalHealingBon.en:
Requires the Medical Delivery hideout upgrade.

Extra health recovered when healing. Higher values help players regain health faster.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_MedicalHealingBon.ch:
需要醫療交付藏身點升級.

治療時額外恢復的健康. 數值越高, 玩家恢復健康越快.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_MedicalHealingBon.cn:
需要医疗交付藏身点升级.

治疗时额外恢复的健康. 数值越高, 玩家恢复健康越快.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_MedicalInfectionP.en:
Requires the Medical Delivery hideout upgrade.

Chance to prevent a newly acquired Knox infection. Does not cure an existing infection.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_MedicalInfectionP.ch:
需要醫療交付藏身點升級.

預防新感染的諾克斯感染的機率. 無法治癒既有的感染.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_MedicalInfectionP.cn:
需要医疗交付藏身点升级.

预防新感染诺克斯感染的概率. 无法治愈已有的感染.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_PvPRotatingRaidSt.ch: PvP 輪換突襲開始方式
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_PvPRotatingRaidSt.cn: PvP 轮换突袭开始方式

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_PvPRotatingRaidSt.en:
Only applies to Coop/PvP | Multi Hideout.

Players enter at any time: groups deploy after everyone readies or opts out, followed by a 10-second countdown. When the destination changes, groups already counting down keep their destination. Everyone else must ready again.

Players enter at 0:00: ready groups deploy together when the rotation timer ends. Spaces are limited by available insertion points.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_PvPRotatingRaidSt.ch:
僅適用於「合作/PvP | 多藏身點」.

玩家隨時進入: 小隊在所有人就緒或選擇不參加後部署, 接著進行 10 秒倒數. 目的地變更時, 已在倒數的小隊保留原目的地. 其他人都必須重新就緒.

玩家於 0:00 進入: 已就緒的小隊會在輪換計時結束時一起部署. 名額受可用的抵達點數量限制.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_PvPRotatingRaidSt.cn:
仅适用于“合作/PvP | 多藏身点”.

玩家随时进入: 小队在所有人就绪或选择不参加后部署, 随后进行 10 秒倒计时. 目的地变更时, 已在倒计时的小队保留原目的地. 其他人都必须重新就绪.

玩家于 0:00 进入: 已就绪的小队会在轮换计时结束时一起部署. 名额受可用的抵达点数量限制.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ReadyCountdownSec.en:
Only applies to Coop | Single Hideout.

Countdown before deployment once the group is ready. Measured in real seconds.

Multi Hideout group deployments use a separate 10-second countdown.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ReadyCountdownSec.ch:
僅適用於「合作 | 單一藏身點」.

小隊就緒後到部署前的倒數, 以現實秒數計.

多藏身點的小隊部署使用另外的 10 秒倒數.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_ReadyCountdownSec.cn:
仅适用于“合作 | 单一藏身点”.

小队就绪后到部署前的倒计时, 以现实秒数计.

多藏身点的小队部署使用单独的 10 秒倒计时.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_SuppressBanditsAu.en:
Requires the Bandits mod and Enable Optional Bandits NPC Integration.

Stops the Bandits mod's own hostile raids. Extraction Mode's configured bandit attacks can still occur.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_SuppressBanditsAu.ch:
需要 Bandits 模組並啟用「啟用選用的匪徒 NPC 整合」.

停止 Bandits 模組自身的敵對突襲. 撤離模式設定的匪徒攻擊仍可能發生.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_SuppressBanditsAu.cn:
需要 Bandits 模组并启用“启用可选的匪徒 NPC 集成”.

停止 Bandits 模组自身的敌对突袭. 撤离模式设置的匪徒攻击仍可能发生.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VentilationSleepB.en:
Requires the Ventilation hideout upgrade.

Extra tiredness recovered while sleeping in the hideout. Higher values let players recover from tiredness faster.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VentilationSleepB.ch:
需要通風藏身點升級.

在藏身點睡覺時額外恢復的疲勞. 數值越高, 玩家從疲勞中恢復越快.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_VentilationSleepB.cn:
需要通风藏身点升级.

在藏身点睡觉时额外恢复的疲劳. 数值越高, 玩家从疲劳中恢复越快.

Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.en: Discomfort modifier when grime is 60 or more but below 75. <LINE> 0 disables discomfort for this stage.
Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.ch: 汙垢達 60 以上但低於 75 時的不適修正值. <LINE> 設為 0 則停用此階段的不適.
Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.cn: 污垢达到 60 以上但低于 75 时的不适修正值. <LINE> 设为 0 则禁用此阶段的不适.

Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.en: Discomfort modifier when grime is 75 or more but below 90. <LINE> 0 disables discomfort for this stage.
Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.ch: 汙垢達 75 以上但低於 90 時的不適修正值. <LINE> 設為 0 則停用此階段的不適.
Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.cn: 污垢达到 75 以上但低于 90 时的不适修正值. <LINE> 设为 0 则禁用此阶段的不适.

Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.en: Discomfort modifier when grime is 90 or more. <LINE> 0 disables discomfort for this stage.
Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.ch: 汙垢達 90 以上時的不適修正值. <LINE> 設為 0 則停用此階段的不適.
Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_GrimeDiscomfo.cn: 污垢达到 90 以上时的不适修正值. <LINE> 设为 0 则禁用此阶段的不适.

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightCivilian.ch: 殭屍類型: 平民權重
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightCivilian.cn: 僵尸类型: 平民权重

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightCivilian_tooltip.en: Relative chance a horde zombie wears a civilian outfit (medical, trades, generic, inmate, etc.). Low-value loot. Raise it to make horde corpses less rewarding. 0 disables the category. Default 60. Setting all five weights to 0 does not stop the horde - zombies spawn in vanilla's own random clothing instead.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightCivilian_tooltip.ch: 屍潮殭屍穿著平民服裝 (醫護, 技工, 一般, 囚犯等) 的相對機率. 戰利品價值低. 調高可讓屍潮殭屍的屍體較沒油水. 0 表示停用此類別. 預設 60. 五項權重全設為 0 並不會停止屍潮 - 殭屍改穿原版的隨機服裝生成.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightCivilian_tooltip.cn: 尸潮僵尸穿着平民服装 (医护, 技工, 普通, 囚犯等) 的相对几率. 战利品价值低. 调高可让尸潮僵尸的尸体收益更少. 0 表示禁用此类别. 默认 60. 五项权重全设为 0 并不会停止尸潮 - 僵尸改穿原版的随机服装生成.

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightHostile.ch: 殭屍類型: 敵對/掠奪者權重
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightHostile.cn: 僵尸类型: 敌对/掠夺者权重

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightHostile_tooltip.en: Relative chance a horde zombie wears a bandit, raider, biker, thug, or punk outfit. 0 disables the category. Default 10.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightHostile_tooltip.ch: 屍潮殭屍穿著強盜, 掠奪者, 機車騎士, 流氓或龐克服裝的相對機率. 0 表示停用此類別. 預設 10.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightHostile_tooltip.cn: 尸潮僵尸穿着强盗, 掠夺者, 摩托车手, 暴徒或朋克服装的相对几率. 0 表示禁用此类别. 默认 10.

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightMilitary.ch: 殭屍類型: 軍事權重
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightMilitary.cn: 僵尸类型: 军事权重

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightMilitary_tooltip.en: Relative chance a horde zombie wears a military outfit (Army camo, service uniform, instructor, Veteran, Ghillie). These carry the most valuable lootable gear. Lower it to stop horde night paying better than it costs. 0 disables the category. Default 10.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightMilitary_tooltip.ch: 屍潮殭屍穿著軍事服裝 (陸軍迷彩, 常服, 教官, 退伍軍人, 吉利服) 的相對機率. 這類殭屍身上的可搜刮裝備價值最高. 調低可避免屍潮夜的收穫大於代價. 0 表示停用此類別. 預設 10.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightMilitary_tooltip.cn: 尸潮僵尸穿着军事服装 (陆军迷彩, 常服, 教官, 退伍军人, 吉利服) 的相对几率. 这类僵尸身上的可搜刮装备价值最高. 调低可避免尸潮夜的收获大于代价. 0 表示禁用此类别. 默认 10.

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.ch: 殭屍類型: 戶外人士權重
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.cn: 僵尸类型: 户外人士权重

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_toolt.en: Relative chance a horde zombie wears a ranger, hunter, or private-militia outfit. Was part of the old combined Tactical weight. 0 disables the category. Default 5.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_toolt.ch: 屍潮殭屍穿著護林員, 獵人或民兵服裝的相對機率. 原屬舊版合併的戰術權重. 0 表示停用此類別. 預設 5.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_toolt.cn: 尸潮僵尸穿着护林员, 猎人或民兵服装的相对几率. 原属旧版合并的战术权重. 0 表示禁用此类别. 默认 5.

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.ch: 殭屍類型: 警察/保全權重
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.cn: 僵尸类型: 警察/保安权重

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity_to.en: Relative chance a horde zombie wears a police, state trooper, riot, SWAT, sheriff's deputy, mall security, prison-guard, or fireman outfit. Also high-value loot. 0 disables the category. Default 5.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity_to.ch: 屍潮殭屍穿著警察, 州警, 鎮暴警察, SWAT, 副警長, 商場保全, 獄警或消防員服裝的相對機率. 同樣是高價值戰利品. 0 表示停用此類別. 預設 5.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity_to.cn: 尸潮僵尸穿着警察, 州警, 防暴警察, SWAT, 副警长, 商场保安, 狱警或消防员服装的相对几率. 同样是高价值战利品. 0 表示禁用此类别. 默认 5.

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.ch: 殭屍類型: 生存專家權重
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.cn: 僵尸类型: 生存专家权重

Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_toolt.en: Relative chance a horde zombie wears one of the five Survivalist outfits - the survivor look. These carry practical survival gear (packs, tools, boots) and are separate from Outdoorsman so you can weight survivors on their own. 0 disables the category. Default 10.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_toolt.ch: 屍潮殭屍穿著五套生存專家服裝之一 (倖存者造型) 的相對機率. 這類殭屍攜帶實用的求生裝備 (背包, 工具, 靴子), 且與戶外人士分開, 讓你能單獨調整倖存者的權重. 0 表示停用此類別. 預設 10.
Sandbox_JH_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_toolt.cn: 尸潮僵尸穿着五套生存专家服装之一 (幸存者造型) 的相对几率. 这类僵尸携带实用的求生装备 (背包, 工具, 靴子), 且与户外人士分开, 让你能单独调整幸存者的权重. 0 表示禁用此类别. 默认 10.

Sandbox_organizedCategories_DisableItemS.en: Turns item sticking off for everyone on this server or save: stuck items move like any other item, and the stick button and anchor markers are hidden. Items keep their flag, so turning this back off restores them.
Sandbox_organizedCategories_DisableItemS.ch: 為此伺服器或存檔中的所有人關閉物品固定: 已固定的物品會像其他物品一樣被移動, 固定按鈕與錨點標記也會隱藏. 物品仍保留固定標記, 因此關閉此選項後即恢復.
Sandbox_organizedCategories_DisableItemS.cn: 为此服务器或存档中的所有人关闭物品固定: 已固定的物品会像其他物品一样被移动, 固定按钮与锚点标记也会隐藏. 物品仍保留固定标记, 因此关闭此选项后即恢复.

Sandbox_CAExtendedCategories_LogVerbosit.en: Controls how much information is logged to the console. Setting this to Debug is helpful if you want to report a bug or ask for compatibility with another mod.
Sandbox_CAExtendedCategories_LogVerbosit.ch: 控制輸出到主控台的記錄資訊量. 若想回報錯誤或請求與其他模組相容, 設為「除錯」會有幫助.
Sandbox_CAExtendedCategories_LogVerbosit.cn: 控制输出到控制台的日志信息量. 若想反馈错误或请求与其他模组兼容, 设为“调试”会有帮助.

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 啟用 Filibuster 丙烷車輸送
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 启用 Filibuster 丙烷车输送

Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.en: Allows Base.fr_fo_f700_90_propane part FRPropaneTank from Filibuster Rhymes' Certified Used Cars B42 to exchange propane with supported carried items and nearby depots. The vehicle mod remains optional. Default: On.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.ch: 允許 Filibuster Rhymes' Certified Used Cars B42 的 Base.fr_fo_f700_90_propane 零件 FRPropaneTank 與受支援的攜帶物品及附近儲罐互相輸送丙烷. 該載具模組仍為選用. 預設值: 開啟.
Sandbox_ArcadiaRefillablePropaneTanks_En.cn: 允许 Filibuster Rhymes' Certified Used Cars B42 的 Base.fr_fo_f700_90_propane 部件 FRPropaneTank 与受支持的携带物品及附近储罐互相输送丙烷. 该载具模组仍为可选. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_NihontoOptions_CareProtectionCha.en: Chance for a properly oiled blade (Choji oil ritual) to fully prevent condition loss on a hit, at no cost to sharpness. Checked before the sharpness protection roll.
Sandbox_NihontoOptions_CareProtectionCha.ch: 妥善上油 (丁子油保養) 的刀身在命中時完全免於耐久損耗的機率, 且不會消耗鋒利度. 此判定會在鋒利度保護判定之前進行.
Sandbox_NihontoOptions_CareProtectionCha.cn: 妥善上油 (丁子油保养) 的刀身在命中时完全免于耐久损耗的几率, 且不会消耗锋利度. 此判定会在锋利度保护判定之前进行.

Sandbox_NihontoOptions_ChojiOilProtectio.ch: 丁子油保護持續次數 (命中)
Sandbox_NihontoOptions_ChojiOilProtectio.cn: 丁子油保护持续次数 (命中)

Sandbox_NihontoOptions_ChojiOilProtectio.en: How many weapon hits the Choji oil protection lasts for before needing to be reapplied.
Sandbox_NihontoOptions_ChojiOilProtectio.ch: 丁子油保護在需要重新塗抹前可維持的武器命中次數.
Sandbox_NihontoOptions_ChojiOilProtectio.cn: 丁子油保护在需要重新涂抹前可维持的武器命中次数.

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.ch: 晾乾架: 漿果所需天數
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.cn: 晾干架: 浆果所需天数

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.en: 7 by default. How many days berries take to dry on the physical Drying Rack. Only affects the Drying Rack, not oven drying.
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.ch: 預設值為 7. 漿果在實體晾乾架上風乾所需的天數. 僅影響晾乾架, 不影響烤箱烘乾.
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.cn: 默认值为 7. 浆果在实体晾干架上风干所需的天数. 仅影响晾干架, 不影响烤箱烘干.

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.en: Drying Rack: Days for Salted Fish
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.ch: 晾乾架: 醃魚所需天數
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.cn: 晾干架: 腌鱼所需天数

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.en: 14 by default. How many days salted fish takes to dry on the physical Drying Rack. Only affects the Drying Rack, not oven drying.
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.ch: 預設值為 14. 醃魚在實體晾乾架上風乾所需的天數. 僅影響晾乾架, 不影響烤箱烘乾.
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.cn: 默认值为 14. 腌鱼在实体晾干架上风干所需的天数. 仅影响晾干架, 不影响烤箱烘干.

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.ch: 晾乾架: 水果所需天數
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.cn: 晾干架: 水果所需天数

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.en: 5 by default. How many days fruit takes to dry on the physical Drying Rack. Only affects the Drying Rack, not oven drying.

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_DryingRackDays.cn: 默认值为 5. 水果在实体晾干架上风干所需的天数. 仅影响晾干架, 不影响烤箱烘干.

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_ShelfLifeMulti.ch: 風乾食品保存期限倍率

Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_ShelfLifeMulti.en: 1 by default. Multiplies how long dried/preserved foods from this mod stay fresh/edible before spoiling. At the default 1x: dried meat stays good for about 3-8 months, dried fish 4-9 months, dried fruit/berries/mushrooms 6-12 months, dried vegetables 5-10 months. 2x doubles those, 0.5x halves them.
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_ShelfLifeMulti.ch: 預設值為 1. 調整本模組風乾與醃製食品在腐壞前保持新鮮、可食用的時間倍率. 預設 1x 時: 風乾肉約可保存 3-8 個月, 風乾魚 4-9 個月, 風乾水果/漿果/蘑菇 6-12 個月, 風乾蔬菜 5-10 個月. 2x 會使上述時間加倍, 0.5x 則減半.
Sandbox_FoodDryingOptions_ShelfLifeMulti.cn: 默认值为 1. 调整本模组风干与腌制食品在变质前保持新鲜、可食用的时间倍率. 默认 1x 时: 风干肉约可保存 3-8 个月, 风干鱼 4-9 个月, 风干水果/浆果/蘑菇 6-12 个月, 风干蔬菜 5-10 个月. 2x 会使上述时间翻倍, 0.5x 则减半.

Sandbox_VanillaFishingFix_EnableSeatedFi.en: Allows fishing from the ground and from recognized chairs or furniture. Furniture must face the water.

Sandbox_GGSGS_AimingPeripheralVision_too.en: Narrows and softens peripheral vision while aiming through an optic. Long-range scopes use the narrowest cone, ACOG-style optics use a medium-small cone, and red dots or mini sights use a medium cone.
Sandbox_GGSGS_AimingPeripheralVision_too.ch: 透過光學瞄具瞄準時, 會縮窄並柔化周邊視野. 長距離瞄準鏡使用最窄的視錐, ACOG 類光學瞄具使用中偏小的視錐, 紅點或迷你瞄具則使用中等視錐.
Sandbox_GGSGS_AimingPeripheralVision_too.cn: 通过光学瞄具瞄准时, 会收窄并柔化周边视野. 远距离瞄准镜使用最窄的视锥, ACOG 类光学瞄具使用中偏小的视锥, 红点或迷你瞄具则使用中等视锥.

Sandbox_GGSGS_CustomScopeCrosshair.cn: 自定义倍率瞄准镜准星

Sandbox_GGSGS_CustomScopeCrosshair_toolt.en: Shows the GGS reticle while aiming through compatible magnified scopes. The reticle follows the real mouse or gamepad aiming position and scales with the player viewport.
Sandbox_GGSGS_CustomScopeCrosshair_toolt.ch: 透過相容的倍率瞄準鏡瞄準時, 顯示 GGS 準星. 準星會跟隨滑鼠或手把的實際瞄準位置, 並隨玩家畫面區域縮放.
Sandbox_GGSGS_CustomScopeCrosshair_toolt.cn: 通过兼容的倍率瞄准镜瞄准时, 显示 GGS 准星. 准星会跟随鼠标或手柄的实际瞄准位置, 并随玩家视口缩放.

Sandbox_GGSGS_DynamicAimRecoil_tooltip.en: Replaces the center aiming mark with a moving red point. Weapon sway moves it inside the vanilla crosshair; each shot kicks it sharply, and single-projectile rounds follow its position.
Sandbox_GGSGS_DynamicAimRecoil_tooltip.ch: 以移動的紅點取代中央瞄準標記. 武器晃動會讓它在原版準星內移動; 每次射擊都會讓它猛然跳動, 單彈頭彈藥會跟隨其位置.
Sandbox_GGSGS_DynamicAimRecoil_tooltip.cn: 用移动的红点取代中央瞄准标记. 武器晃动会让它在原版准星内移动; 每次射击都会让它猛然跳动, 单弹头弹药会跟随其位置.

Sandbox_GGSGS_RealSingleShot_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 半自动模式下的枪械每扣一次扳机只会射击一次. 松开后再次按下攻击键才能射出下一发. 自动射击模式保持原有行为.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_NPCProvider_toolt.en: Choose the mod used for regular attack windows, NPC debug controls, meta events and late-raid horde replacements. Automatic uses A-Life when enabled, otherwise Bandits. Restart the session after changing this option. A-Life uses native faction eligibility, reputation, equipment and attack behavior. Friendly encounter schedules and Bandit Behavior/withdrawal controls remain Bandits features.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_NPCProvider_toolt.ch: 選擇用於一般攻擊時窗、NPC 除錯控制、場景事件與突襲後期屍潮替換的模組. 「自動」會在已啟用 A-Life 時使用 A-Life, 否則使用 Bandits. 變更此選項後需重新載入遊戲. A-Life 會使用其原生的陣營資格、聲望、裝備與攻擊行為. 友善遭遇排程, 以及「匪徒行為」與撤退相關控制, 仍屬於 Bandits 的功能.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_NPCProvider_toolt.cn: 选择用于普通攻击窗口、NPC 调试控制、场景事件与突袭后期尸潮替换的模组. “自动”会在已启用 A-Life 时使用 A-Life, 否则使用 Bandits. 更改此选项后需重新加载游戏. A-Life 会使用其原生的派系资格、声望、装备与攻击行为. 友好遭遇排程, 以及“匪徒行为”和撤退相关控制, 仍属于 Bandits 的功能.

Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeDistribution.ch: 使用Better Fishing的漁獲體型分布
Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeDistribution.cn: 使用Better Fishing的渔获体型分布

Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeDistribution_t.en:
Disabled (default): uses the vanilla fish-size distribution table. Enabled: uses the Better Fishing Small/Medium/Big distribution. Vanilla skill/species weight limits are always preserved.
Note: This choice is applied when the world loads. Reload your save after changing it.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeDistribution_t.ch:
停用 (預設): 使用原版的魚類體型分布表. 啟用: 使用Better Fishing的小/中/大體型分布. 原版的技能與魚種重量上限一律保留.
注意: 此選項會在世界載入時套用. 變更後請重新載入存檔.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeDistribution_t.cn:
禁用 (默认): 使用原版的鱼类体型分布表. 启用: 使用Better Fishing的小/中/大体型分布. 原版的技能与鱼种重量上限始终保留.
注意: 此选项会在世界加载时生效. 更改后请重新加载存档.

Sandbox_PhunServer_GetHours_RefreshSetti.en: When ticked, we will refresh your settings with those found in your Sandbox_Vars.lua file. This is to workaround a bug in the current build where your settings get cached and subsequent changes ignored.
Sandbox_PhunServer_GetHours_RefreshSetti.ch: 勾選後, 將以 Sandbox_Vars.lua 檔案中的設定重新整理你的設定. 這是為了繞過目前版本的錯誤: 設定會被快取, 之後的變更遭到忽略.
Sandbox_PhunServer_GetHours_RefreshSetti.cn: 勾选后, 将使用 Sandbox_Vars.lua 文件中的设置刷新你的设置. 这是为了绕过当前版本的一个错误: 设置会被缓存, 之后的修改会被忽略.

Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnFoods_tooltip.en: The sweetness is gone. If unchecked, desserts and other foods from this mod will not spawn as world loot.
Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnFoods_tooltip.ch: 甜蜜不再. 若取消勾選, 本 MOD 的甜點與其他食物將不會作為世界戰利品生成.
Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnFoods_tooltip.cn: 甜蜜不再. 若取消勾选, 本模组的甜点和其他食物将不会作为世界战利品刷新.

Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnIngredients_tooltip.en: If unchecked, ingredients from this mod will not spawn as world loot. But don't worry - you can still craft most ingredients yourself.
Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnIngredients_tooltip.ch: 若取消勾選, 本 MOD 的食材將不會作為世界戰利品生成. 但別擔心 - 大部分食材仍可自行製作.
Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnIngredients_tooltip.cn: 若取消勾选, 本模组的食材将不会作为世界战利品刷新. 但别担心 - 大部分食材仍可自行制作.

Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnTools_tooltip.en: If unchecked, crafting tools from this mod will not spawn as world loot. But don't worry - you can still craft most tools yourself.
Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnTools_tooltip.ch: 若取消勾選, 本 MOD 的製作工具將不會作為世界戰利品生成. 但別擔心 - 大部分工具仍可自行製作.
Sandbox_HDsFood_SpawnTools_tooltip.cn: 若取消勾选, 本模组的制作工具将不会作为世界战利品刷新. 但别担心 - 大部分工具仍可自行制作.

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCommon.en: Daisho Case spawn (Common: houses, garages, etc.)
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCommon.ch: 大小雙刀盒生成 (常見: 住宅, 車庫等)
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCommon.cn: 大小双刀盒刷新 (常见: 住宅, 车库等)

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCommon_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often the sealed Legendary Daisho Case appears in houses, garages, etc. (very rarely). A daisho is the traditional samurai pair of a katana and a wakizashi: the case holds both with their sheaths, all of the same color.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCommon_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>密封的傳奇大小雙刀盒在住宅, 車庫等處出現的頻率 (非常罕見). 大小 (Daisho) 是武士傳統的一對刀, 由武士刀與脅差組成: 刀盒內裝有兩把刀及其刀鞘, 全部為同一顏色.
0 = 從不, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoCommon_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>密封的传奇大小双刀盒在住宅, 车库等处出现的频率 (非常罕见). 大小 (Daisho) 是武士传统的一对刀, 由武士刀和胁差组成: 刀盒内装有两把刀及其刀鞘, 全部为同一颜色.
0 = 从不, 1 = 极为罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoRare.en: Daisho Case spawn (Rare: police, military, antiques, etc.)
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoRare.ch: 大小雙刀盒生成 (稀有: 警局, 軍事設施, 古董店等)
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoRare.cn: 大小双刀盒刷新 (稀有: 警局, 军事设施, 古董店等)

Sandbox_LKO_DaishoRare_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often the sealed Legendary Daisho Case appears in police stations, military sites, antique stores and survivor stashes. A daisho is the traditional samurai pair of a katana and a wakizashi: the case holds both with their sheaths, all of the same color.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoRare_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>密封的傳奇大小雙刀盒在警察局, 軍事設施, 古董店與倖存者藏匿處出現的頻率. 大小 (Daisho) 是武士傳統的一對刀, 由武士刀與脅差組成: 刀盒內裝有兩把刀及其刀鞘, 全部為同一顏色.
0 = 從不, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LKO_DaishoRare_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>密封的传奇大小双刀盒在警察局, 军事设施, 古董店和幸存者藏匿点出现的频率. 大小 (Daisho) 是武士传统的一对刀, 由武士刀和胁差组成: 刀盒内装有两把刀及其刀鞘, 全部为同一颜色.
0 = 从不, 1 = 极为罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LKO_KatanaZombies_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often loose legendary katanas drop from zombies.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LKO_KatanaZombies_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>殭屍身上掉落單獨傳奇武士刀的頻率.
0 = 從不, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LKO_KatanaZombies_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>僵尸身上掉落单独传奇武士刀的频率.
0 = 从不, 1 = 极为罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LKO_Magazine_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often the magazine that teaches the recipes appears (bookshelves, magazine racks, survivor houses, zombies...).
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LKO_Magazine_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>教授這些配方的雜誌出現的頻率 (書架, 雜誌架, 倖存者住宅, 殭屍…).
0 = 從不, 1 = 極為稀有, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LKO_Magazine_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>教授这些配方的杂志出现的频率 (书架, 杂志架, 幸存者住宅, 僵尸…).
0 = 从不, 1 = 极其稀有, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_LKO_WakizashiZombies_tooltip.en:
<RGB:0,1,0>How often loose legendary wakizashis drop from zombies.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Sandbox_LKO_WakizashiZombies_tooltip.ch:
<RGB:0,1,0>殭屍身上掉落單獨傳奇脅差的頻率.
0 = 從不, 1 = 極為罕見, 5 = 預設, 10 = 預設的 3 倍.
Sandbox_LKO_WakizashiZombies_tooltip.cn:
<RGB:0,1,0>僵尸身上掉落单独传奇胁差的频率.
0 = 从不, 1 = 极为罕见, 5 = 默认, 10 = 默认的 3 倍.

Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip.en: Extends 'Staff ignore zone restrictions' to the Moderator, GM and Overseer roles as well as Admin. Has no effect unless that option is on.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip.ch: 除管理員外, 也將「管理人員無視區域限制」套用到版主, GM 與監督員角色. 需開啟該選項才有效果.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip.cn: 除管理员外, 也将“管理人员无视区域限制”应用到版主, GM 和监督员角色. 需开启该选项才有效果.

Sandbox_PhunZones_ManageNoPvpZones_toolt.en: When on, safe zones are registered with the games own non-pvp zone list. Turn it off to manage that list by hand through the admin panel instead - PhunZones will then remove the zones it created.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ManageNoPvpZones_toolt.ch: 開啟時, 安全區會加入遊戲本身的非 PvP 區域清單. 關閉則改由管理面板手動管理該清單 - 屆時趣味區域會移除它所建立的區域.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ManageNoPvpZones_toolt.cn: 开启时, 安全区会注册到游戏自身的非 PvP 区域列表. 关闭则改为通过管理面板手动管理该列表 - 届时趣味区域会移除它创建的区域.

Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt.ch: 管理人員無視區域限制
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt.cn: 管理人员无视区域限制

Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip.en: When on, staff are not blocked by a zone's No Building, No Placing, No Pickup, No Scrapping, No Destruction, No Safehouse or No Players settings. By itself this covers the Admin role only - tick 'Include Moderator and GM' to widen it. No Fire and safe zones are never exempted: neither check has a player to let through.
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 管理人員不受區域的禁止建造, 禁止放置, 禁止拾取, 禁止拆解, 禁止破壞, 禁止安全屋或禁止玩家設定阻擋. 此選項本身僅涵蓋管理員角色 - 勾選「包含版主與 GM」可擴大範圍. 禁止用火與安全區永遠不會豁免: 這兩項檢查都沒有可放行的玩家.
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 管理人员不受区域的禁止建造, 禁止放置, 禁止拾取, 禁止拆解, 禁止破坏, 禁止安全屋或禁止玩家设置阻挡. 此选项本身仅涵盖管理员角色 - 勾选“包括版主和 GM”可扩大范围. 禁止用火和安全区永远不会豁免: 这两项检查都没有可放行的玩家.

Sandbox_DynamicZ_AlwaysShowLeaderNameTex.en: Shows and continuously refreshes the archetype label over nearby leaders so it remains visible, including while driving. This setting is not overridden by the quick preset.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AlwaysShowLeaderNameTex.ch: 在附近領袖頭上顯示並持續更新原型標籤, 讓它保持可見, 包括駕駛時. 此設定不會被快速預設覆蓋.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AlwaysShowLeaderNameTex.cn: 在附近领袖头上显示并持续刷新原型标签, 使其保持可见, 包括驾驶时. 此设置不会被快速预设覆盖.

Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugOverlay_tool.en: Shows the Dynamic Evolution Z status overlay while debug mode is enabled. Disable it to keep debug commands available without the on-screen overlay.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugOverlay_tool.ch: 在偵錯模式啟用時顯示動態進化 Z 狀態疊加層. 停用它可保留偵錯指令, 但不顯示螢幕上的疊加層.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugOverlay_tool.cn: 在调试模式启用时显示动态进化 Z 状态覆盖层. 禁用它可保留调试命令, 但不显示屏幕上的覆盖层.

Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too.en: Pauses Dynamic Evolution Z batch AI when every active player is travelling in a vehicle, plus local leader scans for the driver. Vanilla zombie AI remains active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too.ch: 當所有活躍玩家都在載具中行駛時, 暫停動態進化 Z 的批次 AI, 以及針對駕駛者的本地領袖掃描. 原版殭屍 AI 仍保持運作.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too.cn: 当所有活跃玩家都在载具中行驶时, 暂停动态进化 Z 的批处理 AI, 以及针对驾驶者的本地领袖扫描. 原版僵尸 AI 仍保持运行.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeDamageEna.en: When enabled, legacy direct HP damage is processed in realtime OnTick instead of minute ticks.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeDamageEna.ch: 啟用後, 傳統直接生命值傷害會在 OnTick 中即時處理, 而非每分鐘處理.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeDamageEna.cn: 启用后, 传统直接生命伤害会在 OnTick 中实时处理, 而非每分钟处理.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.ch: 傳統即時每秒生命值傷害上限
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.cn: 传统实时每秒生命伤害上限

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.en: Maximum legacy HP damage that can be applied per second in realtime mode.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.ch: 即時模式下每秒可套用的傳統生命值傷害上限.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.cn: 实时模式下每秒可应用的传统生命伤害上限.

Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_AppetiteRate.en: Multiplies how quickly hunger returns. Stacks with Project Zomboid's Stats Decrease setting. Does not change calorie burn or weight. 1.0 keeps the intended NMS balance.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_AppetiteRate.ch: 調整飢餓感回來的速度. 會與 Project Zomboid 的「狀態數值降低」設定疊加. 不會改變熱量消耗或體重. 1.0 為 NMS 預期的平衡.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_AppetiteRate.cn: 调整饥饿感回来的速度. 会与 Project Zomboid 的“状态减少速度”设置叠加. 不会改变热量消耗或体重. 1.0 为 NMS 预期的平衡.

Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_EnergyBurnMu.en: Multiplies how quickly calories are burned during rest, movement, work, and sleep. This affects the energy reserve and long-term weight change. 1.0 keeps the intended NMS balance.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_EnergyBurnMu.ch: 調整休息, 移動, 工作與睡眠時燃燒熱量的速度. 這會影響能量儲備與長期體重變化. 1.0 為 NMS 預期的平衡.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_EnergyBurnMu.cn: 调整休息, 移动, 工作和睡眠时燃烧热量的速度. 这会影响能量储备与长期体重变化. 1.0 为 NMS 预期的平衡.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleA.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, completed ambitions are recorded to a personal data disk and marked completed again on recovery. Only the completion is restored, not partial progress; choose which completed ambitions are active from Lifestyle's own ambitions menu.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleA.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 已完成的志向會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時重新標記為已完成. 只會還原完成狀態, 不含部分進度. 請從 Lifestyle 本身的志向選單選擇要啟用哪些已完成的志向.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleA.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 已完成的志向会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时重新标记为已完成. 只会还原完成状态, 不包括部分进度. 请在 Lifestyle 自带的志向菜单中选择要激活哪些已完成的志向.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, the researched improvement levels on each discovered invention come back with it. Requires Recover Lifestyle Inventions, since an improvement needs an invention to sit on. This is the long half of the invention grind, which is why it is separate and off by default. A restore can leave a character holding more special improvements than their Inventing level would let them research from scratch.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 每項已發現發明上研究過的改良等級也會一併恢復. 需要同時啟用「恢復 Lifestyle 發明」, 因為改良必須依附於發明. 這是發明養成中最耗時的部分, 因此獨立成一個選項並預設關閉. 恢復後, 角色持有的特殊改良數量可能超過其發明等級從頭研究所能達到的數量.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 每项已发现发明上研究过的改良等级也会一并恢复. 需要同时启用“恢复 Lifestyle 发明”, 因为改良必须依附于发明. 这是发明养成中最耗时的部分, 因此单独作为一个选项并默认关闭. 恢复后, 角色持有的特殊改良数量可能超过其发明等级从头研究所能达到的数量.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, every invention and toy discovered at the invention workbench is recorded to a personal data disk and known again on recovery. Discovery only: the researched improvements are a separate option, Recover Lifestyle Improvements. All-or-nothing, so the recovery percentage does not apply.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 在發明工作臺發現的每項發明與玩具都會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時重新習得. 僅限發現: 研究過的改良是另一個選項「恢復 Lifestyle 改良」. 此項為全有或全無, 因此不套用恢復百分比.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 在发明工作台发现的每项发明和玩具都会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时重新掌握. 仅限发现: 研究过的改良是另一个选项“恢复 Lifestyle 改良”. 此项为全有或全无, 因此不适用恢复百分比.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.ch: 恢復 Lifestyle 隱藏技能
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.cn: 恢复 Lifestyle 隐藏技能

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, hidden skills (Yoga, Inventing, Ping Pong) are recorded to a personal data disk and restored on recovery like other skills, using the default recovery percentage. Matches the Jeeve's Journals option of the same name: the disk and the journal record and recover the same things.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 隱藏技能 (瑜伽, 發明, 桌球) 會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時像其他技能一樣以預設恢復百分比還原. 與 Jeeve's Journals 的同名選項一致: 軟碟片與日記本記錄及恢復的內容相同.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 隐藏技能 (瑜伽, 发明, 乒乓球) 会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时像其他技能一样按默认恢复百分比还原. 与 Jeeve's Journals 的同名选项一致: 磁盘与日志记录和恢复的内容相同.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, every song the character has learned on every instrument is recorded to a personal data disk and learned again on recovery. A song is all-or-nothing, so the recovery percentage does not apply to it. Songs are rebuilt from the catalogue the installed version of Lifestyle ships, so one that has since been renamed or removed simply does not return.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 角色在每種樂器上學會的每首歌曲都會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時重新學會. 歌曲為全有或全無, 因此不套用恢復百分比. 歌曲會依目前安裝的 Lifestyle 版本所附的曲目清單重建, 之後被改名或移除的歌曲將不會恢復.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 角色在每种乐器上学会的每首歌曲都会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时重新学会. 歌曲为全有或全无, 因此不适用恢复百分比. 歌曲会根据当前安装的 Lifestyle 版本自带的曲目列表重建, 之后被改名或移除的歌曲将不会恢复.

Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles.en: Block street/highway floor tiles in safehouse selections
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles.ch: 禁止在安全屋選取範圍中包含街道/公路地板地塊
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles.cn: 禁止在安全屋选择范围中包含街道/公路地板地块

Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab.en: Enabled: two server-wide offers refresh every 24 in-game hours and disappear for everyone when purchased.<LINE>Disabled: restores the original per-player Dark Web purchase catalog.
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab.ch: 啟用: 兩項全伺服器共用的商品每 24 遊戲小時重新整理一次, 任何人購買後即對所有人消失.<LINE>停用: 恢復原本每位玩家各自的暗網購買目錄.
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab.cn: 启用: 两项全服务器共享的商品每 24 游戏小时刷新一次, 任何人购买后即对所有人消失.<LINE>禁用: 恢复原本每位玩家各自的暗网购买目录.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.en: Allow any knife to fillet fish
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.ch: 允許用任何刀具切魚片
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.cn: 允许用任何刀具切鱼片

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.en: Off: vanilla sharp knives and meat cleavers only. On: allows all vanilla handheld knives, including butter and plastic knives.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.ch: 關閉: 僅限原版利刃與剁肉刀. 開啟: 允許使用所有原版手持刀具, 包括奶油刀與塑膠刀.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.cn: 关闭: 仅限原版锋利刀具和剁肉刀. 开启: 允许使用所有原版手持刀具, 包括黄油刀和塑料刀.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_ForageDensityPe.en: Controls global forage density from 100 to 1,000 percent. 100 is vanilla and recommended for smooth performance. Extremely high values may cause serious stuttering.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_ForageDensityPe.ch: 控制全域搜尋密度, 範圍為 100 到 1,000 百分比. 100 為原版數值, 建議使用以維持流暢效能. 極高數值可能導致嚴重卡頓.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_ForageDensityPe.cn: 控制全局搜寻密度, 范围为 100 到 1,000 百分比. 100 为原版数值, 推荐使用以保证流畅性能. 极高数值可能导致严重卡顿.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceForageVisib.en: Controls both how often rice appears and how easily it is detected. 100 is occasional, 500 is much more common, and 1,000 is very frequent.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceForageVisib.ch: 同時控制稻米出現的頻率與被發現的難易度. 100 為偶爾出現, 500 為更常見, 1,000 為非常頻繁.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceForageVisib.cn: 同时控制稻米出现的频率与被发现的难易程度. 100 为偶尔出现, 500 为更加常见, 1,000 为非常频繁.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageC.en: Legacy setting. Effective rice chance is capped at 15 and rice is crops-only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageC.ch: 舊版設定. 實際稻米機率上限為 15, 且稻米僅屬於農作物類.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageC.cn: 旧版设置. 实际稻米几率上限为 15, 且稻米仅属于农作物类.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.en: Legacy setting. Maximum rice found from one forage icon.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.ch: 舊版設定. 單一搜尋圖示可找到的最多稻米數量.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.cn: 旧版设置. 单个搜寻图标可找到的最多稻米数量.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.en: Legacy setting. Minimum rice found from one forage icon.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.ch: 舊版設定. 單一搜尋圖示可找到的最少稻米數量.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.cn: 旧版设置. 单个搜寻图标可找到的最少稻米数量.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageV.en: Legacy setting. Controls how easy rice is to spot while foraging.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageV.ch: 舊版設定. 控制搜尋時稻米被發現的難易度.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageV.cn: 旧版设置. 控制搜寻时稻米被发现的难易程度.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageCh.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageCh.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageCh.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMa.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMa.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMi.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMi.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMi.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageVi.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageVi.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageVi.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip.en: Extra help in discovering unique points of interest.
Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip.ch: 額外協助你發現獨特的興趣點.
Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip.cn: 额外帮助你发现独特的兴趣点.

Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption.en: Controls how much fuel the Ark generators consume.
Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption.ch: 控制方舟發電機消耗燃料的多寡.
Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption.cn: 控制方舟发电机消耗燃料的多少.

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option1.ch: 極快上升 + 極慢衰減
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option1.cn: 极快上升 + 极慢衰减
