Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option4.cn: 缓慢上升 + 快速衰减

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5.en: Very slow rise + very fast decay
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5.ch: 極慢上升 + 極快衰減
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5.cn: 极慢上升 + 极快衰减

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip.en: Controls the rise and decay speed of the fallout period
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip.ch: 控制落塵期的上升與衰減速度
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip.cn: 控制沉降期的上升与衰减速度

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip.en: Impacts radiation and weather conditions duration as well as the duration of the storyline.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip.ch: 影響輻射與天候狀況的持續時間, 以及劇情的持續時間.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip.cn: 影响辐射与天气状况的持续时间, 以及剧情的持续时间.

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip.en: Impacts initial radiation and weather conditions.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip.ch: 影響初始的輻射與天候狀況.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip.cn: 影响初始的辐射与天气状况.

Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip.en: Determines the typical size of hostile survivor groups.
Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip.ch: 決定敵對倖存者群體的一般規模.
Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip.cn: 决定敌对幸存者群体的一般规模.

Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip.en: Player can regain some skills over time or by interacting with certain objects.
Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip.ch: 玩家能隨時間經過, 或與特定物件互動來恢復部分技能.
Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip.cn: 玩家能随时间推移, 或与特定物体互动来恢复部分技能.

Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip.en: Controls how much scrap materials exist in the world.
Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip.ch: 控制世界中廢料材料的數量.
Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip.cn: 控制世界中废料材料的数量.

Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip.en: Player inventory can get radiated from ground items.
Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip.ch: 玩家物品欄可能會被地上的物品輻射汙染.
Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip.cn: 玩家物品栏可能会被地上的物品辐射污染.

Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip.en: Impacts how often random procedurally generated basements will occur. These are independent from normal basements.
Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip.ch: 影響隨機程序生成地下室的出現頻率. 這些地下室與一般地下室各自獨立.
Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip.cn: 影响随机程序生成地下室的出现频率. 这些地下室与普通地下室相互独立.

Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip.en: (MAY LEAD TO GAME CRASH!) Skeletons have some chance of reanimation.
Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip.ch: (可能導致遊戲當機!) 骷髏有一定機率復活.
Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip.cn: (可能导致游戏崩溃!) 骷髅有一定几率复活.

Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip.en: Controls how cold the nuclear winter is.
Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip.ch: 控制核子冬天的寒冷程度.
Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip.cn: 控制核冬天的寒冷程度.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_Debug_tooltip.en: Print verbose [TaMOOgotchi] logs to console.txt. Useful when reporting bugs.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_Debug_tooltip.ch: 將詳細的 [TaMOOgotchi] 日誌輸出到 console.txt. 回報錯誤時很有用.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_Debug_tooltip.cn: 将详细的 [TaMOOgotchi] 日志输出到 console.txt. 报告错误时很有用.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_DecayMultiplier_tool.en: Higher = stats drop faster. 1.0 is the default rate.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_DecayMultiplier_tool.ch: 越高 = 數值下降越快. 1.0 為預設速率.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_DecayMultiplier_tool.cn: 越高 = 数值下降越快. 1.0 为默认速率.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate.ch: 數值條增加速度 (單位/秒)
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate.cn: 数值条增加速度 (单位/秒)

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate_toolti.en: How fast the bars visually fill after FEED/PLAY/etc.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate_toolti.ch: 餵食/玩耍等動作後數值條在畫面上填滿的速度.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate_toolti.cn: 喂食/玩耍等动作后数值条在画面上填满的速度.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate.ch: 數值條減少速度 (單位/秒)
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate.cn: 数值条减少速度 (单位/秒)

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate_toolti.en: How fast the bars visually drop after action-induced losses.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate_toolti.ch: 動作造成數值減少後, 數值條在畫面上下降的速度.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate_toolti.cn: 动作造成数值减少后, 数值条在画面上下降的速度.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_SpawnMultiplier_tool.en: Multiplier applied to TaMOOgotchi loot weights in containers / vehicles. 0 disables world spawning, 1.0 is default, higher = more common.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_SpawnMultiplier_tool.ch: 套用於容器/車輛中電子牛戰利品權重的倍率. 0 = 停用世界生成, 1.0 為預設, 越高 = 越常見.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_SpawnMultiplier_tool.cn: 应用于容器/车辆中电子牛战利品权重的倍率. 0 = 禁用世界生成, 1.0 为默认, 越高 = 越常见.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_StarterEgg_tooltip.en: If enabled, every new character spawns with a TaMOOgotchi in their inventory.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_StarterEgg_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 每個新角色出生時物品欄中都會有一隻電子牛.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_StarterEgg_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 每个新角色出生时物品栏中都会有一只电子牛.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too.en: Displays vehicle-part condition colors on the vehicle dashboard.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too.ch: 在車輛儀表板上以顏色顯示車輛零件狀態.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too.cn: 在车辆仪表盘上以颜色显示车辆零件状态.

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand.en: Enable Remove Bullet by Hand Action
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand.ch: 啟用徒手取出子彈動作
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand.cn: 启用徒手取出子弹动作

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.ch: 自訂取出子彈動畫 (無法使用)
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.cn: 自定义取出子弹动画 (不可用)

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.en: Reserved compatibility option. The experimental custom animation is disabled on Build 42.20.2 because it can invalidate the multiplayer animation checksum. The action above remains available without it.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.ch: 保留的相容性選項. 實驗性的自訂動畫在 Build 42.20.2 中已停用, 因為它可能導致多人模式動畫校驗碼失效. 上方的動作不需要它仍可使用.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.cn: 保留的兼容性选项. 实验性的自定义动画在 Build 42.20.2 中已禁用, 因为它可能导致多人模式动画校验和失效. 上方的动作不需要它仍可使用.

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_.en: Enables the action that removes lodged bullets by hand from the health panel. The action is disabled by default, returns a bloody bullet and worsens the wound.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_.ch: 啟用從健康面板徒手取出卡在體內子彈的動作. 此動作預設為停用, 會得到一顆沾血的子彈並使傷口惡化.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_.cn: 启用从健康面板徒手取出卡在体内子弹的动作. 此动作默认禁用, 会得到一颗沾血的子弹并使伤口恶化.

Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminRemotePlayerAct.en: Allows admins to use Medical Check, Check Stats, and Trade from the player list without the normal distance limit.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminRemotePlayerAct.ch: 允許管理員從玩家清單使用醫療檢查, 檢視屬性與交易, 不受一般距離限制.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminRemotePlayerAct.cn: 允许管理员从玩家列表使用医疗检查, 查看属性和交易, 不受常规距离限制.

Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarMechanic_.en: Master switch for EBF crowbar actions. Turn this off when another mod, such as Better Lockpicking, should handle crowbar and lockpicking interactions.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarMechanic_.ch: EBF撬棍操作的總開關. 若要由其他模組 (例如 Better Lockpicking) 處理撬棍與開鎖互動, 請關閉此選項.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarMechanic_.cn: EBF撬棍操作的总开关. 若要由其他模组 (例如 Better Lockpicking) 处理撬棍和开锁互动, 请关闭此选项.

Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent.ch: 帳篷包戰利品生成機率 (%%)
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent.cn: 帐篷包战利品生成几率 (%%)

Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t.en: Per-container chance that a filled military tent pack appears in eligible military or ranger/camping containers. 0 disables loot spawns entirely. Default: 10.
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t.ch: 每個容器在符合條件的軍事或護林員/露營容器中出現裝滿的軍用帳篷包的機率. 0 會完全停用戰利品生成. 預設: 10.
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t.cn: 每个符合条件的军事或护林员/露营容器中出现装满的军用帐篷包的几率. 0 会完全禁用战利品生成. 默认: 10.

Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey.ch: Anthropic API 金鑰 (第二階段)
Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey.cn: Anthropic API 密钥 (第二阶段)

Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey_tooltip.ch: 僅限伺服器. 警告: 多人模式下沙盒數值會同步到所有客戶端. 僅限白名單伺服器使用.
Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey_tooltip.cn: 仅限服务器. 警告: 多人模式下沙盒数值会同步到所有客户端. 仅限白名单服务器使用.

Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip.en: Hard limit on brain calls per real-world day. 0 disables the cap.
Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip.ch: 每個現實日大腦呼叫次數的硬性上限. 0 為停用上限.
Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip.cn: 每个现实日大脑调用次数的硬性上限. 0 为禁用上限.

Sandbox_ZT_Model_tooltip.ch: 預設為 Sonnet. Haiku 最便宜, Opus 最聰明.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldIndustrialTankLiquidC.en: Chance for industrial tanks found in the world to contain ethanol, biofuel, or gasoline. Player-built tanks always start empty.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldMetalDrumLiquidChance.en: Chance for metal drums found in the world to contain liquid. This includes grey, orange, and green drums supported by the mod.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldMetalDrumLiquidChance.cn: 世界中找到的金属油桶装有液体的几率. 包括此模组支持的灰色, 橙色和绿色油桶.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldWoodenBarrelLiquidCha.en: Chance for wooden barrels found in the world to contain liquid. Player-built barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldWoodenBarrelLiquidCha.ch: 世界中找到的木桶裝有液體的機率. 玩家建造的木桶一律從空的開始.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueAlertProtectio.en: Non-urgent one-off lines wait briefly instead of cutting off active conversations.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueAlertProtectio.cn: 非紧急的单句台词会稍候, 而非打断进行中的对话.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueConversationPa.cn: 配偶对话中每句台词的间隔.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueDisplayMode_to.en: Choose how spouse dialogue appears in this save.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueDisplayMode_to.ch: 選擇此存檔中配偶對話的顯示方式.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueDisplayMode_to.cn: 选择此存档中配偶对话的显示方式.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueMaxVisibleLine.en: How many recent lines stay visible in the subtitle box.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueMaxVisibleLine.ch: 字幕框中保持顯示的最近台詞行數.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueMaxVisibleLine.cn: 字幕框中保持显示的最近台词行数.

MarriageCompanion_DialoguePortraitImages.cn: 关闭时, 头像对话仍保留可移动的文本框, 但会隐藏实时角色脸部面板.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextDuration_t.en: How long dialogue text stays visible.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextDuration_t.ch: 對話文字顯示的持續時間.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextDuration_t.cn: 对话文本显示的持续时间.

MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextScale_tool.en: Default dialogue text size across subtitle, floating, and portrait surfaces. Portrait chat text can still be fine-tuned in portrait layout tools.
MarriageCompanion_DialogueTextScale_tool.ch: 字幕, 浮動文字與頭像聊天介面共用的預設對話文字大小. 頭像聊天的文字仍可在頭像版面工具中微調.

MarriageCompanion_EnableBringMeAlong_too.en: Adds a manual rescue command for stuck spouses.
MarriageCompanion_EnableBringMeAlong_too.ch: 新增手動救援指令, 用於卡住的配偶.
MarriageCompanion_EnableBringMeAlong_too.cn: 添加手动救援指令, 用于卡住的配偶.

MarriageCompanion_FamilyImmersionEnabled.ch: 家庭與育兒: 婚姻紀念品
MarriageCompanion_FamilyImmersionEnabled.cn: 家庭与育儿: 婚姻纪念品

MarriageCompanion_FamilyImmersionEnabled.en: Adds spouse memories, neighbor recognition, aftermath, and bond dialogue.
MarriageCompanion_FamilyImmersionEnabled.ch: 新增配偶回憶、鄰居辨識、事後餘波與羈絆對話.
MarriageCompanion_FamilyImmersionEnabled.cn: 添加配偶回忆、邻居识别、事后余波和羁绊对话.

MarriageCompanion_MedicalCustomHealthcar.en: Allows TDDUP custom medical supplies in treatment and custom loot injection. Vanilla supplies and clean water remain available where supported.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalCustomHealthcar.ch: 允許在治療與自訂戰利品注入中使用 TDDUP 自訂醫療用品. 在支援的情況下, 原版用品與乾淨的水仍可使用.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalCustomHealthcar.cn: 允许在治疗和自定义战利品注入中使用 TDDUP 自定义医疗用品. 在支持的情况下, 原版用品和干净的水仍可使用.

MarriageCompanion_MedicalDownedMechanic_.en: Allows near-fatal injuries or five open non-fatal substantial injuries to put the spouse into the recoverable DOWNED state.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalDownedMechanic_.ch: 允許瀕死傷勢或五處未癒合的非致命重傷, 使配偶進入可恢復的「倒地」狀態.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalDownedMechanic_.cn: 允许濒死伤势或五处未愈合的非致命重伤, 使配偶进入可恢复的“倒地”状态.

MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjurySystem_to.en: Records evidence-based spouse injuries and enables the custom medical ledger. Turning this off stops new custom injuries; existing ledger data is preserved.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjurySystem_to.ch: 依據實際情況記錄配偶傷勢, 並啟用自訂醫療紀錄. 關閉後不再產生新的自訂傷勢; 既有紀錄資料會保留.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjurySystem_to.cn: 依据实际情况记录配偶伤势, 并启用自定义医疗记录. 关闭后不再产生新的自定义伤势; 现有记录数据会保留.

MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonCombatCondit.en: Enable evidence-driven non-combat ailments such as dehydration, thermal exposure, GI illness, common cold, airborne irritation, and recovery fatigue. No random ailments.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonCombatCondit.ch: 啟用依實際情況觸發的非戰鬥病症, 例如脫水、冷熱曝露、腸胃疾病、感冒、空氣刺激與恢復期疲勞. 不會隨機發病.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonCombatCondit.cn: 启用依实际情况触发的非战斗病症, 例如脱水、冷热暴露、肠胃疾病、感冒、空气刺激和恢复期疲劳. 不会随机发病.

MarriageCompanion_MuteFollowSurvivalNeed.ch: 隱藏跟隨模式下輕微的需求發言.
MarriageCompanion_MuteFollowSurvivalNeed.cn: 隐藏跟随模式下轻微的需求发言.

MarriageCompanion_RadioSpouseCommsEnable.en: Adds long-range commands on matching powered radios.
MarriageCompanion_RadioSpouseCommsEnable.ch: 在相符且已通電的無線電上新增遠距離指令.
MarriageCompanion_RadioSpouseCommsEnable.cn: 在匹配且已通电的无线电上添加远距离指令.

MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.ch: 休閒: 選擇性活動頻率 (0-100)
MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.cn: 休闲: 可选活动频率 (0-100)

MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.en: How often the spouse chooses optional Relax leisure, media, reading, home visits, and casual Relax chatter. 0 disables optional leisure/chatter; 60 is the current default; 100 is the most eager. Survival needs, safety, sleep, cold care, hygiene, injury response, and emergencies ignore this slider.
MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.ch: 配偶選擇進行選擇性休閒放鬆、媒體、閱讀、在家中四處走動與日常閒聊的頻率. 0 會停用選擇性休閒/閒聊; 60 為目前預設值; 100 為最積極. 生存需求、安全、睡眠、禦寒照料、衛生、傷勢處理與緊急狀況不受此滑桿影響.
MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.cn: 配偶选择进行可选的休闲放松、媒体、阅读、在家中四处走动和日常闲聊的频率. 0 会禁用可选休闲/闲聊; 60 为当前默认值; 100 为最积极. 生存需求、安全、睡眠、御寒照料、卫生、伤势处理和紧急情况不受此滑块影响.

Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjuryS.cn: 依据实际情况记录配偶伤势, 并启用自定义医疗记录. 关闭后不再产生新的自定义伤势; 现有记录数据会保留.

Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonComb.en: Enable evidence-driven non-combat ailments such as dehydration, thermal exposure, GI illness, common cold, airborne irritation, and recovery fatigue. No random ailments.

Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonComb.cn: 启用依实际情况触发的非战斗病症, 例如脱水、冷热暴露、肠胃疾病、感冒、空气刺激和恢复期疲劳. 不会随机发病.

Sandbox_SlowGasMaskFiltersB42_EnableMult.en: Allows the server to apply slower filter wear in multiplayer games. Disable only if a server has a conflict with another mod.
Sandbox_SlowGasMaskFiltersB42_EnableMult.ch: 允許伺服器在多人遊戲中套用較慢的濾芯消耗. 僅在伺服器與其他 MOD 衝突時才停用.
Sandbox_SlowGasMaskFiltersB42_EnableMult.cn: 允许服务器在多人游戏中应用较慢的滤芯消耗. 仅在服务器与其他 MOD 冲突时才禁用.

Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_CraftingSpeed_tool.en: Adjusts only the duration of Salvage Works crafting actions. Very Fast = quarter duration; Fast = half duration; Normal = intended duration; Slow = double duration. Vanilla recipes and recipes from other mods are not affected.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_CraftingSpeed_tool.ch: 僅調整回收工坊製作動作的耗時. 非常快 = 四分之一耗時; 快 = 一半耗時; 普通 = 原定耗時; 緩慢 = 兩倍耗時. 本體配方與其他模組的配方不受影響.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_CraftingSpeed_tool.cn: 仅调整回收工坊制作动作的耗时. 非常快 = 四分之一耗时; 快 = 一半耗时; 普通 = 原定耗时; 缓慢 = 两倍耗时. 原版配方与其他模组的配方不受影响.

Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_RecyclingYieldMult.en: The yield multiplier applies only to iron, steel, generic metal and wood recycling. 0.50 = lower; 1.00 = normal; 2.00 = higher. Each craft still produces at least one item; item condition and skill also affect yield.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_RecyclingYieldMult.ch: 產量倍率只套用於鐵、鋼、一般金屬與木材的回收. 0.50 = 較低; 1.00 = 正常; 2.00 = 較高. 每次製作仍至少產出一個物品; 物品狀況與技能也會影響產量.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_RecyclingYieldMult.cn: 产量倍率仅适用于铁、钢、普通金属和木材的回收. 0.50 = 较低; 1.00 = 正常; 2.00 = 较高. 每次制作仍至少产出一个物品; 物品状况和技能也会影响产量.

Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_SkillRequirements_.en: Yes: Salvage Works recipes use their intended skill levels. No: skill levels do not block the mod's recipes. Materials, tools, and workstations are still required. After changing this option, in single-player quit and reload the game. In multiplayer, restart the server for the change to take effect.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_SkillRequirements_.ch: 是: 回收工坊配方使用原定的技能等級. 否: 技能等級不會限制本模組的配方. 仍需要材料、工具與工作臺. 變更此選項後, 單人遊戲請退出並重新載入遊戲. 多人遊戲請重新啟動伺服器才會生效.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_SkillRequirements_.cn: 是: 回收工坊配方使用原定的技能等级. 否: 技能等级不会限制本模组的配方. 仍需要材料、工具与工作台. 更改此选项后, 单人游戏请退出并重新加载游戏. 多人游戏请重启服务器才会生效.

Sandbox_TheButchersTable_FishDryDays_too.cn: 鱼在肉架上晾干所需的游戏内天数 (鱼片与整条鱼). 默认 3.

Sandbox_TheButchersTable_JerkyDryDays.ch: 肉類 (肉乾) 晾乾時間 (天)
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_JerkyDryDays.cn: 肉类 (肉干) 晾干时间 (天)

Sandbox_TheButchersTable_JerkyDryDays_to.en: How many in-game days meat takes to dry into jerky on the meat rack. Default 10.
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_JerkyDryDays_to.ch: 肉在肉架上晾乾成肉乾所需的遊戲內天數. 預設 10.
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_JerkyDryDays_to.cn: 肉在肉架上晾干成肉干所需的游戏内天数. 默认 10.

Sandbox_TheButchersTable_PolendwicaDryDa.en: How many in-game days polendwica takes to dry on the meat rack. Default 5.
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_PolendwicaDryDa.ch: 波蘭燻腸在肉架上晾乾所需的遊戲內天數. 預設 5.
Sandbox_TheButchersTable_PolendwicaDryDa.cn: 波兰熏肠在肉架上晾干所需的游戏内天数. 默认 5.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropUseLootLevelZo.ch: 使用物資等級的殭屍設定
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropUseLootLevelZo.cn: 使用物资等级的僵尸设置

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropUseLootLevelZo.en: When enabled, the selected loot level overrides the manual zombie count, spawn radius and sprinter chance.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieSprinter.en: Chance that each event zombie becomes a sprinter. Set to 0 to disable sprinters from airdrops.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieSprinter.ch: 每隻事件殭屍成為跑屍的機率. 設為 0 即可停用空投跑屍.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropZombieSprinter.cn: 每只事件僵尸成为跑尸的几率. 设为 0 即可禁用空投跑尸.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDirectionArrow.ch: 箭頭指向精確空投位置
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDirectionArrow.cn: 箭头指向精确空投位置

Sandbox_PIP_EnableFertigation_tooltip.en: When on, pour Fertilizer or Compost into a connected rain barrel and the pipe network auto-fertilizes nearby crops (one safe dose per crop, never over-fertilizes). On by default.
Sandbox_PIP_EnableFertigation_tooltip.ch: 開啟後, 將肥料或堆肥倒入相連的雨水收集桶, 管網會自動為附近的作物施肥 (每株作物一份安全劑量, 絕不會過量施肥). 預設開啟.
Sandbox_PIP_EnableFertigation_tooltip.cn: 开启后, 将肥料或堆肥倒入相连的雨水收集桶, 管网会自动为附近的作物施肥 (每株作物一份安全剂量, 绝不会过量施肥). 默认开启.

Sandbox_NewMusic_VinylRecordsSpawnPreset.cn: 黑胶唱片的预设稀有度. 选择“自定义”即可改用“黑胶唱片”选项的生成率数值.

Sandbox_NewMusic_ZomboidOST_tooltip.en: Allows the base mod Zomboid OST items to spawn. Uncheck to disable them.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ZomboidOST_tooltip.ch: 允許基礎模組的殭屍毀滅工程原聲帶物品生成. 取消勾選即可停用.
Sandbox_NewMusic_ZomboidOST_tooltip.cn: 允许基础模组的僵尸毁灭工程原声带物品生成. 取消勾选即可禁用.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_DripBurstPressure.en: Pressure that bursts a drip emitter (tenths)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_DripBurstPressure.ch: 滴灌頭爆裂壓力 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_DripBurstPressure.cn: 滴灌头爆裂压力 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_DripBurstPressure_too.en: Above this pressure a drip emitter blows out and stops watering until you repair it, just like a real one. In tenths of a metre of water column: 150 = 15.0, well under a pump's 25.0, so a pump on the same line will burst your emitters unless you put a router in between and set a limit. Set to 0 so emitters never burst.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_DripBurstPressure_too.ch: 壓力超過此值時, 滴灌頭會爆裂並停止澆水, 直到你修好為止, 就像真的一樣. 單位為十分之一公尺水柱: 150 = 15.0, 遠低於水泵的 25.0, 因此同一條管線上的水泵會把灌溉頭撐爆, 除非你在中間加裝分流器並設定上限. 設為 0 則灌溉頭永遠不會爆裂.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_DripBurstPressure_too.cn: 压力超过此值时, 滴灌头会爆裂并停止浇水, 直到你修好为止, 就像真的一样. 单位为十分之一米水柱: 150 = 15.0, 远低于水泵的 25.0, 因此同一条管线上的水泵会把灌溉头撑爆, 除非你在中间加装分流器并设置上限. 设为 0 则灌溉头永远不会爆裂.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantHead.ch: 消防栓壓力 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantHead.cn: 消防栓压力 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantHead_tooltip.en: Pressure an open, mains-fed fire hydrant holds its network at, in tenths of a metre of water column. 400 = 40.0, well above the household mains (25.0) and a sprinkler's 20.0, because a hydrant is a high-flow tap on the town main. Opening one runs sprinklers far from any container with no pump, right up to the day the water is cut, after which the hydrant still yields its reserve but with no pressure. Lower it to make hydrants less of a free pump.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantHead_tooltip.ch: 開啟且由自來水主管供水的消防栓維持其管網的壓力, 單位為十分之一公尺水柱. 400 = 40.0, 遠高於家用自來水 (25.0) 和灑水器所需的 20.0, 因為消防栓是城鎮主管上的大流量水龍頭. 開啟消防栓可讓遠離任何容器的灑水器在沒有水泵的情況下運轉, 直到停水那天為止; 停水後消防栓仍會流出剩餘的儲水, 但沒有壓力. 調低此值可讓消防栓不那麼像免費水泵.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantHead_tooltip.cn: 打开且由自来水总管供水的消防栓维持其管网的压力, 单位为十分之一米水柱. 400 = 40.0, 远高于家用自来水 (25.0) 和洒水器所需的 20.0, 因为消防栓是城镇总管上的大流量水龙头. 打开消防栓可让远离任何容器的洒水器在没有水泵的情况下运转, 直到停水那天为止; 停水后消防栓仍会流出剩余的储水, 但没有压力. 调低此值可让消防栓不那么像免费水泵.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantReserve_toolti.en: How much water a fire hydrant still holds in its local main once the town water is cut. 1000 by default. While the water service is on the hydrant is mains-fed and effectively bottomless; this is only what is left afterwards, and it drains as you use it. Set to 0 so hydrants run dry the moment the water stops.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantReserve_toolti.ch: 城鎮停水後, 消防栓在其局部主管中仍保有多少水. 預設為 1000. 供水服務期間消防栓由自來水主管供水, 實際上取之不盡; 此值只是停水後剩下的水量, 使用時會逐漸耗盡. 設為 0 則停水當下消防栓就會乾涸.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydrantReserve_toolti.cn: 城镇停水后, 消防栓在其局部总管中仍保有多少水. 默认为 1000. 供水服务期间消防栓由自来水总管供水, 实际上取之不尽; 此值只是停水后剩下的水量, 使用时会逐渐耗尽. 设为 0 则停水当下消防栓就会干涸.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydraulicDemandScale_.en: How much a pipe is charged for the water its NEIGHBOURS are drawing. 100 = full realism: thirty sprinklers on one line starve each other, and only the ones nearest the pump run. 0 = the pre-4.x behaviour, where every consumer priced its run as if it were alone on the network, so any number of sprinklers ran off a single pump. Lower it if an existing farm stopped working and you would rather not rebuild it into zones.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydraulicDemandScale_.ch: 管線要為相鄰裝置汲取的水承擔多少負荷. 100 = 完全擬真: 同一條管線上的三十個灑水器會互相搶水, 只有最靠近水泵的那些能運轉. 0 = 4.x 之前的行為, 每個用水裝置都把自己的管線當成管網中唯一的用水者計算, 因此單一水泵就能帶動任意數量的灑水器. 如果現有的農場停止運作, 而你不想把它重建成分區, 可以調低此值.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_HydraulicDemandScale_.cn: 管线要为相邻设备汲取的水承担多少负荷. 100 = 完全拟真: 同一条管线上的三十个洒水器会互相抢水, 只有最靠近水泵的那些能运转. 0 = 4.x 之前的行为, 每个用水设备都把自己的管线当成管网中唯一的用水者计算, 因此单个水泵就能带动任意数量的洒水器. 如果现有的农场停止运作, 而你不想把它重建成分区, 可以调低此值.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsHead.ch: 城鎮供水壓力 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsHead.cn: 城镇供水压力 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsHead_tooltip.en: Pressure the town supply holds the network at, in tenths of a metre of water column. 250 = 25.0, the low end of what a real municipal main runs. A sprinkler needs 20.0, so at the default the mains runs sprinklers on its own. Lower it if you want pumps to still matter before the shutoff.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsHead_tooltip.ch: 城鎮供水維持管網的壓力, 單位為十分之一公尺水柱. 250 = 25.0, 屬於真實市政主管壓力的低標. 灑水器需要 20.0, 因此在預設值下, 自來水本身就能帶動灑水器. 如果想讓水泵在停水前仍有作用, 可以調低此值.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsHead_tooltip.cn: 城镇供水维持管网的压力, 单位为十分之一米水柱. 250 = 25.0, 属于真实市政总管压力的低端. 洒水器需要 20.0, 因此在默认值下, 自来水本身就能带动洒水器. 如果想让水泵在停水前仍有作用, 可以调低此值.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsIntakeRate.en: Town water intake rate (litres per minute)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsIntakeRate.ch: 城鎮供水進水速度 (公升/分鐘)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsIntakeRate.cn: 城镇供水进水速度 (升/分钟)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsIntakeRate_toolt.en: How much water the town supply pushes into your network each in-game minute. 60 = 3600 litres an hour, three times a pump, because the mains is the fattest source in the game. Lower it if filling your whole reserve before the shutoff feels too easy.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsIntakeRate_toolt.ch: 城鎮供水在每個遊戲內分鐘推入你管網的水量. 60 = 每小時 3600 公升, 是水泵的三倍, 因為自來水是遊戲中最大的水源. 如果覺得在停水前裝滿全部儲水太容易, 可以調低此值.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsIntakeRate_toolt.cn: 城镇供水在每个游戏内分钟推入你管网的水量. 60 = 每小时 3600 升, 是水泵的三倍, 因为自来水是游戏中最大的水源. 如果觉得在停水前装满全部储水太容易, 可以调低此值.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsSupply_tooltip.en: While the water service is still running, a plumbed sink or shower feeds your pipes instead of just drawing from them: it fills your containers and holds the network at mains pressure, so sprinklers run without a pump until the day the water is cut. Turn this off to keep the old behaviour, where plumbing a fixture switched its town water off and gave nothing back.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsSupply_tooltip.ch: 在供水服務仍運作時, 接上水管的水槽或淋浴器會向你的管線供水, 而不只是從中取水: 它會裝滿你的容器, 並讓管網維持自來水壓力, 因此灑水器不需要水泵就能運轉, 直到停水那天為止. 關閉此選項則保留舊行為, 也就是接上水管的用水裝置會關閉其城鎮供水, 且不會回饋任何水.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_MainsSupply_tooltip.cn: 在供水服务仍运作时, 接上水管的水槽或淋浴器会向你的管线供水, 而不只是从中取水: 它会装满你的容器, 并让管网维持自来水压力, 因此洒水器不需要水泵就能运转, 直到停水那天为止. 关闭此选项则保留旧行为, 也就是接上水管的用水设备会关闭其城镇供水, 且不会回馈任何水.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureContainerBase.ch: 容器基礎壓力 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureContainerBase.cn: 容器基础压力 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureContainerBase.en: Pressure a container provides on its own floor, in tenths of a metre of water column, from the weight of its own water. 10 = 1.0, which lets a tap draw from about 20 tiles away on the flat. Raise this if taps in your base sit a long way from their containers.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureContainerBase.ch: 容器憑自身水重在所在樓層提供的壓力, 單位為十分之一公尺水柱. 10 = 1.0, 可讓水龍頭在平地上從約 20 格外取水. 如果基地裡的水龍頭離其容器很遠, 可以調高此值.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureContainerBase.cn: 容器凭自身水重在所在楼层提供的压力, 单位为十分之一米水柱. 10 = 1.0, 可让水龙头在平地上从约 20 格外取水. 如果基地里的水龙头离其容器很远, 可以调高此值.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureFrictionScale.en: How much pressure each pipe tile costs, as a percentage of the default. 100 = default. 200 = pipes lose pressure twice as fast, halving how far water travels. Set to 0 so distance never costs pressure and only height and pumps matter.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureFrictionScale.ch: 每格管線損耗多少壓力, 以預設值的百分比表示. 100 = 預設. 200 = 管線損失壓力的速度加倍, 水能輸送的距離減半. 設為 0 則距離不會損耗壓力, 只有高度和水泵有影響.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureFrictionScale.cn: 每格管线损耗多少压力, 以默认值的百分比表示. 100 = 默认. 200 = 管线损失压力的速度加倍, 水能输送的距离减半. 设为 0 则距离不会损耗压力, 只有高度和水泵有影响.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_Values_.ch: 擬真 (高度, 距離和水泵)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_Values_.cn: 拟真 (高度, 距离和水泵)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_Values_.ch: 簡易 (只計高度, 距離不損耗)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_Values_.cn: 简易 (只计高度, 距离不损耗)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_Values_.ch: 關閉 (舊行為, 只靠重力)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_Values_.cn: 关闭 (旧行为, 只靠重力)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_tooltip.en: How water pressure is worked out. Pressure is measured in metres of water column: height above a tap adds pressure, distance along the pipes spends it, and pumps create it. Realistic uses the full model. Simple counts height only, so distance never costs anything. Off restores the old behaviour, where water simply flows downhill however far it has to travel.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_tooltip.ch: 水壓的計算方式. 壓力以公尺水柱計算: 高於水龍頭的高度會增加壓力, 沿管線的距離會消耗壓力, 水泵則會產生壓力. 擬真使用完整模型. 簡易只計算高度, 因此距離不會有任何損耗. 關閉則恢復舊行為, 水只會往低處流, 不論要流多遠.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressureModel_tooltip.cn: 水压的计算方式. 压力以米水柱计算: 高于水龙头的高度会增加压力, 沿管线的距离会消耗压力, 水泵则会产生压力. 拟真使用完整模型. 简易只计算高度, 因此距离不会有任何损耗. 关闭则恢复旧行为, 水只会往低处流, 不论要流多远.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressurePerLevel.en: Pressure gained per floor of height (tenths)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressurePerLevel.ch: 每層樓高度增加的壓力 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressurePerLevel.cn: 每层楼高度增加的压力 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressurePerLevel_tool.en: Pressure a source gains for each floor it sits above what it feeds, in tenths of a metre of water column. 30 = 3.0 per floor, which matches a real storey height. Higher values make rooftop tanks and water towers stronger.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressurePerLevel_tool.ch: 水源每比供水目標高一層樓所增加的壓力, 單位為十分之一公尺水柱. 30 = 每層 3.0, 符合真實樓層高度. 數值越高, 屋頂水箱和水塔的壓力越強.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PressurePerLevel_tool.cn: 水源每比供水对象高一层楼所增加的压力, 单位为十分之一米水柱. 30 = 每层 3.0, 符合真实楼层高度. 数值越高, 屋顶水箱和水塔的压力越强.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpFromWaterBodies.en: Pumps can draw from rivers and lakes
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpFromWaterBodies.ch: 水泵可從河流和湖泊汲水
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpFromWaterBodies.cn: 水泵可从河流和湖泊汲水

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpFromWaterBodies_t.en: When on, a pump placed beside open water draws unlimited dirty water from it, which you can then clean with a purifier. Turn this off to keep water scarce: pumps will still work from wells and from your own containers.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpFromWaterBodies_t.ch: 開啟後, 放在開放水域旁的水泵可從中汲取無限量的髒水, 之後可用淨水器淨化. 關閉此選項可讓水保持稀缺: 水泵仍可從水井和你自己的容器汲水.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpFromWaterBodies_t.cn: 开启后, 放在开放水域旁的水泵可从中汲取无限量的脏水, 之后可用净水器净化. 关闭此选项可让水保持稀缺: 水泵仍可从水井和你自己的容器汲水.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpHead.ch: 單一水泵增加的壓力 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpHead.cn: 单个水泵增加的压力 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpHead_tooltip.en: Pressure a powered pump adds to its part of the network, in tenths of a metre of water column. 250 = 25.0, which matches a domestic pressure set. Pumps chained together add up. A sprinkler needs 20.0, so one pump runs sprinklers about 30 tiles away.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpHead_tooltip.ch: 通電的水泵為其所在管網區段增加的壓力, 單位為十分之一公尺水柱. 250 = 25.0, 相當於家用增壓裝置. 串接的水泵會累加壓力. 灑水器需要 20.0, 因此一個水泵可帶動約 30 格外的灑水器.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpHead_tooltip.cn: 通电的水泵为其所在管网区段增加的压力, 单位为十分之一米水柱. 250 = 25.0, 相当于家用增压设备. 串联的水泵会累加压力. 洒水器需要 20.0, 因此一个水泵可带动约 30 格外的洒水器.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpIntakeRate.ch: 水泵進水速度 (公升/分鐘)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpIntakeRate_toolti.en: How much water a pump draws from a well or open water each in-game minute. 20 = about 1200 litres an hour, which is on the modest side for a real pump. This is the main brake on infinite river water, so lower it if water feels too easy.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpIntakeRate_toolti.ch: 水泵每個遊戲內分鐘從水井或開放水域汲取的水量. 20 = 每小時約 1200 公升, 對真實水泵來說算是偏低. 這是限制無限河水的主要手段, 如果覺得取水太容易, 可以調低此值.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpIntakeRate_toolti.cn: 水泵每个游戏内分钟从水井或开放水域汲取的水量. 20 = 每小时约 1200 升, 对真实水泵来说算是偏低. 这是限制无限河水的主要手段, 如果觉得取水太容易, 可以调低此值.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpSuctionLimit.ch: 水泵吸程上限 (以 0.1 為單位)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpSuctionLimit.cn: 水泵吸程上限 (以 0.1 为单位)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpSuctionLimit_tool.en: How far below itself a pump can still lift water, in tenths of a metre of water column. 70 = 7.0, about two floors, which is the real limit for a surface pump because atmospheric pressure caps suction. A source further down will not prime, no matter how strong the pump is. Raise this if you want pumps to reach deep basements.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpSuctionLimit_tool.ch: 水泵能從自身下方多深處抽水, 單位為十分之一公尺水柱. 70 = 7.0, 約兩層樓, 這是地面水泵的真實極限, 因為大氣壓力限制了吸力. 更深處的水源無論水泵多強都無法引水. 如果希望水泵能抽到深層地下室, 可以調高此值.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PumpSuctionLimit_tool.cn: 水泵能从自身下方多深处抽水, 单位为十分之一米水柱. 70 = 7.0, 约两层楼, 这是地面水泵的真实极限, 因为大气压力限制了吸力. 更深处的水源无论水泵多强都无法引水. 如果希望水泵能抽到深层地下室, 可以调高此值.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierFilterWear_to.en: How fast the electric purifier's filter wears out with use, as a percentage of the default rate. 100 = default (a full filter cleans about 5000 units of tainted water before it needs repair). 200 = wears twice as fast, 50 = half as fast. Set to 0 so filters never wear out and never need repairing.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierFilterWear_to.ch: 電動淨水器濾芯隨使用而耗損的速度, 以預設速度的百分比表示. 100 = 預設 (完好的濾芯在需要修理前約可淨化 5000 單位受汙染的水). 200 = 耗損速度加倍, 50 = 耗損速度減半. 設為 0 則濾芯永不耗損, 也永遠不需修理.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PurifierFilterWear_to.cn: 电动净水器滤芯随使用而损耗的速度, 以默认速度的百分比表示. 100 = 默认 (完好的滤芯在需要修理前约可净化 5000 单位受污染的水). 200 = 损耗速度加倍, 50 = 损耗速度减半. 设为 0 则滤芯永不损耗, 也永远不需修理.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_RainTaintsOpenWater_t.en: When on, rain falling on an open container left outside taints its whole network, so uncovered collection is a gamble whenever the weather turns. Turn off if you would rather open containers only spoil from sitting still.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_RainTaintsOpenWater_t.ch: 開啟後, 雨水落入放在戶外的開口容器時, 會汙染其整個管網, 因此每逢天氣變化, 無遮蓋的集水都是一場賭博. 如果你寧可讓開口容器只因靜置而變質, 可以關閉此選項.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_RainTaintsOpenWater_t.cn: 开启后, 雨水落入放在户外的开口容器时, 会污染其整个管网, 因此每逢天气变化, 无遮盖的集水都是一场赌博. 如果你宁可让开口容器只因静置而变质, 可以关闭此选项.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_RealisticPurification.en: When on, taps no longer purify tainted water automatically: tainted water stays tainted until you run it through a purifier tile. On by default as the survival baseline; turn it off to have taps serve clean water like vanilla.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_RealisticPurification.ch: 開啟後, 水龍頭不再自動淨化受汙染的水: 受汙染的水會一直保持汙染, 直到你讓它流經淨水器格子. 預設開啟作為生存基準; 關閉則讓水龍頭像原版一樣供應乾淨的水.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_RealisticPurification.cn: 开启后, 水龙头不再自动净化受污染的水: 受污染的水会一直保持污染, 直到你让它流经净水器格子. 默认开启作为生存基准; 关闭则让水龙头像原版一样供应干净的水.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_SprinklerNoise_toolti.en: When on, a running sprinkler attracts zombies, which is the price you pay for watering a whole area at once. Turn it off if you would rather irrigate quietly.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SprinklerNoise_toolti.ch: 開啟後, 運轉中的灑水器會吸引殭屍, 這是一次為整片區域澆水的代價. 如果你寧可安靜地灌溉, 可以關閉此選項.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SprinklerNoise_toolti.cn: 开启后, 运转中的洒水器会吸引僵尸, 这是一次为整片区域浇水的代价. 如果你宁可安静地灌溉, 可以关闭此选项.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysClosed.en: Days before sealed water goes bad

Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysClosed_.en: How many days a sealed container (a covered collector, the pipe network itself, a lidded amphora) may sit with no movement before its water turns tainted. Sealed water keeps for weeks, so this is the long timer. Set to 0 so sealed water never goes bad.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysClosed_.ch: 密封容器 (有蓋的雨水收集器, 管網本身, 有蓋的雙耳罐) 在水不流動的情況下可放置多少天才會變成受汙染的水. 密封的水可保存數週, 因此這是較長的計時. 設為 0 則密封的水永不變質.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysClosed_.cn: 密封容器 (有盖的雨水收集器, 管网本身, 有盖的双耳罐) 在水不流动的情况下可放置多少天才会变成受污染的水. 密封的水可保存数周, 因此这是较长的计时. 设为 0 则密封的水永不变质.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysOpen.en: Days before open water goes bad

Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysOpen_to.en: How many days an open, rain-catching container (a rain collector, an uncovered amphora) may sit with no movement before its water turns tainted. Open water spoils in days, so this is the short timer. Set to 0 so open water never goes bad on its own (rain can still taint it).
Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysOpen_to.ch: 可承接雨水的開口容器 (雨水收集器, 無蓋的雙耳罐) 在水不流動的情況下可放置多少天才會變成受汙染的水. 開放的水幾天內就會變質, 因此這是較短的計時. 設為 0 則開放的水不會自行變質 (雨水仍可能汙染它).
Sandbox_WaterPipes_StagnationDaysOpen_to.cn: 可承接雨水的开口容器 (雨水收集器, 无盖的双耳罐) 在水不流动的情况下可放置多少天才会变成受污染的水. 开放的水几天内就会变质, 因此这是较短的计时. 设为 0 则开放的水不会自行变质 (雨水仍可能污染它).

Sandbox_WaterPipes_WaterStagnation_toolt.en: When on, water left sitting in a container or pipe network turns tainted after a while, and rain contaminates any open water left outside. Drawing from a network, refilling it, or town water flowing through it all count as movement and keep it fresh. Turn off to keep stored water clean forever.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_WaterStagnation_toolt.ch: 開啟後, 留在容器或管網中的水放置一段時間後會變成受汙染的水, 雨水也會汙染放在戶外的任何開放水源. 從管網取水, 重新加水或城鎮供水流經都算是流動, 可保持水質新鮮. 關閉則讓儲存的水永遠保持乾淨.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_WaterStagnation_toolt.cn: 开启后, 留在容器或管网中的水放置一段时间后会变成受污染的水, 雨水也会污染放在户外的任何开放水源. 从管网取水, 重新加水或城镇供水流经都算是流动, 可保持水质新鲜. 关闭则让储存的水永远保持干净.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedMoodlesEnable.en: Enables the moodle with each breed's unique buffs.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedMoodlesEnable.ch: 啟用帶有各犬種專屬增益的狀態.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedMoodlesEnable.cn: 启用带有各犬种独特增益的状态.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacityMulti.en: Multiplies the saddlebag's cargo capacity. 0 makes it purely cosmetic.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacityMulti.ch: 調整馱袋的載物容量倍率. 0 則僅作為裝飾.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacityMulti.cn: 调整驮袋的载物容量倍率. 0 则仅作为装饰.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_Death.ch: 疾病與疏於照顧可能致死
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_Death.cn: 疾病和疏于照顾可能致死

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_Death_tooltip.en: The pet can die of illness, hunger and thirst. Default: off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_Death_tooltip.ch: 寵物可能因疾病, 飢餓和口渴而死亡. 預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_Death_tooltip.cn: 宠物可能因疾病, 饥饿和口渴而死亡. 默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinHours_toolt.en: How many hours a pet can go without protein before it turns Weak.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinHours_toolt.ch: 寵物缺乏蛋白質多少小時後會變得虛弱.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinHours_toolt.cn: 宠物缺乏蛋白质多少小时后会变得虚弱.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinNeedEnabled.en: Enables the animal's need for protein in its diet.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinNeedEnabled.ch: 啟用動物飲食中對蛋白質的需求.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinNeedEnabled.cn: 启用动物饮食中对蛋白质的需求.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TricksEnabled_tool.en: Enables the pet's tricks. Can be OP on a server.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TricksEnabled_tool.ch: 啟用寵物的技巧. 在伺服器上可能過於強大.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TricksEnabled_tool.cn: 启用宠物的技巧. 在服务器上可能过于强大.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TripOverDogs_toolt.en: When on, running into a pet can knock you down.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TripOverDogs_toolt.ch: 開啟時, 撞上寵物可能會使你摔倒.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TripOverDogs_toolt.cn: 开启时, 撞上宠物可能会让你摔倒.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetAllergyChance_t.en: Chance that the pet is born allergic to one meat for life, rolled once per pet. Default 5 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetAllergyChance_t.ch: 寵物天生對某種肉類終身過敏的機率, 每隻寵物僅判定一次. 預設為百分之 5.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetAllergyChance_t.cn: 宠物天生对某种肉类终身过敏的概率, 每只宠物仅判定一次. 默认为百分之 5.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetCareEnabled_too.en: The pet can pick up wounds and illnesses. Default: on.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetCareEnabled_too.ch: 寵物可能受傷和生病. 預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetCareEnabled_too.cn: 宠物可能受伤和生病. 默认: 开启.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetFluChance_toolt.en: Chance of catching the flu: rolled while the pet is starving, and for each hour beside a sick dog. Default 15 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetFluChance_toolt.ch: 感染流感的機率: 寵物挨餓時, 以及每在生病的狗身旁待一小時, 都會進行判定. 預設為百分之 15.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetFluChance_toolt.cn: 感染流感的概率: 宠物挨饿时, 以及每在生病的狗身旁待一小时, 都会进行判定. 默认为百分之 15.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetHeartwormChance.en: Rolled for every 6 straight hours outdoors. Going indoors resets the count. Default 1.5 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetHeartwormChance.ch: 每連續待在戶外 6 小時判定一次. 進入室內會重置計數. 預設為百分之 1.5.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetHeartwormChance.cn: 每连续待在户外 6 小时判定一次. 进入室内会重置计数. 默认为百分之 1.5.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance.en: Flea and tick chance per bite (percent)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance.ch: 每次咬擊沾上跳蚤與壁蝨的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance.cn: 每次撕咬沾上跳蚤和蜱虫的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance_to.en: Chance that each bite in a fight brings fleas or ticks. Default 0.2 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance_to.ch: 戰鬥中每次咬擊帶來跳蚤或壁蝨的機率. 預設為百分之 0.2.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance_to.cn: 战斗中每次撕咬带来跳蚤或蜱虫的概率. 默认为百分之 0.2.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSpoiledChance_t.en: Chance that bad food or water leaves the pet vomiting. Default 25 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSpoiledChance_t.ch: 不良食物或水導致寵物嘔吐的機率. 預設為百分之 25.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSpoiledChance_t.cn: 不良食物或水导致宠物呕吐的概率. 默认为百分之 25.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSprainChance.ch: 每次跳越圍欄扭傷的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSprainChance.cn: 每次翻越栅栏扭伤的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSprainChance_to.en: Percent chance that each fence the pet hops leaves it with a sprained paw. Default 0.5, 0 means never.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSprainChance_to.ch: 寵物每跳越一道圍欄就扭傷爪子的機率百分比. 預設 0.5, 0 表示永不發生.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSprainChance_to.cn: 宠物每翻越一道栅栏就扭伤爪子的概率百分比. 默认 0.5, 0 表示永不发生.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance.en: Worms chance per 6 h with an upset stomach (percent)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance.ch: 腸胃不適時每 6 小時感染寄生蟲的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance.cn: 肠胃不适时每 6 小时感染寄生虫的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance_too.en: Percent chance the pet catches worms for every 6 hours with an upset stomach. Default 10 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance_too.ch: 寵物腸胃不適時, 每 6 小時感染腸道寄生蟲的機率百分比. 預設為百分之 10.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance_too.cn: 宠物肠胃不适时, 每 6 小时感染肠道寄生虫的概率百分比. 默认为百分之 10.

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWoundChance.ch: 每次咬擊受傷的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWoundChance.cn: 每次撕咬受伤的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWoundChance_too.en: Chance that a bite the pet lands on a zombie hurts its paw. Default 0.4 percent. Each Combat level of the pet lowers it by 5 percent of this value, so at level 10 it is halved.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWoundChance_too.ch: 寵物咬中殭屍時爪子受傷的機率. 預設為百分之 0.4. 寵物的戰鬥等級每升 1 級, 機率就降低此數值的百分之 5, 因此到 10 級時會減半.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWoundChance_too.cn: 宠物咬中僵尸时爪子受伤的概率. 默认为百分之 0.4. 宠物的战斗等级每升 1 级, 概率就降低该数值的百分之 5, 因此到 10 级时会减半.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedDebug_tooltip.en: Master switch for bunker_extended debug output. Off by default.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedDebug_tooltip.ch: bunker_extended 除錯輸出的總開關. 預設關閉.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedDebug_tooltip.cn: bunker_extended 调试输出的总开关. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.ch: 發電機自動啟動延遲 (秒)
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.cn: 发电机自动启动延迟 (秒)

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.en: Wait time after grid failure before the first autostart attempt, and between failed autostart retries.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.ch: 電網故障後到首次嘗試自動啟動前的等待時間, 以及自動啟動失敗後重試的間隔.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.cn: 电网故障后到首次尝试自动启动前的等待时间, 以及自动启动失败后重试的间隔.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.ch: 發電機自動啟動最大失敗次數
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.cn: 发电机自动启动最大失败次数

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.en: Failed autostart attempts per grid outage before autostart gives up. Manual start still works. Resets when grid power returns.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.ch: 每次電網停電期間, 自動啟動失敗達此次數後即放棄. 仍可手動啟動. 電網恢復供電時重置.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorAutostart.cn: 每次电网停电期间, 自动启动失败达到此次数后即放弃. 仍可手动启动. 电网恢复供电时重置.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorDebug_too.en: Verbose generator autostart and grid logs.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorDebug_too.ch: 詳細的發電機自動啟動與電網日誌.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedGeneratorDebug_too.cn: 详细的发电机自动启动和电网日志.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedKitchenFoodLootRol.en: Weight multiplier for edible food and drink in the kitchen when reduced loot is enabled. Does not affect flour, salt, pots, or other cooking items. 1.0 = original stocking, 0.35 = about 65%% less food.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedKitchenFoodLootRol.ch: 啟用減少戰利品時, 廚房內可食用食物與飲料的權重倍率. 不影響麵粉, 鹽, 鍋具或其他烹飪物品. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 食物減少約 65%%.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedKitchenFoodLootRol.cn: 启用减少战利品时, 厨房内可食用食物和饮料的权重倍率. 不影响面粉, 盐, 锅具或其他烹饪物品. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 食物减少约 65%%.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedMedicalLootRollMul.en: Loot roll multiplier for the medical room when reduced loot is enabled. 1.0 = original stocking, 0.35 = about 65%% less.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedMedicalLootRollMul.ch: 啟用減少戰利品時, 醫療室的戰利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 減少約 65%%.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedMedicalLootRollMul.cn: 启用减少战利品时, 医疗室的战利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 减少约 65%%.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedPantryLootRollMult.ch: 食品儲藏室炊具戰利品數量
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedPantryLootRollMult.cn: 食品储藏室炊具战利品数量

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedPantryLootRollMult.en: Loot roll multiplier for pantry cooking utensils when reduced loot is enabled. 1.0 = original stocking, 0.35 = about 65%% less.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedPantryLootRollMult.ch: 啟用減少戰利品時, 食品儲藏室炊具的戰利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 減少約 65%%.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedPantryLootRollMult.cn: 启用减少战利品时, 食品储藏室炊具的战利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 减少约 65%%.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedKitchenFood.en: Lower spawn chance for edible food and drink in the kitchen. Cooking tools and ingredients are unchanged. Only affects new worlds.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedKitchenFood.ch: 降低廚房內可食用食物與飲料的生成機率. 烹飪工具與食材不變. 僅影響新世界.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedKitchenFood.cn: 降低厨房内可食用食物和饮料的生成概率. 烹饪工具和食材不变. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedMedicalLoot.en: Lower loot rolls in the medical room. Only affects new worlds.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedMedicalLoot.ch: 降低醫療室的戰利品判定次數. 僅影響新世界.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedMedicalLoot.cn: 降低医疗室的战利品判定次数. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedPantryLoot.ch: 減少食品儲藏室炊具戰利品
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedPantryLoot.cn: 减少食品储藏室炊具战利品

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedPantryLoot_.en: Lower loot rolls for cooking utensils in the pantry. Only affects new worlds.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedPantryLoot_.ch: 降低食品儲藏室炊具的戰利品判定次數. 僅影響新世界.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedPantryLoot_.cn: 降低食品储藏室炊具的战利品判定次数. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom2Loot_t.en: Lower loot rolls in the military gear room. Only affects new worlds.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom2Loot_t.ch: 降低軍事裝備室的戰利品判定次數. 僅影響新世界.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom2Loot_t.cn: 降低军事装备室的战利品判定次数. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom3Loot_t.en: Lower loot rolls in the survival gear room. Only affects new worlds.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom3Loot_t.cn: 降低生存装备室的战利品判定次数. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom4Loot.ch: 減少工作坊補給戰利品
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom4Loot.cn: 减少工作坊补给战利品

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom4Loot_t.en: Lower loot rolls in the workshop and supply room. Only affects new worlds.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom4Loot_t.ch: 降低工作坊與補給室的戰利品判定次數. 僅影響新世界.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedRoom4Loot_t.cn: 降低工作坊和补给室的战利品判定次数. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedWhodLoot_to.en: Lower loot rolls in the main general gear room. Only affects new worlds.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedWhodLoot_to.ch: 降低主要一般裝備室的戰利品判定次數. 僅影響新世界.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedReducedWhodLoot_to.cn: 降低主要一般装备室的战利品判定次数. 仅影响新世界.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedRoom2LootRollMulti.en: Loot roll multiplier for the military gear room when reduced loot is enabled. 1.0 = original stocking, 0.35 = about 65%% less.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedRoom2LootRollMulti.ch: 啟用減少戰利品時, 軍事裝備室的戰利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 減少約 65%%.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedRoom2LootRollMulti.cn: 启用减少战利品时, 军事装备室的战利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 减少约 65%%.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedRoom4LootRollMulti.cn: 工作坊补给战利品数量

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.ch: 選填. 任何已載入 MOD 的完整車輛腳本名稱, 例如 Base.93chevySuburban. 設定後會覆蓋下拉選單. 若找不到該腳本, 則改用富蘭克林·全地形 (SUV).

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.cn: 地堡车辆油箱加满
