Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.cn: KI5: '93 雪佛兰 Suburban (MOD)

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.ch: KI5: M998 悍馬車 (MOD)
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.cn: KI5: M998 悍马 (MOD)

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.ch: KI5: '82 吉普 J10 (MOD)
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.cn: KI5: '82 吉普 J10 (MOD)

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.en: Which vehicle to spawn near the bunker. KI5/mod entries fall back to the SUV if that mod is not enabled. Or use the custom script field for any other vehicle.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.ch: 要在地堡附近生成哪種車輛. 若未啟用對應 MOD, KI5/MOD 選項會改用 SUV. 也可使用自訂腳本欄位指定其他任何車輛.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.cn: 要在地堡附近生成哪种车辆. 如果未启用对应 MOD, KI5/MOD 选项会改用 SUV. 也可以使用自定义脚本字段指定其他任何车辆.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.en: Spawn one vehicle on the dirt trail near the bunker hatch when a player first starts at Private Bunker. Once per world.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.ch: 玩家首次在私人地堡開局時, 在地堡艙口附近的泥土路上生成一輛車. 每個世界僅一次.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedSpawnBunkerVehicle.cn: 玩家首次在私人地堡开局时, 在地堡舱口附近的土路上生成一辆车. 每个世界仅一次.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWaterDebug_tooltip.en: Verbose water pump and fixture sync logs.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWaterDebug_tooltip.ch: 詳細的抽水機與用水設施同步日誌.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWaterDebug_tooltip.cn: 详细的水泵和用水设施同步日志.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWaterPumpTankSize_.en: Local water tank capacity for bunker pumps after city water shuts off. Applies when pumps are loaded or refilled.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWaterPumpTankSize_.ch: 市政供水停止後, 地堡抽水機的本地水箱容量. 於抽水機載入或補水時套用.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWaterPumpTankSize_.cn: 市政停水后, 地堡水泵的本地水箱容量. 在水泵加载或补水时生效.

Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWhodLootRollMultip.en: Loot roll multiplier for the general gear room when reduced loot is enabled. 1.0 = original stocking, 0.35 = about 65%% less.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWhodLootRollMultip.ch: 啟用減少戰利品時, 一般裝備室的戰利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 減少約 65%%.
Sandbox_BunkerExtendedWhodLootRollMultip.cn: 启用减少战利品时, 一般装备室的战利品判定倍率. 1.0 = 原始存量, 0.35 = 减少约 65%%.

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_InfiniteDurabil.en: Claimed weapons never degrade. When off, signature weapons wear and are repaired like any other weapon, but keep their name, kill tracking, and damage bonus.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_InfiniteDurabil.ch: 認領的武器永不損耗. 關閉時, 標誌性武器會像其他武器一樣磨損與修理, 但保留名稱, 擊殺紀錄與傷害加成.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_InfiniteDurabil.cn: 认领的武器永不损耗. 关闭时, 标志性武器会像其他武器一样磨损和修理, 但保留名称, 击杀记录和伤害加成.

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_LegacyRewards_t.en: Restores the original progression: +5%% damage per level to +50%% at level 10, with infinite durability from the moment you claim a weapon. When off, weapons use the tiered system - damage in five +10%% steps on levels 1/3/5/7/9, and an unlock on each even level (2: never degrades, 4: attack speed, 6: critical chance, 8: range, 10: legendary). Kill thresholds and the panic/stress calming are the same either way.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_LegacyRewards_t.ch: 恢復原始成長方式: 每級傷害 +5%%, 10 級時達到 +50%%, 且從認領武器的那一刻起即擁有無限耐久. 關閉時, 武器改用階段式系統 - 傷害在 1/3/5/7/9 級分五次各 +10%%, 每個偶數級解鎖一項能力 (2: 永不損耗, 4: 攻擊速度, 6: 暴擊機率, 8: 攻擊距離, 10: 傳奇). 擊殺門檻與恐慌/壓力舒緩效果在兩種模式下皆相同.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_LegacyRewards_t.cn: 恢复原始成长方式: 每级伤害 +5%%, 10 级时达到 +50%%, 且从认领武器的那一刻起即拥有无限耐久. 关闭时, 武器改用阶段式系统 - 伤害在 1/3/5/7/9 级分五次各 +10%%, 每个偶数级解锁一项能力 (2: 永不损耗, 4: 攻击速度, 6: 暴击几率, 8: 攻击距离, 10: 传奇). 击杀阈值与恐慌/压力缓解效果在两种模式下均相同.

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkAttackSpeed.ch: 特性: 攻擊 / 裝填速度
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkAttackSpeed.cn: 特性: 攻击 / 装填速度

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkAttackSpeed.en: Percent faster at level 4: swing time for melee weapons, reload/aiming/recoil delay for firearms. Ignored by the legacy reward system.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkAttackSpeed.ch: 4 級時加快的百分比: 近戰武器為揮擊時間, 槍械為裝填/瞄準/後座力延遲. 舊版獎勵系統會忽略此項.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkAttackSpeed.cn: 4 级时加快的百分比: 近战武器为挥击时间, 枪械为装填/瞄准/后坐力延迟. 旧版奖励系统会忽略此项.

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkCritChance.ch: 特性: 暴擊機率加成
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkCritChance.cn: 特性: 暴击几率加成

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkCritChance_.en: Percentage points added to a weapon's critical chance at level 6. Ignored by the legacy reward system.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkCritChance_.ch: 6 級時為武器暴擊機率增加的百分點. 舊版獎勵系統會忽略此項.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkCritChance_.cn: 6 级时为武器暴击几率增加的百分点. 旧版奖励系统会忽略此项.

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkRangeBonus.ch: 特性: 攻擊距離加成
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkRangeBonus.cn: 特性: 攻击距离加成

Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkRangeBonus_.en: Percent increase to a weapon's maximum reach at level 8. Minimum range is left alone, so close-in fighting is unaffected. Ignored by the legacy reward system.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkRangeBonus_.ch: 8 級時武器最大攻擊距離增加的百分比. 最小距離維持不變, 因此近身戰鬥不受影響. 舊版獎勵系統會忽略此項.
Sandbox_SignatureWeapons_PerkRangeBonus_.cn: 8 级时武器最大攻击距离增加的百分比. 最小距离保持不变, 因此近身战斗不受影响. 旧版奖励系统会忽略此项.

Sandbox_SVUC_timeMods_tooltip.en: How long it takes to install and uninstall modifications.
Sandbox_SVUC_timeMods_tooltip.ch: 安裝與拆除改裝所需的時間.
Sandbox_SVUC_timeMods_tooltip.cn: 安装与拆除改装所需的时间.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.en: Minimum Lockpicking level required to cut a padlock off a door with bolt cutters. Default: 6.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.ch: 使用斷線鉗剪斷門上掛鎖所需的最低開鎖等級. 預設: 6.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.cn: 使用断线钳剪断门上挂锁所需的最低开锁等级. 默认: 6.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.en: Minimum Nimble level required to cut a padlock off a door with bolt cutters. Default: 5.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.ch: 使用斷線鉗剪斷門上掛鎖所需的最低靈活等級. 預設: 5.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.cn: 使用断线钳剪断门上挂锁所需的最低灵活等级. 默认: 5.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.en: Minimum Strength level required to cut a padlock off a door with bolt cutters. Default: 7.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.ch: 使用斷線鉗剪斷門上掛鎖所需的最低力量等級. 預設: 7.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_BoltCutterMin.cn: 使用断线钳剪断门上挂锁所需的最低力量等级. 默认: 7.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_CrowbarArcMin.ch: 撬棍: 使用圓弧小遊戲 (測試)
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_CrowbarArcMin.cn: 撬棍: 使用圆弧小游戏 (测试)

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_CrowbarArcMin.en: When enabled, the crowbar building-door action uses the circular arc minigame instead of the normal slider. For testing the bolt-cutter minigame feel without needing a padlocked door.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_CrowbarArcMin.ch: 啟用後, 用撬棍撬建築物門的動作會改用圓弧小遊戲, 而非一般的滑桿. 用於在沒有上鎖頭的門時測試斷線鉗小遊戲的手感.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_CrowbarArcMin.cn: 启用后, 用撬棍撬建筑门的动作将改用圆弧小游戏, 而不是普通的滑块. 用于在没有上挂锁的门时测试断线钳小游戏的手感.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableBoltCu.en: When enabled, bolt cutters cannot be used to cut padlocks off doors.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableBoltCu.ch: 啟用後, 無法使用斷線鉗剪斷門上的掛鎖.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableBoltCu.cn: 启用后, 无法使用断线钳剪断门上的挂锁.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableCrowba.en: When enabled, removes the crowbar prying option from permanently locked security doors (police cell doors and secure glass doors). Bobby pin lockpicking remains available.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableCrowba.ch: 啟用後, 移除對永久上鎖安全門 (警局牢房門與安全玻璃門) 的撬棍撬開選項. 仍可使用髮夾開鎖.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableCrowba.cn: 启用后, 移除对永久上锁安全门 (警局牢房门与安全玻璃门) 的撬棍撬开选项. 仍可使用发夹开锁.

Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_MergeIntoObje.en: When enabled, this mod's lockpicking options are moved into the game's Door/Window submenu instead of a separate top-level entry.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_MergeIntoObje.ch: 啟用後, 本模組的開鎖選項會移到遊戲的門/窗子選單中, 而不是獨立的頂層項目.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_MergeIntoObje.cn: 启用后, 本模组的开锁选项会移到游戏的门/窗子菜单中, 而不是独立的顶层项目.

Sandbox_SoapZ_OdorAttractionRange_toolti.en: Maximum distance in tiles at which body odor can attract zombies. With wind, the odor plume travels in that direction without exceeding this range.
Sandbox_SoapZ_OdorAttractionRange_toolti.ch: 體味能吸引殭屍的最遠距離 (格). 有風時, 氣味會順著風向飄散, 但不會超過此範圍.
Sandbox_SoapZ_OdorAttractionRange_toolti.cn: 体味能吸引僵尸的最远距离 (格). 有风时, 气味会顺着风向飘散, 但不会超过此范围.

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_RagdollChance_to.en:
Percentage chance any fall becomes a full dynamic physics ragdoll instead of an animated fall. Requires 'Use Physics Hit Reactions' in game options. Works in singleplayer and multiplayer (with Ragdolls in MP).
Default: 100%% (0 = Animated Only).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_RagdollChance_to.ch:
任何倒地變成完整動態物理布娃娃效果 (而非動畫倒地) 的機率. 需要在遊戲選項中開啟「啟用物理受擊反應」. 單人與多人模式皆可運作 (多人需搭配 Ragdolls in MP 模組).
預設: 100%% (0 = 僅動畫).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_RagdollChance_to.cn:
任何倒地变成完整动态物理布娃娃效果 (而非动画倒地) 的概率. 需要在游戏选项中开启“启用物理受击反应”. 单人和多人模式均可生效 (多人需配合 Ragdolls in MP 模组).
默认: 100%% (0 = 仅动画).

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda.ch: 每次更新載入的倖存者數
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda.cn: 每次更新加载的幸存者数

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda.en: Maximum new survivor bodies loaded during one population update. Higher values help nearby groups appear together but can cause a short performance spike.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda.ch: 每次人口更新時最多載入的新倖存者實體數. 數值越高, 附近的群體越容易一起出現, 但可能造成短暫的效能尖峰.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda.cn: 每次人口更新时最多加载的新幸存者实体数. 数值越高, 附近的群体越容易一起出现, 但可能造成短暂的性能峰值.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowDestructiveDe.en: Allows developer tests that can smash windows or alter the test area. Keep disabled on saves you care about.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowDestructiveDe.ch: 允許可能打破窗戶或改變測試區域的開發者測試. 在你重視的存檔上請保持停用.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowDestructiveDe.cn: 允许可能打破窗户或改变测试区域的开发者测试. 在你在意的存档上请保持禁用.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowFactionRaids_.en: Allows hostile NPC factions to dispatch real members and equipment against an existing base. Requires Knox Events, NPC factions and hostile encounters. Off by default; native raid/return/save acceptance remains pending. Disabling stops new raids without cancelling active parties.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowFactionRaids_.ch: 允許敵對 NPC 陣營派出真實成員與裝備攻擊現有基地. 需要啟用諾克斯事件、NPC 陣營與敵對遭遇. 預設關閉; 原生的突襲、返回與存檔功能仍待驗收. 停用後會停止新的突襲, 但不會取消進行中的隊伍.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowFactionRaids_.cn: 允许敌对 NPC 派系派出真实成员与装备攻击现有基地. 需要启用诺克斯事件、NPC 派系与敌对遭遇. 默认关闭; 原生的突袭、返回与存档功能仍待验收. 禁用后会停止新的突袭, 但不会取消进行中的队伍.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowHostileEncoun.en: Allows independent survivors to threaten or rob one another when they meet.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowHostileEncoun.ch: 允許獨立倖存者相遇時互相威脅或搶劫.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowHostileEncoun.cn: 允许独立幸存者相遇时互相威胁或抢劫.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowNPCFactions_t.en: Allows survivor groups to form factions and establish bases. Existing factions are not removed when disabled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowNPCFactions_t.ch: 允許倖存者群體組成陣營並建立基地. 停用時不會移除既有陣營.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowNPCFactions_t.cn: 允许幸存者群体组成派系并建立基地. 禁用时不会移除现有派系.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorDoorW.en: Allow Survivors to Open Doors and Windows

Default permission for opening closed doors and windows while pathing. Individual companion orders override this default. Survivors without permission can still pass through already open or smashed openings and report the restriction when blocked.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorDoorW.ch: 倖存者尋路時開啟關著的門窗的預設權限. 個別同伴的指令會覆蓋此預設值. 沒有權限的倖存者仍可穿過已開啟或已破壞的開口, 受阻時會回報此限制.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorDoorW.cn: 幸存者寻路时打开关着的门窗的默认权限. 个别同伴的指令会覆盖此默认值. 没有权限的幸存者仍可穿过已打开或已破坏的开口, 受阻时会报告该限制.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye.ch: 允許倖存者與玩家戰鬥
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye.cn: 允许幸存者与玩家战斗

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye.en: Allows hostile survivors and players to fight one another. Relationship and hostility rules still apply.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye.ch: 允許敵對倖存者與玩家互相戰鬥. 關係與敵意規則仍然適用.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye.cn: 允许敌对幸存者与玩家互相战斗. 关系与敌意规则仍然适用.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea.ch: 倖存者為所屬玩家包紮
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea.cn: 幸存者为所属玩家包扎

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea.en: Allows nearby owned companions and base residents with a bandage to treat the bleeding player when they are idle and safe. Active jobs and combat remain higher priority.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea.ch: 允許附近持有繃帶的所屬同伴與基地居民, 在閒置且安全時治療正在流血的玩家. 進行中的工作與戰鬥仍優先.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea.cn: 允许附近持有绷带的所属同伴与基地居民, 在空闲且安全时治疗正在流血的玩家. 进行中的工作与战斗仍优先.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo.ch: 自動劃設 NPC 基地工作區
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo.cn: 自动划设 NPC 基地工作区

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo.en: Lets autonomous NPC factions create practical guard, patrol, farming, wood, corpse, and storage areas at their own bases. Player base areas remain manually controlled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo.ch: 讓自主 NPC 陣營在自己的基地建立實用的守衛、巡邏、耕作、木材、屍體與儲物區. 玩家基地的區域仍由手動控制.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo.cn: 让自主 NPC 派系在自己的基地建立实用的守卫、巡逻、耕作、木材、尸体与储物区. 玩家基地的区域仍由手动控制.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseCooking_toolti.en: Residents cook suitable ingredients from assigned supplies in an empty powered microwave, then store meals. Uses native cooking and automatic shutoff. Optional Cooking areas limit appliance selection and can be outside the base. Ovens, campfires and recipe preparation are not supported yet. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseCooking_toolti.ch: 居民會用指派物資中合適的食材, 以空的、有電的微波爐烹飪, 再將餐點收納起來. 使用原生烹飪與自動關機. 可選的烹飪區域會限制可用的電器, 且可以位於基地外. 尚不支援烤箱、營火與配方備料. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseCooking_toolti.cn: 居民会用指派物资中合适的食材, 以空的、通电的微波炉烹饪, 再将餐点收纳起来. 使用原生烹饪与自动关机. 可选的烹饪区域会限制可用的电器, 且可以位于基地外. 尚不支持烤箱、营火与配方备料. 默认开启.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseReading_toolti.en: Idle residents can read suitable carried books or borrow from assigned supplies. Uses normal reading, lighting, literacy and skill-level rules. Borrowed books are returned; needs, danger and new orders interrupt reading. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseReading_toolti.ch: 閒置的居民可以閱讀身上合適的書, 或從指派物資中借閱. 使用一般的閱讀、照明、識字與技能等級規則. 借來的書會歸還; 需求、危險與新命令會中斷閱讀. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseReading_toolti.cn: 空闲的居民可以阅读身上合适的书, 或从指派物资中借阅. 使用一般的阅读、照明、识字与技能等级规则. 借来的书会归还; 需求、危险与新命令会中断阅读. 默认开启.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CautiousTravel_too.en: Survivors walk on ordinary supply, work and travel routes, crouching around visible nearby zombies while undetected. Escape and catching up with a running leader can still use faster movement. Turning this off restores distance-based jogging. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CautiousTravel_too.ch: 倖存者在一般的補給、工作與移動路線上步行, 未被發現時會在附近可見的殭屍周圍蹲伏前進. 逃跑以及追上奔跑中的領隊時仍可使用較快的移動方式. 關閉此選項會恢復依距離慢跑. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CautiousTravel_too.cn: 幸存者在一般的补给、工作与移动路线上步行, 未被发现时会在附近可见的僵尸周围蹲伏前进. 逃跑以及追上奔跑中的领队时仍可使用较快的移动方式. 关闭此选项会恢复按距离慢跑. 默认开启.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CompanionLimit_too.en: Maximum number of active companions each local player can recruit.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CompanionLimit_too.ch: 每位本機玩家可招募的現役同伴數量上限.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CompanionLimit_too.cn: 每位本地玩家可招募的现役同伴数量上限.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Companions.ch: 諾克斯倖存者 - 同伴與命令
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Companions.cn: 诺克斯幸存者-同伴与命令

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA.ch: 玩家死亡後倖存者延續
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA.cn: 玩家死亡后幸存者延续

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA.en: When enabled, your base and living companions continue under your next character and companions become base residents. The existing spouse stays with that household; the successor does not get a second spouse. When disabled, old player ownership remains unchanged.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA.ch: 啟用時, 你的基地與存活的同伴會延續到你的下一個角色, 同伴會成為基地居民. 原有的配偶會留在該家庭中; 繼任角色不會再獲得第二位配偶. 停用時, 基地與同伴仍歸屬原玩家.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA.cn: 启用时, 你的基地与存活的同伴会延续到你的下一个角色, 同伴会成为基地居民. 原有的配偶会留在该家庭中; 继任角色不会再获得第二位配偶. 禁用时, 基地与同伴仍归属原玩家.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Developer.ch: 諾克斯倖存者 - 開發者工具
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Developer.cn: 诺克斯幸存者-开发者工具

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperScenario_.en: Optionally creates a repeatable test population when the save loads. Manual spawn commands remain available from the world context menu.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperScenario_.ch: 可選擇在載入存檔時建立可重複的測試人口. 仍可從世界右鍵選單使用手動生成指令.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperScenario_.cn: 可选择在加载存档时创建可重复的测试人口. 仍可从世界右键菜单使用手动生成指令.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperSpawnDist.en: Minimum distance in tiles used when placing test survivors around the player.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperSpawnDist.ch: 在玩家周圍放置測試用倖存者時使用的最小距離 (單位: 格).
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperSpawnDist.cn: 在玩家周围放置测试用幸存者时使用的最小距离 (单位: 格).

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DisableSurvivorCap.en: Ignores the active-survivor and companion limits. World Population still sets the starting population, but one new survivor may arrive each refill interval even above that number. Arrivals still require unused world locations and safe spawning; bodies load gradually. Faction ownership still applies. Large populations can reduce performance. Off by default.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DisableSurvivorCap.ch: 忽略現役倖存者與同伴上限. 「世界人口」仍決定初始人口, 但即使超過該數字, 每個補充間隔仍可能有一名新倖存者到來. 到來仍需要未使用的世界位置與安全生成; 實體會逐步載入. 陣營歸屬仍然適用. 人口過多可能降低效能. 預設關閉.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DisableSurvivorCap.cn: 忽略现役幸存者与同伴上限. “世界人口”仍决定初始人口, 但即使超过该数字, 每个补充间隔仍可能有一名新幸存者到来. 到来仍需要未使用的世界位置与安全生成; 实体会逐步加载. 派系归属仍然适用. 人口过多可能降低性能. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDeveloperToo.en: Adds testing commands to the Knox Survivors world context menu. Disabled by default and not intended for normal play.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDeveloperToo.ch: 在諾克斯倖存者的世界右鍵選單中加入測試指令. 預設停用, 不適用於一般遊玩.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDeveloperToo.cn: 在诺克斯幸存者的世界右键菜单中加入测试指令. 默认禁用, 不适用于正常游玩.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental.ch: 允許 NPC 駕駛 (實驗性)
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental.cn: 允许 NPC 驾驶 (实验性)

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental.en: Enables experimental Drive Ahead and right-click map driving orders while you are a passenger. Requires a running vehicle and a free driver seat or your companion already driving. Routes use nearby loaded outdoor ground (up to 160 tiles), with speed limits and obstacle braking. Towing is not supported. Off by default; native Build 42 driving acceptance is still pending.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental.ch: 當你是乘客時, 啟用實驗性的「往前開」與右鍵地圖駕駛命令. 需要一輛發動中的車輛, 以及空的駕駛座或你的同伴已在駕駛. 路線使用附近已載入的戶外地面 (最多 160 格), 並有速限與障礙物煞車. 不支援拖車. 預設關閉; 原生 Build 42 駕駛功能仍待驗收.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental.cn: 当你是乘客时, 启用实验性的“向前开”与右键地图驾驶命令. 需要一辆发动中的车辆, 以及空的驾驶座或你的同伴已在驾驶. 路线使用附近已加载的户外地面 (最多 160 格), 并有限速与障碍物刹车. 不支持拖车. 默认关闭; 原生 Build 42 驾驶功能仍待验收.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents.ch: 啟用諾克斯事件 (實驗性)
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents.cn: 启用诺克斯事件 (实验性)

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents_t.en: Allows scripted faction and named-world events to dispatch. Off by default; native objectives, return and save acceptance remain pending. Automatic arrivals and raids have separate controls. Existing event records are preserved.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents_t.ch: 允許觸發劇本式的陣營與具名世界事件. 預設關閉; 原生的目標、返回與存檔功能仍待驗收. 自動到來與突襲另有獨立設定. 既有事件紀錄會保留.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents_t.cn: 允许触发脚本化的派系与具名世界事件. 默认关闭; 原生的目标、返回与存档功能仍待验收. 自动到来与突袭另有独立设置. 现有事件记录会保留.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Enabled_tooltip.en: Enables survivor gameplay systems. Existing survivor save data is preserved when disabled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 啟用倖存者遊戲系統. 停用時會保留既有的倖存者存檔資料.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 启用幸存者游戏系统. 禁用时会保留现有的幸存者存档数据.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidInterva.en: Minimum number of in-game days between automatic raid scheduling checks. Only one automatic raid can be active at a time.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidInterva.ch: 自動突襲排程檢查之間最少相隔的遊戲天數. 同一時間只能有一場自動突襲進行.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidInterva.cn: 自动突袭调度检查之间最少相隔的游戏天数. 同一时间只能有一场自动突袭进行.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidMinimum.en: Earliest world day when an established hostile faction can automatically plan a raid.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidMinimum.ch: 已成立的敵對陣營最早可自動計畫突襲的世界天數.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidMinimum.cn: 已建立的敌对派系最早可自动计划突袭的世界天数.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerFormation_.en: Preferred positions behind a leader for companions and travelling survivor groups. Paired places two followers in each row; Single File forms a narrower, longer column. Obstacles and native pathfinding may break the formation. This does not control vehicles or combat positioning.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerFormation_.ch: 同伴與旅行中的倖存者群體在領隊身後的偏好位置. 雙列每排放兩名跟隨者; 單列縱隊形成較窄、較長的縱列. 障礙物與原生尋路可能打亂隊形. 這不控制車輛或戰鬥站位.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerFormation_.cn: 同伴与旅行中的幸存者群体在领队身后的偏好位置. 双列每排放两名跟随者; 单列纵队形成较窄、较长的纵列. 障碍物与原生寻路可能打乱队形. 这不控制车辆或战斗站位.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerSpacing_to.en: Grid spacing between preferred follower positions, from 1 to 3 tiles per axis. Larger values spread the group out and place rear members farther behind. Blocked positions still use ordinary nearby-tile recovery. Default 1 preserves the existing close formation.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerSpacing_to.ch: 偏好跟隨位置之間的網格間距, 每軸 1 到 3 格. 數值越大, 群體越分散, 後排成員離得越遠. 被阻擋的位置仍會改用附近一般的格子. 預設 1 維持現有的緊密隊形.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerSpacing_to.cn: 偏好跟随位置之间的网格间距, 每轴 1 到 3 格. 数值越大, 群体越分散, 后排成员离得越远. 被阻挡的位置仍会改用附近一般的格子. 默认 1 保持现有的紧密队形.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_General.ch: 諾克斯倖存者 - 一般

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR.en: Ignore Job Tool and Resource Requirements
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR.ch: 忽略工作的工具與資源需求
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR.cn: 忽略工作的工具与资源需求

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR.en: Provides real tools and materials to survivors for supported base jobs, including barricading, without stocking storage first. Native actions still animate and consume the items; skills, valid targets and world rules still apply. Off by default. Provided items remain if this option is disabled.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR.ch: 為支援的基地工作 (包括加固門窗) 直接提供真實工具與材料給倖存者, 不必先存入倉庫. 原生動作仍會播放動畫並消耗物品; 技能、有效目標與世界規則仍然適用. 預設關閉. 停用此選項後已提供的物品會保留.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR.cn: 为支持的基地工作 (包括加固门窗) 直接提供真实工具与材料给幸存者, 不必先存入仓库. 原生动作仍会播放动画并消耗物品; 技能、有效目标与世界规则仍然适用. 默认关闭. 禁用此选项后已提供的物品会保留.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupChance.en: Chance that nearby starting survivors form a small travelling group when the world is first populated. Groups are still limited by nearby origins.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupChance.ch: 世界初次產生人口時, 附近的初始倖存者組成小型旅行群體的機率. 群體仍受附近出生點限制.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupChance.cn: 世界初次生成人口时, 附近的初始幸存者组成小型旅行群体的概率. 群体仍受附近出生点限制.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupCount_.en: Maximum number of compact survivor groups formed when the world is first populated. Zero disables opening groups and founding factions. Still requires nearby origins and group chance. Does not change total population or dissolve existing groups.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupCount_.ch: 世界初次產生人口時, 可組成的緊密倖存者群體數量上限. 設為 0 會停用開局群體與創始陣營. 仍需要附近的出生點與群體機率. 不會改變總人口, 也不會解散既有群體.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupCount_.cn: 世界初次生成人口时, 可组成的紧密幸存者群体数量上限. 设为 0 会禁用开局群体与创始派系. 仍需要附近的出生点与群体概率. 不会改变总人口, 也不会解散现有群体.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupMaxSiz.en: Maximum size of a group formed from nearby starting survivors. This does not change the total world population.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupMaxSiz.ch: 由附近初始倖存者組成的群體人數上限. 這不會改變世界總人口.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupMaxSiz.cn: 由附近初始幸存者组成的群体人数上限. 这不会改变世界总人口.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxActiveSurvivors.en: Maximum nearby survivor bodies, default 32, configurable up to 128. Off-screen people retain their identity, needs and travel ledger. Higher limits cost more performance; loading stays spread across updates. Existing saved limits are preserved.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxActiveSurvivors.ch: 附近倖存者實體的數量上限, 預設 32, 最多可設為 128. 畫面外的人員會保留其身分、需求與旅程紀錄. 上限越高, 效能消耗越大; 載入仍會分散到多次更新中進行. 既有存檔中的上限會保留.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxActiveSurvivors.cn: 附近幸存者实体的数量上限, 默认 32, 最多可设为 128. 画面外的人员会保留其身份、需求与旅程记录. 上限越高, 性能消耗越大; 加载仍会分散到多次更新中进行. 现有存档中的上限会保留.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MinimumSpawnDistan.en: Minimum distance in tiles from every local player when a survivor appears for the first time. Survivors must also be out of sight, preventing visible pop-in.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MinimumSpawnDistan.ch: 倖存者首次出現時與每位本機玩家的最小距離 (單位: 格). 倖存者也必須在視線外, 以免憑空出現被看見.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MinimumSpawnDistan.cn: 幸存者首次出现时与每位本地玩家的最小距离 (单位: 格). 幸存者也必须在视线外, 以免凭空出现被看见.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMaxMembe.en: Maximum number of survivors an NPC faction can normally recruit. The effective limit is never below Survivors Needed to Form a Faction. Existing members are never removed when this is lowered.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMaxMembe.ch: NPC 陣營通常可招募的倖存者數量上限. 實際上限絕不會低於「組成陣營所需倖存者數」. 調低此值時絕不會移除既有成員.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMaxMembe.cn: NPC 派系通常可招募的幸存者数量上限. 实际上限绝不会低于“组成派系所需幸存者数”. 调低此值时绝不会移除现有成员.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM.en: Survivors Needed to Form a Faction
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM.ch: 組成陣營所需倖存者數
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM.cn: 组成派系所需幸存者数

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM.en: Number of survivors a travelling group needs before it can become an NPC faction. Members must still build familiarity through shared survival. Default: 4.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM.ch: 旅行群體成為 NPC 陣營前所需的倖存者數量. 成員仍需透過共同求生培養熟悉度. 預設: 4.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM.cn: 旅行群体成为 NPC 派系前所需的幸存者数量. 成员仍需通过共同求生培养熟悉度. 默认: 4.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NpcDrivingSpeed_to.en: Maximum speed for NPC drivers. They slow further for turns and stopping distance. Requires NPC Driving.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NpcDrivingSpeed_to.ch: NPC 駕駛的最高速度. 轉彎與煞停距離會讓他們進一步減速. 需要啟用 NPC 駕駛.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NpcDrivingSpeed_to.cn: NPC 驾驶的最高速度. 转弯与刹停距离会让他们进一步减速. 需要启用 NPC 驾驶.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_OrderGestures_tool.en: Player orders use native Follow, Stop and Move Out gestures. Nearby free survivors can nod in acknowledgement. Gestures are rate limited and suppressed during combat, traversal and queued actions.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_OrderGestures_tool.ch: 玩家命令會使用原生的「跟隨」、「停下」與「出發」手勢. 附近空閒的倖存者會點頭示意. 手勢有頻率限制, 且在戰鬥、翻越與排隊動作期間不會使用.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_OrderGestures_tool.cn: 玩家命令会使用原生的“跟随”、“停下”与“出发”手势. 附近空闲的幸存者会点头示意. 手势有频率限制, 且在战斗、翻越与排队动作期间不会使用.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PopulationRefillDa.en: In-game days between replacement survivors, or new arrivals when survivor caps are disabled. Set to 0 for a finite starting population with no routine replacements or arrivals. Existing people remain, and separate Knox Events have their own controls. Re-enabling refill starts a full interval; missed arrivals never accumulate.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PopulationRefillDa.ch: 補充倖存者 (或停用倖存者上限時的新到來者) 之間相隔的遊戲天數. 設為 0 表示初始人口固定, 不會例行補充或有人到來. 既有人員會保留, 獨立的諾克斯事件另有其設定. 重新啟用補充時會從完整間隔開始計算; 錯過的到來不會累積.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PopulationRefillDa.cn: 补充幸存者 (或禁用幸存者上限时的新到来者) 之间相隔的游戏天数. 设为 0 表示初始人口固定, 不会例行补充或有人到来. 现有人员会保留, 独立的诺克斯事件另有其设置. 重新启用补充时会从完整间隔开始计算; 错过的到来不会累积.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowActivityFeed_t.en: Shows the small Knox Survivors message feed. Survivor speech bubbles are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowActivityFeed_t.ch: 顯示諾克斯倖存者的小型訊息動態. 倖存者的對話泡泡不受影響.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowActivityFeed_t.cn: 显示诺克斯幸存者的小型信息动态. 幸存者的对话气泡不受影响.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowCompanionHUD_t.en: Shows the right-side status panel while you have companions.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowCompanionHUD_t.ch: 有同伴時在右側顯示狀態面板.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowCompanionHUD_t.cn: 有同伴时在右侧显示状态面板.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDeveloperDiagn.en: Writes detailed test state to the game console and Knox logs. Disabled by default because this is only useful during focused testing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDeveloperDiagn.ch: 將詳細的測試狀態寫入遊戲主控台與 Knox 日誌. 預設停用, 因為只在專注測試時才有用.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDeveloperDiagn.cn: 将详细的测试状态写入游戏控制台与 Knox 日志. 默认禁用, 因为只在专门测试时才有用.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC.en: Show Knox Orders in Right-Click Menus
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC.ch: 在右鍵選單中顯示諾克斯命令
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC.cn: 在右键菜单中显示诺克斯命令

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC.en: When enabled, adds Knox survivor, party, resident, and location order menus to right-click. When disabled, those right-click order menus are hidden; use the emote radial if it is enabled. Default off; the radial is enabled by default.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC.ch: 啟用時, 會在右鍵選單中加入諾克斯的倖存者、小隊、居民與地點命令選單. 停用時會隱藏這些右鍵命令選單; 若已啟用表情輪盤, 請改用輪盤. 預設關閉; 輪盤預設為開啟.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC.cn: 启用时, 会在右键菜单中加入诺克斯的幸存者、小队、居民与地点命令菜单. 禁用时会隐藏这些右键命令菜单; 若已启用表情轮盘, 请改用轮盘. 默认关闭; 轮盘默认开启.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorNamepl.en: Shows player-style names above survivors you can currently see.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorNamepl.ch: 在你目前看得到的倖存者頭上顯示與玩家相同樣式的名稱.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorNamepl.cn: 在你当前看得到的幸存者头上显示与玩家相同样式的名称.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorSpeech.en: Shows survivor speech bubbles and spoken lines in the activity feed.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorSpeech.ch: 顯示倖存者的對話泡泡, 並在動態訊息中顯示說出的台詞.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorSpeech.cn: 显示幸存者的对话气泡, 并在动态信息中显示说出的台词.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithSpouse_to.en: A new character starts with one uniquely generated spouse companion nearby. Their identity and personality remain stable in that save. If your next character inherits your household, the existing spouse stays with it and no second spouse is created. Enable before starting a new character.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithSpouse_to.ch: 新角色開局時附近會有一名獨特生成的配偶同伴. 對方的身分與個性在該存檔中保持不變. 若你的下一個角色繼承了你的家庭, 原有的配偶會留在其中, 不會再產生第二位配偶. 請在開始新角色前啟用.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithSpouse_to.cn: 新角色开局时附近会有一名独特生成的配偶同伴. 对方的身份与性格在该存档中保持不变. 若你的下一个角色继承了你的家庭, 原有的配偶会留在其中, 不会再生成第二位配偶. 请在开始新角色前启用.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorAimingAssi.en: Controls how readily survivors commit to a firearm and how long they settle their aim. Native Aiming skill and experience still determine shot accuracy, recoil and firearm effectiveness. Native Skills preserves the normal skill gap; Basic and Strong Assistance provide a more forgiving experience without granting skill XP.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorAimingAssi.ch: 控制倖存者多快決定使用槍械, 以及穩定瞄準要花多久. 射擊準度、後座力與槍械效能仍由原生的瞄準技能與經驗決定. 「原生技能」保留一般的技能差距; 「基本輔助」與「強力輔助」提供較寬容的體驗, 但不給予技能經驗.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorAimingAssi.cn: 控制幸存者多快决定使用枪械, 以及稳定瞄准要花多久. 射击准度、后坐力与枪械效能仍由原生的瞄准技能与经验决定. “原生技能”保留一般的技能差距; “基本辅助”与“强力辅助”提供较宽容的体验, 但不给予技能经验.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorEncounterD.en: How close a persistent survivor must be before their body can be loaded into the world. Larger values use more active-survivor slots; spawning still requires a hidden safe square. The effective distance is at least 10 tiles beyond Minimum Survivor Spawn Distance so those settings cannot prevent all first appearances.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorEncounterD.ch: 持續存在的倖存者必須距離多近, 其實體才會載入世界. 數值越大會占用越多現役倖存者名額; 生成仍需要隱蔽的安全格子. 實際距離至少比「倖存者最小生成距離」多 10 格, 避免這些設定讓倖存者完全無法首次出現.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorEncounterD.cn: 持续存在的幸存者必须距离多近, 其实体才会加载到世界中. 数值越大会占用越多现役幸存者名额; 生成仍需要隐蔽的安全格子. 实际距离至少比“幸存者最小生成距离”多 10 格, 避免这些设置让幸存者完全无法首次出现.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorNameplateD.en: Maximum distance in tiles for visible survivor names. Line of sight is still required.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorNameplateD.ch: 顯示倖存者名稱的最大距離 (單位: 格). 仍需要在視線範圍內.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorNameplateD.cn: 显示幸存者名称的最大距离 (单位: 格). 仍需要在视线范围内.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ToolCupboardCapaci.en: Compatibility setting for older saves that still contain a legacy Tool Cupboard policy. Current typed storage assignments use Build 42 native container capacity; this setting does not apply to them. Values are capped to each container's native limit, and changing capacity never deletes contents.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ToolCupboardCapaci.ch: 供仍保有舊版工具櫃規則的舊存檔使用的相容性設定. 目前的分類儲物指派使用 Build 42 原生容器容量; 此設定對其不適用. 數值會限制在各容器的原生上限內, 且變更容量絕不會刪除內容物.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ToolCupboardCapaci.cn: 供仍保留旧版工具柜规则的旧存档使用的兼容性设置. 当前的分类储物指派使用 Build 42 原生容器容量; 此设置对其不适用. 数值会限制在各容器的原生上限内, 且更改容量绝不会删除内容物.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_UseReputation_tool.en: Survivors judge you by trust earned through talk, gifts, help and fights. Low reputation blocks recruiting. Turn off to recruit on contact rules alone. Default on.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_UseReputation_tool.ch: 倖存者會依你透過交談、送禮、幫忙與戰鬥累積的信任來評價你. 聲望低時無法招募. 關閉後僅依接觸規則招募. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_UseReputation_tool.cn: 幸存者会根据你通过交谈、送礼、帮忙和战斗积累的信任来评价你. 声望低时无法招募. 关闭后仅按接触规则招募. 默认开启.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_World.ch: 諾克斯倖存者 - 世界與陣營
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_World.cn: 诺克斯幸存者-世界与派系

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_WorldPopulation_to.en: Persistent people distributed across the county, default 2048. Mostly individuals, with small travelling groups and occasional factions. The actual count is limited by valid unused map origins. Off-screen people keep their identity and stored travel progress; only nearby bodies are loaded. Existing saved values are preserved.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_WorldPopulation_to.ch: 分布於整個郡內的常駐人口, 預設 2048. 大多是單獨個體, 也有小型旅行群體與偶爾出現的陣營. 實際數量受限於有效且未使用的地圖出生點. 畫面外的人員會保留其身分與已儲存的移動進度; 只有附近的實體會被載入. 既有存檔中的數值會保留.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_WorldPopulation_to.cn: 分布在整个郡内的常驻人口, 默认 2048. 大多是单独个体, 也有小型旅行群体与偶尔出现的派系. 实际数量受限于有效且未使用的地图出生点. 画面外的人员会保留其身份与已保存的移动进度; 只有附近的实体会被加载. 现有存档中的数值会保留.

Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieEngagementDi.en: Maximum distance for automatically engaging an idle visible zombie. Default 4 tiles; lower values favor avoidance. Nearby attacks on themselves or allies still trigger defense within 8 tiles, and an existing fight can continue within 6. Aggressive companion orders retain their wider engagement range; base and group boundaries still apply. Hostile human encounters are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieEngagementDi.ch: 自動攻擊閒置且可見殭屍的最大距離. 預設 4 格; 數值越低越傾向迴避. 自身或同伴在附近遭受攻擊時, 仍會在 8 格內進行防禦, 已開始的戰鬥可在 6 格內持續. 積極型同伴指令保有較大的交戰範圍; 基地與群體邊界限制仍然適用. 不影響與敵對人類的遭遇.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieEngagementDi.cn: 自动攻击闲置且可见僵尸的最大距离. 默认 4 格; 数值越低越倾向回避. 自身或同伴在附近遭到攻击时, 仍会在 8 格内进行防御, 已开始的战斗可在 6 格内持续. 积极型同伴指令保留较大的交战范围; 基地与群体边界限制仍然适用. 不影响与敌对人类的遭遇.

Sandbox_PAR_AllowCalibration.en: Allow players to adjust attachment position
Sandbox_PAR_AllowCalibration.ch: 允許玩家調整附件位置
Sandbox_PAR_AllowCalibration.cn: 允许玩家调整附件位置

Sandbox_PAR_AllowCalibration_tooltip.en: When ON (default), right-clicking an attached item offers "Adjust attachment position", letting each player fine-tune where attached items sit on their bags. It is purely visual and local to that player - nothing is sent to the server, and settings persist between play sessions. Turn OFF if you want everyone to see the mod's default placement.
Sandbox_PAR_AllowCalibration_tooltip.ch: 開啟時 (預設), 右鍵點選已附掛的物品會出現「調整附件位置」, 讓每位玩家微調附掛物品在背包上的位置. 這純屬視覺效果且只在該玩家本機生效, 不會傳送任何資料到伺服器, 設定會在遊戲階段之間保留. 若希望所有人都看到模組的預設擺放位置, 請關閉此選項.
Sandbox_PAR_AllowCalibration_tooltip.cn: 开启时 (默认), 右键点击已挂载的物品会出现“调整附件位置”, 让每位玩家微调挂载物品在背包上的位置. 这纯属视觉效果且仅在该玩家本地生效, 不会向服务器发送任何数据, 设置会在游戏会话之间保留. 若希望所有人都看到模组的默认摆放位置, 请关闭此选项.

Sandbox_WoundInfo_ShowHealTime_tooltip.en: Show the estimated in-game time until each wound is fully healed. Turn OFF to hide all healing timers.
Sandbox_WoundInfo_ShowHealTime_tooltip.ch: 顯示每處傷口完全癒合前的預估遊戲內時間. 關閉可隱藏所有癒合計時.
Sandbox_WoundInfo_ShowHealTime_tooltip.cn: 显示每处伤口完全愈合前的预估游戏内时间. 关闭可隐藏所有愈合计时.

Sandbox_WoundInfo_ShowInfectionImpact_to.en: Show what a wound infection does (extra pain, and whether it can damage health if it gets bad).
Sandbox_WoundInfo_ShowInfectionImpact_to.ch: 顯示傷口感染的影響 (額外疼痛, 以及惡化時是否會損害健康).
Sandbox_WoundInfo_ShowInfectionImpact_to.cn: 显示伤口感染的影响 (额外疼痛, 以及恶化时是否会损害健康).

Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors.en: Companions close doors behind them at base
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors.ch: 同伴在基地內會隨手關門
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors.cn: 同伴在基地内会随手关门

Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors_.en: When on, a companion who opens a door inside a base area pulls it shut once she is clear of it. Only simple single-leaf doors; double and garage doors are never touched.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors_.ch: 開啟後, 同伴在基地區域內開門後, 離開門口就會把門關上. 僅限簡單的單扇門, 雙開門與車庫門永遠不會被動到.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors_.cn: 开启后, 同伴在基地区域内开门后, 离开门口就会把门关上. 仅限简单的单扇门, 双开门与车库门永远不会被动到.

Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace.ch: 除錯追蹤 (僅供回報錯誤)
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace.cn: 调试追踪 (仅用于报告错误)

Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace_tooltip.en: Writes a detailed record of what every companion decides and does to TrueCompanions_trace.txt in the Lua sub-folder of your Zomboid folder (the same place as your saves and Logs). Leave this OFF for normal play - it costs performance and the file grows steadily. Turn it ON only when you are reproducing a bug on purpose, then send the file with your report: it is the difference between a guess and an answer.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace_tooltip.ch: 將每位同伴的決策與行動詳細記錄到 Zomboid 資料夾中 Lua 子資料夾裡的 TrueCompanions_trace.txt (與你的存檔和 Logs 位於同一處). 一般遊玩時請保持關閉: 它會影響效能, 且檔案會持續變大. 只在你刻意重現錯誤時開啟, 然後將該檔案附在回報中: 有了它, 我們就能從猜測變成找到答案.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace_tooltip.cn: 将每位同伴的决策与行动详细记录到 Zomboid 文件夹中 Lua 子文件夹里的 TrueCompanions_trace.txt (与你的存档和 Logs 位于同一处). 正常游玩时请保持关闭: 它会影响性能, 且文件会持续变大. 只在你刻意复现错误时开启, 然后将该文件附在报告中: 有了它, 我们就能从猜测变成找到答案.

Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgWatchdog_tooltip.en: ON by default. When a companion holds a walk order but has not moved for about nine seconds her task queue is cleared to force a fresh path, and at about twenty seconds she is stepped directly to her destination. This is what stops a companion standing against a wall forever. Turn it OFF only while bug-hunting: if she still freezes with this off, the freeze is real and the watchdog was only reacting to it - if instead she frees herself, the watchdog was making things worse.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgWatchdog_tooltip.ch: 預設開啟. 當同伴持有移動命令卻約九秒沒有移動時, 會清空她的任務佇列以強制重新尋路; 約二十秒時則會直接將她移到目的地. 這能防止同伴永遠卡在牆邊站著. 僅在追查錯誤時才關閉: 若關閉後她仍然卡住, 代表卡住是真實存在的, 監控只是在對此做出反應; 反之若她自行脫困, 代表是監控讓情況變得更糟.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgWatchdog_tooltip.cn: 默认开启. 当同伴持有移动命令却约九秒没有移动时, 会清空她的任务队列以强制重新寻路; 约二十秒时则会直接将她移到目的地. 这能防止同伴永远卡在墙边站着. 仅在排查错误时才关闭: 若关闭后她仍然卡住, 说明卡住是真实存在的, 监控只是在对此做出反应; 反之若她自行脱困, 说明是监控让情况变得更糟.

Sandbox_BanditsNPC_InfiniteAmmo_tooltip.en: When ON, a companion carrying a firearm never runs out: their reserve is quietly topped up so they keep reloading without you handing over magazines. When OFF (default), they only fire what you actually give them.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_InfiniteAmmo_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 攜帶槍械的同伴彈藥永遠不會用完: 其備用彈藥會被悄悄補滿, 不需要你交給他們彈匣也能持續裝填. 關閉時 (預設), 他們只會使用你實際給予的彈藥.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_InfiniteAmmo_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 携带枪械的同伴弹药永远不会用完: 其备用弹药会被悄悄补满, 无需你交给他们弹匣也能持续装填. 关闭时 (默认), 他们只会使用你实际给予的弹药.

Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_CureXP_too.en: Actual Farming experience gained for treating a diseased plant. Awarded once per valid action, not once per product use.
Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_CureXP_too.ch: 治療染病植物時獲得的實際耕作經驗. 每次有效操作給予一次, 而非每使用一次產品給予一次.
Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_CureXP_too.cn: 治疗患病植物时获得的实际耕作经验. 每次有效操作给予一次, 而非每使用一次产品给予一次.

Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_DisableCro.en: Keeps crops alive in their final productive stage and prevents them from progressing to rotten. It does not restore plants that are already rotten.
Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_DisableCro.ch: 讓作物在最終可收成階段保持存活, 並防止其進入腐爛階段. 不會恢復已經腐爛的植物.
Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_DisableCro.cn: 让作物在最终可收获阶段保持存活, 并防止其进入腐烂阶段. 不会恢复已经腐烂的植物.

Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_HarvestMap.en: Allows harvesting tiles vegetation_farm_01_0 through vegetation_farm_01_5. Normal and forged scythes harvest 3x3; normal and forged hand scythes and the primitive scythe harvest 1x1. Each tile yields one wheat sheaf.
Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_HarvestMap.ch: 允許收割 vegetation_farm_01_0 至 vegetation_farm_01_5 的地塊. 一般與鍛造的鐮刀可收割 3x3 範圍; 一般與鍛造的單手鐮以及石刃鐮刀可收割 1x1 範圍. 每格產出 1 個小麥捆.
Sandbox_VanillaAgricultureFix_HarvestMap.cn: 允许收割 vegetation_farm_01_0 至 vegetation_farm_01_5 的地块. 普通和锻造的镰刀可收割 3x3 范围; 普通和锻造的单手镰以及石刃镰刀可收割 1x1 范围. 每格产出 1 个小麦捆.

Sandbox_ArsenalUpgrades_RepairCost_Toolt.en: Points required to fully repair a melee weapon
Sandbox_ArsenalUpgrades_RepairCost_Toolt.ch: 完全修復一把近戰武器所需的點數.
Sandbox_ArsenalUpgrades_RepairCost_Toolt.cn: 完全修复一把近战武器所需的点数.

Sandbox_ArsenalUpgrades_RepairEnabled_To.en: Enable weapon repair section in the upgrade panel
Sandbox_ArsenalUpgrades_RepairEnabled_To.ch: 在升級面板中開啟武器維修區塊.
Sandbox_ArsenalUpgrades_RepairEnabled_To.cn: 在升级面板中开启武器维修栏.

Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds.en: Cobblestone Generator: Max Seconds Per Reward
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds.ch: 圓石產生器: 每次獎勵最長秒數
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds.cn: 圆石生成器: 每次奖励最长秒数

Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds_tool.en: Maximum seconds of mining between cobblestone generator rewards.
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds_tool.ch: 圓石產生器兩次獎勵之間的最長挖掘秒數.
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMaxSeconds_tool.cn: 圆石生成器两次奖励之间的最长挖掘秒数.

Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds.en: Cobblestone Generator: Min Seconds Per Reward
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds.ch: 圓石產生器: 每次獎勵最短秒數
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds.cn: 圆石生成器: 每次奖励最短秒数

Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds_tool.en: Minimum seconds of mining between cobblestone generator rewards.
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds_tool.ch: 圓石產生器兩次獎勵之間的最短挖掘秒數.
Sandbox_MBSB_CobbleRewardMinSeconds_tool.cn: 圆石生成器两次奖励之间的最短挖掘秒数.

Sandbox_MBSB_CropGrowthSpeed_tooltip.en: Multiplier on farm crop growth (Skyblock uses its own crop timing of 11-18 hours per stage; the vanilla Farming speed setting does not apply). 2.0 = crops grow twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed.
Sandbox_MBSB_CropGrowthSpeed_tooltip.ch: 農田作物生長倍率 (空島使用自己的作物計時, 每階段 11-18 小時; 原版農業速度設定不適用). 2.0 = 作物生長速度加倍, 0.5 = 半速.
Sandbox_MBSB_CropGrowthSpeed_tooltip.cn: 农田作物生长倍率 (空岛使用自己的作物计时, 每阶段 11-18 小时; 原版农业速度设置不适用). 2.0 = 作物生长速度翻倍, 0.5 = 半速.

Sandbox_MBSB_DespawnDistance_tooltip.en: Zombies farther than this from every player slowly despawn (Minecraft's 128-block rule). On the Skyblock map 128 covers nearly everything, so this only matters if players cluster far away for a long time. 0 = never despawn.
Sandbox_MBSB_DespawnDistance_tooltip.ch: 與所有玩家距離都超過此值的殭屍會逐漸消失 (Minecraft 的 128 格規則). 在空島地圖上 128 幾乎涵蓋所有範圍, 因此只有在玩家長時間聚集在遠處時才有影響. 0 = 永不消失.
Sandbox_MBSB_DespawnDistance_tooltip.cn: 与所有玩家距离都超过此值的僵尸会逐渐消失 (Minecraft 的 128 格规则). 在空岛地图上 128 几乎覆盖所有范围, 因此只有在玩家长时间聚集在远处时才有影响. 0 = 永不消失.

Sandbox_MBSB_GrassRegrowDays_tooltip.en: In-game days before cut grass regrows.
Sandbox_MBSB_GrassRegrowDays_tooltip.ch: 割掉的草重新長出前所需的遊戲天數.
Sandbox_MBSB_GrassRegrowDays_tooltip.cn: 割掉的草重新长出前所需的游戏天数.

Sandbox_MBSB_HostileCapPerPlayer.ch: 殭屍生成: 每位玩家上限
Sandbox_MBSB_HostileCapPerPlayer.cn: 僵尸生成: 每位玩家上限

Sandbox_MBSB_HostileCapPerPlayer_tooltip.en: Minecraft-style population scaling: the total zombie cap is this number times the online player count (never exceeding Max Zombies). 0 = no per-player scaling, use Max Zombies only.
Sandbox_MBSB_HostileCapPerPlayer_tooltip.ch: Minecraft 式數量縮放: 殭屍總上限為此數值乘以線上玩家人數 (不會超過最大殭屍數). 0 = 不依玩家人數縮放, 僅使用最大殭屍數.
Sandbox_MBSB_HostileCapPerPlayer_tooltip.cn: Minecraft 式数量缩放: 僵尸总上限为此数值乘以在线玩家人数 (不会超过最大僵尸数). 0 = 不按玩家人数缩放, 仅使用最大僵尸数.

Sandbox_MBSB_MaxZombieCount.ch: 殭屍生成: 世界上限
Sandbox_MBSB_MaxZombieCount.cn: 僵尸生成: 世界上限

Sandbox_MBSB_MaxZombieCount_tooltip.en: No new zombies spawn while this many are already in the world. 0 disables night spawning entirely.
Sandbox_MBSB_MaxZombieCount_tooltip.ch: 當世界中已有這麼多殭屍時, 不再生成新殭屍. 0 會完全停用夜間生成.
Sandbox_MBSB_MaxZombieCount_tooltip.cn: 当世界中已有这么多僵尸时, 不再生成新僵尸. 0 会完全禁用夜间生成.

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnAttemptsPerPlayer.ch: 殭屍生成: 每週期嘗試次數
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnAttemptsPerPlayer.cn: 僵尸生成: 每周期尝试次数

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnAttemptsPerPlayer_tool.en: How many spawn attempts each player generates per spawn cycle. Each attempt rolls the spawn chance independently and targets its own random zone, so higher values mean faster AND more spread-out spawning.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnAttemptsPerPlayer_tool.ch: 每位玩家在每個生成週期產生的生成嘗試次數. 每次嘗試都會獨立判定生成機率, 並以各自的隨機區域為目標, 因此數值越高, 生成越快且越分散.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnAttemptsPerPlayer_tool.cn: 每位玩家在每个生成周期产生的生成尝试次数. 每次尝试都会独立判定生成几率, 并以各自的随机区域为目标, 因此数值越高, 生成越快且越分散.

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnChance.ch: 殭屍生成: 每次嘗試機率 (%%)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnChance.cn: 僵尸生成: 每次尝试几率 (%%)

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnChance_tooltip.en: Each spawn attempt only proceeds this percent of the time. Lower values mean fewer, less predictable spawn waves (and fewer performance hitches at nightfall). 100 = every attempt spawns, 0 = never.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnChance_tooltip.ch: 每次生成嘗試只有此百分比的機率會執行. 數值越低, 生成波次越少且越難預測 (入夜時的效能卡頓也越少). 100 = 每次嘗試都會生成, 0 = 永不生成.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnChance_tooltip.cn: 每次生成尝试只有此百分比的几率会执行. 数值越低, 生成波次越少且越难预测 (入夜时的性能卡顿也越少). 100 = 每次尝试都会生成, 0 = 从不生成.

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnCycleSeconds.ch: 殭屍生成: 週期長度 (現實秒數)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnCycleSeconds.cn: 僵尸生成: 周期长度 (现实秒数)

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnCycleSeconds_tooltip.en: How often the spawner runs, in REAL-WORLD seconds (not in-game time). 30 = a spawn wave every 30 real seconds. Lower = more frequent waves. Minimum 5.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnCycleSeconds_tooltip.ch: 生成器執行的頻率, 以現實世界秒數計算 (非遊戲內時間). 30 = 每 30 現實秒生成一波. 數值越低 = 波次越頻繁. 最小值 5.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnCycleSeconds_tooltip.cn: 生成器运行的频率, 以现实世界秒数计算 (非游戏内时间). 30 = 每 30 现实秒生成一波. 数值越低 = 波次越频繁. 最小值 5.

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnDriver.ch: 殭屍生成: 觸發方式
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnDriver.cn: 僵尸生成: 触发方式

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnDriver_tooltip.en: What triggers zombie spawning. Time of Day: spawns only during the configured night hours (dark tiles only). Darkness (Minecraft): no clock at all — anywhere dark enough can spawn at any hour, including unlit interiors at noon. Light your base!
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnDriver_tooltip.ch: 決定殭屍生成的觸發條件. 時段: 只在設定的夜間時段生成 (僅限黑暗的格子). 黑暗 (Minecraft): 完全不看時間 - 任何夠暗的地方在任何時刻都可能生成, 包括中午時未照明的室內. 記得照亮你的基地!
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnDriver_tooltip.cn: 决定僵尸生成的触发条件. 时段: 只在设置的夜间时段生成 (仅限黑暗的格子). 黑暗 (Minecraft): 完全不看时间 - 任何足够暗的地方在任何时刻都可能生成, 包括中午时未照明的室内. 记得照亮你的基地!

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnLightThreshold.ch: 殭屍生成: 黑暗閾值
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnLightThreshold.cn: 僵尸生成: 黑暗阈值

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnLightThreshold_tooltip.en: Zombies only spawn on tiles at or below this light level (0.0 = pitch black required, 1.0 = spawns even in full light). Checked per-tile and as a 4-tile-radius area average.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnLightThreshold_tooltip.ch: 殭屍只會在光照等級等於或低於此值的格子上生成 (0.0 = 需要完全漆黑, 1.0 = 即使全亮也會生成). 會逐格檢查, 並檢查半徑 4 格區域的平均值.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnLightThreshold_tooltip.cn: 僵尸只会在光照等级等于或低于此值的格子上生成 (0.0 = 需要完全漆黑, 1.0 = 即使全亮也会生成). 会逐格检查, 并检查半径 4 格区域的平均值.

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightEndHour.ch: 殭屍生成: 夜晚結束 (時)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightEndHour.cn: 僵尸生成: 夜晚结束 (时)

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightEndHour_tooltip.en: Time of Day driver only: the hour spawning stops (24h clock, default 6 = 6 AM).
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightEndHour_tooltip.ch: 僅限時段觸發方式: 停止生成的時刻 (24 小時制, 預設 6 = 上午 6 點).
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightEndHour_tooltip.cn: 仅限时段触发方式: 停止生成的时刻 (24 小时制, 默认 6 = 上午 6 点).

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightStartHour.ch: 殭屍生成: 夜晚開始 (時)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightStartHour.cn: 僵尸生成: 夜晚开始 (时)

Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightStartHour_tooltip.en: Time of Day driver only: the hour spawning begins (24h clock, default 20 = 8 PM).
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightStartHour_tooltip.ch: 僅限時段觸發方式: 開始生成的時刻 (24 小時制, 預設 20 = 晚上 8 點).
Sandbox_MBSB_SpawnNightStartHour_tooltip.cn: 仅限时段触发方式: 开始生成的时刻 (24 小时制, 默认 20 = 晚上 8 点).

Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn.en: Zombie Spawn: Special Zombie Rarity (1 in N)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn.ch: 殭屍生成: 特殊殭屍稀有度 (N 分之 1)
Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn.cn: 僵尸生成: 特殊僵尸稀有度 (N 分之 1)

Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn_tooltip.en: Chance for a spawned zombie to be a rare military, survivor, looter or ghillie zombie instead of a civilian. 150 = roughly 1 in 150. Higher = rarer. Set 0 to disable them entirely.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn_tooltip.ch: 生成的殭屍成為稀有的軍人, 倖存者, 掠奪者或吉利服殭屍 (而非平民) 的機率. 150 = 約 150 分之 1. 數值越高 = 越稀有. 設為 0 可完全停用.
Sandbox_MBSB_SpecialZombieOneIn_tooltip.cn: 生成的僵尸成为稀有的军人, 幸存者, 掠夺者或吉利服僵尸 (而非平民) 的几率. 150 = 约 150 分之 1. 数值越高 = 越稀有. 设为 0 可完全禁用.

Sandbox_MBSB_TreeGrowthSpeed_tooltip.en: Multiplier for tree growth. 2.0 = trees grow twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed.
Sandbox_MBSB_TreeGrowthSpeed_tooltip.ch: 樹木生長倍率. 2.0 = 樹木生長速度加倍, 0.5 = 半速.
Sandbox_MBSB_TreeGrowthSpeed_tooltip.cn: 树木生长倍率. 2.0 = 树木生长速度翻倍, 0.5 = 半速.

Sandbox_MBSB_VoidGraceSeconds_tooltip.en: How long a living player can stand at void level before the void kills them. Fall-damage deaths resolve naturally first; this only applies to survivors. Staff (any access level above None) are always exempt. 0 = instant.
Sandbox_MBSB_VoidGraceSeconds_tooltip.ch: 存活的玩家可在虛空高度停留多久才會被虛空殺死. 摔落傷害造成的死亡會先自然判定; 此設定只適用於倖存下來的玩家. 管理人員 (任何高於 None 的權限等級) 一律豁免. 0 = 立即.
Sandbox_MBSB_VoidGraceSeconds_tooltip.cn: 存活的玩家可在虚空高度停留多久才会被虚空杀死. 摔落伤害造成的死亡会先自然结算; 此设置只适用于幸存下来的玩家. 管理人员 (任何高于 None 的权限等级) 始终豁免. 0 = 立即.

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMaxSpawnDistance.ch: 殭屍生成: 最大距離 (格)
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMaxSpawnDistance.cn: 僵尸生成: 最大距离 (格)

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMaxSpawnDistance_tool.en: Zombies never spawn farther than this many tiles from a player.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMaxSpawnDistance_tool.ch: 殭屍生成位置與玩家的距離絕不會超過此格數.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMaxSpawnDistance_tool.cn: 僵尸生成位置与玩家的距离绝不会超过此格数.

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMinSpawnDistance.ch: 殭屍生成: 最小距離 (格)
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMinSpawnDistance.cn: 僵尸生成: 最小距离 (格)

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMinSpawnDistance_tool.en: Zombies never spawn closer than this many tiles from a player on the same floor level. Spawns one level above use half this distance.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMinSpawnDistance_tool.ch: 在同一樓層, 殭屍生成位置與玩家的距離絕不會少於此格數. 在上一層生成時使用此距離的一半.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombieMinSpawnDistance_tool.cn: 在同一楼层, 僵尸生成位置与玩家的距离绝不会少于此格数. 在上一层生成时使用此距离的一半.

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMax.ch: 每次生成殭屍數: 最大
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMax.cn: 每次生成僵尸数: 最大

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMax_tooltip.ch: 每波生成的殭屍數量上限.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMax_tooltip.cn: 每波生成的僵尸数量上限.

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMin.ch: 每次生成殭屍數: 最小
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMin.cn: 每次生成僵尸数: 最小

Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMin_tooltip.ch: 每波生成的殭屍數量下限.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZombiesPerSpawnMin_tooltip.cn: 每波生成的僵尸数量下限.

Sandbox_MBSB_ZoneZombieCap.ch: 殭屍生成: 每區上限
Sandbox_MBSB_ZoneZombieCap.cn: 僵尸生成: 每区上限

Sandbox_MBSB_ZoneZombieCap_tooltip.en: The world is divided into 16x16-tile zones; each zone holds at most this many zombies. Spawning skips full zones, so zombies spread out and torch-lit zones stay clear.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZoneZombieCap_tooltip.ch: 世界被劃分為 16x16 格的區域, 每個區域最多容納此數量的殭屍. 生成時會略過已滿的區域, 因此殭屍會分散開來, 而有火把照明的區域會保持淨空.
Sandbox_MBSB_ZoneZombieCap_tooltip.cn: 世界被划分为 16x16 格的区域, 每个区域最多容纳此数量的僵尸. 生成时会跳过已满的区域, 因此僵尸会分散开来, 而有火把照明的区域会保持清空.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_AllowClientOverrid.ch: 允許客戶端 MOD 選項
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_AllowClientOverrid.cn: 允许客户端 MOD 选项

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_AllowClientOverrid.en: ON: each player can change HUD visibility toggles in Esc > Options > Mods. OFF: everyone uses the sandbox values below (server-wide).
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_AllowClientOverrid.ch: 開: 每位玩家可在 Esc > 選項 > MOD 中切換 HUD 顯示開關. 關: 所有人使用下方的沙盒數值 (全伺服器).
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_AllowClientOverrid.cn: 开: 每位玩家可在 Esc > 选项 > MOD 中切换 HUD 显示开关. 关: 所有人使用下方的沙盒数值 (全服务器).

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_Enabled_tooltip.en: Master switch. OFF replaces the Minecraft-style HUD with the vanilla Project Zomboid hotbar for everyone.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 總開關. 關閉時, 所有人的 Minecraft 風格 HUD 都會換回 Project Zomboid 原版快捷欄.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 总开关. 关闭时, 所有人的 Minecraft 风格 HUD 都会换回 Project Zomboid 原版快捷栏.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_HudSize_tooltip.en: On-screen size of the Minecraft HUD as a percentage. 100 = the original fixed size, 70 = default. Only used when client Mod Options are disabled.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_HudSize_tooltip.ch: Minecraft HUD 在螢幕上的大小百分比. 100 = 原本的固定大小, 70 = 預設值. 僅在停用客戶端 MOD 選項時使用.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_HudSize_tooltip.cn: Minecraft HUD 在屏幕上的大小百分比. 100 = 原本的固定大小, 70 = 默认值. 仅在禁用客户端 MOD 选项时使用.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowArmor_tooltip.en: Server default / forced value for armor icons.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowArmor_tooltip.ch: 護甲圖示的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowArmor_tooltip.cn: 护甲图标的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowDurability_too.en: Server default / forced value for item durability bars.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowDurability_too.ch: 物品耐久條的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowDurability_too.cn: 物品耐久条的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowHealth_tooltip.en: Server default / forced value for the heart row.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowHealth_tooltip.ch: 愛心列的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowHealth_tooltip.cn: 爱心栏的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowHunger_tooltip.en: Server default / forced value for hunger icons.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowHunger_tooltip.ch: 飢餓圖示的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowHunger_tooltip.cn: 饥饿图标的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowStamina_toolti.en: Server default / forced value for the stamina bar.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowStamina_toolti.ch: 耐力條的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowStamina_toolti.cn: 耐力条的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowThirst_tooltip.en: Server default / forced value for thirst air-bubble icons.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowThirst_tooltip.ch: 口渴氣泡圖示的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowThirst_tooltip.cn: 口渴气泡图标的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowXpOrbs_tooltip.en: Server default / forced value for experience orb VFX when you kill zombies/players/animals.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowXpOrbs_tooltip.ch: 擊殺殭屍/玩家/動物時經驗球特效的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_ShowXpOrbs_tooltip.cn: 击杀僵尸/玩家/动物时经验球特效的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_XpOrbSounds_toolti.en: Server default / forced value for absorb sounds when orbs are collected.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_XpOrbSounds_toolti.ch: 收集經驗球時吸收音效的伺服器預設值/強制值.
Sandbox_SkyblockMCHud_XpOrbSounds_toolti.cn: 收集经验球时吸收音效的服务器默认值/强制值.

Sandbox_PZCrossbows_DebugLogging_tooltip.en: Writes PZ Crossbows diagnostics to the console and log files: which side handles each shot, bolt counters and recovery rolls. Leave off unless you are reporting a bug, as it makes the logs noisy.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_DebugLogging_tooltip.ch: 將 PZ 十字弩的診斷資訊寫入主控台和日誌檔: 每次射擊由哪一端處理、弩箭計數和回收判定. 除非你要回報錯誤, 否則請保持關閉, 因為它會讓日誌變得雜亂.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_DebugLogging_tooltip.cn: 将 PZ 十字弩的诊断信息写入控制台和日志文件: 每次射击由哪一端处理、弩箭计数和回收判定. 除非你要报告错误, 否则请保持关闭, 因为它会让日志变得杂乱.

Sandbox_PZCrossbows_LootSpawnMult_toolti.en: Multiplies all PZ Crossbows container loot and foraging spawns, including crossbows, bolt quivers, bolts and bolt parts. This combines with each crossbow's individual multiplier.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_LootSpawnMult_toolti.ch: 調整所有 PZ 十字弩物品在容器戰利品和搜尋中的生成倍率, 包括十字弩、弩箭箭袋、弩箭和弩箭零件. 此倍率會與各十字弩的個別倍率相乘.
Sandbox_PZCrossbows_LootSpawnMult_toolti.cn: 调整所有 PZ 十字弩物品在容器战利品和搜寻中的生成倍率, 包括十字弩、弩箭箭袋、弩箭和弩箭零件. 此倍率会与各十字弩的单独倍率相乘.

Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_EnableNutritionIn.en: Allow players to see additional food and liquid nutrition information.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_EnableNutritionIn.ch: 允許玩家檢視額外的食物和液體營養資訊.
Sandbox_BetterItemInfo_EnableNutritionIn.cn: 允许玩家查看额外的食物和液体营养信息.

Sandbox_FightZ_FistXpMultiplier_tooltip.en: XP multiplier used for the Fists perk when per-skill XP multipliers are enabled.

Sandbox_WanderingHordes_HouseAssaultRadi.en: If there any player in this radius, zombie could make route through house. Outside this radius zombie won't go through the house, it will go around side.

Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_Enabled_t.en: Turn OFF to make the mod completely dormant: no spawning, no recovery, no cabinet visual updates - while the mod stays loaded so your save (especially multiplayer) remains loadable. Use this instead of uninstalling on game 42.20.4+, which cannot cleanly uninstall mods with craftable furniture. Existing cabinets remain as plain containers. A relog may be needed after changing this mid-save.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_Enabled_t.ch: 關閉後模組會完全停止運作: 不生成, 不回收, 不更新櫃子外觀 - 但模組仍維持載入, 讓你的存檔 (尤其是多人遊戲) 依然可以載入. 在 42.20.4 以上版本請改用此選項而非解除安裝, 因為該版本無法乾淨移除含可製作家具的模組. 現有的櫃子會保留為一般容器. 存檔中途更改此設定後可能需要重新登入.
Sandbox_PropaneExchangeCabinet_Enabled_t.cn: 关闭后模组会完全停止运作: 不生成, 不回收, 不更新柜子外观 - 但模组仍保持加载, 让你的存档 (尤其是多人游戏) 依然可以加载. 在 42.20.4 及以上版本请改用此选项而不是卸载, 因为该版本无法干净地卸载含可制作家具的模组. 现有的柜子会保留为普通容器. 存档中途更改此设置后可能需要重新登录.

Sandbox_FPP_DexLevelGate.ch: 魚類圖鑑: 捕獲後解鎖條目
Sandbox_FPP_DexLevelGate.cn: 鱼类图鉴: 捕获后解锁条目

Sandbox_FPP_DexLevelGate_tooltip.en:
Off (default): every fish is listed with its name, icon and 3D model from the start.
On: fish you have not caught show as "???" with no 3D model, and are revealed once you catch them.
Fish descriptions always follow the vanilla rule (caught + Fishing level 6).
Sandbox_FPP_DexLevelGate_tooltip.ch:
關閉 (預設): 一開始就列出所有魚的名稱, 圖示和 3D 模型.
開啟: 尚未捕獲的魚會顯示為「???」且沒有 3D 模型, 捕獲後才會揭曉.
魚類描述一律遵循原版規則 (已捕獲 + 釣魚 6 級).
Sandbox_FPP_DexLevelGate_tooltip.cn:
关闭 (默认): 一开始就列出所有鱼的名称, 图标和 3D 模型.
开启: 尚未捕获的鱼会显示为“???”且没有 3D 模型, 捕获后才会揭晓.
鱼类描述始终遵循原版规则 (已捕获 + 钓鱼 6 级).

Sandbox_YAII_DoubleClick_tooltip.en: Multiplayer global: when enabled, double-clicking loot into the player inventory uses instant transfer; when disabled, vanilla TimedAction is used.
Sandbox_YAII_DoubleClick_tooltip.ch: 多人全域: 啟用後, 雙擊將戰利品移入玩家物品欄時使用即時轉移; 停用後使用原版計時動作.
Sandbox_YAII_DoubleClick_tooltip.cn: 多人全局: 启用后, 双击将战利品移入玩家物品栏时使用即时转移; 禁用后使用原版计时动作.

Sandbox_CMR_IntensityPercentage_tooltip.en: Used only while quick rebalance mode is disabled. 0 restores vanilla values, 100 keeps original CMR, and 200 doubles the difference between vanilla and CMR. Range: 0.00 to 200.00.
Sandbox_CMR_IntensityPercentage_tooltip.ch: 僅在停用快速重平衡模式時使用. 0 恢復原版數值, 100 維持原始 CMR, 200 則將原版與 CMR 之間的差異加倍. 範圍: 0.00 至 200.00.
Sandbox_CMR_IntensityPercentage_tooltip.cn: 仅在禁用快速重平衡模式时使用. 0 恢复原版数值, 100 保持原始 CMR, 200 则将原版与 CMR 之间的差异加倍. 范围: 0.00 至 200.00.

Sandbox_CMR_ProgressionMultiplier_toolti.en: Used only while quick rebalance mode is enabled. Enter the server's progression rate: x1 keeps original CMR, x2 applies 50%%, x3 applies 33.33%%, and x0.5 applies 200%% of CMR. Range: 0.50 to 10.00.
Sandbox_CMR_ProgressionMultiplier_toolti.ch: 僅在啟用快速重平衡模式時使用. 輸入伺服器的成長倍率: x1 維持原始 CMR, x2 套用 50%%, x3 套用 33.33%%, x0.5 套用 200%% 的 CMR. 範圍: 0.50 至 10.00.
Sandbox_CMR_ProgressionMultiplier_toolti.cn: 仅在启用快速重平衡模式时使用. 输入服务器的成长倍率: x1 保持原始 CMR, x2 应用 50%%, x3 应用 33.33%%, x0.5 应用 200%% 的 CMR. 范围: 0.50 至 10.00.

Sandbox_CMR_UseQuickAdjustment_tooltip.en: Enabled: CMR uses only the progression multiplier below. Disabled: CMR ignores that multiplier and uses only the precise percentage setting.
Sandbox_CMR_UseQuickAdjustment_tooltip.ch: 啟用: CMR 只使用下方的成長倍率. 停用: CMR 忽略該倍率, 只使用精確百分比設定.
Sandbox_CMR_UseQuickAdjustment_tooltip.cn: 启用: CMR 只使用下方的成长倍率. 禁用: CMR 忽略该倍率, 只使用精确百分比设置.
