Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal.en: Days unvisited before abandoned RV cleanup list (real-life days)
Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal.ch: 列入廢棄房車清理清單前的未造訪天數 (現實天數)
Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal.cn: 列入废弃房车清理清单前的未访问天数 (现实天数)

Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal.en: Number of real-world calendar days since last entry before an RV interior appears in Manage abandoned interiors. Default: 21. This uses the server or host wall clock; game-time speed, sleeping and restored world clocks do not affect it.
Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal.ch: 自上次進入起經過多少個現實日曆天後, 房車內部空間會出現在「管理廢棄內部空間」中. 預設: 21. 此設定使用伺服器或主機的系統時鐘; 遊戲時間流速, 睡眠及還原的世界時鐘都不會影響它.
Sandbox_RVInterior_AbandonedInteriorReal.cn: 自上次进入起经过多少个现实日历天后, 房车内部空间会出现在“管理废弃内部空间”中. 默认: 21. 此设置使用服务器或主机的系统时钟; 游戏时间流速, 睡眠及恢复的世界时钟都不会影响它.

Sandbox_RVInterior_AllowPlayerInteriorAc.en: Allow players to enter RV interiors
Sandbox_RVInterior_AllowPlayerInteriorAc.ch: 允許玩家進入房車內部
Sandbox_RVInterior_AllowPlayerInteriorAc.cn: 允许玩家进入房车内部

Sandbox_RVInterior_AllowPlayerInteriorAc.en: Allows regular players to enter RV interiors. Disable to block new regular-player entry immediately. Players already inside can always exit. Moderators and administrators retain entry and all Vehicle Manager controls. Takes effect immediately. Default: enabled.
Sandbox_RVInterior_AllowPlayerInteriorAc.ch: 允許一般玩家進入房車內部空間. 停用後會立即阻止一般玩家新進入. 已在內部的玩家隨時都能離開. 版主與管理員仍可進入並使用所有車輛管理器功能. 立即生效. 預設: 啟用.
Sandbox_RVInterior_AllowPlayerInteriorAc.cn: 允许普通玩家进入房车内部空间. 禁用后会立即阻止普通玩家新进入. 已在内部的玩家随时都能离开. 版主与管理员仍可进入并使用所有车辆管理器功能. 立即生效. 默认: 启用.

Sandbox_RVInterior_EnableFirstDiscoveryZ.ch: 啟用首次發現房車殭屍
Sandbox_RVInterior_EnableFirstDiscoveryZ.cn: 启用首次发现房车僵尸

Sandbox_RVInterior_EnableFirstDiscoveryZ.en: Allows a one-time randomized zombie encounter in a newly assigned, previously undiscovered RV interior. Existing, claimed, or modified interiors are never selected. Available in single player, hosted, and dedicated multiplayer. Default: off.
Sandbox_RVInterior_EnableFirstDiscoveryZ.ch: 在新分配且從未被發現的房車內部空間中, 允許發生一次隨機殭屍遭遇. 既有, 已認領或已修改的內部空間永遠不會被選上. 單人遊戲, 主機及專用伺服器多人遊戲皆可使用. 預設: 關閉.
Sandbox_RVInterior_EnableFirstDiscoveryZ.cn: 在新分配且从未被发现的房车内部空间中, 允许发生一次随机僵尸遭遇. 既有, 已认领或已修改的内部空间永远不会被选中. 单人游戏, 主机及专用服务器多人游戏均可使用. 默认: 关闭.

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryLargeMa.ch: 大型內部空間殭屍數量上限
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryLargeMa.cn: 大型内部空间僵尸数量上限

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryLargeMa.en: Random range is zero through this value. Default: 3.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryLargeMa.ch: 隨機範圍為零至此數值. 預設: 3.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryLargeMa.cn: 随机范围为零至此数值. 默认: 3.

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryMediumM.ch: 中型內部空間殭屍數量上限
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryMediumM.cn: 中型内部空间僵尸数量上限

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryMediumM.en: Random range is zero through this value. Default: 3.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryMediumM.ch: 隨機範圍為零至此數值. 預設: 3.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryMediumM.cn: 随机范围为零至此数值. 默认: 3.

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoverySmallMa.ch: 小型內部空間殭屍數量上限
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoverySmallMa.cn: 小型内部空间僵尸数量上限

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoverySmallMa.en: Random range is zero through this value. Default: 2.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoverySmallMa.ch: 隨機範圍為零至此數值. 預設: 2.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoverySmallMa.cn: 随机范围为零至此数值. 默认: 2.

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryVeryLar.en: Very large bus, boat, or heavy-trailer maximum zombies
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryVeryLar.ch: 超大型巴士, 船隻或重型拖車殭屍數量上限
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryVeryLar.cn: 超大型巴士, 船只或重型拖车僵尸数量上限

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryVeryLar.en: Random range is zero through this value. Default: 5.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryVeryLar.ch: 隨機範圍為零至此數值. 預設: 5.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryVeryLar.cn: 随机范围为零至此数值. 默认: 5.

Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryZombieC.en: Chance that an eligible newly discovered RV contains any controlled zombie encounter. The final randomized count may still be zero. Default: 25.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryZombieC.ch: 符合條件的新發現房車內出現受控殭屍遭遇的機率. 最終隨機數量仍可能為零. 預設: 25.
Sandbox_RVInterior_FirstDiscoveryZombieC.cn: 符合条件的新发现房车内出现受控僵尸遭遇的几率. 最终随机数量仍可能为零. 默认: 25.

Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankConsumptionM.en: 0 turns battery drain off; 0.5 halves it; 1 is normal; 2 doubles it. Default: 0.5.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankConsumptionM.ch: 0 關閉電池消耗; 0.5 減半; 1 為正常; 2 加倍. 預設: 0.5.
Sandbox_RVInterior_PowerBankConsumptionM.cn: 0 关闭电池消耗; 0.5 减半; 1 为正常; 2 加倍. 默认: 0.5.

Sandbox_RVInterior_ReturnPlayersToVehicl.en: Return players to vehicle seats on exit
Sandbox_RVInterior_ReturnPlayersToVehicl.ch: 離開時讓玩家回到車輛座位
Sandbox_RVInterior_ReturnPlayersToVehicl.cn: 离开时让玩家回到车辆座位

Sandbox_RVInterior_ReturnPlayersToVehicl.en: When enabled, exiting an RV interior attempts to return each player to their previous seat, or another free seat in the same vehicle. Disabling this function returns players to the rear corner of the vehicle and may reduce desync pressure on the server during peak hours. Default: enabled.
Sandbox_RVInterior_ReturnPlayersToVehicl.ch: 啟用時, 離開房車內部空間會嘗試讓每位玩家回到原本的座位, 或同一輛車的其他空位. 停用此功能會讓玩家回到車輛後方角落, 並可能在尖峰時段減輕伺服器的不同步壓力. 預設: 啟用.
Sandbox_RVInterior_ReturnPlayersToVehicl.cn: 启用时, 离开房车内部空间会尝试让每位玩家回到原来的座位, 或同一辆车的其他空位. 禁用此功能会让玩家回到车辆后方角落, 并可能在高峰时段减轻服务器的不同步压力. 默认: 启用.

Sandbox_RVInterior_ShowVehicleManagerPro.ch: 顯示車輛管理器快捷鍵標籤
Sandbox_RVInterior_ShowVehicleManagerPro.cn: 显示车辆管理器快捷键标签

Sandbox_RVInterior_ShowVehicleManagerPro.en: Show the nearby Vehicle Manager shortcut label. This only changes its label, not access. Battery Bay and pedestal labels are set separately in RV Power Manager > Power settings (admins only).
Sandbox_RVInterior_ShowVehicleManagerPro.ch: 靠近時顯示車輛管理器快捷鍵標籤. 此項只影響標籤, 不影響使用. 電池艙與岸電樁的標籤需另外在「房車電源管理器 > 電源設定」中調整 (僅限管理員).
Sandbox_RVInterior_ShowVehicleManagerPro.cn: 靠近时显示车辆管理器快捷键标签. 此项只影响标签, 不影响使用. 电池舱与岸电桩的标签需另外在“房车电源管理器 > 电源设置”中调整 (仅限管理员).

Sandbox_RVInterior_SpawnStarterPowerBank.ch: 舊版電池艙設定 (無作用)
Sandbox_RVInterior_SpawnStarterPowerBank.cn: 旧版电池舱设置 (无作用)

Sandbox_RVInterior_SpawnStarterPowerBank.en: Kept only so old saves keep working. Every RV now gets a Battery Bay.
Sandbox_RVInterior_SpawnStarterPowerBank.ch: 僅為讓舊存檔正常運作而保留. 現在每輛房車都會有一座電池艙.
Sandbox_RVInterior_SpawnStarterPowerBank.cn: 仅为让旧存档正常运行而保留. 现在每辆房车都会有一座电池舱.

Sandbox_RVInterior_VehicleManagerHotkey_.en: Choose a Vehicle Manager shortcut, or select Disabled to turn the shortcut and its prompt off. When disabled, right-click an eligible vehicle and choose Vehicle Manager. Apply saves the choice immediately.
Sandbox_RVInterior_VehicleManagerHotkey_.ch: 選擇車輛管理器的快捷鍵, 或選擇「停用」以關閉快捷鍵及其提示. 停用時, 請右鍵點選符合條件的車輛並選擇「車輛管理器」. 按下「套用」會立即儲存選擇.
Sandbox_RVInterior_VehicleManagerHotkey_.cn: 选择车辆管理器的快捷键, 或选择“禁用”以关闭快捷键及其提示. 禁用时, 请右键点击符合条件的车辆并选择“车辆管理器”. 点击“应用”会立即保存选择.

Sandbox_DarkPresence_AmbientMinDist.ch: 環境生成距離 (最少格數)
Sandbox_DarkPresence_AmbientMinDist.cn: 环境生成距离 (最少格数)

Sandbox_DarkPresence_AmbientMinDist_tool.en: How far from you the dark must be before it can put a Taken on the ground. Raise it to keep them clear of your base and its walls; lower it to have them arrive right on top of you. They never spawn indoors or anywhere inside a building at any setting. Default 10.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_AmbientMinDist_tool.ch: 黑暗必須離你多遠, 才能在地面上放出被奪者. 調高可讓它們遠離你的基地與圍牆; 調低則會讓它們直接出現在你身邊. 無論如何設定, 它們都不會在室內或建築物內生成. 預設值為 10.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_AmbientMinDist_tool.cn: 黑暗必须离你多远, 才能在地面上放出被夺者. 调高可让它们远离你的基地与围墙; 调低则会让它们直接出现在你身边. 无论如何设置, 它们都不会在室内或建筑物内生成. 默认值为10.

Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnCleansed.en: Cleansed Taken dissolve at dawn too
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnCleansed.ch: 已淨化的被奪者也在黎明時消散
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnCleansed.cn: 已净化的被夺者也在黎明时消散

Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnCleansed_too.en: A Taken whose shield you burned off becomes an ordinary zombie, and by default it survives the dawn - so a busy night leaves a crowd to clear every morning. On: they dissolve with the rest, and the day starts clean. Requires 'Taken dissolve at clear dawn'. Default off.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnCleansed_too.ch: 護盾被你燒掉的被奪者會變成普通殭屍, 預設情況下它能撐過黎明 - 因此忙碌的夜晚過後, 每天早上都會留下一群待清理的殭屍. 開啟: 它們會和其他被奪者一起消散, 一天從乾淨開始. 需要啟用「晴朗黎明時被奪者消散」. 預設為關閉.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_DespawnCleansed_too.cn: 护盾被你烧掉的被夺者会变成普通僵尸, 默认情况下它能撑过黎明 - 因此忙碌的夜晚过后, 每天早上都会留下一群待清理的僵尸. 开启: 它们会和其他被夺者一起消散, 一天从干净开始. 需要开启“晴朗黎明时被夺者消散”. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_DarkPresence_GloomCountsAsNight.ch: 惡劣天氣也會召喚它們
Sandbox_DarkPresence_GloomCountsAsNight.cn: 恶劣天气也会召唤它们

Sandbox_DarkPresence_GloomCountsAsNight_.en: On: rain, fog and heavy overcast count as the dark's time, so Taken roam during storms and gloomy days as well as at night - the dark needs the absence of light, not the clock. Off: a strictly nocturnal threat. Clear nights only, and a foggy afternoon stays an ordinary foggy afternoon. Default on.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_GloomCountsAsNight_.ch: 開啟: 下雨, 起霧與濃厚陰天都算作黑暗的時間, 因此被奪者會在暴風雨與陰鬱的白天以及夜晚出沒 - 黑暗需要的是光的缺席, 而不是時鐘. 關閉: 純粹的夜行威脅. 只在晴朗夜晚出現, 起霧的午後就只是普通起霧的午後. 預設為開啟.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_GloomCountsAsNight_.cn: 开启: 下雨, 起雾与浓厚阴天都算作黑暗的时间, 因此被夺者会在暴风雨与阴郁的白天以及夜晚出没 - 黑暗需要的是光的缺席, 而不是时钟. 关闭: 纯粹的夜行威胁. 只在晴朗夜晚出现, 起雾的午后就只是普通起雾的午后. 默认开启.

Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintRate.en: How fast the dark notices you (%)

Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintRate_tooltip.en: Speed of the taint that builds while you linger outdoors near Taken, and drains in shelter. 100 = default (~11 real minutes of lingering to be fully noticed). Raise it to be hunted sooner and far more often - 400 makes the dark find you most nights. Lower it for a rarer, slower dread. Requires 'The dark notices you'.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintRate_tooltip.ch: 你在被奪者附近的戶外逗留時累積, 並在掩蔽處消退的汙染速度. 100 = 預設 (逗留約 11 分鐘現實時間就會被完全注意到). 調高會更早被獵殺, 且頻率大幅增加 - 400 會讓黑暗在大多數夜晚找到你. 調低則恐懼來得更罕見, 更緩慢. 需要啟用「黑暗注意到你」.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_TaintRate_tooltip.cn: 你在被夺者附近的户外逗留时累积, 并在掩蔽处消退的污染速度. 100 = 默认 (逗留约11分钟现实时间就会被完全注意到). 调高会更早被猎杀, 且频率大幅增加 - 400 会让黑暗在大多数夜晚找到你. 调低则恐惧来得更罕见, 更缓慢. 需要开启“黑暗注意到你”.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_AxialFractureEnab.en: Chest and head fractures need rest
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_AxialFractureEnab.ch: 胸部與頭部骨折需要休息
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_AxialFractureEnab.cn: 胸部与头部骨折需要休息

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_AxialFractureEnab.en: Ribs, a skull, a pelvis - the fractures a splint cannot reach. On: sitting down mends them measurably faster, running on them hurts, sets the bone back and drains you; painkillers dull it. Off: they heal on vanilla's flat timer, untouched by anything you do.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_AxialFractureEnab.ch: 肋骨, 頭骨, 骨盆 - 夾板固定不了的骨折. 開啟: 坐下休息能明顯加快癒合, 帶傷奔跑會疼痛, 使骨頭癒合倒退並耗盡你的體力; 止痛藥可減輕疼痛. 關閉: 依原版的固定計時癒合, 不受你任何行為影響.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_AxialFractureEnab.cn: 肋骨, 颅骨, 骨盆 - 夹板固定不了的骨折. 开启: 坐下休息能明显加快愈合, 带伤奔跑会疼痛, 使骨头愈合倒退并耗尽你的体力; 止痛药可减轻疼痛. 关闭: 按原版的固定计时愈合, 不受你任何行为影响.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodWarmHours.ch: 血液在冰箱外的保存時間 (小時):
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodWarmHours.cn: 血液在冰箱外的保存时间 (小时):

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodWarmHours_to.en:
How many in-game hours drawn blood stays usable while warm. Real blood banks allow 4; the default is 8 so a trip home is possible.
A powered fridge stops the clock, a cooler slows it six times, winter air at 6 C or below keeps blood that is not being carried on a body.
A freezer ruins whole blood.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodWarmHours_to.ch:
抽出的血液在未冷藏時可使用的遊戲小時數. 現實中的血庫允許 4 小時; 預設為 8, 讓你來得及帶回家.
通電的冰箱會停止計時, 保溫箱會使其減慢六倍, 6 C 以下的冬季空氣也能保存未隨身攜帶的血液.
冷凍庫會毀掉全血.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_BloodWarmHours_to.cn:
抽出的血液在未冷藏时可使用的游戏小时数. 现实中的血库允许 4 小时; 默认为 8, 让你来得及带回家.
通电的冰箱会停止计时, 冷藏箱会使其减慢六倍, 6 C 以下的冬季空气也能保存未随身携带的血液.
冷冻柜会毁掉全血.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_CoveredWoundsHidd.en:
A bandaged limb shows only the bandage, a broken bone, and whether it hurts. The kind of wound, stitches and infection stay hidden until the dressing comes off.
What was examined before is remembered: removing the bandage shows it without a new examination.
Off: wounds read through the bandage as before.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_CoveredWoundsHidd.ch:
包紮的肢體只會顯示繃帶, 骨折以及是否疼痛. 傷口類型, 縫線和感染在拆下敷料前都會隱藏.
先前檢查過的內容會被記住: 拆下繃帶後無需重新檢查即可顯示.
關閉: 與以往一樣可透過繃帶看到傷口狀態.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_CoveredWoundsHidd.cn:
包扎的肢体只会显示绷带, 骨折以及是否疼痛. 伤口类型, 缝线和感染在拆下敷料前都会隐藏.
之前检查过的内容会被记住: 拆下绷带后无需重新检查即可显示.
关闭: 与以往一样可透过绷带看到伤口状态.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_MedicalItemsEnabl.en:
Turns on the blood part of the mod: drawing blood, transfusion, blood groups, typing and crossmatching - and puts the supplies for it in hospital and clinic loot: blood collection bags (single-use, the only vessel blood goes into), a transfusion set and a blood typing kit.
OFF by default. While off, none of it is offered and none of the items ever spawn - the mod stays pure Lua and can be removed at any time.
Turning it on lets mod items into your save.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_MedicalItemsEnabl.ch:
啟用本模組的血液相關功能: 抽血, 輸血, 血型, 驗血型與交叉配血 - 並在醫院與診所的戰利品中加入相關耗材: 採血袋 (一次性, 血液唯一能裝入的容器), 輸血套組與血型檢驗套組.
預設關閉. 關閉時不會提供任何相關功能, 相關物品也永遠不會生成 - 模組保持純 Lua, 可隨時移除.
啟用後, 模組物品會進入你的存檔.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_MedicalItemsEnabl.cn:
启用本模组的血液相关功能: 抽血, 输血, 血型, 血型鉴定与交叉配血 - 并在医院与诊所的战利品中加入相关耗材: 采血袋 (一次性, 血液唯一能装入的容器), 输血套件与血型检验套件.
默认关闭. 关闭时不会提供任何相关功能, 相关物品也永远不会生成 - 模组保持纯 Lua, 可随时移除.
启用后, 模组物品会进入你的存档.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_MedicalItemsRate_.en:
Multiplies how often blood bags, transfusion sets and typing kits turn up in clinic and medical storage loot. 1.0 is the mod's own rate, 0.5 half as often, 2.0 twice - 0 removes them from loot entirely.
Only matters while the switch above is on.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_MedicalItemsRate_.ch:
調整血袋, 輸血套組與血型檢驗套組在診所與醫療儲藏處戰利品中出現頻率的倍率. 1.0 為模組本身的機率, 0.5 為一半, 2.0 為兩倍 - 0 則完全從戰利品中移除.
僅在上方開關啟用時有效.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_MedicalItemsRate_.cn:
调整血袋, 输血套件与血型检验套件在诊所与医疗储藏处战利品中出现频率的倍率. 1.0 为模组本身的概率, 0.5 为一半, 2.0 为两倍 - 0 则完全从战利品中移除.
仅在上方开关启用时有效.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_PixelArt_tooltip.en:
Draws the wound close-ups - the examination panel and the stitching minigame - in a pixelated style that sits with the game's own look, instead of the drawn originals.
The wounds, the aim marks and everything they do stay exactly the same; only the rendering changes.
Off by default.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_PixelArt_tooltip.ch:
以符合遊戲本身風格的像素風格繪製傷口特寫 - 檢查面板與縫合小遊戲 - 取代原本的手繪圖.
傷口, 瞄準標記及其所有效果完全不變; 只改變繪製方式.
預設關閉.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_PixelArt_tooltip.cn:
以符合游戏本身风格的像素风格绘制伤口特写 - 检查面板与缝合小游戏 - 取代原本的手绘图.
伤口, 瞄准标记及其所有效果完全不变; 只改变绘制方式.
默认关闭.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_WalkingExamSkill.en: First Aid needed to examine while walking:
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_WalkingExamSkill.ch: 行走時檢查所需的急救等級:
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_WalkingExamSkill.cn: 行走时检查所需的急救等级:

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_WalkingExamSkill_.en:
Below this First Aid level an examination roots the character in place. 0 allows walking from the start, 10 never.
Legs, feet and groin always require standing still - that is anatomy, not skill.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_WalkingExamSkill_.ch:
急救等級低於此值時, 檢查期間角色必須站在原地. 0 為一開始就能邊走邊檢查, 10 為永遠不行.
腿部, 腳部與鼠蹊部一律需要站著不動 - 這是解剖構造的問題, 與技能無關.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_WalkingExamSkill_.cn:
急救等级低于此值时, 检查期间角色必须站在原地. 0 为一开始就能边走边检查, 10 为永远不行.
腿部, 脚部与腹股沟一律需要站着不动 - 这是解剖结构的问题, 与技能无关.

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_XpRate.en: First Aid experience from this mod:
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_XpRate.ch: 本模組提供的急救經驗:
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_XpRate.cn: 本模组提供的急救经验:

Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_XpRate_tooltip.en:
Multiplies the experience the mod's OWN work pays: examining a limb, trimming a laceration, drawing blood, crossmatching, running a transfusion. 1.0 is the mod's own rate, 0 pays nothing for them.
Stitching and bandaging are the game's own awards and are left alone - move those with the world's XP multiplier.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_XpRate_tooltip.ch:
調整本模組「自身」操作所給予經驗的倍率: 檢查肢體, 修剪撕裂傷, 抽血, 交叉配血, 進行輸血. 1.0 為模組本身的數值, 0 則這些操作不給經驗.
縫合與包紮屬於遊戲本身的經驗獎勵, 不受影響 - 請用世界的經驗倍率調整.
Sandbox_WoundsOverhaul_XpRate_tooltip.cn:
调整本模组“自身”操作所给予经验的倍率: 检查肢体, 修剪撕裂伤, 抽血, 交叉配血, 进行输血. 1.0 为模组本身的数值, 0 则这些操作不给经验.
缝合与包扎属于游戏本身的经验奖励, 不受影响 - 请用世界的经验倍率调整.

Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_RestAtEnduranceLeve.ch: 耐力狀態達到此等級時休息
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_RestAtEnduranceLeve.cn: 耐力状态达到此等级时休息

Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_RestAtEnduranceLeve.en: During Work Orders labor, auto-rest until endurance is full once the endurance moodle reaches this level (1-4). 0 = never rest.
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_RestAtEnduranceLeve.ch: 執行工作指令勞動時, 一旦耐力狀態達到此等級 (1-4), 便自動休息直到耐力全滿. 0 = 永不休息.
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_RestAtEnduranceLeve.cn: 执行工作指令劳动时, 一旦耐力状态达到此等级 (1-4), 便自动休息直到耐力全满. 0 = 永不休息.

Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_WorkEnduranceReduct.ch: 工作耐力消耗減免 (百分比)
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_WorkEnduranceReduct.cn: 工作耐力消耗减免 (百分比)

Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_WorkEnduranceReduct.en: Give back this percent of endurance that Work Orders labor costs. 0 = vanilla, 100 = no endurance loss from Work Orders.
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_WorkEnduranceReduct.ch: 返還工作指令勞動所消耗耐力的此百分比. 0 = 原版, 100 = 工作指令不消耗耐力.
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_WorkEnduranceReduct.cn: 返还工作指令劳动所消耗耐力的此百分比. 0 = 原版, 100 = 工作指令不消耗耐力.

Sandbox_BodkinArrowMFDRecovery.ch: 錐形箭矢 (量產) 回收
Sandbox_BodkinArrowMFDRecovery.cn: 锥形箭矢 (量产) 回收

Sandbox_BodkinArrowMFDRecovery_tooltip.en: Percent chance a Bodkin (MFD) Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_BodkinArrowMFDRecovery_tooltip.ch: 錐形箭矢 (量產) 命中殭屍後仍能倖存並卡在屍體內的百分比機率, 可透過搜刮屍體將其回收.
Sandbox_BodkinArrowMFDRecovery_tooltip.cn: 锥形箭矢 (量产) 命中僵尸后仍能幸存并卡在尸体内的百分比概率, 可通过搜刮尸体将其回收.

Sandbox_BodkinArrowRecovery_tooltip.en: Percent chance a Bodkin Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_BodkinArrowRecovery_tooltip.ch: 錐形箭矢命中殭屍後仍能倖存並卡在屍體內的百分比機率, 可透過搜刮屍體將其回收.
Sandbox_BodkinArrowRecovery_tooltip.cn: 锥形箭矢命中僵尸后仍能幸存并卡在尸体内的百分比概率, 可通过搜刮尸体将其回收.

Sandbox_BroadheadArrowMFDRecovery.ch: 寬刃箭矢 (量產) 回收
Sandbox_BroadheadArrowMFDRecovery.cn: 宽刃箭矢 (量产) 回收

Sandbox_BroadheadArrowMFDRecovery_toolti.en: Percent chance a Broadhead (MFD) Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_BroadheadArrowMFDRecovery_toolti.ch: 寬刃箭矢 (量產) 命中殭屍後仍能倖存並卡在屍體內的百分比機率, 可透過搜刮屍體將其回收.
Sandbox_BroadheadArrowMFDRecovery_toolti.cn: 宽刃箭矢 (量产) 命中僵尸后仍能幸存并卡在尸体内的百分比概率, 可通过搜刮尸体将其回收.

Sandbox_BroadheadArrowRecovery_tooltip.en: Percent chance a Broadhead Arrow survives hitting a zombie and lodges in the body, to be recovered by looting the corpse.
Sandbox_BroadheadArrowRecovery_tooltip.ch: 寬刃箭矢命中殭屍後仍能倖存並卡在屍體內的百分比機率, 可透過搜刮屍體將其回收.
Sandbox_BroadheadArrowRecovery_tooltip.cn: 宽刃箭矢命中僵尸后仍能幸存并卡在尸体内的百分比概率, 可通过搜刮尸体将其回收.

Sandbox_Fletching_tooltip.en: Multiplies the XP gained in the Fletching skill from cutting fletching, carving shafts, binding them and fitting a head.
Sandbox_Fletching_tooltip.ch: 將裁製箭羽、削製箭桿、綁合兩者以及安裝箭頭所獲得的製箭技能經驗值乘以該倍率.
Sandbox_Fletching_tooltip.cn: 将裁制箭羽、削制箭杆、绑合两者以及安装箭头所获得的制箭技能经验值乘以该倍率.

Sandbox_LootArrows_tooltip.en: Scales how often loose Carbon Hunting Arrows and their packs and crates spawn, on top of the Overall RadArchery Loot slider above.
Sandbox_LootArrows_tooltip.ch: 在上方「RadArchery 整體戰利品」滑桿的基礎上, 調整散裝碳素箭矢及其整包、整箱的生成頻率.
Sandbox_LootArrows_tooltip.cn: 在上方“RadArchery 整体战利品”滑块的基础上, 调整散装碳素箭矢及其整包、整箱的生成频率.

Sandbox_LootBooks.ch: 射箭與製箭技能書戰利品
Sandbox_LootBooks.cn: 射箭与制箭技能书战利品

Sandbox_LootBooks_tooltip.en: Scales how often the Archery and Fletching skill books spawn, on top of the Overall RadArchery Loot slider above.
Sandbox_LootBooks_tooltip.ch: 在上方「RadArchery 整體戰利品」滑桿的基礎上, 調整射箭與製箭技能書的生成頻率.
Sandbox_LootBooks_tooltip.cn: 在上方“RadArchery 整体战利品”滑块的基础上, 调整射箭与制箭技能书的生成频率.

Sandbox_LootBows_tooltip.en: Scales how often compound bows spawn in containers, vehicles and zombie outfits, on top of the Overall RadArchery Loot slider above. The craft-only carved bows are unaffected -- they never spawn as loot.
Sandbox_LootBows_tooltip.ch: 在上方「RadArchery 整體戰利品」滑桿的基礎上, 調整複合弓在容器、車輛和殭屍服裝中的生成頻率. 只能製作的雕製弓不受影響 -- 它們永遠不會作為戰利品生成.
Sandbox_LootBows_tooltip.cn: 在上方“RadArchery 整体战利品”滑块的基础上, 调整复合弓在容器、车辆和僵尸服装中的生成频率. 只能制作的雕制弓不受影响 -- 它们永远不会作为战利品生成.

Sandbox_LootGeneral_tooltip.en: Scales the spawn chance of every RadArchery item together -- bows, arrows, the Leather Quiver and Archery skill books -- on top of each category's own slider below. Set to 0 to remove all RadArchery loot.
Sandbox_LootGeneral_tooltip.ch: 同時調整所有 RadArchery 物品的生成機率 -- 弓、箭矢、皮革箭袋和射箭技能書 -- 並疊加在下方各類別自己的滑桿之上. 設為 0 可移除所有 RadArchery 戰利品.
Sandbox_LootGeneral_tooltip.cn: 同时调整所有 RadArchery 物品的生成概率 -- 弓、箭矢、皮革箭袋和射箭技能书 -- 并叠加在下方各类别自己的滑块之上. 设为 0 可移除所有 RadArchery 战利品.

Sandbox_LootQuiver_tooltip.en: Scales how often the Leather Quiver spawns, on top of the Overall RadArchery Loot slider above. The quiver is also craftable regardless of this setting.
Sandbox_LootQuiver_tooltip.ch: 在上方「RadArchery 整體戰利品」滑桿的基礎上, 調整皮革箭袋的生成頻率. 無論此設定為何, 箭袋都可以製作.
Sandbox_LootQuiver_tooltip.cn: 在上方“RadArchery 整体战利品”滑块的基础上, 调整皮革箭袋的生成频率. 无论此设置如何, 箭袋都可以制作.

Sandbox_TargetArrowRecovery_tooltip.en: Percent chance an arrow shot into an Archery Target survives and stays stuck in it, to be pulled back out. The same for every arrow type.
Sandbox_TargetArrowRecovery_tooltip.ch: 射入箭靶的箭矢保持完好並插在靶上、可再拔出回收的百分比機率. 所有箭矢類型皆相同.
Sandbox_TargetArrowRecovery_tooltip.cn: 射入箭靶的箭矢保持完好并插在靶上、可再拔出回收的百分比概率. 所有箭矢类型均相同.

Sandbox_TargetXpCapLevel_tooltip.en: Archery level at which shooting an Archery Target stops awarding Archery XP. Zombie hits are unaffected. Set to 0 for no cap.
Sandbox_TargetXpCapLevel_tooltip.ch: 射擊箭靶不再提供射箭經驗的射箭等級. 命中殭屍不受影響. 設為 0 表示無上限.
Sandbox_TargetXpCapLevel_tooltip.cn: 射击箭靶不再提供射箭经验的射箭等级. 命中僵尸不受影响. 设为 0 表示无上限.

Sandbox_InventoryTetris_StackSizeMultipl.en: Multiplies Inventory Tetris stack limits globally. Enter a value from 0.01 to 100.0. Default is 1.0. Items that do not stack remain non-stackable.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_StackSizeMultipl.ch: 全域調整幾何物品欄的堆疊上限. 輸入 0.01 到 100.0 之間的數值. 預設為 1.0. 無法堆疊的物品仍維持不可堆疊.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_StackSizeMultipl.cn: 全局调整几何物品栏的堆叠上限. 输入 0.01 到 100.0 之间的数值. 默认为 1.0. 无法堆叠的物品仍保持不可堆叠.

Sandbox_SkillJournalRecoverFishRecords_t.en: The fish log you open by right-clicking water only lists species you have caught yourself, and death empties it. The journal writes down which species were logged and fills them back in. It hands back the record, never the fish: what the log shows about each species still depends on your Fishing level.
Sandbox_SkillJournalRecoverFishRecords_t.ch: 右鍵點選水面開啟的漁獲紀錄只會列出你親手釣到的魚種, 且死亡後會被清空. 本日記本會記下已記錄的魚種, 並將其補回. 它歸還的是紀錄, 而不是魚: 漁獲紀錄中每個魚種所顯示的資訊仍取決於你的釣魚等級.
Sandbox_SkillJournalRecoverFishRecords_t.cn: 右键点击水面打开的渔获记录只会列出你亲手钓到的鱼种, 且死亡后会被清空. 本日志会记下已登记的鱼种, 并将其补回. 它归还的是记录, 而不是鱼: 渔获记录中每个鱼种所显示的信息仍取决于你的钓鱼等级.

Sandbox_SkillJournalRecoverWeight_toolti.en: The journal records what the author weighed and sets the reader to that figure. Unlike everything else in the journal this is not a floor -- weight is a state rather than progress, so a reader heavier than the page says comes down to it just as a lighter one goes up. Held inside the range the game itself allows, 30 to 130.
Sandbox_SkillJournalRecoverWeight_toolti.ch: 日記本會記錄作者當時的體重, 並將讀者的體重設為該數值. 與日記本中其他內容不同, 這不是下限 -- 體重是一種狀態而非進度, 因此比紀錄更重的讀者會降到該數值, 就像較輕的讀者會升上去一樣. 數值限制在遊戲本身允許的範圍內, 即 30 到 130.
Sandbox_SkillJournalRecoverWeight_toolti.cn: 日志会记录作者当时的体重, 并将读者的体重设为该数值. 与日志中其他内容不同, 这不是下限 -- 体重是一种状态而非进度, 因此比记录更重的读者会降到该数值, 就像较轻的读者会升上去一样. 数值限制在游戏本身允许的范围内, 即 30 到 130.

Sandbox_J93ClassicTV.ch: True Cable TV - 世界整合
Sandbox_J93ClassicTV.cn: True Cable TV - 世界整合

Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturalTuneChance.ch: 自然調至 True Cable 頻道的機率
Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturalTuneChance.cn: 自然调至 True Cable 频道的概率

Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturalTuneChance_t.en: Percentage chance that each newly discovered natural television is tuned to one of the currently enabled True Cable TV channels. The roll is persistent per television and does not power the TV on.
Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturalTuneChance_t.ch: 每台新發現的自然生成電視被調至目前已啟用的某個 True Cable TV 頻道的百分比機率. 每台電視的判定結果固定不變, 且不會開啟電視電源.
Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturalTuneChance_t.cn: 每台新发现的自然生成电视被调至当前已启用的某个 True Cable TV 频道的百分比概率. 每台电视的判定结果固定不变, 且不会打开电视电源.

Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturallyTunedTVs_t.en: Allows naturally spawned televisions discovered while exploring to have a one-time chance of already being tuned to an enabled True Cable TV channel. Player-placed televisions are ignored.
Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturallyTunedTVs_t.ch: 允許探索時發現的自然生成電視有一次機會已預先調至某個已啟用的 True Cable TV 頻道. 玩家放置的電視不受影響.
Sandbox_J93ClassicTV_NaturallyTunedTVs_t.cn: 允许探索时发现的自然生成电视有一次机会已预先调至某个已启用的 True Cable TV 频道. 玩家放置的电视不受影响.

Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapBandits_toolti.en: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapBandits_toolti.ch: -1 由各玩家自行決定, 0 強制所有人關閉, 1 強制開啟. 預設為 -1, 不做任何變更.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapBandits_toolti.cn: -1 由各玩家自行决定, 0 强制所有人关闭, 1 强制开启. 默认为 -1, 不做任何更改.

Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapCompanions_too.en: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapCompanions_too.ch: -1 由各玩家自行決定, 0 強制所有人關閉, 1 強制開啟. 預設為 -1, 不做任何變更.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapCompanions_too.cn: -1 由各玩家自行决定, 0 强制所有人关闭, 1 强制开启. 默认为 -1, 不做任何更改.

Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapSymbols.ch: 將匪徒登記為地圖符號
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapSymbols.cn: 将匪徒注册为地图符号

Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapSymbols_toolti.en: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapSymbols_toolti.ch: -1 由各玩家自行決定, 0 強制所有人關閉, 1 強制開啟. 預設為 -1, 不做任何變更.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MapSymbols_toolti.cn: -1 由各玩家自行决定, 0 强制所有人关闭, 1 强制开启. 默认为 -1, 不做任何更改.

Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MinimapBandits_to.en: -1 leaves it to each player, 0 forces it off for everyone, 1 forces it on. Default is -1, which changes nothing.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MinimapBandits_to.ch: -1 由各玩家自行決定, 0 強制所有人關閉, 1 強制開啟. 預設為 -1, 不做任何變更.
Sandbox_BanditsFixPlus_MinimapBandits_to.cn: -1 由各玩家自行决定, 0 强制所有人关闭, 1 强制开启. 默认为 -1, 不做任何更改.

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndHour.ch: 固定時鐘: 結束小時 (0-23)
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndHour.cn: 固定时钟: 结束小时 (0-23)

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndHour_t.en: Only used in Fixed clock mode. The morning ramp finishes at this time. Default end: 06:00. <LINE> 22:00 to 06:00 crosses midnight automatically. Identical start and end times disable the scheduled night rather than making it last 24 hours.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndHour_t.ch: 僅用於固定時鐘模式. 早晨過渡在此時間結束. 預設結束時間: 06:00. <LINE> 22:00 至 06:00 會自動跨越午夜. 開始與結束時間相同時, 會停用排程夜晚, 而不是讓夜晚持續 24 小時.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndHour_t.cn: 仅用于固定时钟模式. 早晨过渡在此时间结束. 默认结束时间: 06:00. <LINE> 22:00 至 06:00 会自动跨越午夜. 开始与结束时间相同时, 会禁用计划夜晚, 而不是让夜晚持续 24 小时.

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndMinute.ch: 固定時鐘: 結束分鐘 (0-59)
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndMinute.cn: 固定时钟: 结束分钟 (0-59)

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndMinute.en: Only used in Fixed clock mode. For 06:30 choose end hour 6 and end minute 30. <LINE> Default: 0.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndMinute.ch: 僅用於固定時鐘模式. 若要設為 06:30, 請將結束小時設為 6, 結束分鐘設為 30. <LINE> 預設: 0.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedEndMinute.cn: 仅用于固定时钟模式. 若要设为 06:30, 请将结束小时设为 6, 结束分钟设为 30. <LINE> 默认: 0.

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartHour.ch: 固定時鐘: 開始小時 (0-23)
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartHour.cn: 固定时钟: 开始小时 (0-23)

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartHour.en: Only used in Fixed clock mode. Start of the nighttime ramp, using the 24-hour game clock. <LINE> Default start: 22:00 (hour 22, minute 0). Seasonal offsets are ignored in this mode.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartHour.ch: 僅用於固定時鐘模式. 夜間過渡的開始時間, 採用 24 小時制遊戲時鐘. <LINE> 預設開始時間: 22:00 (22 時 0 分). 此模式下會忽略季節偏移量.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartHour.cn: 仅用于固定时钟模式. 夜间过渡的开始时间, 采用 24 小时制游戏时钟. <LINE> 默认开始时间: 22:00 (22 时 0 分). 此模式下会忽略季节偏移量.

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartMinu.ch: 固定時鐘: 開始分鐘 (0-59)
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartMinu.cn: 固定时钟: 开始分钟 (0-59)

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartMinu.en: Only used in Fixed clock mode. For 22:30 choose start hour 22 and start minute 30. <LINE> Default: 0.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartMinu.ch: 僅用於固定時鐘模式. 若要設為 22:30, 請將開始小時設為 22, 開始分鐘設為 30. <LINE> 預設: 0.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_fixedStartMinu.cn: 仅用于固定时钟模式. 若要设为 22:30, 请将开始小时设为 22, 开始分钟设为 30. <LINE> 默认: 0.

Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_timingMode_too.en: Seasonal follows the changing seasonal night, with optional offsets. Fixed clock uses the start and end hour/minute below every day. <LINE> Default: Seasonal (existing saves keep their current schedule). <LINE> Both use the same transition, percentage and speed settings. Sun Is Gone permanent darkness overrides either mode only when both mods are enabled. Vanilla Endless Day/Night and Rain Sprinters keep their overrides.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_timingMode_too.ch: 季節模式會跟隨隨季節變化的夜晚, 並可設定偏移量. 固定時鐘模式則每天使用下方設定的開始與結束時/分. <LINE> 預設: 季節 (既有存檔會保留目前的排程). <LINE> 兩種模式都使用相同的過渡, 比例與速度設定. 只有在兩個模組都啟用時, Sun Is Gone 的永久黑暗才會覆蓋任一模式. 原版的無盡白晝/黑夜與雨天跑屍仍保有各自的覆蓋效果.
Sandbox_NightSprintersDyn_timingMode_too.cn: 季节模式会跟随随季节变化的夜晚, 并可设置偏移量. 固定时钟模式则每天使用下方设置的开始与结束时/分. <LINE> 默认: 季节 (已有存档会保留当前的计划). <LINE> 两种模式都使用相同的过渡, 比例和速度设置. 只有在两个模组都启用时, Sun Is Gone 的永久黑暗才会覆盖任一模式. 原版的无尽白昼/黑夜和雨天跑尸仍保留各自的覆盖效果.

so it can work on its own.

rounds when it is on. This switch

Sandbox_AmmoLootDropGunsOfMarzB42Magazin.en: Zombies Drop Guns of Marz Magazines
Sandbox_AmmoLootDropGunsOfMarzB42Magazin.ch: 殭屍掉落 Guns of Marz 彈匣
Sandbox_AmmoLootDropGunsOfMarzB42Magazin.cn: 僵尸掉落 Guns of Marz 弹匣

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazineDropRate.en: Guns of Marz Magazine Drop Rate
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazineDropRate.ch: Guns of Marz 彈匣掉落率
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazineDropRate.cn: Guns of Marz 弹匣掉落率

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazineDropRate_toolt.en:
<RGB:1,1,1>The chance that a zombie you kill is
carrying a magazine.

This is the total chance, not the
chance for each magazine. All the
magazines you turn on share it.
Turning a caliber off changes which
magazine you get, not how often you
get one.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>Most zombies are checked twice. At
0.5 you get a magazine from about 1
body in 100. The 35 magazines share
that chance.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>The 6 base game magazines are in
that count. This pack drops them so
it can work on its own. If Ammo Loot
Drop Magazine is also on, that mod
drops them instead, and only the 29
this pack adds share the chance
here.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>A loaded magazine is ammunition you
can fire straight away. It is worth
more than the same rounds found
loose. Raise this slowly.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 to stop the drop.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazineDropRate_toolt.ch:
<RGB:1,1,1>你擊殺的殭屍身上帶有彈匣的
機率.

這是總機率, 而非每種彈匣各自的
機率. 所有已開啟的彈匣共用
這個機率. 關閉某種口徑
只會改變你拿到哪種彈匣,
而不會改變你拿到
彈匣的頻率.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>大多數殭屍會被判定兩次. 設為
0.5 時, 大約每 100 具屍體
會掉落 1 個彈匣. 35 種彈匣共用
這個機率.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>其中包含 6 種本體遊戲的彈匣.
本包會自行掉落它們, 因此可以
獨立運作. 若同時啟用 Ammo Loot
Drop Magazine, 則改由該模組
掉落它們, 這裡只剩本包新增的
29 種彈匣共用
此機率.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>已裝彈的彈匣就是能立刻
射擊的彈藥. 它比同樣數量的
散裝子彈更有價值.
請慢慢調高.

<RGB:1,1,1>設為 0 即停止掉落.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazineDropRate_toolt.cn:
<RGB:1,1,1>你击杀的僵尸身上带有弹匣的
概率.

这是总概率, 而非每种弹匣各自的
概率. 所有已开启的弹匣共用
这个概率. 关闭某种口径
只会改变你拿到哪种弹匣,
而不会改变你拿到
弹匣的频率.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>大多数僵尸会被判定两次. 设为
0.5 时, 大约每 100 具尸体
会掉落 1 个弹匣. 35 种弹匣共用
这个概率.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>其中包含 6 种本体游戏的弹匣.
本包会自行掉落它们, 因此可以
独立运作. 若同时启用 Ammo Loot
Drop Magazine, 则改由该模组
掉落它们, 这里只剩本包新增的
29 种弹匣共用
此概率.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>已装弹的弹匣就是能立刻
射击的弹药. 它比同样数量的
散装子弹更有价值.
请慢慢调高.

<RGB:1,1,1>设为 0 即停止掉落.

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_ArmedZombiesO.ch: 只有武裝殭屍會掉落彈匣
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_ArmedZombiesO.cn: 只有武装僵尸会掉落弹匣

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_ArmedZombiesO.en:
<RGB:1,1,1>OFF: any zombie can drop a magazine,
even office workers and nurses.

ON: only zombies who look like they
carried a gun drop one, and only the
kind that suits them:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>All types - soldiers, militia (4)
Pistols, shotguns, rifles - hunters,
rangers, campers, rednecks,
survivalists, raiders (20)
Pistols, shotguns - police, guards,
bandits, bikers (10)
Shotguns, rifles - farmers,
fishermen (2)
Pistols only - detectives, agents,
truckers, mobsters (5)

<RGB:1,1,1>That is 41 of the 125 zombie outfits
in the game. Every other zombie
drops nothing. In a normal town,
only about 1 zombie in 100 wears one
of these outfits.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>Magazines for belt fed and launcher
guns drop from soldiers only. Nobody
else in Kentucky carried them.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>So search where these people worked:
police stations, army bases,
prisons, farms and bars.

<RGB:1,1,1>A higher drop rate helps a little,
but you will still find very little
in the suburbs.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_ArmedZombiesO.ch:
<RGB:1,1,1>關閉: 任何殭屍都可能掉落彈匣,
即使是上班族和護理師.

開啟: 只有看起來帶過槍的殭屍
才會掉落, 而且只會掉落適合
其身分的類型:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>所有類型 - 士兵, 民兵 (4)
手槍, 散彈槍, 步槍 - 獵人,
護林員, 露營者, 鄉巴佬,
生存主義者, 掠奪者 (20)
手槍, 散彈槍 - 警察, 警衛,
匪徒, 機車騎士 (10)
散彈槍, 步槍 - 農夫,
漁夫 (2)
僅手槍 - 警探, 特務,
卡車司機, 黑幫份子 (5)

<RGB:1,1,1>遊戲中 125 種殭屍服裝裡共有 41 種
符合條件. 其他殭屍什麼都
不會掉落. 在一般城鎮中, 大約
每 100 隻殭屍只有 1 隻穿著
這些服裝.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>彈鏈供彈槍械與榴彈發射器的彈匣
只會從士兵身上掉落. 在肯塔基州
沒有其他人攜帶它們.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>所以請到這些人工作的地方搜尋:
警察局, 軍事基地,
監獄, 農場和酒吧.

<RGB:1,1,1>提高掉落率會有一點幫助,
但在郊區你仍然只能找到
極少的東西.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_ArmedZombiesO.cn:
<RGB:1,1,1>关闭: 任何僵尸都可能掉落弹匣,
即使是上班族和护士.

开启: 只有看起来带过枪的僵尸
才会掉落, 而且只会掉落适合
其身份的类型:

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>所有类型 - 士兵, 民兵 (4)
手枪, 霰弹枪, 步枪 - 猎人,
护林员, 露营者, 乡巴佬,
生存主义者, 掠夺者 (20)
手枪, 霰弹枪 - 警察, 警卫,
匪徒, 摩托车手 (10)
霰弹枪, 步枪 - 农民,
渔夫 (2)
仅手枪 - 警探, 特工,
卡车司机, 黑帮分子 (5)

<RGB:1,1,1>游戏中 125 种僵尸服装里共有 41 种
符合条件. 其他僵尸什么都
不会掉落. 在普通城镇中, 大约
每 100 只僵尸只有 1 只穿着
这些服装.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>弹链供弹枪械与榴弹发射器的弹匣
只会从士兵身上掉落. 在肯塔基州
没有其他人携带它们.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>所以请到这些人工作的地方搜寻:
警察局, 军事基地,
监狱, 农场和酒吧.

<RGB:1,1,1>提高掉落率会有一点帮助,
但在郊区你仍然只能找到
极少的东西.

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_MagazineLoade.en:
<RGB:1,1,1>How much ammunition is waiting in a
magazine that drops.

It is a percent of what the magazine
holds, and the amount is rolled each
time, so you get between one round
and this much.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>At 50 a 30 round magazine arrives
holding 1 to 15 rounds.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>The game leaves a looted magazine
empty. This setting is the only
thing that puts rounds in one.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>A loaded magazine saves you a
reload. Set it low if you want the
magazine to be the prize and the
rounds to stay hard to find.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 for empty magazines.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzMagazine_MagazineLoade.ch:
<RGB:1,1,1>掉落的彈匣裡會裝有多少
彈藥.

這是彈匣容量的百分比, 而且每次
都會隨機決定數量, 因此你會得到
1 發到此數量之間的
子彈.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>設為 50 時, 30 發彈匣掉落時會
裝有 1 至 15 發子彈.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>遊戲中搜刮到的彈匣原本是空的.
此設定是唯一會讓彈匣
裝有子彈的方式.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>已裝彈的彈匣可以省下一次
裝填. 如果你希望彈匣本身才是

Sandbox_GunsOfMarzWeapon_MagazineLoaded_.en:
<RGB:1,1,1>How much ammunition is waiting in
a magazine that drops.

It is a percent of what the
magazine holds, and the amount is
rolled each time, so you get
between one round and this much.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>At 50 a 30 round magazine arrives
holding 1 to 15 rounds.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>The game leaves a looted magazine
empty. This setting is the only
thing that puts rounds in one.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>A loaded magazine is ammunition
you can fire straight away. It is
worth more than the same rounds
loose.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 for empty magazines,
which is how they dropped before.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzWeapon_MagazineLoaded_.ch:
<RGB:1,1,1>掉落的彈匣中
預先裝填多少彈藥.

數值為彈匣容量的百分比,
每次掉落時隨機決定數量,
因此會得到
1 發到此上限之間的彈藥.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>設為 50 時, 30 發彈匣
掉落時會裝有 1 到 15 發.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>遊戲本身搜刮到的彈匣
都是空的. 只有此設定
會在彈匣中放入子彈.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>已裝填的彈匣是
可以立即射擊的彈藥.
比同樣數量的散裝子彈
更有價值.

<RGB:1,1,1>設為 0 則掉落空彈匣,
與先前的掉落方式相同.
Sandbox_GunsOfMarzWeapon_MagazineLoaded_.cn:
<RGB:1,1,1>掉落的弹匣中
预先装填多少弹药.

数值为弹匣容量的百分比,
每次掉落时随机决定数量,
因此会得到
1 发到此上限之间的弹药.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>设为 50 时, 30 发弹匣
掉落时会装有 1 到 15 发.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>游戏本身搜刮到的弹匣
都是空的. 只有此设置
会在弹匣中放入子弹.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>已装填的弹匣是
可以立即射击的弹药.
比同样数量的散装子弹
更有价值.

<RGB:1,1,1>设为 0 则掉落空弹匣,
与之前的掉落方式相同.

Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FluidPatch.ch: 修復流出飲料的水龍頭
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FluidPatch.cn: 修复流出饮料的水龙头

Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FluidPatch_to.en: Fixes a base game bug that empties your barrels without filling anything. It only hits drinks like cola, juice and vodka. Water, beer and whiskey were never affected.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FluidPatch_to.ch: 修正原版遊戲的一個錯誤: 水桶會被清空卻沒有裝入任何東西. 此問題只影響可樂, 果汁, 伏特加之類的飲料. 水, 啤酒與威士忌從未受影響.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FluidPatch_to.cn: 修复原版游戏的一个漏洞: 水桶会被清空却没有装入任何东西. 此问题只影响可乐, 果汁, 伏特加之类的饮料. 水, 啤酒和威士忌从未受影响.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_GeneratorR.en: How many tiles a running generator powers around itself, and how far away a building can be to wire it up. Used when the mod sets generator range.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_GeneratorR.ch: 運轉中的發電機為周圍多少格供電, 以及建築最遠可距離多遠仍能接線. 在「由模組設定發電機範圍」開啟時使用.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_GeneratorR.cn: 运行中的发电机为周围多少格供电, 以及建筑最远可距离多远仍能接线. 在“由模组设置发电机范围”开启时使用.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_GeneratorV.en: How many levels above and below a running generator it powers. Wired buildings always get every level. Used when the mod sets generator vertical range.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_GeneratorV.ch: 運轉中的發電機為上下各多少層樓供電. 已接線的建築一律所有樓層都有電. 在「由模組設定發電機垂直範圍」開啟時使用.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_GeneratorV.cn: 运行中的发电机为上下各多少层楼供电. 已接线的建筑一律所有楼层都有电. 在“由模组设置发电机垂直范围”开启时使用.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_StreetLigh.en: Watts a wired street light uses
What one street light costs your generator once you wire it up. The game charges nothing for street lights, so this figure is the mod's. Set 0 to make them free.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_StreetLigh.ch: 接線後每盞路燈對發電機造成的耗電. 遊戲本身不對路燈計算耗電, 因此此數值由本模組設定. 設為 0 則免費.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_StreetLigh.cn: 接线后每盏路灯对发电机造成的耗电. 游戏本身不对路灯计算耗电, 因此此数值由本模组设置. 设为 0 则免费.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.ch: 由模組設定發電機範圍
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.cn: 由模组设置发电机范围

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.en: On: generators and wire relays use the two ranges below, and the game's Generator tile range is set to 1. Off: the game's range is used. Needs a restart.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.ch: 開啟: 發電機與電線中繼器使用下方兩項範圍設定, 遊戲本身的「發電機供電範圍」會設為 1. 關閉: 使用遊戲本身的範圍. 需要重新啟動.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.cn: 开启: 发电机与电线中继器使用下方两项范围设置, 游戏本身的“发电机供电范围”会设为 1. 关闭: 使用游戏本身的范围. 需要重新启动.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.ch: 由模組設定發電機垂直範圍
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.cn: 由模组设置发电机垂直范围

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.en: On: generators and wire relays use the two level settings below, and the game's Generator vertical range is set to 1. Only works while Mod sets generator range is on. Off: the game's vertical range is used. Needs a restart.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.ch: 開啟: 發電機與電線中繼器使用下方兩項樓層設定, 遊戲本身的「發電機垂直供電範圍」會設為 1. 僅在「由模組設定發電機範圍」開啟時有效. 關閉: 使用遊戲本身的垂直範圍. 需要重新啟動.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_TakeOverGe.cn: 开启: 发电机与电线中继器使用下方两项楼层设置, 游戏本身的“发电机垂直供电范围”会设为 1. 仅在“由模组设置发电机范围”开启时有效. 关闭: 使用游戏本身的垂直范围. 需要重新启动.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_WireRelayR.en: How many tiles a wire relay powers around itself, and how many electrical wires it costs. Used when the mod sets generator range.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_WireRelayR.ch: 電線中繼器為周圍多少格供電, 以及需要消耗多少條電線. 在「由模組設定發電機範圍」開啟時使用.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_WireRelayR.cn: 电线中继器为周围多少格供电, 以及需要消耗多少根电线. 在“由模组设置发电机范围”开启时使用.

Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_WireRelayV.en: How many levels above and below a wire relay it powers. Used when the mod sets generator vertical range.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_WireRelayV.ch: 電線中繼器為上下各多少層樓供電. 在「由模組設定發電機垂直範圍」開啟時使用.
Sandbox_LGExtendedElectricity_WireRelayV.cn: 电线中继器为上下各多少层楼供电. 在“由模组设置发电机垂直范围”开启时使用.

Sandbox_LGRealisticPowerUsage_Increases.ch: 允許部分電器耗電增加
Sandbox_LGRealisticPowerUsage_Increases.cn: 允许部分电器耗电增加

Sandbox_LGRealisticPowerUsage_Increases_.en: Off: nothing ever uses more power than it did before, only less. On: a few things that really use a lot now cost a lot. A clothes dryer goes to 3000 watts and an oven to 1500.
Sandbox_LGRealisticPowerUsage_Increases_.ch: 關閉: 任何電器的耗電都不會比以前多, 只會更少. 開啟: 少數真正耗電量大的電器現在會消耗大量電力. 乾衣機提高到 3000 瓦, 烤箱提高到 1500 瓦.
Sandbox_LGRealisticPowerUsage_Increases_.cn: 关闭: 任何电器的耗电都不会比以前多, 只会更少. 开启: 少数真正耗电量大的电器现在会消耗大量电力. 干衣机提高到 3000 瓦, 烤箱提高到 1500 瓦.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixGameplay_UseCusto.ch: 使用社群版武器燈光系統
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixGameplay_UseCusto.cn: 使用社区版武器灯光系统

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixGameplay_UseCusto.en: On (default): toggle weapon lights with the light key; charge drains and the community battery actions apply. Off: use MFS aim-only lights and its original battery actions. Restart the world after changing this setting.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixGameplay_UseCusto.ch: 開啟 (預設): 用燈光鍵切換武器燈; 會消耗電量, 並套用社群版的電池操作. 關閉: 使用 MFS 僅在瞄準時亮起的燈光及其原本的電池操作. 變更此設定後請重新啟動世界.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixGameplay_UseCusto.cn: 开启 (默认): 用灯光键切换武器灯; 会消耗电量, 并应用社区版的电池操作. 关闭: 使用 MFS 仅在瞄准时亮起的灯光及其原本的电池操作. 更改此设置后请重新启动世界.

Sandbox_PushVehicle_MaximumPushableWeigh.en: Vehicles heavier than this cannot be pushed. Set to 0 for no weight limit.
Sandbox_PushVehicle_MaximumPushableWeigh.ch: 重量超過此值的載具無法推動. 設為 0 則不限重量.
Sandbox_PushVehicle_MaximumPushableWeigh.cn: 重量超过此值的载具无法推动. 设为 0 则不限重量.

Sandbox_PushVehicle_PushCooldownSeconds_.en: Minimum time in seconds between successful pushes by the same player. 0 disables the cooldown.
Sandbox_PushVehicle_PushCooldownSeconds_.ch: 同一名玩家兩次成功推動之間的最短間隔秒數. 0 停用冷卻.
Sandbox_PushVehicle_PushCooldownSeconds_.cn: 同一名玩家两次成功推动之间的最短间隔秒数. 0 禁用冷却.

Sandbox_PushVehicle_StaminaCostMultiplie.en: Multiplies the stamina consumed by each successful push. 1.0 keeps the original stamina cost; 0 disables stamina cost.
Sandbox_PushVehicle_StaminaCostMultiplie.ch: 每次成功推動所消耗的耐力會乘以此倍率. 1.0 維持原本的耐力消耗; 0 停用耐力消耗.
Sandbox_PushVehicle_StaminaCostMultiplie.cn: 每次成功推动所消耗的耐力会乘以此倍率. 1.0 保持原本的耐力消耗; 0 禁用耐力消耗.

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.ch: 匪徒 - YANMC — 匪徒核心
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.cn: 匪徒 - YANMC — 匪徒核心

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.BanditSpaw.en: Allows ordinary ambient Bandit spawns outside the deterministic urban map classification.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.BanditSpaw.ch: 允許一般的環境匪徒在固定的城區地圖分類範圍以外生成.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.BanditSpaw.cn: 允许普通的环境匪徒在固定的城区地图分类范围以外生成.

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.BanditSpaw.en: Allows ordinary ambient Bandit spawns in the deterministic urban map classification. Yellow map areas are urban; all unmarked areas are rural.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.BanditSpaw.ch: 允許一般的環境匪徒在固定的城區地圖分類範圍內生成. 地圖上的黃色區域為城區; 所有未標示的區域皆為郊區.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.BanditSpaw.cn: 允许普通的环境匪徒在固定的城区地图分类范围内生成. 地图上的黄色区域为城区; 所有未标记的区域均为郊区.

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.DisableAll.en: Hides all Bandits and Week One event markers, including Home and NPC arrivals. Enabled by default, including existing saves. Turn this off to use Event Marker Visibility. Does not affect spawns or events.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.DisableAll.ch: 隱藏所有匪徒與第一週事件標記, 包括住家與 NPC 抵達標記. 預設啟用, 現有存檔也是如此. 若要使用「事件標記可見度」, 請關閉此項. 不影響生成或事件.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.DisableAll.cn: 隐藏所有匪徒与第一周事件标记, 包括住所与 NPC 抵达标记. 默认启用, 现有存档也是如此. 若要使用“事件标记可见度”, 请关闭此项. 不影响生成或事件.

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.en: Hide all Bandits and Week One markers (Default)
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.ch: 隱藏所有匪徒與第一週標記 (預設)
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.cn: 隐藏所有匪徒与第一周标记 (默认)

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.en: Hide Bandit and hostile NPC spawn markers
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.ch: 隱藏匪徒與敵對 NPC 生成標記
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.cn: 隐藏匪徒与敌对 NPC 生成标记

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.en: Applies only when Disable All Markers is off. Choose which Bandits and Week One markers may appear. The Bandits Arrival Icon option must also be enabled. Does not affect event scheduling or NPC spawning.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.ch: 僅在「停用所有標記」關閉時生效. 選擇可以顯示哪些匪徒與第一週標記. 匪徒的「抵達圖示」選項也必須啟用. 不影響事件排程或 NPC 生成.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.MarkerVisi.cn: 仅在“禁用所有标记”关闭时生效. 选择可以显示哪些匪徒与第一周标记. 匪徒的“抵达图标”选项也必须启用. 不影响事件安排或 NPC 生成.

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.ch: 警察與 S.W.A.T. 生成——郊區
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.cn: 警察与 S.W.A.T. 生成——郊区

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.en: Allows ordinary ambient Police, Riot Police, and SWAT spawns outside the deterministic urban map classification.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.ch: 允許一般的環境警察、防暴警察和 S.W.A.T. 在固定的城區地圖分類範圍以外生成.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.cn: 允许普通的环境警察、防暴警察和 S.W.A.T. 在固定的城区地图分类范围以外生成.

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.ch: 警察與 S.W.A.T. 生成——城區
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.cn: 警察与 S.W.A.T. 生成——城区

Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.en: Allows ordinary ambient Police, Riot Police, and SWAT spawns in the deterministic urban map classification.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.ch: 允許一般的環境警察、防暴警察和 S.W.A.T. 在固定的城區地圖分類範圍內生成.
Sandbox_YANMCBanditsCoreFresh.PoliceSpaw.cn: 允许普通的环境警察、防暴警察和 S.W.A.T. 在固定的城区地图分类范围内生成.

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.ch: 匪徒 - YANMC 第一週事件
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.cn: 匪徒 - YANMC 第一周事件

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.BoeingEvent.ch: 波音客機墜毀事件 (以玩家為目標)
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.BoeingEvent.cn: 波音客机坠毁事件 (以玩家为目标)

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.BoeingEvent_t.en: Disabled by default. When enabled, the crash targets an eligible on-foot player in an urban area, but its full crash footprint is locked outside registered bases and PZ safehouses.
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.BoeingEvent_t.ch: 預設停用. 啟用時, 墜機會以位於城區、徒步中的合格玩家為目標, 但完整的墜毀範圍會被鎖定在已登記基地與 PZ 安全屋之外.
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.BoeingEvent_t.cn: 默认禁用. 启用时, 坠机会以位于城区、徒步中的合格玩家为目标, 但完整的坠毁范围会被锁定在已登记基地与 PZ 安全屋之外.

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.EventGuards.en: Keep destructive events away from players
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.EventGuards.ch: 使破壞性事件遠離玩家
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.EventGuards.cn: 使破坏性事件远离玩家

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.GloomyWeather.en: Gloom and Doom - Final Solution Replacer
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.GloomyWeather.ch: 末日陰霾 - 最終解決方案替代
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.GloomyWeather.cn: 末日阴霾 - 最终解决方案替代

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.GloomyWeather.en: Replaces the Week One Nuke Finale with a scripted event, dark and atmospheric, spawns sweeper NPCs will shoot anything still alive.
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.GloomyWeather.ch: 以腳本事件取代第一週的核彈終幕, 氣氛黑暗陰沉, 並會生成清掃 NPC, 射殺任何仍然存活的東西.
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.GloomyWeather.cn: 以脚本事件取代第一周的核弹终幕, 氛围黑暗阴沉, 并会生成清扫 NPC, 射杀任何仍然存活的东西.

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.NativeHelicop.en: Use YANMC's existing helicopter-event rules. With Gloom and Doom enabled, suppress helicopters on days 9–14 and restore the original schedule afterward.
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.NativeHelicop.ch: 使用 YANMC 現有的直升機事件規則. 啟用「末日陰霾」時, 第 9–14 天不會出現直升機, 之後恢復原本的排程.
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.NativeHelicop.cn: 使用 YANMC 现有的直升机事件规则. 启用“末日阴霾”时, 第 9–14 天不会出现直升机, 之后恢复原本的安排.

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.PreGasMaskLoo.en: Add gas masks before gas events
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.PreGasMaskLoo.ch: 毒氣事件前加入防毒面具
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.PreGasMaskLoo.cn: 毒气事件前添加防毒面具

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.ProtectSafeho.ch: 保護玩家住宅與安全屋
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.ProtectSafeho.cn: 保护玩家住宅与安全屋

Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.UrbanOnlyEnco.en: Allow aircraft events only in urban areas
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.UrbanOnlyEnco.ch: 僅允許在城區觸發飛機事件
Sandbox_YANMCWeekOneEvents.UrbanOnlyEnco.cn: 仅允许在城区触发飞机事件

Sandbox_ProjectDirtroadVehicleSamplingMu.en: Multiplies how often vehicles are sampled, from 1.0 to 10.0. Default 1.0 samples every 10 ticks; 2.0 every 5 ticks; 10.0 every tick. Higher values improve fast-moving vehicle tracking at increased processing cost. Does not multiply wear per passage or change creature sampling frequency.
Sandbox_ProjectDirtroadVehicleSamplingMu.ch: 倍增車輛取樣的頻率, 範圍1.0至10.0. 預設1.0為每10刻取樣一次; 2.0為每5刻一次; 10.0為每刻一次. 數值越高, 越能追蹤高速移動的車輛, 但處理成本也會增加. 不會倍增每次經過造成的磨損, 也不會改變生物的取樣頻率.
Sandbox_ProjectDirtroadVehicleSamplingMu.cn: 倍增车辆采样的频率, 范围1.0至10.0. 默认1.0为每10刻采样一次; 2.0为每5刻一次; 10.0为每刻一次. 数值越高, 越能追踪快速移动的车辆, 但处理开销也会增加. 不会倍增每次通过造成的磨损, 也不会改变生物的采样频率.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_BoltSpawnMultiplier_to.en: Multiplies the spawn chances of loose bolts and bolt boxes. 0 disables their distribution spawns, 1 uses the default rates, and 2 doubles them.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_BoltSpawnMultiplier_to.ch: 倍增散裝弩箭與弩箭盒的生成機率. 0會停用其分布生成, 1使用預設機率, 2則加倍.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_BoltSpawnMultiplier_to.cn: 倍增散装弩箭和弩箭盒的生成几率. 0会禁用其分布生成, 1使用默认几率, 2则翻倍.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_CrossbowSpawnMultiplie.en: Multiplies the spawn chances of every lootable crossbow. This is combined with each crossbow's individual multiplier. 0 disables all crossbow distribution spawns, 1 uses the default global rate, and 2 doubles it.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_CrossbowSpawnMultiplie.ch: 所有可搜刮弩的生成機率倍率. 會與各弩的個別倍率相乘. 0 會停用所有弩的分布生成, 1 使用預設的全域機率, 2 則加倍.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_CrossbowSpawnMultiplie.cn: 所有可搜刮弩的生成概率倍率. 会与各弩的单独倍率相乘. 0 会禁用所有弩的分布生成, 1 使用默认的全局概率, 2 则翻倍.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_HandCrossbowSpawnMulti.en: Additional multiplier for the Hand Crossbow. This is multiplied by the All Crossbows setting. For example, a global multiplier of 2 and an individual multiplier of 0.5 produce the original spawn rate.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_HandCrossbowSpawnMulti.ch: 手弩的額外倍率. 會與「所有弩」設定相乘. 例如全域倍率 2 搭配個別倍率 0.5, 即為原本的生成機率.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_HandCrossbowSpawnMulti.cn: 手弩的额外倍率. 会与“所有弩”设置相乘. 例如全局倍率 2 搭配单独倍率 0.5, 即为原始生成概率.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_HazeCompoundSpawnMulti.en: Additional multiplier for the Haze 470 Compound Crossbow. This is multiplied by the All Crossbows setting. For example, a global multiplier of 2 and an individual multiplier of 0.5 produce the original spawn rate.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_HazeCompoundSpawnMulti.ch: Haze 470複合弩的額外倍率. 會與「所有弩」設定相乘. 例如全域倍率 2 搭配個別倍率 0.5, 即為原本的生成機率.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_HazeCompoundSpawnMulti.cn: Haze 470复合弩的额外倍率. 会与“所有弩”设置相乘. 例如全局倍率 2 搭配单独倍率 0.5, 即为原始生成概率.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_MagazineSpawnMultiplie.ch: 末日生存者手冊雜誌生成倍率
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_MagazineSpawnMultiplie.cn: 末日生存者手册杂志生成倍率

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_MagazineSpawnMultiplie.en: Multiplies the spawn chances of the Doomsday Preppers magazines. 0 disables their distribution spawns, 1 uses the default rates, and 2 doubles them.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_MagazineSpawnMultiplie.ch: 「末日生存者手冊」雜誌的生成機率倍率. 0 會停用其分布生成, 1 使用預設機率, 2 則加倍.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_MagazineSpawnMultiplie.cn: “末日生存者手册”杂志的生成概率倍率. 0 会禁用其分布生成, 1 使用默认概率, 2 则翻倍.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_RecurveCrossbowSpawnMu.en: Additional multiplier for the Recurve Crossbow. This is multiplied by the All Crossbows setting. For example, a global multiplier of 2 and an individual multiplier of 0.5 produce the original spawn rate.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_RecurveCrossbowSpawnMu.ch: 反曲弩的額外倍率. 會與「所有弩」設定相乘. 例如全域倍率 2 搭配個別倍率 0.5, 即為原本的生成機率.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_RecurveCrossbowSpawnMu.cn: 反曲弩的额外倍率. 会与“所有弩”设置相乘. 例如全局倍率 2 搭配单独倍率 0.5, 即为原始生成概率.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_ScoutCompoundSpawnMult.en: Additional multiplier for the Scout Compound Crossbow. This is multiplied by the All Crossbows setting. For example, a global multiplier of 2 and an individual multiplier of 0.5 produce the original spawn rate.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_ScoutCompoundSpawnMult.ch: 斥候複合弩的額外倍率. 會與「所有弩」設定相乘. 例如全域倍率 2 搭配個別倍率 0.5, 即為原本的生成機率.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_ScoutCompoundSpawnMult.cn: 斥候复合弩的额外倍率. 会与“所有弩”设置相乘. 例如全局倍率 2 搭配单独倍率 0.5, 即为原始生成概率.

Sandbox_AlicesKCM_SkillBookSpawnMultipli.en: Multiplies the spawn chances of the aiming and reloading skill books added by the mod. 0 disables their distribution spawns, 1 uses the default rates, and 2 doubles them.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_SkillBookSpawnMultipli.ch: 本模組新增的瞄準與裝填技能書的生成機率倍率. 0 會停用其分布生成, 1 使用預設機率, 2 則加倍.
Sandbox_AlicesKCM_SkillBookSpawnMultipli.cn: 本模组添加的瞄准和装填技能书的生成概率倍率. 0 会禁用其分布生成, 1 使用默认概率, 2 则翻倍.

Sandbox_NoStressBuddyIgnoreCraven_toolti.en: An animal born with the craven genetic defect always flees, whatever its stress and familiarity: the game decides before it even reads them. The mod strips that defect from farm animals. The genome is left alone: offspring still inherit it and the genetics screen still shows it. Uncheck to keep your craven animals craven.
Sandbox_NoStressBuddyIgnoreCraven_toolti.ch: 天生帶有怯懦基因缺陷的動物無論壓力與熟悉度如何都會逃跑: 遊戲甚至在讀取這兩項數值之前就已做出決定. 本模組會移除農場動物身上的這個缺陷. 基因組不受影響: 後代仍會遺傳此缺陷, 基因畫面也仍會顯示. 取消勾選則讓怯懦的動物維持怯懦.
Sandbox_NoStressBuddyIgnoreCraven_toolti.cn: 天生带有怯懦基因缺陷的动物无论压力和熟悉度如何都会逃跑: 游戏甚至在读取这两项数值之前就已做出决定. 本模组会移除农场动物身上的这个缺陷. 基因组不受影响: 后代仍会遗传此缺陷, 基因界面也仍会显示. 取消勾选则让怯懦的动物保持怯懦.

Sandbox_NoStressBuddyIgnoreZombies_toolt.en: Farm animals stop bolting when a zombie comes into view. The trade-off: an animal no longer moves away from a zombie that gets inside the pen. Wild animals are left alone.
Sandbox_NoStressBuddyIgnoreZombies_toolt.ch: 農場動物看到殭屍時不再狂奔逃離. 代價是: 若殭屍進入圍欄, 動物也不會再遠離牠. 野生動物不受影響.
Sandbox_NoStressBuddyIgnoreZombies_toolt.cn: 农场动物看到僵尸时不再狂奔逃离. 代价是: 如果僵尸进入围栏, 动物也不会再远离它. 野生动物不受影响.

Sandbox_TAS_AutoRemoveNegativesAtLevel_t.en: This is the INITIAL level required in a trait skill for negative traits to be removed automatically. If the starting level is lower than this number, the player must level up to remove the spectrum's already-surpassed negative traits.
Sandbox_TAS_AutoRemoveNegativesAtLevel_t.ch: 這是特質技能中自動移除負面特質所需的「初始」等級. 若起始等級低於此數值, 玩家必須升級才能移除該譜系中已超越的負面特質.
Sandbox_TAS_AutoRemoveNegativesAtLevel_t.cn: 这是特质技能中自动移除负面特质所需的“初始”等级. 若起始等级低于此数值, 玩家必须升级才能移除该谱系中已超越的负面特质.

Sandbox_TAS_Grid_tooltip.en: Customize the evolutive trait spectrums for this server. Drag traits from the pool into the level ranges of each spectrum. Changes are shared by all players on the server.
Sandbox_TAS_Grid_tooltip.ch: 自訂此伺服器的演進特質譜系. 將特質從特質池拖曳到各譜系的等級區間中. 變更會由伺服器上的所有玩家共用.
Sandbox_TAS_Grid_tooltip.cn: 自定义此服务器的演进特质谱系. 将特质从特质池拖到各谱系的等级区间中. 更改由服务器上的所有玩家共享.

Sandbox_TAS_PermanentDeafness_tooltip.en: Characters born deaf keep the trait forever. Turn it off to let them raise the Hearing spectrum and lose the trait.
Sandbox_TAS_PermanentDeafness_tooltip.ch: 天生雙耳失聰的角色會永遠保有此特質. 關閉後可讓他們提升聽覺譜系並失去此特質.
Sandbox_TAS_PermanentDeafness_tooltip.cn: 天生耳聋的角色会永远保留此特质. 关闭后可让他们提升听觉谱系并失去此特质.

Sandbox_TAS_PermanentShortsightedness_to.en: Characters born shortsighted keep the trait forever. Turn it off to let them raise the Vision spectrum and lose the trait.
Sandbox_TAS_PermanentShortsightedness_to.ch: 天生近視的角色會永遠保有此特質. 關閉後可讓他們提升視覺譜系並失去此特質.
Sandbox_TAS_PermanentShortsightedness_to.cn: 天生近视的角色会永远保留此特质. 关闭后可让他们提升视觉谱系并失去此特质.

Sandbox_TAS_ShootingHearingLossMultiplie.en: Multiplies the Hearing XP lost every shot fired. 1.0 normal. 2.0 double. 0.5 half. 0.0 disables hearing loss from gunfire.
Sandbox_TAS_ShootingHearingLossMultiplie.ch: 每次開槍損失的聽覺經驗倍率. 1.0 為正常. 2.0 為兩倍. 0.5 為一半. 0.0 則停用槍聲造成的聽力損失.
Sandbox_TAS_ShootingHearingLossMultiplie.cn: 每次开枪损失的听觉经验倍率. 1.0 为正常. 2.0 为两倍. 0.5 为一半. 0.0 则禁用枪声造成的听力损失.

Sandbox_TAS_TooltipLossesIfOwned.en: Show trait losses only if owned
Sandbox_TAS_TooltipLossesIfOwned.ch: 僅在擁有時顯示特質失去
Sandbox_TAS_TooltipLossesIfOwned.cn: 仅在拥有时显示特质失去

Sandbox_TAS_TooltipLossesIfOwned_tooltip.en: When ON, the 'Level down' line of the spectrum tooltip only shows the loss of positive traits that the character actually has. Turn it off to always show which positive traits a level would take away.
Sandbox_TAS_TooltipLossesIfOwned_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 譜系提示中的「降級」一行只會顯示角色實際擁有、降級時會失去的正面特質. 關閉後則一律顯示降級會失去哪些正面特質.
Sandbox_TAS_TooltipLossesIfOwned_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 谱系提示中的“降级”一行只会显示角色实际拥有、降级时会失去的正面特质. 关闭后则始终显示降级会失去哪些正面特质.

Sandbox_TAS_XPGainActiveMultiplier_toolt.en: Multiplies the XP earned by playing (eating well reading healing killing zombies driving). 1.0 normal. 2.0 double. 0.5 half. 0.0 off.
Sandbox_TAS_XPGainActiveMultiplier_toolt.ch: 遊玩時獲得經驗的倍率 (好好進食, 閱讀, 治療, 擊殺殭屍, 駕駛). 1.0 為正常. 2.0 為兩倍. 0.5 為一半. 0.0 為關閉.
Sandbox_TAS_XPGainActiveMultiplier_toolt.cn: 游玩时获得经验的倍率 (好好进食, 阅读, 治疗, 击杀僵尸, 驾驶). 1.0 为正常. 2.0 为两倍. 0.5 为一半. 0.0 为关闭.

Sandbox_TAS_XPGainPassiveMultiplier_tool.en: Multiplies the XP that spectrums earn passively over time (resting staying healthy well fed and hydrated). 1.0 normal. 2.0 double. 0.5 half. 0.0 off.
Sandbox_TAS_XPGainPassiveMultiplier_tool.ch: 譜系隨時間被動獲得經驗的倍率 (休息, 保持健康, 吃飽喝足). 1.0 為正常. 2.0 為兩倍. 0.5 為一半. 0.0 為關閉.
Sandbox_TAS_XPGainPassiveMultiplier_tool.cn: 谱系随时间被动获得经验的倍率 (休息, 保持健康, 吃饱喝足). 1.0 为正常. 2.0 为两倍. 0.5 为一半. 0.0 为关闭.

Sandbox_TAS_XPLossActiveMultiplier_toolt.en: Multiplies the XP lost through harmful actions while playing (rotten food smoking taking damage). 1.0 normal. 2.0 double. 0.5 half. 0.0 off.
Sandbox_TAS_XPLossActiveMultiplier_toolt.ch: 遊玩時因有害行為而損失經驗的倍率 (腐壞食物, 吸菸, 受到傷害). 1.0 為正常. 2.0 為兩倍. 0.5 為一半. 0.0 為關閉.
Sandbox_TAS_XPLossActiveMultiplier_toolt.cn: 游玩时因有害行为而损失经验的倍率 (腐烂食物, 吸烟, 受到伤害). 1.0 为正常. 2.0 为两倍. 0.5 为一半. 0.0 为关闭.

Sandbox_TAS_XPLossPassiveMultiplier_tool.en: Multiplies the XP that spectrums lose passively over time (hunger thirst bad habits). 1.0 normal. 2.0 double. 0.5 half. 0.0 off.
Sandbox_TAS_XPLossPassiveMultiplier_tool.ch: 譜系隨時間被動損失經驗的倍率 (飢餓, 口渴, 不良習慣). 1.0 為正常. 2.0 為兩倍. 0.5 為一半. 0.0 為關閉.
Sandbox_TAS_XPLossPassiveMultiplier_tool.cn: 谱系随时间被动损失经验的倍率 (饥饿, 口渴, 不良习惯). 1.0 为正常. 2.0 为两倍. 0.5 为一半. 0.0 为关闭.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EnableLateRaidHor.en: Enable timed late-raid hordes in Normal Raids and Free Roam. Disable to skip the initial horde, repeat hordes, escalating waves and their NPC replacements, and hide all horde info on the HUD. Extraction flare responses and regular NPC encounters are unchanged.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EnableLateRaidHor.ch: 在一般突襲與自由漫遊中啟用定時的突襲後期屍潮. 停用則略過初始屍潮, 追加屍潮, 遞增波次及其 NPC 替換, 並在 HUD 上隱藏所有屍潮資訊. 撤離訊號彈引來的回應與一般 NPC 遭遇不受影響.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EnableLateRaidHor.cn: 在普通突袭和自由漫游中启用定时的突袭后期尸潮. 禁用则跳过初始尸潮, 追加尸潮, 递增波次及其 NPC 替换, 并在 HUD 上隐藏所有尸潮信息. 撤离信号弹引来的响应和普通 NPC 遭遇不受影响.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RaidMode_tooltip.en:
Normal Raids: the existing raid rules.

Free Roam: choose an insertion location and explore without visible raid boundaries. Every main town has one helicopter extraction site, including your insertion town. GPS and special destinations do not provide extra helicopter extraction sites. Outside your insertion area, the driver can start a cancellable 10-second vehicle extraction if there is enough fuel. The listed fuel is spent when the countdown finishes.

With Enable Late Raid Horde on, major hordes first arrive after 24 in-game hours and return 24 hours after each successful arrival. Intel Center adds its configured delay to both the first horde and every repeat (27 hours with the default +3 bonus). Vehicle timing penalties and Normal Raid repeat/escalating-wave timers do not apply. The HUD countdown updates once per game hour. Supports single player and multiplayer; multi-hideout groups choose their destination in DEPLOY.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RaidMode_tooltip.ch:
一般突襲: 沿用現有的突襲規則.

自由漫遊: 選擇抵達地點, 在沒有可見突襲邊界的情況下探索. 每個主要城鎮都有一個直升機撤離點, 包括你的抵達城鎮. GPS 與特殊目的地不會提供額外的直升機撤離點. 在抵達區域以外, 若燃料充足, 駕駛可以開始可取消的 10 秒乘車撤離. 倒數結束時會消耗列出的燃料.

開啟「啟用突襲後期屍潮」時, 大型屍潮會在 24 遊戲小時後首次來襲, 之後每次成功來襲後 24 小時再次出現. 情報中心會將其設定的延遲同時加到第一波屍潮與每次追加屍潮上 (預設 +3 加成時為 27 小時). 車輛時間懲罰與一般突襲的追加/遞增波次計時器不適用. HUD 倒數每遊戲小時更新一次. 支援單人與多人遊戲; 多藏身點小隊在「部署」中選擇目的地.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_RaidMode_tooltip.cn:
普通突袭: 沿用现有的突袭规则.

自由漫游: 选择抵达地点, 在没有可见突袭边界的情况下探索. 每个主要城镇都有一个直升机撤离点, 包括你的抵达城镇. GPS 和特殊目的地不会提供额外的直升机撤离点. 在抵达区域以外, 若燃料充足, 驾驶员可以开始可取消的 10 秒乘车撤离. 倒计时结束时会消耗列出的燃料.

开启“启用突袭后期尸潮”时, 大型尸潮会在 24 游戏小时后首次来袭, 之后每次成功来袭后 24 小时再次出现. 情报中心会将其设置的延迟同时加到第一波尸潮和每次追加尸潮上 (默认 +3 加成时为 27 小时). 车辆时间惩罚和普通突袭的追加/递增波次计时器不适用. HUD 倒计时每游戏小时更新一次. 支持单人和多人游戏; 多藏身点小队在“部署”中选择目的地.

Sandbox_EPR_WaterRestoration_tooltip.en: Lets the water treatment plant be repaired to bring water back. When off, the plant cannot be repaired and water shuts off everywhere as normal, while power restoration keeps working.
Sandbox_EPR_WaterRestoration_tooltip.ch: 允許修復水廠以恢復供水. 關閉時, 水廠無法修復, 自來水會照常在各地停止供應, 而電力恢復功能仍可正常運作.
Sandbox_EPR_WaterRestoration_tooltip.cn: 允许修复水厂以恢复供水. 关闭时, 水厂无法修复, 自来水会照常在各地停止供应, 而电力恢复功能仍可正常运作.

Sandbox_Title_DansOPWeapons_Cash.ch: D商店 - 現金 / 第0級
Sandbox_Title_DansOPWeapons_Cash.cn: D商店 - 现金 / 第0级

Sandbox_CBB_ExtraDepositItems_tooltip.en: Adds extra item types to every looted safe deposit box. Enter full item IDs separated by commas. Leave blank to add nothing.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraDepositItems_tooltip.ch: 為每個被搜刮的銀行保管箱新增額外的物品種類. 輸入完整物品 ID, 以逗號分隔. 留空則不新增.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraDepositItems_tooltip.cn: 为每个被搜刮的银行保管箱添加额外的物品种类. 输入完整物品ID, 以逗号分隔. 留空则不添加.

Sandbox_CBB_ExtraSafeItems_tooltip.en: Adds extra item types to every looted bank safe. Enter full item IDs separated by commas, for example: Base.Pistol,Base.GoldBar. Leave blank to add nothing.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraSafeItems_tooltip.ch: 為每個被搜刮的銀行保險箱新增額外的物品種類. 輸入完整物品 ID, 以逗號分隔, 例如: Base.Pistol,Base.GoldBar. 留空則不新增.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraSafeItems_tooltip.cn: 为每个被搜刮的银行保险柜添加额外的物品种类. 输入完整物品ID, 以逗号分隔, 例如: Base.Pistol,Base.GoldBar. 留空则不添加.

Sandbox_CBB_KeySpawnChance_tooltip.en: Chance for a Bank Safe Key to spawn somewhere inside each bank. A successful bank will receive one key in a suitable desk, counter or filing cabinet. 0% disables key spawning. Default: 65%.
Sandbox_CBB_KeySpawnChance_tooltip.ch: 每間銀行內生成一把銀行保險櫃鑰匙的機率. 成功時, 該銀行會在合適的辦公桌、櫃檯或檔案櫃中放入一把鑰匙. 0%% 會停用鑰匙生成. 預設: 65%%.
Sandbox_CBB_KeySpawnChance_tooltip.cn: 每间银行内生成一把银行保险柜钥匙的几率. 成功时, 该银行会在合适的办公桌、柜台或文件柜中放入一把钥匙. 0%%会禁用钥匙生成. 默认: 65%%.

Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier.ch: 保險箱與保管箱戰利品倍率
Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier.cn: 保险柜与保管箱战利品倍率

Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier_tooltip.en: Controls how much loot is generated when opening bank safes and safe deposit boxes. 1.0 = normal loot, 2.0 = roughly double. Higher values also increase the chance of some valuables appearing.
Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier_tooltip.ch: 控制開啟銀行保險箱與保管箱時生成的戰利品數量. 1.0 = 正常, 2.0 = 約兩倍. 數值越高, 出現貴重物品的機率也越高.
Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier_tooltip.cn: 控制打开银行保险柜与保管箱时生成的战利品数量. 1.0 = 正常, 2.0 = 约两倍. 数值越高, 出现贵重物品的几率也越高.

Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours.en: Safe & Deposit Box Loot Respawn Time
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours.ch: 保險箱與保管箱戰利品重生時間
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours.cn: 保险柜与保管箱战利品重生时间

Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours_tooltip.en: Number of in-game hours before looted bank safes and safe deposit boxes can contain loot again. Set to 0 to disable loot respawning. Default: 0.
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours_tooltip.ch: 被搜刮過的銀行保險箱與保管箱需經過多少遊戲內小時才能再次出現戰利品. 設為 0 可停用戰利品重生. 預設: 0.
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours_tooltip.cn: 被搜刮过的银行保险柜与保管箱需经过多少游戏内小时才能再次出现战利品. 设为0可禁用战利品重生. 默认: 0.

Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys.en: Keys Only Work at Their Own Bank
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys.ch: 鑰匙僅限所屬銀行使用
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys.cn: 钥匙仅限所属银行使用

Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys_tooltip.en: When enabled, a Bank Safe Key only opens safes and deposit boxes at the bank where that key was found. When disabled, any Bank Safe Key can be used at any bank.
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys_tooltip.ch: 啟用時, 銀行保險櫃鑰匙只能開啟發現該鑰匙那間銀行的保險箱與保管箱. 停用時, 任何銀行保險櫃鑰匙都能在任何銀行使用.
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys_tooltip.cn: 启用时, 银行保险柜钥匙只能打开发现该钥匙那间银行的保险柜与保管箱. 禁用时, 任何银行保险柜钥匙都能在任何银行使用.

Sandbox_SZ_OpenDoorChance_tooltip.en:
Percent of sentient zombies that work a door handle instead of
pounding on it. Rolled once per zombie.
Locked and barricaded doors are always thumped as normal, so
locking up is still a real defence.
Separate from the vanilla "Door Opening" lore setting -- if both
are above zero, both apply.
Sandbox_SZ_OpenDoorChance_tooltip.ch:
具有感知能力的殭屍中會轉動門把而非
猛力捶門的百分比. 每隻殭屍判定一次.
上鎖和設置路障的門一律照常被捶打, 因此
鎖門依然是真正有效的防禦.
此設定獨立於原版「開門」殭屍特性設定 -- 若兩者
皆大於零, 兩者同時生效.
Sandbox_SZ_OpenDoorChance_tooltip.cn:
具有感知能力的僵尸中会转动门把手而非
猛力捶门的百分比. 每只僵尸判定一次.
上锁和设置路障的门一律照常被捶打, 因此
锁门依然是真正有效的防御.
此设置独立于原版“开门”僵尸特性设置 -- 若两者
都大于零, 两者同时生效.

Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip.en: Lets players convert generators into Off-Grid backups. Off stops the ones that are running and refuses new conversions; Convert to normal generator still works.
Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip.ch: 允許玩家將發電機改裝為離網備用發電機. 關閉時會停止運轉中的備用發電機並拒絕新的改裝, 「轉換為一般發電機」仍可使用.
Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip.cn: 允许玩家将发电机改装为离网备用发电机. 关闭时会停止运行中的备用发电机并拒绝新的改装, “转换为普通发电机”仍可使用.

Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip.en: How much gasoline a backup generator burns. 1 burns what a normal generator burns for the same appliances, or in Realistic Mode what a real generator burns. 0 is free.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip.ch: 備用發電機消耗的汽油量. 1 表示與一般發電機為相同電器供電時的耗油量相同, 在寫實模式下則與真實發電機相同. 0 表示不耗油.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip.cn: 备用发电机消耗的汽油量. 1 表示与普通发电机为相同电器供电时的耗油量相同, 在写实模式下则与真实发电机相同. 0 表示不耗油.

Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance.en: Storage barns with spare solar gear (one in)
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance.ch: 存有備用太陽能設備的儲藏穀倉 (幾座中有一座)
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance.cn: 存有备用太阳能设备的储藏谷仓 (几座中有一座)

Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip.en: On newly explored ground, one hay-storage barn in this many holds a few spare panels and battery racks. 0 means none.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip.ch: 在新探索的區域中, 每這麼多座儲草穀倉就有一座存放少量備用太陽能板和電池架. 0 表示沒有.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip.cn: 在新探索的区域中, 每这么多座储草谷仓就有一座存放少量备用光伏板和电池架. 0 表示没有.

Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip.en: How far a transformer's power line can run, to the controller or to another transformer, in tiles.
Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip.ch: 變壓器的電力線路可延伸的距離 (連到控制器或另一台變壓器), 單位為格.
Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip.cn: 变压器的电力线路可延伸的距离 (连到控制器或另一台变压器), 单位为格.

Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode.ch: 寫實模式 (1993 年太陽能板)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode.cn: 写实模式 (1993 年光伏板)

Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip.en: Panels make what panels made in 1993: three modules of about 50 W to a frame, so a standard frame gives about 140 W in full sun, a quarter of the usual. Makeshift frames make about half that, premium frames a little more. Backup generators burn gasoline like real generators: 0.15 L an hour for each kW of their rating, plus 0.45 L for each kWh they deliver.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip.ch: 太陽能板的發電量與 1993 年的太陽能板相同: 每個框架裝三塊約 50 W 的元件, 因此標準框架在全日照下約可發電 140 W, 為一般情況的四分之一. 簡易框架約為其一半, 高級框架稍多一些. 備用發電機會像真實發電機一樣消耗汽油: 每 kW 額定功率每小時 0.15 L, 另加每輸出 1 kWh 消耗 0.45 L.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip.cn: 光伏板的发电量与 1993 年的光伏板相同: 每个框架装三块约 50 W 的组件, 因此标准框架在全日照下约可发电 140 W, 为通常的四分之一. 简易框架约为其一半, 高级框架稍多一些. 备用发电机会像真实发电机一样消耗汽油: 每 kW 额定功率每小时 0.15 L, 另加每输出 1 kWh 消耗 0.45 L.

Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance.en: Houses with a solar rig (one in)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance.ch: 設有太陽能設備的房屋 (幾棟中有一棟)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance.cn: 设有太阳能设备的房屋 (几栋中有一栋)

Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip.en: On newly explored ground, one house in this many has a solar rig in the yard. 0 means none.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip.ch: 在新探索的區域中, 每這麼多棟房屋就有一棟在院子裡設有太陽能設備. 0 表示沒有.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip.cn: 在新探索的区域中, 每这么多栋房屋就有一栋在院子里设有太阳能设备. 0 表示没有.

Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip.en: What each transformer draws while the system has power, even with nothing switched on.
Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip.ch: 系統有電時, 每台變壓器即使沒有開啟任何電器也會耗用的電力.
Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip.cn: 系统有电时, 每台变压器即使没有打开任何电器也会消耗的电力.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M49.en: Capacity in litres for the M49A2C fuel cargo tank. Applies to newly loaded vehicles.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M49.ch: M49A2C 燃油罐體的容量 (公升). 套用於新載入的車輛.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M49.cn: M49A2C 燃油罐体的容量 (升). 适用于新加载的车辆.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M50.en: Capacity in litres for the M50A3 water cargo tank. Applies to newly loaded vehicles.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M50.ch: M50A3 儲水罐體的容量 (公升). 套用於新載入的車輛.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M50.cn: M50A3 储水罐体的容量 (升). 适用于新加载的车辆.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M96.en: Capacity in litres for the M967 fuel cargo tank. Applies to newly loaded vehicles.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M96.ch: M967 燃油罐體的容量 (公升). 套用於新載入的車輛.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M96.cn: M967 燃油罐体的容量 (升). 适用于新加载的车辆.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_Pum.en: Multiplier for tanker pump transfer speed. 1 is the default speed.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_Pum.ch: 油罐車泵送輸送速度的倍率. 1 為預設速度.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_Pum.cn: 油罐车泵送输送速度的倍率. 1 为默认速度.

Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.ch: 聖徒的枯萎手指掉落機率 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.cn: 圣徒的枯萎手指掉落几率 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.en: Chance for each killed zombie to drop one Saint's Withered Finger. Independent of Blessing Abundance and Blessings on Zombie Equipment. Default: 0.5%%. Set to 0 to disable new drops; existing fingers remain usable.
Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.ch: 每隻被擊殺的殭屍掉落一根聖徒的枯萎手指的機率. 不受祝福豐富度與殭屍裝備祝福影響. 預設: 0.5%%. 設為 0 可停用新的掉落; 已有的手指仍可使用.
Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.cn: 每只被击杀的僵尸掉落一根圣徒的枯萎手指的几率. 不受祝福丰富度与僵尸装备祝福影响. 默认: 0.5%%. 设为 0 可禁用新的掉落; 已有的手指仍可使用.

Sandbox_NRE_LethalEmptyShafts_tooltip.en: On by default. When on, every elevator shaft is an open pit on every floor except the one the car is parked at. Calling a car and stepping in as the doors open is always safe, but if you open a shaft door on a floor the car isn't at and walk in, you fall.
Sandbox_NRE_LethalEmptyShafts_tooltip.ch: 預設開啟. 開啟時, 除了車廂停靠的樓層外, 每一層的電梯井都是敞開的深坑. 呼叫車廂並在門開啟時走進去永遠是安全的, 但如果你在車廂不在的樓層開啟電梯井門並走進去, 就會摔下去.
Sandbox_NRE_LethalEmptyShafts_tooltip.cn: 默认开启. 开启时, 除了轿厢停靠的楼层外, 每一层的电梯井都是敞开的深坑. 呼叫轿厢并在门打开时走进去永远是安全的, 但如果你在轿厢不在的楼层打开电梯井门并走进去, 就会摔下去.

Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds.cn: 使用自定义李小龙音效

Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds_t.en: When enabled, martial-arts attacks use the mod's custom sound effects and finisher yell. Disable this to replace them with sounds from the base game.
Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds_t.ch: 啟用時, 武術攻擊會使用此 MOD 的自訂音效與終結吶喊. 停用則改用原版遊戲的音效.
Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds_t.cn: 启用时, 武术攻击会使用此 MOD 的自定义音效与终结呐喊. 禁用则改用原版游戏的音效.

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld.en: Realistic Suppressor System - Guns of Marz Old Version
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld.ch: 真實消音器系統: Marz的槍械 (舊版)
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld.cn: 真实消音器系统: Marz的枪械 (旧版)

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.en: Enable Guns of Marz Old Version muzzle adapters
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.ch: 啟用Marz的槍械 (舊版) 槍口轉接器
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.cn: 启用Marz的枪械 (旧版) 枪口适配器

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.en: WORLD-START OPTION: Choose whether the original Guns of Marz Old Version muzzle mounting adapters remain enabled. Restart required. When disabled, AR/AK/Pistol/.45 adapters cannot be mounted and are removed from GoM random spawn tables and the vanilla replacement pool.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.ch: 開局選項: 選擇是否保留Marz的槍械 (舊版) 原有的槍口安裝轉接器. 需要重新啟動. 停用後, AR/AK/手槍/.45轉接器將無法安裝, 並會從GoM隨機生成表與原版替換池中移除.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.cn: 开局选项: 选择是否保留Marz的枪械 (旧版) 原有的枪口安装适配器. 需要重启. 禁用后, AR/AK/手枪/.45适配器将无法安装, 并会从GoM随机生成表与原版替换池中移除.

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.en: Enable Guns of Marz Old Version suppressors
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.ch: 啟用Marz的槍械 (舊版) 消音器
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.cn: 启用Marz的枪械 (旧版) 消音器

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.en: WORLD-START OPTION: Choose whether the original Guns of Marz Old Version suppressors remain enabled. Restart required. When disabled, GoM suppressors cannot be mounted and are removed from GoM random spawn tables.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.ch: 開局選項: 選擇是否保留Marz的槍械 (舊版) 原有的消音器. 需要重新啟動. 停用後, GoM消音器將無法安裝, 並會從GoM隨機生成表中移除.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.cn: 开局选项: 选择是否保留Marz的枪械 (旧版) 原有的消音器. 需要重启. 禁用后, GoM消音器将无法安装, 并会从GoM随机生成表中移除.

Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers.en: NPC accuracy against zombies and NPCs

Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers_tooltip.en: Percent of their usual chance to hit walkers and each other with a gun.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers_tooltip.ch: NPC用槍命中行屍與彼此的機率, 以其一般機率的百分比表示.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers_tooltip.cn: NPC用枪命中行尸和彼此的几率, 以其正常几率的百分比表示.

Sandbox_RNPC_AimPlayers_tooltip.en: Percent of their usual chance to hit you with a gun. 100 is normal, 0 never hits.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimPlayers_tooltip.ch: NPC用槍命中你的機率, 以其一般機率的百分比表示. 100為正常, 0為永不命中.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimPlayers_tooltip.cn: NPC用枪命中你的几率, 以其正常几率的百分比表示. 100为正常, 0为永不命中.

Sandbox_RNPC_BaseRaids_tooltip.en: Off by default. A faction that hates you and has found your base may raid it.
Sandbox_RNPC_BaseRaids_tooltip.ch: 預設關閉. 痛恨你且已找到你基地的陣營可能會襲擊它.
Sandbox_RNPC_BaseRaids_tooltip.cn: 默认关闭. 痛恨你且已找到你基地的派系可能会袭击它.

Sandbox_RNPC_FactionMemory_tooltip.en: Deaths, raids and betrayals are remembered, talked about and acted on.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionMemory_tooltip.ch: 死亡、襲擊與背叛都會被記住、談論, 並付諸行動.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionMemory_tooltip.cn: 死亡、袭击和背叛都会被记住、谈论, 并付诸行动.

Sandbox_RNPC_FactionQuests_tooltip.en: What factions ask of players. Expanded adds jobs that come from what happened to them.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionQuests_tooltip.ch: 陣營向玩家提出的委託. 擴充會加入源自他們遭遇事件的工作.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionQuests_tooltip.cn: 派系向玩家提出的委托. 扩展会加入源自他们遭遇事件的任务.

Sandbox_RNPC_JoinFactions_tooltip.en: A faction you stand high with offers to take you in. Members share its friends and enemies.
Sandbox_RNPC_JoinFactions_tooltip.ch: 對你評價很高的陣營會邀請你加入. 成員共享該陣營的盟友與敵人.
Sandbox_RNPC_JoinFactions_tooltip.cn: 对你评价很高的派系会邀请你加入. 成员共享该派系的盟友和敌人.

Sandbox_RNPC_NPCInfection_tooltip.en: A bitten NPC may sicken and rise as a walker in their own clothes.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCInfection_tooltip.ch: 被咬的NPC可能會發病, 並穿著自己的衣服變成行屍.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCInfection_tooltip.cn: 被咬的NPC可能会发病, 并穿着自己的衣服变成行尸.

Sandbox_RNPC_Raids_tooltip.en: Factions at war rob each other's bases. Often is twice as many.
Sandbox_RNPC_Raids_tooltip.ch: 交戰中的陣營會搶劫彼此的基地. 「經常」為兩倍次數.
Sandbox_RNPC_Raids_tooltip.cn: 交战中的派系会抢劫彼此的基地. “经常”为两倍次数.

Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitMeals_tooltip.en: Once a day each recruit eats from a container you marked Food, or goes hungry.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitMeals_tooltip.ch: 每位隊員每天會從你標記為食物的容器中進食一次, 否則就會挨餓.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitMeals_tooltip.cn: 每名队员每天会从你标记为食物的容器中进食一次, 否则就会挨饿.

Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitOrders_tooltip.en: Tell a recruit to wait, guard a spot or patrol round it. Off: they only follow you.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitOrders_tooltip.ch: 命令隊員等待、守衛某處或在其周圍巡邏. 關閉: 他們只會跟隨你.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitOrders_tooltip.cn: 命令队员等待、守卫某处或在其周围巡逻. 关闭: 他们只会跟随你.

Sandbox_RNPC_SeatFires_tooltip.en: Faction seats light a campfire at night and keep someone by it.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatFires_tooltip.ch: 陣營據點會在夜間點燃營火, 並留人在旁看守.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatFires_tooltip.cn: 派系据点会在夜间点燃营火, 并留人在旁看守.

Sandbox_RNPC_StandingFade_tooltip.en: How fast your standing with a faction drifts back to where it started. Percent: 100 is normal, 0 never fades.
Sandbox_RNPC_StandingFade_tooltip.ch: 你在陣營中的聲望回到初始值的速度. 百分比: 100為正常, 0為永不回歸.
Sandbox_RNPC_StandingFade_tooltip.cn: 你在派系中的声望回到初始值的速度. 百分比: 100为正常, 0为永不回归.

Sandbox_RNPC_Stops_tooltip.en: Raiders demand payment before shooting. Checkpoints check you over.
Sandbox_RNPC_Stops_tooltip.ch: 掠奪者會在開槍前要求付錢. 檢查哨會對你進行搜查.
Sandbox_RNPC_Stops_tooltip.cn: 掠夺者会在开枪前要求付钱. 检查站会对你进行搜查.

Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextColor_tooltip.en: Color of the [RNPC] line at the top of the screen.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextColor_tooltip.ch: 螢幕頂部 [RNPC] 文字的顏色.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextColor_tooltip.cn: 屏幕顶部 [RNPC] 文字的颜色.

Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextOpacity_tooltip.en: Percent. 100 is solid; lower lets the game show through.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextOpacity_tooltip.ch: 百分比. 100為完全不透明; 數值越低越能看見後方的遊戲畫面.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextOpacity_tooltip.cn: 百分比. 100为完全不透明; 数值越低越能看见后方的游戏画面.

Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextSize_tooltip.en: The [RNPC] line at the top of the screen, in solo or with no chat box.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextSize_tooltip.ch: 單人遊玩或沒有聊天框時, 顯示在螢幕頂部的 [RNPC] 文字.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextSize_tooltip.cn: 单人游玩或没有聊天框时, 显示在屏幕顶部的 [RNPC] 文字.

Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays.en: Days before a wiped-out faction regroups
Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays.ch: 被消滅的陣營重新集結前的天數
Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays.cn: 被消灭的派系重新集结前的天数

Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays_tooltip.ch: 遊戲內天數. 預設30. 僅限暫時.
Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays_tooltip.cn: 游戏内天数. 默认30. 仅限临时.

Sandbox_RNPC_Wipeouts_tooltip.en: Rare: it takes days of losses. Temporary: they may regroup later.
Sandbox_RNPC_Wipeouts_tooltip.ch: 罕見: 需要連續數天的損失. 暫時: 他們之後可能重新集結.
Sandbox_RNPC_Wipeouts_tooltip.cn: 罕见: 需要连续数天的损失. 临时: 他们之后可能重新集结.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.CaravanAccidentDe.en: Chance per abstract trader/caravan member every two in-game hours. Set to 0 to disable accidental deaths for caravans.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.CaravanAccidentDe.ch: 每兩個遊戲小時, 每名抽象商人/商隊成員的機率. 設為0可停用商隊的意外死亡.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.CaravanAccidentDe.cn: 每两个游戏小时, 每名抽象商人/商队成员的几率. 设为0可禁用商队的意外死亡.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr.en: Percentage of a component's Base.Money ingredients returned to colony storage when the component is deconstructed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr.ch: 拆除元件時, 該元件 Base.Money 材料退還至聚落倉庫的百分比.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr.cn: 拆除组件时, 该组件 Base.Money 材料返还至聚落仓库的百分比.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ConstructionCance.en: Multiplies the proportional materials returned when unfinished construction is cancelled. 1.0 returns the full remaining fraction; 0 returns nothing.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ConstructionCance.ch: 調整取消未完成建造時按比例退還材料的倍率. 1.0退還全部剩餘比例; 0則不退還.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ConstructionCance.cn: 调整取消未完成建造时按比例返还材料的倍率. 1.0返还全部剩余比例; 0则不返还.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag.en: Uses each NPC's equipped weapon damage and combat skill. Disable to use legacy combat-profile damage values.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag.ch: 使用每名NPC裝備武器的傷害與戰鬥技能. 停用則使用舊版戰鬥設定檔的傷害值.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag.cn: 使用每名NPC装备武器的伤害和战斗技能. 禁用则使用旧版战斗配置的伤害值.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.LooterAccidentDea.en: Chance per abstract looter member every two in-game hours. Set to 0 to disable accidental deaths for looters.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.LooterAccidentDea.ch: 每兩個遊戲小時, 每名抽象拾荒者成員的機率. 設為0可停用拾荒者的意外死亡.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.LooterAccidentDea.cn: 每两个游戏小时, 每名抽象拾荒者成员的几率. 设为0可禁用拾荒者的意外死亡.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MobileSettlementA.en: Chance per eligible mobile-group member to join an AI-owned settlement on arrival. Colony population capacity still applies.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MobileSettlementA.ch: 流動團體中每名符合條件的成員抵達時加入AI聚落的機率. 仍受聚落人口上限限制.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MobileSettlementA.cn: 流动团体中每名符合条件的成员抵达时加入AI聚落的几率. 仍受聚落人口上限限制.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula.en: Adjusts diminishing population growth from player count and the number of distinct active sectors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula.ch: 依玩家人數與不同活躍區域數量調整遞減的人口成長.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula.cn: 根据玩家人数和不同活跃区域数量调整递减的人口增长.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio.en: Requires ranged PNC NPCs to carry the firearm's ammunition in their virtual inventory and consumes one round per resolved shot.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio.ch: 要求遠程PNC NPC在虛擬物品欄中攜帶槍械彈藥, 每次結算射擊消耗一發.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio.cn: 要求远程PNC NPC在虚拟物品栏中携带枪械弹药, 每次结算射击消耗一发.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul.en: Scales weapon-based damage dealt by PNC NPCs. 1.0 is normal and 0 prevents weapon-based damage.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul.ch: 縮放PNC NPC造成的武器傷害. 1.0為正常, 0則不造成武器傷害.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul.cn: 缩放PNC NPC造成的武器伤害. 1.0为正常, 0则不造成武器伤害.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.ch: NPC感染致死時間 (遊戲小時)
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.cn: NPC感染致死时间 (游戏小时)

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.en: In-game hours from infection to terminal fever and death. Health declines during the later stages.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.ch: 從感染到末期發燒與死亡的遊戲內小時數. 健康會在後期階段下降.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.cn: 从感染到末期发烧和死亡的游戏内小时数. 健康会在后期阶段下降.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa.en: Independent identity-seeded chance that a generated NPC receives a melee weapon. Melee and ranged rolls can both succeed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa.ch: 生成的NPC獲得近戰武器的獨立機率, 以身分作為種子. 近戰與遠程判定可同時成功.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa.cn: 生成的NPC获得近战武器的独立几率, 以身份作为种子. 近战和远程判定可同时成功.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t.en: Allows PNC NPC attacks to cause pain, scratches, and bleeding on players in addition to overall health loss.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t.ch: 允許PNC NPC的攻擊除了降低整體健康外, 也會對玩家造成疼痛、抓傷與流血.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t.cn: 允许PNC NPC的攻击除了降低整体健康外, 也会对玩家造成疼痛、抓伤和流血.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too.en: Controls automatic survivor population targets. Lowering this never deletes existing persistent survivors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too.ch: 控制自動倖存者人口目標. 調低此值不會刪除既有的永久倖存者.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too.cn: 控制自动幸存者人口目标. 调低此值不会删除现有的永久幸存者.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp.en: Independent identity-seeded chance that a generated NPC receives a firearm and matching ammunition. Melee and ranged rolls can both succeed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp.ch: 生成的NPC獲得槍械與相符彈藥的獨立機率, 以身分作為種子. 近戰與遠程判定可同時成功.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp.cn: 生成的NPC获得枪械和匹配弹药的独立几率, 以身份作为种子. 近战和远程判定可同时成功.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec.en: Real-time seconds between infection death and vanilla corpse reanimation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec.ch: 從感染死亡到原版屍體復活之間的現實秒數.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec.cn: 从感染死亡到原版尸体复活之间的现实秒数.
