Turn this on to add the mod to a server world that was started without it: back up the server, turn this on, delete map_basements.bin from the server's save folder, and restart. House basements stay as they were, and the sewers and caves appear wherever nobody has been yet. Players who joined before must delete their own copy of map_basements.bin for this server once; the game tells them where. Leave it off on a server that started with the mod. Single player works this out by itself.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_AddedToExistin.ch: 僅限伺服器. 開啟此選項可將本模組加入一個原本未安裝本模組就開始的伺服器世界: 先備份伺服器, 開啟此選項, 從伺服器的存檔資料夾刪除 map_basements.bin, 然後重新啟動. 房屋地下室維持原樣, 下水道與洞穴會出現在還沒有人去過的地方. 之前加入過的玩家必須為這個伺服器刪除一次自己的 map_basements.bin 副本; 遊戲會告訴他們位置. 若伺服器一開始就裝了本模組, 請保持關閉. 單人遊戲會自行處理.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_AddedToExistin.cn: 仅限服务器. 开启此选项可将本模组加入一个原本未安装本模组就开始的服务器世界: 先备份服务器, 开启此选项, 从服务器的存档文件夹删除 map_basements.bin, 然后重启. 房屋地下室保持原样, 下水道和洞穴会出现在尚无人去过的地方. 之前加入过的玩家必须为这个服务器删除一次自己的 map_basements.bin 副本; 游戏会告诉他们位置. 如果服务器一开始就装了本模组, 请保持关闭. 单人游戏会自行处理.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_CaveMineMapRev.en: Caves and mines map shows everything
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_CaveMineMapRev.ch: 洞穴與礦坑地圖顯示全部
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_CaveMineMapRev.cn: 洞穴与矿坑地图显示全部

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_CaveMineMapRev.en: Off: caves and mines go on the map as you find them, or when you read a survey map. On: every cave and mine, every level, is on the map from the start.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_CaveMineMapRev.ch: 關閉: 洞穴與礦坑會在你發現時, 或閱讀測量圖時才標上地圖. 開啟: 所有洞穴與礦坑的每一層一開始就在地圖上.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_CaveMineMapRev.cn: 关闭: 洞穴与矿坑会在你发现时, 或阅读测绘图时才标上地图. 开启: 所有洞穴与矿坑的每一层一开始就在地图上.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Caves_tooltip.en: The eight caves under the old dry wells, the well ropes and the cave survey map. Off: the wells are ordinary wishing wells. Decided when the world is made: a world already started keeps the underground it was made with.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Caves_tooltip.ch: 八座位於舊枯井底下的洞穴, 井繩與洞穴測量圖. 關閉: 這些井只是普通的許願井. 於建立世界時決定: 已開始的世界會保留建立時的地下內容.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Caves_tooltip.cn: 八座位于旧枯井底下的洞穴, 井绳与洞穴测绘图. 关闭: 这些井只是普通的许愿井. 在创建世界时决定: 已开始的世界会保留创建时的地下内容.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_ManholeCrowbar.en: On: a manhole cover is pried up with a crowbar. Off: it can be lifted by hand.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_ManholeCrowbar.ch: 開啟: 人孔蓋需要用撬棍撬開. 關閉: 可以徒手掀開.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_ManholeCrowbar.cn: 开启: 井盖需要用撬棍撬开. 关闭: 可以徒手掀开.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_MinerProfessio.en: Off: the Miner is not offered at character creation. A character who already has it keeps it.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_MinerProfessio.ch: 關閉: 角色建立時不提供礦工. 已擁有的角色會保留.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_MinerProfessio.cn: 关闭: 创建角色时不提供矿工. 已拥有的角色会保留.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Mines_tooltip.en: The 22 mines under their shaft entrances and the mine survey map. Digging your own tunnels works either way. Decided when the world is made: a world already started keeps the underground it was made with.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Mines_tooltip.ch: 22 座位於豎井入口下的礦坑與礦區測量圖. 無論開啟與否, 都能自己挖掘隧道. 於建立世界時決定: 已開始的世界會保留建立時的地下內容.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Mines_tooltip.cn: 22 座位于竖井入口下的矿坑与矿区测绘图. 无论开启与否, 都能自己挖掘隧道. 在创建世界时决定: 已开始的世界会保留创建时的地下内容.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningXpMultip.en: Used only when the game's global XP multiplier is switched off, like the game's own per-skill multipliers.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningXpMultip.ch: 僅在遊戲的全域經驗倍率關閉時使用, 與遊戲本身的各技能倍率相同.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_MiningXpMultip.cn: 仅在游戏的全局经验倍率关闭时使用, 与游戏本身的各技能倍率相同.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_PrepareToRemov.en: A character saved with a trait from a removed mod will not load. Turn this on, load every character once and save: this mod's traits and the Miner profession come off each character as it loads. Then the mod can be removed from a single-player game. A multiplayer world that has ever run this mod must keep it: the game will not let players join a server it was removed from.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_PrepareToRemov.ch: 帶有已移除模組特質的角色存檔將無法載入. 開啟此選項, 將每個角色各載入一次並存檔: 每個角色載入時, 本模組的特質與礦工職業都會被移除. 之後即可從單人遊戲中移除本模組. 曾經執行過本模組的多人世界必須保留它: 遊戲不允許玩家加入已移除該模組的伺服器.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_PrepareToRemov.cn: 带有已移除模组特质的角色存档将无法加载. 开启此选项, 将每个角色各加载一次并存档: 每个角色加载时, 本模组的特质和矿工职业都会被移除. 之后即可从单人游戏中移除本模组. 曾经运行过本模组的多人世界必须保留它: 游戏不允许玩家加入已移除该模组的服务器.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_RealisticClimb.en: Off: throw a grappling hook and climb, no falls. On: you also need a carabiner, and the game's own rope fall check runs, so a tired, heavily loaded or hurt climber can fall.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_RealisticClimb.ch: 關閉: 擲出抓鉤就能攀爬, 不會摔落. 開啟: 還需要登山扣, 並套用遊戲本身的繩索摔落判定, 疲累, 負重過重或受傷的攀爬者可能摔落.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_RealisticClimb.cn: 关闭: 抛出抓钩就能攀爬, 不会摔落. 开启: 还需要登山扣, 并应用游戏本身的绳索摔落判定, 疲惫, 负重过重或受伤的攀爬者可能摔落.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_RopeClimbStren.en: The Strength level a character needs to throw a grappling hook up a wall. Climbing a rope already hung needs none; Strength and Fitness set how fast anyone climbs.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_RopeClimbStren.ch: 角色把抓鉤擲上牆所需的力量等級. 攀爬已掛好的繩索不需要; 力量與體格決定任何人的攀爬速度.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_RopeClimbStren.cn: 角色把抓钩抛上墙所需的力量等级. 攀爬已挂好的绳索不需要; 力量和体格决定任何人的攀爬速度.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SMBStepsLadder.en: Leave the game's ladders to SMB Steps
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SMBStepsLadder.ch: 將遊戲的梯子交給 SMB Steps
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SMBStepsLadder.cn: 将游戏的梯子交给 SMB Steps

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SMBStepsLadder.en: Only matters when SMB Steps is on. The game's own ladders are then climbed SMB Steps' way, and this mod's manhole, catwalk and well ladders and wall ropes stay this mod's. Off: this mod climbs the game's ladders too, and both mods offer to climb them.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SMBStepsLadder.ch: 僅在啟用 SMB Steps 時有作用. 遊戲本身的梯子將以 SMB Steps 的方式攀爬, 而本模組的人孔, 步道與井梯以及牆面繩索仍由本模組處理. 關閉: 本模組也會處理遊戲的梯子, 兩個模組都會提供攀爬選項.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SMBStepsLadder.cn: 仅在启用 SMB Steps 时有作用. 游戏本身的梯子将以 SMB Steps 的方式攀爬, 而本模组的检查井, 步道和井梯以及墙面绳索仍由本模组处理. 关闭: 本模组也会处理游戏的梯子, 两个模组都会提供攀爬选项.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SewerWater_opt.ch: 致命, 數小時內發作
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SewerWater_opt.cn: 致命, 数小时内发作

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SewerWater_too.en: What drinking straight from the sewer channel does. Tainted: the game's own tainted water, a little poison, boil it clean. Deadly at once: light poison, food sickness and sickness the moment you drink. Deadly over hours: the same three, building over four hours. Water carried out in a bottle is tainted either way and boils clean.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SewerWater_too.ch: 直接飲用下水道水渠的水會有什麼後果. 受汙染: 遊戲本身的受汙染水, 有輕微毒性, 煮沸即可淨化. 致命, 立即發作: 一喝下就會輕度中毒, 食物中毒並生病. 致命, 數小時內發作: 同樣三種效果, 在四小時內逐漸加重. 無論哪種設定, 用瓶子裝出來的水都是受汙染的, 煮沸即可淨化.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SewerWater_too.cn: 直接饮用下水道水渠的水会有什么后果. 受污染: 游戏本身的受污染水, 有轻微毒性, 煮沸即可净化. 致命, 立即发作: 一喝下就会轻度中毒, 食物中毒并生病. 致命, 数小时内发作: 同样三种效果, 在四小时内逐渐加重. 无论哪种设置, 用瓶子装出来的水都是受污染的, 煮沸即可净化.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Sewers_tooltip.en: The sewer under every town: its manholes, side rooms and crawl tunnels, the sewer view on the map and the sewer works map. Off: every manhole is plain street. Decided when the world is made: a world already started keeps the underground it was made with.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Sewers_tooltip.ch: 每座城鎮底下的下水道: 包括人孔, 側室與爬行隧道, 地圖上的下水道視圖以及下水道工程圖. 關閉: 所有人孔都只是普通街道. 於建立世界時決定: 已開始的世界會保留建立時的地下內容.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_Sewers_tooltip.cn: 每座城镇底下的下水道: 包括检查井, 侧室与爬行隧道, 地图上的下水道视图以及下水道工程图. 关闭: 所有检查井都只是普通街道. 在创建世界时决定: 已开始的世界会保留创建时的地下内容.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMines_to.en: Who can sink a shaft or dig stairs down from the surface. Admins only matters on servers; single player digs as normal. Digging stairs up out of a cave, a sewer or a mine is always allowed, so nobody is ever shut in below ground.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMines_to.ch: 誰可以從地面開鑿豎井或往下挖樓梯. 「僅限管理員」只在伺服器上有作用; 單人遊戲照常挖掘. 從洞穴, 下水道或礦坑往上挖樓梯一律允許, 因此沒有人會被困在地下.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_StreetMines_to.cn: 谁可以从地面开凿竖井或往下挖楼梯. “仅限管理员”只在服务器上有作用; 单人游戏照常挖掘. 从洞穴, 下水道或矿坑往上挖楼梯一律允许, 因此没有人会被困在地下.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SurfaceMushroo.en: Off: the mod's fifteen mushrooms are found only below ground. On: they also turn up when foraging above ground, wherever and whenever the game's own wild mushrooms do. Takes effect when the world loads.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SurfaceMushroo.ch: 關閉: 本模組的十五種蘑菇只能在地下找到. 開啟: 在地面搜尋時也會出現, 時間與地點和遊戲本身的野生蘑菇相同. 於世界載入時生效.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_SurfaceMushroo.cn: 关闭: 本模组的十五种蘑菇只能在地下找到. 开启: 在地面搜寻时也会出现, 时间和地点与游戏本身的野生蘑菇相同. 在世界加载时生效.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_TankDrainBelow.en: How fast a switched-on oxygen tank empties while you are below ground, on top of the breathing gear drain rate. The base game empties a full tank in about five and a half minutes at normal speed, in fresh air or foul; 0.25 makes one last about 22 minutes down here, and 1.0 is the base game's rate. Tanks on the surface are left alone.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_TankDrainBelow.ch: 你在地下時, 開啟的氧氣罐排空的速度, 疊加在呼吸裝備消耗速度之上. 原版遊戲在正常速度下約五分半鐘就會用完一整罐, 不論空氣清新或汙濁; 0.25 可讓一罐在地下撐約 22 分鐘, 1.0 則是原版遊戲的速度. 地面上的氧氣罐不受影響.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_TankDrainBelow.cn: 你在地下时, 开启的氧气罐排空的速度, 叠加在呼吸装备消耗速度之上. 原版游戏在正常速度下约五分半钟就会用完一整罐, 不论空气清新或污浊; 0.25 可让一罐在地下撑约 22 分钟, 1.0 则是原版游戏的速度. 地面上的氧气罐不受影响.

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_UndergroundTra.en: Deep Lungs and Bad Back traits
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_UndergroundTra.ch: 肺活量大與腰背痛特質
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_UndergroundTra.cn: 肺活量大与腰背痛特质

Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_UndergroundTra.en: Off: the two traits are not offered at character creation. A character who already has one keeps it.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_UndergroundTra.ch: 關閉: 角色建立時不提供這兩種特質. 已擁有其中之一的角色會保留.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnderGround_UndergroundTra.cn: 关闭: 创建角色时不提供这两种特质. 已拥有其中之一的角色会保留.

Sandbox_HydeCoBeavers_PrepareToRemove_to.en: Removing this mod from a game where a beaver was out at the last save loses the other animals saved around it, your own included. In single player, save once with this version (sleep, or quit) and it should be safe to remove. On a server, turn this on first: no beavers or zombie beavers come out and any that are out go home; let the server save, then remove the mod.
Sandbox_HydeCoBeavers_PrepareToRemove_to.ch: 如果在最後一次存檔時有河狸在外, 從該遊戲移除此模組會讓其周圍儲存的其他動物一起遺失, 包括你自己的動物. 單人遊戲中, 用此版本存檔一次 (睡覺或退出) 後應可安全移除. 在伺服器上, 請先開啟此選項: 河狸與殭屍河狸都不會再出來, 在外的會回巢; 讓伺服器存檔後再移除模組.
Sandbox_HydeCoBeavers_PrepareToRemove_to.cn: 如果最后一次存档时有河狸在外, 从该游戏中移除此模组会导致其周围保存的其他动物一并丢失, 包括你自己的动物. 单人游戏中, 用此版本存档一次 (睡觉或退出) 后应可安全移除. 在服务器上, 请先开启此选项: 河狸和僵尸河狸都不会再出来, 在外的会回巢; 让服务器存档后再移除模组.

Sandbox_HydeCoFrogs_PrepareToRemove_tool.en: Removing this mod from a game where a frog was out at the last save loses the other animals saved around it, your own included. In single player, save once with this version (sleep, or quit), after letting go of any you carry and it should be safe to remove. On a server, turn this on first: no frogs come out and any that are out go home; let the server save, then remove the mod.
Sandbox_HydeCoFrogs_PrepareToRemove_tool.ch: 如果在最後一次存檔時有青蛙在外, 從該遊戲移除此模組會讓其周圍儲存的其他動物一起遺失, 包括你自己的動物. 單人遊戲中, 先放開身上攜帶的青蛙, 再用此版本存檔一次 (睡覺或退出), 之後應可安全移除. 在伺服器上, 請先開啟此選項: 青蛙不會再出來, 在外的會回去; 讓伺服器存檔後再移除模組.
Sandbox_HydeCoFrogs_PrepareToRemove_tool.cn: 如果最后一次存档时有青蛙在外, 从该游戏中移除此模组会导致其周围保存的其他动物一并丢失, 包括你自己的动物. 单人游戏中, 先放开身上携带的青蛙, 再用此版本存档一次 (睡觉或退出), 之后应可安全移除. 在服务器上, 请先开启此选项: 青蛙不会再出来, 在外的会回去; 让服务器存档后再移除模组.

Sandbox_HydeCoRobins_PrepareToRemove_too.en: Removing this mod from a game where a robin was out at the last save loses the other animals saved around it, your own included. In single player, save once with this version (sleep, or quit), after letting go of any you carry and it should be safe to remove. On a server, turn this on first: no robins come out and any that are out go home; let the server save, then remove the mod.
Sandbox_HydeCoRobins_PrepareToRemove_too.ch: 若上次存檔時有知更鳥在外面, 從該遊戲移除此模組會讓存在牠周圍的其他動物遺失, 包括你自己的動物. 單人遊戲中, 先放開你帶著的知更鳥, 再用這個版本存檔一次 (睡覺或離開遊戲), 之後應可安全移除. 在伺服器上, 請先開啟此選項: 不會再有知更鳥出來, 已經在外面的會回家; 等伺服器存檔後, 再移除模組.
Sandbox_HydeCoRobins_PrepareToRemove_too.cn: 如果上次存档时有知更鸟在外面, 从该游戏移除此模组会导致它周围一同保存的其他动物丢失, 包括你自己的动物. 单人游戏中, 先放开你携带的知更鸟, 再用这个版本存档一次 (睡觉或退出游戏), 之后应该就能安全移除. 在服务器上, 请先开启此选项: 不会再有知更鸟出来, 已经在外面的会回家; 等服务器存档后, 再移除模组.

Sandbox_SMA_MartialArts_tooltip.en: XP multiplier for the Martial Arts skill. Used when the global XP multiplier is switched off.
Sandbox_SMA_MartialArts_tooltip.ch: 武術技能的經驗倍率. 在全域經驗倍率關閉時使用.
Sandbox_SMA_MartialArts_tooltip.cn: 武术技能的经验倍率. 在全局经验倍率关闭时使用.

Sandbox_BBP_AdminOnly_tooltip.en: When on, only admins can plan, save, start or build blueprints. Changing it in-game takes effect at once, no restart needed. Constructions already under way pause until it is turned off.
Sandbox_BBP_AdminOnly_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 只有管理員能規劃、儲存、開始或建造藍圖. 在遊戲中變更會立即生效, 不需重新啟動. 已在進行中的工程會暫停, 直到此選項關閉為止.
Sandbox_BBP_AdminOnly_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 只有管理员能规划、保存、开始或建造蓝图. 在游戏中更改会立即生效, 无需重启. 已在进行中的工程会暂停, 直到此选项关闭为止.

Sandbox_BBP_AllowDisassembly_tooltip.en: When on, players see a Disassemble building option on blueprint-built buildings and can take them down for part of their materials. Off by default.
Sandbox_BBP_AllowDisassembly_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 玩家會在以藍圖建造的建築上看到「拆解建築」選項, 並可將其拆除以取回部分材料. 預設關閉.
Sandbox_BBP_AllowDisassembly_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 玩家会在以蓝图建造的建筑上看到“拆解建筑”选项, 并可将其拆除以取回部分材料. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_BBP_Catalog_appliance_tooltip.en: When off, players who are not admins never load the Appliances tiles into their building catalog, whatever they pick in Mod Options. Every loaded tile costs memory, so turn off groups your server does not need if players run out of memory. The basic wooden walls, floors, doors, windows, roofs and stairs always stay, and admins are not affected.
Sandbox_BBP_Catalog_appliance_tooltip.ch: 關閉時, 非管理員玩家的建築型錄一律不會載入家電圖塊, 無論他們在模組選項中如何選擇. 每個載入的圖塊都會佔用記憶體, 若玩家記憶體不足, 請關閉伺服器用不到的群組. 基本的木製牆、地板、門、窗戶、屋頂與樓梯一律保留, 管理員也不受影響.
Sandbox_BBP_Catalog_appliance_tooltip.cn: 关闭时, 非管理员玩家的建造目录永远不会加载家电图块, 无论他们在模组选项中如何选择. 每个加载的图块都会占用内存, 如果玩家内存不足, 请关闭服务器不需要的分组. 基础的木制墙、地板、门、窗户、屋顶和楼梯始终保留, 管理员也不受影响.

Sandbox_BBP_DisassemblyRefund_tooltip.en: Share of the materials a building cost that come back when it is disassembled. They are dropped on the ground where it stood, nails packed into boxes. Pieces built with the admin build cheat give nothing back.
Sandbox_BBP_DisassemblyRefund_tooltip.ch: 建築拆解時可取回的建造材料比例. 材料會掉落在建築原本所在的地面上, 釘子會裝進盒子. 以創造模式建造的構件不會返還任何東西.
Sandbox_BBP_DisassemblyRefund_tooltip.cn: 建筑拆解时可取回的建造材料比例. 材料会掉落在建筑原本所在的地面上, 钉子会装进盒子. 以创造模式建造的构件不会返还任何东西.

Sandbox_BBP_EasyBuild_tooltip.en: When enabled, an entire blueprint can be built in a single stationary action. Materials are still consumed unless the admin build cheat is on.
Sandbox_BBP_EasyBuild_tooltip.ch: 啟用時, 只需原地進行一次動作即可建造整份藍圖. 除非開啟創造模式, 否則仍會消耗材料.
Sandbox_BBP_EasyBuild_tooltip.cn: 启用时, 只需原地进行一次动作即可建造整份蓝图. 除非开启创造模式, 否则仍会消耗材料.

Sandbox_BBP_Progression_tooltip.en: The build menu fills up as you level Carpentry: crude walls at first, everything sensible by level 7, and faster building above it. Electrical work needs Electrical skill. Magazines and studying built examples unlock pieces early. When off, every piece can be built. Changing it in-game takes effect at once.
Sandbox_BBP_Progression_tooltip.ch: 建造選單會隨木工等級提升逐步解鎖: 一開始只有簡陋的牆, 到 7 級時所有合理項目都會解鎖, 之後等級越高建造越快. 電工類項目需要電工技能. 雜誌與觀摩已建成的範例可提早解鎖構件. 關閉時, 所有構件皆可建造. 在遊戲中變更會立即生效.
Sandbox_BBP_Progression_tooltip.cn: 建造菜单会随木工等级提升逐步解锁: 一开始只有简陋的墙, 到 7 级时所有合理项目都会解锁, 之后等级越高建造越快. 电工类项目需要电工技能. 杂志与观摩已建成的范例可提前解锁构件. 关闭时, 所有构件均可建造. 在游戏中更改会立即生效.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AliasStarts.ch: 其他模組職業的工作地點開局
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AliasStarts.cn: 其他模组职业的工作地点开局

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AliasStarts_toolti.en: Lets a job from another mod start where one of ours does. Their job's id, equals sign, our job's name, separated by commas. Example: exoticdancer=Club Dancer. Needs Vanilla Jobs Start at Work Too on.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AliasStarts_toolti.ch: 讓其他模組的職業沿用本模組某個職業的開局地點. 格式: 對方職業的 id、等號、本模組職業名稱, 以逗號分隔. 範例: exoticdancer=Club Dancer. 需開啟「原版職業也在工作地點開局」.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AliasStarts_toolti.cn: 让其他模组的职业沿用本模组某个职业的开局地点. 格式: 对方职业的 id、等号、本模组职业名称, 以逗号分隔. 示例: exoticdancer=Club Dancer. 需开启“原版职业也在工作地点开局”.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AskWhereToStart.ch: 詢問在工作地點或在家開局
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AskWhereToStart.cn: 询问在工作地点或在家开局

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AskWhereToStart_to.en: When you press Play, ask whether to start at work or at home. Off: you start at work whenever your job has a workplace anywhere on the map. Single player only.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AskWhereToStart_to.ch: 按下開始遊戲時, 詢問要在工作地點還是在家開局. 關閉: 只要你的職業在地圖上任何地方有工作地點, 就一律在工作地點開局. 僅限單人模式.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_AskWhereToStart_to.cn: 点击开始游戏时, 询问要在工作地点还是在家开局. 关闭: 只要你的职业在地图上任何地方有工作地点, 就一律在工作地点开局. 仅限单人模式.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_ClearStartBuilding.en: Zombies are kept out of the whole building you start in for the first few minutes. The game on its own clears only part of a big building. Single player only.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_ClearStartBuilding.ch: 開局後的最初幾分鐘內, 你開局所在的整棟建築都不會有殭屍. 遊戲本身只會清除大型建築的一部分. 僅限單人模式.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_ClearStartBuilding.cn: 开局后的最初几分钟内, 你开局所在的整栋建筑都不会有僵尸. 游戏本身只会清除大型建筑的一部分. 仅限单人模式.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_EveryJobStartsAtWo.en: Vanilla Jobs Start at Work Too
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_EveryJobStartsAtWo.ch: 原版職業也在工作地點開局
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_EveryJobStartsAtWo.cn: 原版职业也在工作地点开局

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_EveryJobStartsAtWo.en: The game's own jobs and other mods' jobs also start at work: a police officer at the police station, a chef in a kitchen. Off: only Job Fair jobs do.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_EveryJobStartsAtWo.ch: 原版職業與其他模組的職業也會在工作地點開局: 警官在警察局, 廚師在廚房. 關閉: 只有就業博覽會職業會這樣.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_EveryJobStartsAtWo.cn: 原版职业与其他模组的职业也会在工作地点开局: 警官在警察局, 厨师在厨房. 关闭: 只有招聘会职业会这样.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HiddenJobs_tooltip.en: Jobs to remove from character creation, separated by commas. Example: Cult Leader, Barber. A group name hides the whole group: Airport, Coalfield, Criminals, Medical, Retail, Sports and the rest. Unemployed is always kept.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HiddenJobs_tooltip.ch: 要從角色建立中移除的職業, 以逗號分隔. 範例: Cult Leader, Barber. 輸入職業類別名稱即隱藏整個類別: Airport、Coalfield、Criminals、Medical、Retail、Sports 等. 無業遊民一律保留.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HiddenJobs_tooltip.cn: 要从角色创建中移除的职业, 以逗号分隔. 示例: Cult Leader, Barber. 输入职业类别名称即隐藏整个类别: Airport、Coalfield、Criminals、Medical、Retail、Sports 等. 无业游民始终保留.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HiddenTraits_toolt.en: Job Fair traits to remove from character creation, separated by commas. Example: Chatterbox, Old Soul.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HiddenTraits_toolt.ch: 要從角色建立中移除的就業博覽會特質, 以逗號分隔. 範例: Chatterbox, Old Soul.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HiddenTraits_toolt.cn: 要从角色创建中移除的招聘会特质, 以逗号分隔. 示例: Chatterbox, Old Soul.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HideTraits.ch: 隱藏所有就業博覽會特質

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HideTraits_tooltip.en: None of Job Fair's 28 traits can be picked at character creation, so only the jobs are added. Traits that come with a job are kept.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HideTraits_tooltip.ch: 角色建立時無法選擇就業博覽會的 28 種特質, 只會加入職業. 職業附帶的特質仍會保留.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_HideTraits_tooltip.cn: 角色创建时无法选择招聘会的 28 种特质, 只会加入职业. 职业附带的特质仍会保留.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShiftAll.ch: 原版職業點數也一併調整
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShiftAll.cn: 原版职业点数也一并调整

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShiftAll_to.en: Adjust All Job Costs also changes the game's own jobs and other mods' jobs, Unemployed included.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShiftAll_to.ch: 「調整所有職業點數」也會套用到原版職業與其他模組的職業, 包括無業遊民.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShiftAll_to.cn: “调整所有职业点数”也会应用到原版职业与其他模组的职业, 包括无业游民.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShift_toolt.en: Changes the points of every Job Fair job at once. Negative numbers make jobs cost more points, positive numbers cost fewer. Example: at -2, a job that costs 4 points costs 6. 0 = no change.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShift_toolt.ch: 一次調整所有就業博覽會職業的點數. 負數讓職業花費更多點數, 正數則花費更少. 範例: 設為 -2 時, 原本花費 4 點的職業會花費 6 點. 0 = 不變.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCostShift_toolt.cn: 一次调整所有招聘会职业的点数. 负数让职业花费更多点数, 正数则花费更少. 示例: 设为 -2 时, 原本花费 4 点的职业会花费 6 点. 0 = 不变.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCosts_tooltip.en: Set the points of any job yourself. Job name, equals sign, points, separated by commas. Example: Cult Leader=-6, Barber=-2. Negative costs points, positive gives points. Works on the game's own jobs too.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCosts_tooltip.ch: 自行設定任何職業的點數. 格式: 職業名稱、等號、點數, 以逗號分隔. 範例: Cult Leader=-6, Barber=-2. 負數花費點數, 正數給予點數. 也適用於原版職業.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_JobCosts_tooltip.cn: 自行设置任何职业的点数. 格式: 职业名称、等号、点数, 以逗号分隔. 示例: Cult Leader=-6, Barber=-2. 负数花费点数, 正数给予点数. 也适用于原版职业.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_PrepareToRemove_to.en: Turn on before removing Job Fair, or characters made with it will not load. Load and save each character once: Job Fair traits are taken off and Job Fair jobs become Unemployed (skills and items stay). Then remove the mod. On a server, every player must log in once.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_PrepareToRemove_to.ch: 移除就業博覽會前請先開啟, 否則用它建立的角色將無法載入. 每個角色載入並存檔一次: 就業博覽會特質會被移除, 就業博覽會職業會變成無業遊民 (技能和物品保留). 然後再移除模組. 在伺服器上, 每位玩家都必須登入一次.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_PrepareToRemove_to.cn: 移除招聘会前请先开启, 否则用它创建的角色将无法加载. 每个角色加载并存档一次: 招聘会特质会被移除, 招聘会职业会变成无业游民 (技能和物品保留). 然后再移除模组. 在服务器上, 每位玩家都必须登录一次.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_StartKits_tooltip.en: Job Fair jobs start with the tools of their trade, the key to their workplace, and for some jobs a work vehicle parked nearby.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_StartKits_tooltip.ch: 就業博覽會職業開局時會帶著本行的工具、工作地點的鑰匙, 部分職業還有一輛工作用車停在附近.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_StartKits_tooltip.cn: 招聘会职业开局时会带着本行的工具、工作地点的钥匙, 部分职业还有一辆工作用车停在附近.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_StartStates_toolti.en: Story jobs start the way their story says: the Hospital Patient sick, the Evacuee filthy and hungry, the Just Married drunk, the Escaped Inmate bloodied, and so on. Off: everyone starts healthy and clean.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_StartStates_toolti.ch: 劇情職業會依其背景故事開局: 住院病患帶病, 撤離者又髒又餓, 新婚人士醉酒, 越獄犯滿身是血, 以此類推. 關閉: 所有人都以健康乾淨的狀態開局.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_StartStates_toolti.cn: 剧情职业会按其背景故事开局: 住院病人带病, 撤离者又脏又饿, 新婚人士醉酒, 越狱犯满身是血, 以此类推. 关闭: 所有人都以健康干净的状态开局.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_WorkBags_tooltip.en: Job Fair jobs also start with a bag for their trade (a medic bag, a toolbox, a cooler) with extra supplies and an everyday weapon (a frying pan, a pipe wrench, a golf club). Free, like the game's starter kit.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_WorkBags_tooltip.ch: 就業博覽會職業開局時還會帶一個本行的包 (醫療包、工具箱、保溫箱), 內含額外物資與一件日常武器 (平底煎鍋、管鉗、高爾夫球桿). 免費, 就像遊戲的新手包.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_WorkBags_tooltip.cn: 招聘会职业开局时还会带一个本行的包 (医疗包、工具箱、保温箱), 内含额外物资与一件日常武器 (平底煎锅、管钳、高尔夫球杆). 免费, 就像游戏的新手包.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_WorkplaceStarts_to.en: Your character starts at their workplace instead of at home. If the town you picked has no workplace for your job, you start at the nearest one in another town. Jobs tied to one place (Coalfield, the country club, the airport) always start there.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_WorkplaceStarts_to.ch: 你的角色會在工作地點而不是在家開局. 若你選的城鎮沒有你職業的工作地點, 會改在其他城鎮最近的工作地點開局. 綁定單一地點的職業 (煤田鎮、郊野俱樂部、機場) 一律在該處開局.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_WorkplaceStarts_to.cn: 你的角色会在工作地点而不是在家开局. 若你选择的城镇没有你职业的工作地点, 会改在其他城镇最近的工作地点开局. 绑定单一地点的职业 (煤田镇、郊野俱乐部、机场) 始终在该处开局.

Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_ZombieCoworkers_to.en: When you start at work, this many of your coworkers have already turned: zombies in their work clothes, somewhere in your building, a few seconds after you arrive. 0 = none. Above 0, Clear Zombies from Workplace is skipped.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_ZombieCoworkers_to.ch: 在工作地點開局時, 有這麼多名同事已經屍變: 你抵達幾秒後, 穿著工作服的殭屍會出現在你所在建築的某處. 0 = 無. 大於 0 時, 會略過「清除工作地點殭屍」.
Sandbox_HydeCoJobFair_ZombieCoworkers_to.cn: 在工作地点开局时, 有这么多名同事已经尸变: 你抵达几秒后, 穿着工作服的僵尸会出现在你所在建筑的某处. 0 = 无. 大于 0 时, 会跳过“清除工作地点僵尸”.

Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Health_tooltip.en: How much health every monster has. 100%% is the mod as made; 75%% makes them die about a quarter sooner, 125%% makes them take about a quarter more hits, 150%% half as many again. The Human Flower cannot be hurt either way. Monsters already in the world keep the health they have.
Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Health_tooltip.ch: 每隻怪物的生命值. 100%% 為模組原始設定; 75%% 會讓它們大約早四分之一倒下, 125%% 會讓它們多承受大約四分之一的攻擊次數, 150%% 則再多一半. 無論如何設定, 人花都無法被傷害. 已在世界中的怪物會保留目前的生命值.
Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Health_tooltip.cn: 每种怪物的生命值. 100%%为模组原始设定; 75%%会让它们大约提前四分之一死亡, 125%%会让它们多承受大约四分之一的攻击次数, 150%%则再多一半. 无论如何设置, 人花都无法受到伤害. 世界中已有的怪物会保留当前的生命值.

Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Loudness_tooltip.en: How loud the monsters are. 100%% is the mod as made. Footsteps and some hit and death sounds stay at 100%%. The Sawrunner's chase music is not changed by this.
Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Loudness_tooltip.ch: 怪物的音量大小. 100%% 為模組原始設定. 腳步聲以及部分受擊與死亡音效會維持 100%% 不變. 電鋸狂奔者的追逐音樂不受此設定影響.
Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Loudness_tooltip.cn: 怪物的音量大小. 100%%为模组原始设定. 脚步声以及部分受击和死亡音效保持100%%不变. 电锯狂奔者的追逐音乐不受此设置影响.

Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Ragdolls_tooltip.en: On: a monster hit hard by a car is thrown as a ragdoll and gets up again. Single-player only (the game has no ragdolls in multiplayer) and only with the game's own ragdoll option on. Not the Taller, the Human Flower or the Flygare.
Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Ragdolls_tooltip.ch: 開啟: 被車輛猛烈撞擊的怪物會以布娃娃系統被拋飛, 之後再爬起來. 僅限單人遊戲 (遊戲在多人模式中沒有布娃娃系統), 且必須開啟遊戲本身的布娃娃系統選項. 不適用於高個子、人花與 Flygare.
Sandbox_COF_Monsters_Ragdolls_tooltip.cn: 开启: 被车辆猛烈撞击的怪物会以布娃娃系统被撞飞, 随后重新站起. 仅限单人游戏 (游戏在多人模式中没有布娃娃系统), 且必须开启游戏自带的布娃娃系统选项. 不适用于高个子、人花和吊床怪.

Sandbox_Gunsmith_AmmoLoot_tooltip.en: A multiplier for how often Gunsmith rounds, boxes and cartons spawn. 1 = leave it alone: ammo simply follows the game's own ammo loot setting (set the game to Rare and Gunsmith ammo is rare). 2 = twice as often, 0.5 = half, 0 = never. It multiplies the game's setting, it does not replace it: raising both stacks, and a high value can fill a container and leave less room for other loot.
Sandbox_Gunsmith_AmmoLoot_tooltip.ch: 倍率, 控制槍匠的子彈、盒裝與箱裝彈藥的生成頻率. 1 = 維持原樣: 彈藥直接依照遊戲本身的彈藥物資設定 (遊戲設為稀少, 槍匠彈藥就稀少). 2 = 兩倍頻率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 從不生成. 此值是乘上遊戲設定, 而非取代: 兩者都調高會疊加, 數值過高可能塞滿容器, 讓其他物資的空間變少.
Sandbox_Gunsmith_AmmoLoot_tooltip.cn: 倍率, 控制枪匠的子弹、盒装和箱装弹药的生成频率. 1 = 保持原样: 弹药直接按照游戏本身的弹药物资设置 (游戏设为稀少, 枪匠弹药就稀少). 2 = 两倍频率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 从不生成. 此值是乘以游戏设置, 而不是取代: 两者都调高会叠加, 数值过高可能塞满容器, 让其他物资的空间变少.

Sandbox_Gunsmith_GunLoot_tooltip.en: A multiplier for how often Gunsmith guns spawn as loot (gun stores, police, army, pawn shops, homes). 1 = leave it alone: guns simply follow the game's own firearm loot setting. 2 = twice as often, 0.5 = half, 0 = never. It multiplies the game's setting, it does not replace it: raising both stacks (game on Abundant and this on 3 is a lot of guns).
Sandbox_Gunsmith_GunLoot_tooltip.ch: 倍率, 控制槍匠槍械作為物資的生成頻率 (槍械店、警局、軍方、當鋪、民宅). 1 = 維持原樣: 槍械直接依照遊戲本身的槍械物資設定. 2 = 兩倍頻率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 從不生成. 此值是乘上遊戲設定, 而非取代: 兩者都調高會疊加 (遊戲設為豐富且此值設為 3 時, 槍會非常多).
Sandbox_Gunsmith_GunLoot_tooltip.cn: 倍率, 控制枪匠枪械作为物资的生成频率 (枪械店、警局、军队、当铺、民宅). 1 = 保持原样: 枪械直接按照游戏本身的枪械物资设置. 2 = 两倍频率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 从不生成. 此值是乘以游戏设置, 而不是取代: 两者都调高会叠加 (游戏设为丰富且此值设为 3 时, 枪会非常多).

Sandbox_Gunsmith_MagazineLoot_tooltip.en: A multiplier for how often loose magazines and clips spawn. 1 = leave it alone: they follow the game's own loot setting. 2 = twice as often, 0.5 = half, 0 = never. It multiplies the game's setting, it does not replace it: raising both stacks. Guns in a gun store's rifle rack come with one to three of their own magazines whatever this is set to.
Sandbox_Gunsmith_MagazineLoot_tooltip.ch: 倍率, 控制散落彈匣與彈夾的生成頻率. 1 = 維持原樣: 直接依照遊戲本身的物資設定. 2 = 兩倍頻率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 從不生成. 此值是乘上遊戲設定, 而非取代: 兩者都調高會疊加. 無論此值設為多少, 槍械店步槍架上的槍都會附帶一到三個專用彈匣.
Sandbox_Gunsmith_MagazineLoot_tooltip.cn: 倍率, 控制散落弹匣和弹夹的生成频率. 1 = 保持原样: 直接按照游戏本身的物资设置. 2 = 两倍频率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 从不生成. 此值是乘以游戏设置, 而不是取代: 两者都调高会叠加. 无论此值设为多少, 枪械店步枪架上的枪都会附带一到三个专用弹匣.

Sandbox_Gunsmith_PartLoot_tooltip.en: A multiplier for how often loose gun parts spawn: barrels, stocks, grips, sights, scopes, mounts, muzzle devices, lights and lasers. 1 = as the mod ships. 2 = twice as often, 0.5 = half, 0 = never. Parts only spawn in gun places (gun stores, police and army storage, surplus stores), so a high value fills those shelves and can leave less room there for other things.
Sandbox_Gunsmith_PartLoot_tooltip.ch: 倍率, 控制散落槍械零件的生成頻率: 槍管、槍托、握把、瞄具、瞄準鏡、鏡座、槍口裝置、戰術燈與雷射. 1 = MOD 原始設定. 2 = 兩倍頻率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 從不生成. 零件只會在槍械相關地點生成 (槍械店、警局與軍方倉庫、軍品店), 因此數值過高會塞滿那些貨架, 讓那裡其他物品的空間變少.
Sandbox_Gunsmith_PartLoot_tooltip.cn: 倍率, 控制散落枪械零件的生成频率: 枪管、枪托、握把、瞄具、瞄准镜、镜座、枪口装置、战术灯和激光. 1 = MOD 原始设置. 2 = 两倍频率, 0.5 = 一半, 0 = 从不生成. 零件只会在枪械相关地点生成 (枪械店、警局和军队仓库、军品店), 因此数值过高会塞满那些货架, 让那里其他物品的空间变少.

Sandbox_ZomVisFix_AffectZombieVision_too.en: let zombies revealed by this mod also detect the player (default: true)
Sandbox_ZomVisFix_AffectZombieVision_too.ch: 讓本模組顯示的殭屍也能發現玩家 (預設: 開啟)
Sandbox_ZomVisFix_AffectZombieVision_too.cn: 让此模组显示的僵尸也能发现玩家 (默认: 开启)

Sandbox_ZomVisFix_HardMode_tooltip.en: a zombie's entire width needs to be unobscured in order to be revealed by this mod (default: false)
Sandbox_ZomVisFix_HardMode_tooltip.ch: 殭屍的整個寬度都必須未被遮擋, 才會被本模組顯示 (預設: 關閉)
Sandbox_ZomVisFix_HardMode_tooltip.cn: 僵尸的整个宽度都必须未被遮挡, 才会被此模组显示 (默认: 关闭)

Sandbox_HydeCoOrchard_PrepareToRemove_to.en: Turn on before removing Orchard, or characters with an Orchard job or trait will not load. Load and save each character once: Orchard traits are taken off and Orchard jobs become Unemployed (skills and items stay). Then remove the mod. On a server, every player must log in once.
Sandbox_HydeCoOrchard_PrepareToRemove_to.ch: 移除果園模組前請先開啟此選項, 否則擁有果園職業或特質的角色將無法載入. 每個角色都要載入並存檔一次: 果園特質會被移除, 果園職業會變成「自訂職業」 (技能與物品保留). 然後再移除模組. 在伺服器上, 每名玩家都必須登入一次.
Sandbox_HydeCoOrchard_PrepareToRemove_to.cn: 移除果园模组前请先开启此选项, 否则拥有果园职业或特质的角色将无法加载. 每个角色都要加载并存档一次: 果园特质会被移除, 果园职业会变为“无业游民” (技能和物品保留). 然后再移除模组. 在服务器上, 每名玩家都必须登录一次.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_EnableFlood_toolt.en: Torrential rain, then rising water. After up to an hour of rain the flood rises over up to two hours, floods streets and houses up to the depth set below, then drains away when the storm ends. Deep water exhausts and can drown you.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_EnableFlood_toolt.ch: 先是傾盆大雨, 接著水位上漲. 下雨最多一小時後, 洪水會在最多兩小時內上漲, 淹沒街道與房屋直到下方設定的深度, 風暴結束後才退去. 深水會耗盡體力, 還可能讓你溺斃.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_EnableFlood_toolt.cn: 先是倾盆大雨, 然后水位上涨. 降雨最多一小时后, 洪水会在最多两小时内上涨, 将街道和房屋淹没至下方设置的深度, 风暴结束后退去. 深水会耗尽体力, 还可能让你溺亡.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_EnableWildfire_to.en: Hot, dry, windy days when a fire front sweeps in from the countryside, burning grass and trees and anything in its way, buildings included. Needs the vanilla fire spread option on to spread beyond the front. June to October.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_EnableWildfire_to.ch: 炎熱、乾燥、多風的日子裡, 火線從鄉間席捲而來, 燒毀草地、樹木與沿途一切, 包括建築物. 必須開啟原版的火勢蔓延選項, 火勢才會蔓延到火線以外. 六月至十月.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_EnableWildfire_to.cn: 炎热、干燥、多风的日子里, 火线从乡间席卷而来, 烧毁草地、树木和沿途一切, 包括建筑物. 需要开启原版的火势蔓延选项, 火势才会蔓延到火线以外. 六月至十月.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_FirstStormDay_too.en: No extreme weather before this many days have passed.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_FirstStormDay_too.ch: 經過這麼多天之前不會出現極端天氣.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_FirstStormDay_too.cn: 在经过这么多天之前不会出现极端天气.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_FloodWaterServer_.en: The server lays the standing water of a flash flood around every player and sends it to everyone, so all players see the same flood. Off: players still get the puddles, rain, wading, deep water and a murky screen tint. Floating debris is single-player only. Single-player always shows the water.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_FloodWaterServer_.ch: 伺服器會在每名玩家周圍鋪設暴洪的積水並同步給所有人, 讓所有玩家看到相同的洪水. 關閉: 玩家仍會有水坑、雨、涉水、深水效果與混濁的畫面色調. 漂浮碎片僅限單人遊戲. 單人遊戲一律顯示積水.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_FloodWaterServer_.cn: 服务器会在每名玩家周围铺设暴洪积水并同步给所有人, 让所有玩家看到相同的洪水. 关闭: 玩家仍会有水坑、降雨、涉水、深水效果和浑浊的屏幕色调. 漂浮碎片仅限单人游戏. 单人游戏始终显示积水.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_ShowTestMenu_tool.en: Adds an 'Extreme Weather' entry to the right-click menu to start or stop storms. Always shown to admins and in single-player debug mode. In multiplayer only admins (and the co-op host) see it.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_ShowTestMenu_tool.ch: 在右鍵選單加入「極端天氣」項目, 用來開始或停止風暴. 管理員與單人除錯模式下一律顯示. 多人遊戲中只有管理員 (以及合作模式主機) 看得到.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_ShowTestMenu_tool.cn: 在右键菜单中添加“极端天气”选项, 用于开始或停止风暴. 管理员和单人调试模式下始终显示. 多人游戏中仅管理员 (以及合作模式房主) 可见.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_StormChance_toolt.en: Chance per in-game day that an extreme weather event begins (rolled hourly).
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_StormChance_toolt.ch: 每個遊戲日發生極端天氣事件的機率 (每小時判定一次).
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_StormChance_toolt.cn: 每个游戏日发生极端天气事件的概率 (每小时判定一次).

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoDestroysBu.en: Tornadoes tear apart what they pass over, scaled by strength: EF1 knocks down fences, EF2 starts on roofs and loose objects, EF3 rips off roofs and upper floors, EF4 brings down many walls, EF5 levels buildings to the foundations. Includes player-built bases. The damage is permanent.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoDestroysBu.ch: 龍捲風會依強度撕裂經過的一切: EF1 吹倒圍籬, EF2 開始破壞屋頂與鬆散物品, EF3 掀掉屋頂與上層樓, EF4 推倒許多牆壁, EF5 將建築夷為平地只剩地基. 包括玩家建造的基地. 破壞是永久性的.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoDestroysBu.cn: 龙卷风会按强度撕裂经过的一切: EF1 吹倒围栏, EF2 开始破坏屋顶和松散物品, EF3 掀掉屋顶和上层楼层, EF4 推倒大量墙壁, EF5 将建筑夷为平地只剩地基. 包括玩家建造的基地. 破坏是永久性的.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxEF_tool.en: Tornadoes roll EF1 35 percent, EF2 28, EF3 20, EF4 12, EF5 5 within this range. EF3+ rip off doors and wreck cars, EF4+ uproot trees, EF5 flattens player-built walls and fences.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxEF_tool.ch: 在此範圍內, 龍捲風等級的機率為 EF1 百分之 35、EF2 28、EF3 20、EF4 12、EF5 5. EF3 以上會扯掉門並摧毀車輛, EF4 以上會連根拔起樹木, EF5 會夷平玩家建造的牆壁與圍籬.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxEF_tool.cn: 在此范围内, 龙卷风等级的概率为 EF1 百分之 35、EF2 28、EF3 20、EF4 12、EF5 5. EF3 及以上会扯掉门并摧毁车辆, EF4 及以上会将树木连根拔起, EF5 会夷平玩家建造的墙壁和围栏.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxHours.ch: 龍捲風: 最長持續時間 (小時)
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxHours.cn: 龙卷风: 最长持续时间 (小时)

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxHours_t.en: Longest a tornado lasts, in game hours (72 = 3 days). 0 = use the general maximum storm length. With both left at 0 a tornado never lasts more than 3 hours.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxHours_t.ch: 龍捲風最長持續時間, 以遊戲小時計 (72 = 3 天). 0 = 使用通用的最長風暴時長. 若兩者都保持 0, 龍捲風最多持續 3 小時.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMaxHours_t.cn: 龙卷风最长持续时间, 以游戏小时计 (72 = 3 天). 0 = 使用通用的最长风暴时长. 若两者都保持为 0, 龙卷风最多持续 3 小时.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMinHours.ch: 龍捲風: 最短持續時間 (小時)
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMinHours.cn: 龙卷风: 最短持续时间 (小时)

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMinHours_t.en: Shortest a tornado lasts, in game hours. 0 = use the general minimum storm length.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMinHours_t.ch: 龍捲風最短持續時間, 以遊戲小時計. 0 = 使用通用的最短風暴時長.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoMinHours_t.cn: 龙卷风最短持续时间, 以游戏小时计. 0 = 使用通用的最短风暴时长.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPickup_too.en: EF2+ tornadoes can lift players on foot who get into the funnel, spin them around and throw them clear. Landing damage and fracture chance scale with the EF rating.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPickup_too.ch: EF2 以上的龍捲風可將進入漏斗雲的步行玩家捲起, 旋轉後甩出. 落地傷害與骨折機率隨 EF 等級提高.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPickup_too.cn: EF2 及以上的龙卷风可将进入漏斗云的步行玩家卷起, 旋转后甩出. 落地伤害和骨折概率随 EF 等级提高.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPlayerDeat.ch: 龍捲風落地可致玩家死亡
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPlayerDeat.cn: 龙卷风落地可致玩家死亡

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPlayerDeat.en: A player thrown by a tornado can die on landing: EF3 10 percent, EF4 40 percent, EF5 85 percent. Off = landings only injure.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPlayerDeat.ch: 被龍捲風甩出的玩家可能在落地時死亡: EF3 百分之 10, EF4 百分之 40, EF5 百分之 85. 關閉 = 落地只會受傷.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoPlayerDeat.cn: 被龙卷风甩出的玩家可能在落地时死亡: EF3 百分之 10, EF4 百分之 40, EF5 百分之 85. 关闭 = 落地只会受伤.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoVehicles_t.en: Vehicles in the funnel get picked up and thrown by its winds, trucks and cars with people driving or sitting in them included, more the bigger the tornado: EF1 hops them off the ground, EF2 lifts and spins them, EF3 rolls them, EF4 throws them and EF5 throws them high. Heavier vehicles move less.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoVehicles_t.ch: 漏斗雲中的車輛會被強風捲起並拋出, 卡車以及有人駕駛或乘坐的車輛也不例外, 龍捲風越大威力越強: EF1 使車輛彈離地面, EF2 將其抬起並使其打轉, EF3 使其翻滾, EF4 將其拋飛, EF5 則將其高高拋起. 較重的車輛移動較少.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoVehicles_t.cn: 漏斗云中的车辆会被强风卷起并抛出, 卡车以及有人驾驶或乘坐的车辆也不例外, 龙卷风越大威力越强: EF1 使车辆弹离地面, EF2 将其抬起并使其打转, EF3 使其翻滚, EF4 将其抛飞, EF5 则将其高高抛起. 较重的车辆移动较少.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoZombiePick.en: EF2+ tornadoes sweep up zombies outdoors in the funnel, spin them around and throw them out. Stronger tornadoes kill more of them on landing; survivors may be left crawling.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoZombiePick.ch: EF2 以上的龍捲風會捲起漏斗雲中位於戶外的殭屍, 旋轉後甩出. 龍捲風越強, 落地時死亡的殭屍越多; 倖存的殭屍可能只能爬行.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_TornadoZombiePick.cn: EF2 及以上的龙卷风会卷起漏斗云中位于户外的僵尸, 旋转后甩出. 龙卷风越强, 落地时死亡的僵尸越多; 幸存的僵尸可能只能爬行.

Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_WarningMinutes_to.en: In-game minutes between the emergency broadcast and the storm hitting.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_WarningMinutes_to.ch: 從緊急廣播到風暴來襲之間的遊戲分鐘數.
Sandbox_ExtremeWeather_WarningMinutes_to.cn: 从紧急广播到风暴来袭之间的游戏分钟数.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorBatteryDays.cn: 湿度传感器电池续航 (天)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorBatteryDays_too.en: How many days a full Battery keeps a moisture sensor running when its tile has no electricity.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorBatteryDays_too.ch: 所在格子沒有電力時, 一顆充滿電的電池可讓濕度感測器運作多少天.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorBatteryDays_too.cn: 所在格子没有电力时, 一块充满电的电池可让湿度传感器运行多少天.

Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorLinkRange.ch: 濕度感測器連結範圍 (格)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorLinkRange.cn: 湿度传感器关联范围 (格)

Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorLinkRange_toolt.en: How far from a moisture sensor a valve can be and still be linked to it. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorLinkRange_toolt.ch: 閥門與濕度感測器相距多遠以內仍可與其連結. 0 = 無限制.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_SensorLinkRange_toolt.cn: 阀门与湿度传感器相距多远以内仍可与其关联. 0 = 无限制.

Sandbox_RVInterior_EngineBatteryDamageAf.ch: 引擎/電池損壞影響引擎充電
Sandbox_RVInterior_EngineBatteryDamageAf.cn: 发动机/电池损坏影响发动机充电

Sandbox_RVInterior_EngineBatteryDamageAf.en: On: engine or starter-battery damage reduces engine input, with a 0.0025 /h running floor. Off: use the configured engine input regardless of damage. A stopped or destroyed engine still supplies zero. Marine-bay batteries and shore input are unaffected.
Sandbox_RVInterior_EngineBatteryDamageAf.ch: 開啟: 引擎或啟動電池受損會降低引擎輸入電量, 運轉時最低仍有 0.0025 /h. 關閉: 不論損壞程度, 一律使用設定的引擎輸入電量. 熄火或已損毀的引擎依然不供電. 電池艙內的電池與岸電輸入不受影響.
Sandbox_RVInterior_EngineBatteryDamageAf.cn: 开启: 发动机或启动电池受损会降低发动机输入电量, 运转时最低仍有 0.0025 /h. 关闭: 无论损坏程度, 一律使用设置的发动机输入电量. 熄火或已损毁的发动机依然不供电. 电池舱内的电池和岸电输入不受影响.

Sandbox_BackcountryATVPack.cn: Backcountry 全地形越野车: 新车辆

Sandbox_BackcountryATVPack_EngineVolume_.en: How loud the quad's engine is, for everyone. 100 is normal, 0 is silent, 200 is twice as loud.
Sandbox_BackcountryATVPack_EngineVolume_.ch: 全地形車引擎的音量, 對所有人生效. 100 為正常, 0 為靜音, 200 為兩倍音量.
Sandbox_BackcountryATVPack_EngineVolume_.cn: 全地形越野车引擎的音量, 对所有人生效. 100 为正常, 0 为静音, 200 为两倍音量.

Sandbox_BackcountryATVPack_FlipQuad_tool.cn: 让玩家可以通过右键菜单将翻倒的车辆翻正, 使车轮重新着地.

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorRed.ch: 原款全地形車顏色: 紅色
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorRed.cn: 原款全地形越野车颜色: 红色

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorRed_tooltip.en: Ticked: new original quads can spawn in this color. Untick a color and none spawn in it; quads already in it get a ticked color. Untick all but White for the classic look.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorRed_tooltip.ch: 勾選: 新生成的原款全地形車可以是此顏色. 取消勾選某個顏色後就不會再生成該顏色; 已是該顏色的全地形車會改為某個已勾選的顏色. 若要經典外觀, 只保留白色勾選即可.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorRed_tooltip.cn: 勾选: 新生成的原款全地形越野车可以是此颜色. 取消勾选某个颜色后就不会再生成该颜色; 已是该颜色的全地形越野车会改为某个已勾选的颜色. 若要经典外观, 只保留白色勾选即可.

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorWhite.ch: 原款全地形車顏色: 白色
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorWhite.cn: 原款全地形越野车颜色: 白色

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorWhite_toolti.en: Ticked: new original quads can spawn in this color. Untick a color and none spawn in it; quads already in it get a ticked color. Untick all but White for the classic look.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorWhite_toolti.ch: 勾選: 新生成的原款全地形車可以是此顏色. 取消勾選某個顏色後就不會再生成該顏色; 已是該顏色的全地形車會改為某個已勾選的顏色. 若要經典外觀, 只保留白色勾選即可.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorWhite_toolti.cn: 勾选: 新生成的原款全地形越野车可以是此颜色. 取消勾选某个颜色后就不会再生成该颜色; 已是该颜色的全地形越野车会改为某个已勾选的颜色. 若要经典外观, 只保留白色勾选即可.

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorYellow.ch: 原款全地形車顏色: 黃色
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorYellow.cn: 原款全地形越野车颜色: 黄色

Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorYellow_toolt.en: Ticked: new original quads can spawn in this color. Untick a color and none spawn in it; quads already in it get a ticked color. Untick all but White for the classic look.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorYellow_toolt.ch: 勾選: 新生成的原款全地形車可以是此顏色. 取消勾選某個顏色後就不會再生成該顏色; 已是該顏色的全地形車會改為某個已勾選的顏色. 若要經典外觀, 只保留白色勾選即可.
Sandbox_BackcountryATV_ColorYellow_toolt.cn: 勾选: 新生成的原款全地形越野车可以是此颜色. 取消勾选某个颜色后就不会再生成该颜色; 已是该颜色的全地形越野车会改为某个已勾选的颜色. 若要经典外观, 只保留白色勾选即可.

Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_PreferTownsAndR.en: Events with scenes look for a place in towns, trailer parks and roads first. They only happen in forests or fields when there is no other place in range
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_PreferTownsAndR.ch: 有場景的事件會優先在城鎮、拖車公園與道路上尋找地點. 只有在範圍內沒有其他地點時, 才會發生在森林或田野中
Sandbox_ReactiveSEScenes_PreferTownsAndR.cn: 带场景的事件会优先在城镇、拖车公园和道路上寻找地点. 只有在范围内没有其他地点时, 才会发生在森林或田野中

Sandbox_ReactiveSEWorld_AllowEventsBeyon.en: Allow Events Across the Ohio River
Sandbox_ReactiveSEWorld_AllowEventsBeyon.ch: 允許事件發生在俄亥俄河對岸
Sandbox_ReactiveSEWorld_AllowEventsBeyon.cn: 允许事件发生在俄亥俄河对岸

Sandbox_ReactiveSEWorld_AllowEventsBeyon.en: On the vanilla map nothing across the Ohio river is reachable (north of Riverside and West Point, west and north of Louisville), so events never happen there. Enable only if a map mod adds content on that side
Sandbox_ReactiveSEWorld_AllowEventsBeyon.ch: 在原版地圖上, 俄亥俄河對岸的區域都無法抵達 (河畔鎮與西點鎮以北, 路易斯維爾以西與以北), 因此事件從不會在那裡發生. 僅在地圖模組於該側新增內容時才啟用
Sandbox_ReactiveSEWorld_AllowEventsBeyon.cn: 在原版地图上, 俄亥俄河对岸的区域都无法到达 (河畔镇和西点镇以北, 路易斯维尔以西和以北), 因此事件永远不会在那里发生. 仅在地图模组在该侧添加内容时才启用

Sandbox_HDsFood_Freshness_tooltip.en: Adjusts how long this mod's food stays fresh. Vanilla Level: about 5-6 days, Medium: about 10-13 days, Generous: about 20-25 days. Does not affect food that already exists.
Sandbox_HDsFood_Freshness_tooltip.ch: 調整本 MOD 食物的保鮮時間. 原版水準: 約 5-6 天, 中等: 約 10-13 天, 寬裕: 約 20-25 天. 不影響已存在的食物.
Sandbox_HDsFood_Freshness_tooltip.cn: 调整本模组食物的保鲜时间. 原版水平: 约 5-6 天, 中等: 约 10-13 天, 宽裕: 约 20-25 天. 不影响已经存在的食物.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout.ch: MFS 6 - 出廠配件與殭屍掉落
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout.cn: MFS 6 - 出厂配件与僵尸掉落

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_AlwaysSto.en: When on, a gun that takes a stock always spawns with one from its loadout list (with its stock adapter where needed). Off: the stock rolls like any other slot.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_AlwaysSto.ch: 開啟時, 可安裝槍托的槍械生成時必定附帶一個出自其出廠配件清單的槍托 (必要時連同槍托轉接器). 關閉: 槍托與其他槽位一樣隨機判定.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_AlwaysSto.cn: 开启时, 可安装枪托的枪械刷新时必定附带一个出自其出厂配件列表的枪托 (必要时连同枪托转接器). 关闭: 枪托与其他槽位一样随机判定.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ArmedZomb.ch: 僅限看似持有武器的殭屍掉落
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ArmedZomb.cn: 仅限看似持有武器的僵尸掉落

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ArmedZomb.ch: 警察、士兵、獵人、生存主義者、強盜…
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ArmedZomb.cn: 警察、士兵、猎人、生存主义者、强盗…

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_DropMagaz.en: Dropped Guns Come with a Magazine
A gun dropped by a zombie also brings one of its magazines.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_DropMagaz.ch: 殭屍掉落的槍械也會附帶一個該槍的彈匣.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_DropMagaz.cn: 僵尸掉落的枪械也会附带一个该枪的弹匣.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_Enabled_t.en: Newly generated MFS guns (containers, vehicles and zombie drops) may come with attachments from each gun's loadout list. Parts the vanilla upgrade roll already attached are kept. Existing items are never changed.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_Enabled_t.ch: 新產生的 MFS 槍械 (容器、車輛與殭屍掉落) 可能會附帶該槍出廠配件清單中的配件. 原版升級判定已安裝的部件會保留. 既有物品永遠不會被更改.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_Enabled_t.cn: 新生成的 MFS 枪械 (容器、车辆和僵尸掉落) 可能会附带该枪出厂配件列表中的配件. 原版升级判定已安装的部件会保留. 现有物品永远不会被更改.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_PartChanc.en: For each slot in a gun's loadout list (optic, grip, light, laser, muzzle, bipod, sling...), the chance that one listed part is attached. 0 leaves guns bare except the stock.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_PartChanc.ch: 槍械出廠配件清單中的每個槽位 (瞄具、握把、槍燈、雷射、槍口裝置、兩腳架、槍背帶…), 安裝其中一個所列部件的機率. 0 表示除了槍托外不安裝任何配件.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_PartChanc.cn: 枪械出厂配件列表中的每个槽位 (瞄具、握把、枪灯、激光、枪口装置、两脚架、枪背带…), 安装其中一个所列部件的几率. 0 表示除枪托外不安装任何配件.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_PartLootF.en: While spawn attachments are on, loose attachment loot is multiplied by this (on top of the MFS 3 multipliers), because guns now bring parts with them. 1 keeps the old amount.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_PartLootF.ch: 開啟「槍械生成時附帶配件」時, 散裝配件物資會乘以此倍率 (疊加在 MFS 3 的倍率之上), 因為槍械現在會自帶部件. 1 維持原本的數量.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_PartLootF.cn: 开启“枪械刷新时附带配件”时, 散装配件物资会乘以此倍率 (叠加在 MFS 3 的倍率之上), 因为枪械现在会自带部件. 1 保持原来的数量.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_RarePartC.ch: 消音器 / 下掛式發射器機率 (%%)
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_RarePartC.cn: 消音器 / 下挂式发射器几率 (%%)

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_RarePartC.en: If a loadout list names a suppressor or an underbarrel grenade launcher, it is only used this often when its slot is picked. Default 5.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_RarePartC.ch: 若出廠配件清單中列有消音器或下掛式榴彈發射器, 抽中其槽位時只會以此機率使用它. 預設: 5.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_RarePartC.cn: 若出厂配件列表中列有消音器或下挂式榴弹发射器, 抽中其槽位时只会以此几率使用它. 默认: 5.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.en: Rolled separately for each calibre, like loose ammo. Default 0.2. If Riko's Ammo Loot Drop box sub-mod is on, hers is used and this is skipped.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.ch: 與散裝彈藥一樣, 每種口徑分別判定. 預設: 0.2. 若已啟用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的彈藥盒子模組, 則由該子模組處理掉落並略過此項.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.cn: 与散装弹药一样, 每种口径分别判定. 默认: 0.2. 若已启用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的弹药盒子模组, 则由该子模组处理掉落并跳过此项.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.ch: 殭屍散裝彈藥掉落機率 (%%)
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.cn: 僵尸散装弹药掉落几率 (%%)

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.en: Rolled separately for each calibre the zombie could use. A hit leaves 1 to the maximum below. Calibres whose guns are all off never drop. Default 2. If Riko's Ammo Loot Drop ammo sub-mod is on, hers is used and this is skipped.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.ch: 針對該殭屍可能使用的每種口徑分別判定. 判定成功時會留下 1 發至下方上限的子彈. 所屬槍械全部關閉的口徑永遠不會掉落. 預設: 2. 若已啟用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的彈藥子模組, 則由該子模組處理掉落並略過此項.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieAmm.cn: 针对该僵尸可能使用的每种口径分别判定. 判定成功时会留下 1 发至下方上限的子弹. 所属枪械全部关闭的口径永远不会掉落. 默认: 2. 若已启用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的弹药子模组, 则由该子模组处理掉落并跳过此项.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieGun.en: Percent chance that a zombie carries an MFS gun. The gun is chosen from the guns this zombie could carry, using the MFS 2 rates; guns set to 0 never drop. Default 0.1 (about 1 corpse in 1000). If Riko's Ammo Loot Drop Weapons sub-mod (MFS edition) is on, hers is used and this is skipped; disable it or set its rate to 0 to use this patch's guns.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieGun.ch: 殭屍攜帶 MFS 槍械的百分比機率. 槍械會依 MFS 2 的生成率, 從該殭屍可能攜帶的槍械中選出; 設為 0 的槍械永遠不會掉落. 預設: 0.1 (約每 1000 具屍體 1 具). 若已啟用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的武器子模組 (MFS 版), 則由該子模組處理掉落並略過此項; 若要使用本修正檔的槍械, 請停用該子模組或將其機率設為 0.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieGun.cn: 僵尸携带 MFS 枪械的百分比几率. 枪械会按 MFS 2 的刷新率, 从该僵尸可能携带的枪械中选出; 设为 0 的枪械永远不会掉落. 默认: 0.1 (约每 1000 具尸体 1 具). 若已启用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的武器子模组 (MFS 版), 则由该子模组处理掉落并跳过此项; 若要使用本补丁的枪械, 请禁用该子模组或将其几率设为 0.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieLoo.ch: 每次掉落的散裝子彈上限
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieLoo.cn: 每次掉落的散装子弹上限

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieLoo.en: Upper limit of loose rounds left by one ammo drop.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieLoo.ch: 單次彈藥掉落所留下散裝子彈的數量上限.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieLoo.cn: 单次弹药掉落所留下散装子弹的数量上限.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.ch: 殭屍備用彈匣掉落機率 (%%)
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.cn: 僵尸备用弹匣掉落几率 (%%)

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.en: Percent chance that a zombie carries a spare magazine for one of the guns it could carry. Default 0.5. If Riko's Ammo Loot Drop Magazines sub-mod is on, hers is used and this is skipped; disable it or set its rate to 0 to use this patch's.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.ch: 殭屍攜帶備用彈匣的百分比機率, 該彈匣屬於殭屍可能攜帶的其中一把槍械. 預設: 0.5. 若已啟用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的彈匣子模組, 則由該子模組處理掉落並略過此項; 若要使用本修正檔提供的彈匣, 請停用該子模組或將其機率設為 0.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.cn: 僵尸携带备用弹匣的百分比几率, 该弹匣属于僵尸可能携带的其中一把枪械. 默认: 0.5. 若已启用 Riko's Ammo Loot Drop 的弹匣子模组, 则由该子模组处理掉落并跳过此项; 若要使用本补丁提供的弹匣, 请禁用该子模组或将其几率设为 0.

Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.en: Most rounds already in a dropped magazine, as a percent of its capacity (random from 1). 0 leaves it empty.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.ch: 掉落彈匣內已裝子彈數的上限, 以彈匣容量的百分比表示 (從 1 起隨機). 0 表示彈匣為空.
Sandbox_MFSCommunityFixLoadout_ZombieMag.cn: 掉落弹匣内已装子弹数的上限, 以弹匣容量的百分比表示 (从 1 起随机). 0 表示弹匣为空.

Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisFade_tooltip.en: Cold NPC campfires and checkpoint props go once nobody is near. 0 keeps them.
Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisFade_tooltip.ch: 附近沒人時, NPC留下的熄滅營火與檢查哨道具會被移除. 0 為保留.
Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisFade_tooltip.cn: 附近没人时, NPC留下的熄灭营火和检查站道具会被移除. 0 为保留.

Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisRoadCamps.ch: 舊的路邊營火也會消失
Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisRoadCamps.cn: 旧的路边营火也会消失

Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisRoadCamps_tooltip.en: Cold roadside campfires from before 2.22 fade too. Can take a burnt-out fire a player left by a road.
Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisRoadCamps_tooltip.ch: 2.22 版之前留下的熄滅路邊營火也會消失. 可能連玩家留在路邊、已燒完的營火也一併移除.
Sandbox_RNPC_DebrisRoadCamps_tooltip.cn: 2.22 版之前留下的熄灭路边营火也会消失. 可能连玩家留在路边、已烧完的营火也一并移除.

Sandbox_RNPC_DesperateRob.ch: 走投無路的倖存者會搶劫
Sandbox_RNPC_DesperateRob.cn: 走投无路的幸存者会抢劫

Sandbox_RNPC_DesperateRob_tooltip.en: Neutral people short of food, medicine or ammo stop players and ask for some.
Sandbox_RNPC_DesperateRob_tooltip.ch: 缺少食物、藥品或彈藥的中立人士會攔下玩家, 向玩家討一些.
Sandbox_RNPC_DesperateRob_tooltip.cn: 缺少食物、药品或弹药的中立人员会拦下玩家, 向玩家讨要一些.

Sandbox_RNPC_HostileShare.ch: 新來者中掠奪者與盜匪的比例 (百分比)
Sandbox_RNPC_HostileShare.cn: 新来者中掠夺者和盗匪的比例 (百分比)

Sandbox_RNPC_HostileShare_tooltip.en: Share of new people who are raiders or bandits. Default 16.
Sandbox_RNPC_HostileShare_tooltip.ch: 新出現的人當中屬於掠奪者或盜匪的比例. 預設: 16.
Sandbox_RNPC_HostileShare_tooltip.cn: 新出现的人当中属于掠夺者或盗匪的比例. 默认: 16.

Sandbox_RNPC_NPCFirstAid_tooltip.en: A friendly NPC near a bleeding player hands over a bandage, paid from their faction's medicine.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCFirstAid_tooltip.ch: 友善NPC在流血的玩家附近時會遞上繃帶, 從其陣營的藥品中支出.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCFirstAid_tooltip.cn: 友善NPC在流血的玩家附近时会递上绷带, 从其派系的药品中支出.

Sandbox_RNPC_NPCLights_tooltip.en: People walking outdoors after dark carry a light. Loners, bandits and raiders stay dark.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCLights_tooltip.ch: 天黑後在戶外行走的人會帶著照明. 獨行者、盜匪與掠奪者則不點燈.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCLights_tooltip.cn: 天黑后在户外行走的人会带着照明. 独行者、盗匪和掠夺者则不点灯.

Sandbox_RNPC_NPCShareFood_tooltip.en: A friendly NPC near a starving player gives them something to eat from their faction's food.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCShareFood_tooltip.ch: 友善NPC在挨餓的玩家附近時, 會從其陣營的食物中拿些吃的給對方.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCShareFood_tooltip.cn: 友善NPC在挨饿的玩家附近时, 会从其派系的食物中拿些吃的给对方.

Sandbox_RNPC_NPCStandoff_tooltip.en: Armed NPCs you aim at raise their weapon and talk you down instead of backing off. They never fire first.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCStandoff_tooltip.ch: 被你瞄準的武裝NPC會舉起武器勸你放下, 而不是退開. 他們絕不會先開火.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCStandoff_tooltip.cn: 被你瞄准的武装NPC会举起武器劝你放下, 而不是退开. 他们绝不会先开火.

Sandbox_RNPC_Revenge_tooltip.en: A faction sends a few people after a player who killed one of theirs.
Sandbox_RNPC_Revenge_tooltip.ch: 玩家殺了某陣營的人後, 該陣營會派幾個人去找那名玩家.
Sandbox_RNPC_Revenge_tooltip.cn: 玩家杀了某派系的人后, 该派系会派几个人去找那名玩家.

Sandbox_RNPC_TensionPace_tooltip.en: How much each incident sours a faction on you, or on another faction.
Sandbox_RNPC_TensionPace_tooltip.ch: 每次事件會讓陣營對你或對其他陣營的態度惡化多少.
Sandbox_RNPC_TensionPace_tooltip.cn: 每次事件会让派系对你或对其他派系的态度恶化多少.

Sandbox_RNPC_WalkerDamage_tooltip.en: How hard NPC hits land on walkers. 100 is the old damage, 0 means they never kill one.
Sandbox_RNPC_WalkerDamage_tooltip.ch: NPC攻擊行屍的傷害程度. 100 為原本的傷害, 0 表示他們永遠殺不死行屍.
Sandbox_RNPC_WalkerDamage_tooltip.cn: NPC攻击行尸的伤害程度. 100 为原来的伤害, 0 表示他们永远杀不死行尸.

Sandbox_VRO_DisableUninstallRequirement.ch: 停用零件拆卸前置需求
Sandbox_VRO_DisableUninstallRequirement.cn: 禁用部件拆卸前置要求

Sandbox_VRO_DisableUninstallRequirement_.en: When enabled, parts that normally require another part to be uninstalled first — like brakes or suspension under a tire, or a window with armor on it — can be repaired without removing that part first. (If the Old Repair System is enabled, this setting does nothing)
Sandbox_VRO_DisableUninstallRequirement_.ch: 啟用後, 通常需要先拆下另一個零件才能維修的零件 (例如輪胎後方的煞車或懸吊系統, 或裝有防護鋼板的車窗) 不必先拆下該零件即可維修. (若已啟用舊版維修系統, 此設定無效)
Sandbox_VRO_DisableUninstallRequirement_.cn: 启用后, 通常需要先拆下另一个部件才能维修的部件 (例如轮胎后方的制动器或悬挂, 或装有防护钢板的车窗) 无需先拆下该部件即可维修. (若已启用旧版维修系统, 此设置将无效. )

Sandbox_PlayablePool_AllowBots_tooltip.en: Lets players seat computer opponents at any table that offers them. Turn it off to keep every game to solo play and human opponents; pool's solo practice stays available. A bot already seated keeps its chair until someone removes it.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_AllowBots_tooltip.ch: 允許玩家在任何提供電腦對手的桌上讓電腦對手入座. 關閉後, 所有遊戲都只能單人遊玩或與真人對戰; 撞球的單人練習仍可使用. 已入座的電腦玩家會保留座位, 直到有人將其移除.
Sandbox_PlayablePool_AllowBots_tooltip.cn: 允许玩家在任何提供电脑对手的桌上让电脑对手入座. 关闭后, 所有游戏都只能单人游玩或与真人对战; 台球的单人练习仍可使用. 已入座的电脑玩家会保留座位, 直到有人将其移除.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponA.en: Dynamic pool: add ammo with firearms
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponA.ch: 動態池: 槍械附帶彈藥
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponA.cn: 动态池: 枪械附带弹药

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponA.en: Each dynamic firearm comes with a box of its rounds, or a magazine/loose rounds when no box exists (mod ammo).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponA.ch: 動態池中的每把槍械都會附帶一盒對應的子彈; 若該彈藥沒有盒裝 (模組彈藥), 則改為附帶彈匣或散裝子彈.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponA.cn: 动态池中的每把枪械都会附带一盒对应的子弹; 若该弹药没有盒装 (模组弹药), 则改为附带弹匣或散装子弹.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponM.ch: 動態池: 近戰武器最低傷害
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponM.cn: 动态池: 近战武器最低伤害

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponM.en: Melee weapons with MaxDamage below this value are left out (pens, forks and similar junk). Firearms ignore it.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponM.ch: MaxDamage 低於此值的近戰武器會被排除 (筆、餐叉之類的雜物). 槍械不受此限.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponM.cn: MaxDamage 低于此值的近战武器会被排除 (笔、叉子之类的杂物). 枪械不受此限制.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponW.en: Total weight of the dynamic pool compared to the fixed loot tables (the Military table sums about 24). Each enabled class shares this weight equally, and inside a class every weapon has the same chance, so a mod with many rifles does not drown the rest. Multiplied by the loot level (0.15 / 0.8 / 1.6 / 3.2).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponW.ch: 動態池相對於固定物資池的總權重 (軍用物資池合計約 24). 每個已啟用的類別平分此權重, 而同一類別內每把武器的機率相同, 因此擁有大量步槍的模組不會蓋過其他武器. 會再依物資等級乘上倍率 (0.15 / 0.8 / 1.6 / 3.2).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeaponW.cn: 动态池相对于固定物资池的总权重 (军用物资池合计约24). 每个已启用的类别平分该权重, 且同一类别内每把武器的几率相同, 因此拥有大量步枪的模组不会淹没其他武器. 会再按物资等级乘以倍率 (0.15 / 0.8 / 1.6 / 3.2).

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Dynamic weapon pool (all weapons, incl. mods)
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 動態武器池 (所有武器, 含模組)
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 动态武器池 (所有武器, 含模组)

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 動態池: 包含模組武器
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 动态池: 包含模组武器

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: When disabled only vanilla (Base) weapons enter the dynamic pool.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 停用時, 只有原版 (Base) 武器會進入動態池.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 禁用时, 只有原版 (Base) 武器会进入动态池.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Dynamic pool: include strong tools and crafted weapons
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 動態池: 包含強力工具與自製武器
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 动态池: 包含强力工具和自制武器

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Includes items the game files as ToolWeapon, GardeningWeapon, SportsWeapon or WeaponCrafted when their MaxDamage is at least 1.5: axes, sledgehammer, machete, barbell, spiked bats... Hammers, screwdrivers and other light tools never enter the pool.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 納入遊戲歸類為 ToolWeapon、GardeningWeapon、SportsWeapon 或 WeaponCrafted, 且 MaxDamage 至少 1.5 的物品: 斧頭、大錘、大砍刀、槓鈴、釘刺球棒… 鐵鎚、螺絲起子與其他輕型工具絕不會進入此池.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 纳入游戏归类为 ToolWeapon、GardeningWeapon、SportsWeapon 或 WeaponCrafted, 且 MaxDamage 至少为 1.5 的物品: 斧头、大锤、大砍刀、杠铃、钉刺球棒… 锤子、螺丝刀和其他轻型工具绝不会进入此池.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Enables axes, blunt weapons, blades and spears in the dynamic pool.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 在動態池中啟用斧頭、鈍器、刀刃武器與長矛.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 在动态池中启用斧头、钝器、刀刃武器和长矛.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 動態池: 手槍與左輪手槍
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 动态池: 手枪和左轮手枪

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Enables the pistol class of the dynamic pool.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 啟用動態池的手槍類別.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 启用动态池的手枪类别.

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Dynamic pool: rifles and long guns
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 動態池: 步槍與長槍
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 动态池: 步枪和长枪

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Enables the rifle class (long range or heavy firearms, including SMGs from mods).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 啟用步槍類別 (遠程或重型槍械, 包括模組中的衝鋒槍).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 启用步枪类别 (远程或重型枪械, 包括模组中的冲锋枪).

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Enables the shotgun class (any firearm using shells).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 啟用霰彈槍類別 (任何使用霰彈的槍械).
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 启用霰弹枪类别 (任何使用霰弹的枪械).

Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.en: Adds every weapon registered in the game, from vanilla or any loaded mod, to the airdrop roll, grouped by category (pistols, rifles, shotguns, axes, blunt, blades, spears). Firearms come with matching ammo when enabled below.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.ch: 將遊戲中已註冊的所有武器 (無論來自原版或任何已載入的模組) 加入空投抽選, 並依類別分組 (手槍、步槍、霰彈槍、斧頭、鈍器、刀刃、長矛). 若啟用下方選項, 槍械會附帶對應的彈藥.
Sandbox_AirdropMod_AirdropDynamicWeapons.cn: 将游戏中已注册的所有武器 (无论来自原版还是任何已加载的模组) 加入空投随机抽取, 并按类别分组 (手枪、步枪、霰弹枪、斧头、钝器、刀刃、长矛). 若启用下方选项, 枪械会附带对应的弹药.

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_ExtraNpcTags_too.en: Comma-separated animation variables or ModData tags to exempt custom NPC mods from tripping. Built-in: Bandit, SurvivorNPC, NotAloneBody, md:ProjectALifeOwned.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_ExtraNpcTags_too.ch: 以逗號分隔的動畫變數或 ModData 標籤, 讓自訂 NPC 模組的 NPC 免於絆倒. 內建: Bandit, SurvivorNPC, NotAloneBody, md:ProjectALifeOwned.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_ExtraNpcTags_too.cn: 以逗号分隔的动画变量或 ModData 标签, 让自定义 NPC 模组的 NPC 免于绊倒. 内置: Bandit, SurvivorNPC, NotAloneBody, md:ProjectALifeOwned.

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_FirearmFall_tool.en:
Percentage chance a gunshot hit knocks a living zombie to the ground.
Default: 22%% (0 = Disabled).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_FirearmFall_tool.ch:
槍擊命中時把未死的殭屍擊倒在地的機率.
預設: 22%% (0 = 停用).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_FirearmFall_tool.cn:
枪击命中时把未死的僵尸击倒在地的概率.
默认: 22%% (0 = 禁用).

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_HitFallDelay_too.en:
Game ticks a hit reaction plays before the zombie falls to the floor (~60 ticks = 1 second). Allows realistic impact stagger before collapse.
Default: 2 ticks.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_HitFallDelay_too.ch:
殭屍倒地前, 受擊反應動作播放的遊戲刻數 (約 60 刻 = 1 秒). 讓殭屍在倒下前先呈現逼真的受擊踉蹌.
預設: 2 刻.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_HitFallDelay_too.cn:
僵尸倒地前, 受击反应动作播放的游戏刻数 (约 60 刻 = 1 秒). 让僵尸在倒下前先呈现逼真的受击踉跄.
默认: 2 刻.

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_HitFall_tooltip.en:
Percentage chance a shove or melee weapon hit knocks a zombie to the floor. Directional falls pitch away from the attacker.
Default: 8%% (0 = Disabled).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_HitFall_tooltip.ch:
推開或近戰武器命中時把殭屍擊倒在地的機率. 殭屍會朝遠離攻擊者的方向倒下.
預設: 8%% (0 = 停用).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_HitFall_tooltip.cn:
推开或近战武器命中时把僵尸击倒在地的概率. 僵尸会朝远离攻击者的方向倒下.
默认: 8%% (0 = 禁用).

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StairTrip_toolti.en:
Percentage chance a zombie loses its footing mid-flight while chasing up or down stairs. Rolled once per staircase.
Default: 8%% (0 = Disabled). Stays active even when Proper Ragdolls is enabled.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StairTrip_toolti.ch:
殭屍追逐上下樓梯時, 在樓梯中段失足的機率. 每段樓梯判定一次.
預設: 8%% (0 = 停用). 即使啟用 Proper Ragdolls 模組仍會生效.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StairTrip_toolti.cn:
僵尸追逐上下楼梯时, 在楼梯中段失足的概率. 每段楼梯判定一次.
默认: 8%% (0 = 禁用). 即使启用 Proper Ragdolls 模组仍会生效.

Sandbox_Armingsword_SpawnRate_tooltip.en: Sets the extra spawn rate of Arming Swords
Sandbox_Armingsword_SpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 設定武裝劍的額外生成率
Sandbox_Armingsword_SpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 设置武装剑的额外刷新率

Sandbox_Battleaxe_SpawnRate_tooltip.en: Sets the extra spawn rate of Battle Axes
Sandbox_Battleaxe_SpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 設定戰斧的額外生成率
Sandbox_Battleaxe_SpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 设置战斧的额外刷新率

Sandbox_Greataxe_SpawnRate_tooltip.en: Sets the extra spawn rate of Great Axes
Sandbox_Greataxe_SpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 設定巨斧的額外生成率
Sandbox_Greataxe_SpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 设置巨斧的额外刷新率

Sandbox_Morningstar_SpawnRate_tooltip.en: Sets the extra spawn rate of Morningstars
Sandbox_Morningstar_SpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 設定晨星錘的額外生成率
Sandbox_Morningstar_SpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 设置晨星锤的额外刷新率

Sandbox_LiveToFightScenes.ch: 留得青山在: 各場景 (3.0)
Sandbox_LiveToFightScenes.cn: 留得青山在: 各场景 (3.0)

Sandbox_LiveToFightSoldier.ch: 留得青山在: 封鎖區士兵 (測試版)
Sandbox_LiveToFightSoldier.cn: 留得青山在: 封锁区士兵 (测试版)

Sandbox_LiveToFight_Broadcast_tooltip.en: With a radio or walkie-talkie switched on, you may hear a message about an evacuation point. Go and see.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Broadcast_tooltip.ch: 開著收音機或對講機時, 你可能會聽到一則關於撤離點的訊息. 去看看吧.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Broadcast_tooltip.cn: 开着收音机或对讲机时, 你可能会听到一条关于撤离点的消息. 去看看吧.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentFromVeter.ch: 退伍軍人以封鎖區士兵身分開局
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentFromVeter.cn: 退伍军人以封锁区士兵身份开局

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentFromVeter.en: If the new occupation does not appear in your version of the game, turn this on and pick Veteran instead.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentFromVeter.ch: 若你的遊戲版本沒有出現這個新職業, 請開啟此選項並改選「退伍軍人」.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentFromVeter.cn: 如果你的游戏版本没有出现这个新职业, 请开启此选项并改选“退伍军人”.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentHorde_too.en: How many zombies wait at the end.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentHorde_too.ch: 最後等著你的殭屍數量.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentHorde_too.cn: 最后等着你的僵尸数量.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentOverrun_t.en: Leave this on. What happens is for you to find out. In worlds without a containment soldier, the outpost has fallen by day 7 and is empty.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentOverrun_t.ch: 請保持開啟. 會發生什麼, 就留給你自己發現. 在沒有封鎖區士兵的世界中, 該前哨站到第 7 天時已經失守, 物資也已清空.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentOverrun_t.cn: 请保持开启. 会发生什么, 就留给你自己去发现. 在没有封锁区士兵的世界中, 该前哨站到第 7 天时已经失守, 物资也已清空.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentQuota_too.en: How many of the day's three orders must be done before you sleep.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentQuota_too.ch: 每天三項命令中, 睡覺前必須完成幾項.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentQuota_too.cn: 每天三项命令中, 睡觉前必须完成几项.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentRelief_to.en: Go to sleep without enough orders done and you wake up somewhere else, without your post. When off, a missed day is only a warning.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentRelief_to.ch: 若沒有完成足夠的命令就去睡覺, 你會在別處醒來, 失去你的崗位. 關閉時, 未達標的一天只會收到警告.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentRelief_to.cn: 如果没有完成足够的命令就去睡觉, 你会在别处醒来, 失去你的岗位. 关闭时, 未达标的一天只会收到警告.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentReturnMin.en: Minutes to get back to the outpost

When the day's orders are done, command orders the officer back to the outpost. Stay more than 50 tiles away for this many real minutes of play and the screen goes black and you head back, in your car if you are in one. 0 switches it off.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentReturnMin.ch: 當天的命令完成後, 指揮部會命令這名軍官返回前哨站. 若在距離前哨站超過 50 格的地方停留達這麼多分鐘的實際遊玩時間, 畫面就會變黑, 你會返回前哨站, 若你在車上則會開車回去. 0 為關閉.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentReturnMin.cn: 当天的命令完成后, 指挥部会命令这名军官返回前哨站. 如果在距离前哨站超过 50 格的地方停留达这么多分钟的实际游玩时间, 画面就会变黑, 你会返回前哨站, 如果你在车上则会开车回去. 0 为关闭.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSampleCha.ch: 每次擊殺取得樣本的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSampleCha.cn: 每次击杀获得样本的几率 (百分比)

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSampleCha.en: Chance that a zombie you kill on duty gives a sample.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSampleCha.ch: 執勤時你擊殺的殭屍提供樣本的機率.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSampleCha.cn: 执勤时你击杀的僵尸提供样本的几率.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSoldier_t.en: Adds the containment soldier occupation: a black screen, then seven days of orders from an outpost at the edge of West Point. Beta: if it is well received, more occupations get their own story.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSoldier_t.ch: 新增「封鎖區士兵」職業: 先是黑畫面, 接著是在西點鎮邊緣的前哨站接受七天的命令. 測試版: 若反應良好, 會有更多職業擁有自己的故事.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentSoldier_t.cn: 新增“封锁区士兵”职业: 先是黑屏, 然后是在西点镇边缘的前哨站接受七天的命令. 测试版: 如果反响良好, 会有更多职业拥有自己的故事.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentUniform_t.en: The officer starts in their own clothes. A uniform waits in the gear crate at the outpost with the rest of the kit.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentUniform_t.ch: 軍官開局時穿著自己的衣服. 制服和其餘裝備一起放在前哨站的裝備箱裡.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ContainmentUniform_t.cn: 军官开局时穿着自己的衣服. 制服和其余装备一起放在前哨站的装备箱里.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_EventFrequency_toolt.en: Scales the chance of every event. 100 is the default.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_EventFrequency_toolt.ch: 按比例調整所有事件的機率. 預設為 100.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_EventFrequency_toolt.cn: 按比例调整所有事件的几率. 默认为 100.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_Events_tooltip.en: Things that happen near you: someone running past, knocking at night, a flare, an engine in the distance.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Events_tooltip.ch: 在你附近發生的事: 有人跑過、夜裡的敲門聲、訊號彈、遠處的引擎聲.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Events_tooltip.cn: 在你附近发生的事: 有人跑过、夜里的敲门声、信号弹、远处的引擎声.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_GiftGoodwill_tooltip.en: Makes the mod gentler. Food or medicine left beside a thank-you note (two things or more) makes up for one earlier bad visit with that person. Off: a gift is only a gift.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_GiftGoodwill_tooltip.ch: 讓本模組更溫和. 在感謝紙條旁留下食物或藥品 (兩件以上), 能彌補先前與那個人的一次不愉快遭遇. 關閉: 禮物就只是禮物.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_GiftGoodwill_tooltip.cn: 让本模组更温和. 在感谢纸条旁留下食物或药品 (两件以上), 能弥补之前与那个人的一次不愉快遭遇. 关闭: 礼物就只是礼物.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HazmatHarmless.en: The dead in hazmat suits cannot bite
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HazmatHarmless.ch: 穿化學防護服的死者無法咬人
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HazmatHarmless.cn: 穿化学防护服的死者无法咬人

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HazmatHarmless_toolt.en: A zombie still sealed in a hazmat suit cannot bite, scratch or cut you through it. Where it grabs you, it only hurts.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HazmatHarmless_toolt.ch: 仍密封在化學防護服中的殭屍無法隔著防護服咬傷、抓傷或割傷你. 被它抓住的部位只會感到疼痛.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HazmatHarmless_toolt.cn: 仍密封在化学防护服中的僵尸无法隔着防护服咬伤、抓伤或割伤你. 被它抓住的部位只会感到疼痛.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardAlarm_tooltip.en: Heard only until day 60 (or "Outbreak scenes stop after", if sooner), then never again.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardAlarm_tooltip.ch: 只在第 60 天以前聽得到 (若「爆發期場景停止時間」較早則以其為準), 之後不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardAlarm_tooltip.cn: 只在第 60 天以前听得到 (若“爆发期场景停止时间”更早则以其为准), 之后不再出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardCrash.en: Heard from afar: a car crash

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardCrash_tooltip.en: Can be heard for the whole game. Needs "Heard scenes" on.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardCrash_tooltip.ch: 整局遊戲都可能聽到. 需要開啟「先聽到聲響的場景」.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardCrash_tooltip.cn: 整局游戏都可能听到. 需要开启“先听到声响的场景”.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardFiresiren.ch: 遠處傳來: 消防車聲
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardFiresiren.cn: 远处传来: 消防车声

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardFiresiren_toolt.en: Heard only until day 30 (or "Outbreak scenes stop after", if sooner), then never again.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardFiresiren_toolt.ch: 只在第 30 天以前聽得到 (若「爆發期場景停止時間」較早則以其為準), 之後不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardFiresiren_toolt.cn: 只在第 30 天以前听得到 (若“爆发期场景停止时间”更早则以其为准), 之后不再出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardLaststand.en: Heard from afar: a last stand
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardLaststand.ch: 遠處傳來: 最後的抵抗
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardLaststand.cn: 远处传来: 最后的抵抗

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardLaststand_toolt.en: Can be heard for the whole game. Needs "Heard scenes" on.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardLaststand_toolt.ch: 整局遊戲都可能聽到. 需要開啟「先聽到聲響的場景」.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardLaststand_toolt.cn: 整局游戏都可能听到. 需要开启“先听到声响的场景”.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardMilitarycar_too.en: Heard only until day 45 (or "Outbreak scenes stop after", if sooner), then never again.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardMilitarycar_too.ch: 只在第 45 天以前聽得到 (若「爆發期場景停止時間」較早則以其為準), 之後不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardMilitarycar_too.cn: 只在第 45 天以前听得到 (若“爆发期场景停止时间”更早则以其为准), 之后不再出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardShootout_toolti.en: Can be heard for the whole game. Needs "Heard scenes" on.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardShootout_toolti.ch: 整局遊戲都可能聽到. 需要開啟「先聽到聲響的場景」.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardShootout_toolti.cn: 整局游戏都可能听到. 需要开启“先听到声响的场景”.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardSiren_tooltip.en: Heard only until day 30 (or "Outbreak scenes stop after", if sooner), then never again.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardSiren_tooltip.ch: 只在第 30 天以前聽得到 (若「爆發期場景停止時間」較早則以其為準), 之後不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_HeardSiren_tooltip.cn: 只在第 30 天以前听得到 (若“爆发期场景停止时间”更早则以其为准), 之后不再出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_LivedIn_tooltip.en: Round every scene: rubbish, junk, the odd bin, chair, table or cold campfire, blood, sometimes a body, and a mess on the floors inside. Nothing useful is added.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_LivedIn_tooltip.ch: 每個場景周圍會有垃圾、廢棄物、偶爾出現的垃圾桶、椅子、桌子或熄滅的營火、血跡, 有時還有屍體, 室內地板也一片凌亂. 不會加入任何有用的東西.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_LivedIn_tooltip.cn: 每个场景周围会有垃圾、废弃物、偶尔出现的垃圾桶、椅子、桌子或熄灭的营火、血迹, 有时还有尸体, 室内地板也一片狼藉. 不会添加任何有用的东西.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_NoRescueBitten_toolt.en: Makes the mod harsher. Nobody saves a character carrying the infection: going down infected is a real death.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NoRescueBitten_toolt.ch: 讓本模組更嚴苛. 沒有人會救帶有感染的角色: 在感染狀態下倒下就是真正死亡.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NoRescueBitten_toolt.cn: 让本模组更严苛. 没有人会救带有感染的角色: 在感染状态下倒下就是真的死亡.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_NoteFrequency_toolti.en: Scales every chance of finding a note. 100 is the default, 0 means no notes at all, 300 is three times as many.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NoteFrequency_toolti.ch: 按比例調整所有找到紙條的機率. 預設為 100, 0 表示完全沒有紙條, 300 為三倍數量.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NoteFrequency_toolti.cn: 按比例调整所有找到纸条的几率. 默认为 100, 0 表示完全没有纸条, 300 为三倍数量.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesInHouses_toolti.en: Notes can be found in drawers, cupboards, desks and on floors when a house is first searched. At the default frequency about one house in five has one, and the first two come twice as easily.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesInHouses_toolti.ch: 首次搜查房屋時, 可能在抽屜、櫥櫃、書桌和地板上找到紙條. 在預設頻率下, 大約每五間房屋有一間有紙條, 而最初的兩張出現機率加倍.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesInHouses_toolti.cn: 首次搜查房屋时, 可能在抽屉、柜子、书桌和地板上找到纸条. 在默认频率下, 大约每五间房屋有一间有纸条, 而最初的两张出现几率翻倍.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesOnStreets_toolt.en: Now and then a note lies outside, on a road or a pavement.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesOnStreets_toolt.ch: 偶爾會有紙條落在屋外的馬路或人行道上.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesOnStreets_toolt.cn: 偶尔会有纸条落在屋外的马路或人行道上.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesOnZombies_toolt.en: Killed zombies can carry a note. Their clothes decide what kind: soldiers carry military notes, medics medical notes, hazmat suits CDC reports.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesOnZombies_toolt.ch: 被擊殺的殭屍身上可能帶著紙條. 種類取決於其服裝: 士兵帶著軍方紙條, 醫護人員帶著醫療紙條, 穿化學防護服的則帶著 CDC 報告.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_NotesOnZombies_toolt.cn: 被击杀的僵尸身上可能带着纸条. 种类取决于其服装: 士兵带着军方纸条, 医护人员带着医疗纸条, 穿化学防护服的则带着 CDC 报告.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutbreakDays.ch: 爆發期場景停止時間 (天)
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutbreakDays.cn: 爆发期场景停止时间 (天)

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutbreakDays_tooltip.en: After this many days the collapse is over: no new roadblocks, checkpoints, evacuations or sirens happen. What they left is still found, gone quiet, but only in places you have not been since. Burning houses, loudspeakers, fresh crashes and shop alarms stop for good. Survivors' scenes go on. A world that starts months after the apocalypse counts those months too.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutbreakDays_tooltip.ch: 經過這麼多天後, 崩潰期就結束了: 不會再發生新的路障、檢查哨、撤離或警笛. 它們留下的痕跡仍能找到, 已然沉寂, 但只會出現在你從那時起沒再去過的地方. 燃燒的房屋、擴音器、新發生的車禍與商店警報會永久停止. 倖存者的場景會繼續. 若世界在末日發生數個月後才開始, 那幾個月也會計入.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutbreakDays_tooltip.cn: 经过这么多天后, 崩溃期就结束了: 不会再发生新的路障、检查站、撤离或警笛. 它们留下的痕迹仍能找到, 已然沉寂, 但只会出现在你从那时起没再去过的地方. 燃烧的房屋、扩音器、新发生的车祸和商店警报会永久停止. 幸存者的场景会继续. 如果世界在末日发生几个月后才开始, 那几个月也会计入.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMax.en: Outposts: most days before one appears
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMax.ch: 前哨站: 出現前的最多天數
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMax.cn: 前哨站: 出现前的最多天数

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMax_toolt.en: And at most this many. The countdown starts over somewhere else if you walk into the place before it ends.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMax_toolt.ch: 最多也只會等這麼多天. 若你在倒數結束前走進該地點, 倒數會改在別處重新開始.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMax_toolt.cn: 最多也只会等这么多天. 如果你在倒计时结束前走进该地点, 倒计时会改在别处重新开始.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMin.en: Outposts: fewest days before one appears
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMin.ch: 前哨站: 出現前的最少天數
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMin.cn: 前哨站: 出现前的最少天数

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMin_toolt.en: Once a place is picked, the outpost appears there after at least this many days.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMin_toolt.ch: 選定地點後, 前哨站至少要經過這麼多天才會在那裡出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostDaysMin_toolt.cn: 选定地点后, 前哨站至少要经过这么多天才会在那里出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostForgetDays.en: Outposts: days away before ground counts as new
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostForgetDays.ch: 前哨站: 離開幾天後該地視為未去過
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostForgetDays.cn: 前哨站: 离开几天后该地视为未去过

Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostForgetDays_to.en: Outposts only appear on ground you have not been to. Ground you left this many days ago counts as new again.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostForgetDays_to.ch: 前哨站只會出現在你沒去過的地方. 你離開已達這麼多天的地方, 會再次視為沒去過.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_OutpostForgetDays_to.cn: 前哨站只会出现在你没去过的地方. 你离开已达这么多天的地方, 会再次被视为没去过.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_Outposts_tooltip.en: Fenced outposts the army, the police, the doctors or other survivors set up to hold a town, long since overrun. At most four to a town, one of each kind. A place is picked on ground you have never been to, and the outpost appears there after a few days. Walk into that place before then and it is picked somewhere else.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Outposts_tooltip.ch: 軍隊、警察、醫生或其他倖存者為守住城鎮而設立的圍欄前哨站, 早已被攻陷. 每座城鎮最多四個, 每種各一. 會在你從未去過的地方選定地點, 幾天後前哨站就會在那裡出現. 若你在那之前走進該地點, 就會改選別處.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Outposts_tooltip.cn: 军队、警察、医生或其他幸存者为守住城镇而设立的带围栏的前哨站, 早已被攻陷. 每座城镇最多四个, 每种各一个. 会在你从未去过的地方选定地点, 几天后前哨站就会在那里出现. 如果你在那之前走进该地点, 就会改选别处.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_QuietDays.en: Days before a used area turns up something new
Sandbox_LiveToFight_QuietDays.ch: 常待區域出現新事物前的天數
Sandbox_LiveToFight_QuietDays.cn: 常待区域出现新事物前的天数

Sandbox_LiveToFight_QuietDays_tooltip.en: An area you keep spending time in goes quiet. Nothing new is placed there until you have stayed away this many days. Nothing ever appears in front of you.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_QuietDays_tooltip.ch: 你一直待著的區域會沉寂下來. 直到你離開這麼多天, 那裡才會放置新東西. 任何東西都不會當著你的面出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_QuietDays_tooltip.cn: 你一直待着的区域会沉寂下来. 直到你离开这么多天, 那里才会放置新东西. 任何东西都不会当着你的面出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_RegionSize_tooltip.en: The map is divided into areas of this size. Each area has its own people: survivors, police, soldiers, medics and more, each with their own health and mood.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_RegionSize_tooltip.ch: 地圖會被劃分成這個大小的區域. 每個區域都有自己的人: 倖存者、警察、士兵、醫護人員等, 各自擁有自己的健康與心情.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_RegionSize_tooltip.cn: 地图会被划分成这个大小的区域. 每个区域都有自己的人: 幸存者、警察、士兵、医护人员等, 各自拥有自己的健康和心情.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_RescuerNotes_tooltip.en: The strangers from your own save, the warden, the nurse, the arsonist and the rest, leave notes in the world too. Rare: about one per area each.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_RescuerNotes_tooltip.ch: 你自己存檔中的陌生人, 如看守者、護士、縱火犯等, 也會在世界中留下紙條. 很少見: 每人每個區域大約一張.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_RescuerNotes_tooltip.cn: 你自己存档中的陌生人, 如看守者、护士、纵火犯等, 也会在世界中留下纸条. 很少见: 每人每个区域大约一张.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAlarmshop.en: The shop with its alarm still set

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAlarmshop_toolt.en: Happens only in days 0 to 25 (never after "Outbreak scenes stop after"). It is only ever something happening right now, so nothing of it is left to find later.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAlarmshop_toolt.ch: 只在第 0 到 25 天發生 (不會晚於「爆發期場景停止時間」). 它只會是正在發生的事, 因此之後不會留下任何東西可找.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAlarmshop_toolt.cn: 只在第 0 到 25 天发生 (不会晚于“爆发期场景停止时间”). 它只会是正在发生的事, 因此之后不会留下任何东西可找.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAmbulance_toolt.en: Happens in days 0 to 30 (never after "Outbreak scenes stop after"). "Its days, then what is left": after that, what it left is still found, gone quiet, in places you have not been since. "Only in its own days": after that, never.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAmbulance_toolt.ch: 於第 0 到 30 天發生 (不會晚於「爆發期場景停止時間」). 「發生期間, 之後留下殘跡」: 之後在你從那時起沒再去過的地方, 仍能找到它留下的已沉寂的痕跡. 「僅限其發生期間」: 之後就不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAmbulance_toolt.cn: 于第 0 到 30 天发生 (不会晚于“爆发期场景停止时间”). “发生期间, 之后留下残迹”: 之后在你从那时起没再去过的地方, 仍能找到它留下的已沉寂的痕迹. “仅限其发生期间”: 之后就不再出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAttic_tooltip.en: Survivors' doing: it can turn up from day 2 on, for the whole game.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAttic_tooltip.ch: 倖存者所為: 從第 2 天起可能出現, 持續整局遊戲.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneAttic_tooltip.cn: 幸存者所为: 从第 2 天起可能出现, 持续整局游戏.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneBlockade_toolti.en: Happens in days 0 to 30 (never after "Outbreak scenes stop after"). "Its days, then what is left": after that, what it left is still found, gone quiet, in places you have not been since. "Only in its own days": after that, never.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneBlockade_toolti.ch: 於第 0 到 30 天發生 (不會晚於「爆發期場景停止時間」). 「發生期間, 之後留下殘跡」: 之後在你從那時起沒再去過的地方, 仍能找到它留下的已沉寂的痕跡. 「僅限其發生期間」: 之後就不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneBlockade_toolti.cn: 于第 0 到 30 天发生 (不会晚于“爆发期场景停止时间”). “发生期间, 之后留下残迹”: 之后在你从那时起没再去过的地方, 仍能找到它留下的已沉寂的痕迹. “仅限其发生期间”: 之后就不再出现.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneBunker_tooltip.en: Survivors' doing: it can turn up from day 14 on, for the whole game.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneBunker_tooltip.ch: 倖存者所為: 從第 14 天起可能出現, 持續整局遊戲.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneBunker_tooltip.cn: 幸存者所为: 从第 14 天起可能出现, 持续整局游戏.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneCampsite_toolti.en: Survivors' doing: it can turn up from day 10 on, for the whole game.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneCampsite_toolti.ch: 倖存者所為: 從第 10 天起可能出現, 持續整局遊戲.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneCampsite_toolti.cn: 幸存者所为: 从第 10 天起可能出现, 持续整局游戏.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneCheckpoint_tool.en: Happens in days 0 to 45 (never after "Outbreak scenes stop after"). "Its days, then what is left": after that, what it left is still found, gone quiet, in places you have not been since. "Only in its own days": after that, never.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneCheckpoint_tool.ch: 於第 0 到 45 天發生 (不會晚於「爆發期場景停止時間」). 「發生期間, 之後留下殘跡」: 之後在你從那時起沒再去過的地方, 仍能找到它留下的已沉寂的痕跡. 「僅限其發生期間」: 之後就不再出現.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneNoise_tooltip.en: Like the game's own distant gunfire: you hear a scene's shots, crashes and sirens from the way they came, and they make real noise where they happen, so the dead around there go to it. Sirens and alarms you set off up close draw them too. When off they are only sound.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneNoise_tooltip.ch: 如同遊戲本身的遠方槍聲: 你會從場景所在的方向聽到它的槍聲、撞擊聲與警笛聲, 而這些聲響會在發生處製造真正的噪音, 讓附近的死者前往. 你在近處觸發的警笛與警報也會吸引它們. 關閉時這些只是音效.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneNoise_tooltip.cn: 如同游戏自带的远处枪声: 你会从场景所在的方向听到它的枪声、撞击声和警笛声, 而这些声响会在发生处产生真正的噪音, 让附近的死者前往. 你在近处触发的警笛和警报也会吸引它们. 关闭时它们只是音效.
