Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneWreck_tooltip.cn: 只在第 0 到 10 天发生 (不会晚于“爆发期场景停止时间”). 它只会是正在发生的事, 因此之后不会留下任何东西可找.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_Scenes_tooltip.en: Places where something happened: crashes, blockades, checkpoints, camps, bunkers and more. They are placed in areas you are not in.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Scenes_tooltip.ch: 發生過某些事的地方: 車禍、路障、檢查哨、營地、地下室避難所等等. 它們會被放在你不在的區域.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Scenes_tooltip.cn: 发生过某些事的地方: 车祸、路障、检查站、营地、地下室避难所等等. 它们会被放置在你不在的区域.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ShotAt_tooltip.en: Someone you never see fires at you. Out in the open the shots are more likely to hit, near houses they mostly miss.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ShotAt_tooltip.ch: 某個你始終看不到的人會朝你開槍. 在空曠處槍擊較容易命中, 在房屋附近則大多會落空.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ShotAt_tooltip.cn: 某个你始终看不到的人会朝你开枪. 在空旷处子弹更容易命中, 在房屋附近则大多会打偏.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ShotHits_tooltip.en: When off, every shot at you misses.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ShotHits_tooltip.ch: 關閉時, 所有朝你開的槍都會落空.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ShotHits_tooltip.cn: 关闭时, 所有朝你开的枪都会打偏.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SkipBlackScreen.en: Enter skips ahead on the black screen
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SkipBlackScreen.ch: 黑畫面中按 Enter 快轉
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SkipBlackScreen.cn: 黑屏中按 Enter 快进

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SkipBlackScreen_tool.en: Press Enter to move past the lines while dying, on the journey and the hammering. What happens and the hours that pass stay the same; the journal still tells all of it.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SkipBlackScreen_tool.ch: 在瀕死、移動途中與敲打段落時, 按 Enter 可跳過文字. 發生的事與經過的時數不變; 日記本仍會記下全部經過.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SkipBlackScreen_tool.cn: 在濒死、移动途中和敲打段落时, 按 Enter 可跳过文字. 发生的事和经过的时长不变; 日志仍会记下全部经过.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_Sniper_tooltip.en: Rarely, a shooter follows you for a day, missing a few times. Later you can find where they watched you from.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Sniper_tooltip.ch: 極少數情況下, 會有槍手跟蹤你一天, 開了幾槍都沒打中. 之後你可以找到他們監視你的位置.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Sniper_tooltip.cn: 极少数情况下, 会有枪手跟踪你一天, 开了几枪都没打中. 之后你可以找到他们监视你的位置.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SoundScenes_tooltip.en: Gunfire, a crash, screaming or a generator from a direction, and something to find there later.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SoundScenes_tooltip.ch: 從某個方向傳來槍聲、撞擊聲、尖叫聲或發電機聲, 之後可在那裡找到些什麼.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SoundScenes_tooltip.cn: 从某个方向传来枪声、撞击声、尖叫声或发电机声, 之后可以在那里找到些什么.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_StashShare.ch: 指向某處的紙條 (百分比)
Sandbox_LiveToFight_StashShare.cn: 指向某处的纸条 (百分比)

Sandbox_LiveToFight_StashShare_tooltip.en: Share of notes that point to something real. The item is placed in a container nearby first and the note only hints at where. No map marker.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_StashShare_tooltip.ch: 指向真實物品的紙條所佔比例. 物品會先放進附近的容器, 紙條只會暗示位置. 不會有地圖標記.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_StashShare_tooltip.cn: 指向真实物品的纸条所占比例. 物品会先放进附近的容器, 纸条只会暗示位置. 没有地图标记.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ThankYou_tooltip.en: For three days after waking you can leave a note where you woke for the one who saved you (needs a pen or pencil and paper). Whatever lies next to it goes with it. The next time they find you, they answer. Nobody who meant you harm is thanked.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ThankYou_tooltip.ch: 醒來後三天內, 你可以在醒來處留一張紙條給救了你的人 (需要筆或鉛筆與紙). 放在紙條旁的任何東西都會一起被帶走. 下次他們找到你時會回覆. 對你懷有惡意的人不會收到感謝.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ThankYou_tooltip.cn: 醒来后三天内, 你可以在醒来的地方给救了你的人留一张纸条 (需要笔或铅笔以及纸). 放在纸条旁的任何东西都会一起被带走. 下次他们找到你时会回复. 对你怀有恶意的人不会收到感谢.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderChance.ch: 每次睡眠的商人來訪機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderChance.cn: 每次睡眠的商人来访几率 (百分比)

Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderChance_tooltip.en: Chance that a trader comes by while you sleep, once the days below have passed.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderChance_tooltip.ch: 在下方的天數過去後, 你睡覺時商人來訪的機率.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderChance_tooltip.cn: 在下方的天数过去后, 你睡觉时商人来访的几率.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderCooldownDays_t.en: At least this many days pass between two trader notes at your door.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderCooldownDays_t.ch: 你門口的兩張商人紙條之間至少相隔這麼多天.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_TraderCooldownDays_t.cn: 你门口的两张商人纸条之间至少相隔这么多天.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_Traders_tooltip.en: While you sleep, a trader may leave a note at the door. Leave something where they ask, and maybe something comes back while you are away.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Traders_tooltip.ch: 你睡覺時, 商人可能會在門口留下紙條. 把東西放在對方指定的地方, 也許在你離開期間會有東西送回來.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_Traders_tooltip.cn: 你睡觉时, 商人可能会在门口留下纸条. 把东西放在对方指定的地方, 也许在你离开期间会有东西送回来.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_World.ch: 第二章: 外面的世界
Sandbox_LiveToFight_World.cn: 第二章: 外面的世界

Sandbox_LiveToFight_World_tooltip.en: Chapter II, added in 3.0: the places, sounds and notes you find out in the world, traders, scenes and events. Off by default. When off, the mod is the rescue only, exactly as in 2.0. Turn it on here for a new game; in a save that does not have it, you are asked once when you start playing, and can change it later by right-clicking the ground. The containment soldier has its own switch.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_World_tooltip.ch: 第二章, 3.0 版新增: 你在外面世界中發現的地點、聲響與紙條, 還有商人、場景與事件. 預設關閉. 關閉時, 本模組只有救援, 與 2.0 完全相同. 新遊戲請在此開啟; 在尚未包含此內容的存檔中, 開始遊玩時會詢問你一次, 之後可對地面按右鍵更改. 封鎖區士兵有自己的開關.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_World_tooltip.cn: 第二章, 3.0 版新增: 你在外面世界中发现的地点、声响和纸条, 还有商人、场景和事件. 默认关闭. 关闭时, 本模组只有救援, 与 2.0 完全相同. 新游戏请在此开启; 在尚未包含此内容的存档中, 开始游玩时会询问你一次, 之后可以右键点击地面更改. 封锁区士兵有自己的开关.

Sandbox_BFBackpackAttachment_enabled_too.en: Allows Torch1, Torch2, Torch3 and Torch5 to use the bottom slot of any backpack that has one: regular and large hiking bags, crafted framepacks, and ALICE or military backpacks. The flashlight shares the slot with a tent or bedroll. Its model sits sideways, but the standard beam still shines forward through the character. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_BFBackpackAttachment_enabled_too.ch: 允許 Torch1、Torch2、Torch3 與 Torch5 使用任何具有底部掛槽的背包: 一般與大型登山包、自製框架背包, 以及 ALICE 背包或軍用背包. 手電筒與帳篷或睡袋共用此掛槽. 其模型會橫向擺放, 但標準光束仍會穿過角色向前照射. 預設停用.
Sandbox_BFBackpackAttachment_enabled_too.cn: 允许 Torch1、Torch2、Torch3 和 Torch5 使用任何带有底部挂槽的背包: 普通和大型登山包、自制框架背包, 以及 ALICE 背包或军用背包. 手电筒与帐篷或睡袋共用此挂槽. 其模型横向放置, 但标准光束仍会穿过角色向前照射. 默认禁用.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Camoufla.en: M81 Woodland, Tigerstripe, Flecktarn, 3 Color Desert, and 6 Color Desert. 0 disables these variants; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and location settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Camoufla.ch: M81 林地迷彩、虎斑迷彩、斑點迷彩、三色沙漠迷彩與六色沙漠迷彩. 設為 0 會停用這些款式; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及地點設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Camoufla.cn: M81 林地迷彩、虎斑迷彩、斑点迷彩、三色沙漠迷彩和六色沙漠迷彩. 设为 0 会禁用这些款式; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及地点设置相乘.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Civilian.en: Household wardrobes, general and school lockers, and women's clothing stores. 0 disables ponchos in these pools; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and color settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Civilian.ch: 住家衣櫃、一般與學校置物櫃, 以及女裝店. 設為 0 會停用這些戰利品池中的雨衣; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及顏色設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Civilian.cn: 住宅衣柜、普通和学校储物柜, 以及女装店. 设为 0 会禁用这些战利品池中的斗篷; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及颜色设置相乘.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Emergenc.en: Police and fire department loot multiplier
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Emergenc.ch: 警察與消防局戰利品倍率
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Emergenc.cn: 警察和消防局战利品倍率

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Emergenc.en: Police storage, outfits and lockers, and fire department lockers. 0 disables ponchos in these pools; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and color settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Emergenc.ch: 警察局儲藏區、警用服裝與置物櫃, 以及消防局置物櫃. 設為 0 會停用這些戰利品池中的雨衣; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及顏色設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Emergenc.cn: 警察局储藏区、警用服装和储物柜, 以及消防局储物柜. 设为 0 会禁用这些战利品池中的斗篷; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及颜色设置相乘.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Military.ch: 軍方與軍用品店戰利品倍率
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Military.cn: 军方和军用品店战利品倍率

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Military.en: Army storage, army bedroom/bunker lockers, and surplus stores. 0 disables ponchos in these pools; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and color settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Military.ch: 軍方儲藏區、軍營寢室/碉堡置物櫃, 以及軍用品店. 設為 0 會停用這些戰利品池中的雨衣; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及顏色設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_Military.cn: 军方储藏区、军营宿舍/地堡储物柜, 以及军用品店. 设为 0 会禁用这些战利品池中的斗篷; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及颜色设置相乘.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_OutdoorS.ch: 戶外與狩獵戰利品倍率
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_OutdoorS.cn: 户外和狩猎战利品倍率

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_OutdoorS.en: Camping stores and lockers, gun stores, fishing stores, fisherman outfits, and survival gear. 0 disables ponchos in these pools; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and color settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_OutdoorS.ch: 露營用品店與置物櫃、槍店、釣具店、漁夫服裝, 以及生存裝備. 設為 0 會停用這些戰利品池中的雨衣; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及顏色設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_OutdoorS.cn: 露营用品店和储物柜、枪店、渔具店、渔夫服装, 以及生存装备. 设为 0 会禁用这些战利品池中的斗篷; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及颜色设置相乘.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_SolidSpa.en: Green, Black, Yellow, Red, Blue, White, Pink, Purple, Brown, and Coyote. 0 disables these variants; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and location settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_SolidSpa.ch: 綠、黑、黃、紅、藍、白、粉、紫、棕與郊狼色. 設為 0 會停用這些款式; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及地點設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_SolidSpa.cn: 绿、黑、黄、红、蓝、白、粉、紫、棕和郊狼色. 设为 0 会禁用这些款式; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及地点设置相乘.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_SpawnMul.en: Multiplies all poncho loot weights. Default: 0.8 (20 percent below original weights). 0 = disabled; 0.5 = half weight; 1 = original weights; 2 = double weight. Range: 0-10. Stacks with location and color settings and vanilla loot rarity. These are weights, not guaranteed percentages. Restart the world/server after changing settings; only newly generated loot is affected.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_SpawnMul.ch: 將所有雨衣的戰利品權重乘以此值. 預設: 0.8 (比原始權重低百分之 20). 0 = 停用; 0.5 = 一半權重; 1 = 原始權重; 2 = 雙倍權重. 範圍: 0-10. 會與地點、顏色設定以及原版戰利品稀有度疊加. 這些是權重, 不是保證出現的百分比. 變更設定後請重新啟動世界/伺服器; 只會影響新產生的戰利品.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_SpawnMul.cn: 将所有斗篷的战利品权重乘以此值. 默认: 0.8 (比原始权重低百分之 20). 0 = 禁用; 0.5 = 一半权重; 1 = 原始权重; 2 = 双倍权重. 范围: 0-10. 会与地点、颜色设置以及原版战利品稀有度叠加. 这些是权重, 而非保证出现的百分比. 更改设置后请重启世界/服务器; 只会影响新生成的战利品.

Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_VehicleS.en: Hunter and survivalist vehicle storage. 0 disables ponchos in these pools; 1 preserves original weights. Multiplies the overall and color settings.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_VehicleS.ch: 獵人與生存主義者車輛的置物空間. 設為 0 會停用這些戰利品池中的雨衣; 設為 1 則維持原始權重. 會與整體及顏色設定相乘.
Sandbox_MilitaryPonchosRELOADED_VehicleS.cn: 猎人和生存主义者车辆的储物空间. 设为 0 会禁用这些战利品池中的斗篷; 设为 1 则维持原始权重. 会与总体及颜色设置相乘.

Sandbox_AWS_EnableIconsInventoryWear.ch: 在 Icons Inventory 中顯示磨損
Sandbox_AWS_EnableIconsInventoryWear.cn: 在 Icons Inventory 中显示磨损

Sandbox_AWS_EnableIconsInventoryWear_too.en: Adds AWS wear colors to clothing and backpack icon borders and a remaining-integrity ring in Icons Inventory. Independent of inventory name colors. Disable to restore the original icon display. Requires Icons Inventory.
Sandbox_AWS_EnableIconsInventoryWear_too.ch: 在 Icons Inventory 中, 為衣物與背包的圖示邊框加上 AWS 磨損顏色, 並顯示剩餘完整性圓環. 與物品欄名稱顏色各自獨立. 停用即可恢復原本的圖示顯示. 需要 Icons Inventory.
Sandbox_AWS_EnableIconsInventoryWear_too.cn: 在 Icons Inventory 中, 为衣物和背包的图标边框添加 AWS 磨损颜色, 并显示剩余完整性圆环. 与物品栏名称颜色相互独立. 禁用即可恢复原始图标显示. 需要 Icons Inventory.

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsHomeCalm.ch: 居民在基地時保持放鬆
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsHomeCalm.cn: 居民在基地时保持放松

Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsHomeCalm_too.en: Your people inside their own base behave like people at home. Nobody sneaks about (A-Life's Stealth specialty and its quiet walking). Nobody leaves the base to look for a zombie that went out of sight past the fence, or walks out to a noise past it (someone who shot at them is still hunted). Nobody goes to check a noise made by their own crew or by you, or treats the base's own barricades, generators and cars as clues to search. Guards stay on their posts unless a crewmate close by calls for help. The early-outbreak panic doesn't grip them. A real threat changes all of it: someone they see and fight, the base alarm, a mission, an escort. Off: A-Life decides as it does everywhere else.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsHomeCalm_too.ch: 你的人在自己的基地內會像在家一樣行動. 沒有人會四處潛行 (A-Life 的潛行殺手專長與其安靜行走). 沒有人會為了尋找在圍籬外走出視線的殭屍而離開基地, 也不會走出去查探圍籬外的聲響 (朝他們開槍的人仍會被追殺). 沒有人會去察看自己隊伍或你發出的聲響, 也不會把基地自己的路障、發電機與車輛當成線索去搜尋. 除非附近的隊友呼救, 否則警衛會留在崗哨上. 疫情爆發初期的恐慌不會影響他們. 真正的威脅會改變這一切: 他們看見並交戰的對象、基地警報、任務、護送. 關閉: 由 A-Life 照它在其他地方的方式決定.
Sandbox_ALifeJimmy_ResidentsHomeCalm_too.cn: 你的人在自己的基地内会像在家一样行动. 没有人会四处潜行 (A-Life 的潜行杀手专长及其安静行走). 没有人会为了寻找在围栏外走出视线的僵尸而离开基地, 也不会走出去查探围栏外的声响 (朝他们开枪的人仍会被追杀). 没有人会去查看自己队伍或你发出的声响, 也不会把基地自己的路障、发电机和车辆当成线索去搜索. 除非附近的队友呼救, 否则警卫会留在岗哨上. 疫情爆发初期的恐慌不会影响他们. 真正的威胁会改变这一切: 他们看见并交战的对象、基地警报、任务、护送. 关闭: 由 A-Life 按它在其他地方的方式决定.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_DryingRackHeatBrid.en: Drying Racks Use Simulated Room Heat

Drying racks and leather curing use the mod's simulated room temperature. A rack in a room at or above the minimum below dries at normal speed, and faster in rooms warmer than 20°C. The rack's warmth stays on the rack and does not heat the room. While the power grid is on, the base game already keeps powered buildings warm, so this matters once the grid goes down.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_DryingRackHeatBrid.ch: 晾曬架與皮革乾燥會使用本模組模擬的室溫. 若晾曬架所在房間的溫度達到或高於下方的最低值, 就會以正常速度晾乾, 房間溫度高於 20°C 時則會更快. 晾曬架的熱度只作用於晾曬架本身, 不會讓房間變暖. 電網供電期間, 原版遊戲本來就會讓有電的建築保持溫暖, 因此電網停止供電後, 這項設定便顯得重要.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_DryingRackHeatBrid.cn: 晾晒架和皮革干燥会使用本模组模拟的室温. 若晾晒架所在房间的温度达到或高于下方的最低值, 就会以正常速度晾干, 房间温度高于 20°C 时则会更快. 晾晒架的热量只作用于晾晒架本身, 不会让房间变暖. 电网供电期间, 原版游戏本来就会让有电的建筑保持温暖, 因此电网停止供电后, 这项设置就更为重要.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_DryingRackMinRoomT.en: How warm a room must be (°C) before racks in it dry at normal speed. Colder rooms are left to the base game.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_DryingRackMinRoomT.ch: 房間需達到多少溫度 (°C), 其中的晾曬架才會以正常速度晾乾. 更冷的房間則交由原版遊戲處理.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_DryingRackMinRoomT.cn: 房间需达到多少温度 (°C), 其中的晾晒架才会以正常速度晾干. 更冷的房间则交由原版游戏处理.

Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowBody.en: Allows players to place corpses in a composter to produce fertilizer
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowBody.ch: 允許玩家將屍體放入堆肥箱以產生肥料
Sandbox_ZombieVirusVaccineBETA_AllowBody.cn: 允许玩家将尸体放入堆肥箱以产生肥料

Sandbox_JC_MemberRights_tooltip.en: When enabled, a claim owner can set what each member may do: use containers, build, destroy, and manage members. Presets are Guest (may enter, nothing else), Member and Manager. Existing members keep full Member rights until the owner changes them. Off: members work exactly as before.
Sandbox_JC_MemberRights_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 認領擁有者可以設定每位成員能做的事: 使用容器、建造、破壞與管理成員. 預設組合有來賓 (可進入, 其他都不行)、成員與管理者. 既有成員會保有完整的成員權限, 直到擁有者變更為止. 關閉: 成員的運作方式與以前完全相同.
Sandbox_JC_MemberRights_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 认领所有者可以设置每位成员能做的事: 使用容器、建造、破坏和管理成员. 预设有宾客 (可进入, 其他都不行)、成员和管理者. 现有成员会保留完整的成员权限, 直到所有者更改为止. 关闭: 成员的运作方式与以前完全相同.

Sandbox_JC_PublicEntry_tooltip.en: When enabled, a claim owner can open a safehouse to the public. Visitors may walk in (and optionally use containers) but are never members. Only works when the server option SafehouseAllowTrepass is off and DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected is off. While inside, a visitor counts as a visit for the vanilla SafeHouseRemovalTime clock (not for this mod's own claim expiry). Turning this off closes every open claim and removes any visitor inside within a second.
Sandbox_JC_PublicEntry_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 認領擁有者可以將安全屋對外開放. 訪客可以走進來 (並可選擇讓他們使用容器), 但永遠不會是成員. 僅在伺服器選項 SafehouseAllowTrepass 與 DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected 都關閉時才有效. 訪客待在裡面時, 會算作原版 SafeHouseRemovalTime 計時的一次造訪 (不計入本模組自己的認領過期). 關閉此項會關閉所有開放中的認領, 並在一秒內移除裡面的所有訪客.
Sandbox_JC_PublicEntry_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 认领所有者可以将安全屋对外开放. 访客可以走进来 (并可选择让他们使用容器), 但永远不会是成员. 仅在服务器选项 SafehouseAllowTrepass 和 DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected 都关闭时才有效. 访客待在里面时, 会算作原版 SafeHouseRemovalTime 计时的一次造访 (不计入本模组自己的认领过期). 关闭此项会关闭所有开放中的认领, 并在一秒内移除里面的所有访客.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmMinChance_tooltip.en: However high Nimble gets, a pick never becomes completely silent against an alarmed building. Set to 0 to let a master picker beat an alarm outright. Turn off and a window already latched no longer holds.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmMinChance_tooltip.ch: 無論靈活多高, 對裝有警報的建築撬鎖都不會完全無聲. 設為 0 可讓撬鎖高手完全不觸發警報. 關閉後, 已閂上的窗戶也不再鎖得住.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmMinChance_tooltip.cn: 无论灵活多高, 对装有警报的建筑撬锁都不会完全无声. 设为 0 可让撬锁高手完全不触发警报. 关闭后, 已闩上的窗户也不再锁得住.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmOnBreakIn.en: Breaking in trips a house alarm

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmOnBreakIn_tooltip.en: In the base game only climbing through a window can set off a house alarm, so prying the front door off its hinges is completely silent. With this on, picking, prying or cutting your way into an alarmed building wakes it too. Only a successful break-in trips it.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmOnBreakIn_tooltip.ch: 原版遊戲中只有爬窗才會觸發房屋警報, 所以把前門從鉸鏈上撬下來完全不會響. 開啟後, 以撬鎖、撬開或剪斷的方式闖入裝有警報的建築也會觸發警報. 只有成功闖入才會觸發.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmOnBreakIn_tooltip.cn: 在原版游戏中, 只有翻窗才会触发房屋警报, 因此把前门从铰链上撬下来完全不会响. 开启后, 以撬锁、撬开或剪断的方式闯入装有警报的建筑同样会触发警报. 只有成功闯入才会触发.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPerNimble.en: Alarm chance removed per Nimble level
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPerNimble.ch: 每級靈活降低的警報機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPerNimble.cn: 每级灵活降低的警报几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPerNimble_tooltip.en: Taken off both alarm chances for each level of Nimble, so a practised hand is quieter whether the attempt lands or not. One slider moves both cases together, which is what stops them ever crossing over.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPerNimble_tooltip.ch: 每級靈活從兩種警報機率各扣除的數值, 所以熟練的手不論嘗試成功與否都更安靜. 一個滑桿同時調整兩種情況, 這樣兩者的高低才永遠不會顛倒.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPerNimble_tooltip.cn: 每级灵活从两种警报几率中各扣除的数值, 因此熟练的手无论尝试成功与否都更安静. 一个滑块同时调整两种情况, 这样两者的高低才永远不会颠倒.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickFailChance.en: Alarm chance on a failed pick
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickFailChance.ch: 撬鎖失敗時的警報機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickFailChance.cn: 撬锁失败时的警报几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickFailChance_to.en: How likely a botched lockpick attempt is to wake an alarmed building, before Nimble is taken off. Fumbling a lock is the loudest way to meet one, so this is the higher of the two.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickFailChance_to.ch: 撬鎖失敗時驚動裝有警報之建築的機率, 未扣除靈活減免. 笨手笨腳地弄鎖是碰上警報最吵的方式, 所以這是兩者中較高的那個.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickFailChance_to.cn: 撬锁失败时惊动装有警报的建筑的几率, 尚未扣除灵活减免. 笨手笨脚地摆弄锁是碰上警报最吵的方式, 因此这是两者中较高的一个.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickSuccessChance.en: Alarm chance on a successful pick
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickSuccessChance.ch: 撬鎖成功時的警報機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickSuccessChance.cn: 撬锁成功时的警报几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickSuccessChance.en: How likely a clean lockpick is to wake an alarmed building, before Nimble is taken off. Slipping a lock quietly is the whole point, so keep this well below the failure chance.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickSuccessChance.ch: 俐落撬開鎖時驚動裝有警報之建築的機率, 未扣除靈活減免. 悄悄開鎖正是重點所在, 所以請讓它遠低於失敗時的機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AlarmPickSuccessChance.cn: 干净利落地撬开锁时惊动装有警报的建筑的几率, 尚未扣除灵活减免. 悄无声息地开锁才是重点, 因此请将其设得远低于失败时的几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowContainerLocks_to.en: Lets a player fit a padlock or combination padlock to storage furniture: cabinets, lockers, dressers, crates, counters and the like. Appliances, campfires, feeding troughs and foraging bushes are never included. Turn off and a container answers only to its own vanilla lock.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowContainerLocks_to.ch: 讓玩家可在收納家具上安裝掛鎖或密碼鎖: 櫥櫃、儲物櫃、五斗櫃、板條箱、櫃檯之類. 家電、營火、飼料槽與採集用的灌木叢永遠不在此列. 關閉後, 容器只受它原版自帶的鎖控制.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowContainerLocks_to.cn: 允许玩家为储物家具安装挂锁或密码锁: 橱柜、储物柜、五斗柜、板条箱、柜台等. 家电、营火、饲料槽和采集用的灌木丛永远不包括在内. 关闭后, 容器只受其原版自带的锁控制.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyRetrieval_tool.en: Adds a right-click entry that moves a matching key out of a bag and into your hands. The game only looks for keys in your main inventory and on key rings, so a key in a backpack hides the vanilla Lock and Unlock entries even though you are carrying it.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyRetrieval_tool.ch: 新增一個右鍵選項, 把對應的鑰匙從包裡移到你手上. 遊戲只會在主物品欄與鑰匙環上找鑰匙, 所以放在背包裡的鑰匙即使帶在身上, 原版的「上鎖」與「解鎖」選項也不會出現.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyRetrieval_tool.cn: 添加一个右键选项, 将匹配的钥匙从包里移到你手上. 游戏只会在主物品栏和钥匙环上查找钥匙, 因此即使你随身携带, 放在背包里的钥匙也会让原版的“上锁”和“解锁”选项不出现.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyedWindows.en: Window latches can take a key

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyedWindows_tool.en: Off by default, because a window is a latch and not a lock. Switched on, latching a window also binds it to a house key you are carrying, so whoever holds that key can open it from outside instead of having to shim it.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyedWindows_tool.ch: 預設關閉, 因為窗戶上的是閂而不是鎖. 開啟後, 閂上窗戶時也會將它綁定到你身上帶著的房屋鑰匙, 持有那把鑰匙的人就能從外面打開, 不必撥開窗閂.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyedWindows_tool.cn: 默认关闭, 因为窗户上的是闩而不是锁. 开启后, 闩上窗户时也会将其绑定到你随身携带的房屋钥匙, 持有该钥匙的人就能从外面打开, 而不必拨开窗闩.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowWindowLocks_toolt.en: Lets a player throw a window latch from inside, and shim a latched window open from outside with a screwdriver and a paperclip. Shimming costs exactly what picking a door lock costs and also follows the lockpicking switch. The base game has no way to lock or unlock a window at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowWindowLocks_toolt.ch: 讓玩家可從室內閂上窗閂, 並從室外用螺絲起子與迴紋針撥開已閂上的窗戶. 撥開窗閂的消耗與撬門鎖完全相同, 也受撬鎖開關控制. 原版遊戲完全沒有鎖上或解鎖窗戶的方法.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowWindowLocks_toolt.cn: 允许玩家从室内闩上窗闩, 并从室外用螺丝刀和回形针拨开已闩上的窗户. 拨开窗闩的消耗与撬门锁完全相同, 同样受撬锁开关控制. 原版游戏完全无法锁上或解锁窗户.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AutoNameKeys_tooltip.en: A freshly cut key is named after the room it opens, so a key ring stops being a pile of identical keys. You can still rename any key by hand. Keys cut for an outdoor gate, which belongs to no room, keep their default name.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AutoNameKeys_tooltip.ch: 新配製的鑰匙會以它能開啟的房間命名, 讓鑰匙環不再是一堆一模一樣的鑰匙. 你仍可手動重新命名任何鑰匙. 為室外柵門配製的鑰匙不屬於任何房間, 會保留預設名稱.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AutoNameKeys_tooltip.cn: 新配制的钥匙会以其能打开的房间命名, 避免钥匙环变成一堆难以分辨的相同钥匙. 你仍可以手动重命名任何钥匙. 为室外大门配制的钥匙不属于任何房间, 会保留默认名称.

Sandbox_Locksmith_ShowLockTooltip.en: Show lock state on the tooltip
Sandbox_Locksmith_ShowLockTooltip.ch: 在提示框顯示鎖的狀態
Sandbox_Locksmith_ShowLockTooltip.cn: 在提示框中显示锁的状态

Sandbox_Locksmith_ShowLockTooltip_toolti.en: Hovering a locked door, gate or container shows what kind of lock it has and whether you can open it, so you no longer have to right-click to find out. It never shows a combination, only whether you know it.
Sandbox_Locksmith_ShowLockTooltip_toolti.ch: 滑鼠移到上鎖的門、柵門或容器上時, 會顯示它裝的是哪種鎖以及你能否打開, 不必再按右鍵確認. 它絕不會顯示密碼, 只會顯示你是否知道密碼.
Sandbox_Locksmith_ShowLockTooltip_toolti.cn: 鼠标悬停在上锁的门、大门或容器上时, 会显示其锁的类型以及你能否打开, 无需再右键查看. 它从不显示密码, 只显示你是否知道密码.

Sandbox_ALifeDriving_Enabled_tooltip.en: NPC driving, passenger crews and automatic multiplayer control handover. Driving debug controls require admin access.
Sandbox_ALifeDriving_Enabled_tooltip.ch: NPC 駕駛、乘車隊伍, 以及多人遊戲中的自動控制權交接. 駕駛除錯控制需要管理員權限.
Sandbox_ALifeDriving_Enabled_tooltip.cn: NPC 驾驶、乘车队伍, 以及多人游戏中的自动控制权移交. 驾驶调试控制需要管理员权限.

Sandbox_ALifeDriving_VehicleArrivals_too.en: By car spawns create functioning vehicles with seated NPC crews. They drive to a reachable nearby road and dismount. Requires loaded terrain.
Sandbox_ALifeDriving_VehicleArrivals_too.ch: 「乘車」生成會建立可正常運作的車輛, 並載著已就座的 NPC 隊伍. 他們會開到附近可抵達的道路後下車. 需要地形已載入.
Sandbox_ALifeDriving_VehicleArrivals_too.cn: “乘车”生成会创建可正常使用的车辆, 并载有已就座的 NPC 队伍. 他们会开到附近可到达的道路后下车. 需要地形已加载.

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_RainWashHours.ch: 雨水沖走積雪所需時間 (小時)
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_RainWashHours.cn: 雨水冲走积雪所需时间 (小时)

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_RainWashHours_tool.en: Game hours of rain that wash a full cover of snow off the ground, in stages: the snow thins out, the prints and the depth go with it; heavy rain is twice as fast. 0: all at once at the next hour, as in vanilla. In MP the server decides.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_RainWashHours_tool.ch: 雨水把地面一整層積雪沖走所需的遊戲小時數, 分階段進行: 積雪逐漸變薄, 腳印與積雪深度也隨之消失; 大雨時快一倍. 0: 與原版相同, 在下一個整點一次全部消失. 多人遊戲中由伺服器決定.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_RainWashHours_tool.cn: 雨水把地面整层积雪冲走所需的游戏小时数, 分阶段进行: 积雪逐渐变薄, 脚印和积雪深度也随之消失; 大雨时快一倍. 0: 与原版相同, 在下一个整点一次性全部消失. 多人游戏中由服务器决定.

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DGround_toolt.en: Only in the 3D view of Viewpoint with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on: the snow on the ground has a depth (prints, ruts and furrows pressed into it). Off: the ground snow is flat, as Viewpoint lays it.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DGround_toolt.ch: 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組時的 Viewpoint 3D 視角: 地面積雪具有深度 (腳印、車轍與溝痕會壓進雪中). 關閉: 地面積雪是平的, 與 Viewpoint 原本的鋪法相同.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DGround_toolt.cn: 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组时的 Viewpoint 3D 视角: 地面积雪具有深度 (脚印、车辙和沟痕会压进雪中). 关闭: 地面积雪是平的, 与 Viewpoint 原本的铺设方式相同.

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DVehicles_too.en: Only in the 3D view of Viewpoint with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on: the snow on vehicles lies on top as a layer with a thickness (roof, bonnet, boot). Off: the snow on vehicles is flat, as in the isometric view.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DVehicles_too.ch: 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組時的 Viewpoint 3D 視角: 車輛上的積雪會以具有厚度的雪層堆在上方 (車頂、引擎罩、後車廂). 關閉: 車輛上的積雪是平的, 與等角視角相同.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DVehicles_too.cn: 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组时的 Viewpoint 3D 视角: 车辆上的积雪会以具有厚度的雪层堆在上方 (车顶、引擎盖、后备箱). 关闭: 车辆上的积雪是平的, 与等距视角相同.

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowDepth_tooltip.en: Only with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on: depth of the snow on the ground in Viewpoint's 3D view at the highest snow level, less while it is building up or melting. The snow also drifts deeper against buildings, steps run together into a trench and shovelled squares stand as cuttings; from 10 cm it slows you down (3D snow slows you down).
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowDepth_tooltip.ch: 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組: Viewpoint 3D 視角中, 積雪達最高等級時的地面積雪深度, 積雪累積或融化期間會較淺. 積雪也會在建築旁堆得更深, 連續的腳步會連成一道雪溝, 用鏟子清過的格子則像切開的雪道般凹下; 從 10 公分起會拖慢你 (「3D 積雪會拖慢你」).
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowDepth_tooltip.cn: 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组: Viewpoint 3D 视角中, 积雪达到最高等级时的地面积雪深度, 积雪累积或融化期间会较浅. 积雪还会在建筑旁堆得更深, 连续的脚步会连成一道雪沟, 用铲子清理过的格子则像切开的雪道般凹陷; 从 10 厘米起会减慢你的速度 (“3D 积雪会减慢你的速度”).

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowSlowdown_toolt.en: Only with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on (its 3D snow on the ground): from 10 cm of snow (Snow depth) wading through it tires you, from 30 cm you cannot sprint, and a vehicle you drive goes slower (at 45 cm about half its top speed). Not on squares cleared with a shovel; on trampled paths it is easier. In MP the server decides.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowSlowdown_toolt.ch: 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組 (其地面 3D 積雪): 積雪達 10 公分 (「積雪深度」) 起, 在雪中跋涉會消耗耐力; 從 30 公分起無法衝刺. 積雪也會讓你駕駛的車輛變慢 (45 公分時約為最高速度的一半). 用鏟子清過的格子不受影響; 在踩踏小徑上比較輕鬆. 多人遊戲中由伺服器決定.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowSlowdown_toolt.cn: 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组 (其地面 3D 积雪): 积雪达到 10 厘米 (“积雪深度”) 起, 在雪中跋涉会消耗耐力; 从 30 厘米起无法冲刺. 积雪也会使你驾驶的车辆减速 (45 厘米时约为最高速度的一半). 用铲子清理过的格子不受影响; 在踩踏路径上比较轻松. 多人游戏中由服务器决定.

Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowThickness3D_to.en: Only in the 3D view of Viewpoint with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on: the snow on vehicles stands out as a layer where it settles on top (the roof, the bonnet: up to about 12 cm at the last stage at 100%%); clothes, the vehicles' sides, ice and frost on the glass stay flat. 0: flat, as before.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowThickness3D_to.ch: 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組時的 Viewpoint 3D 視角: 車輛上方積雪的地方會凸起成一層雪 (車頂、引擎罩: 設為 100%% 時, 最後階段最厚約 12 公分); 衣物、車身側面、玻璃上的冰與霜仍是平的. 0: 平的, 與以前相同.
Sandbox_ImmersiveSnow_SnowThickness3D_to.cn: 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组时的 Viewpoint 3D 视角: 车辆上方积雪的地方会凸起成一层雪 (车顶、引擎盖: 设为 100%% 时, 最后阶段最厚约 12 厘米); 衣物、车身侧面、玻璃上的冰和霜仍是平的. 0: 平的, 与以前相同.

Sandbox_COF_Spawns_DrownedAmount_tooltip.en: How many Drowned live in each map area. Type any number, decimals too: 0.25 = one in every 4 areas. 0 = none. The old settings: Rare 0.25, Uncommon 0.5, Normal 1, High 2.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_DrownedAmount_tooltip.ch: 每個地圖區域中有多少溺死者. 可輸入任何數字, 小數也可以: 0.25 = 每 4 個區域 1 個. 0 = 沒有. 舊設定對照: 稀少 0.25, 少見 0.5, 普通 1, 多 2.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_DrownedAmount_tooltip.cn: 每个地图区域中有多少溺亡者. 可输入任意数字, 也可以是小数: 0.25 = 每 4 个区域 1 个. 0 = 无. 旧设置对照: 罕见 0.25, 稀少 0.5, 普通 1, 高 2.

Sandbox_COF_Spawns_RegularAmount_tooltip.en: How many regular monsters (Slowers, Fasters, Children and others) live around you in a town; fewer in the suburbs and the countryside. Type any number, decimals too. 0 = none. The old settings: Rare 4, Uncommon 8, Normal 12, High 20.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_RegularAmount_tooltip.ch: 你在城鎮中時, 周圍有多少一般怪物 (慢行者、快行者、孩童等); 郊區與鄉間較少. 可輸入任何數字, 小數也可以. 0 = 沒有. 舊設定對照: 稀少 4, 少見 8, 普通 12, 多 20.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_RegularAmount_tooltip.cn: 你在城镇中时, 周围有多少常规怪物 (慢行者、快行者、小孩等); 郊区和乡村较少. 可输入任意数字, 也可以是小数. 0 = 无. 旧设置对照: 罕见 4, 稀少 8, 普通 12, 高 20.

Sandbox_COF_Spawns_SawcrazyAmount_toolti.en: How many Sawcrazies live in each map area. Type any number, decimals too: 0.25 = one in every 4 areas, 1 = one in each. 0 = none. The old settings: Rare 0.1, Uncommon 0.25, Normal 0.5, High 1.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_SawcrazyAmount_toolti.ch: 每個地圖區域中有多少電鋸瘋子. 可輸入任何數字, 小數也可以: 0.25 = 每 4 個區域 1 個, 1 = 每個區域 1 個. 0 = 沒有. 舊設定對照: 稀少 0.1, 少見 0.25, 普通 0.5, 多 1.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_SawcrazyAmount_toolti.cn: 每个地图区域中有多少电锯疯子. 可输入任意数字, 也可以是小数: 0.25 = 每 4 个区域 1 个, 1 = 每个区域 1 个. 0 = 无. 旧设置对照: 罕见 0.1, 稀少 0.25, 普通 0.5, 高 1.

Sandbox_COF_Spawns_SawrunnerAmount_toolt.en: How many Sawrunners live in each map area (needs ordinary Sawrunner spawning on). Type any number, decimals too: 0.25 = one in every 4 areas. 0 = none. The old settings: Rare 0.25, Uncommon 0.5, Normal 1, High 2.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_SawrunnerAmount_toolt.ch: 每個地圖區域中有多少電鋸狂奔者 (需開啟「允許電鋸狂奔者一般生成」). 可輸入任何數字, 小數也可以: 0.25 = 每 4 個區域 1 個. 0 = 沒有. 舊設定對照: 稀少 0.25, 少見 0.5, 普通 1, 多 2.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_SawrunnerAmount_toolt.cn: 每个地图区域中有多少电锯狂奔者 (需开启“允许常规生成电锯狂奔者”). 可输入任意数字, 也可以是小数: 0.25 = 每 4 个区域 1 个. 0 = 无. 旧设置对照: 罕见 0.25, 稀少 0.5, 普通 1, 高 2.

Sandbox_COF_Spawns_StrangerAmount_toolti.en: How many Strangers live in each map area. Type any number, decimals too: 0.25 = one in every 4 areas. 0 = none. The old settings: Rare 0.25, Uncommon 0.5, Normal 1, High 2.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_StrangerAmount_toolti.ch: 每個地圖區域中有多少陌生人. 可輸入任何數字, 小數也可以: 0.25 = 每 4 個區域 1 個. 0 = 沒有. 舊設定對照: 稀少 0.25, 少見 0.5, 普通 1, 多 2.
Sandbox_COF_Spawns_StrangerAmount_toolti.cn: 每个地图区域中有多少怪人. 可输入任意数字, 也可以是小数: 0.25 = 每 4 个区域 1 个. 0 = 无. 旧设置对照: 罕见 0.25, 稀少 0.5, 普通 1, 高 2.

Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_ScaleByTou.en: Off by default: preserve fixed HP damage and Zombie Lore toughness differences. When enabled, scale by the average Fragile or Tough spawn health relative to Normal. Hit counts remain approximate. Normal and Random use no scaling; Random retains individual health variation.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_ScaleByTou.ch: 預設關閉: 維持固定的生命值傷害, 保留殭屍設定中韌性造成的差異. 啟用後, 依脆弱或堅韌殭屍生成時的平均生命值相對於普通殭屍的比例調整傷害. 所需擊打次數仍只是大約值. 普通與隨機不做調整; 隨機會保留每隻殭屍各自的生命值差異.
Sandbox_BarricadesHurtZombies_ScaleByTou.cn: 默认关闭: 保持固定的生命值伤害, 保留僵尸设置中韧性带来的差异. 启用后, 按脆弱或坚强僵尸生成时的平均生命值相对于普通僵尸的比例缩放伤害. 所需命中次数仍只是近似值. 普通和随机不进行缩放; 随机会保留每只僵尸各自的生命值差异.

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableExecutions.en:
Allows sneaking players behind unaware zombies to perform critical ambush executions with knives, blades, and heavy weapons.
Default: Off (Opt-in).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableExecutions.ch:
允許潛行中的玩家在未察覺的殭屍背後, 用刀子、刀刃類武器與重型武器發動致命的伏擊處決.
預設: 關閉 (需自行開啟).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableExecutions.cn:
允许潜行中的玩家在未察觉的僵尸背后, 用小刀、刀刃类武器和重型武器发动致命的伏击处决.
默认: 关闭 (需手动开启).

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableMeleeDeath.en:
Enables physical ragdoll collapses on fatal melee and gunshot hits with sub-tile wall and vehicle collision detection to prevent clipping.
Default: On.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableMeleeDeath.ch:
近戰與槍擊致命命中時, 殭屍會以物理布娃娃效果倒下, 並以小於一格的精度偵測牆壁與車輛碰撞, 避免模型穿透.
預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_EnableMeleeDeath.cn:
近战和枪击致命命中时, 僵尸会以物理布娃娃效果倒下, 并以小于一格的精度检测墙壁和车辆碰撞, 防止穿模.
默认: 开启.

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StrengthScaling.ch: 依玩家力量與武器重量調整
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StrengthScaling.cn: 按玩家力量和武器重量缩放

Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StrengthScaling_.en:
Dynamically scales melee and shove knockdowns using the player's Strength perk level and heavy weapon weight modifiers. True range scales from 3%% (Strength 0 knife) to 30%% (Strength 10 sledgehammer) when base chance is 8%%.
Default: Off (Opt-in).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StrengthScaling_.ch:
依玩家的力量技能等級與重型武器的重量修正, 動態調整近戰與推開的擊倒效果. 基礎機率為 8%% 時, 實際範圍從 3%% (力量 0 持小刀) 到 30%% (力量 10 持大錘).
預設: 關閉 (需自行開啟).
Sandbox_TrippingZombies_StrengthScaling_.cn:
根据玩家的力量技能等级和重型武器的重量修正, 动态缩放近战和推开的击倒效果. 基础概率为 8%% 时, 实际范围从 3%% (力量 0 持小刀) 到 30%% (力量 10 持大锤).
默认: 关闭 (需手动开启).

Sandbox_DarkPresence_ShadowLookOnly_tool.en: Turns this into a looks-only mod. Every zombie in the world wears the dark body, and nothing else changes: no shields, no light burning them away, no Taken spawning or possessing walkers, no dissolving at dawn, no story. They are ordinary zombies that look like shadows, so you never meet a resistant one mixed in with normal ones. Overrides the options below. Default off.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_ShadowLookOnly_tool.ch: 將本模組變成純外觀模組. 世界上每隻殭屍都會換上黑暗軀體, 除此之外一切不變: 沒有護盾、光照不會燒除它們、沒有被奪者生成或占據行屍、黎明時不會消散、沒有故事. 它們只是看起來像暗影的普通殭屍, 因此你不會遇到混在普通殭屍裡的抗性個體. 此選項優先於下方的選項. 預設為關閉.
Sandbox_DarkPresence_ShadowLookOnly_tool.cn: 将本模组变为纯外观模组. 世界上每只僵尸都会披上黑暗躯体, 除此之外一切不变: 没有护盾、光照不会烧除它们、没有被夺者生成或占据行尸、黎明时不会消散、没有故事. 它们只是看起来像暗影的普通僵尸, 因此你不会遇到混在普通僵尸中的抗性个体. 此选项优先于下方的选项. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_BigText.en: Bigger text for what your character says

Sandbox_LiveToFight_BigText_tooltip.en: For high resolutions such as 4K: the lines your character says about the mod's events are shown in a larger font above them, instead of the game's small speech text.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_BigText_tooltip.ch: 適用於 4K 等高解析度: 角色針對本模組事件所說的台詞, 會以較大的字型顯示在角色上方, 而非遊戲原本的小字對話.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_BigText_tooltip.cn: 适用于 4K 等高分辨率: 角色针对本模组事件所说的台词, 会以较大的字体显示在角色上方, 而不是游戏原本的小字对话.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterMenu.en: Chapter II switch on the right-click menu
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterMenu.ch: 右鍵選單上的第二章開關
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterMenu.cn: 右键菜单上的第二章开关

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterMenu_tooltip.en: Off by default: once Chapter II is on, the right-click menu no longer shows its switch. While it is off you still see it, so you can turn it on. Turn this on to always keep the switch on the menu.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterMenu_tooltip.ch: 預設關閉: 第二章開啟後, 右鍵選單就不再顯示它的開關. 第二章關閉期間仍會顯示, 讓你可以開啟. 開啟此選項可讓開關一直保留在選單上.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterMenu_tooltip.cn: 默认关闭: 第二章开启后, 右键菜单就不再显示它的开关. 第二章关闭期间仍会显示, 让你可以开启. 开启此选项可让开关始终保留在菜单上.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterPrompt.en: Ask about Chapter II when a save starts
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterPrompt.ch: 存檔開始時詢問是否開啟第二章
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterPrompt.cn: 存档开始时询问是否开启第二章

Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterPrompt_toolti.en: The one-time question about Chapter II a few seconds into a save that does not have it yet. Turn this off and you are never asked; Chapter II then stays as set above.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterPrompt_toolti.ch: 在尚未包含第二章的存檔中, 開始遊玩幾秒後跳出的一次性第二章詢問. 關閉此選項就永遠不會被詢問; 第二章會維持上方的設定.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_ChapterPrompt_toolti.cn: 在尚未包含第二章的存档中, 开始游玩几秒后弹出的一次性第二章询问. 关闭此选项就永远不会被询问; 第二章将保持上方的设置.

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneRemnantpost.ch: 被重新利用的軍事據點
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneRemnantpost.cn: 被重新利用的军事据点

Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneRemnantpost_too.en: An army checkpoint survivors moved into, on a straight road with no house within 15 squares (no town needed). Happens in days 3 to 30 (never after "Outbreak scenes stop after"). "Its days, then what is left": after that, what it left is still found in places you have not been since. "Only in its own days": after that, never.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneRemnantpost_too.ch: 倖存者遷入的軍方檢查哨, 位於 15 格內沒有房屋的筆直道路上 (不需要城鎮). 於第 3 到 30 天發生 (不會晚於「爆發期場景停止時間」). 「發生期間, 之後留下殘跡」: 之後在你從那時起沒再去過的地方, 仍能找到它留下的東西. 「僅限其發生期間」: 之後就不再出現.
Sandbox_LiveToFight_SceneRemnantpost_too.cn: 幸存者迁入的军方检查站, 位于 15 格内没有房屋的笔直道路上 (不需要城镇). 于第 3 到 30 天发生 (不会晚于“爆发期场景停止时间”). “发生期间, 之后留下残迹”: 之后在你从那时起没再去过的地方, 仍能找到它留下的东西. “仅限其发生期间”: 之后就不再出现.

Sandbox_FTZCarts_MechanicCapacity._note: 2026-10-26 As1 v3.12.0 收錄 FTZ Carts & Trolleys（3815775971）後退役 own 目錄，As1 未收的這鍵遷入本層

Sandbox_FTZCarts_MechanicCapacity_toolti.en: Weight a mechanic tool cart can hold (42 by default).
Sandbox_FTZCarts_MechanicCapacity_toolti.ch: 汽修工具推車可容納的重量 (預設 42).
Sandbox_FTZCarts_MechanicCapacity_toolti.cn: 汽修工具推车可容纳的重量 (默认 42).
Sandbox_FTZCarts_MechanicCapacity_toolti._note: 2026-10-26 As1 v3.12.0 收錄 FTZ Carts & Trolleys（3815775971）後退役 own 目錄，As1 未收的這鍵遷入本層

Sandbox_BL_CigHabitSmokes.ch: 菸不離手特質: 所需香菸數
Sandbox_BL_CigHabitSmokes.cn: 烟不离手特质: 所需香烟数

Sandbox_BL_CigHabitSmokes_tooltip.en: Cigarettes smoked before a clean character earns the Chain Smoker trait. 0 disables. Default 40.
Sandbox_BL_CigHabitSmokes_tooltip.ch: 未成癮的角色要抽多少根香菸才會獲得菸不離手特質. 設為 0 則停用. 預設: 40.
Sandbox_BL_CigHabitSmokes_tooltip.cn: 未成瘾的角色需要抽多少支香烟才会获得烟不离手特质. 设为 0 则禁用. 默认: 40.

Sandbox_BL_HabitThresholdHours.ch: 酗酒成性特質: 所需醉酒時數
Sandbox_BL_HabitThresholdHours.cn: 酗酒成性特质: 所需醉酒时数

Sandbox_BL_HabitThresholdHours_tooltip.en: Cumulative hours spent drunk (net of sober decay) before a clean character earns the Alcoholic trait. 0 disables acquisition. Default 10.
Sandbox_BL_HabitThresholdHours_tooltip.ch: 未成癮的角色累計醉酒多少小時 (扣除清醒時的衰減) 後會獲得酗酒成性特質. 設為 0 則無法獲得. 預設: 10.
Sandbox_BL_HabitThresholdHours_tooltip.cn: 未成瘾的角色累计醉酒多少小时 (扣除清醒时的衰减) 后会获得酗酒成性特质. 设为 0 则无法获得. 默认: 10.

Sandbox_BL_MethAddictLevel.en: Meth Addict Trait: Addiction Level Trigger
Sandbox_BL_MethAddictLevel.ch: 冰毒成癮特質: 觸發成癮程度
Sandbox_BL_MethAddictLevel.cn: 冰毒成瘾特质: 触发成瘾程度

Sandbox_BL_MethAddictLevel_tooltip.en: When the KNXDrugs addiction meter reaches this level through use, the Meth Addict trait is granted. Requires KNXDrugs. 0 disables. Default 55.
Sandbox_BL_MethAddictLevel_tooltip.ch: 因使用而使 KNXDrugs 的成癮量表達到此數值時, 會獲得冰毒成癮特質. 需要 KNXDrugs. 設為 0 則停用. 預設: 55.
Sandbox_BL_MethAddictLevel_tooltip.cn: 因使用导致 KNXDrugs 的成瘾值达到此数值时, 会获得冰毒成瘾特质. 需要 KNXDrugs. 设为 0 则禁用. 默认: 55.

Sandbox_BL_PillHabitDoses.ch: 藥不離口特質: 所需劑數
Sandbox_BL_PillHabitDoses.cn: 药不离口特质: 所需剂数

Sandbox_BL_PillHabitDoses_tooltip.en: Painkiller and sleeping-pill doses before a clean character earns the Pill Popper trait. Beta blockers and vitamins never count. 0 disables. Default 25.
Sandbox_BL_PillHabitDoses_tooltip.ch: 未成癮的角色服用多少劑止痛藥與安眠藥後會獲得藥不離口特質. β-阻斷劑與咖啡因藥丸一律不計入. 設為 0 則停用. 預設: 25.
Sandbox_BL_PillHabitDoses_tooltip.cn: 未成瘾的角色服用多少剂止痛药和安眠药后会获得药不离口特质. β-阻断剂和维生素一律不计入. 设为 0 则禁用. 默认: 25.
Sandbox_BL_PillHabitDoses_tooltip._note: vitamins 指原版 Base.PillsVitamins（B42 英文已改名 Caffeine Pills）：繁中照 LangFor42「咖啡因藥丸」，簡中照 LangFor42「维生素」（BadlandsCharacters_Data.lua 的 DoseTypes 只算 Base.Pills、PillsSleepingTablets 與 BADLANDS Drugs 藥瓶，2026-10-26 查）

Sandbox_BL_VanillaIntegration_tooltip.en: Master switch: vanilla drinking can grow into the Alcoholic trait, idle skill traits gain live effects, and trait crafts (moonshine) appear. Off kills the whole layer without a mod update.
Sandbox_BL_VanillaIntegration_tooltip.ch: 總開關: 原版的飲酒行為可能演變為酗酒成性特質, 原本閒置的技能特質會獲得實際效果, 並出現特質專屬製作 (私釀酒). 關閉時會停用整個整合層, 無須更新模組.
Sandbox_BL_VanillaIntegration_tooltip.cn: 总开关: 原版的饮酒行为可能发展为酗酒成性特质, 原本闲置的技能特质会获得实际效果, 并出现特质专属制作 (私酿酒). 关闭时会禁用整个整合层, 无需更新模组.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmCha.ch: 黃金存款: 警報機率
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmCha.cn: 黄金存款: 警报概率

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmCha.en: Chance each deposit trips the alarm.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmCha.ch: 每次存款觸發警報的機率.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmCha.cn: 每次存款触发警报的概率.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmEna.ch: 黃金存款: 無聲警報
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmEna.cn: 黄金存款: 无声警报

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmEna.en: A deposit has a chance to trip a silent alarm that draws nearby zombies toward the box. No new zombies are spawned.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmEna.ch: 存款時有機率觸發無聲警報, 把附近的殭屍引向存款箱. 不會生成新的殭屍.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAlarmEna.cn: 存款时有概率触发无声警报, 把附近的僵尸引向存款箱. 不会生成新的僵尸.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushCh.ch: 黃金存款: 伏擊機率
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushCh.cn: 黄金存款: 伏击概率

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushCh.en: Chance each deposit triggers the ambush.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushCh.ch: 每次存款觸發伏擊的機率.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushCh.cn: 每次存款触发伏击的概率.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushEn.en: A deposit has a chance to trigger an armed ambush near the box. Requires the Bandits or Roaming Survivors mod.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushEn.ch: 存款時有機率在存款箱附近觸發武裝伏擊. 需要 Bandits 或 Roaming Survivors 模組.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositAmbushEn.cn: 存款时有概率在存款箱附近触发武装伏击. 需要 Bandits 或流浪幸存者模组.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositEnabled_.en: Lets Gold Bars be deposited at a physical drop box placed outside each bank. Deposits every Gold Bar carried at once and pays out in Cash Cases, several bars' worth each (see Gold Deposit: Bars Per Payout).
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositEnabled_.ch: 允許在每間銀行外的實體存款箱存入金錠. 會一次存入身上攜帶的所有金錠, 並以現金箱支付, 每箱相當於數個金錠的價值 (見「黃金存款: 每箱金錠數」).
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositEnabled_.cn: 允许在每家银行外的实体存款箱存入金锭. 会一次存入身上携带的全部金锭, 并以现金箱支付, 每箱相当于数块金锭的价值 (见“黄金存款: 每箱金锭数”).

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositMaxBars.ch: 黃金存款: 每箱金錠數
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositMaxBars.cn: 黄金存款: 每箱金锭数

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositMaxBars_.en: How many Gold Bars' worth of value goes into each payout container.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositMaxBars_.ch: 每個支付容器中裝入相當於幾個金錠的價值.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositMaxBars_.cn: 每个支付容器中装入相当于多少块金锭的价值.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositValue_to.en: How much Cash one Gold Bar is worth when deposited. Gold Bars can't be spent as currency or sold to a trader over the radio -- depositing is the only way to cash one in.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositValue_to.ch: 存入時一個金錠值多少現金. 金錠無法當作貨幣使用, 也無法透過電臺賣給商人 —— 存款是把它換成現金的唯一方法.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_GoldDepositValue_to.cn: 存入时一块金锭值多少现金. 金锭不能当作货币使用, 也不能通过电台卖给商人 —— 存款是把它兑换成现金的唯一途径.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_ThreadsClothingSour.en: Restricts what clothing Threads stocks and buys. Everything: normal behavior, every clothing mod plus vanilla. Vanilla Only: just vanilla (Base.*) clothing, no mods. Authentic Z Only: just Authentic Z's clothing, nothing vanilla or from any other mod.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ThreadsClothingSour.ch: 限制針線進貨與收購的服裝. 全部: 一般行為, 包含所有服裝模組與原版. 僅限原版: 只有原版 (Base.*) 服裝, 不含模組. 僅限 Authentic Z: 只有 Authentic Z 的服裝, 不含原版或任何其他模組.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ThreadsClothingSour.cn: 限制布店进货和收购的衣物. 全部: 常规行为, 包含所有衣物模组和原版. 仅限原版: 只有原版 (Base.*) 衣物, 不含模组. 仅限 Authentic Z: 只有 Authentic Z 的衣物, 不含原版或其他任何模组.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinChance_to.en: Chance a killed zombie is carrying loose coins (Gold or Silver Coin), separate from the wallet/cash chance above. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinChance_to.ch: 被殺的殭屍身上帶有零散硬幣 (「硬幣 (金)」或「硬幣 (銀)」) 的機率, 與上方的錢包/現金機率分開計算. 設為 0 可停用.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinChance_to.cn: 被杀的僵尸身上带有零散硬币 (“硬币 (金)”或“硬币 (银)”) 的概率, 与上方的钱包/现金概率分开计算. 设为 0 可禁用.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinCountMax_.en: Most coins dropped when the chance above hits.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinCountMax_.ch: 上方機率觸發時掉落的最多硬幣數.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinCountMax_.cn: 上方概率触发时掉落的最多硬币数.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinCountMin_.en: Fewest coins dropped when the chance above hits.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinCountMin_.ch: 上方機率觸發時掉落的最少硬幣數.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinCountMin_.cn: 上方概率触发时掉落的最少硬币数.

Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinGoldChanc.ch: 殭屍硬幣: 金幣機率
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinGoldChanc.cn: 僵尸硬币: 金币概率

Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinGoldChanc.en: Of the coins a zombie drops, the chance each individual one is a Gold Coin instead of a Silver Coin.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinGoldChanc.ch: 在殭屍掉落的硬幣中, 每一枚是「硬幣 (金)」而非「硬幣 (銀)」的機率.
Sandbox_RadioTraders_ZombieCoinGoldChanc.cn: 在僵尸掉落的硬币中, 每一枚是“硬币 (金)”而不是“硬币 (银)”的概率.

Sandbox_Fletcher_ArcheryXP_tooltip.en: Archery's own XP multiplier, used when the global XP multiplier is turned off (per-skill multipliers), like every vanilla skill's.
Sandbox_Fletcher_ArcheryXP_tooltip.ch: 射箭專屬的經驗倍率, 在關閉全域經驗倍率 (改用各技能倍率) 時使用, 與每個原版技能相同.
Sandbox_Fletcher_ArcheryXP_tooltip.cn: 射箭专属的经验倍率, 在关闭全局经验倍率 (改用各技能倍率) 时使用, 与每个原版技能相同.

Sandbox_Fletcher_ArrowSpread_tooltip.en: How far flying arrows and bolts stray from where you aim. 1 is the default. Lower is more precise (0.5 halves the spread), higher is wilder (2 doubles it). The aiming reticle follows it. Archery level, steady aim, moving and moodles still apply on top.
Sandbox_Fletcher_ArrowSpread_tooltip.ch: 飛行中的箭與弩箭偏離瞄準點的程度. 1 為預設值. 越低越精準 (0.5 讓散布減半), 越高越散亂 (2 讓散布加倍). 瞄準準星會隨之調整. 射箭等級、穩定瞄準、移動與狀態仍會額外疊加影響.
Sandbox_Fletcher_ArrowSpread_tooltip.cn: 飞行中的箭与弩箭偏离瞄准点的程度. 1 为默认值. 越低越精准 (0.5 使散布减半), 越高越散乱 (2 使散布加倍). 瞄准准星会随之变化. 射箭等级、稳定瞄准、移动和状态仍会额外叠加影响.

Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrowDamage_tooltip.en: Multiplies every bomb arrow's blast damage (Blasting, Shrapnel, Concussion and Sticky): 1 is normal (a pipe bomb is about 1.5), 0 harmless.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrowDamage_tooltip.ch: 調整所有爆炸箭的爆炸傷害倍率 (爆破、破片、震撼與黏性): 1 為正常 (土製炸彈約為 1.5), 0 為無害.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrowDamage_tooltip.cn: 调整所有爆炸箭的爆炸伤害倍率 (爆破、破片、震撼和粘性): 1 为正常 (土制炸弹约为 1.5), 0 为无害.

Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrowFire_tooltip.en: Incendiary Arrows start fires. Unticked: they don't go off (no fire from any arrow but the plain fire arrow). The server's own no-fire setting also stops them.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrowFire_tooltip.ch: 燃燒箭矢會引發火災. 未勾選時: 燃燒箭矢不會引爆 (除了普通的火焰箭矢以外, 任何箭都不會起火). 伺服器本身的禁止火災設定也會阻止它們.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrowFire_tooltip.cn: 燃烧箭矢会引发火灾. 未勾选时: 燃烧箭矢不会引爆 (除了普通的火焰箭矢, 任何箭都不会起火). 服务器自身的禁止火灾设置也会阻止它们.

Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrows_tooltip.en: Bomb arrows (Blasting, Shrapnel, Concussion, Sticky, Incendiary and Smoke) go off where they land, and Explosives Diagrams can teach how to make them. Unticked: they never go off, and diagrams teach only the game's own recipes.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrows_tooltip.ch: 爆炸箭 (爆破、破片、震撼、黏性、燃燒與煙霧) 會在落點引爆, 且爆炸物圖紙可以教你製作方法. 未勾選時: 爆炸箭永遠不會引爆, 圖紙也只會教遊戲原本的配方.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BombArrows_tooltip.cn: 爆炸箭 (爆破、破片、震撼、粘性、燃烧和烟雾) 会在落点引爆, 并且爆炸物图示可以教你制作方法. 未勾选时: 爆炸箭永远不会引爆, 图示也只会教游戏原有的配方.

Sandbox_Fletcher_BowLoot_tooltip.en: How often bows, crossbows and boxes of arrows or bolts turn up in the world: 1 is normal, 0 none (craft everything yourself), up to 4. Hunter zombies with bows have their own setting.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BowLoot_tooltip.ch: 弓、十字弩以及盒裝箭矢或弩箭在世界中出現的頻率: 1 為正常, 0 為無 (一切都要自己製作), 最高 4. 持弓獵人殭屍有獨立的設定.
Sandbox_Fletcher_BowLoot_tooltip.cn: 弓、十字弩以及盒装箭矢或弩箭在世界中出现的频率: 1 为正常, 0 为无 (一切都得自己制作), 最高 4. 持弓猎人僵尸有单独的设置.

Sandbox_Fletcher_HunterZombieBows_toolti.en: Percent of hunter zombies that carry a bow or crossbow on their back. Rangers and survivalists sometimes do too. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_Fletcher_HunterZombieBows_toolti.ch: 背著弓或十字弩的獵人殭屍所占百分比. 護林員與生存專家有時也會背. 0 為關閉.
Sandbox_Fletcher_HunterZombieBows_toolti.cn: 背着弓或十字弩的猎人僵尸所占的百分比. 护林员和生存专家有时也会背. 0 为关闭.

Sandbox_Fletcher_LightFireArrowsByHand.en: Fire Arrows: Light By Hand (Off: Light On Release)
Sandbox_Fletcher_LightFireArrowsByHand.ch: 火焰箭矢: 手動點燃 (關閉時: 放箭時點燃)
Sandbox_Fletcher_LightFireArrowsByHand.cn: 火焰箭矢: 手动点燃 (关闭时: 放箭时点燃)

Sandbox_Fletcher_LightFireArrowsByHand_t.en: Ticked: you light each fire arrow yourself. With it nocked, hold R (RB on a controller) and choose Light Arrow, with a lighter or matches; it burns for about 25 seconds, and if you don't shoot in time the rag burns away and a plain arrow is left. A fire arrow shot without lighting it doesn't burn anything. Unticked: fire arrows light themselves as you shoot, if you carry a lighter or matches (one use per arrow).
Sandbox_Fletcher_LightFireArrowsByHand_t.ch: 勾選時: 你要自己點燃每支火焰箭矢. 搭箭後按住 R (控制器為 RB) 並選擇「點燃箭矢」, 需要打火機或火柴; 箭會燃燒約 25 秒, 若沒及時射出, 碎布會燒光, 只剩下一支普通的箭. 未點燃就射出的火焰箭矢不會點燃任何東西. 未勾選時: 只要你身上帶著打火機或火柴, 火焰箭矢會在射出時自動點燃 (每支箭消耗一次).
Sandbox_Fletcher_LightFireArrowsByHand_t.cn: 勾选时: 你需要亲手点燃每支火焰箭矢. 搭箭后按住 R (手柄为 RB) 并选择“点燃箭矢”, 需要打火机或火柴; 箭会燃烧约 25 秒, 如果没有及时射出, 碎布会烧尽, 只剩下一支普通的箭. 未点燃就射出的火焰箭矢不会点燃任何东西. 未勾选时: 只要你身上带着打火机或火柴, 火焰箭矢会在射出时自动点燃 (每支箭消耗一次).

Sandbox_Fletcher_StealthShots_tooltip.en: Arrows and bolts loosed while sneaking at a zombie that hasn't noticed you hit 20 percent harder and are more likely to be critical hits (more with the Sneaking skill). Flying arrows only.
Sandbox_Fletcher_StealthShots_tooltip.ch: 潛行時對尚未發現你的殭屍射出的箭與弩箭, 傷害提高百分之 20, 且更容易造成暴擊 (潛行技能越高效果越強). 僅適用於實際飛行的箭矢.
Sandbox_Fletcher_StealthShots_tooltip.cn: 潜行时对尚未发现你的僵尸射出的箭与弩箭, 伤害提高百分之 20, 且更容易打出暴击 (潜行技能越高效果越强). 仅适用于实际飞行的箭矢.

Sandbox_Fletcher_TrueProjectiles_tooltip.en: Arrows and bolts fly as real projectiles: they drop over distance, stop at walls and trees, and hit whatever they reach first, with headshots by height. Off: every shot hits or misses at once like a gun.
Sandbox_Fletcher_TrueProjectiles_tooltip.ch: 箭與弩箭會以真實的拋射物飛行: 隨距離下墜, 會被牆壁與樹木擋下, 並命中最先碰到的東西, 依高度判定爆頭. 關閉時: 每一箭都像槍一樣立即判定命中或未命中.
Sandbox_Fletcher_TrueProjectiles_tooltip.cn: 箭与弩箭作为真实的抛射物飞行: 随距离下坠, 会被墙壁和树木挡住, 并命中最先碰到的东西, 按高度判定爆头. 关闭时: 每一箭都像枪一样立即判定命中或未命中.

Sandbox_Fletcher_XPBonuses_tooltip.en: Harder shots earn more Archery XP (long shots, lobs, headshots, moving targets, a quick release...), and bomb and fire arrows earn a share of a kill for each zombie they kill, up to a limit. Easy shots pay less as Archery rises, and so do repeated hits on the same zombie. Off: every hit pays the same, as before 0.12.
Sandbox_Fletcher_XPBonuses_tooltip.ch: 越難的射擊獲得越多射箭經驗 (遠射、拋射、爆頭、移動目標、快速放箭…), 爆炸箭與火焰箭矢每殺死一隻殭屍, 都能分得一部分擊殺經驗, 有上限. 射箭等級越高, 簡單射擊給的經驗越少, 重複命中同一隻殭屍也是如此. 關閉時: 每次命中給的經驗都一樣, 與 0.12 版之前相同.
Sandbox_Fletcher_XPBonuses_tooltip.cn: 越难的射击获得越多射箭经验 (远射、抛射、爆头、移动目标、快速放箭…), 爆炸箭和火焰箭矢每杀死一只僵尸, 都能分得一部分击杀经验, 有上限. 射箭等级越高, 简单射击给的经验越少, 重复命中同一只僵尸也一样. 关闭时: 每次命中给的经验都相同, 与 0.12 版之前一样.

Sandbox_TWGameplay_DeepSnowSlowdown_tool.en: How much of your speed the deepest snow takes: 0.45 = a little under half, 0 = none, 0.85 = a crawl.
Sandbox_TWGameplay_DeepSnowSlowdown_tool.ch: 最深的積雪會讓你損失多少速度: 0.45 = 略少於一半, 0 = 不減速, 0.85 = 寸步難行.
Sandbox_TWGameplay_DeepSnowSlowdown_tool.cn: 最深的积雪会让你损失多少速度: 0.45 = 略少于一半, 0 = 不减速, 0.85 = 寸步难行.

Sandbox_TWGameplay_DeepSnowSlows_tooltip.en: Wading through deep snow (True Weathers & Lighting's raised snow) slows walking and running, more the deeper it lies. Outdoors at ground level, on foot; vehicles are unaffected.
Sandbox_TWGameplay_DeepSnowSlows_tooltip.ch: 在深雪中跋涉 (True Weathers & Lighting 堆高的積雪) 會減慢步行與奔跑速度, 雪越深越慢. 僅限在戶外地面層徒步時; 車輛不受影響.
Sandbox_TWGameplay_DeepSnowSlows_tooltip.cn: 在深雪中跋涉 (True Weathers & Lighting 堆高的积雪) 会减慢步行和奔跑速度, 雪越深越慢. 仅限在户外地面层徒步时; 车辆不受影响.

Sandbox_TWGameplay_MeteoriteDays_tooltip.en: On average how many in-game days between meteorite falls (one at most per night).
Sandbox_TWGameplay_MeteoriteDays_tooltip.ch: 平均每隔多少遊戲天數會墜落一顆隕石 (每晚最多一顆).
Sandbox_TWGameplay_MeteoriteDays_tooltip.cn: 平均每隔多少游戏天会坠落一颗陨石 (每晚最多一颗).

Sandbox_TWGameplay_Meteorites_tooltip.en: Now and then at night a fireball comes down somewhere within a kilometre of a player, seen across the whole map, and leaves a small smoking crater with a meteorite in it (iron: it can be smelted). Players hear its sonic boom a minute or more later.
Sandbox_TWGameplay_Meteorites_tooltip.ch: 夜裡偶爾會有火球墜落在玩家周圍 1 公里內的某處, 整張地圖都看得到, 並留下一個冒煙的小隕石坑, 坑裡有一顆隕石 (鐵質: 可以熔煉). 玩家會在一分鐘或更久之後聽到它的音爆.
Sandbox_TWGameplay_Meteorites_tooltip.cn: 夜里偶尔会有火球坠落在玩家周围 1 公里内的某处, 全图都能看到, 并留下一个冒烟的小陨石坑, 坑里有一颗陨石 (铁质: 可以熔炼). 玩家会在一分钟或更久之后听到它的音爆.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants.en: Project A-Life NPCs with an implant
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants.ch: 帶有植入物的 Project A-Life NPC
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants.cn: 带有植入物的 Project A-Life NPC

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants_toolti.en: Only with Project A-Life [ALIFE NPCS]. An NPC dressed with the Sandevistan spine in the A-Life creator leaves the implant in its corpse, and you extract it like an ex-subject's: military-grade comes out pristine, a lab prototype slightly worn. Off = the spine on those NPCs is only a look.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants_toolti.ch: 僅限搭配 Project A-Life [ALIFE NPCS]. 在 A-Life 建立器中穿上斯安威斯坦脊椎的 NPC, 死後屍體上會留下植入物, 取出方式與前受試者相同: 軍規型號取出時完好無損, 實驗室原型則略有磨損. 關閉 = 這些 NPC 身上的脊椎只是外觀.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants_toolti.cn: 仅限搭配 Project A-Life [ALIFE NPCS]. 在 A-Life 创建器中穿上斯安威斯坦脊椎的 NPC, 死后尸体上会留下植入物, 取出方式与前受试者相同: 军规型号取出时完好无损, 实验室原型则略有磨损. 关闭 = 这些 NPC 身上的脊椎只是外观.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_AmbientCooling_optio.ch: 普通 (寒冷、潮溼或有風時有幫助)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_AmbientCooling_optio.cn: 普通 (寒冷、潮湿或有风时有帮助)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_AmbientCooling_toolt.en: Only a bonus: cold weather, a wet body and wind outdoors cool the implant faster. It never makes cooling worse.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_AmbientCooling_toolt.ch: 只有加成: 寒冷天氣、身體潮溼及戶外的風會讓植入物冷卻得更快. 絕不會讓冷卻變差.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_AmbientCooling_toolt.cn: 只有加成: 寒冷天气、身体潮湿以及户外的风会让植入物冷却得更快. 绝不会让冷却变差.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option2.en: Gentle (less time and lower fail chance)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option2.ch: 寬鬆 (耗時較短, 失敗機率較低)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option2.cn: 宽松 (耗时较短, 失败概率较低)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option4.en: Harsh (much more time and higher fail chance)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option4.ch: 嚴苛 (耗時長得多, 失敗機率較高)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option4.cn: 严苛 (耗时长得多, 失败概率较高)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_tooltip.en: Without the skill level, the vanilla books of that skill in your inventory let you do it anyway: slower and with a chance to fail. You need the books of the levels you are missing (with First Aid 0 for something that needs 4, volumes 1 and 2; with 2, only volume 2), and the penalty is smaller the closer you are to the level. At the required level there is no penalty at all.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_tooltip.ch: 技能等級不足時, 只要物品欄裡有該技能的原版書籍, 仍然可以照做: 速度較慢, 而且可能失敗. 你需要缺少等級對應的書 (急救 0 級要做需要 4 級的事, 需第 1 冊和第 2 冊; 急救 2 級則只需第 2 冊), 越接近要求等級, 懲罰越小. 達到要求等級時完全沒有懲罰.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_tooltip.cn: 技能等级不足时, 只要物品栏里有该技能的原版书籍, 仍然可以照做: 速度较慢, 而且可能失败. 你需要所缺等级对应的书 (急救 0 级要做需要 4 级的事, 需要第 1 卷和第 2 卷; 急救 2 级则只需要第 2 卷), 越接近所需等级, 惩罚越小. 达到所需等级时完全没有惩罚.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CatastrophicFailureC.en: Without cyberpsychosis. Overdrive never destroys the implant. Default 0.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CatastrophicFailureC.ch: 未罹患賽博精神病時適用. 超限絕不會摧毀植入物. 預設 0.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CatastrophicFailureC.cn: 未患赛博精神病时适用. 超限绝不会摧毁植入物. 默认 0.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CharacterTraits.ch: 角色建立時的斯安威斯坦特質
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CharacterTraits.cn: 角色创建时的斯安威斯坦特质

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CharacterTraits_tool.en: Off = the mod's 8 traits (You Are Special, Edgerunner, Ex-Corpo, Chrome Rejection...) don't show up when creating a character. Characters that already have one keep it and it still works.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CharacterTraits_tool.ch: 關閉 = 建立角色時不會出現本模組的 8 個特質 (天選之人、邊緣行者、前企業員工、義體排斥…). 已擁有特質的角色會保留, 且仍然有效.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CharacterTraits_tool.cn: 关闭 = 创建角色时不会出现本模组的 8 个特质 (天选之人、边缘行者、前公司员工、义体排斥…). 已拥有特质的角色会保留, 且仍然有效.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CivilExSubjectChance.ch: 第二名平民前受試者機率
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CivilExSubjectChance.cn: 第二名平民前受试者概率

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CivilExSubjectChance.en: Every campus always has one ex-subject next to the notes and the implant. One roll per campus at world creation decides whether there is a second one.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CivilExSubjectChance.ch: 每個校區一定會有一名前受試者, 位於筆記和植入物旁. 建立世界時每個校區擲一次骰, 決定是否有第二名.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CivilExSubjectChance.cn: 每个校区一定会有一名前受试者, 位于笔记和植入物旁边. 创建世界时每个校区掷一次骰, 决定是否有第二名.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CraftedRecipeKnown.ch: 預先知道自製免疫抑制劑配方
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CraftedRecipeKnown.cn: 预先知道自制免疫抑制剂配方

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CraftedRecipeKnown_t.en: Everyone knows the recipe without reading the notebook.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CraftedRecipeKnown_t.ch: 所有人不必閱讀筆記本就知道這個配方.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CraftedRecipeKnown_t.cn: 所有人不必阅读笔记本就知道这个配方.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Craving_tooltip.en: With high neural load and 12 h without using the implant, stress and unhappiness slowly climb and the monitor insists; it fades on its own at 48 h. Using it for 10 s resets it. It never touches neural load.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Craving_tooltip.ch: 神經負荷偏高且 12 小時未使用植入物時, 壓力與憂鬱會慢慢上升, 監測器也會不斷提醒; 48 小時後會自行消退. 使用植入物 10 秒即可重置. 這絕不會影響神經負荷.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Craving_tooltip.cn: 神经负荷偏高且 12 小时未使用植入物时, 压力和忧郁会慢慢上升, 监测器也会不断提醒; 48 小时后会自行消退. 使用植入物 10 秒即可重置. 这绝不会影响神经负荷.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisDeathC.ch: 超限死亡機率 (賽博精神病)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisDeathC.cn: 超限死亡概率 (赛博精神病)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisDeathC.en: Default 0.01. Cyberpsychosis also adds a 20%% chance of a deep chest cut.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisDeathC.ch: 預設 0.01. 賽博精神病還會附加 20%% 的胸口深傷口機率.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisDeathC.cn: 默认 0.01. 赛博精神病还会附加 20%% 的胸口深伤口概率.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisRemiss.en: Cyberpsychosis fades after 5 in-game days without any implant installed (you have to remove it). It leaves a scar: neural load from use rises 25%% faster afterwards. Off = permanent.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisRemiss.ch: 未安裝任何植入物滿遊戲內 5 天後, 賽博精神病會消退 (你必須摘除植入物). 但會留下疤痕: 之後使用時神經負荷以快 25%% 的速度上升. 關閉 = 永久.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisRemiss.cn: 未安装任何植入物满游戏内 5 天后, 赛博精神病会消退 (你必须摘除植入物). 但会留下疤痕: 之后使用时神经负荷以快 25%% 的速度上升. 关闭 = 永久.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawnChan.en: Chance per check (every 24 h per zone)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawnChan.ch: 每次檢查機率 (每個區域每 24 小時)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawnChan.cn: 每次检查概率 (每个区域每 24 小时)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawnMax.ch: 每個區域額外前受試者上限
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawnMax.cn: 每个区域额外前受试者上限

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawn_too.en: Spawns extra ex-subjects with low chance in case the fixed ones despawn.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawn_too.ch: 以低機率生成額外的前受試者, 以防固定生成的前受試者消失.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawn_too.cn: 以低概率生成额外的前受试者, 以防固定生成的前受试者消失.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FastPlayerAnimations.en: While the Sandevistan is on, your walk, run and sprint animations play faster in step with the speed boost (extra animation nodes, vanilla files untouched). Off = only your position is boosted and the legs may slide.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FastPlayerAnimations.ch: 斯安威斯坦啟動時, 你的走路、奔跑與衝刺動畫會配合速度加成加快播放 (額外的動畫節點, 不更動原版檔案). 關閉 = 只加快你的位置移動, 腿部可能會滑步.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FastPlayerAnimations.cn: 斯安威斯坦开启时, 你的行走、奔跑和冲刺动画会配合速度加成加快播放 (额外的动画节点, 不改动原版文件). 关闭 = 只加快你的位置移动, 腿部可能会滑步.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall.en: Give the field guide on first implant
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall.ch: 首次植入時給予實戰指南
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall.cn: 首次植入时给予实战指南

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall_.en: A field guide item (Heat, Neural Load, rejection, adaptation, surgery and extraction, crafting and blueprints) is added to the pack of whoever receives their first implant. Existing implanted characters get it once.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall_.ch: 首次接受植入的人, 背包裡會放入一本實戰指南 (熱量、神經負荷、排斥、適應、手術與取出、製作與藍圖). 已裝有植入物的現有角色會收到一次.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall_.cn: 首次接受植入的人, 背包里会放入一本实战指南 (热量、神经负荷、排斥、适应、手术与取出、制作与蓝图). 已装有植入物的现有角色会收到一次.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirearmActionSpeed_t.en: While the Sandevistan is on, reloading, racking the bolt and loading or ejecting magazines run as much faster as your own speed boost. Damage and aim are untouched.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirearmActionSpeed_t.ch: 斯安威斯坦啟動時, 裝填、上膛以及裝入或退出彈匣的速度會與你自身的速度加成同步加快. 傷害與瞄準不受影響.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirearmActionSpeed_t.cn: 斯安威斯坦开启时, 装填、上膛以及装入或退出弹匣的速度会与你自身的速度加成同步加快. 伤害和瞄准不受影响.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown.en: Know every firmware program from the start
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown.ch: 開局即知道所有韌體程式
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown.cn: 开局即掌握所有固件程序

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown_too.en: If on, every program is known from the start. Otherwise they are learned as the adaptation level grows.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown_too.ch: 開啟時, 開局即知道所有程式. 否則會隨適應等級提升逐步學會.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown_too.cn: 开启时, 开局即掌握所有程序. 否则会随适应等级提升逐步学会.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareEnabled_tool.en: Turns on firmware chips: two slots (System and Skill) that change how the implant behaves. Off, chips do nothing and cannot be installed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareEnabled_tool.ch: 啟用韌體晶片: 兩個插槽 (系統與技能), 可改變植入物的行為. 關閉時, 晶片沒有作用, 也無法安裝.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareEnabled_tool.cn: 启用固件芯片: 两个插槽 (系统和技能), 可改变植入物的行为. 关闭时, 芯片没有作用, 也无法安装.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Hallucinations_toolt.en: Local hallucinations with cyberpsychosis and neural load 60+.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Hallucinations_toolt.ch: 罹患賽博精神病且神經負荷 60 以上時, 出現僅在本機呈現的幻覺.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Hallucinations_toolt.cn: 患赛博精神病且神经负荷 60 以上时, 出现仅在本地呈现的幻觉.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_HeatRateMultiplier_t.en: How fast the Heat rises while the implant is on. Higher = shorter runs before a thermal cutout.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_HeatRateMultiplier_t.ch: 植入物啟動時熱量上升的速度. 越高 = 過熱斷電前可持續的時間越短.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_HeatRateMultiplier_t.cn: 植入物开启时热量上升的速度. 越高 = 过热断电前可持续的时间越短.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImmunoDurationMultip.ch: 免疫抑制劑持續時間倍率
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImmunoDurationMultip.cn: 免疫抑制剂持续时间倍率

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImmunoDurationMultip.en: Scales how many hours each dose covers you (clinical, homemade and herbal).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImmunoDurationMultip.ch: 調整每劑能覆蓋你多少小時 (臨床、自製與草藥).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImmunoDurationMultip.cn: 调整每剂能覆盖你多少小时 (临床、自制和草药).

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Immunodepression.ch: 免疫抑制劑造成的免疫低下
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Immunodepression.cn: 免疫抑制剂导致的免疫低下

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Immunodepression_too.en: Each dose lowers your defenses for a while: wounds get infected more and heal slower, and colds and sickness hit harder. Light and Harsh scale those effects.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Immunodepression_too.ch: 每劑都會暫時降低你的免疫力: 傷口更容易感染、癒合更慢, 感冒和疾病的影響也更嚴重. 輕度與嚴苛會調整這些效果的強弱.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Immunodepression_too.cn: 每剂都会暂时降低你的免疫力: 伤口更容易感染、愈合更慢, 感冒和疾病的影响也更严重. 轻度和严苛会调整这些效果的强弱.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImplantOverride_tool.en: With the implant off, holding the key skips the air or heat safety and goes straight into Overdrive. It always ends in a collapse and you pay for it: no air means fatigue and no sprinting until you recover; stuck from heat means a burn, wear and a thermal scar.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImplantOverride_tool.ch: 植入物關閉時, 按住按鍵會無視沒氣或過熱的安全限制, 直接進入超限. 最後一定會崩潰, 而且你要付出代價: 沒氣了會造成疲勞, 恢復前無法衝刺; 因過熱而鎖定會造成燒傷、磨損與熱疤痕.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImplantOverride_tool.cn: 植入物关闭时, 按住按键会无视没气或过热的安全限制, 直接进入超限. 最后一定会崩溃, 而且你要付出代价: 没气了会导致疲劳, 恢复前无法冲刺; 因过热而锁定会导致烧伤、磨损和热疤痕.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_MPHitRateGuard.ch: 遵守伺服器命中頻率反作弊
Sandbox_Sandevistan_MPHitRateGuard.cn: 遵守服务器命中频率反作弊

Sandbox_Sandevistan_MPHitRateGuard_toolt.en: Multiplayer only. The server kicks players who hit more than 3 zombies in 1.2 seconds with a normal weapon (AntiCheatHit=2, the default). With this on, Sandevistan attacks drop to normal speed right before that limit. Turn it off only if the server has AntiCheatHit=3 (log only) or 4 (disabled). Admins are never limited.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_MPHitRateGuard_toolt.ch: 僅限多人遊戲. 伺服器會踢出用普通武器在 1.2 秒內命中超過 3 隻殭屍的玩家 (AntiCheatHit=2, 預設值). 開啟後, 斯安威斯坦的攻擊會在即將達到該限制前降回正常速度. 只有在伺服器設為 AntiCheatHit=3 (僅記錄) 或 4 (停用) 時才關閉. 管理員永遠不受限制.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_MPHitRateGuard_toolt.cn: 仅限多人游戏. 服务器会踢出用普通武器在 1.2 秒内命中超过 3 只僵尸的玩家 (AntiCheatHit=2, 默认值). 开启后, 斯安威斯坦的攻击会在即将达到该限制前降回正常速度. 只有在服务器设为 AntiCheatHit=3 (仅记录) 或 4 (禁用) 时才关闭. 管理员永远不受限制.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_MilitaryCryoBoxCount.ch: 基地的低溫保存箱數量
Sandbox_Sandevistan_MilitaryCryoBoxCount.cn: 基地的低温保存箱数量

Sandbox_Sandevistan_OverdriveHeatCap_too.en: Repeated Overdrive collapses lower your maximum Heat: the first collapse each in-game day is free, each extra one costs 5 (total fury 15, down to 50). It recovers 1 per hour while the implant is off. Thermal and manual cutoffs never lower it.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_OverdriveHeatCap_too.ch: 反覆的超限崩潰會降低你的熱量上限: 每個遊戲日的第一次崩潰沒有代價, 之後每次扣 5 (完全狂暴扣 15, 最低降到 50). 植入物關閉時每小時恢復 1. 過熱斷電和手動關閉絕不會降低上限.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_OverdriveHeatCap_too.cn: 反复的超限崩溃会降低你的热量上限: 每个游戏日的第一次崩溃没有代价, 之后每次扣 5 (完全狂暴扣 15, 最低降到 50). 植入物关闭时每小时恢复 1. 过热断电和手动关闭绝不会降低上限.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PartsLootMultiplier.ch: 原型 06 零件掉落倍率
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PartsLootMultiplier.cn: 原型 06 零件掉落倍率

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PartsLootMultiplier_.en: Scales how often neural boards, thermal regulators and power cells appear as loot. 0 = never (craft them).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PartsLootMultiplier_.ch: 調整神經介面板、熱能調節器與能量電池在戰利品中出現的頻率. 0 = 永不出現 (需自行製作).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PartsLootMultiplier_.cn: 调整神经接口板、热能调节器和能量电池在战利品中出现的频率. 0 = 永不出现 (需自行制作).

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option2.en: Arcade (all the power, almost no punishment)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option2.ch: 街機 (全力發揮, 幾乎沒有懲罰)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option2.cn: 街机 (全力发挥, 几乎没有惩罚)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option5.ch: 寫實 (零件稀少, 排斥嚴苛)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option5.cn: 写实 (零件稀少, 排斥严苛)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option6.ch: 殘酷 (賽博精神病無法回頭)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option6.cn: 残酷 (赛博精神病无法逆转)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_tooltip.en: Picks a ready-made set of Sandevistan rules. Anything other than Custom OVERRIDES the individual options below (the menu fills them in for you); Custom uses the options exactly as you set them.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_tooltip.ch: 套用一組現成的斯安威斯坦規則. 選擇自訂以外的任何難度, 都會強制覆蓋下方的個別選項 (選單會自動幫你填入); 自訂則完全照你設定的選項運作.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_tooltip.cn: 套用一组现成的斯安威斯坦规则. 选择自定义以外的任何难度, 都会强制覆盖下方的各项选项 (菜单会自动帮你填好); 自定义则完全按照你设置的选项运行.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype06Enabled_t.en: Allows studying a loose implant and building replicas that perform like Prototype 05.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype06Enabled_t.ch: 允許研究未安裝的植入物, 並製作性能與原型 05 相當的複製品.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype06Enabled_t.cn: 允许研究未安装的植入物, 并制作性能与原型 05 相当的复制品.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype07Enabled.ch: 可製作 Mk. II (軍用複製品)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype07Enabled.cn: 可制作 Mk. II (军用复制品)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype07Enabled_t.en: Allows researching a working military implant (with both military dossiers complete) and building a replica from special parts. Off = the military variant can only be found.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype07Enabled_t.ch: 允許研究可運作的軍用植入物 (需兩份完整的軍方檔案夾), 並用特殊零件製作複製品. 關閉 = 軍用型號只能靠尋找取得.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype07Enabled_t.cn: 允许研究能正常工作的军用植入物 (需要两份完整的军方档案夹), 并用特殊零件制作复制品. 关闭 = 军用型号只能靠寻找获得.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisAudio.ch: 賽博精神病: 聽覺幻覺
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisAudio.cn: 赛博精神病: 听觉幻觉

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisAudio_toolt.en: Fake footsteps, groans, bangs, glass and whispers that only the player hears (they do not attract zombies).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisAudio_toolt.ch: 只有玩家聽得到的假腳步聲、呻吟、碰撞聲、玻璃聲與低語 (不會吸引殭屍).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisAudio_toolt.cn: 只有玩家听得到的假脚步声、呻吟、撞击声、玻璃声和低语 (不会吸引僵尸).

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBerserk.ch: 賽博精神病: 賽博狂暴
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBerserk.cn: 赛博精神病: 赛博狂暴

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBerserk_too.en: With cyberpsychosis and the implant on: more melee damage and attack speed, no panic, less pain.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBerserk_too.ch: 罹患賽博精神病且植入物啟動時: 近戰傷害與攻擊速度提高, 不會恐慌, 疼痛減輕.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBerserk_too.cn: 患赛博精神病且植入物开启时: 近战伤害和攻击速度提高, 不会恐慌, 疼痛减轻.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBlackouts_t.en: At critical neural load: tunnel vision, heartbeat and sometimes a moment of darkness (you can still move).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBlackouts_t.ch: 神經負荷處於危急區時: 視野狹窄、心跳聲, 有時會短暫眼前一黑 (仍可移動).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBlackouts_t.cn: 神经负荷处于危急区时: 视野狭窄、心跳声, 有时会短暂眼前一黑 (仍可移动).

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op.en: Players seen as zombies too, only with PvP off
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op.ch: 也把玩家看成殭屍, 僅限 PvP 關閉時
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op.cn: 也把玩家看成僵尸, 仅限 PvP 关闭时

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op.en: Players seen as zombies too, always (even with PvP)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op.ch: 也把玩家看成殭屍, 一律生效 (即使開啟 PvP)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op.cn: 也把玩家看成僵尸, 始终生效 (即使开启 PvP)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_to.en: At stage 3, very rarely and for 20 to 40 s, you see others with the other side's skin. Only you see it. Zombies seen as people are real and really bite; the tell is that now and then they "skip" back to what they are. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_to.ch: 在第 3 階段, 極少數情況下會持續 20 到 40 秒, 你會看到其他人披著另一方的外皮. 只有你看得到. 被看成人類的殭屍是真的, 也真的會咬人; 破綻在於他們偶爾會「閃」回原本的樣子. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模組與幻覺選項.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_to.cn: 在第 3 阶段, 极少数情况下会持续 20 到 40 秒, 你会看到其他人披着另一方的外皮. 只有你看得到. 被看成人类的僵尸是真的, 也真的会咬人; 破绽在于他们偶尔会“闪”回原本的样子. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模组和幻觉选项.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisEchoes_tool.en: Zombies you can see leave red and cyan afterimages, like double vision. Needs the SandevistanViewpoint afterimage mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisEchoes_tool.ch: 你看得到的殭屍會留下紅色與青色殘影, 就像複視一樣. 需要 SandevistanViewpoint 殘影模組與幻覺選項.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisEchoes_tool.cn: 你看得到的僵尸会留下红色和青色残影, 就像复视一样. 需要 SandevistanViewpoint 残影模组和幻觉选项.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisFakeZombies.ch: 賽博精神病: 假殭屍
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisFakeZombies.cn: 赛博精神病: 假僵尸

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisFakeZombies.en: Zombies that don't exist chase you and dissolve when they touch you or you hit them. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisFakeZombies.ch: 不存在的殭屍會追著你跑, 碰到你或被你打中時就會消散. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模組與幻覺選項.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisFakeZombies.cn: 不存在的僵尸会追着你跑, 碰到你或被你打中时就会消散. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模组和幻觉选项.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o.en: Mild (half as often, no blackouts, misfires, jump scares or disguise)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o.ch: 輕微 (頻率減半, 沒有失神、誤觸發、驚嚇或偽裝)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o.cn: 轻微 (频率减半, 没有失神、误触发、惊吓或伪装)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o.en: Brutal (more often, more fake zombies and twice the jump scares)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o.ch: 殘酷 (更頻繁, 假殭屍更多, 驚嚇加倍)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o.cn: 残酷 (更频繁, 假僵尸更多, 惊吓加倍)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_t.en: One knob for every cyberpsychosis symptom. It applies on top of the difficulty and the individual options below: it never turns on something they turned off. Neural Load and its costs do not change; only how much you notice it.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_t.ch: 一次調整所有賽博精神病症狀. 它疊加在難度與下方個別選項之上: 絕不會開啟它們已關閉的項目. 神經負荷及其代價不變; 只改變你察覺到的程度.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_t.cn: 一次调整所有赛博精神病症状. 它叠加在难度和下方各项选项之上: 绝不会开启它们已关闭的项目. 神经负荷及其代价不变; 只改变你察觉到的程度.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMessages.ch: 賽博精神病: 幻覺訊息
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMessages.cn: 赛博精神病: 幻觉消息

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMessages_to.en: Now and then, inside a text that is already being corrupted, a short coherent phrase appears for a moment. It can land on a label, a tooltip or chat. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMessages_to.ch: 偶爾在已經開始亂碼的文字中, 會短暫出現一句通順的短語. 可能出現在標籤、提示或聊天中. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模組與幻覺選項.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMessages_to.cn: 偶尔在已经开始乱码的文字中, 会短暂出现一句通顺的短语. 可能出现在标签、提示或聊天中. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模组和幻觉选项.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMisfire.ch: 賽博精神病: 反射誤觸發
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMisfire.cn: 赛博精神病: 反射误触发

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMisfire_too.en: At critical neural load the implant can fire by itself for a few seconds when a zombie attacks you.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMisfire_too.ch: 神經負荷處於危急區時, 殭屍攻擊你時植入物可能自行啟動幾秒.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMisfire_too.cn: 神经负荷处于危急区时, 僵尸攻击你时植入物可能自行启动几秒.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisNightTerror.en: With high neural load you may wake up screaming after a few hours of sleep.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisNightTerror.ch: 神經負荷偏高時, 你可能在睡了幾小時後尖叫驚醒.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisNightTerror.cn: 神经负荷偏高时, 你可能在睡了几小时后尖叫惊醒.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisOverload.ch: 賽博精神病: 神經過載
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisOverload.cn: 赛博精神病: 神经过载

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisOverload_to.en: When neural load hits 100: forced shutdown, knockout, nosebleed and a scream that attracts zombies (load drops to 85). With cyberpsychosis, sometimes a locked 15-second total fury instead.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisOverload_to.ch: 神經負荷達到 100 時: 強制關機、昏迷、流鼻血, 並發出吸引殭屍的尖叫 (負荷降到 85). 罹患賽博精神病時, 有時會改為進入無法中止的 15 秒完全狂暴.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisOverload_to.cn: 神经负荷达到 100 时: 强制关机、昏迷、流鼻血, 并发出吸引僵尸的尖叫 (负荷降到 85). 患赛博精神病时, 有时会改为进入无法中止的 15 秒完全狂暴.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisPhantomFigu.ch: 賽博精神病: 幻影人形
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisPhantomFigu.cn: 赛博精神病: 幻影人形

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisPhantomFigu.en: A dark, see-through figure shows at the edge of your view and dissolves if you look straight at it or get close. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisPhantomFigu.ch: 一個黑色半透明人影會出現在視野邊緣, 你直視或靠近時就會消散. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模組與幻覺選項.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisPhantomFigu.cn: 一个黑色半透明人影会出现在视野边缘, 你直视或靠近时就会消散. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模组和幻觉选项.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTextGlitch.ch: 賽博精神病: 文字亂碼
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTextGlitch.cn: 赛博精神病: 文字乱码

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTextGlitch_.en: Now and then the letters on screen turn into symbols. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTextGlitch_.ch: 螢幕上的文字偶爾會變成符號. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模組與幻覺選項.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTextGlitch_.cn: 屏幕上的文字偶尔会变成符号. 需要 SandevistanPsychosis 模组和幻觉选项.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisThreatVisio.ch: 賽博精神病: 危險感知
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisThreatVisio.cn: 赛博精神病: 危险感知

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisThreatVisio.en: Faint red brackets on nearby zombies you cannot see (behind walls or corners), same floor only. Your reflexes sense them. With your head a mess, now and then a marker shows up on someone who is not there, mostly behind you, and dissolves as soon as you look that way.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisThreatVisio.ch: 附近看不到的殭屍 (在牆後或轉角) 身上會出現淡紅色框線, 僅限同一樓層. 這是你的反射神經感覺到了它們. 腦袋一團亂時, 偶爾會在不存在的人身上出現標記, 大多在你背後, 你一看過去就會消散.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisThreatVisio.cn: 附近看不到的僵尸 (在墙后或拐角) 身上会出现淡红色框线, 仅限同一楼层. 这是你的反射神经感知到了它们. 脑子一团乱时, 偶尔会在不存在的人身上出现标记, 大多在你背后, 你一看过去就会消散.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTimeGlitch.ch: 賽博精神病: 時間不穩定
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTimeGlitch.cn: 赛博精神病: 时间不稳定

Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTimeGlitch_.en: With cyberpsychosis the dilation stutters: nearby zombies briefly return to normal speed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTimeGlitch_.ch: 罹患賽博精神病時, 時間膨脹會斷斷續續: 附近的殭屍會短暫恢復正常速度.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTimeGlitch_.cn: 患赛博精神病时, 时间膨胀会断断续续: 附近的僵尸会短暂恢复正常速度.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_RejectionRateMultipl.ch: 調整適應期排斥與慢性排斥.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_RejectionRateMultipl.cn: 调整适应期排斥和慢性排斥.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowRadius_tooltip.en: How far from you zombies (and other players in multiplayer) are slowed while the Sandevistan is on. Larger = the slowdown starts farther away and the transition is less visible, but more zombies are processed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowRadius_tooltip.ch: 斯安威斯坦啟動時, 距離你多遠內的殭屍 (多人遊戲中也包括其他玩家) 會被減速. 越大 = 減速從更遠處開始, 過渡較不明顯, 但需要處理的殭屍也更多.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowRadius_tooltip.cn: 斯安威斯坦开启时, 距离你多远内的僵尸 (多人游戏中也包括其他玩家) 会被减速. 越大 = 减速从更远处开始, 过渡较不明显, 但需要处理的僵尸也更多.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowZombieAnimations.en: Zombies slowed by the Sandevistan also play their walk, run, lunge, turn and attack animations in slow motion (extra animation nodes, vanilla files untouched). Off = only their movement is slowed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowZombieAnimations.ch: 被斯安威斯坦減速的殭屍, 其行走、奔跑、撲擊、轉身與攻擊動畫也會以慢動作播放 (額外的動畫節點, 不更動原版檔案). 關閉 = 只減慢它們的移動.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowZombieAnimations.cn: 被斯安威斯坦减速的僵尸, 其行走、奔跑、扑击、转身和攻击动画也会以慢动作播放 (额外的动画节点, 不改动原版文件). 关闭 = 只减慢它们的移动.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option2.en: Normal (debt is charged with the overdraft price)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option2.ch: 普通 (扣除透支額並承受透支代價)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option2.cn: 普通 (扣除透支额并承受透支代价)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option3.en: Gentle (debt is charged, no stagger or sprint block)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option3.ch: 寬鬆 (扣除透支額, 不會踉蹌或禁止衝刺)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option3.cn: 宽松 (扣除透支额, 不会踉跄或禁止冲刺)

Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_tooltip.en: While the Sandevistan runs your stamina does not drop: everything you spend (running, sprinting, hitting, pushing and the implant's own drain) becomes debt and is charged all at once when it goes off. Natural regeneration pays the debt instead of raising the bar. Normal also staggers you and blocks sprinting if the debt went past what you had; Gentle only charges it.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_tooltip.ch: 斯安威斯坦運作期間耐力不會下降: 你消耗的一切 (奔跑、衝刺、攻擊、推擠以及植入物本身的消耗) 都會變成透支額, 在關閉時一次扣除. 自然恢復會用來償還透支額, 而不是填回量條. 若透支額超過你原有的耐力, 普通還會讓你踉蹌並禁止衝刺; 寬鬆則只扣除.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_tooltip.cn: 斯安威斯坦运行期间耐力不会下降: 你消耗的一切 (奔跑、冲刺、攻击、推挤以及植入物本身的消耗) 都会变成透支额, 在关闭时一次性扣除. 自然恢复会用来偿还透支额, 而不是填回进度条. 若透支额超过你原有的耐力, 普通还会让你踉跄并禁止冲刺; 宽松则只扣除.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_Stopgaps_tooltip.en: The game's painkillers, sleeping pills and beta blockers slow rejection and neural load a little, for a while and with tolerance. They do not replace immunosuppressants: they only buy time.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Stopgaps_tooltip.ch: 遊戲原有的止痛藥、安眠藥與 β-阻斷劑能暫時稍微減緩排斥與神經負荷, 但會產生耐受性. 它們無法取代免疫抑制劑: 只能爭取時間.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Stopgaps_tooltip.cn: 游戏原有的止痛药、安眠药和 β-阻断剂能暂时稍微减缓排斥和神经负荷, 但会产生耐受性. 它们无法取代免疫抑制剂: 只能争取时间.

Sandbox_Sandevistan_UseSpatialSlowInSP.ch: 單人模式使用空間減速
Sandbox_Sandevistan_UseSpatialSlowInSP.cn: 单人模式使用空间减速

Sandbox_Sandevistan_UseSpatialSlowInSP_t.en: Use strategy B (nearby zombies slowed) in singleplayer too. Off = experimental global clock.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_UseSpatialSlowInSP_t.ch: 單人遊戲也使用方案 B (減速附近的殭屍). 關閉 = 實驗性的全域時鐘.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_UseSpatialSlowInSP_t.cn: 单人游戏也使用方案 B (减速附近的僵尸). 关闭 = 实验性的全局时钟.

Sandbox_VehicleFire_BlastDebrisChance.en: Chance of debris after a large blast (percent)
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BlastDebrisChance.ch: 大型爆炸後產生殘骸的機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BlastDebrisChance.cn: 大型爆炸后产生残骸的概率 (百分比)

Sandbox_VehicleFire_BlastDebrisChance_to.en: One roll per large tank blast. At most one actually detached part at about 5 percent condition OR unusable metal is placed on a reachable loaded square nearby. Never creates loot from absent parts.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BlastDebrisChance_to.ch: 每次油箱大型爆炸判定一次. 最多會有一個實際脫落、狀況約百分之 5 的零件, 或無法使用的金屬, 被放在附近可到達且已載入的地塊上. 絕不會用不存在的零件產生戰利品.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BlastDebrisChance_to.cn: 每次油箱大型爆炸判定一次. 最多会有一个实际脱落, 状况约为百分之 5 的部件, 或无法使用的金属, 被放到附近可到达且已加载的地块上. 绝不会用不存在的部件生成战利品.

Sandbox_VehicleFire_BurnedTireHandling.ch: 燒毀輪胎導致轉向不穩
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BurnedTireHandling.cn: 烧毁轮胎导致转向不稳

Sandbox_VehicleFire_BurnedTireHandling_t.en: A moving vehicle driven on tires burst by THIS mod receives gentle sideways drifting/oversteer, reminiscent of drunken driving. Each fire-damaged tire adds about 15%% of effect strength, up to 60%% with four. Standard deflated/repaired tires do not trigger it; no steering changes while parked.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BurnedTireHandling_t.ch: 行駛中的車輛若使用被本模組燒爆的輪胎, 會出現輕微的側滑/轉向過度, 類似酒駕. 每個被火損壞的輪胎約增加 15%% 的效果強度, 四個輪胎時最多達 60%% 的強度. 一般洩氣/修補過的輪胎不會觸發; 停車時不會改變轉向.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_BurnedTireHandling_t.cn: 行驶中的载具若使用被本模组烧爆的轮胎, 会出现轻微的侧滑/转向过度, 类似醉驾. 每个被火损坏的轮胎约增加 15%% 的效果强度, 四个轮胎时最多达 60%% 的强度. 普通的漏气/修补过的轮胎不会触发; 停车时不会改变转向.

Sandbox_VehicleFire_DangerousCargo.en: Dangerous cargo increases tank explosion odds
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DangerousCargo.ch: 危險貨物提高油箱爆炸機率
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DangerousCargo.cn: 危险货物提高油箱爆炸概率

Sandbox_VehicleFire_DangerousCargo_toolt.en: When a trunk/cargo bed contains a NONEMPTY propane cylinder or petrol/diesel can, tank blast chance rises to 80%% with under half a tank (small pop) or 60%% with at least half a tank (large fireball). One roll per tank; empty containers or fuel cans filled with water do not count. Explosion Chance = 0 still disables blasts.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DangerousCargo_toolt.ch: 後車廂/貨斗內有「非空」的丙烷罐或汽油/柴油罐時, 油箱爆炸機率會提高: 油量低於半箱時為 80%% (小型爆炸), 至少半箱時為 60%% (大型火球). 每個油箱判定一次; 空容器或裝水的油罐不計入. 「燃料爆炸機率上限」設為 0 時仍會停用爆炸.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DangerousCargo_toolt.cn: 后备箱/货斗内有“非空”的丙烷罐或汽油/柴油桶时, 油箱爆炸概率会提高: 油量低于半箱时为 80%% (小型爆炸), 至少半箱时为 60%% (大型火球). 每个油箱判定一次; 空容器或装了水的油桶不计入. “燃料爆炸概率上限”设为 0 时仍会禁用爆炸.

Sandbox_VehicleFire_DesaturateVanilla.en: Fade paint on retained vanilla bodywork
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DesaturateVanilla.ch: 保留的原版車身漆面褪色
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DesaturateVanilla.cn: 保留的原版车身漆面褪色

Sandbox_VehicleFire_DesaturateVanilla_to.en: Vanilla vehicles without an applicable burnt-model replacement gradually lose color saturation to zero. Original brightness and hue are kept. Does not replace textures or change modded vehicle paint.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DesaturateVanilla_to.ch: 沒有適用燒毀模型可替換的原版車輛, 色彩飽和度會逐漸降到零. 保留原本的亮度與色相. 不會替換材質, 也不會改變模組車輛的烤漆.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_DesaturateVanilla_to.cn: 没有适用的烧毁模型可替换的原版车辆, 色彩饱和度会逐渐降为零. 保留原本的亮度和色相. 不会替换贴图, 也不会改变模组载具的涂装.

Sandbox_VehicleFire_LateOpenChance.ch: 受熱彈開機率: 模組車引擎蓋 / 後車廂
Sandbox_VehicleFire_LateOpenChance.cn: 受热弹开概率: 模组载具引擎盖 / 后备箱

Sandbox_VehicleFire_LateOpenChance_toolt.en: One roll per installed hood or trunk lid after 70 percent burnout. Passenger doors are excluded. Visible movement requires a model animation. The developer buttons bypass the random roll for testing.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_LateOpenChance_toolt.ch: 燒毀程度達百分之 70 後, 每個已安裝的引擎蓋或後車廂蓋各判定一次. 不包括乘客車門. 要看得到開啟動作, 模型必須有動畫. 開發者按鈕會略過隨機判定以供測試.
Sandbox_VehicleFire_LateOpenChance_toolt.cn: 烧毁程度达到百分之 70 后, 每个已安装的引擎盖或后备箱盖各判定一次. 不包括乘客车门. 模型必须带有动画才能看到开启动作. 开发者按钮会跳过随机判定以便测试.
