Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BCGSemi.en: Semi only: no trip surface for an auto sear. Its condition also drives jam chance.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BCGSemi.ch: 僅限半自動: 沒有可觸發自動阻鐵的觸發面. 其耐久也會影響卡彈機率.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BCGSemi.cn: 仅限半自动: 没有可触发自动阻铁的触发面. 其耐久也会影响卡壳几率.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Barrel24.en: Varmint and match barrel: very accurate and very heavy, slow to bring up.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Barrel24.ch: 獵狐與競賽級槍管: 非常精準也非常沉重, 舉槍緩慢.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Barrel24.cn: 猎狐与比赛级枪管: 非常精准也非常沉重, 举枪缓慢.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BarrelHBAR.en: Heavy match profile: holds its accuracy as it heats up, slower to swing.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BarrelHBAR.ch: 重型競賽級輪廓: 槍管發熱時仍能保持精準度, 擺槍較慢.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BarrelHBAR.cn: 重型比赛级轮廓: 枪管发热时仍能保持精准度, 摆枪较慢.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BirdcageA1.en: Hides muzzle flash. Open bottom: no muzzle-climb help, kicks up dust prone.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BirdcageA1.ch: 遮蔽槍口焰. 底部開口: 無助於抑制槍口上揚, 臥姿射擊時會揚起塵土.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_BirdcageA1.cn: 遮蔽枪口焰. 底部开口: 无助于抑制枪口上扬, 卧姿射击时会扬起尘土.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Conv22.en: A .22 bolt in place of the bolt carrier: cheap, quiet rounds. .22 LR magazines shaped like the 30-rounders. Unload the rifle first. Swap the bolt carrier back for 5.56.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Conv22.ch: 以 .22 槍機取代槍機框: 子彈便宜又安靜. 使用外型與 30 發彈匣相同的 .22 LR 彈匣. 請先將步槍退彈. 換回槍機框即可改回 5.56.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Conv22.cn: 用 .22 枪机取代枪机框: 子弹便宜又安静. 使用外形与 30 发弹匣相同的 .22 LR 弹匣. 请先给步枪退弹. 换回枪机框即可改回 5.56.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Conv9mm.en: Turns the rifle into a 9mm carbine: Colt-pattern 9mm stick magazines. Unload the rifle first. Nothing is cut: the rifle goes back to 5.56 as it was.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Conv9mm.ch: 將步槍改為 9mm 卡賓槍: 使用柯爾特規格 9mm 直彈匣. 請先將步槍退彈. 不需切割任何部位: 步槍可原樣改回 5.56.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Conv9mm.cn: 将步枪改为 9mm 卡宾枪: 使用柯尔特规格 9mm 直弹匣. 请先给步枪退弹. 无需切割任何部位: 步枪可原样改回 5.56.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_FSBARMS41.en: Folds flat, so it fits under free-float handguards and still gives a front sight.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_FSBARMS41.ch: 可平摺收起, 因此能裝在自由浮動護木下方, 同時仍提供準星.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_FSBARMS41.cn: 可平折收起, 因此能装在自由浮动护木下方, 同时仍提供准星.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_FSBDremel.en: Ground-down A2 base. No front sight, sloppy gas seal. Crafted from an A2 front sight base with a file.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_FSBDremel.ch: 磨平的 A2 準星座. 沒有準星, 導氣密封不佳. 以銼刀加工 A2 準星座製成.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_FSBDremel.cn: 磨平的 A2 准星座. 没有准星, 导气密封不佳. 用锉刀加工 A2 准星座制成.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasClamp.en: No front sight. Clamp screws go on quick but can work loose.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasClamp.ch: 沒有準星. 夾緊螺絲安裝快速, 但可能鬆脫.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasClamp.cn: 没有准星. 夹紧螺丝安装快速, 但可能松脱.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasColtPinOn.en: Pinned, so it never shifts. No front sight.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasColtPinOn.ch: 以銷釘固定, 永不位移. 沒有準星.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasColtPinOn.cn: 用销钉固定, 永不移位. 没有准星.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasVMatch.en: No front sight. Held by set screws.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasVMatch.ch: 沒有準星. 以止付螺絲固定.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GasVMatch.cn: 没有准星. 用紧定螺丝固定.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripA1.ch: 纖細, 沒有指間凸塊.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripA1.cn: 纤细, 没有指间凸块.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripShaved.en: A2 grip with the finger nub carved off. Crafted with a knife.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripShaved.ch: 削去指間凸塊的 A2 握把. 以刀子製作.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripShaved.cn: 削去指间凸块的 A2 握把. 用刀制作.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripWalnut.en: Hand-fitted match grip with a palm shelf: steady, slow to bring up.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripWalnut.ch: 手工修配的競賽級握把, 附掌托: 穩定, 但舉槍緩慢.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_GripWalnut.cn: 手工修配的比赛级握把, 带掌托: 稳定, 但举枪缓慢.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardA1.en: Vietnam-era three-sided handguard. Left and right halves are not interchangeable.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardA1.ch: 越戰時期的三角形護木. 左右兩半不可互換.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardA1.cn: 越战时期的三角形护木. 左右两半不可互换.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardRIS.en: Drops in over the standard front sight base.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardRIS.ch: 可直接套裝在標準準星座上.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardRIS.cn: 可直接套装在标准准星座上.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardSIR.en: Free-floats the barrel. Hex key + wrench, 5 min.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardSIR.ch: 讓槍管自由浮動. 需六角扳手 + 扳手, 5 分鐘.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardSIR.cn: 让枪管自由浮动. 需内六角扳手 + 扳手, 5 分钟.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardSIRRifle.en: Free-floats a rifle-length barrel. Hex key + wrench, 5 min.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardSIRRifle.ch: 讓步槍長度的槍管自由浮動. 需六角扳手 + 扳手, 5 分鐘.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardSIRRifle.cn: 让步枪长度的枪管自由浮动. 需内六角扳手 + 扳手, 5 分钟.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardVMatch.en: Free-floats the barrel. Smooth tube, no rail. Wrench, 5 min.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardVMatch.ch: 讓槍管自由浮動. 光滑護管, 無導軌. 需扳手, 5 分鐘.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardVMatch.cn: 让枪管自由浮动. 光滑护管, 无导轨. 需扳手, 5 分钟.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardVMatchRifl.en: Free-floats a rifle-length barrel. Smooth tube with a sling stud a bipod clamps to. Wrench, 5 min.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardVMatchRifl.ch: 讓步槍長度的槍管自由浮動. 光滑護管附背帶環, 可夾裝兩腳架. 需扳手, 5 分鐘.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_HandguardVMatchRifl.cn: 让步枪长度的枪管自由浮动. 光滑护管带背带环, 可夹装两脚架. 需扳手, 5 分钟.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_LaFranceM16K.en: Threads straight onto the barrel, so it takes the muzzle slot. Hides flash, fades with wear, fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_LaFranceM16K.ch: 直接旋上槍管, 因此佔用槍口欄位. 遮蔽槍口焰, 效果隨磨損減弱, 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_LaFranceM16K.cn: 直接拧上枪管, 因此占用枪口槽位. 遮蔽枪口焰, 效果随磨损减弱, 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_LightningLink.en: Full auto with a semi trigger + M16 carrier. Illegal, crude.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_LightningLink.ch: 搭配半自動扳機 + M16 槍機框即可全自動射擊. 違法, 粗糙.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_LightningLink.cn: 搭配半自动扳机 + M16 枪机框即可全自动射击. 违法, 粗糙.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_MountPiggyback.en: Rides a scope over the carry handle. Hex key.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_MountPiggyback.ch: 將瞄準鏡架在提把上方. 需六角扳手.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_MountPiggyback.cn: 将瞄准镜架在提把上方. 需内六角扳手.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_MountZ.en: You can still use the iron sights underneath. Very high, poor cheek weld.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_MountZ.ch: 仍可使用下方的機械瞄具. 架得非常高, 貼腮不佳.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_MountZ.cn: 仍可使用下方的机械瞄具. 架得非常高, 贴腮不佳.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_OilFilter.en: Baffle strikes cost accuracy. Fouling x2. Burns out in about 100 shots. Crafted from an oil filter with a drill.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_OilFilter.ch: 子彈擦撞隔板會降低精準度. 積碳 x2. 約 100 發後就會燒壞報廢. 以鑽在機油濾清器上加工製成.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_OilFilter.cn: 子弹擦撞隔板会降低精准度. 积碳 x2. 约 100 发后就会烧坏报废. 用钻在机油滤清器上加工制成.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_OpsSuppressor.en: Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_OpsSuppressor.ch: 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_OpsSuppressor.cn: 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_RailSection.en: Screwed through a plastic handguard. Screwdriver, 3 min, uses 4 screws.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_RailSection.ch: 以螺絲穿過塑膠護木固定. 需螺絲起子, 3 分鐘, 消耗 4 顆螺絲.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_RailSection.cn: 用螺丝穿过塑料护木固定. 需螺丝刀, 3 分钟, 消耗 4 颗螺丝.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Scope4x20.en: Fits the carry handle or a flattop rail.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Scope4x20.ch: 可裝在提把或平頂導軌上.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Scope4x20.cn: 可装在提把或平顶导轨上.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ScopeBushnell.en: Common hunting scope. Flattop only: rides the rail in 1-inch rings, never over a carry handle. Hex key.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ScopeBushnell.ch: 常見的狩獵瞄準鏡. 僅限平頂: 以 1 吋鏡環架在導軌上, 不能架在提把上. 需六角扳手.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ScopeBushnell.cn: 常见的狩猎瞄准镜. 仅限平顶: 用 1 英寸镜环架在导轨上, 不能架在提把上. 需内六角扳手.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ScopePVS4.en: Second-generation starlight scope on its carry-handle bracket: see and shoot in the dark. Heavy, runs on batteries.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ScopePVS4.ch: 裝在專用提把支架上的第二代微光瞄準鏡: 可在黑暗中看清並射擊. 沉重, 需使用電池.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ScopePVS4.cn: 装在专用提把支架上的第二代微光瞄准镜: 可在黑暗中看清并射击. 沉重, 需使用电池.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_StockA1.en: 5/8 inch shorter than the A2: quicker to shoulder.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_StockA1.ch: 比 A2 短 5/8 吋: 抵肩更快.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_StockA1.cn: 比 A2 短 5/8 英寸: 抵肩更快.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_StockCAR15.en: Hold-R wheel: collapse (Aim time -2 more, Recoil +2) or extend.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_StockCAR15.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 收合 (瞄準時間再 -2, 後坐力 +2) 或伸展.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_StockCAR15.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘: 收合 (瞄准时间再 -2, 后坐力 +2) 或伸展.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ThreadAdapter.en: Needed for the oil filter. Crafted from scrap metal with a file and a saw.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ThreadAdapter.ch: 安裝機油濾清器時必備. 以銼刀與鋸子加工金屬廢料製成.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_ThreadAdapter.cn: 安装机油滤清器时必需. 用锉刀和锯加工金属废料制成.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_TriggerAuto.en: Full auto with the M16 carrier.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_TriggerAuto.ch: 搭配 M16 槍機框可全自動射擊.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_TriggerAuto.cn: 搭配 M16 枪机框可全自动射击.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_TriggerBurst.ch: 搭配 M16 槍機框可 3 發連發.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_TriggerBurst.cn: 搭配 M16 枪机框可 3 发连发.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Upper723.en: Simple A1-style flip rear sight: quicker to pick up, less precise.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Upper723.ch: 簡易 A1 式翻轉照門: 對準較快, 但較不精確.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Upper723.cn: 简易 A1 式翻转照门: 对准较快, 但精度较低.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Upper727.en: M4-style feed ramps feed more reliably.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Upper727.ch: M4 式供彈斜坡讓供彈更可靠.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_Upper727.cn: M4 式供弹斜坡让供弹更可靠.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_UpperA1.en: Vietnam-era upper: simple A1 flip rear sight, teardrop forward assist, no brass deflector.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_UpperA1.ch: 越戰時期上機匣: 簡易 A1 翻轉照門, 淚滴形輔助閉鎖鈕, 無拋殼擋板.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_UpperA1.cn: 越战时期上机匣: 简易 A1 翻转照门, 泪滴形辅助闭锁钮, 无抛壳挡板.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_UpperFlattop.en: No carry handle and no rear sight: needs an optic, or it gets the no-sights penalty.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_UpperFlattop.ch: 沒有提把也沒有照門: 需要光學瞄具, 否則會受到無瞄具懲罰.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_UpperFlattop.cn: 没有提把也没有照门: 需要光学瞄具, 否则会受到无瞄具惩罚.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_VortexFlashHider.en: Open tines: the best flash suppression of its day.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_VortexFlashHider.ch: 開放式叉齒: 當時最佳的消焰效果.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_VortexFlashHider.cn: 开放式叉齿: 当时最好的消焰效果.

Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_XM177Moderator.en: Long Vietnam-era CAR-15 flash suppressor: hides flash and takes the edge off the report. Not a silencer.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_XM177Moderator.ch: 越戰時期 CAR-15 的長型消焰器: 遮蔽槍口焰並減弱槍聲. 不是消音器.
Tooltip_GS_ARGS_Part_XM177Moderator.cn: 越战时期 CAR-15 的长型消焰器: 遮蔽枪口焰并减弱枪声. 不是消音器.

Tooltip_GS_GS29_Part_GripsSW29Rubber.en: Rubber wraparound: a steadier hold on full-power loads.
Tooltip_GS_GS29_Part_GripsSW29Rubber.ch: 包覆式橡膠握把: 射擊全裝藥彈時握持更穩.
Tooltip_GS_GS29_Part_GripsSW29Rubber.cn: 包覆式橡胶握把: 射击全装药弹时握持更稳.

Tooltip_GS_GS311_Part_Barrels311Sawn.en: Cut down with a saw: a wide, close-range pattern.
Tooltip_GS_GS311_Part_Barrels311Sawn.ch: 以鋸子截短: 近距離彈著散布範圍大.
Tooltip_GS_GS311_Part_Barrels311Sawn.cn: 用锯截短: 近距离弹着散布范围大.

Tooltip_GS_GS36_Part_GripsSW36Rubber.en: Rubber wraparound: a steadier hold on full-power loads.
Tooltip_GS_GS36_Part_GripsSW36Rubber.ch: 包覆式橡膠握把: 射擊全裝藥彈時握持更穩.
Tooltip_GS_GS36_Part_GripsSW36Rubber.cn: 包覆式橡胶握把: 射击全装药弹时握持更稳.

Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_1911Conv22.en: Swaps on the .22 slide and barrel: cheap, quiet practice. 10-round .22 magazines. Unload it first. Take it off for .45 ACP.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_1911Conv22.ch: 換上 .22 滑套與槍管: 練習便宜又安靜. 使用 10 發 .22 彈匣. 請先退彈. 拆下即可改回 .45 ACP.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_1911Conv22.cn: 换上 .22 套筒和枪管: 练习便宜又安静. 使用 10 发 .22 弹匣. 请先退弹. 拆下即可改回 .45 ACP.

Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_Comp1911.en: Ported ahead of the slide: much less muzzle flip, louder.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_Comp1911.ch: 滑套前方開有洩氣孔: 大幅減少槍口上跳, 但更吵.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_Comp1911.cn: 套筒前方开有泄气孔: 大幅减少枪口上跳, 但更响.

Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_Grips1911Rubber.en: Wraps the front strap: a firmer hold on a .45.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_Grips1911Rubber.ch: 包覆握把前緣: 握持 .45 更牢固.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_Grips1911Rubber.cn: 包覆握把前缘: 握持 .45 更牢固.

Tooltip_GS_GS527_Part_CZ527Kit223.en: Swaps the bolt head and magazine: unload the rifle first.
Tooltip_GS_GS527_Part_CZ527Kit223.ch: 更換槍機頭與彈匣: 請先將步槍退彈.
Tooltip_GS_GS527_Part_CZ527Kit223.cn: 更换枪机头和弹匣: 请先给步枪退弹.

Tooltip_GS_GS527_Part_CZ527Kit76239.en: Swaps the bolt head and magazine: unload the rifle first.
Tooltip_GS_GS527_Part_CZ527Kit76239.ch: 更換槍機頭與彈匣: 請先將步槍退彈.
Tooltip_GS_GS527_Part_CZ527Kit76239.cn: 更换枪机头和弹匣: 请先给步枪退弹.

Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_MountSTD30700.en: Steel bases on the front ring and bridge, rings for a 30mm scope (no Weaver rail).
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_MountSTD30700.ch: 裝在機匣前環與橋部的鋼製底座, 附 30mm 瞄準鏡用鏡環 (無韋弗導軌).
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_MountSTD30700.cn: 装在机匣前环和桥部的钢制底座, 附 30mm 瞄准镜用镜环 (无韦弗导轨).

Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_MountSTD700.en: Steel bases on the front ring and bridge, rings for a 1-inch scope (no Weaver rail).
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_MountSTD700.ch: 裝在機匣前環與橋部的鋼製底座, 附 1 吋瞄準鏡用鏡環 (無韋弗導軌).
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_MountSTD700.cn: 装在机匣前环和桥部的钢制底座, 附 1 英寸瞄准镜用镜环 (无韦弗导轨).

Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_Stock700PSS.en: Aluminium bedding block: the action never shifts.
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_Stock700PSS.ch: 鋁製槍床座: 機匣永不位移.
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_Stock700PSS.cn: 铝制枪床座: 机匣永不移位.

Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_Barrel870_14.ch: 短小好用, 散布範圍大.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_Barrel870_14.cn: 短小灵活, 散布范围大.

Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_Forend870Light.en: Hold-R wheel: light on/off. A battery lasts about 2 hours on.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_Forend870Light.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 開/關燈. 一顆電池約可持續亮燈 2 小時.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_Forend870Light.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘: 开/关灯. 一节电池约可持续亮灯 2 小时.

Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_MagExt870.en: Two more shells in the tube.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_MagExt870.ch: 彈倉管可多裝兩發霰彈.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_MagExt870.cn: 弹仓管可多装两发霰弹.

Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_SideSaddle870.en: Six shells on the receiver: loads much faster.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_SideSaddle870.ch: 機匣側掛六發霰彈: 裝填快得多.
Tooltip_GS_GS870_Part_SideSaddle870.cn: 机匣侧挂六发霰弹: 装填快得多.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_BrakeAK74.en: 5.56 only. Much less muzzle climb, louder.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_BrakeAK74.ch: 僅限 5.56. 大幅減少槍口上揚, 但更吵.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_BrakeAK74.cn: 仅限 5.56. 大幅减少枪口上扬, 但更响.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_BrakeAKSlant.ch: 僅限 7.62x39. 壓住槍口上揚.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_BrakeAKSlant.cn: 仅限 7.62x39. 压住枪口上扬.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_HGAKBirch.en: Laminated wood does not warp with barrel heat: steadier, a little heavier.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_HGAKBirch.ch: 層壓木不會因槍管發熱而變形: 更穩定, 稍重一些.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_HGAKBirch.cn: 层压木不会因枪管发热而变形: 更稳定, 稍重一些.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_HGAKRPD.en: A long machine gun handguard clamped on: a steady hold, but heavy.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_HGAKRPD.ch: 夾裝上去的長型機槍護木: 握持穩定, 但沉重.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_HGAKRPD.cn: 夹装上去的长型机枪护木: 握持稳定, 但沉重.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_MountAKBP02.en: High: the iron sights stay usable under it.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_MountAKBP02.ch: 架得高: 下方的機械瞄具仍可使用.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_MountAKBP02.cn: 架得高: 下方的机械瞄具仍可使用.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_StockAKThumbhole.en: Made for the MAK-90 Sporter only. The thumbhole is its grip.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_StockAKThumbhole.ch: 專為 MAK-90 運動型打造. 指孔即為握把.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_StockAKThumbhole.cn: 专为 MAK-90 运动型打造. 指孔即为握把.

Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_SuppressorPBS1.ch: 僅限 7.62x39. 遮蔽槍口焰. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSAK_Part_SuppressorPBS1.cn: 仅限 7.62x39. 遮蔽枪口焰. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_GSB9_Part_GripsB92Rubber.en: Soaks up recoil, steadier follow-up shots.
Tooltip_GS_GSB9_Part_GripsB92Rubber.ch: 吸收後坐力, 後續射擊更穩.
Tooltip_GS_GSB9_Part_GripsB92Rubber.cn: 吸收后坐力, 后续射击更稳.

Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_DEBarrel41.en: Turns it into a .41 Magnum (the .44 bolt fits): 8-round .41 magazines. Unload it first. Take it off for the factory .44.
Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_DEBarrel41.ch: 改為 .41 馬格南 (可沿用 .44 槍機): 使用 8 發 .41 彈匣. 請先退彈. 拆下即可改回原廠 .44.
Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_DEBarrel41.cn: 改为 .41 马格南 (可沿用 .44 枪机): 使用 8 发 .41 弹匣. 请先退弹. 拆下即可改回原厂 .44.

Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_DEConv357.en: Turns it into a .357 Magnum: 9-round .357 magazines. Unload it first. Take it off for the factory .44.
Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_DEConv357.ch: 改為 .357 馬格南: 使用 9 發 .357 彈匣. 請先退彈. 拆下即可改回原廠 .44.
Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_DEConv357.cn: 改为 .357 马格南: 使用 9 发 .357 弹匣. 请先退弹. 拆下即可改回原厂 .44.

Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_GripsDERubber.en: Tames the magnum's kick a little.
Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_GripsDERubber.ch: 稍微壓制馬格南的後坐力.
Tooltip_GS_GSDE_Part_GripsDERubber.cn: 稍微压制马格南的后坐力.

Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_BarrelFAL533.en: Full-length rifle barrel: steadier and reaches further, slower to swing.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_BarrelFAL533.ch: 全長步槍槍管: 更穩定, 射程更遠, 擺槍較慢.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_BarrelFAL533.cn: 全长步枪枪管: 更稳定, 射程更远, 摆枪较慢.

Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_BipodFAL.en: Clamps to the barrel. Steadier, slower to swing.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_BipodFAL.ch: 夾裝在槍管上. 更穩定, 擺槍較慢.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_BipodFAL.cn: 夹装在枪管上. 更稳定, 摆枪较慢.

Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_MountFALTop.en: Replaces the top cover. Weaver rail for a scope or dot.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_MountFALTop.ch: 取代頂蓋. 附韋弗導軌, 可裝瞄準鏡或紅點.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_MountFALTop.cn: 取代顶盖. 附韦弗导轨, 可装瞄准镜或红点.

Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_TriggerFALAuto.en: Safe / Single / Auto. Full auto in 7.62 NATO climbs hard.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_TriggerFALAuto.ch: 保險 / 單發 / 全自動. 7.62 NATO 全自動射擊時槍口上揚劇烈.
Tooltip_GS_GSFAL_Part_TriggerFALAuto.cn: 保险 / 单点 / 全自动. 7.62 NATO 全自动射击时枪口上扬剧烈.

Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_BarrelFNC363.en: The Para's short barrel: quicker to swing, less reach.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_BarrelFNC363.ch: 傘兵型的短槍管: 擺槍更快, 射程較短.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_BarrelFNC363.cn: 伞兵型的短枪管: 摆枪更快, 射程较短.

Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_BarrelFNC449.en: Front sight, gas block and flash hider on the barrel.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_BarrelFNC449.ch: 槍管上附準星、導氣箍與消焰器.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_BarrelFNC449.cn: 枪管上附准星、导气箍和消焰器.

Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_MountFNC.en: Clamps onto the receiver top. Claw bases for a scope or dot.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_MountFNC.ch: 夾裝在機匣頂部. 爪式底座可裝瞄準鏡或紅點.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_MountFNC.cn: 夹装在机匣顶部. 爪式底座可装瞄准镜或红点.

Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_StockFNCFixed.en: Solid stock: steadier, a little slower.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_StockFNCFixed.ch: 固定式槍托: 更穩定, 稍慢一些.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_StockFNCFixed.cn: 固定式枪托: 更稳定, 稍慢一些.

Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_TriggerFNCBurst.ch: 保險 / 單發 / 3 發連發 / 全自動.
Tooltip_GS_GSFN_Part_TriggerFNCBurst.cn: 保险 / 单点 / 3 发连发 / 全自动.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_CompGlock.en: Clamps under the frame and ports the barrel ahead of the slide: much less muzzle flip, louder.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_CompGlock.ch: 夾裝在槍身下方, 並在滑套前方為槍管洩氣: 大幅減少槍口上跳, 但更吵.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_CompGlock.cn: 夹装在枪身下方, 并在套筒前方为枪管泄气: 大幅减少枪口上跳, 但更响.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_GripSleeveGlock.en: Slip-on rubber sleeve with finger grooves: a steadier hold. Hands only.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_GripSleeveGlock.ch: 套上式橡膠握把套, 附指槽: 握持更穩. 徒手即可安裝.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_GripSleeveGlock.cn: 套装式橡胶握把套, 带指槽: 握持更稳. 徒手即可安装.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_LaserGlockClamp.en: Clamps around the front of the trigger guard. Hold-R wheel. While on: Accuracy +6, Aim time -6. About 8 hours a battery.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_LaserGlockClamp.ch: 夾裝在扳機護弓前方. 按住 R 開啟輪盤. 開啟時: 精準度 +6, 瞄準時間 -6. 一顆電池約 8 小時.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_LaserGlockClamp.cn: 夹装在扳机护圈前方. 按住 R 打开轮盘. 开启时: 精准度 +6, 瞄准时间 -6. 一节电池约 8 小时.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_LightGlockClamp.en: Clamps around the front of the trigger guard (no rail on these Glocks). Hold-R wheel: light on/off. A battery lasts about 2 hours on.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_LightGlockClamp.ch: 夾裝在扳機護弓前方 (這些格洛克沒有導軌). 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 開/關燈. 一顆電池約可持續亮燈 2 小時.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_LightGlockClamp.cn: 夹装在扳机护圈前方 (这些格洛克没有导轨). 按住 R 打开轮盘: 开/关灯. 一节电池约可持续亮灯 2 小时.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_MagReleaseGlockExt.en: Stands proud of the frame: faster magazine changes.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_MagReleaseGlockExt.ch: 凸出於槍身: 更換彈匣更快.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_MagReleaseGlockExt.cn: 凸出于枪身: 更换弹匣更快.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_MagwellGlock.en: Flared funnel on the grip: the magazine finds its way in fast.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_MagwellGlock.ch: 握把上的擴口漏斗: 彈匣能快速插入到位.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_MagwellGlock.cn: 握把上的扩口漏斗: 弹匣能快速插入到位.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_SightsGlockAdj.en: Target rear sight, windage and elevation screws: better at range, a touch slower to line up. Screwdriver.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_SightsGlockAdj.ch: 競技用照門, 附風偏與高低調整螺絲: 遠距離表現更好, 對準稍慢. 需螺絲起子.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_SightsGlockAdj.cn: 竞技用照门, 带风偏和高低调整螺丝: 远距离表现更好, 对准稍慢. 需螺丝刀.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_SightsGlockSteel.en: All-steel square notch and post: tougher and crisper than the factory plastic sights. Screwdriver.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_SightsGlockSteel.ch: 全鋼方形缺口照門與柱狀準星: 比原廠塑膠瞄具更耐用、更清晰. 需螺絲起子.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_SightsGlockSteel.cn: 全钢方形缺口照门和柱状准星: 比原厂塑料瞄具更耐用、更清晰. 需螺丝刀.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_TriggerGlockComp.ch: 扳機力輕、俐落, 專為比賽設計.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_TriggerGlockComp.cn: 扳机力轻、干脆, 专为比赛设计.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_TriggerGlockNY.en: Heavy 8 lb pull, as the NYPD ordered it: safer in a hurry, harder to shoot well.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_TriggerGlockNY.ch: 依紐約市警局要求的 8 磅重扳機力: 慌忙時更安全, 但更難打得準.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_TriggerGlockNY.cn: 按纽约市警察局要求的 8 磅重扳机力: 慌乱时更安全, 但更难打得准.

Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_BipodHK.en: Clamps to the cocking tube. Steadier, slower to swing.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_BipodHK.ch: 夾裝在拉機柄管上. 更穩定, 擺槍較慢.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_BipodHK.cn: 夹装在拉机柄管上. 更稳定, 摆枪较慢.

Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_HKConv22.en: A .22 bolt group for cheap, quiet practice: 20-round .22 magazines. Unload the rifle first. Take it off for 7.62 NATO.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_HKConv22.ch: .22 槍機組, 練習便宜又安靜: 使用 20 發 .22 彈匣. 請先將步槍退彈. 拆下即可改回 7.62 NATO.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_HKConv22.cn: .22 枪机组, 练习便宜又安静: 使用 20 发 .22 弹匣. 请先给步枪退弹. 拆下即可改回 7.62 NATO.

Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_MountHKClaw.en: Clamps onto the receiver, no tools. STANAG top: takes optics made for it, not Weaver rings.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_MountHKClaw.ch: 免工具夾裝在機匣上. STANAG 頂部: 可裝對應的光學瞄具, 不適用韋弗鏡環.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_MountHKClaw.cn: 免工具夹装在机匣上. STANAG 顶部: 可装对应的光学瞄具, 不适用韦弗镜环.

Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_OpticHensoldtZF.en: Fixed 4x military scope. Clamps straight onto the STANAG claw mount.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_OpticHensoldtZF.ch: 定倍 4x 軍用瞄準鏡. 可直接夾裝在 STANAG 爪式鏡座上.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_OpticHensoldtZF.cn: 定倍 4x 军用瞄准镜. 可直接夹装在 STANAG 爪式镜座上.

Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_StockHKA3.en: Hold-R wheel: collapse (Aim time -3 more, Recoil +3) or extend.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_StockHKA3.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 收合 (瞄準時間再 -3, 後坐力 +3) 或伸展.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_StockHKA3.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘: 收合 (瞄准时间再 -3, 后坐力 +3) 或伸展.

Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_TriggerHKSEF.en: Safe / Single / Auto. Full auto in 7.62 NATO climbs hard.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_TriggerHKSEF.ch: 保險 / 單發 / 全自動. 7.62 NATO 全自動射擊時槍口上揚劇烈.
Tooltip_GS_GSHK_Part_TriggerHKSEF.cn: 保险 / 单点 / 全自动. 7.62 NATO 全自动射击时枪口上扬剧烈.

Tooltip_GS_GSK98_Part_BasesK98.en: A gunsmith drills and taps the receiver for them: a Weaver rail for any scope or dot.
Tooltip_GS_GSK98_Part_BasesK98.ch: 需由槍匠在機匣上鑽孔攻牙安裝: 提供韋弗導軌, 可裝任何瞄準鏡或紅點.
Tooltip_GS_GSK98_Part_BasesK98.cn: 需由枪匠在机匣上钻孔攻丝安装: 提供韦弗导轨, 可装任何瞄准镜或红点.

Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_BoltMosinBent.en: Turned down along the stock: clears a scope, and a little quicker to work.
Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_BoltMosinBent.ch: 沿槍托向下彎折: 避開瞄準鏡, 操作也稍快.
Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_BoltMosinBent.cn: 沿枪托向下弯折: 避开瞄准镜, 操作也稍快.

Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_MountMosinPU.en: Screws to the receiver's left side. The scope sits right over the action: no stripper clips with it on.
Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_MountMosinPU.ch: 以螺絲固定在機匣左側. 瞄準鏡正好位於槍機上方: 裝上後無法使用橋夾.
Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_MountMosinPU.cn: 用螺丝固定在机匣左侧. 瞄准镜正好位于枪机上方: 装上后无法使用桥夹.

Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_OpticMosinPU.en: Soviet 3.5x scope with its own rings. Fits only the PU side mount.
Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_OpticMosinPU.ch: 蘇聯 3.5x 瞄準鏡, 附專用鏡環. 僅適用 PU 側裝鏡座.
Tooltip_GS_GSMN_Part_OpticMosinPU.cn: 苏联 3.5x 瞄准镜, 附专用镜环. 仅适用 PU 侧装镜座.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_BoltMP5.en: Its condition also drives jam chance.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_BoltMP5.ch: 其耐久也會影響卡彈機率.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_BoltMP5.cn: 其耐久也会影响卡壳几率.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_ClawMount.en: Clamps onto the receiver, no tools.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_EndCapMP5.en: Compact and fast, hard to hold steady.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_EndCapMP5.ch: 小巧迅速, 難以握穩.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_EndCapMP5.cn: 小巧迅速, 难以握稳.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_SDBarrel.en: Ported: every round leaves the muzzle below the speed of sound, so no crack. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_SDBarrel.ch: 槍管開有洩氣孔: 每發子彈離開槍口時都低於音速, 因此沒有音爆聲. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_SDBarrel.cn: 枪管开有泄气孔: 每发子弹离开枪口时都低于音速, 因此没有音爆声. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_StdBarrelMP5.en: The MP5A3's 225 mm barrel: full 9mm report and muzzle flash, nothing to wear out but the barrel. Lighter and quicker to the shoulder than the SD.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_StdBarrelMP5.ch: MP5A3 的 225 mm 槍管: 9mm 槍聲與槍口焰毫無減弱, 除了槍管本身沒有會磨耗的部件. 比 SD 更輕, 抵肩更快.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_StdBarrelMP5.cn: MP5A3 的 225 mm 枪管: 9mm 枪声和枪口焰毫无减弱, 除了枪管本身没有会磨损的部件. 比 SD 更轻, 抵肩更快.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_StockA3MP5.en: Hold-R wheel: collapse (Aim time -3 more, Recoil +3) or extend.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_StockA3MP5.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 收合 (瞄準時間再 -3, 後坐力 +3) 或伸展.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_StockA3MP5.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘: 收合 (瞄准时间再 -3, 后坐力 +3) 或伸展.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerBurst.ch: 保險 / 單發 / 2 發連發 / 全自動.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerBurst.cn: 保险 / 单点 / 2 发连发 / 全自动.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerNavy.en: Selector on both sides. Safe / Single / Auto.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerNavy.ch: 兩側皆有快慢機. 保險 / 單發 / 全自動.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerNavy.cn: 两侧都有快慢机. 保险 / 单点 / 全自动.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerSEF.ch: 保險 / 單發 / 全自動.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_TriggerSEF.cn: 保险 / 单点 / 全自动.

Tooltip_GS_GSPY_Part_GripsPYTHONRubber.en: Rubber wraparound: a steadier hold on full-power loads.
Tooltip_GS_GSPY_Part_GripsPYTHONRubber.ch: 包覆式橡膠握把: 射擊全裝藥彈時握持更穩.
Tooltip_GS_GSPY_Part_GripsPYTHONRubber.cn: 包覆式橡胶握把: 射击全装药弹时握持更稳.

Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_MountSKSKengs.en: Replaces the receiver cover. Weaver base for a scope or dot.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_MountSKSKengs.ch: 取代機匣蓋. 附韋弗底座, 可裝瞄準鏡或紅點.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_MountSKSKengs.cn: 取代机匣盖. 附韦弗底座, 可装瞄准镜或红点.

Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_OpticKengs4x28.en: Compact 4x scope, comes with its own clamp ring.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_OpticKengs4x28.ch: 小巧的 4x 瞄準鏡, 附專用夾環.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_OpticKengs4x28.cn: 小巧的 4x 瞄准镜, 附专用夹环.

Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_SKSMag10.en: Take it out to use 30-round detachable magazines. Unload the rifle first.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_SKSMag10.ch: 拆下後即可使用 30 發可拆式彈匣. 請先將步槍退彈.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_SKSMag10.cn: 拆下后即可使用 30 发可拆卸弹匣. 请先给步枪退弹.

Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_StockSKSSynth.en: Lighter than the wood stock, with a rubber recoil pad.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_StockSKSSynth.ch: 比木製槍托更輕, 附橡膠緩衝墊.
Tooltip_GS_GSSKS_Part_StockSKSSynth.cn: 比木制枪托更轻, 带橡胶缓冲垫.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_BCGSR25.en: Its condition also drives jam chance.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_BCGSR25.ch: 其耐久也會影響卡彈機率.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_BCGSR25.cn: 其耐久也会影响卡壳几率.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_Barrel24.ch: 自由浮動, 非常精準, 沉重.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_Barrel24.cn: 自由浮动, 非常精准, 沉重.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_FlashHiderSR25.en: The Knight's suppressor locks onto it.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_FlashHiderSR25.ch: 奈特軍械的消音器可鎖固在上面.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_FlashHiderSR25.cn: 奈特军械的消音器可锁固在上面.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardAR10Black.en: Old-pattern two-piece handguard: light, but it touches the barrel.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardAR10Black.ch: 舊式兩件式護木: 輕巧, 但會接觸槍管.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardAR10Black.cn: 旧式两件式护木: 轻巧, 但会接触枪管.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardAR10Brown.en: The 1950s look. Light, but it touches the barrel.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardAR10Brown.ch: 1950 年代的外觀. 輕巧, 但會接觸槍管.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardAR10Brown.cn: 1950 年代的外观. 轻巧, 但会接触枪管.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25.en: Never touches the barrel. Has a sling stud for a bipod.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25.ch: 完全不接觸槍管. 附可裝兩腳架的背帶環.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25.cn: 完全不接触枪管. 带可装两脚架的背带环.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25RAS.en: Free-floated quad rail: takes foregrips, lights and lasers, plus a bipod stud.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25RAS.ch: 自由浮動四面導軌: 可裝前握把、戰術燈與雷射, 另有兩腳架安裝環.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25RAS.cn: 自由浮动四面导轨: 可装前握把、战术灯和激光, 另有两脚架安装环.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25Vent.en: Lighter free-float tube that sheds barrel heat.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25Vent.ch: 更輕的自由浮動護管, 能散去槍管熱量.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_HandguardSR25Vent.cn: 更轻的自由浮动护管, 能散发枪管热量.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_SuppressorSR25.en: Hides flash. 7.62 stays loud-ish: the supersonic crack can't be suppressed. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_SuppressorSR25.ch: 遮蔽槍口焰. 7.62 依然偏吵: 超音速的音爆聲無法消除. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_SuppressorSR25.cn: 遮蔽枪口焰. 7.62 依然偏响: 超音速的音爆声无法消除. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_UpperSR25.en: Flat top rail, no iron sights: needs an optic.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_UpperSR25.ch: 平頂導軌, 無機械瞄具: 需要光學瞄具.
Tooltip_GS_GSSR_Part_UpperSR25.cn: 平顶导轨, 无机械瞄具: 需要光学瞄具.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_BipodHarris.en: Clamps to a sling stud. Steadier, slower to swing.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_BipodHarris.ch: 夾裝在背帶環上. 更穩定, 擺槍較慢.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_BipodHarris.cn: 夹装在背带环上. 更稳定, 摆枪较慢.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_DotAimpoint.en: 30mm tube: needs 30mm rings. A battery lasts about 10 days in hand.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_DotAimpoint.ch: 30mm 鏡管: 需要 30mm 鏡環. 手持時一顆電池約可用 10 天.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_DotAimpoint.cn: 30mm 镜管: 需要 30mm 镜环. 手持时一节电池约可用 10 天.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_DotTasco.en: Cheap. Eats a battery in about 5 days in hand.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_DotTasco.ch: 便宜. 手持時約 5 天就會耗光一顆電池.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_DotTasco.cn: 便宜. 手持时约 5 天就会耗光一节电池.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ForegripGangster.en: A spare pistol grip hose-clamped under the handguard. No rail needed; the clamps loosen. Crafted from a pistol grip + 2 hose clamps.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ForegripGangster.ch: 用管束把備用手槍握把固定在護木下方. 不需要導軌; 管束會鬆脫. 以手槍握把 + 2 個管束製成.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ForegripGangster.cn: 用喉箍把备用手枪握把固定在护木下方. 不需要导轨; 喉箍会松脱. 用手枪握把 + 2 个喉箍制成.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ForegripLSO.en: Clamps to the rail with a hex key.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ForegripLSO.ch: 以六角扳手夾裝在導軌上.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ForegripLSO.cn: 用内六角扳手夹装在导轨上.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LaserAIM.en: Hold-R wheel. While on: Accuracy +6, Aim time -6. About 8 hours a battery.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LaserAIM.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤. 開啟時: 精準度 +6, 瞄準時間 -6. 一顆電池約 8 小時.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LaserAIM.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘. 开启时: 精准度 +6, 瞄准时间 -6. 一节电池约 8 小时.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LightLPC7.en: Hold-R wheel: light on/off. A battery lasts about 2 hours on.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LightLPC7.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 開/關燈. 一顆電池約可持續亮燈 2 小時.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LightLPC7.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘: 开/关灯. 一节电池约可持续亮灯 2 小时.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LightMaglite.en: Hold-R wheel: light on/off. Heavy D-cell light, about 3 hours a battery. Crafted from a flashlight + 2 hose clamps.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LightMaglite.ch: 按住 R 開啟輪盤: 開/關燈. 沉重的 1 號電池手電筒, 一顆電池約 3 小時. 以手電筒 + 2 個管束製成.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_LightMaglite.cn: 按住 R 打开轮盘: 开/关灯. 沉重的 1 号电池手电筒, 一节电池约 3 小时. 用手电筒 + 2 个喉箍制成.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_Rings1in.en: A pair of 1-inch rings for a Weaver rail: needed for 1-inch scopes.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_Rings1in.ch: 一對用於韋弗導軌的 1 吋鏡環: 1 吋瞄準鏡必備.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_Rings1in.cn: 一对用于韦弗导轨的 1 英寸镜环: 1 英寸瞄准镜必需.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_Rings30.en: A pair of 30mm rings for a Weaver rail: needed for 30mm scopes and red dots.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_Rings30.ch: 一對用於韋弗導軌的 30mm 鏡環: 30mm 瞄準鏡與紅點瞄準器必備.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_Rings30.cn: 一对用于韦弗导轨的 30mm 镜环: 30mm 瞄准镜和红点瞄准器必需.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeACOG.en: Tritium lit, never needs batteries. Fits the carry handle or a flattop rail.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeACOG.ch: 氚光照明, 永遠不需要電池. 可裝在提把或平頂導軌上.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeACOG.cn: 氚光照明, 永远不需要电池. 可装在提把或平顶导轨上.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeLeupold.en: Low 1.5x setting keeps it usable up close. A hunting scope: rides a rail in its own 1-inch rings, never over a carry handle. Hex key.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeLeupold.ch: 低倍 1.5x 設定讓它在近距離仍可使用. 狩獵瞄準鏡: 以專用 1 吋鏡環架在導軌上, 不能架在提把上. 需六角扳手.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeLeupold.cn: 低倍 1.5x 挡位让它在近距离仍可使用. 狩猎瞄准镜: 用专用 1 英寸镜环架在导轨上, 不能架在提把上. 需内六角扳手.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeM3.en: Fixed 10x with bullet-drop turret: superb at range, useless up close. 30mm tube: needs 30mm rings on a rail, never over a carry handle. Hex key.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeM3.ch: 定倍 10x, 附彈道下墜補償旋鈕: 遠距離表現極佳, 近距離毫無用處. 30mm 鏡管: 需在導軌上使用 30mm 鏡環, 不能架在提把上. 需六角扳手.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_ScopeM3.cn: 定倍 10x, 带弹道下坠补偿旋钮: 远距离表现极佳, 近距离毫无用处. 30mm 镜管: 需在导轨上使用 30mm 镜环, 不能架在提把上. 需内六角扳手.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_TritiumSights.en: Glowing tritium dots: aims far better in the dark. Never needs batteries. Screwdriver.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_TritiumSights.ch: 發光的氚光點: 在黑暗中瞄準好得多. 永遠不需要電池. 需螺絲起子.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_TritiumSights.cn: 发光的氚光点: 在黑暗中瞄准好得多. 永远不需要电池. 需螺丝刀.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_MagChargerAR.en: The steel guide that lets 5.56 stripper clips feed straight into an AR-15 magazine.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_MagChargerAR.ch: 讓 5.56 橋夾能直接壓彈進 AR-15 彈匣的鋼製導引器.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_MagChargerAR.cn: 让 5.56 桥夹能直接压弹进 AR-15 弹匣的钢制导引器.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_PaperTarget.en: An old practice target. Build a Steel Plate Target or a paper target from the build menu instead: they stand the right way up.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_PaperTarget.ch: 舊式練習標靶. 請改從建造選單建造鋼板標靶或紙製標靶: 它們能正確直立.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_PaperTarget.cn: 旧式练习靶. 请改从建造菜单建造钢板靶或纸质靶: 它们能正确直立.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_StripperClip556.en: Carry these with the magazine charger to load AR-15 magazines ten rounds at a time: much faster.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_StripperClip556.ch: 將這些與彈匣橋夾導引器一起攜帶, 即可一次十發地裝填 AR-15 彈匣: 快得多.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_StripperClip556.cn: 将这些和弹匣桥夹导引器一起携带, 即可一次十发地装填 AR-15 弹匣: 快得多.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_StripperClip76239.en: Carry these to load the SKS through the top of the action ten rounds at a time: much faster.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_StripperClip76239.ch: 攜帶這些即可從機匣頂部一次十發地為 SKS 裝彈: 快得多.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_StripperClip76239.cn: 携带这些即可从机匣顶部一次十发地为 SKS 装弹: 快得多.

Tooltip_GS_PaperBullseye.en: A paper bullseye target pinned to a wall. Shoot at it from 3 to 30 tiles to train Aiming, or to zero a new optic.
Tooltip_GS_PaperBullseye.ch: 釘在牆上的紙製靶心標靶. 從 3 到 30 格的距離射擊可訓練瞄準, 或替新光學瞄具歸零.
Tooltip_GS_PaperBullseye.cn: 钉在墙上的纸质靶心靶. 从 3 到 30 格的距离射击可训练瞄准, 或给新光学瞄具归零.

Tooltip_GS_PaperSilhouette.en: A paper silhouette target pinned to a wall. Shoot at it from 3 to 30 tiles to train Aiming, or to zero a new optic.
Tooltip_GS_PaperSilhouette.ch: 釘在牆上的紙製人形標靶. 從 3 到 30 格的距離射擊可訓練瞄準, 或替新光學瞄具歸零.
Tooltip_GS_PaperSilhouette.cn: 钉在墙上的纸质人形靶. 从 3 到 30 格的距离射击可训练瞄准, 或给新光学瞄具归零.

Tooltip_GS_SteelTarget.en: A steel plate on a wooden stand, like the ones at gun ranges. Shoot at it from 3 to 30 tiles to train Aiming, or to zero a new optic. Pick it up and move it like furniture.
Tooltip_GS_SteelTarget.ch: 裝在木架上的鋼板, 就像靶場用的那種. 從 3 到 30 格的距離射擊可訓練瞄準, 或替新光學瞄具歸零. 可像家具一樣拿起搬動.
Tooltip_GS_SteelTarget.cn: 装在木架上的钢板, 就像靶场用的那种. 从 3 到 30 格的距离射击可训练瞄准, 或给新光学瞄具归零. 可像家具一样拿起搬动.

Tooltip_SnackTime89_ST_Bamboola.en: The cocoa biscuit with chocolate chips that turns snack time into a party!
Tooltip_SnackTime89_ST_Bamboola.ch: 加了巧克力豆的可可餅乾, 讓點心時間變成派對!
Tooltip_SnackTime89_ST_Bamboola.cn: 加了巧克力豆的可可饼干, 让零食时间变成派对!

Tooltip_SnackTime89_ST_BamboolaBiscuit.en: The cocoa biscuit with chocolate chips that turns snack time into a party!
Tooltip_SnackTime89_ST_BamboolaBiscuit.ch: 加了巧克力豆的可可餅乾, 讓點心時間變成派對!
Tooltip_SnackTime89_ST_BamboolaBiscuit.cn: 加了巧克力豆的可可饼干, 让零食时间变成派对!

Tooltip_IDBFS_BookBiofuel.ch: 教導如何將乙醇精製成生物燃料.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookBiofuel.cn: 教导如何将乙醇精炼成生物燃料.

Tooltip_IDBFS_BookBottled.en: Teaches bottling of spirits, drinks, vinegar and oils.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookBottled.ch: 教導如何將烈酒、飲料、醋與油裝瓶.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookBottled.cn: 教导如何将烈酒、饮料、醋和油装瓶.

Tooltip_IDBFS_BookDestilery.en: Teaches all alcohol distillation processes at the still.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookDestilery.ch: 教導在蒸餾器進行的所有酒精蒸餾製程.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookDestilery.cn: 教导在蒸馏器上进行的所有酒精蒸馏工艺.

Tooltip_IDBFS_BookFermentation.en: Teaches mash preparation, yeast, fermentation and vinegar production.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookFermentation.ch: 教導醪的調製、酵母、發酵與醋的製作.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookFermentation.cn: 教导醪的调制、酵母、发酵和醋的制作.

Tooltip_IDBFS_BookIndustrial.en: Teaches construction of all ten IDBFS machines and storage structures.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookIndustrial.ch: 教導如何建造全部十種 IDBFS 機器與儲存設施.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookIndustrial.cn: 教导如何建造全部十种 IDBFS 机器和储存设施.

Tooltip_IDBFS_BookOilProduction.en: Teaches sunflower and olive oil production.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookOilProduction.ch: 教導如何製作葵花籽油與橄欖油.
Tooltip_IDBFS_BookOilProduction.cn: 教导如何制作葵花籽油和橄榄油.

Tooltip_IDBFS_RequiresManual.ch: 閱讀 %1 即可學會此製程.
Tooltip_IDBFS_RequiresManual.cn: 阅读 %1 即可学会此工艺.

Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeHumiditySensorDes.en: A stake you push into soil that can be planted. It reads how much water the crop on its tile has: when it drops to the minimum you set it gives a signal, and when it climbs to the maximum it stops; in between it keeps what it was doing. The valves you link to it open on the signal and close without it. Runs on the tile's electricity or on a Battery. Right-click it to set it up and link valves.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeHumiditySensorDes.ch: 插進可耕種土壤的感測樁. 它會讀取同一格作物的含水量: 降到你設定的下限時發出訊號, 升到上限時停止發出; 介於兩者之間時維持原本的狀態. 與它連結的閥門在收到訊號時開啟, 沒有訊號時關閉. 使用所在格子的電力或電池運作. 對它按右鍵即可進行設定並連結閥門.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeHumiditySensorDes.cn: 插入可耕种土壤的传感桩. 它会读取同一格作物的含水量: 降到你设置的下限时发出信号, 升到上限时停止发出; 介于两者之间时保持原来的状态. 与它关联的阀门在收到信号时打开, 没有信号时关闭. 使用所在格子的电力或电池运行. 右键点击它即可进行设置并关联阀门.

No.09 : 绀碧

No.12 : Wisteria Purple
A light blue-purple inspired by wisteria flowers.

No.12 : 藤紫
以紫藤花為靈感的淺藍紫色.
Tooltip_P4ColorPen12.cn:
No.12 : 藤紫
以紫藤花为灵感的浅蓝紫色.

以鳶尾與花菖蒲花朵為靈感的紫色.

No.13 : 菖蒲色

映照紅梅花色、略顯黯淡的紅紫色.

No.14 : 梅紫
映照红梅花色、略显暗淡的红紫色.

Tooltip_P4ColorPen15.en:

A deep scarlet with a subtle yellow undertone.
Tooltip_P4ColorPen15.ch:
No.15 : 深緋
帶有些微黃調的深緋紅色.

No.15 : 深绯
带有一丝黄调的深绯红色.

以桃花為靈感, 略顯褪色的深紅色.

以桃花为灵感, 略显褪色的深红色.

Tooltip_P4ColorPenMapColor_NeedPen.ch: 使用此顏色需要持有對應的四季物語.
Tooltip_P4ColorPenMapColor_NeedPen.cn: 使用此颜色需要持有对应的四季物语.

Requires an empty box and all twenty original Shiki Monogatari pens.
The completed display box cannot be taken apart.

需要一個空盒子與全部二十支初代四季物語彩色筆.
完成的展示盒無法拆開.
Tooltip_Recipe_P4CompleteColorPenDisplay.cn:

Tooltip_craft_RCAirConditionerDesc.en: A split air conditioner, mounted high on an outside wall. Point it at a solid wall that leads straight outdoors. Needs grid power or a generator.
Tooltip_craft_RCAirConditionerDesc.ch: 分離式冷氣機, 安裝在外牆高處. 請對準一面直通室外的實心牆. 需要電網供電或發電機.
Tooltip_craft_RCAirConditionerDesc.cn: 分体式空调, 安装在外墙高处. 请对准一面直通室外的实心墙. 需要电网供电或发电机.

Tooltip_SMA_CombativesMagazine.en: Learn Krav Maga. A Krav Maga-inspired game adaptation, not an authentic curriculum. Interrupt threats, create space and disengage. No pain-compliance or choke incapacitation against zombies.
Tooltip_SMA_CombativesMagazine.ch: 學習以色列格鬥術. 這是受以色列格鬥術啟發的遊戲改編, 並非正統課程. 打斷威脅、拉開距離並脫離. 對殭屍無法使用疼痛壓制或鎖喉制伏.
Tooltip_SMA_CombativesMagazine.cn: 学习马伽术. 这是受马伽术启发的游戏改编版本, 并非正统课程. 打断威胁、拉开距离并脱身. 对僵尸无法使用疼痛制服或锁喉制伏.

Tooltip_BBP_EditLevelDown.en: Work on the level below. To add a basement room, use Edit Footprint and step the level down there.
Tooltip_BBP_EditLevelDown.ch: 改為編輯下一層. 若要新增地下室房間, 請使用「編輯佔地範圍」並在其中切換到下一層.
Tooltip_BBP_EditLevelDown.cn: 切换到下一层进行编辑. 若要添加地下室房间, 请使用“编辑占地范围”并在其中切换到下一层.

Tooltip_BBP_EditLevelUp.cn: 切换到上一层进行编辑.

Tooltip_BBP_NoteNeedsPaper.en: Needs a blank sheet of paper or an empty notebook in the inventory.
Tooltip_BBP_NoteNeedsPaper.ch: 物品欄中需要有一張空白紙張或空白筆記本.
Tooltip_BBP_NoteNeedsPaper.cn: 物品栏中需要有一张空白纸张或空白笔记本.

Tooltip_BBP_RoomLevelDown.en: Draw rooms one level down. Below the ground floor is a basement: it is dug out with a shovel before anything is built in it, and it needs stairs up.
Tooltip_BBP_RoomLevelDown.ch: 在下一層繪製房間. 地面層以下為地下室: 在其中建造任何東西前, 需先用鏟子挖開, 且需要有往上的樓梯.
Tooltip_BBP_RoomLevelDown.cn: 在下一层绘制房间. 地面层以下为地下室: 在其中建造任何东西前, 需先用铲子挖开, 且需要有向上的楼梯.

Tooltip_BBP_ToggleAbove.en: Show or hide the floors above this basement level while you edit it. Hidden, their rooms stay as a faint outline while Rooms is on.
Tooltip_BBP_ToggleAbove.ch: 編輯此地下室樓層時, 顯示或隱藏其上方的樓層. 隱藏時, 若「房間」已開啟, 上方樓層的房間會以淡淡的輪廓顯示.
Tooltip_BBP_ToggleAbove.cn: 编辑此地下室楼层时, 显示或隐藏其上方的楼层. 隐藏时, 若“房间”已开启, 上方楼层的房间会以淡淡的轮廓显示.

Tooltip_BBP_ToggleBasement.en: Mark where the basement lies while you edit a floor above it: a faint shade in see-through view, an outline in solid view. Needs Rooms on.
Tooltip_BBP_ToggleBasement.ch: 編輯地下室上方的樓層時標示地下室的位置: 透視檢視中以淡色陰影顯示, 實體檢視中以輪廓顯示. 需開啟「房間」.
Tooltip_BBP_ToggleBasement.cn: 编辑地下室上方的楼层时标示地下室的位置: 透视视图中以淡色阴影显示, 实体视图中以轮廓显示. 需开启“房间”.

Tooltip_TBeltOrig.en: Looks like usual belt but all items hide.
Tooltip_TBeltOrig.ch: 看起來像普通腰帶, 但所有物品都會隱藏.
Tooltip_TBeltOrig.cn: 看起来像普通腰带, 但所有物品都会隐藏.

Tooltip_Locksmith_LatchWindow.en: Holds the window shut against anyone outside. You can release it again from in here.
Tooltip_Locksmith_LatchWindow.ch: 把窗戶閂緊, 外面的人都打不開. 之後你可以從室內再解開.
Tooltip_Locksmith_LatchWindow.cn: 将窗户闩紧, 外面的人都打不开. 之后你可以从室内再次解开.

Tooltip_Locksmith_ShimWindow.en: Slip the latch with a screwdriver and a paperclip. Costs exactly what picking a door lock costs, and pays the same Nimble either way.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ShimWindow.ch: 用螺絲起子與迴紋針撥開窗閂. 消耗與獲得的靈活經驗都和撬門鎖完全相同.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ShimWindow.cn: 用螺丝刀和回形针拨开窗闩. 消耗和获得的灵活经验都与撬门锁完全相同.

Tooltip_Locksmith_TakeKey.en: The game only finds keys in your main inventory and on key rings, so this one is hidden from the lock menu while it sits in a bag.
Tooltip_Locksmith_TakeKey.ch: 遊戲只會在主物品欄與鑰匙環上找鑰匙, 所以這把鑰匙放在包裡時, 鎖的選單不會出現它.
Tooltip_Locksmith_TakeKey.cn: 游戏只会在主物品栏和钥匙环上查找钥匙, 因此这把钥匙放在包里时, 锁的菜单中不会显示它.

Tooltip_Locksmith_WindowInside.en: The latch is on the other side. You would have to shim it, or go round.
Tooltip_Locksmith_WindowInside.ch: 窗閂在另一側. 你得把它撥開, 或是繞過去.
Tooltip_Locksmith_WindowInside.cn: 窗闩在另一侧. 你得把它拨开, 或者绕过去.

Tooltip_item_BIRDBRAINTeto.en: baby, i don't know when i'm supposed to stop!
Tooltip_item_BIRDBRAINTeto.ch: 寶貝, 我不知道什麼時候該停下來!
Tooltip_item_BIRDBRAINTeto.cn: 宝贝, 我不知道什么时候该停下来!

Tooltip_item_Pearto.en: DO. NOT. EAT. THIS. its not worth it.
Tooltip_item_Pearto.ch: 不. 要. 吃. 這. 個. 真的不值得.
Tooltip_item_Pearto.cn: 不. 要. 吃. 这. 个. 真的不值得.

Tooltip_item_SynthVTeto.ch: 她是確切而真實的存在.
Tooltip_item_SynthVTeto.cn: 她是确切而真实的存在.

Tooltip_item_VOICEPEAKTeto.ch: 這是VOICEPEAK Teto… 嗯, 沒錯.
Tooltip_item_VOICEPEAKTeto.cn: 这是VOICEPEAK Teto… 嗯, 没错.

Tooltip_FTZCorpseFull.en: The cart is full (5 bodies max).
Tooltip_FTZCorpseFull.ch: 推車已滿 (最多 5 具屍體).
Tooltip_FTZCorpseFull.cn: 推车已满 (最多 5 具尸体).
Tooltip_FTZCorpseFull._note: 2026-10-26 As1 v3.12.0 收錄 FTZ Carts & Trolleys（3815775971）後退役 own 目錄，As1 未收的這鍵遷入本層

Tooltip_FTZCorpseNotEmpty.en: Empty the cart first: bodies only.
Tooltip_FTZCorpseNotEmpty.ch: 請先清空推車: 只能裝屍體.
Tooltip_FTZCorpseNotEmpty.cn: 请先清空推车: 只能装尸体.
Tooltip_FTZCorpseNotEmpty._note: 2026-10-26 As1 v3.12.0 收錄 FTZ Carts & Trolleys（3815775971）後退役 own 目錄，As1 未收的這鍵遷入本層

Tooltip_Fletcher_ArcheryTarget.en: A straw bale with a painted face. Put it down and shoot at it: arrows stick in the straw without breaking, and you learn from every hit until Archery 3.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ArcheryTarget.ch: 一個畫上靶面的草捆. 放下後對著它射: 箭會插在草裡而不會斷, 在射箭達到 3 級之前, 每次命中都能學到經驗.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ArcheryTarget.cn: 一个画着靶面的草捆. 放下后对着它射: 箭会扎在草里而不会折断, 在射箭达到 3 级之前, 每次命中都能获得经验.

Tooltip_Fletcher_BackQuiver.en: Worn across the back, with a bow on your back or a backpack if you like. Holds only arrows and bolts, and many more than the hip quiver. Arrows come from the hip quiver first; nocking from the back quiver is a little faster than from a bag.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BackQuiver.ch: 斜背在背上, 可以同時背弓或背包. 只能裝箭與弩箭, 容量比腰掛箭袋多得多. 會優先從腰掛箭袋取箭; 從背負箭袋搭箭比從包包取箭稍快.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BackQuiver.cn: 斜挎在背上, 可以同时背弓或背包. 只能装箭和弩箭, 容量比腰挂箭袋大得多. 会优先从腰挂箭袋取箭; 从背负箭袋搭箭比从包里取箭稍快.

Tooltip_Fletcher_BenchDesc.en: A fletcher's workbench with a jig and a vise: fletch arrows and bolts five at a time, faster, as matched sets that fly truer and break less.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BenchDesc.ch: 配有黏羽器與虎鉗的製箭匠工作台: 一次製作五支箭或弩箭, 速度更快, 成品是飛得更準、更不易損壞的成套箭組.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BenchDesc.cn: 配有粘羽器和台钳的制箭匠工作台: 一次制作五支箭或弩箭, 速度更快, 成品是飞得更准、更不易损坏的成套箭组.

Tooltip_Fletcher_BlastingArrow.en: A pipe charge on a heavy shaft, with an impact fuze. It explodes where it strikes, killing almost anything within about 3 tiles, you included, and every zombie for a long way hears it. Heavy: it flies slower and not as far. The fuze only arms after about 5 tiles, so closer than that it's a dud. Walls and closed doors stop the blast. Used up when it goes off.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BlastingArrow.ch: 一支裝在重型箭桿上、附有觸發引信的管狀炸藥. 在命中處爆炸, 約 3 格內幾乎無一倖免, 包括你自己, 而且很遠範圍內的殭屍都會聽到. 很重: 飛得較慢, 也飛不遠. 引信約飛行 5 格後才會啟動待發, 距離更近時就是啞彈. 牆壁與關閉的門能擋住爆炸. 引爆後即用盡.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BlastingArrow.cn: 一支装在重型箭杆上、带有触发引信的管状炸药. 在命中处爆炸, 约 3 格内几乎无一幸免, 包括你自己, 而且很远范围内的僵尸都会听到. 很重: 飞得较慢, 也飞不远. 引信约飞行 5 格后才会启动待发, 距离更近时就是哑弹. 墙壁和关着的门能挡住爆炸. 引爆后即耗尽.

Tooltip_Fletcher_BlastingCharge.en: A sawn length of pipe packed with gunpowder and capped. One goes on a Blasting Arrow.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BlastingCharge.ch: 一段鋸下的管子, 塞滿火藥並封口. 一支爆破箭矢需要一個.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BlastingCharge.cn: 一段锯下的管子, 填满火药并封口. 一支爆破箭矢需要一个.

Tooltip_Fletcher_BoardBowStave.en: A bow-length strip sawn from a plank. Lumber is already dry: string it as it is.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BoardBowStave.ch: 從木板鋸下的一根弓長木條. 木材已經乾燥: 直接上弦即可.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BoardBowStave.cn: 从木板上锯下的一根弓长木条. 木材已经干燥: 直接上弦即可.

Tooltip_Fletcher_BowLight.en: A light made for a compound bow, on a short stabilizer. Brighter and lighter than a flashlight taped on, and barely slows your aim. Fits the Compound Bow. Takes batteries.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BowLight.ch: 專為複合弓設計的照明燈, 裝在短平衡桿上. 比用膠帶綁上的手電筒更亮也更輕, 幾乎不影響瞄準速度. 適用於複合弓. 需要電池.
Tooltip_Fletcher_BowLight.cn: 专为复合弓设计的照明灯, 装在短平衡杆上. 比用胶带绑上的手电筒更亮也更轻, 几乎不影响瞄准速度. 适用于复合弓. 需要电池.

Tooltip_Fletcher_ClubBoard.en: Stand it within 20 tiles of an Archery Target. Ten arrows at the target make a round out of 100, and the best ten rounds go up on the board by name. Right-click it to read it.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ClubBoard.ch: 立在射箭標靶 20 格內. 對標靶射十箭為一局, 滿分 100, 最佳的十局會連同姓名登上記分板. 右鍵點選即可閱讀.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ClubBoard.cn: 立在射箭标靶 20 格内. 对标靶射十箭为一局, 满分 100, 最好的十局会连同名字登上记分板. 右键点击即可阅读.

Tooltip_Fletcher_ConcussionArrow.en: An aerosol can wrapped in aluminium on a heavy shaft, set off by an impact fuze. A small blast, a deafening bang that draws zombies from far away, and zombies within about 4 tiles are knocked off their feet. For breaking up a crowd, not for killing. The fuze arms after about 5 tiles.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ConcussionArrow.ch: 一個包著鋁箔的噴霧罐, 裝在重型箭桿上, 由觸發引信引爆. 爆炸威力小, 但震耳欲聾的巨響會引來遠處的殭屍, 約 4 格內的殭屍會被震倒. 用來驅散屍群, 而非殺敵. 引信約飛行 5 格後啟動待發.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ConcussionArrow.cn: 一个包着铝箔的喷雾罐, 装在重型箭杆上, 由触发引信引爆. 爆炸威力小, 但震耳欲聋的巨响会引来远处的僵尸, 约 4 格内的僵尸会被震倒. 用于驱散尸群, 而非杀敌. 引信约飞行 5 格后启动待发.

Tooltip_Fletcher_DamagedArrow.en: Bent shaft, torn fletching: it won't fly true. Re-fletch it with one Fletching to shoot it again.
Tooltip_Fletcher_DamagedArrow.ch: 箭桿彎曲, 箭羽破損: 飛不準了. 用一份箭羽重裝箭羽後即可再次射出.
Tooltip_Fletcher_DamagedArrow.cn: 箭杆弯曲, 箭羽破损: 飞不准了. 用一份箭羽重装箭羽后即可再次射出.

Tooltip_Fletcher_DamagedBolt.en: Its vanes are torn: re-fletch it with one Fletching to shoot it again.
Tooltip_Fletcher_DamagedBolt.ch: 羽片已破損: 用一份箭羽重裝箭羽後即可再次射出.
Tooltip_Fletcher_DamagedBolt.cn: 羽片已破损: 用一份箭羽重装箭羽后即可再次射出.

Tooltip_Fletcher_FireArrow.en: A fuel-soaked rag behind the point. Carry a lighter or matches and it is lit as you loose it: it sets alight whatever it hits, or starts a fire where it lands, and burns away. Fires spread: mind the grass and your own walls.
Tooltip_Fletcher_FireArrow.ch: 箭尖後方綁著浸過燃料的碎布. 身上帶著打火機或火柴, 射出時就會點燃: 會點燃命中的東西, 或在落點起火, 隨後燒盡. 火勢會蔓延: 小心草地和你自己的牆.
Tooltip_Fletcher_FireArrow.cn: 箭尖后方绑着浸过燃料的碎布. 身上带着打火机或火柴, 射出时就会点燃: 会点燃命中的东西, 或在落点起火, 随后烧尽. 火势会蔓延: 当心草地和你自己的墙.

Tooltip_Fletcher_FishingArrow.en: A barbed arrow on a fishing line. Aim at fishable water and watch for fish breaking the surface: shoot one as it rises and reel it in. Missed shots are reeled back. Choose it from the reload menu.
Tooltip_Fletcher_FishingArrow.ch: 一支綁著魚線的倒鉤箭. 瞄準可釣魚的水域, 留意躍出水面的魚: 趁魚浮上來時射中牠, 再把牠收回來. 沒射中也會把箭收回. 從裝填選單中選擇.
Tooltip_Fletcher_FishingArrow.cn: 一支绑着鱼线的倒钩箭. 瞄准可钓鱼的水域, 留意跃出水面的鱼: 趁鱼浮上来时射中它, 再收线拉回来. 没射中也会把箭收回. 从装填菜单中选择.

Tooltip_Fletcher_FlareArrow.en: A road flare taped over the point, struck as you loose it. It lights where it lands, or the zombie it hits, bright red for about a minute, and never starts a fire. It hisses while it burns, and zombies nearby come to see. Spent once it lands.
Tooltip_Fletcher_FlareArrow.ch: 箭尖上用膠帶綁著一支道路訊號彈, 射出時點燃. 它會照亮落點或命中的殭屍, 發出亮紅色光芒約一分鐘, 且絕不會起火. 燃燒時會嘶嘶作響, 附近的殭屍會過來察看. 落地後即用盡.
Tooltip_Fletcher_FlareArrow.cn: 箭尖上用胶带绑着一支道路信号弹, 射出时点燃. 它会照亮落点或命中的僵尸, 发出亮红色光芒约一分钟, 而且绝不会起火. 燃烧时会发出嘶嘶声, 附近的僵尸会过来查看. 落地后即耗尽.

Tooltip_Fletcher_GreenStave.en: Green wood. Lay it on a Stave Rack to season it (a bow stave takes 3 days, a longbow stave 5): a bow from seasoned wood hits harder, reaches farther and wears slower.
Tooltip_Fletcher_GreenStave.ch: 未乾木材. 放在弓胚架上風乾 (弓胚需 3 天, 長弓弓胚需 5 天): 用風乾過的木材製成的弓威力更大、射程更遠、磨損更慢.
Tooltip_Fletcher_GreenStave.cn: 未干木材. 放在弓胚架上风干 (弓胚需要 3 天, 长弓弓胚需要 5 天): 用风干过的木材制成的弓威力更大、射程更远、磨损更慢.

Tooltip_Fletcher_HideGluePot.en: Cook it on a stove or campfire for about an hour, then pour off the glue.
Tooltip_Fletcher_HideGluePot.ch: 在爐子或營火上煮約一小時, 再倒出膠.
Tooltip_Fletcher_HideGluePot.cn: 在炉子或营火上煮约一小时, 然后倒出胶.

Tooltip_Fletcher_HideGluePotCooked.en: Pour it off to get a tube of glue and your pot back.
Tooltip_Fletcher_HideGluePotCooked.ch: 倒出後可得到一管膠水, 並拿回你的鍋子.
Tooltip_Fletcher_HideGluePotCooked.cn: 倒出后可得到一管胶水, 并拿回你的锅.

Tooltip_Fletcher_HipQuiver.en: Worn on the right hip. Holds only arrows and bolts; nocking or cocking from it is faster.
Tooltip_Fletcher_HipQuiver.ch: 掛在右腰. 只能裝箭與弩箭; 從中取箭搭箭或上弦都更快.
Tooltip_Fletcher_HipQuiver.cn: 挂在右腰. 只能装箭和弩箭; 从中取箭搭箭或上弦都更快.

Tooltip_Fletcher_ImpactFuze.en: A nail striker over a shotgun-shell primer: it sets the charge off when the arrow strikes.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ImpactFuze.ch: 霰彈底火上裝了一根釘子撞針: 箭命中時會引爆裝藥.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ImpactFuze.cn: 霰弹底火上方装有一根钉子撞针: 箭命中时会引爆装药.

Tooltip_Fletcher_IncendiaryArrow.en: A can of petrol with a rag wick on a heavy shaft. Light it first, like a fire arrow: where it lands it bursts into a ring of fire about 3 tiles across. Fire spreads: keep it away from your own walls. Unlit, it's a dud. Heavy: it flies slower and not as far.
Tooltip_Fletcher_IncendiaryArrow.ch: 一罐插著碎布引信的汽油, 裝在重型箭桿上. 跟火焰箭矢一樣要先點燃: 落地處會爆出直徑約 3 格的火圈. 火勢會蔓延: 別讓它靠近你自己的牆. 未點燃就是啞彈. 很重: 飛得較慢, 也飛不遠.
Tooltip_Fletcher_IncendiaryArrow.cn: 一罐插着碎布引信的汽油, 装在重型箭杆上. 和火焰箭矢一样要先点燃: 落地处会爆出直径约 3 格的火圈. 火势会蔓延: 别让它靠近你自己的墙. 未点燃就是哑弹. 很重: 飞得较慢, 也飞不远.

Tooltip_Fletcher_Jig.en: Holds an arrow shaft while its fletching sets, so every vane sits the same. Part of a Fletcher's Bench.
Tooltip_Fletcher_Jig.ch: 在箭羽黏合固定時夾住箭桿, 讓每片羽片的位置都一致. 製箭工作台的一部分.
Tooltip_Fletcher_Jig.cn: 在箭羽粘合定型时夹住箭杆, 让每片羽片的位置都一致. 制箭工作台的组成部分.

Tooltip_Fletcher_Matched.en: One of a matched set made at a Fletcher's Bench: strays less and breaks less than an ordinary arrow.
Tooltip_Fletcher_Matched.ch: 在製箭工作台製作的成套箭組之一: 比普通的箭更不易偏離, 也更不易損壞.
Tooltip_Fletcher_Matched.cn: 在制箭工作台制作的成套箭组之一: 比普通的箭更不易偏离, 也更不易损坏.

Tooltip_Fletcher_MessageArrow.en: A note rolled round the shaft behind a rubber blunt. Write the note first. Wherever the arrow lands, the note is left there for whoever finds it: a rooftop, a fenced yard, a window you can't reach.
Tooltip_Fletcher_MessageArrow.ch: 橡膠鈍頭後方的箭桿上捲著一張紙條. 先寫好紙條. 無論箭落在哪裡, 紙條都會留在那裡, 等待發現它的人: 屋頂、圍起來的院子、你搆不到的窗戶.
Tooltip_Fletcher_MessageArrow.cn: 橡胶钝头后方的箭杆上卷着一张纸条. 先写好纸条. 无论箭落在哪里, 纸条都会留在那里, 等着发现它的人: 屋顶、围起来的院子、你够不着的窗户.

Tooltip_Fletcher_NoiseArrow.en: A rattling can on a blunt arrow. Wherever it lands it makes a racket for a few seconds that draws zombies within about 18 tiles: shoot it away from you to pull a crowd off your path. Barely hurts.
Tooltip_Fletcher_NoiseArrow.ch: 鈍頭箭上綁著一個會嘎啦作響的罐子. 無論落在哪裡, 都會吵鬧幾秒, 吸引約 18 格內的殭屍: 往遠離你的方向射, 就能把屍群從你的路線上引開. 幾乎沒有傷害.
Tooltip_Fletcher_NoiseArrow.cn: 钝头箭上绑着一个哗啦作响的罐子. 无论落在哪里, 都会吵闹几秒, 吸引约 18 格内的僵尸: 往远离你的方向射, 就能把尸群从你的路线上引开. 几乎没有伤害.

Tooltip_Fletcher_PayloadShaft.en: A stiff arrow shaft with a socket and oversized vanes, made to carry a payload: the base of the Blasting and Incendiary Arrows.
Tooltip_Fletcher_PayloadShaft.ch: 一支附有插槽與加大羽片的硬挺箭桿, 用來搭載酬載: 是爆破箭矢與燃燒箭矢的基礎.
Tooltip_Fletcher_PayloadShaft.cn: 一支带有插槽和加大羽片的硬挺箭杆, 用于携带载荷: 是爆破箭矢和燃烧箭矢的基础.

Tooltip_Fletcher_PlasticVanes.en: Fletching cut from plastic. Arrows fletched with it last longer and break less, but stray a little more than feathered ones.
Tooltip_Fletcher_PlasticVanes.ch: 用塑膠裁成的箭羽. 用它裝羽的箭更耐用、更不易損壞, 但比羽毛箭羽稍容易偏離.
Tooltip_Fletcher_PlasticVanes.cn: 用塑料裁成的箭羽. 用它装羽的箭更耐用、更不易损坏, 但比用羽毛的箭稍容易偏离.

Tooltip_Fletcher_RackDesc.en: A bowyer's drying rack. Lay green bow and longbow staves on its pegs to season them: 3 days for a bow stave, 5 for a longbow stave. Seasoned wood makes a stronger bow.
Tooltip_Fletcher_RackDesc.ch: 弓匠用的晾乾架. 把未乾的弓胚與長弓弓胚放在架上的木栓上風乾: 弓胚需 3 天, 長弓弓胚需 5 天. 風乾過的木材能做出更強的弓.
Tooltip_Fletcher_RackDesc.cn: 弓匠用的晾干架. 把未干的弓胚和长弓弓胚放在架上的木钉上风干: 弓胚需要 3 天, 长弓弓胚需要 5 天. 风干过的木材能做出更强的弓.

Tooltip_Fletcher_RopeArrow.en: A grapple and a coil of rope. Shoot it through an open or broken upstairs window, or high on the wall right beside one, and it hangs a rope down to the ground that you can climb: no stairs needed. Heavy: it doesn't fly far.
Tooltip_Fletcher_RopeArrow.ch: 一個抓鉤與一捆繩索. 把它射進樓上開著或破掉的窗戶, 或射在緊鄰窗戶的高處牆面, 就會垂下一條通到地面的繩索讓你攀爬: 不需要樓梯. 很重: 飛不遠.
Tooltip_Fletcher_RopeArrow.cn: 一个抓钩和一捆绳索. 把它射进楼上打开或破损的窗户, 或射在紧挨窗户的高处墙面上, 就会垂下一条通到地面的绳索供你攀爬: 不需要楼梯. 很重: 飞不远.

Tooltip_Fletcher_SeasonedStave.en: Seasoned on a stave rack: a bow made from it hits harder, reaches farther and wears slower.
Tooltip_Fletcher_SeasonedStave.ch: 已在弓胚架上風乾: 用它製成的弓威力更大、射程更遠、磨損更慢.
Tooltip_Fletcher_SeasonedStave.cn: 已在弓胚架上风干: 用它制成的弓威力更大、射程更远、磨损更慢.

Tooltip_Fletcher_ShrapnelArrow.en: A Blasting Arrow with nails taped round the charge. It explodes where it strikes like a Blasting Arrow, and throws nails out to about 5 tiles, wounding or killing what stands further off. Very loud. The fuze arms after about 5 tiles. Used up when it goes off.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ShrapnelArrow.ch: 一支在裝藥周圍用膠帶纏上釘子的爆破箭矢. 會像爆破箭矢一樣在命中處爆炸, 並把釘子噴射到約 5 格遠, 讓更外圍的目標受傷或死亡. 非常大聲. 引信約飛行 5 格後啟動待發. 引爆後即用盡.
Tooltip_Fletcher_ShrapnelArrow.cn: 一支在装药周围用胶带缠上钉子的爆破箭矢. 会像爆破箭矢一样在命中处爆炸, 并把钉子喷射到约 5 格远, 让更外围的目标受伤或死亡. 非常响. 引信约飞行 5 格后启动待发. 引爆后即耗尽.

Tooltip_Fletcher_SmokeArrow.en: A smoke mix wrapped behind the point. Light it first, like a fire arrow: where it lands it pours out thick smoke about 3 tiles across for a while, and zombies caught in it lose track of what they were after. It never starts a fire. Unlit, it's a dud.
Tooltip_Fletcher_SmokeArrow.ch: 箭尖後方包著煙霧混合劑. 跟火焰箭矢一樣要先點燃: 落地處會在一段時間內冒出直徑約 3 格的濃煙, 困在煙中的殭屍會失去原本追蹤的目標. 絕不會起火. 未點燃就是啞彈.
Tooltip_Fletcher_SmokeArrow.cn: 箭尖后方包着烟雾混合剂. 和火焰箭矢一样要先点燃: 落地处会在一段时间内冒出直径约 3 格的浓烟, 困在烟中的僵尸会跟丢原本追踪的目标. 绝不会起火. 未点燃就是哑弹.

Tooltip_Fletcher_StickyArrow.en: A Blasting Arrow on a crafted timer, with glue on its nose. It sticks in whatever it hits and goes off about 5 seconds later, wherever that zombie has walked to; it beeps while it counts down. A miss goes off where it lands. Used up when it goes off.
Tooltip_Fletcher_StickyArrow.ch: 一支裝上自製計時器、箭頭塗了膠的爆破箭矢. 會黏在命中的東西上, 約 5 秒後引爆, 不論那隻殭屍走到哪裡; 倒數時會發出嗶嗶聲. 沒射中則在落點引爆. 引爆後即用盡.
Tooltip_Fletcher_StickyArrow.cn: 一支装上自制计时器、箭头涂了胶的爆破箭矢. 会粘在命中的东西上, 约 5 秒后引爆, 不管那只僵尸走到哪里; 倒计时时会发出哔哔声. 没射中则在落点引爆. 引爆后即耗尽.

Tooltip_Fletcher_StrappedLight.en: A flashlight taped to an arrow shaft. Attach it to any bow or crossbow: it sits on the bow like a stabilizer and lights where you aim. Turn it on and off with the light key or from the reload menu. Takes batteries; unstrap it to get the flashlight back.
Tooltip_Fletcher_StrappedLight.ch: 用膠帶綁在箭桿上的手電筒. 可裝在任何弓或十字弩上: 它像平衡桿一樣裝在弓上, 照亮你瞄準的地方. 用照明鍵或從裝填選單開關. 需要電池; 卸下即可拿回手電筒.
Tooltip_Fletcher_StrappedLight.cn: 用胶带绑在箭杆上的手电筒. 可装在任何弓或十字弩上: 它像平衡杆一样装在弓上, 照亮你瞄准的地方. 用照明键或从装填菜单开关. 需要电池; 卸下即可拿回手电筒.

Tooltip_Fletcher_TapeVanes.en: Folded tape fletching: quick and needs no tools, but arrows fletched with it stray more and wear out fast. Not good enough for a matched set.
Tooltip_Fletcher_TapeVanes.ch: 摺疊膠帶做成的箭羽: 做起來快, 不需要工具, 但用它裝羽的箭較容易偏離, 磨損也快. 品質不足以做成成套箭組.
Tooltip_Fletcher_TapeVanes.cn: 折叠胶带做成的箭羽: 做起来快, 不需要工具, 但用它装羽的箭更容易偏离, 磨损也快. 质量不够做成成套箭组.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_BookGuide.en: With the books in your inventory, no level needed.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_BookGuide.ch: 物品欄裡有書時, 不需要技能等級.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_BookGuide.cn: 物品栏里有书时, 不需要技能等级.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwApogeo.en: Skill: every kill lowers Heat a lot and gives more XP; Heat rises a little faster.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwApogeo.ch: 技能: 每次擊殺都會大幅降低熱量並給予更多經驗; 熱量上升稍快.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwApogeo.cn: 技能: 每次击杀都会大幅降低热量并给予更多经验; 热量上升稍快.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwBlank.en: Blank chip: a program must be written on it at a computer or with the terminal.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwBlank.ch: 空白晶片: 必須在電腦上或用終端機寫入程式.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwBlank.cn: 空白芯片: 必须在电脑上或用终端写入程序.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCamaraCriogenica.en: System: cools almost twice as fast with the implant off; more Heat, lower cap and shorter Overdrive.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCamaraCriogenica.ch: 系統: 植入物關閉時冷卻速度近乎加倍; 熱量更多、上限更低、超限時間更短.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCamaraCriogenica.cn: 系统: 植入物关闭时冷却速度接近翻倍; 热量更多、上限更低、超限时间更短.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCentinela.en: System: Heat of use depends on how much you move; standing still costs far less.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCentinela.ch: 系統: 使用熱量取決於你的移動量; 站著不動消耗少得多.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCentinela.cn: 系统: 使用热量取决于你的移动量; 站着不动消耗少得多.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCompatibilidad.en: System: a quarter less rejection and immunodepression per dose, and half again as much passive adaptation XP; Heat rises a little more.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCompatibilidad.ch: 系統: 排斥與每劑造成的免疫低下減少四分之一, 被動適應經驗增加一半; 熱量上升稍多.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwCompatibilidad.cn: 系统: 排斥和每剂造成的免疫低下减少四分之一, 被动适应经验增加一半; 热量上升稍多.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwFiltro.en: System: visual hallucinations drop to a quarter, at the cost of losing the danger sense and the Heat warning.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwFiltro.ch: 系統: 視覺幻覺降為四分之一, 代價是失去危險感知與熱量警告.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwFiltro.cn: 系统: 视觉幻觉降为四分之一, 代价是失去危险感知和热量警告.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwMartillo.en: Skill: harder melee hits that refund stamina; the weapon wears faster.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwMartillo.ch: 技能: 近戰打擊更重, 還會返還耐力; 武器磨損更快.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwMartillo.cn: 技能: 近战打击更重, 还会返还耐力; 武器磨损更快.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwOverclock.en: Skill: no Overdrive; the hotter the implant runs, the more speed, attack and slowdown; much more neural load.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwOverclock.ch: 技能: 無法超限; 植入物越熱, 速度、攻擊與減速效果越強; 神經負荷大幅增加.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwOverclock.cn: 技能: 无法超限; 植入物越热, 速度、攻击和减速效果越强; 神经负荷大幅增加.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwReactor.en: System: the Heat bar fills 1.5 times slower for long sessions and momentum builds faster; cools much slower.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwReactor.ch: 系統: 熱量條累積速度慢 1.5 倍, 適合長時間使用, 衝勁累積更快; 冷卻慢得多.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwReactor.cn: 系统: 热量条累积速度慢 1.5 倍, 适合长时间使用, 冲劲累积更快; 冷却慢得多.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTaller.en: Skill: work mode; crafting, repairing and reading take 25 percent less.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTaller.ch: 技能: 工作模式; 製作、修理與閱讀耗時減少百分之 25.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTaller.cn: 技能: 工作模式; 制作、修理和阅读耗时减少百分之 25.

Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTerminal.en: Portable terminal: writes and decompiles firmware anywhere, one battery per use.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTerminal.ch: 可攜式終端機: 隨處寫入與反編譯韌體, 每次使用消耗一顆電池.
Tooltip_Sandevistan_FwTerminal.cn: 便携式终端: 随时随地写入和反编译固件, 每次使用消耗一节电池.

Tooltip_Common_Sense.en: Ayane's cute-looking gun. Don't keep talking nonsense in front of her and you'll never have to see it.

Tooltip_item_TLD_ForestRevolver.en: More durable version of classic revolver, but with slightly longer aim time.
Tooltip_item_TLD_ForestRevolver.ch: 經典左輪手槍的更耐用版本, 但瞄準時間稍長.
Tooltip_item_TLD_ForestRevolver.cn: 经典左轮手枪的更耐用版本, 但瞄准时间稍长.

Tooltip_item_TLD_HunterRevolver.en: Custom revolver with increased effective range, but slightly increased weight.
Tooltip_item_TLD_HunterRevolver.ch: 改裝左輪手槍, 有效射程更遠, 但重量略微增加.
Tooltip_item_TLD_HunterRevolver.cn: 改装左轮手枪, 有效射程更远, 但重量略有增加.

Tooltip_item_TLD_Revolver.en: A classic revolver with reliable performance.
Tooltip_item_TLD_Revolver.ch: 表現可靠的經典左輪手槍.
Tooltip_item_TLD_Revolver.cn: 性能可靠的经典左轮手枪.

Tooltip_item_TLD_WardenRevolver.en: Snub-nose revolver with lower weight, but slightly reduced effective range.
Tooltip_item_TLD_WardenRevolver.ch: 短管左輪手槍, 重量較輕, 但有效射程略短.
Tooltip_item_TLD_WardenRevolver.cn: 短管左轮手枪, 重量较轻, 但有效射程略短.

Tooltip_WoundsBurnCream.en: Silver sulfadiazine. Spread over a burn to keep infection out and help it heal.
Tooltip_WoundsBurnCream.ch: 磺胺嘧啶銀. 塗抹在燒傷處, 可防止感染並幫助癒合.
Tooltip_WoundsBurnCream.cn: 磺胺嘧啶银. 涂抹在烧伤处, 可防止感染并帮助愈合.

Tooltip_WoundsHerbalSalve.en: Plantain or comfrey in fat. Soothes a burn and helps it heal, but keeps infection out less well than the cream.
Tooltip_WoundsHerbalSalve.ch: 以油脂調製的車前草或聚合草. 能舒緩燒傷並幫助癒合, 但防止感染的效果不如燒傷藥膏.
Tooltip_WoundsHerbalSalve.cn: 用油脂调制的车前草或聚合草. 能舒缓烧伤并帮助愈合, 但防止感染的效果不如烧伤药膏.

Tooltip_AimpointPRO_reddot.ch: 堅固耐用的 Aimpoint PRO (巡邏步槍光學瞄具) 紅點瞄準鏡.
Tooltip_AimpointPRO_reddot.cn: 坚固耐用的 Aimpoint PRO (巡逻步枪光学瞄具) 红点瞄准镜.

Tooltip_VR80_HERA_stock.en: Complete HERA CQB stock assembly for the VR80. Occupies the stock adapter slot and blocks a separate stock.
Tooltip_VR80_HERA_stock.ch: 適用於 VR80 的完整 HERA CQB 槍托組件. 佔用槍托轉接器欄位, 無法再加裝獨立槍托.
Tooltip_VR80_HERA_stock.cn: 适用于 VR80 的完整 HERA CQB 枪托组件. 占用枪托转接器槽位, 无法再加装独立枪托.

Tooltip_VR80_Stockadapter.en: Install on the VR80 before adding a compatible separate stock. Remove the stock before removing this adapter.
Tooltip_VR80_Stockadapter.ch: 須先安裝在 VR80 上, 才能加裝相容的獨立槍托. 拆除此轉接器前須先拆下槍托.
Tooltip_VR80_Stockadapter.cn: 须先安装在 VR80 上, 才能加装兼容的独立枪托. 拆除此转接器前须先拆下枪托.

Tooltip_VR80_original_stock.en: Complete factory stock assembly for the VR80. Occupies the stock adapter slot and blocks a separate stock.
Tooltip_VR80_original_stock.ch: 適用於 VR80 的完整原廠槍托組件. 佔用槍托轉接器欄位, 無法再加裝獨立槍托.
Tooltip_VR80_original_stock.cn: 适用于 VR80 的完整原厂枪托组件. 占用枪托转接器槽位, 无法再加装独立枪托.

Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_ThreadedBarrel1911.en: Sticks out past the slide, threaded for a suppressor.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_ThreadedBarrel1911.ch: 伸出滑套前方, 附可安裝消音器的螺紋.
Tooltip_GS_GS45_Part_ThreadedBarrel1911.cn: 伸出套筒前方, 带可安装消音器的螺纹.

Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_Supp700.en: Screws onto the threaded muzzle. Takes .308 and .223. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_Supp700.ch: 旋裝在螺紋槍口上. 適用 .308 與 .223. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_Supp700.cn: 拧装在螺纹枪口上. 适用 .308 和 .223. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_ThreadedMuzzle700.en: The muzzle cut and threaded by a gunsmith, a cap over the threads. Takes a suppressor.
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_ThreadedMuzzle700.ch: 由槍匠切削槍口並車出螺紋, 螺紋上套有護帽. 可安裝消音器.
Tooltip_GS_GS700_Part_ThreadedMuzzle700.cn: 由枪匠切削枪口并车出螺纹, 螺纹上套着护帽. 可安装消音器.

Tooltip_GS_GSB9_Part_ThreadedBarrelB92.en: Sticks out past the slide, threaded for a suppressor.
Tooltip_GS_GSB9_Part_ThreadedBarrelB92.ch: 伸出滑套前方, 附可安裝消音器的螺紋.
Tooltip_GS_GSB9_Part_ThreadedBarrelB92.cn: 伸出套筒前方, 带可安装消音器的螺纹.

Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_ThreadedBarrelGlock.en: Sticks out past the slide, threaded for a suppressor. Fits every Glock.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_ThreadedBarrelGlock.ch: 伸出滑套前方, 附可安裝消音器的螺紋. 適用所有格洛克.
Tooltip_GS_GSGL_Part_ThreadedBarrelGlock.cn: 伸出套筒前方, 带可安装消音器的螺纹. 适用所有格洛克.

Tooltip_GS_GSM14_Part_SuppMini14.en: Clamps onto the factory flash hider. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSM14_Part_SuppMini14.ch: 夾裝在原廠消焰器上. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSM14_Part_SuppMini14.cn: 夹装在原厂消焰器上. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_SuppMP5.en: Locks onto the standard barrel's three lugs. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_SuppMP5.ch: 鎖固在標準槍管的三個凸耳上. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSMP_Part_SuppMP5.cn: 锁固在标准枪管的三个凸耳上. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BarrelTEC3.en: The Mini's short bare barrel, threaded: handier, less accurate, louder.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BarrelTEC3.ch: Mini 型的無護套短槍管, 附螺紋: 更好用, 但精準度較低, 也更吵.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BarrelTEC3.cn: Mini 型的无护套短枪管, 带螺纹: 更灵活, 但精准度更低, 也更响.

Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BarrelTEC5.en: The factory barrel inside its perforated shroud, threaded at the muzzle.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BarrelTEC5.ch: 原廠槍管裝在開孔護套內, 槍口車有螺紋.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BarrelTEC5.cn: 原厂枪管装在开孔护套内, 枪口带螺纹.

Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BrakeTEC.en: Ported tube on the threaded muzzle: less muzzle climb, more noise.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BrakeTEC.ch: 裝在螺紋槍口上的開孔套管: 減少槍口上揚, 但噪音更大.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_BrakeTEC.cn: 装在螺纹枪口上的开孔套管: 减少枪口上扬, 但噪音更大.

Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_NutTEC.en: Holds the shroud on the threaded muzzle.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_NutTEC.ch: 將護套固定在螺紋槍口上.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_NutTEC.cn: 将护套固定在螺纹枪口上.

Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_SuppTEC.en: Screws onto the threaded muzzle in place of the shroud nut. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_SuppTEC.ch: 取代護套螺帽, 旋裝在螺紋槍口上. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_GSTC_Part_SuppTEC.cn: 代替护套螺母, 拧装在螺纹枪口上. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_SuppPistol45.en: Screws onto a threaded pistol barrel. .45 ACP, .40 S&W and 10mm. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_SuppPistol45.ch: 旋裝在手槍的螺紋槍管上. 適用 .45 ACP、.40 S&W 與 10mm. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_SuppPistol45.cn: 拧装在手枪的螺纹枪管上. 适用 .45 ACP、.40 S&W 和 10mm. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_SuppPistol9.en: Screws onto a threaded pistol barrel. 9mm only. Hides flash. Quieting fades with wear. Fouling x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_SuppPistol9.ch: 旋裝在手槍的螺紋槍管上. 僅限 9mm. 遮蔽槍口焰. 消音效果隨磨損減弱. 積碳 x1.5.
Tooltip_GS_Gunsmith_Acc_SuppPistol9.cn: 拧装在手枪的螺纹枪管上. 仅限 9mm. 遮蔽枪口焰. 消音效果随磨损减弱. 积碳 x1.5.

Tooltip_Pants_TuckNotTheseBoots.en: These boots can't take tucked trousers yet.
Tooltip_Pants_TuckNotTheseBoots.ch: 這雙靴子目前還無法把褲管塞進去.
Tooltip_Pants_TuckNotTheseBoots.cn: 这双靴子暂时还不能塞入裤管.

Tooltip_LNPC_Crutch.en: Use two crutches, one in each hand. Only shoving is allowed while using crutches.
Tooltip_LNPC_Crutch.ch: 需使用兩支拐杖, 兩手各持一支. 使用拐杖時只能推擠.
Tooltip_LNPC_Crutch.cn: 需使用两根拐杖, 两手各持一根. 使用拐杖时只能推搡.

Tooltip_LNPC_ProstheticDevelopment.en: Player fitting from the amputated part in Health. Requires a closed, non-bleeding, uninfected stump. Removal returns the item.
Tooltip_LNPC_ProstheticDevelopment.ch: 玩家要從健康面板中的截肢部位裝上. 殘肢傷口須已閉合、未出血且未感染. 取下時會歸還物品.
Tooltip_LNPC_ProstheticDevelopment.cn: 玩家需在健康面板中从截肢部位装上. 残肢伤口须已闭合、未出血且未感染. 取下时会归还物品.

Tooltip_LNPC_ProstheticsManual.en: Player fitting from the amputated part in Health. Requires a closed, non-bleeding, uninfected stump. Removal returns the item.

Tooltip_LNPC_ProstheticsManual.cn: 玩家需在健康面板中从截肢部位装上. 残肢伤口须已闭合、未出血且未感染. 取下时会归还物品.

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowContext.ch: 選擇是否在右鍵選單中顯示「臥倒」選項. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[啟用]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowContext.cn: 选择是否在右键菜单中显示“卧倒”选项. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[启用]

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.en: Choose if you want to see the posture hud. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[Enabled]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.ch: 選擇是否顯示姿勢HUD. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[啟用]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.cn: 选择是否显示姿势HUD. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[启用]

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.en: A higher value will increase the Hud transparency. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.ch: 數值越高, HUD的透明度越高. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%%]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.cn: 数值越高, HUD的透明度越高. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%%]

UI_ForgedByCombat_Tooltip_NextLevel.ch: 下一級: %1 次擊殺 (還差%2)
UI_ForgedByCombat_Tooltip_NextLevel.cn: 下一级: %1 次击杀 (还差%2)

UI_ForgedByCombat_description.en: Fighting skill honed through melee combat. Each zombie killed sharpens your instincts and improves your attack speed, damage, and critical chance.
UI_ForgedByCombat_description.ch: 透過近身搏鬥磨練戰鬥技巧. 每消滅一個殭屍都會提升你的直覺, 提高攻速, 傷害和暴擊率
UI_ForgedByCombat_description.cn: 通过近身搏斗磨练战斗技巧. 每消灭一个僵尸都会提升你的直觉, 提高攻速, 伤害和暴击率

UI_gain_smoker.en: I'm really craving a cigarette right about now...
UI_gain_smoker.ch: 我現在真的很想來根菸…
UI_gain_smoker.cn: 我现在真的很想来根烟…

UI_lost_stoner.en: Been a while since I last smoked some weed...

UI_regain_smoker.en: I feel like having a cigarette...

UI_speech_seed1.en: Do I see a seed in this bud?
UI_speech_seed1.ch: 這朵花蕾裡是不是有顆種子?
UI_speech_seed1.cn: 这朵花蕾里是不是有颗种子?

UI_trait_stonerdesc.en: Does not get sleepy or hungry from smoking pot, but needs more for the same effect.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.ch: 抽大麻不會想睡也不會餓, 但要抽更多才能達到同樣效果.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.cn: 抽大麻不会想睡也不会饿, 但要抽更多才能达到同样效果.

UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.en: You were hooked up on benzos before the apocalypse.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.ch: 末日之前你就對苯二氮平類藥物成癮了.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.cn: 末日之前你就对苯二氮䓬类药物成瘾了.

UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.en: You had brain damaged. Focusing is now harder.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.ch: 你的大腦受過損傷. 現在更難集中注意力.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.cn: 你的大脑受过损伤. 现在更难集中注意力.

UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.en: You are interested in drugs and made a little too much researches.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.ch: 你對毒品很感興趣, 而且研究得有點過頭.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.cn: 你对毒品很感兴趣, 而且研究得有点过头.

UI_KD_Huffer_desc.en: You like to sniff things that shouldn't be...
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.ch: 你喜歡吸一些本來不該吸的東西…
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.cn: 你喜欢吸一些本来不该吸的东西…

UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.en: You took the habit of consumming low stimulant a little too much...
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.ch: 你養成了服用輕度興奮劑的習慣, 而且用得有點多…
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.cn: 你养成了服用轻度兴奋剂的习惯, 而且用得有点多…

UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.en: Idk how but you're addicted to raw opium
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.ch: 不知怎麼的, 你對生鴉片上癮了
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.cn: 不知怎么的, 你对生鸦片上瘾了

UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.ch: 你已離不開甲基安非他命.
UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.cn: 你已离不开甲基苯丙胺.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.en: It feels your fear, and hates it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.ch: 它感受到你的恐懼, 並為此憎惡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.cn: 它感受到你的恐惧, 并为此憎恶.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.en: Just a tool. Nothing has marked it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.ch: 不過是件工具. 還沒有任何事物在它身上留下痕跡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.cn: 不过是件工具. 还没有任何事物在它身上留下痕迹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.en: Rain and red run together. Nothing sticks.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.ch: 雨水與血色一同流下. 什麼也沾不住.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.cn: 雨水与血色一同流下. 什么也沾不住.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.en: Late and still. It dreams of edges it has met.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.ch: 夜深而靜. 它夢見自己交手過的每一道鋒刃.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.cn: 夜深而静. 它梦见自己交手过的每一道锋刃.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.en: It won't come clean. It doesn't try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.ch: 它擦不乾淨. 它也不打算擦.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.cn: 它擦不干净. 它也不打算擦.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.en: Idle and indoors. It dozes against your side.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.ch: 閒置於室內. 它靠在你身側打盹.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.cn: 闲置于室内. 它靠在你身侧打盹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.en: Blooded in the dark. It pulls toward the next one.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中飲過血. 它拉扯著奔向下一個.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中饮过血. 它拉扯着奔向下一个.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.en: Your dread strikes a spark in it, then nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.ch: 你的恐懼在它體內擦出一星火花, 隨即歸於虛無.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.cn: 你的恐惧在它体内擦出一星火花, 随即归于虚无.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.en: The light goes. It feels the long dark coming on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.ch: 天光將盡. 它感覺到漫長的黑暗正在逼近.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.cn: 天光将尽. 它感觉到漫长的黑暗正在逼近.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.en: Slick to the grip and full — and hungry anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.ch: 握柄濕滑, 已然飽足——卻依舊飢渴.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.cn: 握柄湿滑, 已然饱足——却依旧饥渴.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.en: Grey at the edges — you've lasted the night. It eases.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.ch: 天邊泛起灰白——你熬過了這一夜. 它鬆弛下來.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.cn: 天边泛起灰白——你熬过了这一夜. 它松弛下来.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.en: Quiet warmth in the daylight. Content, briefly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.ch: 日光下靜靜地溫著. 短暫地心滿意足.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.cn: 日光下静静地温着. 短暂地心满意足.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.en: Half-fed in the dark, casting for more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中半飽, 仍四處搜尋著下一口.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中半饱, 仍四处搜寻着下一口.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.en: No voice in it — only the weight of the dead.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.ch: 它體內沒有聲音——只有亡者的重量.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.cn: 它体内没有声音——只有亡者的重量.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.en: Quiet — but it counts the dead it has made.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.ch: 靜默——但它清點著自己造就的亡者.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.cn: 静默——但它清点着自己造就的亡者.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.en: It won't settle. It paces in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.ch: 它靜不下來. 在你手中來回踱步.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.cn: 它静不下来. 在你手中来回踱步.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.en: The rain takes the blood. It lets go, for now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.ch: 雨水帶走血跡. 它暫時鬆手了.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.cn: 雨水带走血迹. 它暂时松手了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.en: Awake to the work now. It wants the rhythm to hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.ch: 它已為這場活計醒來. 它想讓這節奏持續下去.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.cn: 它已为这场活计醒来. 它想让这节奏持续下去.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.en: Clean and sheltered, it forgets what it saw.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.ch: 潔淨而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看過什麼.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.cn: 洁净而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看过什么.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.en: It rings between every blow. It does not want to stop.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.ch: 每一擊之間它都在鳴響. 它不想停下.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.cn: 每一击之间它都在鸣响. 它不想停下.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.en: Resting. Patient. It has all the time there is.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.ch: 歇息. 耐心. 它擁有世上全部的時間.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.cn: 歇息. 耐心. 它拥有世上全部的时间.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.en: Heavier than it was. It blames your tired arm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.ch: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲憊的手臂.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.cn: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲惫的手臂.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.en: Clean under a dead sky. It wants that to change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.ch: 在死寂的天空下潔淨無染. 它想改變這一點.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.cn: 在死寂的天空下洁净无染. 它想改变这一点.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.en: Too much death, too fast — it shudders to keep up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.ch: 死亡太多, 太快——它顫抖著才勉強跟上.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.cn: 死亡太多, 太快——它颤抖着才勉强跟上.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.en: The dark leans in. It almost understands why.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.ch: 黑暗傾身逼近. 它幾乎明白了緣由.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.cn: 黑暗倾身逼近. 它几乎明白了缘由.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.en: The blood leaves a warmth it can't name.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.ch: 血留下一種它無法名狀的溫熱.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.cn: 血留下一种它无法名状的温热.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.en: Awake in the dark, listening with you.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中醒著, 與你一同傾聽.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中醒着, 与你一同倾听.

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL.en: Double-click food eats the whole item

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.en: When enabled, double-clicking food uses the vanilla behavior and eats the whole item instead of smart partial eating.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.ch: 啟用後, 雙擊食物將採用原版行為, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智慧分次進食.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.cn: 启用后, 双击食物将采用原版行为, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智能分次进食.

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 搜尋: 忽略附帶種子
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 搜寻: 忽略附带种子

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.en: Singleplayer: controlled only by Mod Options and overrides Sandbox. Multiplayer: controlled by the server Sandbox setting. When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 單人遊戲: 僅由模組選項控制, 並覆寫沙盒設定. 多人遊戲: 由伺服器沙盒設定控制. 啟用後, 搜尋找到的野生作物仍會給予食物物品, 但自動產生的額外種子物品會被忽略.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 单人游戏: 仅由模组选项控制, 并覆盖沙盒设置. 多人游戏: 由服务器沙盒设置控制. 启用后, 搜寻找到的野生作物仍会给予食物物品, 但自动产生的额外种子物品会被忽略.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.en: Reload cleanup options are mutually exclusive: enable either dropping leftovers or deleting leftovers, never both. Deleting permanently removes the leftover item from your inventory.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.ch: 裝填清理選項互斥: 丟棄殘件與刪除殘件只能擇一啟用, 不可同時開啟. 刪除會將殘件從你的物品欄中永久移除.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.cn: 装填清理选项互斥: 丢弃残件与删除残件只能择一启用, 不可同时开启. 删除会将残件从你的物品栏中永久移除.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 裝填鍵: 刪除損壞殘件
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 装填键: 删除损坏残件

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.en: Optional cleanup. Whenever a melee reload is executed by quick reload or by selecting a weapon from the hold-reload radial menu, broken melee leftovers are permanently deleted from the main inventory. This removes the leftover item from your inventory and cannot be used together with Drop Broken Leftovers.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 選用的清理功能. 每當透過快速裝填, 或從按住裝填鍵開啟的環形選單中選擇武器而執行近戰裝填時, 損壞的近戰殘件會從主物品欄中永久刪除. 此選項會將殘件從你的物品欄移除, 且不可與「丟棄損壞殘件」同時使用.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 可选的清理功能. 每当通过快速装填, 或从按住装填键打开的环形菜单中选择武器而执行近战装填时, 损坏的近战残件会从主物品栏中永久删除. 此选项会将残件从你的物品栏移除, 且不可与“丢弃损坏残件”同时使用.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.en: When enabled, combat-stance movement speed uses the selected Nimble limit only if your real Nimble level is higher. XP is not reduced.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.ch: 啟用後, 只有在你實際的靈活等級高於所選上限時, 戰鬥姿態的移動速度才會套用該上限. 經驗值不會減少.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.cn: 启用后, 只有在你实际的灵活等级高于所选上限时, 战斗姿态的移动速度才会应用该上限. 经验值不会减少.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.en: Sets the maximum effective Nimble level for combat-stance movement speed. If your real Nimble level is equal or lower, nothing is changed.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.ch: 設定戰鬥姿態移動速度所採用的靈活等級上限. 若你實際的靈活等級等於或低於此值, 則不會有任何變化.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.cn: 设定战斗姿态移动速度所采用的灵活等级上限. 若你实际的灵活等级等于或低于此值, 则不会有任何变化.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.en: Double-click traps to add best bait
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.ch: 雙擊陷阱自動放入最佳誘餌
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.cn: 双击陷阱自动放入最佳诱饵

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.en: Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.ch: 雙擊空陷阱時, 自動從你的物品欄取用最佳的新鮮誘餌. 若該陷阱能捕捉兔子, 會優先使用兔子誘餌.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.cn: 双击空陷阱时, 自动从你的物品栏取用最佳的新鲜诱饵. 若该陷阱能捕捉兔子, 会优先使用兔子诱饵.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.en: After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.ch: 放置陷阱後, 若物品欄中仍有同類型陷阱, 會自動接著放置下一個.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.cn: 放置陷阱后, 若物品栏中仍有同类型陷阱, 会自动接着放置下一个.

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.en: Color trap highlight by bait state
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.ch: 依誘餌狀態顯示陷阱高亮顏色

UI_trait_slowpoke._note: issue #125：MoreTraits - Dynamic 的 MoreTraits - Dynamic.lua:284（有效分支 42.17，該檔無任何 Lua 長註解，確認為活程式碼）在移除 gimp 特質時以 getText("UI_trait_slowpoke") 顯示 halo 文字，但該鍵未定義於任何檔、任何語言。上游 EN 的 UI_trait_gimp 即為 "Slowpoke"，可判定作者誤植鍵名，故值與 UI_trait_gimp 一致（磨磨蹭蹭），非自行造詞。【同批已撤】UI_trait_lightdrink/harddrink(+desc) 曾一併登記，後查出唯一 producer MoreTraitsMainCreationMethods.lua:413-414 位於該檔第 1 行 --[[ 至第 426 行 --]] 的整檔註解內、永不執行，且 ToadTraits.txt 未以 character_trait_definition 補回，屬死鍵故移除。教訓：以 regex 掃 getText( 判定活引用時必須先排除 Lua 註解區塊。
