UI_CHLyra_Bubble_Intro.en:
Careful with the cards you clutch so tightly. Some of their threads run deeper than this crypt, down past the bedrock, into a place the church stopped naming.

She listens there. She likes curious hands.
UI_CHLyra_Bubble_Intro.ch:
小心你緊緊攥著的那些卡牌. 有些卡牌的絲線延伸得比這座墓穴更深, 穿過基岩, 通往一個教會不再提起名字的地方.

她在那裡聆聽. 她喜歡好奇的手.
UI_CHLyra_Bubble_Intro.cn:
小心你紧紧攥着的那些卡牌. 有些卡牌的丝线延伸得比这座墓穴更深, 穿过基岩, 通往一个教会不再提起名字的地方.

她在那里聆听. 她喜欢好奇的手.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_CallasFamily.en:
In the records, the Callas look immaculate: the family appointed to stand between the church and the place below, after the first archivist - the one they bound down there - the one that had to be contained.

The wards beneath don't listen to prayers. They listen to blood. Callas blood opens doors other people can only die in front of.

So the church called it duty. Privilege. Legacy.

She reads it differently. To her, the Callas line has always been a promise: that where the margins of her own bloodline bled into theirs, a Callas girl would be born more key than child - ink and Callas blood braided into a vessel made to fit the one below.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_CallasFamily.ch:
在紀錄中, 卡拉斯家族看似無可挑剔: 他們受命守在教會與下方之地之間, 這是在第一位檔案管理者之後的事——那個被他們封印在下面的人——那個必須被囚禁的人.

下方的結界不聽禱告. 它們只聽血脈. 卡拉斯的血能開啟那些旁人只能死在門前的門.

所以教會稱之為職責. 特權. 傳承.

她卻有不同的解讀. 對她而言, 卡拉斯血脈一直是一個承諾: 在她自身血脈的邊緣滲入他們血脈的地方, 終將誕生一個卡拉斯家的女孩, 與其說是孩子, 不如說是一把鑰匙——墨水與卡拉斯之血交織成的容器, 為契合下方那位而生.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_CallasFamily.cn:
在记录中, 卡拉斯家族看似无可挑剔: 他们受命守在教会与下方之地之间, 这是在第一位档案管理者之后的事——那个被他们封印在下面的人——那个必须被囚禁的人.

下方的结界不听祷告. 它们只听血脉. 卡拉斯的血能打开那些旁人只能死在门前的门.

所以教会称之为职责. 特权. 传承.

她却有不同的解读. 对她而言, 卡拉斯血脉一直是一个承诺: 在她自身血脉的边缘渗入他们血脉的地方, 终将诞生一个卡拉斯家的女孩, 与其说是孩子, 不如说是一把钥匙——墨水与卡拉斯之血交织成的容器, 为契合下方那位而生.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_Default.en:
Careful with the cards you clutch so tightly. Some of their threads run deeper than this crypt, down past the bedrock, into a place the church stopped naming.

She listens there. She likes curious hands.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_Default.ch:
小心你緊緊攥著的那些卡牌. 有些卡牌的絲線延伸得比這座墓穴更深, 穿過基岩, 通往一個教會不再提起名字的地方.

她在那裡聆聽. 她喜歡好奇的手.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_Default.cn:
小心你紧紧攥着的那些卡牌. 有些卡牌的丝线延伸得比这座墓穴更深, 穿过基岩, 通往一个教会不再提起名字的地方.

她在那里聆听. 她喜欢好奇的手.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UndyingOnes.en:
You call them undying.

I see bodies whose stories were cut wrong and stitched back by a will that refuses endings.

Some of what's wrong here is older than that. Those people died the way people are meant to.

Flesh to soil, breath to silence. It's their souls that never made it out - thin, stubborn echoes pinned here, because this estate and the place below drink from the same poisoned vein.

The others are different. They went down into the place below and left too much of themselves within her reach.

What crawled back up wears their meat, but there isn't a story inside anymore... just hunger, hanging off a borrowed thread.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UndyingOnes.ch:
你們稱他們為不死者.

我看到的, 是一具具故事被剪錯, 又被一股拒絕終結的意志重新縫合的軀體.

這裡有些不對勁的東西比那還要古老. 那些人以人本該有的方式死去.

肉身歸於泥土, 氣息歸於寂靜. 是他們的靈魂從未離開——稀薄而執拗的回響被釘在這裡, 因為這座莊園與下方之地吸取著同一條有毒的血脈.

其他的則不同. 他們走進了下方之地, 把太多的自己留在了她觸手可及之處.

那些爬回來的東西穿著他們的血肉, 但裡面已經不再有故事了…只剩下飢餓, 懸掛在一根借來的絲線上.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UndyingOnes.cn:
你们称他们为不死者.

我看到的, 是一具具故事被剪错, 又被一股拒绝终结的意志重新缝合的躯体.

这里有些不对劲的东西比那还要古老. 那些人以人本该有的方式死去.

肉身归于泥土, 气息归于寂静. 是他们的灵魂从未离开——稀薄而执拗的回响被钉在这里, 因为这座庄园与下方之地吸取着同一条有毒的血脉.

其他的则不同. 他们走进了下方之地, 把太多的自己留在了她触手可及之处.

那些爬回来的东西穿着他们的血肉, 但里面已经不再有故事了…只剩下饥饿, 悬挂在一根借来的丝线上.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UnspoiledGraceAccepte.en:
Then we ask water to remember what it was before it learned to bargain.

Find the vial Marlowe kept. Untouched grace can rinse noise from a vision without teaching it to bite back.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UnspoiledGraceAccepte.ch:
那我們就請水記起它在學會討價還價之前是什麼模樣.

去找馬洛收著的那個藥劑瓶. 未受玷汙的恩典能洗去幻象中的雜訊, 又不會讓它學會反咬一口.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UnspoiledGraceAccepte.cn:
那我们就请水记起它在学会讨价还价之前是什么模样.

去找马洛保存的那个药剂瓶. 未受玷污的恩典能洗去幻象中的噪声, 又不会让它学会反咬一口.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UnspoiledGraceTurnedI.en:
There. The thread finds its pattern again.

The static recedes, and the image of the Sanctum begins to gather back into shape. You did well.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UnspoiledGraceTurnedI.ch:
好了. 絲線再次找到了它的紋路.

雜訊漸漸退去, 聖所的影像開始重新凝聚成形. 你做得很好.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_UnspoiledGraceTurnedI.cn:
好了. 丝线再次找到了它的纹路.

噪声渐渐退去, 圣所的影像开始重新凝聚成形. 你做得很好.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhatAreTheseCards.en:
On the surface?

Just pictures, numbers, promises. Underneath, they're pages torn from lives that already happened - memories that slipped the binding.

Each card is an echo of a story you never got to live. When you hand me a set, I press that story into one shape and give it a body again.

You call it an item.
I call it... closure.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhatAreTheseCards.ch:
表面上?

不過是圖畫, 數字, 承諾. 但在底下, 它們是從已經發生過的人生中撕下的書頁——從裝訂中滑脫的記憶.

每張卡牌都是一個你從未有機會經歷的故事的回響. 當你交給我一整套, 我就把那個故事壓成一個形體, 再次賦予它軀殼.

你稱之為物品.
我稱之為…了結.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhatAreTheseCards.cn:
表面上?

不过是图画, 数字, 承诺. 但在底下, 它们是从已经发生过的人生中撕下的书页——从装订中滑脱的记忆.

每张卡牌都是一个你从未有机会经历的故事的回响. 当你交给我一整套, 我就把那个故事压成一个形体, 再次赋予它躯壳.

你称之为物品.
我称之为…了结.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhereFindCards.en:
Anywhere the place below brushes against the surface.

They cling to things that kept moving after their story should have stopped, and to those who walked too far into the wrong corridors and didn't come back whole.

If a road feels like it's straying toward the depths, watch what falls there.

The cards are drawn to that kind of ruin.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhereFindCards.ch:
任何下方之地觸及地表的地方.

它們依附在那些故事早該結束卻仍持續移動的東西上, 也依附在那些在錯誤的走廊中走得太遠, 回來時已不再完整的人身上.

如果一條路感覺正偏向深處, 留意那裡掉落的東西.

卡牌會被那種毀滅所吸引.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhereFindCards.cn:
任何下方之地触及地表的地方.

它们依附在那些故事早该结束却仍持续移动的东西上, 也依附在那些在错误的走廊中走得太远, 回来时已不再完整的人身上.

如果一条路感觉正偏向深处, 留意那里掉落的东西.

卡牌会被那种毁灭所吸引.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.en:
Who am I...?

That depends which one of you is asking.

Up here they write it as Lyra, Weaver of Threads. Sounds tidy, doesn't it?

As if any of this was done on purpose.

I listen to the loose strands that got caught in your cards - the bits of you that almost were, or were once already.

I give them something solid to become, and you walk away thinking it was just a trade.

As for who I was before...

She remembers better than I do.

The one below.

I try not to use her name; it has a habit of answering back.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.ch:
我是誰…?

那要看你們之中是哪一個在問.

在上面這裡, 他們寫作萊拉, 絲線編織者. 聽起來很工整, 不是嗎?

彷彿這一切都是刻意為之.

我聆聽那些纏在你卡牌裡的鬆散絲縷——那些差點成為你, 或曾經就是你的碎片.

我給它們一個可以化為實體的東西, 而你離開時還以為這只是一場交易.

至於我以前是誰…

她記得比我清楚.

下方的那位.

我盡量不說出她的名字; 它有回應的習慣.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.cn:
我是谁…?

那要看你们之中是哪一个在问.

在上面这里, 他们写作莱拉, 丝线编织者. 听起来很工整, 不是吗?

仿佛这一切都是刻意为之.

我聆听那些缠在你卡牌里的松散丝缕——那些差点成为你, 或曾经就是你的碎片.

我给它们一个可以化为实体的东西, 而你离开时还以为这只是一场交易.

至于我以前是谁…

她记得比我清楚.

下方的那位.

我尽量不说出她的名字; 它有回应的习惯.

UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhoIsShe.en:
She was the one who filed other people's truths into neat little rows. An archivist, breathing dust and ink, lingering in the forbidden margins no one was meant to read.

Then the words stopped lying still for her. They slipped off the page, wound themselves around her thoughts... and a few important stitches came loose.

The church called it heresy. The place below called it an opening.

Now she's more pull than person - a will moving along the deeper threads, looking for a loose one like yours to tug.

I don't use her name. Names are doorhandles, and she's very good at turning them.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhoIsShe.ch:
她曾是把別人的真相整齊歸檔成一列列的人. 一名檔案管理員, 呼吸著灰塵與墨水, 流連於那些無人該讀的禁忌頁邊.

後來, 那些文字不再安分地躺著. 它們從紙頁上滑落, 纏繞住她的思緒… 而幾處重要的縫線就此鬆脫.

教會稱之為異端. 下方的那個地方稱之為一道開口.

如今她與其說是人, 不如說是一股牽引——一股沿著更深處絲線移動的意志, 尋找像你這樣鬆脫的線頭來拉扯.

我不提她的名字. 名字就是門把, 而她非常擅長轉動它們.
UI_CHLyra_Dialogue_WhoIsShe.cn:
她曾是把别人的真相整齐归档成一列列的人. 一名档案管理员, 呼吸着灰尘与墨水, 流连于那些无人该读的禁忌页边.

后来, 那些文字不再安分地躺着. 它们从纸页上滑落, 缠绕住她的思绪… 而几处重要的缝线就此松脱.

教会称之为异端. 下方的那个地方称之为一道开口.

如今她与其说是人, 不如说是一股牵引——一股沿着更深处丝线移动的意志, 寻找像你这样松脱的线头来拉扯.

我不提她的名字. 名字就是门把手, 而她非常擅长转动它们.

UI_CHLyra_DivinationUnavailableSay.en: Lyra's transmutation is not available right now.
UI_CHLyra_DivinationUnavailableSay.ch: 萊拉的轉化目前無法使用.
UI_CHLyra_DivinationUnavailableSay.cn: 莱拉的转化目前无法使用.

UI_CHMarlowe_DialogueOption_WhatDeals.en: What kind of deals does it offer?

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_AreYouControllingI.en:
Controlling it? Good heavens, no.

I simply understand its manners better than most.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_AreYouControllingI.ch:
控制它? 老天, 當然不是.

我只是比大多數人更懂它的脾性罷了.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_AreYouControllingI.cn:
控制它? 老天, 当然不是.

我只是比大多数人更懂它的脾性罢了.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_AreYouControllingI.en: My dear friend, everyone uses something. Tools, faith, fear, other people. I am merely more polite about it.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_AreYouControllingI.ch: 我親愛的朋友, 每個人都在利用某些東西. 工具, 信仰, 恐懼, 他人. 我只是比較有禮貌而已.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_AreYouControllingI.cn: 我亲爱的朋友, 每个人都在利用某些东西. 工具, 信仰, 恐惧, 他人. 我只是比较有礼貌而已.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_ChooseYourFateAcce.en:
Excellent. The fountain is waiting, and it adores decisive customers.

Take one bargain. Any one. Return when the water has marked the transaction, and I will release the vial.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_ChooseYourFateAcce.ch:
好極了. 泉水正等著呢, 而且它最愛果斷的顧客.

接受一項交易. 任何一項都行. 等泉水為這筆交易留下印記後再回來, 我就會交出那瓶藥劑.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_ChooseYourFateAcce.cn:
好极了. 泉水正等着呢, 而且它最爱果断的顾客.

接受一项交易. 任何一项都行. 等泉水为这笔交易留下印记后再回来, 我就会交出那瓶药剂.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_ChooseYourFateTurn.en:
There we are. Paid in consequence, sealed by the fountain, witnessed by a man of impeccable bookkeeping.

Take the vial to Lyra. And do try to remember who kept it safe all these years.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_ChooseYourFateTurn.ch:
這就對了. 以代價支付, 由泉水封印, 並由一位帳目無可挑剔的紳士見證.

把藥劑瓶交給萊拉. 也請記得這些年來是誰替它妥善保管的.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_ChooseYourFateTurn.cn:
这就对了. 以代价支付, 由泉水封印, 并由一位账目无可挑剔的绅士见证.

把药剂瓶交给莱拉. 也请记得这些年来是谁替它妥善保管的.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_Default.en:
Ah, a customer. Or a pilgrim. Hard to tell these days.

Either way, welcome.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_Default.ch:
啊, 一位顧客. 或是一位朝聖者. 這年頭很難分辨.

無論如何, 歡迎.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_Default.cn:
啊, 一位顾客. 或是一位朝圣者. 这年头很难分辨.

无论如何, 欢迎.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting1.en: Back again? Wonderful. I was beginning to worry you had developed caution.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting1.ch: 又回來了? 太好了. 我還開始擔心你學會謹慎了呢.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting1.cn: 又回来了? 太好了. 我还开始担心你学会谨慎了呢.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting2.en: Come to bargain, or merely to stare at the consequences?
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting2.ch: 是來交易的, 還是只是來盯著後果看?
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting2.cn: 是来交易的, 还是只是来盯着后果看?

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting3.en: Careful near the water. It has a talent for overhearing desire.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting3.ch: 靠近水邊時小心點. 它特別擅長偷聽慾望.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting3.cn: 靠近水边时小心点. 它特别擅长偷听欲望.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting4.en: Ah. My favorite kind of visitor. Alive, curious, and not yet sufficiently warned.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting4.ch: 啊. 我最喜歡的那種訪客. 活著, 好奇, 而且還沒被充分警告過.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_RepeatGreeting4.cn: 啊. 我最喜欢的那种访客. 活着, 好奇, 而且还没被充分警告过.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatDeals.en:
Useful ones. Dangerous ones. The sort people swear they would never accept, until they need them badly enough.

Strength for frailty. Fortune for hunger. Clarity for something you may miss only after it is gone.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatDeals.ch:
有用的. 危險的. 那種人們發誓絕不會接受, 直到迫切需要時才會接受的.

以虛弱換取力量. 以飢餓換取財富. 以某樣你或許要等失去後才會懷念的東西換取清明.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatDeals.cn:
有用的. 危险的. 那种人们发誓绝不会接受, 直到迫切需要时才会接受的.

以虚弱换取力量. 以饥饿换取财富. 以某样你或许要等失去后才会怀念的东西换取清明.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatDeals_Response.en: Most bargains do, when described honestly.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatDeals_Response.ch: 照實描述的話, 大多數交易聽起來都是這樣.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatDeals_Response.cn: 照实描述的话, 大多数交易听起来都是这样.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatIsFountain.en:
Once? A holy little thing, I am told. Graceful, generous, terribly inefficient.

Now? It has matured.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatIsFountain.ch:
從前? 據說是個神聖的小東西. 優雅, 慷慨, 效率差得可怕.

現在? 它成熟了.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatIsFountain.cn:
从前? 据说是个神圣的小东西. 优雅, 慷慨, 效率差得可怕.

现在? 它成熟了.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatIsFountain_Res.en: A blessing for a consequence. That is how the fountain speaks now.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatIsFountain_Res.ch: 一份祝福, 換一份代價. 如今泉水就是這樣說話的.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhatIsFountain_Res.cn: 一份祝福, 换一份代价. 如今泉水就是这样说话的.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.en: <accent>Marlowe Veyne</accent>. Collector of rare opportunities, negotiator of regrettable wishes, and, on better days, a perfectly respectable gentleman.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.ch: <accent>馬洛·韋恩</accent>. 稀有機會的收藏家, 令人遺憾之願望的談判者, 而在狀況好的日子裡, 是一位完全體面的紳士.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.cn: <accent>马洛·韦恩</accent>. 稀有机会的收藏家, 令人遗憾之愿望的谈判者, 而在状况好的日子里, 是一位完全体面的绅士.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhoAreYou_Response.en: Charlatan is such an ugly word. I prefer... <accent>specialist in selective truths</accent>.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhoAreYou_Response.ch: 騙子這個詞太難聽了. 我比較喜歡… <accent>選擇性真相專家</accent>.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhoAreYou_Response.cn: 骗子这个词太难听了. 我比较喜欢… <accent>选择性真相专家</accent>.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.en:
Because this is where people come when prayer has failed, coin has failed, and good sense has failed most of all.

And because the fountain and I have an understanding.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.ch:
因為當祈禱失敗, 金錢失敗, 而理智失敗得最徹底時, 人們就會來到這裡.

也因為泉水和我之間有某種默契.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.cn:
因为当祈祷失败, 金钱失败, 而理智失败得最彻底时, 人们就会来到这里.

也因为泉水和我之间有某种默契.

UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhyOutHere_Respons.en: I bring it the desperate. It reminds them that nothing worth having arrives cleanly.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhyOutHere_Respons.ch: 我替它帶來走投無路的人. 它則提醒他們, 值得擁有的東西從不會乾乾淨淨地到來.
UI_CHMarlowe_Dialogue_WhyOutHere_Respons.cn: 我替它带来走投无路的人. 它则提醒他们, 值得拥有的东西从不会干干净净地到来.

UI_CHMarlowe_PlayerResponse_Charlatan.en: That sounds like a lot of words for charlatan.
UI_CHMarlowe_PlayerResponse_Charlatan.ch: 說了這麼多, 不就是騙子嘛.
UI_CHMarlowe_PlayerResponse_Charlatan.cn: 说了这么多, 不就是骗子嘛.

UI_CHMelora_Bubble_Intro.en:
Cynthia, if Mr. Klaus sees you out late again... oh.

You're someone else. Forgive me.

The water keeps returning the wrong reflections.
UI_CHMelora_Bubble_Intro.ch:
辛西婭, 要是克勞斯先生又看到妳這麼晚還在外面… 噢.

你是別人. 請原諒我.

這水總是映出錯誤的倒影.
UI_CHMelora_Bubble_Intro.cn:
辛西娅, 要是克劳斯先生又看到你这么晚还在外面… 噢.

你是别人. 请原谅我.

这水总是映出错误的倒影.

UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_Default.en:
Cynthia, if Mr. Klaus sees you out late again... oh.

You're someone else. Forgive me.

The water keeps returning the wrong reflections.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_Default.ch:
辛西婭, 要是克勞斯先生又看到妳這麼晚還在外面… 噢.

你是別人. 請原諒我.

這水總是映出錯誤的倒影.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_Default.cn:
辛西娅, 要是克劳斯先生又看到你这么晚还在外面… 噢.

你是别人. 请原谅我.

这水总是映出错误的倒影.

UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_DoYouNeedHelp.en:
No... no, I'm fine.

I have everything I need.

But... if you do see Julian, tell him I'll be waiting.

Just a little longer.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_DoYouNeedHelp.ch:
不… 不, 我很好.

我需要的都有了.

不過… 如果你見到朱利安, 告訴他我會等他.

再等一會兒就好.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_DoYouNeedHelp.cn:
不… 不, 我很好.

我需要的都有了.

不过… 如果你见到朱利安, 告诉他我会等他.

再等一会儿就好.

UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_NeverMind.en:
Of course.

The water's better company, anyway.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_NeverMind.ch:
當然.

反正水是更好的陪伴.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_NeverMind.cn:
当然.

反正水是更好的陪伴.

UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.en:
The name is Melora.

I work the kitchens.

Sometimes I help with the little ones when the mistress isn't looking.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.ch:
我叫梅洛拉.

我在廚房做事.

有時趁女主人不注意, 我會幫忙照顧小傢伙們.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.cn:
我叫梅洛拉.

我在厨房做事.

有时趁女主人不注意, 我会帮忙照顾小家伙们.

UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.en:
Oh, I like it here.

It's quiet.

The water listens better than people do.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.ch:
噢, 我喜歡這裡.

很安靜.

水比人更懂得傾聽.
UI_CHMelora_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.cn:
噢, 我喜欢这里.

很安静.

水比人更懂得倾听.

UI_CHMothersCrypt_FoundSomethingInCoffin.en: I found something in the coffin!
UI_CHMothersCrypt_FoundSomethingInCoffin.ch: 我在棺材裡找到了東西!
UI_CHMothersCrypt_FoundSomethingInCoffin.cn: 我在棺材里找到了东西!

UI_CHQuestLog_a_bell_in_the_ruins_DescRi.en:
You woke with the sound of a bell in your head.
In the dream, you saw a ruined church beneath a dead sky. Its doors stood open.
Below the floorboards, candlelight flickered.
You do not know why it matters.
But a church may still mean shelter, supplies, or answers.
UI_CHQuestLog_a_bell_in_the_ruins_DescRi.ch:
你醒來時, 腦中迴盪著鈴聲.
在夢中, 你看見一座死寂天空下的殘破教堂. 它的大門敞開著.
地板下方, 燭光搖曳.
你不知道這為何重要.
但教堂或許仍意味著庇護, 物資, 或是答案.
UI_CHQuestLog_a_bell_in_the_ruins_DescRi.cn:
你醒来时, 脑中回荡着铃声.
在梦中, 你看见一座死寂天空下的残破教堂. 它的大门敞开着.
地板下方, 烛光摇曳.
你不知道这为何重要.
但教堂或许仍意味着庇护, 物资, 或是答案.

UI_CHQuestLog_choose_your_fate_DescRich.en: Marlowe has the Vial of Unspoiled Grace, and no intention of releasing it for something as cheap as gratitude. He calls the fountain honest: one blessing, one consequence, every miracle properly accounted for. Accept one bargain from the fountain, then return to Marlowe and collect the vial.
UI_CHQuestLog_choose_your_fate_DescRich.ch: 馬洛持有純淨恩典藥劑瓶, 卻完全不打算為了感激這種廉價的東西交出它. 他說泉水很誠實: 一份祝福, 一份代價, 每個奇蹟都記得清清楚楚. 從泉水那裡接受一項交易, 然後回到馬洛身邊領取藥劑瓶.
UI_CHQuestLog_choose_your_fate_DescRich.cn: 马洛持有纯净恩典药剂瓶, 却完全不打算为了感激这种廉价的东西交出它. 他说泉水很诚实: 一份祝福, 一份代价, 每个奇迹都记得清清楚楚. 从泉水那里接受一项交易, 然后回到马洛身边领取药剂瓶.

UI_CHQuestLog_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_D.en: Lyra's visions of the Sanctum are drowning in corrupted divine noise. The fountain's current waters would only turn memory into a bargain. Marlowe holds a Vial of Unspoiled Grace, drawn before the curse. Find him by the courtyard fountain behind Callas Manor and recover it.
UI_CHQuestLog_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_D.ch: 萊拉對聖所的幻視正被腐化的神聖雜音淹沒. 泉水如今的水只會把記憶變成一場交易. 馬洛持有在詛咒降臨前汲取的純淨恩典藥劑瓶. 到卡拉斯莊園後方庭院的泉水旁找到他, 把它取回.
UI_CHQuestLog_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_D.cn: 莱拉对圣所的幻视正被腐化的神圣杂音淹没. 泉水如今的水只会把记忆变成一场交易. 马洛持有在诅咒降临前汲取的纯净恩典药剂瓶. 到卡拉斯庄园后方庭院的泉水旁找到他, 把它取回.

UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_relic_altar_DescR.en:
Serevine returns the Sanctified Bell to you,
not as a trophy, but with a purpose.
She believes the altar in the chamber beside her was made to receive relics such as this, allowing their sacred influence to endure while bound within it.
Place the Sanctified Bell into the relic altar, then return to Serevine.
UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_relic_altar_DescR.ch:
塞雷維恩將聖化聖鈴交還給你,
不是作為戰利品, 而是另有用意.
她相信她身旁那間密室裡的祭壇正是為了接納這類聖物而造, 讓它們在封存其中時, 神聖的影響力得以延續.
將聖化聖鈴放入聖物祭壇, 然後回到塞雷維恩身邊.
UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_relic_altar_DescR.cn:
塞雷维恩将圣化圣铃交还给你,
不是作为战利品, 而是另有用意.
她相信她身旁那间密室里的祭坛正是为了接纳这类圣物而造, 让它们在封存其中时, 神圣的影响力得以延续.
将圣化圣铃放入圣物祭坛, 然后回到塞雷维恩身边.

UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_relic_altar_Objec.en: Place the <accent>Sanctified Bell</accent> into the <accent>relic altar</accent>

UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_the_bell_below_De.en:
Serevine believes the bell seen in your dream may be the Sanctified Bell, a sacred Valerian relic once sealed somewhere beneath Cedar Hill Church. If she is right, then your dream was no mere imagining.
Descend deeper into the church cellars, uncover the hidden reliquary, recover the Sanctified Bell, and return it to Serevine.
UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_the_bell_below_De.ch:
塞雷維恩認為你夢中所見的鈴鐺可能就是聖化聖鈴, 一件曾被封存在雪松山教堂地下某處的神聖瓦萊里安聖物. 如果她說得沒錯, 那麼你的夢就不只是想像.
深入教堂地窖, 找出隱藏的聖物室, 取回聖化聖鈴, 並將它交還給塞雷維恩.
UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_the_bell_below_De.cn:
塞雷维恩认为你梦中所见的铃铛可能就是圣化圣铃, 一件曾被封存在雪松山教堂地下某处的神圣瓦莱里安圣物. 如果她说得没错, 那么你的梦就不只是想象.
深入教堂地窖, 找出隐藏的圣物室, 取回圣化圣铃, 并将它交还给塞雷维恩.

UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_the_callas_record.en:
Serevine has exhausted the church's surviving records of the Sanctuary. They confirm that it once existed, but reveal nothing of its location, its purpose, or the reason it was hidden. The Callas family may have preserved what the church concealed.
Travel to Callas Manor and uncover any record they left behind concerning the Sanctuary.
UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_the_callas_record.ch:
塞雷維恩已經翻遍教會現存關於聖域的紀錄. 這些紀錄證實它確實存在過, 卻完全沒透露它的位置, 用途, 或被隱藏的原因. 卡拉斯家族或許保存了教會所隱瞞的事物.
前往卡拉斯莊園, 找出他們留下的任何有關聖域的紀錄.
UI_CHQuestLog_serevine_the_callas_record.cn:
塞雷维恩已经翻遍教会现存关于圣域的记录. 这些记录证实它确实存在过, 却完全没透露它的位置, 用途, 或被隐藏的原因. 卡拉斯家族或许保存了教会所隐瞒的事物.
前往卡拉斯庄园, 找出他们留下的任何有关圣域的记录.

UI_CHQuestLog_silas_ashen_wards_DescRich.en:
Silas has heard the dead of House Callas stirring within their family cemetery. The wards etched upon their stone coffins are failing, leaving their rest exposed to whatever stirs below.
Take the warding kit, repair the broken wards, and return to Silas once the graves have fallen silent.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_ashen_wards_DescRich.ch:
塞拉斯聽見卡拉斯家族的亡者在家族墓園中騷動. 刻在他們石棺上的結界正在失效, 讓他們的安息暴露在下方蠢動之物面前.
帶上典獄長封緘工具組, 修復損壞的結界, 等墳墓歸於寂靜後再回到塞拉斯身邊.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_ashen_wards_DescRich.cn:
塞拉斯听见卡拉斯家族的亡者在家族墓园中骚动. 刻在他们石棺上的结界正在失效, 让他们的安息暴露在下方蠢动之物面前.
带上典狱长封缄工具组, 修复损坏的结界, 等坟墓归于寂静后再回到塞拉斯身边.

UI_CHQuestLog_silas_the_invitation_DescR.en:
Silas believes you have earned an introduction. With the Regal Hatch Key in hand, the way to the Carrion Ascension now lies open.
Beneath the opposite crypt waits an arena few living souls are invited to see.
Descend through the hatch and present your invitation to Try Honesty.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_the_invitation_DescR.ch:
塞拉斯認為你已經贏得了一次引薦. 有了華貴地窖活板門鑰匙, 通往腐屍飛昇的道路如今已經敞開.
在對面的墓穴下方, 有一座極少活人受邀得見的競技場.
穿過活板門往下走, 向'誠試'出示你的邀請函.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_the_invitation_DescR.cn:
塞拉斯认为你已经赢得了一次引荐. 有了华贵地窖活板门钥匙, 通往腐尸飞升的道路如今已经敞开.
在对面的墓穴下方, 有一座极少活人受邀得见的竞技场.
穿过活板门往下走, 向'诚试'出示你的邀请函.

UI_CHQuestLog_silas_unquiet_crypt_DescRi.en: Silas has entrusted you with a grim task. The Mother's Crypt is poisoned by a sorrow that has festered into rage, unsettling the peace of the graveyard. He has given you the key, and charged you to enter the crypt, find the source of the turmoil, and put it to rest by any means necessary.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_unquiet_crypt_DescRi.ch: 塞拉斯託付給你一項嚴峻的任務. 母親之墓被一股潰爛成憤怒的悲傷所毒害, 擾亂了墓園的安寧. 他給了你鑰匙, 要你進入墓穴, 找出騷亂的源頭, 並不擇手段讓它安息.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_unquiet_crypt_DescRi.cn: 塞拉斯托付给你一项严峻的任务. 母亲之墓被一股溃烂成愤怒的悲伤所毒害, 扰乱了墓园的安宁. 他给了你钥匙, 要你进入墓穴, 找出骚乱的源头, 并不择手段让它安息.

UI_CHQuestLog_silas_warden_call_DescRich.en:
You heard a voice near the Callas Family Cemetery...

"Ah, a living soul... a rare and welcome sight these days. If you have a moment for an old warden, come, let us speak."

Find the source of the voice among the graves, and learn what stirs there.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_warden_call_DescRich.ch:
你在卡拉斯家族墓園附近聽見一個聲音…

「啊, 一個活生生的靈魂… 這年頭真是難得又令人欣慰的景象. 若你願意抽空陪一位老守墓人, 來吧, 我們聊聊.」

在墳墓間找出聲音的來源, 並查明那裡有什麼在蠢動.
UI_CHQuestLog_silas_warden_call_DescRich.cn:
你在卡拉斯家族墓园附近听见一个声音…

“啊, 一个活生生的灵魂… 这年头真是难得又令人欣慰的景象. 若你愿意抽空陪一位老守墓人, 来吧, 我们聊聊.”

在坟墓间找出声音的来源, 并查明那里有什么在蠢动.

UI_CHQuestLog_the_servants_way_DescRich.en:
Explore the Estate. While the right path leads to the old graveyard, the left fork remains largely unexplored.
It winds past the estate's overgrown greenhouse and down toward the waterline. Perhaps the servants who once walked this route knew secrets their masters had long since forgotten.
UI_CHQuestLog_the_servants_way_DescRich.ch:
探索莊園. 右邊的路通往舊墓園, 而左邊的岔路大多仍未經探索.
它蜿蜒經過莊園雜草叢生的溫室, 一路向下通往水邊. 或許曾走過這條路的僕人們, 知道他們的主人早已遺忘的秘密.
UI_CHQuestLog_the_servants_way_DescRich.cn:
探索庄园. 右边的路通往旧墓园, 而左边的岔路大多仍未经探索.
它蜿蜒经过庄园杂草丛生的温室, 一路向下通往水边. 或许曾走过这条路的仆人们, 知道他们的主人早已遗忘的秘密.

UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.en:
Try Honesty is not done with you yet.
The crowd has seen you survive. Now they want to know whether you can win without leaning on the fountain like a wounded noble at a garden party.
Complete one full arena match without using the fountain, then return to Try Honesty.
UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.ch:
'誠試'還沒跟你完事.
觀眾已經看到你活了下來. 現在他們想知道, 你能否不像花園派對上負傷的貴族那樣倚靠泉水也能取勝.
在不使用泉水的情況下完成一整場競技場比賽, 然後回到'誠試'身邊.
UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.cn:
'诚试'还没跟你完事.
观众已经看到你活了下来. 现在他们想知道, 你能否不像花园派对上负伤的贵族那样倚靠泉水也能取胜.
在不使用泉水的情况下完成一整场竞技场比赛, 然后回到'诚试'身边.

UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_first_match_Des.en:
Try Honesty has accepted your invitation,
though not without making a spectacle of it.
The Carrion Ascension does not hand out glory freely. Step into the arena, survive one full match, and return to Try Honesty with your dignity mostly intact.
UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_first_match_Des.ch:
'誠試'接受了你的邀請函,
不過免不了大肆炫耀一番.
腐屍飛昇不會白白送出榮耀. 踏入競技場, 撐過一整場比賽, 然後帶著大致完好的尊嚴回到'誠試'身邊.
UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_first_match_Des.cn:
'诚试'接受了你的邀请函,
不过免不了大肆炫耀一番.
腐尸飞升不会白白送出荣耀. 踏入竞技场, 撑过一整场比赛, 然后带着大致完好的尊严回到'诚试'身边.

UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wage.en:
Try Honesty has decided your survival may yet be useful. An old wager with the Curator ended poorly after a match was soured by technicalities, excuses, and one very inconvenient fountain.
Ask the Curator about the wager, recover the Brass Bout Bell, and return it to Try Honesty.
UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wage.ch:
'誠試'認定你活下來或許還有點用處. 一場與館長之間的陳年賭約結局很難看, 因為某場比賽被技術性細節, 藉口, 以及一座非常礙事的泉水給攪局了.
向館長詢問賭約的事, 取回黃銅決鬥鈴鐺, 並將它交還給'誠試'.
UI_CHQuestLog_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wage.cn:
'诚试'认定你活下来或许还有点用处. 一场与馆长之间的陈年赌约结局很难看, 因为某场比赛被技术性细节, 借口, 以及一座非常碍事的泉水给搅局了.
向馆长询问赌约的事, 取回黄铜决斗铃铛, 并将它交还给'诚试'.

UI_CHQuestSay_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_c.ch: 萊拉的幻視現在或許能清晰起來了.
UI_CHQuestSay_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_c.cn: 莱拉的幻视现在或许能清晰起来了.

UI_CHQuestSay_silas_unquiet_crypt_comple.en: The spirits... they're finally at peace.
UI_CHQuestSay_silas_unquiet_crypt_comple.ch: 那些亡魂… 終於安息了.
UI_CHQuestSay_silas_unquiet_crypt_comple.cn: 那些亡魂… 终于安息了.

UI_CHQuestSay_silas_warden_call_complete.en: The old warden... what tales he must hold.
UI_CHQuestSay_silas_warden_call_complete.ch: 那位老守墓人… 他肚子裡一定有不少故事.
UI_CHQuestSay_silas_warden_call_complete.cn: 那位老守墓人… 他肚子里一定有不少故事.

UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.ch: 沒有泉水. 沒有藉口.
UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.cn: 没有泉水. 没有借口.

UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.en: The fountain broke the challenge. I will have to try again.
UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.ch: 泉水破壞了這次挑戰. 我得再試一次.
UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_mor.cn: 泉水破坏了这次挑战. 我得再试一次.

UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_first_match_com.en: I made it through the arena.

UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wage.en: The bell is back where it belongs.
UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wage.ch: 鈴鐺回到它該在的地方了.
UI_CHQuestSay_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wage.cn: 铃铛回到它该在的地方了.

UI_CHQuestTracker_ControlsHeight.cn: - 高度会自动延伸以容纳内容

UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Desc.en: You woke with the sound of a bell in your head. Not loud. Not near. But certain. In the dream, you saw a ruined church standing beneath a dead sky. Its doors were open. A stairway waited inside, descending into candlelight. You do not know why it matters. But in a world this far gone, a church may still mean shelter, supplies, or answers. Find the church from your dream.
UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Desc.ch: 你醒來時, 腦中迴盪著鈴聲. 不響亮. 不靠近. 卻很確定. 在夢中, 你看見一座矗立在死寂天空下的殘破教堂. 它的大門敞開著. 裡面有一道階梯在等待, 向下延伸至燭光之中. 你不知道這為何重要. 但在一個已經崩壞至此的世界裡, 教堂或許仍意味著庇護, 物資, 或是答案. 找到你夢中的那座教堂.
UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Desc.cn: 你醒来时, 脑中回荡着铃声. 不响亮. 不靠近. 却很确定. 在梦中, 你看见一座矗立在死寂天空下的残破教堂. 它的大门敞开着. 里面有一道阶梯在等待, 向下延伸至烛光之中. 你不知道这为何重要. 但在一个已经崩坏至此的世界里, 教堂或许仍意味着庇护, 物资, 或是答案. 找到你梦中的那座教堂.

UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Objective.en: Find the church from your dream
UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Objective.ch: 找到你夢中的那座教堂
UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Objective.cn: 找到你梦中的那座教堂

UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Objective.en: Look for signs of life beneath the church
UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Objective.ch: 在教堂下方尋找生命跡象
UI_CHQuest_a_bell_in_the_ruins_Objective.cn: 在教堂下方寻找生命迹象

UI_CHQuest_choose_your_fate_Desc.en: Marlowe has the Vial of Unspoiled Grace, and no intention of releasing it for something as cheap as gratitude. He calls the fountain honest: one blessing, one consequence, every miracle properly accounted for. Accept one bargain from the fountain, then return to Marlowe and collect the vial.
UI_CHQuest_choose_your_fate_Desc.ch: 馬洛持有純淨恩典藥劑瓶, 卻無意只為了感激這種廉價的東西就交出來. 他說泉水很公道: 一份賜福, 一份代價, 每個奇蹟都清清楚楚記在帳上. 從泉水那裡接受一份交易, 然後回到馬洛身邊領取藥劑瓶.
UI_CHQuest_choose_your_fate_Desc.cn: 马洛持有纯净恩典药剂瓶, 却无意只为了感激这种廉价的东西就交出来. 他说泉水很公道: 一份赐福, 一份代价, 每个奇迹都清清楚楚记在账上. 从泉水那里接受一份交易, 然后回到马洛身边领取药剂瓶.

UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Desc.en: Lyra's visions of the Sanctum are drowning in corrupted divine noise. The fountain's current waters would only turn memory into a bargain. Marlowe holds a Vial of Unspoiled Grace, drawn before the curse. Find him by the courtyard fountain behind Callas Manor and recover it.
UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Desc.ch: 萊拉對聖所的幻視正被腐化的神聖雜音淹沒. 泉水如今的水只會把記憶變成交易. 馬洛持有純淨恩典藥劑瓶, 那是在詛咒降臨前汲取的. 到卡拉斯莊園後方庭院的泉水旁找到他, 取回藥劑瓶.
UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Desc.cn: 莱拉对圣所的幻视正被腐化的神圣杂音淹没. 泉水如今的水只会把记忆变成交易. 马洛持有纯净恩典药剂瓶, 那是在诅咒降临前汲取的. 到卡拉斯庄园后方庭院的泉水旁找到他, 取回药剂瓶.

UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Obje.en: Obtain the Vial of Unspoiled Grace
Return the Vial of Unspoiled Grace to Lyra
UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Obje.ch: 將純淨恩典藥劑瓶交還給萊拉
UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Obje.cn: 将纯净恩典药剂瓶交还给莱拉

UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Obje.en: Speak to Marlowe in the courtyard behind Callas Manor
UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Obje.ch: 與卡拉斯莊園後方庭院的馬洛交談
UI_CHQuest_lyra_the_unspoiled_grace_Obje.cn: 与卡拉斯庄园后方庭院的马洛交谈

UI_CHQuest_serevine_relic_altar_Desc.en: Serevine returns the Sanctified Bell to you, not as a trophy, but with a purpose. She believes the altar in the chamber beside her was made to receive relics such as this, allowing their sacred influence to endure while bound within it. Place the Sanctified Bell into the relic altar, then return to Serevine once it has been set in place.
UI_CHQuest_serevine_relic_altar_Desc.ch: 塞雷維恩將聖化聖鈴交還給你, 不是當作戰利品, 而是另有用意. 她認為身旁房間裡的祭壇正是為了承接這類聖物而造, 聖物安放其中時, 其神聖影響力便能延續下去. 將聖化聖鈴放入聖物祭壇, 安放妥當後回到塞雷維恩身邊.
UI_CHQuest_serevine_relic_altar_Desc.cn: 塞雷维恩将圣化圣铃交还给你, 不是当作战利品, 而是另有用意. 她认为身旁房间里的祭坛正是为了承接这类圣物而造, 圣物安放其中时, 其神圣影响力便能延续下去. 将圣化圣铃放入圣物祭坛, 安放妥当后回到塞雷维恩身边.

UI_CHQuest_serevine_relic_altar_Objectiv.en: Place the Sanctified Bell into the relic altar
UI_CHQuest_serevine_relic_altar_Objectiv.ch: 將聖化聖鈴放入聖物祭壇
UI_CHQuest_serevine_relic_altar_Objectiv.cn: 将圣化圣铃放入圣物祭坛

UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_bell_below_Desc.en: Serevine believes the bell seen in your dream may be the Sanctified Bell, a sacred Valerian relic once sealed somewhere beneath Cedar Hill Church. If she is right, then your dream was no mere imagining. Descend deeper into the church cellars, uncover the hidden reliquary, recover the Sanctified Bell, and return it to Serevine.
UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_bell_below_Desc.ch: 塞雷維恩認為你夢中所見的鈴鐺可能就是聖化聖鈴, 一件曾被封存在雪松山教堂地底某處的瓦萊里安神聖聖物. 若她說得沒錯, 那麼你的夢絕非單純的幻想. 深入教堂地窖, 找出隱藏的聖物龕, 取回聖化聖鈴, 並交給塞雷維恩.
UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_bell_below_Desc.cn: 塞雷维恩认为你梦中所见的铃铛可能就是圣化圣铃, 一件曾被封存在雪松山教堂地底某处的瓦莱里安神圣圣物. 若她说得没错, 那么你的梦绝非单纯的幻想. 深入教堂地窖, 找出隐藏的圣物龛, 取回圣化圣铃, 并交给塞雷维恩.

UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_bell_below_Objec.en: Find a way to open the hidden passage

UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_callas_record_De.en: Serevine has exhausted the church's surviving records of the Sanctuary. They confirm that it once existed, but reveal nothing of its location, its purpose, or the reason it was hidden. The Callas family may have preserved what the church concealed. Travel to Callas Manor and recover any record they left behind concerning the Sanctuary.
UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_callas_record_De.ch: 塞雷維恩已翻遍教會現存關於聖域的紀錄. 這些紀錄證實它確實存在過, 卻對它的位置、用途, 以及被隱藏的原因隻字未提. 卡拉斯家族或許保存了教會所隱瞞的事. 前往卡拉斯莊園, 找回他們留下的任何與聖域有關的紀錄.
UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_callas_record_De.cn: 塞雷维恩已翻遍教会现存关于圣域的记录. 这些记录证实它确实存在过, 却对它的位置、用途, 以及被隐藏的原因只字未提. 卡拉斯家族或许保存了教会所隐瞒的事. 前往卡拉斯庄园, 找回他们留下的任何与圣域有关的记录.

UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_callas_record_Ob.en: Uncover the Callas family's record of the Sanctuary
UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_callas_record_Ob.ch: 找出卡拉斯家族關於聖域的紀錄
UI_CHQuest_serevine_the_callas_record_Ob.cn: 找出卡拉斯家族关于圣域的记录

UI_CHQuest_silas_ashen_wards_Desc.en: Silas believes the cemetery wards were not merely broken, but miswritten. He gives you a small warden's kit and asks you to inspect the grave seals across the Callas cemetery. Most still hold. Five have been corrupted. Examine the graves, correct every corrupted seal you find, and return to Silas before the unrest deepens.
UI_CHQuest_silas_ashen_wards_Desc.ch: 塞拉斯認為墓園結界不只是遭到破壞, 而是被寫錯了. 他交給你一套小小的典獄長封緘工具組, 請你檢查卡拉斯墓園各處的墓地封印. 大多數仍然完好, 但有五處已遭腐化. 檢查墳墓, 修正你找到的每一處腐化封印, 並在騷動加劇之前回到塞拉斯身邊.
UI_CHQuest_silas_ashen_wards_Desc.cn: 塞拉斯认为墓园结界不只是遭到破坏, 而是被写错了. 他交给你一套小小的典狱长封缄工具组, 请你检查卡拉斯墓园各处的墓地封印. 大多数仍然完好, 但有五处已遭腐化. 检查坟墓, 修正你找到的每一处腐化封印, 并在骚动加剧之前回到塞拉斯身边.

UI_CHQuest_silas_ashen_wards_Objective_c.en: Find and correct corrupted grave seals
UI_CHQuest_silas_ashen_wards_Objective_c.ch: 找出並修正遭腐化的墓地封印
UI_CHQuest_silas_ashen_wards_Objective_c.cn: 找出并修正遭腐化的墓地封印

UI_CHQuest_silas_the_invitation_Desc.en: Use the <accent>Regal Hatch Key</accent> to enter the <accent>Carrion Ascension</accent> and present your <accent>invitation</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_silas_the_invitation_Desc.ch: 使用<accent>華貴地窖活板門鑰匙</accent>進入<accent>腐屍飛昇</accent>, 並出示你的<accent>邀請函</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_silas_the_invitation_Desc.cn: 使用<accent>华贵地窖活板门钥匙</accent>进入<accent>腐尸飞升</accent>, 并出示你的<accent>邀请函</accent>.

UI_CHQuest_silas_unquiet_crypt_Desc.en: Enter The Mother's Crypt using the Crypt Key, deal with the source of the unrest, and then return to Silas.
UI_CHQuest_silas_unquiet_crypt_Desc.ch: 使用老舊墓穴鑰匙進入母親之墓, 處理騷動的根源, 然後回到塞拉斯身邊.
UI_CHQuest_silas_unquiet_crypt_Desc.cn: 使用老旧墓穴钥匙进入母亲之墓, 处理骚动的根源, 然后回到塞拉斯身边.

UI_CHQuest_silas_unquiet_crypt_Objective.en: Confront the unrest at the coffin
Descend into the crypt behind Silas
UI_CHQuest_silas_unquiet_crypt_Objective.ch: 下到塞拉斯身後的墓穴
UI_CHQuest_silas_unquiet_crypt_Objective.cn: 下到塞拉斯身后的墓穴

UI_CHQuest_silas_warden_call_Desc.en: You heard a voice near the Callas Family Cemetery... 'Ah, a living soul... a rare and welcome sight these days. If you have a moment for an old warden, come, let us speak.' The voice seems to come from the cemetery.
UI_CHQuest_silas_warden_call_Desc.ch: 你在卡拉斯家族墓園附近聽見一個聲音… 「啊, 一個活人… 這年頭可是難得又令人欣喜的景象. 若你願意為老守墓人撥出片刻, 來吧, 我們談談.」 那聲音似乎來自墓園.
UI_CHQuest_silas_warden_call_Desc.cn: 你在卡拉斯家族墓园附近听见一个声音… “啊, 一个活人… 这年头可是难得又令人欣喜的景象. 若你愿意为老守墓人抽出片刻, 来吧, 我们谈谈.” 那声音似乎来自墓园.

UI_CHQuest_silas_warden_call_Objective_f.en: Locate the warden in the family cemetery
UI_CHQuest_silas_warden_call_Objective_f.ch: 在家族墓園找到守墓人
UI_CHQuest_silas_warden_call_Objective_f.cn: 在家族墓园找到守墓人

UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Desc.en: Take the <accent>servants' way</accent>: left at the fork, past the <accent>greenhouse</accent>, down to the <accent>water</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Desc.ch: 走<accent>僕人小徑</accent>: 在岔路口左轉, 經過<accent>溫室</accent>, 一路往下到<accent>水邊</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Desc.cn: 走<accent>仆人小径</accent>: 在岔路口左转, 经过<accent>温室</accent>, 一路往下到<accent>水边</accent>.

UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Objective_ts.en: Follow the path down to the boathouse
Reach the fork before Callas Manor
UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Objective_ts.ch: 抵達卡拉斯莊園前的岔路口
UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Objective_ts.cn: 抵达卡拉斯庄园前的岔路口

UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Objective_ts.en: Head west at the fork and follow the path ahead
UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Objective_ts.ch: 在岔路口往西走, 沿著前方的小徑前進
UI_CHQuest_the_servants_way_Objective_ts.cn: 在岔路口往西走, 沿着前方的小径前进

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_more_D.en: <accent>Try Honesty</accent> wants another victory, but this time you must finish the <accent>arena</accent> without drawing strength from the <accent>fountain</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_more_D.ch: <accent>'誠試'</accent>想再看一場勝利, 但這次你必須在不從<accent>泉水</accent>汲取力量的情況下打完<accent>競技場</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_more_D.cn: <accent>'诚试'</accent>想再看一场胜利, 但这次你必须在不从<accent>泉水</accent>汲取力量的情况下打完<accent>竞技场</accent>.

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_more_O.en: Complete one arena match without using the fountain
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_more_O.ch: 在不使用泉水的情況下完成一場競技場比賽
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_crowd_wants_more_O.cn: 在不使用泉水的情况下完成一场竞技场比赛

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_first_match_Desc.en: Step into <accent>Try Honesty</accent>'s <accent>arena</accent>, complete <accent>one full match</accent>, and then return to him.
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_first_match_Desc.ch: 踏入<accent>'誠試'</accent>的<accent>競技場</accent>, 完成<accent>一場完整比賽</accent>, 然後回到他身邊.
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_first_match_Desc.cn: 踏入<accent>'诚试'</accent>的<accent>竞技场</accent>, 完成<accent>一场完整比赛</accent>, 然后回到他身边.

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_D.en: Ask the <accent>Curator</accent> about <accent>Try Honesty</accent>'s <accent>old wager</accent>, collect the <accent>Brass Bout Bell</accent>, and return it to <accent>Try Honesty</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_D.ch: 向<accent>館長</accent>詢問<accent>'誠試'</accent>的<accent>舊日賭約</accent>, 取得<accent>黃銅決鬥鈴鐺</accent>, 並交給<accent>'誠試'</accent>.
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_D.cn: 向<accent>馆长</accent>询问<accent>'诚试'</accent>的<accent>旧日赌约</accent>, 拿到<accent>黄铜决斗铃铛</accent>, 并交给<accent>'诚试'</accent>.

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.en: Ask the Curator about Try Honesty's old wager
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.ch: 向館長詢問'誠試'的舊日賭約

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.en: Collect the Brass Bout Bell from the Curator
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.ch: 從館長那裡取得黃銅決鬥鈴鐺
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.cn: 从馆长那里拿到黄铜决斗铃铛

UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.en: Return the Brass Bout Bell to Try Honesty
UI_CHQuest_tryhonesty_gentlemans_wager_O.ch: 將黃銅決鬥鈴鐺交給'誠試'

UI_CHRelicAltar_EmptyHint.cn: 从物品栏将已登记的圣物拖到槽位中.

UI_CHRelicAltar_NoEffect.ch: 此聖物沒有登記任何共鳴效果.
UI_CHRelicAltar_NoEffect.cn: 此圣物没有登记任何共鸣效果.

UI_CHRelicAltar_SayCannotHoldCurrent.en: Your inventory cannot hold the current relic.
UI_CHRelicAltar_SayCannotHoldCurrent.ch: 你的物品欄放不下目前的聖物.

UI_CHRelicAltar_SayCannotTake.cn: 祭坛无法接收这件圣物.

UI_CHRelicAltar_SayInvalidRelic.cn: 祭坛对那件物品毫无回应.

UI_CHRelic_ProsperityChime_Desc.en: While slotted, Cedar Hill Soul Shard rewards are increased by 25%.
UI_CHRelic_ProsperityChime_Desc.ch: 安放期間, 雪松山靈魂碎片獎勵增加 25%%.
UI_CHRelic_ProsperityChime_Desc.cn: 安放期间, 雪松山灵魂碎片奖励增加 25%%.

UI_CHRelic_TheFirstWish_Desc.en: While slotted, random item bargains from the Deal Fountain roll reward rarity twice and keep the better result. The price is unchanged.
UI_CHRelic_TheFirstWish_Desc.ch: 安放期間, 契約泉水的隨機物品交易會擲兩次獎勵稀有度, 並保留較好的結果. 代價不變.
UI_CHRelic_TheFirstWish_Desc.cn: 安放期间, 契约泉水的随机物品交易会掷两次奖励稀有度, 并保留较好的结果. 代价不变.

UI_CHRelic_ValeriansRelic_Desc.en: While slotted, its faint resonance slowly steadies panic and stress.
UI_CHRelic_ValeriansRelic_Desc.ch: 安放期間, 其微弱的共鳴會緩緩平息恐慌與壓力.
UI_CHRelic_ValeriansRelic_Desc.cn: 安放期间, 其微弱的共鸣会缓缓平息恐慌与压力.

UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church01.en:
Stop right there. Not a step closer!
...Oh. A person. And alive?
Wonderful. Alarming, but wonderful.
Come in, then. A fellow explorer, I hope.
UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church01.ch:
站住. 別再靠近一步!
…喔. 是個人. 而且還活著?
太好了. 嚇人, 但真是太好了.
那就進來吧. 希望你也是個探險者.
UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church01.cn:
站住. 别再靠近一步!
…哦. 是个人. 而且还活着?
太好了. 吓人, 但真是太好了.
那就进来吧. 希望你也是个探险者.

UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church02.en:
Sorry. You startled me half to death, which is very rude in a place already full of death.
I'm Serevine, Valerian scholar, temporary cellar resident, and currently very grateful you are not trying to eat me.
UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church02.ch:
抱歉. 你差點把我嚇個半死, 在一個早已充滿死亡的地方, 這可是非常失禮的.
我是塞雷維恩, 瓦萊里安學者, 暫時住在地窖裡, 而且此刻非常慶幸你沒打算吃掉我.
UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church02.cn:
抱歉. 你差点把我吓个半死, 在一个早已充满死亡的地方, 这可是非常失礼的.
我是塞雷维恩, 瓦莱里安学者, 暂时住在地窖里, 而且此刻非常庆幸你没打算吃掉我.

UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church03.en: Oh, it worked! There is something different about you now. A steadiness, perhaps... as though the Bell has finally found its proper bearer. Leave it upon the altar, and I believe its blessing will remain with you.
UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church03.ch: 噢, 成功了! 你現在有些不一樣了. 也許是一種沉穩… 彷彿聖鈴終於找到了真正的持有者. 把它留在祭壇上, 我相信它的賜福會一直伴隨著你.
UI_CHSerevine_Bubble_Church03.cn: 噢, 成功了! 你现在有些不一样了. 也许是一种沉稳… 仿佛圣铃终于找到了真正的持有者. 把它留在祭坛上, 我相信它的赐福会一直伴随着你.

UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_CallasMap.en: Is that a map of Callas Manor?
UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_CallasMap.ch: 那是卡拉斯莊園的地圖嗎?
UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_CallasMap.cn: 那是卡拉斯庄园的地图吗?

UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_DeadWalk.en: Any idea why the dead walk?
UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_DeadWalk.ch: 你知道死者為什麼會行走嗎?
UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_DeadWalk.cn: 你知道死者为什么会行走吗?

UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_DreamChurch.en: I saw this church in a dream
UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_DreamChurch.ch: 我在夢裡見過這座教堂
UI_CHSerevine_DialogueOption_DreamChurch.cn: 我在梦里见过这座教堂

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_CallasMap.en:
It is. Remarkable, isn't it?

Every wing, every garden path, even the servants' passages have been recorded in extraordinary detail.

I had expected a parish sketch. This is something far more deliberate.

Though it has one rather curious omission.

The records place Valerian's first sanctuary somewhere beneath the estate.

Yet this map makes no mention of it at all.

For a place of such importance to be absent from a map this precise... I find it very difficult to believe that was an oversight.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_CallasMap.ch:
沒錯. 很了不起, 對吧?

每一側廂房、每一條花園小徑, 甚至連僕人通道, 都記錄得鉅細靡遺.

我原本以為只是一張教區草圖. 這東西顯然是刻意繪製的, 用心得多.

不過它有一處相當奇怪的遺漏.

紀錄指出瓦萊里安的第一座聖域就位於莊園地底某處.

然而這張地圖對此隻字未提.

如此重要的地方, 竟然沒出現在這麼精確的地圖上… 我實在很難相信那只是疏忽.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_CallasMap.cn:
没错. 很了不起, 对吧?

每一侧厢房、每一条花园小径, 甚至连仆人通道, 都记录得巨细靡遗.

我原本以为只是一张教区草图. 这东西显然是刻意绘制的, 用心得多.

不过它有一处相当奇怪的遗漏.

记录指出瓦莱里安的第一座圣域就位于庄园地底某处.

然而这张地图对此只字未提.

如此重要的地方, 竟然没出现在这么精确的地图上… 我实在很难相信那只是疏忽.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_DeadWalk.en:
Nothing I could honestly call an answer.

But I have found records of visits to a Valerian sanctuary on the Callas estate. Supposedly, the first sanctuary ever raised in His name.

If that is true, it is extraordinary. Thousands of years of history, doctrine, relics... perhaps even accounts from the founding of the faith itself.

I confess, I was rather thrilled when I first understood what I was reading.

Then I reached the later entries. The visits become fewer. People return from the sanctuary described as distant... vacant... diminished.

One account says a man came back breathing, walking, and speaking... yet his wife insisted that whatever returned from beneath the estate was no longer her husband.

I would very much like to dismiss it as frightened superstition. Given what is wandering outside, that has become rather difficult.

If there is an answer beneath the Callas estate, I think we ought to find it.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_DeadWalk.ch:
老實說, 我沒有什麼稱得上答案的東西.

不過我找到了一些造訪卡拉斯莊園內某座瓦萊里安聖域的紀錄. 據說, 那是以祂之名建起的第一座聖域.

若此事屬實, 那可是非同小可. 數千年的歷史、教義、聖物… 甚至可能有這個信仰創立之初的記載.

我承認, 當我初次明白自己讀到的是什麼時, 我相當興奮.

接著我讀到了後期的紀錄. 造訪的次數越來越少. 從聖域回來的人被描述成心不在焉… 空洞… 衰弱.

有份紀錄提到, 一個男人回來時還有呼吸、能走路、能說話… 但他的妻子堅稱, 從莊園地底回來的那個東西已經不是她的丈夫了.

我很想把它當成驚恐之下的迷信一笑置之. 但看看外面遊蕩的那些東西, 這就變得相當困難了.

如果卡拉斯莊園地底真有答案, 我想我們應該把它找出來.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_DeadWalk.cn:
老实说, 我没有什么称得上答案的东西.

不过我找到了一些造访卡拉斯庄园内某座瓦莱里安圣域的记录. 据说, 那是以祂之名建起的第一座圣域.

若此事属实, 那可是非同小可. 数千年的历史、教义、圣物… 甚至可能有这个信仰创立之初的记载.

我承认, 当我初次明白自己读到的是什么时, 我相当兴奋.

接着我读到了后期的记录. 造访的次数越来越少. 从圣域回来的人被描述成心不在焉… 空洞… 衰弱.

有份记录提到, 一个男人回来时还有呼吸、能走路、能说话… 但他的妻子坚称, 从庄园地底回来的那个东西已经不是她的丈夫了.

我很想把它当成惊恐之下的迷信一笑置之. 但看看外面游荡的那些东西, 这就变得相当困难了.

如果卡拉斯庄园地底真有答案, 我想我们应该把它找出来.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_DreamChurch.en:
This church? Before you had ever set foot inside it?
How extraordinary.

Forgive me. I imagine it was rather less extraordinary to experience.

Dreams of sacred sites do appear in old Valerian studies, though never in any account I considered reliable.

There is one detail those accounts repeat with peculiar consistency.

Tell me, did you hear a bell?
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_DreamChurch.ch:
這座教堂? 在你踏進來之前?
真是不可思議.

抱歉. 我想親身經歷時大概沒那麼美妙.

關於聖地的夢境確實出現在古老的瓦萊里安研究中, 只不過我從未見過哪份記載是可信的.

那些記載中有一個細節反覆出現, 一致得出奇.

告訴我, 你聽見鈴聲了嗎?
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_DreamChurch.cn:
这座教堂? 在你踏进来之前?
真是不可思议.

抱歉. 我想亲身经历时大概没那么美妙.

关于圣地的梦境确实出现在古老的瓦莱里安研究中, 只不过我从未见过哪份记载是可信的.

那些记载中有一个细节反复出现, 一致得出奇.

告诉我, 你听见铃声了吗?

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_HeardItRinging.en:
You did?
Then I may owe several long-dead scholars a sincere apology.

I had always assumed they were describing a symbol, not an actual phenomenon.

Judging by the state of the steeples, I sincerely doubt the tower bell has rung for a very long time.

Yet the accounts describe a bell heard in sleep, calling the living toward sacred ground.

I thought it devotional allegory.

Now you are standing here, in the very church those accounts describe. Which makes this considerably more important than I had hoped.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_HeardItRinging.ch:
你聽見了?
那我可能欠幾位早已作古的學者一個誠心的道歉.

我一直以為他們描述的是一種象徵, 而不是真實的現象.

從尖塔的狀況來看, 我非常懷疑塔上的鐘已經很久沒響過了.

然而那些記載描述的是一道在睡夢中聽見的鈴聲, 召喚生者前往聖地.

我原以為那只是虔信的寓言.

如今你就站在這裡, 站在那些記載所描述的教堂中. 這讓事情比我所希望的重要得多.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_HeardItRinging.cn:
你听见了?
那我可能欠几位早已作古的学者一个诚心的道歉.

我一直以为他们描述的是一种象征, 而不是真实的现象.

从尖塔的状况来看, 我非常怀疑塔上的钟已经很久没响过了.

然而那些记载描述的是一道在睡梦中听见的铃声, 召唤生者前往圣地.

我原以为那只是虔信的寓言.

如今你就站在这里, 站在那些记载所描述的教堂中. 这让事情比我所希望的重要得多.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_RelicAltarAccepte.en:
Take it. Not as a trophy, but with a purpose.

The altar in the nearby chamber was made to receive relics such as this. If the bell is placed there, its influence may endure without being carried in your hands.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_RelicAltarAccepte.ch:
拿去吧. 不是當作戰利品, 而是另有用意.

附近房間裡的祭壇正是為了承接這類聖物而造. 若將聖鈴安放在那裡, 它的影響力或許就能延續, 無須你親手攜帶.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_RelicAltarAccepte.cn:
拿去吧. 不是当作战利品, 而是另有用意.

附近房间里的祭坛正是为了承接这类圣物而造. 若将圣铃安放在那里, 它的影响力或许就能延续, 无须你亲手携带.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_RelicAltarTurnedI.en:
Then it worked. There is something steadier in the air now, as though the Bell has finally found its proper bearer.

Leave it upon the altar, and I believe its blessing will remain with you.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_RelicAltarTurnedI.ch:
那就是成功了. 此刻空氣中多了一份沉穩, 彷彿聖鈴終於找到了真正的持有者.

把它留在祭壇上, 我相信它的賜福會一直伴隨著你.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_RelicAltarTurnedI.cn:
那就是成功了. 此刻空气中多了一份沉稳, 仿佛圣铃终于找到了真正的持有者.

把它留在祭坛上, 我相信它的赐福会一直伴随着你.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheBellBelowAccep.en:
Then we should treat your dream as evidence, however inconvenient that may be.

The accounts speak of a bell beneath holy ground. If the relic is here, it will not have been left in any ordinary chamber.

Descend below the church. Find what the Valerians sealed away, and bring the bell to me before you bind it to anything.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheBellBelowAccep.ch:
那我們就該把你的夢當成證據, 不管這有多麼麻煩.

那些記載提到一口埋於聖地之下的鈴. 若聖物真的在這裡, 它絕不會被放在什麼普通的房間裡.

下到教堂底下. 找出瓦萊里安信徒封存起來的東西, 在你將聖鈴與任何東西綁定之前, 先把它帶來給我.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheBellBelowAccep.cn:
那我们就该把你的梦当成证据, 不管这有多么麻烦.

那些记载提到一口埋于圣地之下的铃. 若圣物真的在这里, 它绝不会被放在什么普通的房间里.

下到教堂底下. 找出瓦莱里安信徒封存起来的东西, 在你将圣铃与任何东西绑定之前, 先把它带来给我.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheBellBelowTurne.en:
You found it. Valerian's Bell... and not merely a story after all.

There is a sanctified mark beneath the tarnish. Give me a moment with it. If the old rite still answers, I can return it to you as something more than salvage.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheBellBelowTurne.ch:
你找到了. 瓦萊里安之鈴… 原來終究不只是個傳說.

鏽斑底下有個聖化印記. 給我一點時間處理它. 若古老儀式仍有回應, 我就能讓它以不只是撿來的破爛的模樣回到你手上.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheBellBelowTurne.cn:
你找到了. 瓦莱里安之铃… 原来终究不只是个传说.

锈斑底下有个圣化印记. 给我一点时间处理它. 若古老仪式仍有回应, 我就能让它以不只是捡来的破烂的模样回到你手上.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheCallasRecordAc.en:
The church records have taken us as far as they can.

If the Callas family concealed what the Church could not admit, their manor may still hold the missing account. Recover any record they left behind concerning the Sanctuary.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheCallasRecordAc.ch:
教會紀錄能帶我們走的路就到此為止了.

如果卡拉斯家族隱瞞了教會無法承認的事, 那麼他們的莊園裡或許還保存著缺失的記載. 找回他們留下的任何與聖域有關的紀錄.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheCallasRecordAc.cn:
教会记录能带我们走的路就到此为止了.

如果卡拉斯家族隐瞒了教会无法承认的事, 那么他们的庄园里或许还保存着缺失的记载. 找回他们留下的任何与圣域有关的记录.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheCallasRecordTu.en:
This is exactly what I feared, and exactly what I needed.

The Callas record gives shape to the omission. Whatever lies beneath that estate was not forgotten. It was deliberately hidden.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheCallasRecordTu.ch:
這正是我所害怕的, 也正是我所需要的.

卡拉斯紀錄讓那處遺漏有了輪廓. 無論那座莊園底下藏著什麼, 它都不是被遺忘了, 而是被刻意隱藏起來.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_TheCallasRecordTu.cn:
这正是我所害怕的, 也正是我所需要的.

卡拉斯记录让那处遗漏有了轮廓. 无论那座庄园底下藏着什么, 它都不是被遗忘了, 而是被刻意隐藏起来.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_WhatIsThisPlace.en:
I had hoped it was only a hidden archive. The scrolls, the sealed records, the fireplace kept for long nights of study... those I can understand.

Though judging by the dust, no one has studied here in centuries.

The cages in the corridor are rather harder to explain. Rust, brittle leather, dust thick enough to bury a confession.

Whatever happened here, it happened long before the dead began walking.

There are restraints here. Instruments meant for questioning, if one wishes to be charitable.

Whatever was recorded in this room, I do not think it was always offered willingly.

That is the part I find most troubling. The restraints bear Valerian seals. The records beside them carry the same insignia.

Whoever used this place was not hiding from the Church. They were acting in its name.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_WhatIsThisPlace.ch:
我原本希望這裡只是一座隱密的檔案庫. 卷軸、密封的紀錄、供漫漫長夜研讀時取暖的壁爐…這些我都能理解.

不過從灰塵來看, 這裡已有好幾個世紀沒人在此研讀了.

走廊上的牢籠就難解釋得多了. 鐵鏽、脆裂的皮革, 灰塵厚得足以埋葬一份懺悔.

不論這裡發生過什麼, 都遠在死者開始行走之前.

這裡有拘束器具. 若想說得厚道些, 那是用來審問的器械.

不論這個房間記錄了什麼, 我想那些話並不總是心甘情願說出口的.

這才是最令我不安的部分. 這些拘束器具上刻著瓦萊里安印記. 旁邊的紀錄也帶著同樣的徽記.

使用這裡的人並不是在躲避教會. 他們是以教會之名行事.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_WhatIsThisPlace.cn:
我原本希望这里只是一座隐秘的档案库. 卷轴、密封的记录、供漫漫长夜研读时取暖的壁炉…这些我都能理解.

不过从灰尘来看, 这里已经好几个世纪没人在此研读了.

走廊里的牢笼就难解释得多了. 铁锈、脆裂的皮革, 灰尘厚得足以埋葬一份忏悔.

无论这里发生过什么, 都远在死者开始行走之前.

这里有束缚器具. 若想说得厚道些, 那是用来审问的器械.

无论这个房间记录了什么, 我想那些话并不总是心甘情愿说出口的.

这才是最令我不安的部分. 这些束缚器具上刻着瓦莱里安印记. 旁边的记录也带着同样的徽记.

使用这里的人并不是在躲避教会. 他们是以教会之名行事.

UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.en:
I study Valerian relics, sacred sites, and the history people usually find more comfortable leaving buried.

I came to Cedar Hill after hearing the rather extraordinary accounts surrounding Callas Manor.

My superiors thought the matter warranted investigation.

Truthfully, I would have come whether they asked or not.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.ch:
我研究瓦萊里安聖物、聖地, 以及人們通常寧願讓它繼續埋著的歷史.

我聽說了圍繞卡拉斯莊園的種種離奇傳聞, 才來到雪松山.

我的上級認為這件事值得調查.

老實說, 不管他們有沒有開口, 我都會來.
UI_CHSerevine_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.cn:
我研究瓦莱里安圣物、圣地, 以及人们通常宁愿让它继续埋着的历史.

我听说了围绕卡拉斯庄园的种种离奇传闻, 才来到雪松山.

我的上级认为这件事值得调查.

老实说, 不管他们有没有开口, 我都会来.

UI_CHShatteredVisage_SavedFromDeathSay.en: The Shattered Visage shatters, saving you from death!
UI_CHShatteredVisage_SavedFromDeathSay.ch: 破碎面像護符碎裂了, 讓你免於一死!
UI_CHShatteredVisage_SavedFromDeathSay.cn: 破碎面像护符碎裂了, 让你免于一死!

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_AllCorrected.en: That should be all of them. Silas should know.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_AllCorrected.ch: 應該就是全部了. 該讓塞拉斯知道.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_AllCorrected.cn: 应该就是全部了. 该让塞拉斯知道.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine1.en: This grave seal is intact. No correction needed.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine1.ch: 這座墓地封印完好無損. 無需修正.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine1.cn: 这座墓地封印完好无损. 无需修正.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine2.en: The ward holds here. Leave this grave be.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine2.ch: 這裡的結界依然穩固. 別去打擾這座墳墓.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine2.cn: 这里的结界依然稳固. 别去打扰这座坟墓.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine3.en: No corruption here. This seal is already correct.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine3.ch: 這裡沒有腐化. 這個封印已經正確了.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CleanLine3.cn: 这里没有腐化. 这个封印已经正确了.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine1.en: Corrupted seal found. Use Silas' kit to correct it.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine1.ch: 發現受腐化的封印. 使用塞拉斯的工具包來修正它.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine1.cn: 发现受腐化的封印. 使用塞拉斯的工具包来修正它.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine2.en: This ward is inverted. Correct this grave seal.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine2.ch: 這道結界被倒轉了. 修正這座墓地封印.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine2.cn: 这道结界被倒转了. 修正这座墓地封印.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine3.en: The seal is broken here. This grave needs correction.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine3.ch: 這裡的封印損壞了. 這座墳墓需要修正.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_CorruptedLine3.cn: 这里的封印损坏了. 这座坟墓需要修正.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_ExamineFirst.en: I should examine the seal first.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_NeedSealKit.en: I need Silas' seal kit for this.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_NeedSealKit.cn: 我需要塞拉斯的典狱长封缄工具组才能做这件事.

UI_CHSilasAshenWards_RemainingUnstable.en: The seal settles. {count} still feel unstable.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_RemainingUnstable.ch: 封印平息了. 還有 {count} 處仍感覺不穩定.
UI_CHSilasAshenWards_RemainingUnstable.cn: 封印平息了. 还有 {count} 处仍感觉不稳定.

UI_CHSilas_Bubble_Intro.en: Greetings, traveler. I am <accent>Silas</accent>, the warden of this place. It is not often I receive visitors who still draw breath.
UI_CHSilas_Bubble_Intro.ch: 你好, 旅人. 我是<accent>塞拉斯</accent>, 此地的守墓人. 我很少接待仍有呼吸的訪客.
UI_CHSilas_Bubble_Intro.cn: 你好, 旅人. 我是<accent>塞拉斯</accent>, 此地的守墓人. 我很少接待仍有呼吸的访客.

UI_CHSilas_Bubble_WardenCall.en: Ah, a living soul... a rare and welcome sight these days. If you have a moment for an old warden, come, let us speak.
UI_CHSilas_Bubble_WardenCall.ch: 啊, 一個活生生的靈魂…這年頭真是難得又令人欣喜的景象. 如果你願意為一位老守墓人花點時間, 來吧, 我們聊聊.
UI_CHSilas_Bubble_WardenCall.cn: 啊, 一个活生生的灵魂…这年头真是难得又令人欣喜的景象. 如果你愿意为一位老守墓人花点时间, 来吧, 我们聊聊.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_AshenWardsAccepted.en:
Take the kit. Its tools are modest, but they remember the shape of the old wards.

Examine the grave seals throughout the cemetery. If one answers wrong, correct it before the unrest spreads.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_AshenWardsAccepted.ch:
收下這個工具包. 它的工具雖然簡樸, 但它們記得古老結界的形狀.

檢查墓園各處的墓地封印. 若有哪一道回應有誤, 就在騷動蔓延之前修正它.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_AshenWardsAccepted.cn:
收下这个工具包. 它的工具虽然简朴, 但它们记得古老结界的形状.

检查墓园各处的墓地封印. 若有哪一道回应有误, 就在骚动蔓延之前修正它.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_AshenWardsTurnedIn.en:
Yes... I can feel it. The stones are quieter now.

You have given the dead a kindness, and the living a little more time.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_AshenWardsTurnedIn.ch:
是的…我感覺得到. 墓碑現在安靜多了.

你給了死者一份慈悲, 也給了生者多一點時間.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_AshenWardsTurnedIn.cn:
是的…我感觉得到. 墓碑现在安静多了.

你给了死者一份慈悲, 也给了生者多一点时间.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_CanIHelp.en:
Perhaps. The wards around this cemetery have begun to fray in ways they should not.

If you are willing, I would ask you to inspect the grave seals, correct what has been miswritten, and return before the unrest deepens.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_CanIHelp.ch:
或許吧. 這座墓園周圍的結界, 開始以不該有的方式鬆動了.

如果你願意, 我想請你檢查各處的墓地封印, 修正那些被寫錯的部分, 並在騷動加劇之前回來.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_CanIHelp.cn:
或许吧. 这座墓园周围的结界, 开始以不该有的方式松动了.

如果你愿意, 我想请你检查各处的墓地封印, 修正那些被写错的部分, 并在骚动加剧之前回来.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_Default.en: Greetings, traveler. I am <accent>Silas</accent>, the warden of this place. It is not often I receive visitors who still draw breath.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_Default.ch: 你好, 旅人. 我是<accent>塞拉斯</accent>, 此地的守墓人. 我很少接待仍有呼吸的訪客.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_Default.cn: 你好, 旅人. 我是<accent>塞拉斯</accent>, 此地的守墓人. 我很少接待仍有呼吸的访客.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_InvitationAccepted.en:
Then the way is open. Take this invitation.

The place across the grounds will not welcome the living easily, but it should recognize the warden's seal.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_InvitationAccepted.ch:
那麼道路已經敞開. 收下這份邀請函.

園區另一頭的那個地方不會輕易歡迎生者, 但它應該認得守墓人的印章.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_InvitationAccepted.cn:
那么道路已经敞开. 收下这份邀请函.

园区另一头的那个地方不会轻易欢迎生者, 但它应该认得守墓人的印章.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_UnquietCryptAccepted.en:
I see you have taken an interest in the plight of this place. Thank you.

The Mother's Crypt holds a sorrow that has festered into rage.

It disturbs the peace of this entire ground.

Take this key. Enter, and pacify the source of the turmoil.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_UnquietCryptAccepted.ch:
看來你對此地的苦難產生了興趣. 謝謝你.

母親之墓裡藏著一股已潰爛成憤怒的悲傷.

它擾亂了這整片土地的安寧.

收下這把鑰匙. 進入其中, 平息騷亂的根源.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_UnquietCryptAccepted.cn:
看来你对此地的苦难产生了兴趣. 谢谢你.

母亲之墓里藏着一股已溃烂成愤怒的悲伤.

它扰乱了这整片土地的安宁.

收下这把钥匙. 进入其中, 平息骚乱的根源.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_UnquietCryptTurnedIn.en:
The crypt is still at last.

Whatever pain was bound below has loosened its grip. Rest may return to this ground.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_UnquietCryptTurnedIn.ch:
墓穴終於平靜了.

不論底下束縛著何種痛苦, 它都已鬆開了手. 安息或許能重回這片土地.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_UnquietCryptTurnedIn.cn:
墓穴终于平静了.

无论底下束缚着何种痛苦, 它都已松开了手. 安息或许能重回这片土地.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.en:
My name is Silas.

I am the keeper of this graveyard, a warden of memories and a tender of final rest.

I have watched over these stones for longer than I care to recall, ensuring the peace of those who reside here.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.ch:
我的名字是塞拉斯.

我是這座墓園的看守者, 記憶的守望人, 最終安息的照料者.

我守護這些墓碑的歲月, 久到我都不願回想, 只為確保長眠於此者的安寧.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.cn:
我的名字是塞拉斯.

我是这座墓园的看守者, 记忆的守望人, 最终安息的照料者.

我守护这些墓碑的岁月, 久到我都不愿回想, 只为确保长眠于此者的安宁.

UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.en:
This is my purpose.

The living have their bustling cities, and the departed... have this.

Someone must ensure their slumber is not disturbed by the... restless energies that cling to Callas Manor.

It is a quiet duty, but a necessary one.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.ch:
這是我的使命.

生者有他們熙攘的城市, 而逝者…有這裡.

總得有人確保他們的長眠不會被纏繞著卡拉斯莊園的那些…躁動能量所打擾.

這是份安靜的職責, 卻是必要的.
UI_CHSilas_Dialogue_WhyOutHere.cn:
这是我的使命.

生者有他们熙攘的城市, 而逝者…有这里.

总得有人确保他们的长眠不会被缠绕着卡拉斯庄园的那些…躁动能量所打扰.

这是份安静的职责, 却是必要的.

UI_CHTryHonestyArena_OccupiedSay.ch: 競技場目前有人使用中.

UI_CHTryHonestyArena_RankIncreasedSay.cn: 你的竞技场等级提升至 {rank}.

UI_CHTryHonestyArena_StartSay.ch: 踏入競技場, 證明你自己.

UI_CHTryHonestyArena_VictorySay.ch: 你獲勝了. ({count} 個靈魂碎片)
UI_CHTryHonestyArena_VictorySay.cn: 你获胜了. ({count} 个灵魂碎片)

UI_CHTryHonesty_ArenaUnavailableSay.en: The arena is not available right now.

UI_CHTryHonesty_Bubble_Intro.en: How delightful. Silas has sent me another mortal who thinks they're meant for more. Give me the invitation. We'll see what survives.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Bubble_Intro.ch: 真令人愉快. 塞拉斯又給我送來一個自以為命不止於此的凡人. 把邀請函給我. 我們來看看什麼能活下來.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Bubble_Intro.cn: 真令人愉快. 塞拉斯又给我送来一个自以为命不止于此的凡人. 把邀请函给我. 我们来看看什么能活下来.

UI_CHTryHonesty_DialogueOption_ArenaRank.ch: 我的競技場等級是多少?
UI_CHTryHonesty_DialogueOption_ArenaRank.cn: 我的竞技场等级是多少?

UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_ArenaRank.en: Your arena rank is shown below.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_ArenaRank.ch: 你的競技場等級顯示如下.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_ArenaRank.cn: 你的竞技场等级显示如下.

UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_DoYouEnjoyThis.en:
Enjoy? That's the word mortals use when someone finally does what they were made for.

I don't enjoy it. I am it.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_DoYouEnjoyThis.ch:
樂在其中? 那是凡人在某人終於做起與生俱來之事時所用的字眼.

我並不樂在其中. 我就是它本身.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_DoYouEnjoyThis.cn:
乐在其中? 那是凡人在某人终于做起与生俱来之事时所用的字眼.

我并不乐在其中. 我就是它本身.

UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_GentlemansWager.en:
You've got potential. A rare inconvenience. Most who enter my arena die too quickly to be of use to me.

The Curator and I once placed a gentleman's wager. A relic against the outcome of a bout. Then the match soured, a fountain was touched, and that shrivelled little priest of order decided the rules had been violated.

I say a fighter still breathing is a fighter still in the contest. He says otherwise. Naturally, he wrote the conclusion down and called it truth.

So he kept my stake. The Brass Bout Bell. Without it, the pit is mere spectacle. With it, the bout is sanctioned.

Go to him. Tell him I want the bell returned.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_GentlemansWager.ch:
你有潛力. 真是難得的麻煩. 大多數踏進我競技場的人都死得太快, 對我毫無用處.

我和館長曾經下過一場君子賭約. 以一件聖物押一場對決的結果. 後來比賽變了調, 有人碰了泉水, 那個乾癟的秩序小神父就認定規則被破壞了.

我說還在喘氣的鬥士, 就還在比賽之中. 他可不這麼認為. 理所當然地, 他把結論寫了下來, 還稱之為真理.

於是他扣下了我的賭注. 那只黃銅決鬥鈴鐺. 沒有它, 鬥坑只不過是場表演. 有了它, 對決才算名正言順.

去找他. 告訴他我要他把鈴鐺還回來.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_GentlemansWager.cn:
你有潜力. 真是难得的麻烦. 大多数踏进我竞技场的人都死得太快, 对我毫无用处.

我和馆长曾经下过一场君子赌约. 以一件圣物押一场对决的结果. 后来比赛变了味, 有人碰了泉水, 那个干瘪的秩序小神父就认定规则被破坏了.

我说还在喘气的斗士, 就还在比赛之中. 他可不这么认为. 理所当然地, 他把结论写了下来, 还称之为真理.

于是他扣下了我的赌注. 那只黄铜决斗铃铛. 没有它, 斗坑只不过是场表演. 有了它, 对决才算名正言顺.

去找他. 告诉他我要他把铃铛还回来.

UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.en:
Name's Try Honesty.

I build the trials that prove what you are and bury what you pretend to be.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.ch:
我叫誠試.

我打造試煉, 證明你是什麼, 並埋葬你假裝成為的模樣.
UI_CHTryHonesty_Dialogue_WhoAreYou.cn:
我叫诚试.

我打造试炼, 证明你是什么, 并埋葬你假装成为的模样.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_EntryLimit.ch: 這台 PDA 最多可儲存 40 筆紀錄.
UI_HSPPersonalLog_EntryLimit.cn: 这台 PDA 最多可保存 40 条记录.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_PDAUnavailable.ch: 必須將 PDA 裝備在主手.
UI_HSPPersonalLog_PDAUnavailable.cn: 必须将 PDA 装备在主手.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_RequestFailed.en: The log request failed. Please try again.
UI_HSPPersonalLog_RequestFailed.ch: 日誌請求失敗. 請再試一次.
UI_HSPPersonalLog_RequestFailed.cn: 日志请求失败. 请重试.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_SaveBeforeMap.en: Save the entry before opening the map.
UI_HSPPersonalLog_SaveBeforeMap.ch: 開啟地圖前請先儲存紀錄.
UI_HSPPersonalLog_SaveBeforeMap.cn: 打开地图前请先保存记录.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_SyncConflict.en: This PDA log was changed elsewhere. The latest version has been loaded.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_SyncConflict.cn: 这台 PDA 的日志已在其他地方更改. 已加载最新版本.

UI_HSPPersonalLog_UnsavedChanges.ch: 要捨棄未儲存的變更嗎?

UI_TTF_BCI_Option_FloatingBackgroundHove.cn: 仅在鼠标悬停时显示浮动背景

UI_NO_RVLifeLoaded.en: Interior map hasn't loaded.  Return to the vehicle now?
UI_NO_RVLifeLoaded.ch: 車內場景尚未載入, 是否立刻返回載具?
UI_NO_RVLifeLoaded.cn: 车内场景尚未加载, 是否立刻返回载具?

UI_RVLnoFreeSpawns.en: There are no more interiors available for this vehicle type.
UI_RVLnoFreeSpawns.ch: 該車型無內部空間可用.
UI_RVLnoFreeSpawns.cn: 该车型无内部空间可用.

UI_TTF_BF_Status_Bait_TT.en:
Bait Detection

Red: Your equipped fishing rod has no valid bait attached.

魚餌偵測
綠色: 你裝備的魚竿已掛上有效的魚餌.
紅色: 你裝備的魚竿沒有掛上有效的魚餌.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Bait_TT.cn:
诱饵检测
绿色: 你装备的鱼竿已挂上有效的诱饵.
红色: 你装备的鱼竿没有挂上有效的诱饵.

UI_TTF_BF_Status_BonusTime_TT.en:
Bonus Time
Green: You are currently inside the configured fishing bonus time window.
White: You are outside the bonus time window.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_BonusTime_TT.ch:
獎勵時段
綠色: 你目前處於設定的釣魚獎勵時段內.
白色: 你目前不在獎勵時段內.

奖励时段
绿色: 你当前处于设置的钓鱼奖励时段内.
白色: 你当前不在奖励时段内.

UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT.en:
Shore Detection
Red: Your current aim position is detected as near shore.
White: Your current aim position is not near shore.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT.ch:
岸邊偵測
紅色: 你目前的瞄準位置被判定為靠近岸邊.
白色: 你目前的瞄準位置不在岸邊附近.
UI_TTF_BF_Status_Shore_TT.cn:
岸边检测
红色: 你当前的瞄准位置被判定为靠近岸边.
白色: 你当前的瞄准位置不在岸边附近.

Weather Detection

天氣偵測
綠色: 目前的天氣有利於釣魚.

紅色: 目前的天氣不利於釣魚.

天气检测
绿色: 当前天气有利于钓鱼.
白色: 当前天气没有影响.
红色: 当前天气不利于钓鱼.

UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat.en: Disables the icon-only fishing status UI when a fishing rod is equipped.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat.ch: 裝備魚竿時, 停用僅顯示圖示的釣魚狀態介面.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_disableStat.cn: 装备鱼竿时, 禁用仅显示图标的钓鱼状态界面.

UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca.en: Changes the size of the fishing status UI.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca.ch: 變更釣魚狀態介面的大小.
UI_options_TTF_BetterFishing_statusUISca.cn: 更改钓鱼状态界面的大小.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_autoLockDela.en: How long a browsed inventory remains selected during active gameplay before snapping back to the Proximity/Corpse inventory. Paused time is not counted.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_autoLockDela.ch: 遊戲進行中, 瀏覽的物品欄保持選取多久後才彈回鄰近/屍體物品欄. 暫停時間不計入.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_autoLockDela.cn: 游戏进行中, 浏览的物品栏保持选中多长时间后才弹回邻近/尸体物品栏. 暂停时间不计入.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo.en: When enabled, locking is automatic. Players can browse other inventories until moving away or the configured delay expires.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo.ch: 啟用後, 鎖定會自動進行. 玩家可瀏覽其他物品欄, 直到走遠或設定的延遲時間到期.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo.cn: 启用后, 锁定将自动进行. 玩家可以浏览其他物品栏, 直到走远或设定的延迟时间到期.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableDualMo.en: Shows both Proximity and Corpses Only. Auto-Lock prefers Corpses Only while corpses are nearby. Corpse Only mode takes priority if both modes are enabled.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableDualMo.ch: 同時顯示鄰近與僅屍體. 附近有屍體時, 自動鎖定會優先選擇僅屍體. 若兩種模式皆啟用, 以僅屍體模式為優先.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableDualMo.cn: 同时显示邻近和仅尸体. 附近有尸体时, 自动锁定会优先选择仅尸体. 如果两种模式都启用, 以仅尸体模式为优先.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.en: When enabled, containers inside loot inventories are shown as additional container buttons.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.ch: 啟用後, 戰利品物品欄中的容器會顯示為額外的容器按鈕.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.cn: 启用后, 战利品物品栏中的容器会显示为额外的容器按钮.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.en: When enabled, containers inside the player inventory are shown as additional container buttons.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.ch: 啟用後, 玩家物品欄中的容器會顯示為額外的容器按鈕.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableNested.cn: 启用后, 玩家物品栏中的容器会显示为额外的容器按钮.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_hideIndividu.en: When Corpses Only or Dual Mode is active, hides individual corpse buttons and uses the Corpses Only inventory instead.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_hideIndividu.ch: 當僅屍體或雙重模式啟用時, 隱藏個別屍體按鈕, 改用僅屍體物品欄.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_hideIndividu.cn: 当仅尸体或双重模式启用时, 隐藏单个尸体按钮, 改用仅尸体物品栏.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.ch: 暫停後保留物品欄視窗
UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.cn: 暂停后保留物品栏窗口

UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.en: When enabled, inventory windows that were open before entering the pause menu are restored after returning to the game.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.ch: 啟用後, 進入暫停選單前已開啟的物品欄視窗會在回到遊戲後還原.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_preserveInve.cn: 启用后, 进入暂停菜单前已打开的物品栏窗口会在返回游戏后恢复.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_proximityInc.en: Active when Loot Nested Containers is enabled
UI_BetterContainers_Options_proximityInc.ch: 啟用戰利品巢狀容器時生效
UI_BetterContainers_Options_proximityInc.cn: 启用战利品嵌套容器时生效

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.ch: 僅在附近有屍體時顯示僅屍體
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.cn: 仅在附近有尸体时显示仅尸体

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.en: In Dual Mode, hides the Corpses Only button when no corpses are nearby. The Proximity button remains available.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.ch: 雙重模式下, 附近沒有屍體時隱藏僅屍體按鈕. 鄰近按鈕仍可使用.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showCorpsesO.cn: 双重模式下, 附近没有尸体时隐藏仅尸体按钮. 邻近按钮仍可使用.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.ch: 顯示已裝備/已掛載區塊
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.cn: 显示已装备/已挂载区域

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.en: When enabled, worn, held, attached hotbar items, and keyrings are grouped into one collapsible section in the player inventory.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.ch: 啟用後, 穿戴, 手持, 掛在快捷列上的物品以及鑰匙圈會歸入玩家物品欄中一個可摺疊的區塊.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showEquipped.cn: 启用后, 穿戴, 手持, 挂在快捷栏上的物品以及钥匙圈会归入玩家物品栏中一个可折叠的区域.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.en: Show Pinned Item Types on Player Inventory
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.ch: 在玩家物品欄顯示已固定的物品類型
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.cn: 在玩家物品栏显示已固定的物品类型

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.en: When enabled, pinned item types are also shown on the player inventory.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.ch: 啟用後, 已固定的物品類型也會顯示在玩家物品欄.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFavourit.cn: 启用后, 已固定的物品类型也会显示在玩家物品栏.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Show Freshness Bar for Spoilable Food
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 顯示易腐食物的新鮮度條
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 显示易腐食物的新鲜度条

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Shows remaining freshness from 100%% fresh to 0%% rotten, with a marker at the stale threshold.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 顯示剩餘新鮮度, 從 100%% 新鮮到 0%% 腐爛, 並在不新鮮的門檻處標示記號.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 显示剩余新鲜度, 从 100%% 新鲜到 0%% 腐烂, 并在不新鲜的阈值处显示标记.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Show Freshness Percentage for Spoilable Food
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 顯示易腐食物的新鮮度百分比
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 显示易腐食物的新鲜度百分比

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.en: Shows the remaining freshness percentage on hover and permanently for individual items in expanded stacks.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.ch: 滑鼠懸停時顯示剩餘新鮮度百分比, 展開堆疊中的個別物品則會持續顯示.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showFoodFres.cn: 鼠标悬停时显示剩余新鲜度百分比, 展开堆叠中的单个物品则会持续显示.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo.en: When enabled, nested container buttons show the icon of the container they are inside.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo.ch: 啟用後, 巢狀容器按鈕會顯示其所在容器的圖示.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showNestedCo.cn: 启用后, 嵌套容器按钮会显示其所在容器的图标.

UI_BetterContainers_Options_showWeightCo.en: Show stack and individual weights in inventory lists. Click the weight header to change sort direction.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showWeightCo.ch: 在物品欄清單中顯示堆疊與單個物品的重量. 點選重量標題可變更排序方向.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showWeightCo.cn: 在物品栏列表中显示堆叠和单个物品的重量. 点击重量标题可更改排序方向.

UI_Blacklist_Active.ch: 生效中的禁令 / 搜尋
UI_Blacklist_Active.cn: 生效中的禁令 / 搜索

UI_Blacklist_Err_Category.en: The server administrator has banned this item category from trading.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Category.ch: 伺服器管理員已禁止交易此物品類別.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Category.cn: 服务器管理员已禁止交易此物品类别.

UI_Blacklist_Err_Fluid.en: The server administrator has banned this liquid, including mixtures and other containers.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Fluid.ch: 伺服器管理員已禁止此液體, 包括其混合物與其他容器.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Fluid.cn: 服务器管理员已禁止此液体, 包括其混合物和其他容器.

UI_Blacklist_Err_Item.en: The server administrator has banned this item from trading.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Item.ch: 伺服器管理員已禁止交易此物品.
UI_Blacklist_Err_Item.cn: 服务器管理员已禁止交易此物品.

UI_Blacklist_Help.en: Rules apply immediately to sales and supply contracts. Listings are returned; open orders are refunded. Accepted contracts and paid deliveries continue. Category rules cover every item in that inventory category.
UI_Blacklist_Help.ch: 規則會立即套用於銷售與供貨合約. 已上架的商品會退回; 未成交的訂單會退款. 已接受的合約與已付款的交付會繼續進行. 類別規則涵蓋該物品欄類別中的所有物品.
UI_Blacklist_Help.cn: 规则会立即应用于销售和供货合同. 已上架的商品会退回; 未成交的订单会退款. 已接受的合同和已付款的交付会继续进行. 类别规则涵盖该物品栏类别中的所有物品.

UI_Blacklist_Inherited.en: Already blocked by category; an individual ban can also be added
UI_Blacklist_Inherited.ch: 已被類別規則封鎖; 仍可另外新增個別禁令
UI_Blacklist_Inherited.cn: 已被类别规则屏蔽; 仍可另外添加单独禁令

UI_Blacklist_Saved.en: Blacklist saved. Listings returned: {1}; open contracts refunded: {2}.
UI_Blacklist_Saved.ch: 黑名單已儲存. 退回的上架商品: {1}; 退款的未成交合約: {2}.
UI_Blacklist_Saved.cn: 黑名单已保存. 退回的上架商品: {1}; 退款的未成交合同: {2}.

UI_Contract_AdminPayout.en: Pay executor; refund remainder to customer
UI_Contract_AdminPayout.ch: 支付執行者; 剩餘款項退還委託人
UI_Contract_AdminPayout.cn: 支付执行者; 剩余款项退还委托人

UI_Contract_AgreedHours.en: Agreed real hours — work: {1}; service review: {2}.
UI_Contract_AgreedHours.ch: 約定的現實時數 — 工作: {1}; 服務審核: {2}.
UI_Contract_AgreedHours.cn: 约定的现实时数 — 工作: {1}; 服务审核: {2}.

UI_Contract_Amount.ch: 數量 / 公升 (最多 3 位小數)
UI_Contract_Amount.cn: 数量 / 升 (最多 3 位小数)

UI_Contract_CatalogueEmpty.en: No matches. Change the search or category.
UI_Contract_CatalogueEmpty.ch: 沒有符合的結果. 請變更搜尋內容或類別.
UI_Contract_CatalogueEmpty.cn: 没有匹配的结果. 请更改搜索内容或类别.

UI_Contract_CatalogueResults.en: Found: {1} — up to 50 items per page
UI_Contract_CatalogueResults.ch: 找到: {1} — 每頁最多 50 個物品
UI_Contract_CatalogueResults.cn: 找到: {1} — 每页最多 50 个物品

UI_Contract_CatalogueSearchHelp.en: Search by name or item ID. Multiple words can be entered in any order.
UI_Contract_CatalogueSearchHelp.ch: 依名稱或物品 ID 搜尋. 可輸入多個關鍵字, 順序不拘.
UI_Contract_CatalogueSearchHelp.cn: 按名称或物品 ID 搜索. 可输入多个关键词, 顺序不限.

UI_Contract_Err_AcceptLimit.en: Your active assignment limit has been reached.
UI_Contract_Err_AcceptLimit.ch: 你進行中的任務已達上限.
UI_Contract_Err_AcceptLimit.cn: 你进行中的任务已达上限.

UI_Contract_Err_Payout.en: Enter a valid payout, no greater than the reserved reward, with at most two decimal places.
UI_Contract_Err_Payout.ch: 請輸入有效的支付金額, 不得超過預留的報酬, 且最多兩位小數.
UI_Contract_Err_Payout.cn: 请输入有效的支付金额, 不得超过预留的报酬, 且最多两位小数.

UI_Contract_Err_Requirements.en: Invalid requirements. Check the type, quantity and percentages. Use liquid orders for liquid containers; restricted items cannot be ordered.
UI_Contract_Err_Requirements.ch: 需求無效. 請檢查類型、數量與百分比. 液體容器請使用液體訂單; 受限物品無法訂購.
UI_Contract_Err_Requirements.cn: 需求无效. 请检查类型、数量和百分比. 液体容器请使用液体订单; 受限物品无法订购.

UI_NMS_Help.en: <H1> Nutrition <LINE> <TEXT> Food does three things: it fills your <RGB:0.86,0.76,0.52> stomach <RGB:1,1,1> , it tops up your <RGB:0.95,0.72,0.35> energy <RGB:1,1,1> , and it supplies <RGB:0.62,0.78,0.58> protein <RGB:1,1,1> . Food tooltips show all three as pips. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Stomach <LINE> <TEXT> One pip is about one hour of fullness. Bulky, fatty and protein-rich food keeps you full longer than sugary snacks with the same calories. While your stomach has food in it you are Well Fed and wounds heal a little faster. A stomach holds about five hours; eating past that is wasted. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Hunger <LINE> <TEXT> Hunger returns gradually as the stomach empties, and faster when your energy reserve is low. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Energy <LINE> <TEXT> One pip is about 250 kcal. Hard work burns more. A small surplus is stored as fat and a deficit is drawn from fat, so your weight follows what you eat over weeks. Below zero your body is running on empty and malnourishment builds. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Protein <LINE> <TEXT> One pip is about 10 g. Protein slowly runs down every day. Meat, fish, eggs, beans, nuts and dairy restore it. Staying deficient causes malnourishment even if you eat enough calories. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Malnourishment <LINE> <TEXT> Builds over days when you are short on calories or protein, and fades over a day or two once you eat properly. It slows stamina recovery and healing. The faint bar shows where it is heading. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Weight <LINE> <TEXT> Changes slowly. The coloured bands are where weight traits change: underweight below 75 kg, overweight above 85 kg.
UI_NMS_Help.ch: <H1> 營養 <LINE> <TEXT> 食物有三種作用: 填飽你的 <RGB:0.86,0.76,0.52> 胃 <RGB:1,1,1> , 補充你的 <RGB:0.95,0.72,0.35> 能量 <RGB:1,1,1> , 並提供 <RGB:0.62,0.78,0.58> 蛋白質 <RGB:1,1,1> . 食物提示會以刻度格顯示這三項. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 胃 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格約等於一小時的飽足感. 體積大, 油脂多與富含蛋白質的食物, 比熱量相同的含糖零食更耐餓. 胃裡有食物時, 你會處於「吃飽了」狀態, 傷口癒合也會稍微加快. 胃大約能容納五小時的份量, 超過的部分會被浪費. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 飢餓 <LINE> <TEXT> 隨著胃逐漸排空, 飢餓感會慢慢回來, 能量儲備偏低時回來得更快. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 能量 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格約為 250 kcal. 勞動越繁重, 消耗越多. 少量盈餘會轉為脂肪囤積, 不足時則從脂肪中提取, 因此你的體重會在數週內隨飲食而變化. 低於零時, 你的身體已能量耗盡, 營養不良會逐漸累積. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 蛋白質 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格約為 10 g. 蛋白質每天都會慢慢減少. 肉, 魚, 蛋, 豆類, 堅果與乳製品可以補充. 長期缺乏蛋白質, 即使熱量攝取足夠也會導致營養不良. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 營養不良 <LINE> <TEXT> 熱量或蛋白質不足時, 會在數天內逐漸累積, 恢復正常飲食後約一兩天內消退. 它會減緩耐力恢復與傷口癒合. 淡色條顯示它的變化趨勢. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 體重 <LINE> <TEXT> 變化緩慢. 彩色區段是體重特質改變的分界: 低於 75 kg 為體重過輕, 高於 85 kg 為體重過重.
UI_NMS_Help.cn: <H1> 营养 <LINE> <TEXT> 食物有三种作用: 填饱你的 <RGB:0.86,0.76,0.52> 胃 <RGB:1,1,1> , 补充你的 <RGB:0.95,0.72,0.35> 能量 <RGB:1,1,1> , 并提供 <RGB:0.62,0.78,0.58> 蛋白质 <RGB:1,1,1> . 食物提示会以格子显示这三项. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 胃 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格约等于一小时的饱腹感. 体积大, 油脂多和富含蛋白质的食物, 比热量相同的含糖零食更耐饿. 胃里有食物时, 你会处于“吃饱了”状态, 伤口愈合也会稍微加快. 胃大约能容纳五小时的量, 超出的部分会被浪费. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 饥饿 <LINE> <TEXT> 随着胃逐渐排空, 饥饿感会慢慢回来, 能量储备偏低时回来得更快. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 能量 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格约为 250 kcal. 劳动越繁重, 消耗越多. 少量盈余会转化为脂肪囤积, 不足时则从脂肪中提取, 因此你的体重会在数周内随饮食而变化. 低于零时, 你的身体已经能量耗尽, 营养不良会逐渐累积. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 蛋白质 <LINE> <TEXT> 一格约为 10 g. 蛋白质每天都会慢慢减少. 肉, 鱼, 蛋, 豆类, 坚果和乳制品可以补充. 长期缺乏蛋白质, 即使热量摄入足够也会导致营养不良. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 营养不良 <LINE> <TEXT> 热量或蛋白质不足时, 会在数天内逐渐累积, 恢复正常饮食后约一两天内消退. 它会减缓耐力恢复和伤口愈合. 淡色条显示它的变化趋势. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 体重 <LINE> <TEXT> 变化缓慢. 彩色区段是体重特质改变的分界: 低于 75 kg 为体重过轻, 高于 85 kg 为体重过重.

UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Backup.en: BACKUPS: It is strongly recommended that you make frequent backups of your save file. You have only one life and cannot respawn. Additionally, game crashes may corrupt your save file, leaving you with no way to recover your progress. Save folders are located in the Zomboid/Saves directory.

UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Diff.en: IT'S DIFFERENT: Do not expect the usual experience as this this mod significantly changes the game. It's a lore rich, quest based, narrative-driven adventure in which you not only have to survive, but also protect other human being. Some mechanics of the game have been altered or removed, some sandbox options are overridden. But be sure that there are many new features to explore.
UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Diff.ch: 截然不同: 別期待平常的遊戲體驗, 因為此 MOD 大幅改變了遊戲. 這是一場背景故事豐富、以任務為主、劇情導向的冒險, 你不只要生存, 還要保護另一個人. 遊戲的部分機制已被修改或移除, 部分沙盒選項會被覆寫. 但請放心, 還有許多新功能等你探索.
UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Diff.cn: 截然不同: 别期待平常的游戏体验, 因为此 MOD 大幅改变了游戏. 这是一场背景故事丰富、以任务为主、剧情驱动的冒险, 你不仅要生存, 还要保护另一个人. 游戏的部分机制已被修改或移除, 部分沙盒选项会被覆盖. 但请放心, 还有许多新功能等你探索.

UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Enjoy.en: HAVE FUN: Your adventure will be hard, yet if you endure, you will reveal the origin of the Ark and the secret of Knox Infection. Feel free to leave feedback or seek help on Steam or Discord. Endure!

UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Enjoy.cn: 玩得开心: 你的冒险会很艰难, 但只要坚持下去, 你就能揭开方舟的起源与诺克斯感染的秘密. 欢迎到 Steam 或 Discord 留下反馈或寻求帮助. 坚持下去!

UI_optionscreen_BWOA_Mods.en: MODS: This mod may conflict with other mods. Avoid mods that alter zombie behavior, as well as those that change the appearance of zombies or the player. Mods that add new vehicles, items, or clothing may not work as intended.

UI_BN_DismissConfirm.en:
Dismiss %1?

They will stop taking orders, stop using their assigned spots,
wander off on their own and no longer be protected.

(Routines and schedules run AUTOMATICALLY while they stay
recruited - you never need to dismiss them for that.)
UI_BN_DismissConfirm.ch:
解散 %1?

對方將不再聽從命令, 不再使用指派的地點,
會自行四處遊蕩, 也不再受到保護.

(只要對方仍處於招募狀態, 日常活動與行程都會「自動」執行
- 你完全不需要為此解散同伴.)

解散 %1?

- 你完全不需要为此解散同伴.)
