UI_RPT_StoreAction.ch: 正將丙烷存入工業儲罐
UI_RPT_StoreAction.cn: 正在将丙烷存入工业储罐

UI_RPT_StoreItemInDepot.ch: 將攜帶的丙烷存入儲罐
UI_RPT_StoreItemInDepot.cn: 将携带的丙烷存入储罐

UI_RPT_StoreVehicleInDepot.en: Store nearby truck propane in tank
UI_RPT_StoreVehicleInDepot.ch: 將附近丙烷車的丙烷存入儲罐
UI_RPT_StoreVehicleInDepot.cn: 将附近丙烷车的丙烷存入储罐

UI_CU_CrudeBroke.ch: 你的木製義肢碎裂解體了
UI_CU_CrudeBroke.cn: 你的木制假肢碎裂散架了

UI_CU_CrudeWarn.ch: 你的木製義肢正在碎裂
UI_CU_CrudeWarn.cn: 你的木制假肢正在开裂

UI_CU_TooHeavyForTeeth.en: Too heavy to lift in your teeth.
UI_CU_TooHeavyForTeeth.ch: 太重了, 無法用牙齒叼起來.
UI_CU_TooHeavyForTeeth.cn: 太重了, 没法用牙齿叼起来.

UI_FNVG_Brightness_tooltip.en: How strong the night vision overlay is. Higher values make the view brighter
UI_FNVG_Brightness_tooltip.ch: 夜視疊加效果的強度. 數值越高, 畫面越亮
UI_FNVG_Brightness_tooltip.cn: 夜视叠加效果的强度. 数值越高, 画面越亮

UI_HCTS_OptAlwaysQuick_TT.en: Every get-up from the ground or furniture uses the quick animation, however it is started (moving, the right-click menu, keybinds). The Crouch double-tap works either way.
UI_HCTS_OptAlwaysQuick_TT.ch: 從地上或家具起身時一律使用快速動畫, 不論是以何種方式觸發 (移動、右鍵選單、按鍵綁定). 雙擊蹲下鍵在兩種設定下都有效.
UI_HCTS_OptAlwaysQuick_TT.cn: 从地上或家具起身时一律使用快速动画, 无论以何种方式触发 (移动、右键菜单、按键绑定). 双击下蹲键在两种设置下都有效.

UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyMagazineReset.en: The mark is gone. It is just a magazine.
UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyMagazineReset.ch: 銘印消失了. 它只是個普通的彈匣.
UI_VorpallySauced_NotifyMagazineReset.cn: 铭印消失了. 它只是个普通的弹匣.

UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeDesc.en: Strips the mark. The magazine goes back to holding %1. Nothing comes back.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeDesc.ch: 剝除銘印. 彈匣容量恢復為 %1. 失去的不會再回來.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeDesc.cn: 剥除铭印. 弹匣容量恢复为 %1. 失去的不会再回来.

UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeNeedEmpty.en: Empty it first. There are still %1 rounds in there.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeNeedEmpty.ch: 先把它清空. 裡面還有 %1 發子彈.
UI_VorpallySauced_UnmakeNeedEmpty.cn: 先把它清空. 里面还有 %1 发子弹.

UI_ST_DescKeyOrigin.en: Keys: which building the key opens and the street it is on
UI_ST_DescKeyOrigin.ch: 鑰匙: 可開啟哪棟建築及其所在街道
UI_ST_DescKeyOrigin.cn: 钥匙: 能打开哪栋建筑及其所在街道

UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensMany.en: This key also fits %1 other buildings
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensMany.ch: 這把鑰匙也能開啟另外 %1 棟建築
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensMany.cn: 这把钥匙也能打开另外 %1 栋建筑

UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensOne.en: This key also fits one other building
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensOne.ch: 這把鑰匙也能開啟另外一棟建築
UI_ST_KeyAlsoOpensOne.cn: 这把钥匙也能打开另外一栋建筑

UI_FNVG_Color_tooltip.en: The color of the night vision overlay

UI_LPP_Notice_CrowRemoved.en:
Livestock Panel Plus update

The rooster crow is no longer part of Livestock Panel Plus.
It is now only in the standalone mod Rooster Crow.
To keep roosters crowing, subscribe to Rooster Crow on the Steam Workshop and enable it.
If you already use Rooster Crow, nothing changes.
UI_LPP_Notice_CrowRemoved.ch:
牲畜面板增強版更新

公雞啼叫功能已不再屬於牲畜面板增強版.
現在只收錄在獨立模組 Rooster Crow 中.
若想讓公雞繼續啼叫, 請在 Steam 工作坊訂閱 Rooster Crow 並啟用它.
如果你已經在使用 Rooster Crow, 則不受任何影響.
UI_LPP_Notice_CrowRemoved.cn:
牲畜面板增强版更新

公鸡打鸣功能已不再属于牲畜面板增强版.
现在只包含在独立模组 Rooster Crow 中.
若想让公鸡继续打鸣, 请在 Steam 创意工坊订阅 Rooster Crow 并启用它.
如果你已经在使用 Rooster Crow, 则不受任何影响.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessBusy.en: One of the players already has a Chess invitation.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessBusy.ch: 其中一名玩家已經有西洋棋邀請了.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessBusy.cn: 其中一名玩家已经有国际象棋邀请了.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDeclined.cn: 国际象棋邀请已被拒绝.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnected.en: A player left the Chess game. Start a new multiplayer game to play again.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnected.ch: 有玩家離開了西洋棋對局. 開始新的多人對局即可再次遊玩.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnected.cn: 有玩家离开了国际象棋对局. 开始新的多人对局即可再次游玩.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedDevice.en: A PalmPilot was put away, lost power, or had Beam disabled. Start a new multiplayer game to play again.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedDevice.ch: 有台 PalmPilot 被收起、沒電, 或停用了紅外線傳輸. 開始新的多人對局即可再次遊玩.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedDevice.cn: 有台 PalmPilot 被收起、没电, 或禁用了红外传输. 开始新的多人对局即可再次游玩.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedRange.en: Players moved too far apart. Stay within 3 tiles on the same floor. Start a new multiplayer game to play again.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedRange.ch: 玩家之間距離太遠. 請待在同一樓層的 3 格範圍內. 開始新的多人對局即可再次遊玩.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessDisconnectedRange.cn: 玩家之间距离太远. 请待在同一楼层的 3 格范围内. 开始新的多人对局即可再次游玩.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessMPOnly.en: Multiplayer Chess requires a hosted or multiplayer game.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMPOnly.ch: 多人西洋棋只能在自架主機或多人遊戲中進行.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMPOnly.cn: 多人国际象棋只能在自建主机或多人游戏中进行.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessMenuHint.en: Solo games are saved. Multiplayer starts fresh.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMenuHint.ch: 單人對局會儲存進度. 多人對局每次都會重新開始.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessMenuHint.cn: 单人对局会保存进度. 多人对局每次都会重新开始.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessNoPlayers.en: No nearby player has a powered PalmPilot in hand.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessNoPlayers.ch: 附近沒有玩家手上拿著已開機的 PalmPilot.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessNoPlayers.cn: 附近没有玩家手持已开机的 PalmPilot.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessOffer.en: %1 invites you to play Chess on your PalmPilot.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessOffer.ch: %1 邀請你在 PalmPilot 上下西洋棋.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessOffer.cn: %1 邀请你在 PalmPilot 上下国际象棋.

UI_PalmPilots_ChessUnavailable.en: Chess player or PalmPilot is unavailable or out of range.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessUnavailable.ch: 西洋棋玩家或 PalmPilot 無法使用, 或已超出範圍.
UI_PalmPilots_ChessUnavailable.cn: 国际象棋玩家或 PalmPilot 不可用, 或已超出范围.

UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects.en: Configure muzzle and shell-ejection effects independently from weapon sounds.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects.ch: 可獨立於武器音效, 單獨設定槍口與拋殼特效.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects.cn: 可独立于武器音效, 单独配置枪口与抛壳特效.

UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too.en: Show muzzle flash and smoke when firing. Disable to hide this visual effect.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too.ch: 開火時顯示槍口火光與煙霧. 關閉則隱藏此視覺效果.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too.cn: 开火时显示枪口火光与烟雾. 关闭则隐藏此视觉效果.

UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t.en: Eject spent shell casings that fall to the ground. Disable to stop spawning casings.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t.ch: 射擊時拋出彈殼並掉落在地上. 關閉則不再生成彈殼.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t.cn: 射击时抛出弹壳并掉落在地上. 关闭则不再生成弹壳.

UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too.en: Adjust the volume of shell casings hitting the ground. 0 mutes it, 0.5 is the default, and 2 is double volume.
UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too.ch: 調整彈殼落地的音量. 0為靜音, 0.5為預設, 2為兩倍音量.
UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too.cn: 调整弹壳落地的音量. 0为静音, 0.5为默认, 2为两倍音量.

UI_NEQ_options_disable_tooltip.en: For you only: no figure button, no panel, no shortcut, and the inventory list is drawn by the game again. Saved outfits are kept. Useful on a server where the mod is required.
UI_NEQ_options_disable_tooltip.ch: 只對你自己生效: 不顯示人物按鈕與面板, 快捷鍵也會失效, 物品欄清單改回由遊戲原本的方式繪製. 已儲存的套裝會保留. 適合在必須安裝此模組的伺服器上使用.
UI_NEQ_options_disable_tooltip.cn: 仅对你自己生效: 不显示人物按钮和面板, 快捷键也会失效, 物品栏列表改回由游戏原本的方式绘制. 已保存的套装会保留. 适合在必须安装此模组的服务器上使用.

UI_NEQ_options_reset_geometry_tooltip.en: Puts the panel back on the inventory at its starting size. Use it if the panel has grown past the edge of the screen.
UI_NEQ_options_reset_geometry_tooltip.ch: 把面板以初始大小放回物品欄上. 若面板已經大到超出螢幕邊緣, 可使用此項.
UI_NEQ_options_reset_geometry_tooltip.cn: 将面板以初始大小放回物品栏上. 如果面板已经大到超出屏幕边缘, 可使用此项.

UI_options_AWCWF_desc_thermal.ch: 熱成像瞄準鏡掃描最佳化 (由 Gogumi 製作). 選擇你本機的標記樣式; 其他玩家保留各自的設定.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_thermal.cn: 热成像瞄准镜扫描优化 (由 Gogumi 制作). 选择你本地的标记样式; 其他玩家保留各自的设置.

UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_marker_mode_too.en:
Both styles use the optimized scanner.
 Classic keeps detected markers.
 Visibility Fade holds markers for 150 ms, then 
fades them over 350 ms after losing sight.
 Apply a style change to clear current markers.
 Your choice is saved on this computer.
UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_marker_mode_too.ch: 兩種樣式都使用最佳化的掃描器. 「經典」會保留已偵測到的標記. 「可見度淡出」會在失去視線後讓標記停留 150 毫秒, 再於 350 毫秒內淡出. 套用樣式變更會清除目前的標記. 你的選擇會儲存在這台電腦上.
UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_marker_mode_too.cn: 两种样式都使用优化后的扫描器. “经典”会保留已检测到的标记. “可见度淡出”会在失去视线后让标记停留 150 毫秒, 再在 350 毫秒内淡出. 应用样式更改会清除当前的标记. 你的选择会保存在这台电脑上.

UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_mode_classic.ch: 最佳化 - 經典標記 (預設)
UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_mode_classic.cn: 优化 - 经典标记 (默认)

UI_options_AWCWF_thermal_mode_fade.ch: 最佳化 - 可見度淡出

UI_FamilyZMedicine_NoteConflict.en: This note changed since you opened it. Refresh it before editing again.
UI_FamilyZMedicine_NoteConflict.ch: 此紀錄在你開啟後已被更改. 請先重新整理再編輯.
UI_FamilyZMedicine_NoteConflict.cn: 此记录在你打开后已被更改. 请先刷新再编辑.

UI_NEQ_options_match_cleanui_tooltip.en: The panel and the wardrobe use CleanUI's own frame and the background opacity set in CleanUI's options, so they match the inventory. The opacity slider is not used while this is on. Needs CleanUI.
UI_NEQ_options_match_cleanui_tooltip.ch: 面板與衣櫥會使用 CleanUI 本身的外框, 以及 CleanUI 選項中設定的背景不透明度, 讓外觀與物品欄一致. 開啟此項時不會使用不透明度滑桿. 需要 CleanUI.
UI_NEQ_options_match_cleanui_tooltip.cn: 面板和衣橱会使用 CleanUI 自身的边框, 以及 CleanUI 选项中设置的背景不透明度, 使外观与物品栏一致. 开启此项时不会使用不透明度滑块. 需要 CleanUI.

UI_NEQ_options_panel_opacity_tooltip.en: How solid the background of the panel and the wardrobe is. 100 is fully opaque; lower lets the game show through.
UI_NEQ_options_panel_opacity_tooltip.ch: 面板與衣櫥背景的不透明程度. 100 為完全不透明; 數值越低, 越能透出後方的遊戲畫面.
UI_NEQ_options_panel_opacity_tooltip.cn: 面板和衣橱背景的不透明程度. 100 为完全不透明; 数值越低, 越能透出后方的游戏画面.

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagBalloo.en:
Adds a balloon attachment slot to bags that can be equipped on the back.
Changing this option requires reloading your save data.
If an equipped bag does not match the current setting, unequip and re-equip it.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagBalloo.ch:
為可背在背上的背包新增氣球掛載欄位.
更改此設定後需要重新載入存檔資料.
如果已裝備的背包與目前設定不符, 請卸下後重新裝備.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagBalloo.cn:
为可背在背上的背包添加气球挂载栏位.
更改此设置后需要重新加载存档数据.
如果已装备的背包与当前设置不符, 请卸下后重新装备.

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagCarabi.en:
Adds left- and right-side carabiner attachment slots to supported bags.
Changing this option requires reloading your save data.
If an equipped bag does not match the current setting, unequip and re-equip it.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagCarabi.ch:
為支援的背包新增左右兩側的登山扣掛載欄位.
更改此設定後需要重新載入存檔資料.
如果已裝備的背包與目前設定不符, 請卸下後重新裝備.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_BackBagCarabi.cn:
为支持的背包添加左右两侧的登山扣挂载栏位.
更改此设置后需要重新加载存档数据.
如果已装备的背包与当前设置不符, 请卸下后重新装备.

UI_KnoxGPS_OptCarsTip.en: Steering wheel where you left each vehicle. The mark clears itself when you get back in.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptCarsTip.ch: 在你停放每輛車的位置顯示方向盤圖示. 你回到車上時標記會自動清除.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptCarsTip.cn: 在你停放每辆车的位置显示方向盘图标. 你回到车上时标记会自动清除.

UI_KnoxGPS_OptVisitedTip.en: Small check mark on every building this character has walked into. Zoom in to see them.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptVisitedTip.ch: 在此角色走進過的每棟建築上顯示小勾號. 放大地圖即可看到.
UI_KnoxGPS_OptVisitedTip.cn: 在此角色走进过的每栋建筑上显示小勾号. 放大地图即可看到.

UI_EPR_BlackoutVolume_tooltip.en: Volume of the sounds a power outage makes, on top of Sound Volume: the breaker, the crackle of flickering lights, power coming back, alarms and lightning strikes. 0 mutes them.
UI_EPR_BlackoutVolume_tooltip.ch: 停電時各種音效的音量, 會再疊加在「音量」之上: 斷路器跳脫、燈光閃爍的劈啪聲、恢復供電、警報與雷擊. 設為0則靜音.
UI_EPR_BlackoutVolume_tooltip.cn: 停电时各种音效的音量, 会再叠加在“音量”之上: 断路器跳闸、灯光闪烁的噼啪声、恢复供电、警报与雷击. 设为0则静音.

UI_EPR_Menu_PumpNoPower.en: No power here. Start a generator nearby first.
UI_EPR_Menu_PumpNoPower.ch: 此處沒有電力. 請先啟動附近的發電機.
UI_EPR_Menu_PumpNoPower.cn: 此处没有电力. 请先启动附近的发电机.

UI_EPR_Menu_StartPumpTT.en: Pumps this tank's water through the building's pipes. Sinks, toilets and showers here keep running while a generator powers the tank.
UI_EPR_Menu_StartPumpTT.ch: 將此水箱的水抽送進建築的管線. 只要有發電機為水箱供電, 這裡的水槽、馬桶與淋浴間就能持續供水.
UI_EPR_Menu_StartPumpTT.cn: 将此水箱的水抽送进建筑的管道. 只要有发电机为水箱供电, 这里的水槽、马桶和淋浴间就能持续供水.

UI_EPR_Menu_StopPumpTT.en: Stops pumping this tank's water through the building's pipes.
UI_EPR_Menu_StopPumpTT.ch: 停止將此水箱的水抽送進建築的管線.
UI_EPR_Menu_StopPumpTT.cn: 停止将此水箱的水抽送进建筑的管道.

UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_floor.en: player built only, replaced with the ground next door
UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_floor.ch: 僅限玩家建造的, 會換成相鄰的地面
UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_floor.cn: 仅限玩家建造的, 替换为相邻的地面

UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_loot.ch: 真正的物品, 移除後永久消失
UI_Aegis_ClearCatSub_loot.cn: 真实物品, 移除后永久消失

UI_Aegis_ClearCatsHint.en: Only what actually stands in the area is listed.
UI_Aegis_ClearCatsHint.ch: 只會列出此區域內實際存在的東西.
UI_Aegis_ClearCatsHint.cn: 仅列出该区域内实际存在的内容.

UI_Aegis_ClearChunkFull.en: At most %1 chunks at a time.

UI_Aegis_ClearChunkHint.en: Click chunks to pick or drop them, Enter clears, Escape cancels
UI_Aegis_ClearChunkHint.ch: 點選區塊以選取或取消選取, Enter 清除, Escape 取消
UI_Aegis_ClearChunkHint.cn: 点击区块以选择或取消选择, Enter清理, Escape取消

UI_Aegis_ClearChunkTooltip.en: Pick whole chunks (8x8 tiles each) by clicking them. Clicking a picked chunk again drops it. Enter clears them, Escape cancels.

UI_RMMP_TraitRules.en: Cognition controls door opening. Sight and hearing each use a separate deterministic roll per zombie. Chances are thresholds, not weights: best, normal, poor, then random. Unmatched rolls use sandbox defaults. Good/Pinpoint Hearing and Bad/Poor senses are aliases; the higher chance wins. Overlapping regions use the highest chance per property. Blank fields inherit category properties, then sandbox defaults.
UI_RMMP_TraitRules.ch: 感知控制開門. 視覺與聽覺各自對每隻殭屍使用獨立的確定性擲點. 機率是門檻而非權重: 依序為最佳, 正常, 差, 最後是隨機. 未落入任何門檻的擲點使用沙盒預設值. 聽覺好與精確聽覺, 以及感官的差與弱互為別名, 取較高的機率. 重疊的區域在每個屬性上取最高機率. 空白欄位先繼承類別屬性, 再沿用沙盒預設值.
UI_RMMP_TraitRules.cn: 感知控制开门. 视觉和听觉各自对每只僵尸使用独立的确定性掷点. 概率是阈值而非权重: 依次为最佳, 正常, 差, 最后是随机. 未落入任何阈值的掷点使用沙盒默认值. 好听觉与精确听觉, 以及感官的差与弱互为别名, 取较高的概率. 重叠区域在每个属性上取最高概率. 空白字段先继承类别属性, 再使用沙盒默认值.

UI_ArcadiaShore_InteriorPowerNotLoaded.en: Enter the RV once to finish initializing its power system, then refresh and connect again. No shore power was granted.

UI_ArcadiaShore_InteriorPowerNotLoaded.cn: 请先进入房车一次以完成其电力系统的初始化, 然后刷新并重新连接. 未供应岸电.

UI_ArcadiaShore_InteriorPowerNotReady.en: RV power has not finished loading or settling. Refresh and try connecting again; no power was granted.
UI_ArcadiaShore_InteriorPowerNotReady.ch: 房車電力尚未完成載入或結算. 請重新整理後再試著連接; 未供應任何電力.
UI_ArcadiaShore_InteriorPowerNotReady.cn: 房车电力尚未完成加载或结算. 请刷新后再尝试连接; 未供应任何电力.

UI_ArcadiaShore_NoReadyBatteryBay.en: No battery bay is ready inside this RV. Place a Battery Bay if none is installed; otherwise enter the RV and let its contents load, then refresh and connect again.
UI_ArcadiaShore_NoReadyBatteryBay.ch: 此房車內沒有就緒的電池艙. 若尚未安裝, 請放置一座電池艙; 否則請進入房車並等待其內容物載入, 然後重新整理並再次連接.

UI_IconsInventory_options_enableDpadCont.en: Up on first row to go to previous, down on last to go next
UI_IconsInventory_options_enableDpadCont.ch: 在第一列按上切換到上一個, 在最後一列按下切換到下一個
UI_IconsInventory_options_enableDpadCont.cn: 在第一行按上切换到上一个, 在最后一行按下切换到下一个

UI_optionscreen_KBW_ShowUnlearnedRecipes.en: Show recipes you have not learned yet
List magazine recipes before you read the magazine, locked, with the magazine or skill level that unlocks them. Turn this off to hide them until learned.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_ShowUnlearnedRecipes.ch: 在閱讀雜誌之前就列出雜誌配方, 以鎖定狀態顯示, 並標示可解鎖它們的雜誌或技能等級. 關閉此選項則會將它們隱藏, 直到學會為止.

UI_UO_StatusMismatch.cn: 已暂停: 宽度不一致

UI_UO_StatusMismatchTip.cn: 已保留原始结果. 清除缓存的测量数据后重新计算, 结果仍然不同. 请保存报告并附上游戏版本和模组列表.

UI_UO_StatusScanTip.cn: UO 无法读取已启用的模组列表. 请保存报告并检查 console.txt.

UI_UO_StatusUnavailableTip.cn: 请开始世界会话. 若问题持续, 请替换整个模组文件夹并重新启动.

UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuilds.ch: 實驗性: 允許未驗證的 B42 版本
UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuilds.cn: 实验性: 允许未验证的 B42 版本

UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuildsTip.en: Off by default. On unverified B42 builds, compare every nonempty calculation with the original. Extra checks add work and do not establish full compatibility. Known mod guards remain active.
UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuildsTip.ch: 預設關閉. 在未驗證的 B42 版本上, 將每次非空的計算與原始計算比對. 額外檢查會增加負擔, 且無法確保完全相容. 已知 MOD 的防護仍會生效.
UI_UO_allowUnverifiedBuildsTip.cn: 默认关闭. 在未验证的 B42 版本上, 将每次非空的计算与原始计算比对. 额外检查会增加开销, 且无法确保完全兼容. 已知模组的防护仍会生效.

UI_UO_menuTimingTip.en: Optional millisecond timing for cached and original calculations. For an OFF run, disable caching while leaving timing enabled. Zero samples can represent sub-millisecond calls. Suspended for known overlapping optimizers.
UI_UO_menuTimingTip.ch: 選用的毫秒計時, 用於快取與原始計算. 若要進行 OFF 測試, 請停用快取但保持計時啟用. 測得 0 毫秒的樣本可能代表不到 1 毫秒的呼叫. 遇到已知的重疊最佳化 MOD 時會暫停.
UI_UO_menuTimingTip.cn: 可选的毫秒计时, 用于缓存和原始计算. 若要进行 OFF 测试, 请禁用缓存但保持计时启用. 测得 0 毫秒的样本可能代表不到 1 毫秒的调用. 遇到已知的重叠优化模组时会暂停.

UI_UO_periodicReportsTip.en: Also write during play at the selected interval. Requires automatic start/end reports. Off by default to reduce disk activity.
UI_UO_periodicReportsTip.ch: 遊玩期間也依所選間隔寫入報告. 需要啟用自動開始/結束報告. 預設關閉以減少磁碟活動.
UI_UO_periodicReportsTip.cn: 游玩期间也按所选间隔写入报告. 需要启用“自动会话报告”. 默认关闭以减少磁盘活动.

UI_UO_reportIntervalSecondsTip.en: 60 to 900 real seconds. Used only when periodic reports are enabled.

UI_UO_reportIntervalSecondsTip.cn: 现实时间 60 到 900 秒. 仅在启用定期报告时使用.

UI_HP_HeartPill.ch: 止痛藥讓胸口的壓迫感稍微舒緩了一些
UI_HP_HeartPill.cn: 止痛药让胸口的压迫感稍微缓解了一些

UI_HP_HeartSafe.en: The pressure in your chest is finally gone
UI_HP_HeartSafe.ch: 胸口的壓迫感終於消失了
UI_HP_HeartSafe.cn: 胸口的压迫感终于消失了

UI_HP_HeartWarn.en: A heavy pressure in your chest spreads down your left arm... I need a painkiller, now.
UI_HP_HeartWarn.ch: 胸口一陣沉重的壓迫感, 一路蔓延到左手臂… 我現在就需要止痛藥.
UI_HP_HeartWarn.cn: 胸口一阵沉重的压迫感, 一路蔓延到左臂… 我现在就需要止痛药.

UI_HP_Hottie.ch: 哎… 髒比辣妹從來不會讓人失望!
UI_HP_Hottie.cn: 哎呀… 脏比辣妹从来不会让人失望!

UI_HP_HottieBoys.ch: 哎… 髒比猛男從來不會讓人失望!
UI_HP_HottieBoys.cn: 哎呀… 脏比猛男从来不会让人失望!

UI_HP_HunkZ.ch: 哎… 髒比靚男從來不會讓人失望!
UI_HP_HunkZ.cn: 哎呀… 脏比靓男从来不会让人失望!

UI_HP_Interrupt.ch: 呃, 興致全被你毀了!
UI_HP_Interrupt.cn: 呃, 兴致全被你毁了!

UI_HP_MP_Accepted.ch: %1 答應了! 這才叫真朋友
UI_HP_MP_Accepted.cn: %1 答应了! 这才叫真朋友

UI_HP_MP_Ask.en: %1 is asking you for a hand, in private. Lend one?
UI_HP_MP_Ask.ch: %1 想私下請你幫個手. 要幫嗎?
UI_HP_MP_Ask.cn: %1 想私下请你搭把手. 要帮吗?

UI_HP_MP_Busy.en: %1 does not want to be disturbed

UI_HP_MP_DndOff.en: You can receive helping-hand requests again
UI_HP_MP_DndOff.ch: 你又可以接受幫個手的請求了
UI_HP_MP_DndOff.cn: 你又可以接收搭把手的请求了

UI_HP_MP_DndOn.en: Do not disturb: nobody can ask you for a hand or bust you
UI_HP_MP_DndOn.ch: 請勿打擾: 沒人能請你幫個手, 也沒人能當場抓包
UI_HP_MP_DndOn.cn: 请勿打扰: 没人能请你搭把手, 也没人能当场撞破你的好事

UI_HP_MP_OptDndOff.ch: 幫個手: 重新接受請求
UI_HP_MP_OptDndOff.cn: 搭把手: 重新接受请求

UI_HP_MP_Rejected.en: left on read... how embarrassing, bro
UI_HP_MP_Rejected.ch: 已讀不回… 好尷尬啊, 兄弟
UI_HP_MP_Rejected.cn: 已读不回… 太尴尬了, 兄弟

UI_HP_MP_Sent.en: request sent... let's see what they say
UI_HP_MP_Sent.ch: 請求已送出… 看看對方怎麼說
UI_HP_MP_Sent.cn: 请求已发送… 看看对方怎么说

UI_HP_MagGone.en: pages stuck together... the magazine is done
UI_HP_MagGone.ch: 書頁都黏在一起了… 這本雜誌報廢了
UI_HP_MagGone.cn: 书页都粘在一起了… 这本杂志报废了

UI_HP_MagLeft.ch: 這本雜誌還能用 %1 次
UI_HP_MagLeft.cn: 这本杂志还能用 %1 次

UI_HP_MixDeath.en: booze plus pills? goodbye cruel world...
UI_HP_MixDeath.ch: 酒加藥? 再見了, 殘酷的世界…
UI_HP_MixDeath.cn: 酒加药? 再见了, 残酷的世界…

UI_HP_MixSick.cn: 呕, 这么混着吃真难受…

UI_HP_Moan10.ch: 快了… 快了… 就是現在!
UI_HP_Moan10.cn: 快了… 快了… 就是现在!

UI_HP_Moan13.ch: 不要一直盯著看, 變態!
UI_HP_Moan13.cn: 别一直盯着看, 变态!

UI_HP_Moan14.ch: 想像一下… 你有… 兩頭牛!
UI_HP_Moan14.cn: 想象一下… 你有… 两头牛!

UI_HP_Moan15.ch: 最棒的情人就是我自己!
UI_HP_Moan15.cn: 最棒的情人就是我自己!

UI_HP_Moan16.en: this way... I beg NO ONE!
UI_HP_Moan16.ch: 這樣… 我誰都不用求!
UI_HP_Moan16.cn: 这样… 我谁都不用求!

UI_HP_Moan19.en: I'm telling NO ONE about this...

UI_HP_Moan21.ch: 哎… 向 cira 問好!
UI_HP_Moan21.cn: 哎呀… 向 cira 问好!

UI_HP_Moan23.en: AH... saludos al grupo de nombre largo!
UI_HP_Moan23.ch: 啊… 向那個名字超長的群組問好!
UI_HP_Moan23.cn: 啊… 向那个名字超长的群组问好!

UI_HP_Moan25.ch: 遊戲… 自給… 自足!
UI_HP_Moan25.cn: 游戏… 自给… 自足!

UI_HP_Moan26.en: gracias por tanto... perdon por tan poco!
UI_HP_Moan26.ch: 謝謝你們付出這麼多… 抱歉我回報得這麼少!
UI_HP_Moan26.cn: 谢谢你们付出这么多… 抱歉我回报得这么少!

UI_HP_Moan27.en: soy... TheJETI... y estos son los MODS DE LA SEMANAAA!
UI_HP_Moan27.ch: 我是… TheJETI… 這些是本週模組精選!
UI_HP_Moan27.cn: 我是… TheJETI… 这些是本周模组精选!

UI_HP_MoanF3.en: I don't need ANY man... for ANYTHING!
UI_HP_MoanF3.ch: 我不需要任何男人… 做任何事!
UI_HP_MoanF3.cn: 我不需要任何男人… 做任何事!

UI_HP_MoanM3.en: not even the smoothest guy... comes close to ME!
UI_HP_MoanM3.ch: 再會撩的男人… 也比不上我!
UI_HP_MoanM3.cn: 再会撩的男人… 也比不上我!

UI_HP_MoanSC1.ch: 我就是… 稻草人人人
UI_HP_MoanSC1.cn: 我就是… 稻草人人人

UI_HP_MoanSC2.en: are you afraid... of the STRAW?

UI_HP_MoanSC3.ch: 讓恐懼… 吞噬你你你
UI_HP_MoanSC3.cn: 让恐惧… 吞噬你你你

UI_HP_MoanSC4.en: no one... knows who I AM
UI_HP_MoanSC4.ch: 沒有人… 知道我是誰
UI_HP_MoanSC4.cn: 没有人… 知道我是谁

UI_HP_Nightmare.ch: 啊啊! 好可怕的惡夢!
UI_HP_Nightmare.cn: 啊啊! 好可怕的噩梦!

UI_HP_NoFill.en: ...not even this does it for me anymore.

UI_HP_NoPublic.en: not here, not with an audience!
UI_HP_NoPublic.ch: 不要在這裡, 有人在看!
UI_HP_NoPublic.cn: 不在这儿, 这么多人看着呢!

UI_HP_OptBed.en: By the bed: ease the tension
UI_HP_OptBed.ch: 在床邊: 紓解一下緊繃
UI_HP_OptBed.cn: 在床边: 释放一下紧张

UI_HP_OptChair.en: By the couch: get comfy and relax
UI_HP_OptChair.ch: 在沙發邊: 舒舒服服地放鬆
UI_HP_OptChair.cn: 在沙发边: 舒舒服服地放松

UI_HP_OptCloth.en: Put the underwear to good use

UI_HP_OptGroundSit.en: Sit down and ease the tension

UI_HP_OptTissue.cn: 擤个鼻涕… 找个没人的地方

UI_HP_OptTissueBox.en: Go through the whole tissue box

UI_HP_OptToilet.en: Go through the whole toilet roll

UI_HP_PhaseDown_habit.en: getting better: it's just a habit now
UI_HP_PhaseDown_habit.ch: 好轉了: 現在只是習慣而已
UI_HP_PhaseDown_habit.cn: 好转了: 现在只是习惯而已

UI_HP_PhaseUp_anxiety.en: rock bottom... this is anxiety now
UI_HP_PhaseUp_anxiety.ch: 跌到谷底… 現在是焦慮了
UI_HP_PhaseUp_anxiety.cn: 跌到谷底… 现在是焦虑了

UI_HP_PhaseUp_dependency.en: you're hooked... it doesn't hit the same
UI_HP_PhaseUp_dependency.ch: 你上癮了… 感覺沒那麼爽了
UI_HP_PhaseUp_dependency.cn: 你上瘾了… 感觉不如从前了

UI_HP_Sat3_1.ch: 哎, 這是另一個境界!
UI_HP_Sat3_1.cn: 哎呀, 这是另一个境界!

UI_HP_SawScarecrow.en: you saw THE STRAW MAN mid-action... you'll never sleep the same
UI_HP_SawScarecrow.ch: 你撞見稻草人正在辦事… 你再也睡不安穩了
UI_HP_SawScarecrow.cn: 你撞见稻草人正在办事… 你再也睡不安稳了

UI_HP_SawYou.en: you saw %1 mid-action... you can't unsee it
UI_HP_SawYou.ch: 你撞見 %1 正在辦事… 這畫面忘不掉了
UI_HP_SawYou.cn: 你撞见 %1 正在办事… 这画面忘不掉了

UI_HP_September.en: NO FAP SEPTEMBER... the temptation is stronger all month
UI_HP_September.ch: 九月禁慾月… 整個月的誘惑都更強
UI_HP_September.cn: 九月禁欲月… 整个月的诱惑都更强

UI_HP_TensionAnxious.en: so hot and bothered... I'm getting anxious
UI_HP_TensionAnxious.ch: 慾火焚身… 我開始焦慮了
UI_HP_TensionAnxious.cn: 欲火焚身… 我开始焦虑了

UI_HP_TensionClear.en: ahhh... I can see clearly again

UI_HP_TensionHigh.en: I can't focus... so worked up!
UI_HP_TensionHigh.ch: 我沒辦法專心… 太興奮了!
UI_HP_TensionHigh.cn: 我没法集中精神… 太上头了!

UI_HP_TerrorAwake.en: I can't even close my eyes...

UI_HP_WornGone.en: nothing left... not even for your nose
UI_HP_WornGone.ch: 什麼都不剩了… 連擤鼻涕都不夠
UI_HP_WornGone.cn: 啥都不剩了… 连擤鼻涕都不够

UI_HP_ZombieHands.en: AAAH! NOT while my hands are busy!
UI_HP_ZombieHands.ch: 啊啊! 我手正忙著的時候不要來!
UI_HP_ZombieHands.cn: 啊啊! 我手正忙着呢, 别来!

UI_trait_AdrenalinicoDesc.en: Strong scares and zombie kill streaks give you a RUSH: your arousal goes up and for a while you feel no sleepiness or fatigue... then comes the crash.
UI_trait_AdrenalinicoDesc.ch: 強烈驚嚇和連續擊殺殭屍會讓你「爽」一下: 慾火上升, 一段時間內你不會睏也不會累… 接著就是崩潰.
UI_trait_AdrenalinicoDesc.cn: 强烈惊吓和连续击杀僵尸会让你“爽”一下: 欲火上升, 一段时间内你不会困也不会累… 接着就是崩溃.

UI_trait_ManosQuietasDesc.en: Iron self-control. The counter climbs half as fast and you recover quicker.
UI_trait_ManosQuietasDesc.ch: 鋼鐵般的自制力. 計數上升速度只有一半, 恢復得也更快.
UI_trait_ManosQuietasDesc.cn: 钢铁般的自制力. 计数上升速度只有一半, 恢复得也更快.

UI_trait_PajeroDesc.en: You've already got the itch. You start at Habit, the counter climbs twice as fast and you never fully quit.
UI_trait_PajeroDesc.ch: 你早就有這個癮了. 一開始就處於習慣階段, 計數上升速度兩倍, 而且永遠無法完全戒掉.
UI_trait_PajeroDesc.cn: 你早就有这个瘾了. 一开局就处于习惯阶段, 计数上升速度翻倍, 而且永远无法完全戒掉.

UI_profdesc_CTB_Meyhaneci.en:
Years spent behind a tavern counter: you can smell when a barrel has stalled
and hear when a still is running.
Bottling wine and beer is already second nature,
and a cellar is a calendar rather than a dark room.
UI_profdesc_CTB_Meyhaneci.ch:
在酒館吧檯後待了多年: 你聞得出發酵桶何時停滯
也聽得出蒸餾器何時在運轉.
葡萄酒與啤酒裝瓶早已成了第二天性,
酒窖對你來說是一本日曆, 而不是一間暗房.
UI_profdesc_CTB_Meyhaneci.cn:
在酒馆吧台后待了多年: 你闻得出发酵桶何时停滞
也听得出蒸馏器何时在运转.
给葡萄酒和啤酒装瓶早已成为本能,
酒窖对你来说是一本日历, 而不是一间暗室.

UI_trait_CTB_CirakDesc.en:
A summer spent behind the counter: washing barrels, carrying buckets,
watching the master gauge the must.
Only just starting a pot of your own.
UI_trait_CTB_CirakDesc.ch:
在吧檯後度過了一個夏天: 洗木桶、提水桶,
看著師傅估量果漿.
才剛開始釀自己的第一鍋.
UI_trait_CTB_CirakDesc.cn:
在吧台后度过了一个夏天: 洗木桶、提水桶,
看着师傅估量果浆.
才刚开始酿自己的第一锅.

UI_trait_CTB_MeyhaneciDesc.en:
The badge of the Tavern Keeper profession.
The language of barrel, still and cellar was learnt on the job.
UI_trait_CTB_MeyhaneciDesc.ch:
酒館老闆職業的標誌.
發酵桶、蒸餾器與酒窖的門道, 都是在工作中學會的.
UI_trait_CTB_MeyhaneciDesc.cn:
酒馆老板职业的标志.
发酵桶、蒸馏器和酒窖的门道, 都是在工作中学会的.

UI_OverTheShoulder_DoubleTapHold_tooltip.en: A double tap of the look key keeps the head following the mouse until the key is pressed again. A tap still glances and holding the key still follows the mouse.
UI_OverTheShoulder_DoubleTapHold_tooltip.ch: 連按兩下回望鍵後, 頭部會持續跟隨滑鼠, 直到再按一次該鍵. 輕按仍為一瞥, 按住仍會跟隨滑鼠.
UI_OverTheShoulder_DoubleTapHold_tooltip.cn: 双击回望键后, 头部会持续跟随鼠标, 直到再次按下该键. 点击仍为瞥视, 按住仍会跟随鼠标.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip.en: How the briefing looks. Every look shows the lines you switch on above, at the position and text size set below (Emergency Broadcast becomes a full-width bar in the centre positions; Cinematic always uses the whole screen). To try them all on your own character, press "Preview the looks" below.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip.ch: 簡報的外觀. 每種外觀都會顯示你在上方開啟的資訊行, 並使用下方設定的位置與文字大小 (緊急廣播在置中位置會變成全寬橫條; 電影外觀一律使用整個螢幕). 若要在自己的角色上逐一試用, 請按下方的「預覽外觀」.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip.cn: 简报的外观. 每种外观都会显示你在上方开启的信息行, 并使用下方设置的位置和文本大小 (紧急广播在居中位置会变成全宽横条; 电影外观始终使用整个屏幕). 若要在自己的角色上逐一试用, 请点击下方的“预览外观”.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip.en: Shows the daily briefing at sunrise instead of at the hour above. Sunrise follows the game's seasons: earlier in summer, later in winter. If the world has no sunrise (Endless Day or Endless Night), the hour above is used.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip.ch: 在日出時顯示每日簡報, 而不是在上方設定的時刻. 日出時間依遊戲季節而變: 夏天較早, 冬天較晚. 若世界沒有日出 (永晝模式或永夜模式), 則使用上方的時刻.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip.cn: 在日出时显示每日简报, 而不是在上方设置的时刻. 日出时间随游戏季节变化: 夏天较早, 冬天较晚. 如果世界没有日出 (永昼模式或永夜模式), 则使用上方的时刻.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu.en: Looks window in the right-click menu
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu.ch: 右鍵選單中的外觀視窗
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu.cn: 右键菜单中的外观窗口

UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip.en: Also puts "Survivor Briefing: test looks" in the menu you get by right-clicking in the world. Off by default: "Preview the looks" above opens the same window.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip.ch: 同時在世界中按右鍵開啟的選單裡加入「倖存者簡報: 測試外觀」. 預設關閉: 上方的「預覽外觀」會開啟同一個視窗.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip.cn: 同时在世界中右键点击打开的菜单里添加“幸存者简报: 测试外观”. 默认关闭: 上方的“预览外观”会打开同一个窗口.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip.en: Shows the briefing when you walk or drive into a town or a named area such as the airport. Not again for the same place within 6 in-game hours, and not when you only skirt its edge.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip.ch: 當你步行或開車進入城鎮或具名區域 (例如機場) 時顯示簡報. 同一地點在遊戲內 6 小時內不會再次顯示, 只是擦過邊緣時也不會顯示.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip.cn: 当你步行或驾车进入城镇或有名称的区域 (例如机场) 时显示简报. 同一地点在游戏内6小时内不会再次显示, 只是擦过边缘时也不会显示.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool.en: Which day of the Knox Event it is. The outbreak began on July 4, 1993 (the in-game radio says so), so July 4 is day 1 and the usual start, July 9, is day 6. Not shown before July 4. With "Only what your character can know" on, it needs the date, like the Date line.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool.ch: 現在是諾克斯事件的第幾天. 疫情於 1993 年 7 月 4 日爆發 (遊戲內的廣播是這麼說的), 所以 7 月 4 日是第 1 天, 一般的開局日 7 月 9 日是第 6 天. 7 月 4 日之前不會顯示. 開啟「只顯示角色能得知的資訊」時, 和「日期」行一樣需要知道日期.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool.cn: 现在是诺克斯事件的第几天. 疫情于1993年7月4日爆发 (游戏内的广播是这么说的), 所以7月4日是第1天, 通常的开局日7月9日是第6天. 7月4日之前不显示. 开启“仅显示角色可知信息”时, 和“日期”行一样需要知道日期.

UI_SNS_Options_KeyTip.en: Key for the list of your sensor networks (admins: all networks).
UI_SNS_Options_KeyTip.ch: 開啟你的感應網路清單的按鍵 (管理員: 所有網路).
UI_SNS_Options_KeyTip.cn: 打开你的感应网络列表的按键 (管理员: 所有网络).

UI_SNS_Options_Title.ch: 廢料場哨兵 - 感應柱
UI_SNS_Options_Title.cn: 废料场哨兵 - 感应柱

UI_SNT_Options_Title.ch: 廢料場哨兵: 砲塔與防禦系統
UI_SNT_Options_Title.cn: 废料场哨兵: 炮塔与防御系统

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_ClimbNoOpening.en: There is rock straight above you.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_DigUpOn.en: Digging up. Swing at the floor in front to open the rock above it.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_DigUpOn.ch: 往上挖掘. 朝前方地面揮擊, 可打通其上方的岩石.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_DigUpOn.cn: 往上挖掘. 朝前方地面挥击, 可打通其上方的岩石.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsHint.en: Bare hands: hold Shift and swing at rock to the north or west to claw stairs up.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsHint.ch: 徒手: 按住 Shift 朝北方或西方的岩石揮擊, 可以扒出往上的樓梯.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsHint.cn: 徒手: 按住 Shift 朝北方或西方的岩石挥击, 可以扒出往上的楼梯.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsNorthWest.en: By hand you can only claw stairs up into rock to the north or west.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsNorthWest.ch: 徒手只能朝北方或西方的岩石扒出往上的樓梯.
UI_HydeCoUnderGround_HandsNorthWest.cn: 徒手只能朝北方或西方的岩石扒出往上的楼梯.

UI_HydeCoUnderGround_StaleLayoutSP.en: Knox Underground: this save's basement layout was made without the mod's sewers, caves and mines, so it has no underground. To add it: quit, delete map_basements.bin from Zomboid/Saves/%1, and load the save again. House basements stay as they are; places you have already been stay without the underground.

UI_SMA_Guide_Common.en: <H2> Learn and practise <LINE> <TEXT> Close this guide and choose Read on the magazine to learn the style. Opening these pages alone does not teach it. Finish reading; interrupted reading does not grant the style. <LINE> <LINE> Martial Arts is one skill, from level 0 to 10, shared by every style. Each level raises your attack speed and damage and lowers the endurance each strike costs. Every style also has its own hidden mastery, from 0 to 5. Landing hits with a style trains the skill and that style's mastery. You begin with two combinations. Each mastery level unlocks four more, longer ones, and mastery 2, 3, 4 and 5 each unlock a special, which is a heavy attack. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Controls <LINE> <TEXT> Keep both hands free of ordinary equipment. Aim and attack to begin. Hold attack to continue the combination; release it to finish the current strike. Release aim to cancel. Aim toward a fallen zombie and use the floor-attack control when necessary. <LINE> <LINE> Right-click the ground and choose Martial Arts, or press K, to open the Martial Arts window. Choose the style you fight with there and see each style's mastery and everything it unlocks; click an unlocked heavy attack of your active style to equip it. Default keys: Backtick (`) cycles learned styles; R uses the equipped special; K opens the window. All of them can be rebound in Options. <LINE> <LINE> Every strike costs endurance, including misses. Moving strikes cost 12% more, and each skill level improves efficiency and stance footwork. Watch your endurance. Higher skill improves speed but does not remove fatigue or attack recovery. Specials have no timed cooldown.
UI_SMA_Guide_Common.ch: <H2> 學習與練習 <LINE> <TEXT> 關閉本指南, 然後對雜誌選擇「閱讀」以學會該流派. 只翻開這些頁面並不會學會. 必須讀完; 中斷閱讀不會習得該流派. <LINE> <LINE> 武術是單一技能, 從 0 級到 10 級, 所有流派共用. 每提升一級都會提高攻擊速度與傷害, 並降低每次出招消耗的耐力. 每個流派另有各自的隱藏精通度, 從 0 到 5. 使用某個流派命中目標會同時訓練此技能與該流派的精通度. 一開始你會有兩個連段. 每提升一級精通度會再解鎖四個更長的連段, 而精通度 2、3、4、5 各會解鎖一個特殊技, 也就是重擊. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 操作 <LINE> <TEXT> 雙手不要拿一般裝備. 瞄準並攻擊即可開始. 按住攻擊可延續連段; 放開則完成目前這一擊. 放開瞄準即可取消. 必要時瞄準倒地的殭屍並使用地面攻擊操作. <LINE> <LINE> 在地面按右鍵並選擇「武術」, 或按 K, 即可開啟武術視窗. 你可以在那裡選擇作戰流派, 檢視各流派的精通度與所有解鎖內容; 點選目前流派已解鎖的重擊即可裝備. 預設按鍵: 反引號鍵 (`)切換已學會的流派; R 使用已裝備的特殊技; K 開啟視窗. 全部都可以在「選項」中重新設定. <LINE> <LINE> 每次出招都會消耗耐力, 揮空也一樣. 移動中出招多消耗 12%%, 而每一級技能都會提升效率與架式步法. 注意你的耐力. 技能越高速度越快, 但不會消除疲勞或攻擊後的硬直. 特殊技沒有冷卻時間.
UI_SMA_Guide_Common.cn: <H2> 学习与练习 <LINE> <TEXT> 关闭本指南, 然后对杂志选择“阅读”来学会该流派. 仅仅翻开这些页面并不能学会. 必须读完; 中断阅读不会习得该流派. <LINE> <LINE> 武术是一项技能, 从0级到10级, 所有流派共享. 每提升一级都会提高攻击速度和伤害, 并降低每次出招消耗的耐力. 每个流派还有各自的隐藏精通度, 从0到5. 用某个流派命中目标会同时训练该技能和该流派的精通度. 开始时你拥有两个连招. 每提升一级精通度会再解锁四个更长的连招, 而精通度2、3、4、5各解锁一个特殊技, 即重击. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 操作 <LINE> <TEXT> 双手不要持有普通装备. 瞄准并攻击即可开始. 按住攻击可继续连招; 松开则完成当前这一击. 松开瞄准即可取消. 必要时瞄准倒地的僵尸并使用地面攻击操作. <LINE> <LINE> 右键点击地面并选择“武术”, 或按 K, 即可打开武术窗口. 你可以在那里选择战斗所用的流派, 并查看各流派的精通度及其全部解锁内容; 点击当前流派已解锁的重击即可装备. 默认按键: 反引号键 (`)切换已学会的流派; R 使用已装备的特殊技; K 打开窗口. 所有按键均可在“选项”中重新绑定. <LINE> <LINE> 每次出招都会消耗耐力, 打空也一样. 移动中出招多消耗12%%, 每级技能都会提升效率和架势步法. 注意你的耐力. 技能越高速度越快, 但不会消除疲劳或攻击后摇. 特殊技没有冷却时间.

UI_SMA_Guide_basic.en: Slow, ordinary strikes available to everyone. Mastery levels 1-4 add body straight, one-two, short knee and straight-hook. At mastery 5, Grab and Knee unlocks as your only heavy attack. Equip it in the Martial Arts window and use the heavy-attack control (R by default). Eight normal attack choices and one heavy at full mastery, with modest speed and damage gains. At close range, the knee and jab-knee can grab a standing zombie by the head. Use the normal shove control for emergency separation.
UI_SMA_Guide_basic.ch: 動作緩慢的一般打擊, 人人都能使用. 精通度 1-4 級會加入腹部直拳、一二連擊、短膝擊與直拳接勾拳. 精通度 5 時解鎖「抓握膝擊」, 這是你唯一的重擊. 在武術視窗中裝備它, 並使用重擊操作 (預設為 R). 完全精通時共有八種一般攻擊可選與一種重擊, 速度與傷害提升幅度不大. 近距離時, 膝擊與刺拳膝擊可以抓住站立殭屍的頭. 緊急拉開距離時請使用一般推擠操作.
UI_SMA_Guide_basic.cn: 动作缓慢的普通打击, 所有人都能使用. 精通度1-4级会加入腹部直拳、一二连击、短膝击和直拳接勾拳. 精通度5时解锁“抓握膝击”, 这是你唯一的重击. 在武术窗口中装备它, 并使用重击操作 (默认为 R). 满精通时共有八种普通攻击可选和一种重击, 速度和伤害提升幅度有限. 近距离时, 膝击和刺拳膝击可以抓住站立僵尸的头部. 紧急脱身时请使用普通推开操作.

UI_SMA_Guide_boxing.en: <H1> Boxing <LINE> <TEXT> Work behind the jab. Slip and roll under punches, then counter with hooks, uppercuts, body shots and the overhand right. The rear cross and uppercuts deliver your strongest punches. Short combinations conserve endurance; a long flurry leaves less room to disengage. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor to drop into a crouching hammer punch, then recover before moving on.
UI_SMA_Guide_boxing.ch: <H1> 拳擊 <LINE> <TEXT> 以刺拳為核心進攻. 側閃、下潛避開來拳, 再以勾拳、上勾拳、腹部拳與右手過頂拳反擊. 後手直拳與上勾拳是你威力最強的拳. 短連段可節省耐力; 長串連打會讓你更難脫離. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可蹲身使出鎚拳, 收招後再繼續行動.
UI_SMA_Guide_boxing.cn: <H1> 拳击 <LINE> <TEXT> 以刺拳为核心展开进攻. 侧闪、下潜躲开来拳, 再用勾拳、上勾拳、腹部拳和右手过顶拳反击. 后手直拳和上勾拳是你最强力的拳. 短连招能节省耐力; 长串连打会让你更难脱身. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可蹲下打出锤拳, 收招后再继续行动.

UI_SMA_Guide_karate.en: <H1> Karate <LINE> <TEXT> Alternate lead and reverse punches with snapping kicks. Front, side and roundhouse kicks lead into spinning hook, spinning back and jumping kicks. Keep enough space to recover from the heavier techniques. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor for a leaping heel stomp. At Karate mastery 4, hold Shift and press your special key for the running flying kick. You do not need to aim first.
UI_SMA_Guide_karate.ch: <H1> 空手道 <LINE> <TEXT> 交替使用前手拳、逆突與彈踢. 前踢、側踢與迴旋踢可銜接轉身勾踢、轉身後踢與跳踢. 保留足夠空間, 以便從較重的招式中收招. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可躍起以腳跟踩踏. 空手道精通度 4 時, 按住 Shift 並按下特殊技按鍵即可施展助跑飛踢. 不需要先瞄準.
UI_SMA_Guide_karate.cn: <H1> 空手道 <LINE> <TEXT> 交替使用前手拳、逆突和弹踢. 前踢、侧踢和回旋踢可衔接转身勾踢、转身后踢和跳踢. 保持足够的距离, 以便从较重的招式中恢复. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可跃起用脚跟踩踏. 空手道精通度4时, 按住 Shift 并按下特殊技按键即可发动助跑飞踢. 无需先瞄准.

UI_SMA_Guide_mma.en: <H1> Mixed martial arts <LINE> <TEXT> Mix punches, elbows, knees and kicks. Enter with straights or a superman punch, work the body, then finish with hooks, a spinning backfist or a flying knee. Leg kicks create a different entry into punching range. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor for a diving punch. The double-leg takedown is a separate special, unlocked at MMA mastery 5, with a paired ground-and-pound sequence. That finisher supports solo and experimental hosted/dedicated multiplayer testing. A server reservation prevents two players from mounting the same zombie. <LINE> <LINE> To use the finisher, reach MMA mastery 5, right-click the ground > Martial Arts > Equipped special and choose Double-leg takedown and ground-and-pound. Keep both hands free, face a standing zombie within five tiles, aim and press R. Your character walks into position, grabs and completes the sequence. You can release right-click; incidental movement inputs do not cancel it. Press Space to cancel. Start with at least 35% endurance. It begins with a standing takedown; a zombie already on the floor is not an entry target.
UI_SMA_Guide_mma.ch: <H1> 綜合格鬥 <LINE> <TEXT> 混合運用拳、肘、膝與踢. 以直拳或超人拳切入, 攻擊身體, 再以勾拳、轉身背拳或飛膝收尾. 腿踢提供另一種切入出拳距離的方式. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可使出俯衝拳. 抱雙腿摔是另一個獨立的特殊技, 於綜合格鬥精通度 5 解鎖, 並搭配一段地面捶打動作. 這個終結技支援單人遊戲, 以及實驗性的自架/專用伺服器多人測試. 伺服器端的預約機制可防止兩名玩家騎上同一隻殭屍. <LINE> <LINE> 要使用這個終結技, 請達到綜合格鬥精通度 5, 在地面按右鍵 > 武術 > 已裝備的特殊技, 並選擇「抱雙腿摔接地面捶打」. 保持雙手空著, 面向五格內一隻站立的殭屍, 瞄準並按 R. 你的角色會走到定位、抓住對方並完成整套動作. 你可以放開右鍵; 不小心的移動輸入不會取消動作. 按空白鍵取消. 開始時至少需有 35%% 的耐力. 動作從站立摔開始; 已倒在地上的殭屍不能作為切入目標.
UI_SMA_Guide_mma.cn: <H1> 综合格斗 <LINE> <TEXT> 混合使用拳、肘、膝和腿. 用直拳或超人拳切入, 攻击身体, 再以勾拳、转身背拳或飞膝收尾. 腿踢提供了另一种切入出拳距离的方式. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可打出俯冲拳. 抱双腿摔是一个单独的特殊技, 在综合格斗精通度5时解锁, 并配有一套地面砸拳动作. 该终结技支持单人游戏, 以及实验性的主机/专用服务器多人测试. 服务器端的预占机制可防止两名玩家骑上同一只僵尸. <LINE> <LINE> 要使用该终结技, 需达到综合格斗精通度5, 右键点击地面 > 武术 > 已装备的特殊技, 并选择“抱双腿摔接地面砸拳”. 保持双手空闲, 面向五格内一只站立的僵尸, 瞄准并按 R. 你的角色会自动走到位置、抓住对方并完成整套动作. 你可以松开右键; 无意中的移动输入不会取消动作. 按空格键取消. 开始时至少需要35%%的耐力. 动作从站立抱摔开始; 已倒地的僵尸不能作为切入目标.

UI_SMA_Guide_muaythai.en: <H1> Muay Thai <LINE> <TEXT> Use the push kick to manage distance. Round kicks follow the hands; elbows, spinning and jumping elbows and knees punish opponents at close range. Heavy kicks cost more endurance than setup punches. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> A grounded opponent <LINE> <TEXT> Aim at the floor to leap and drop onto a fallen opponent, then return to your high guard.
UI_SMA_Guide_muaythai.ch: <H1> 泰拳 <LINE> <TEXT> 用推踢控制距離. 掃踢緊接在拳之後; 肘擊、轉身肘、跳肘與膝擊可在近距離重創對手. 重踢比起手的拳消耗更多耐力. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的對手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄準地面即可躍起壓向倒地的對手, 之後回到高位防守.
UI_SMA_Guide_muaythai.cn: <H1> 泰拳 <LINE> <TEXT> 用推踢控制距离. 扫踢紧跟在拳之后; 肘击、转身肘、跳肘和膝击能在近距离重创对手. 重踢比铺垫的拳消耗更多耐力. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> 倒地的对手 <LINE> <TEXT> 瞄准地面即可跃起压向倒地的对手, 然后恢复高位防守.

UI_SMA_Guide_taekwondo.en: Control distance with kicks and light footwork. Mastery unlocks twenty-two combinations, including jumping and tornado-kick chains. Back, hook, turning and axe kicks are heavy attacks. Longer combinations need more room and stamina.
UI_SMA_Guide_taekwondo.ch: 以踢擊與輕快的步法控制距離. 精通度可解鎖二十二種連段, 包括跳踢與旋風踢連段. 後踢、勾踢、轉身踢與下劈踢屬於重擊. 較長的連段需要更多空間與耐力.
UI_SMA_Guide_taekwondo.cn: 用踢击和轻快的步法控制距离. 精通度可解锁二十二种连招, 包括跳踢和旋风踢连招. 后踢、勾踢、转身踢和下劈腿属于重击. 较长的连招需要更多空间和耐力.

UI_trait_SMABoxerDesc.en: Start with Boxing learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands; gloves are optional. Landing punches trains Martial Arts and Boxing mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.

UI_trait_SMABoxerDesc.cn: 开局即学会拳击, 精通度为1. 空手作战; 拳套可戴可不戴. 出拳命中会训练武术和拳击精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMAKarateDesc.en: Start with Karate learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands. Landing hits trains Martial Arts and Karate mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.

UI_trait_SMAKarateDesc.cn: 开局即学会空手道, 精通度为1. 空手作战. 命中目标会训练武术和空手道精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMAMMADesc.en: Start with MMA learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands. Landing hits trains Martial Arts and MMA mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.
UI_trait_SMAMMADesc.ch: 開局即學會綜合格鬥, 且精通度為 1. 以空手作戰. 命中目標會訓練武術與綜合格鬥精通度, 精通度可解鎖更長的連段與重擊.
UI_trait_SMAMMADesc.cn: 开局即学会综合格斗, 精通度为1. 空手作战. 命中目标会训练武术和综合格斗精通度, 精通度可解锁更长的连招和重击.

UI_trait_SMAMuayThaiDesc.en: Start with Muay Thai learned and its mastery at 1. Fight with empty hands. Landing hits trains Martial Arts and Muay Thai mastery, which unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks.
UI_trait_SMAMuayThaiDesc.ch: 開局即學會泰拳, 且精通度為 1. 以空手作戰. 命中目標會訓練武術與泰拳精通度, 精通度可解鎖更長的連段與重擊.

UI_trait_SMATrainedFighterDesc.en: Start with Martial Arts at level 1 and gain Martial Arts experience faster. The skill raises attack speed and damage and lowers strike stamina cost for every martial arts style you learn.
UI_trait_SMATrainedFighterDesc.ch: 開局武術技能為 1 級, 且武術經驗成長較快. 此技能會提高你學會的每種武術流派的攻擊速度與傷害, 並降低出招的耐力消耗.

Starts at the wedding shop in Irvington, whatever town you pick.
Carries a sewing kit, a measuring tape, scissors and thread.
Can sew dresses, skirts, shirts and trousers.
Starting at work, has the building's key.
With work bags on: a tote bag of work gear.
UI_profdesc_HCJF_WeddingShopClerk.ch:
在歐文頓的婚紗店開局, 無論你選哪個城鎮.
攜帶針線盒、捲尺、剪刀和線.
會縫製洋裝、裙子、襯衫和長褲.
在工作地點開局時, 持有該建築的鑰匙.
開啟工作包時: 一個裝滿工作裝備的購物袋.
UI_profdesc_HCJF_WeddingShopClerk.cn:
在欧文顿的婚纱店开局, 无论选择哪个城镇.
携带针线盒、卷尺、剪刀和线.
会缝制连衣裙、裙子、衬衫和长裤.
在工作地点开局时, 持有该建筑的钥匙.
开启工作包时: 一个装满工作装备的购物袋.

UI_profdesc_HCJF_Woodcarver.en:
Starts at a woodworking shop or a woodshed, in the nearest town that has one.
Carries a pocket knife, a carpentry chisel and wood glue.
Starting at work, has the building's key.
With work bags on: a leather tool roll of work gear and a hatchet.
UI_profdesc_HCJF_Woodcarver.ch:
在木工坊或柴房開局, 位於最近一個有此地點的城鎮.
攜帶摺疊刀、木工鑿和木膠.
在工作地點開局時, 持有該建築的鑰匙.
開啟工作包時: 一個裝滿工作裝備的皮革工具捲, 以及一把單手斧.
UI_profdesc_HCJF_Woodcarver.cn:
在木工坊或柴房开局, 位于最近一个有此地点的城镇.
携带折叠刀、木工凿和木胶.
在工作地点开局时, 持有该建筑的钥匙.
开启工作包时: 一个装满工作装备的皮革工具卷, 以及一把单手斧.

UI_profdesc_HCJF_Wrangler.en:
Starts in Coalfield at the livery barn.
Carries a rope, leather gloves and an apple.
Can make barbed wire.
Starting at work, has the building's key.
With work bags on: a leather satchel of work gear and a garden fork.
UI_profdesc_HCJF_Wrangler.ch:
在煤田鎮的出租馬廄開局.
攜帶繩索、皮手套和一顆蘋果.
會製作帶刺鐵絲.
在工作地點開局時, 持有該建築的鑰匙.
開啟工作包時: 一個裝滿工作裝備的皮革側背包, 以及一把園藝叉.
UI_profdesc_HCJF_Wrangler.cn:
在煤田镇的马匹租赁马厩开局.
携带绳索、皮手套和一个苹果.
会制作带刺铁丝.
在工作地点开局时, 持有该建筑的钥匙.
开启工作包时: 一个装满工作装备的皮革挎包, 以及一把园艺叉.

UI_trait_HCJF_ArcWelderDesc.ch: 金工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_ArcWelderDesc.cn: 金工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_BarFighterDesc.ch: 短棍經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_BarFighterDesc.cn: 短棍经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_BarflyDesc.en: Unhappiness and stress creep up once a day has gone by without a drink, as a smoker's do.
UI_trait_HCJF_BarflyDesc.ch: 一整天沒喝酒後, 憂鬱與壓力就會逐漸上升, 就像吸菸者沒菸抽一樣.
UI_trait_HCJF_BarflyDesc.cn: 一整天没喝酒后, 忧郁和压力就会逐渐上升, 就像吸烟者没烟抽一样.

UI_trait_HCJF_ChatterboxDesc.en: Every so often you talk to yourself out loud, and zombies hear it.
UI_trait_HCJF_ChatterboxDesc.ch: 你不時會大聲自言自語, 殭屍會聽見.
UI_trait_HCJF_ChatterboxDesc.cn: 你时不时会大声自言自语, 僵尸会听见.

UI_trait_HCJF_ClockWatcherDesc.en: Boredom builds half again as fast.
UI_trait_HCJF_ClockWatcherDesc.ch: 無聊累積速度變為 1.5 倍.
UI_trait_HCJF_ClockWatcherDesc.cn: 无聊积累速度变为 1.5 倍.

UI_trait_HCJF_CoolUnderFireDesc.en: Panic drains away twice as fast.

UI_trait_HCJF_CrowdPleaserDesc.en: Holding a musical instrument or a microphone while standing still slowly lifts boredom and unhappiness.
UI_trait_HCJF_CrowdPleaserDesc.ch: 靜止站立並手持樂器或麥克風時, 會慢慢減輕無聊與憂鬱.
UI_trait_HCJF_CrowdPleaserDesc.cn: 静止站立并手持乐器或麦克风时, 会慢慢缓解无聊和忧郁.

UI_trait_HCJF_DeskJockeyDesc.en: Fitness, Strength and Running level 25%% slower.
UI_trait_HCJF_DeskJockeyDesc.ch: 體格、力量與衝刺經驗獲取速度減慢 25%%
UI_trait_HCJF_DeskJockeyDesc.cn: 体格、力量和冲刺经验获取速度降低 25%%

UI_trait_HCJF_EarlyRiserDesc.en: Tires half as fast between five and eleven in the morning.
UI_trait_HCJF_EarlyRiserDesc.ch: 早上五點到十一點之間, 疲勞累積速度減半.
UI_trait_HCJF_EarlyRiserDesc.cn: 早上五点到十一点之间, 疲劳积累速度减半.

UI_trait_HCJF_ForgeHardenedDesc.en: Heat bothers you less: overheating builds more slowly.
UI_trait_HCJF_ForgeHardenedDesc.ch: 較不怕熱: 過熱累積得更慢.
UI_trait_HCJF_ForgeHardenedDesc.cn: 不太怕热: 过热积累得更慢.

UI_trait_HCJF_GreaseMonkeyDesc.ch: 技工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_GreaseMonkeyDesc.cn: 技工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_GreenThumbDesc.ch: 耕作經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_GreenThumbDesc.cn: 耕作经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_HeavyHitterDesc.ch: 長棍經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_HeavyHitterDesc.cn: 长棍经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_HorseSenseDesc.ch: 畜牧經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_HorseSenseDesc.cn: 畜牧经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_IronLiverDesc.en: Gets drunk slower and sobers up twice as fast.
UI_trait_HCJF_IronLiverDesc.ch: 較不容易喝醉, 酒醒速度加倍.
UI_trait_HCJF_IronLiverDesc.cn: 更不容易喝醉, 醒酒速度加倍.

UI_trait_HCJF_LongHaulerDesc.en: Tires a third more slowly while in a vehicle.
UI_trait_HCJF_LongHaulerDesc.ch: 待在車內時, 疲勞累積速度減慢三分之一.
UI_trait_HCJF_LongHaulerDesc.cn: 待在车内时, 疲劳积累速度减慢三分之一.

UI_trait_HCJF_NeedleworkDesc.ch: 縫紉經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_NeedleworkDesc.cn: 缝纫经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_OldSoulDesc.en: The old crafts (Carving, Knapping, Pottery, Blacksmithing, Masonry, Tailoring, Glassmaking) level 40%% faster.
UI_trait_HCJF_OldSoulDesc.ch: 傳統工藝 (雕刻、石器、陶藝、鍛造、石工、縫紉、玻璃) 經驗獲取速度加快 40%%
UI_trait_HCJF_OldSoulDesc.cn: 传统手艺 (雕刻、石器、陶艺、锻造、石工、缝纫、玻璃) 经验获取速度提高 40%%

UI_trait_HCJF_ProspectorSEyeDesc.en: Spots stones, old coins and buried finds more easily in search mode.
UI_trait_HCJF_ProspectorSEyeDesc.ch: 在搜尋模式中更容易發現石頭、古錢幣與埋藏物.
UI_trait_HCJF_ProspectorSEyeDesc.cn: 在搜索模式中更容易发现石头、古钱币和埋藏物.

UI_trait_HCJF_ShortOrderDesc.ch: 烹飪經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_ShortOrderDesc.cn: 烹饪经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_SparkyDesc.ch: 電工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_SparkyDesc.cn: 电工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_SteadyHandDesc.en: First Aid, Short Blade and Butchering level 50%% faster.
UI_trait_HCJF_SteadyHandDesc.ch: 急救、短刀與屠宰經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_SteadyHandDesc.cn: 急救、短刀和屠宰经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_StrongStomachDesc.en: Rotting corpses make you sick half as fast, and handling the dead doesn't upset you.
UI_trait_HCJF_StrongStomachDesc.ch: 腐爛屍體讓你生病的速度減半, 處理死者也不會讓你心煩.
UI_trait_HCJF_StrongStomachDesc.cn: 腐烂尸体让你生病的速度减半, 处理死者也不会让你心烦.

UI_trait_HCJF_SuperstitiousDesc.en: Being outside after dark wears on your nerves.
UI_trait_HCJF_SuperstitiousDesc.ch: 天黑後待在戶外會讓你心神不寧.
UI_trait_HCJF_SuperstitiousDesc.cn: 天黑后待在户外会让你心神不宁.

UI_trait_HCJF_TeetotalerDesc.en: Drinking makes you unhappy instead of relaxed.
UI_trait_HCJF_TeetotalerDesc.ch: 喝酒不會讓你放鬆, 反而讓你憂鬱.
UI_trait_HCJF_TeetotalerDesc.cn: 喝酒不会让你放松, 反而让你忧郁.

UI_trait_HCJF_TradesmanDesc.ch: 木工與石工經驗獲取速度加快 50%%
UI_trait_HCJF_TradesmanDesc.cn: 木工和石工经验获取速度提高 50%%

UI_trait_HCJF_TrailLegsDesc.en: Endurance comes back half again as fast while walking.
UI_trait_HCJF_TrailLegsDesc.ch: 步行時耐力恢復速度變為 1.5 倍.
UI_trait_HCJF_TrailLegsDesc.cn: 步行时耐力恢复速度变为 1.5 倍.

UI_trait_gs_carelessreloaderdesc.en: Sloppy at the press. About 1 round in 20 is spoiled: its primer and powder are lost.
UI_trait_gs_carelessreloaderdesc.ch: 在壓床前做事馬虎. 每 20 發約有 1 發報廢: 其底火與火藥會損失.
UI_trait_gs_carelessreloaderdesc.cn: 在压床前做事马虎. 每 20 发约有 1 发报废: 其底火和火药会损失.

UI_trait_gs_handloaderdesc.en: Years at the reloading bench. Loads rounds a quarter faster at the press, and improvised powder costs no quality.
UI_trait_gs_handloaderdesc.ch: 在複裝工作臺前待了多年. 在壓床上複裝子彈的速度快四分之一, 使用簡易火藥也不會降低品質.
UI_trait_gs_handloaderdesc.cn: 在复装工作台前待了多年. 在压床上复装子弹的速度快四分之一, 使用简易火药也不会降低质量.

UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Jumpscare_Desc.en: let zombies revealed by this mod influence the jumpscare effect handling (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Jumpscare_Desc.ch: 讓本模組顯示的殭屍影響驚嚇效果的處理 (預設: 開啟)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Jumpscare_Desc.cn: 让此模组显示的僵尸影响惊吓效果的处理 (默认: 开启)

UI_ZomVisFix_Options_SubTile_Desc.en: use exact player and zombie positions for raycasting (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_SubTile_Desc.ch: 使用玩家與殭屍的精確位置進行射線偵測 (預設: 開啟)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_SubTile_Desc.cn: 使用玩家和僵尸的精确位置进行光线追踪 (默认: 开启)

UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingRat.en: limit how many times per second should this mod process a zombie
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingRat.ch: 限制本模組每秒處理單一殭屍的次數
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingRat.cn: 限制此模组每秒处理单个僵尸的次数

UI_HydeCoOrchard_NeedMulch.en: Mulching takes %1, made from raked leaves.
UI_HydeCoOrchard_NeedMulch.ch: 鋪覆蓋物需要 %1, 用耙集的落葉製成.
UI_HydeCoOrchard_NeedMulch.cn: 铺护根物需要 %1, 用耙集的落叶制成.

UI_AHS_Episode_severe_malnutrition.ch: 重度蛋白質熱量營養不良
UI_AHS_Episode_severe_malnutrition.cn: 重度蛋白质-能量营养不良

UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_cardiovascular_.en: Hard effort brings weakness and discomfort in my chest.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_cardiovascular_.ch: 一用力就覺得虛弱, 胸口也不舒服.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_cardiovascular_.cn: 一用力就觉得虚弱, 胸口也不舒服.

UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_knee_osteoarthr.en: My knee aches after long walks or running, even after losing weight.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_knee_osteoarthr.ch: 走遠路或跑步之後膝蓋就會痛, 就算瘦下來了也一樣.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_knee_osteoarthr.cn: 走远路或跑步之后膝盖就会疼, 就算瘦下来了也一样.

UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_nutritional_ane.en: I tire quickly and feel weak when I exert myself.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_nutritional_ane.ch: 我很容易累, 一出力就覺得虛弱.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_nutritional_ane.cn: 我很容易累, 一使劲就觉得没力气.

UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_severe_malnutri.en: I feel deeply exhausted and my wounds recover slowly. I need sustained adequate nutrition.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_severe_malnutri.ch: 我覺得累到不行, 傷口也好得很慢. 我需要持續攝取足夠的營養.
UI_AHS_Report_Basic_Type_severe_malnutri.cn: 我觉得累得不行, 伤口也好得很慢. 我需要持续摄入足够的营养.

UI_NEQ_options_show_key_rings_tooltip.en: Key rings stay in the inventory list even while equipped items are hidden.
UI_NEQ_options_show_key_rings_tooltip.ch: 即使隱藏已裝備物品, 鑰匙環仍會留在物品欄清單中.
UI_NEQ_options_show_key_rings_tooltip.cn: 即使隐藏已装备物品, 钥匙环仍会保留在物品栏列表中.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_PreviewLooks_tooltip.en: Opens the looks window as soon as you are back in the game: click a look to see it on your own character, and "Use these settings" keeps it.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_PreviewLooks_tooltip.ch: 回到遊戲後立即開啟外觀視窗: 點選一種外觀即可在自己的角色上預覽, 按「套用這些設定」即可保留.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_PreviewLooks_tooltip.cn: 回到游戏后立即打开外观窗口: 点击一种外观即可在自己的角色上预览, 点击“使用这些设置”即可保留.

UI_ModManagerExt_changelogOrderTip.en: Reads a ChangeLog.txt that lists its newest version at the top the right way round, in the Changelog row and in the change notes Mod Manager fills in when uploading. Off reads every ChangeLog.txt newest at the bottom, as Mod Manager does.
UI_ModManagerExt_changelogOrderTip.ch: 把最新版本列在最上方的 ChangeLog.txt 會以正確的順序讀取, 套用於「更新說明」列以及模組管理器上傳時自動填入的更新說明. 關閉則與模組管理器相同, 一律將每個 ChangeLog.txt 當作最新版本在最下方來讀取.
UI_ModManagerExt_changelogOrderTip.cn: 将最新版本列在顶部的 ChangeLog.txt 会按正确的顺序读取, 适用于“更新说明”行以及模组管理器上传时自动填写的更新说明. 关闭则与模组管理器相同, 始终将每个 ChangeLog.txt 视为最新版本在底部来读取.

UI_optionscreen_binding_VPUI_HudLayout.ch: HUD 版面 (移動/隱藏 HUD)
UI_optionscreen_binding_VPUI_HudLayout.cn: HUD 布局 (移动/隐藏 HUD)

UI_RSE_ModOptions_BaseOpacity_tooltip.en: Transparency of the background circle (0 = invisible, 1 = solid)
UI_RSE_ModOptions_BaseOpacity_tooltip.ch: 背景圓圈的透明度 (0 = 不可見, 1 = 完全不透明)
UI_RSE_ModOptions_BaseOpacity_tooltip.cn: 背景圆圈的透明度 (0 = 不可见, 1 = 完全不透明)

UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescColors.en: Customize the background colors for each event
UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescColors.ch: 自訂各事件的背景顏色
UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescColors.cn: 自定义各事件的背景颜色

UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescIndicator.en: Customize the visual indicator for distant sound events. Drag it to move it, double-click it to hide it
UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescIndicator.ch: 自訂遠方聲音事件的視覺指示器. 拖曳可移動, 按兩下可隱藏
UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescIndicator.cn: 自定义远处声音事件的视觉指示器. 拖动可移动, 双击可隐藏

UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescMap.en: Customize the radio intel markers on the map
UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescMap.ch: 自訂地圖上的收音機情報標記
UI_RSE_ModOptions_DescMap.cn: 自定义地图上的收音机情报标记

UI_RSE_ModOptions_IndicatorEnabled_toolt.en: Display a visual indicator pointing toward sound events
UI_RSE_ModOptions_IndicatorEnabled_toolt.ch: 顯示指向聲音事件的視覺指示器
UI_RSE_ModOptions_IndicatorEnabled_toolt.cn: 显示指向声音事件的视觉指示器

UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerAutoRemove_to.en: Remove a marker from the map when you get within 50 tiles of it. If off, right-click a marker on the map to remove it
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerAutoRemove_to.ch: 當你距離標記 50 格以內時, 從地圖上移除該標記. 若關閉, 請在地圖上對標記按右鍵將其移除
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerAutoRemove_to.cn: 当你距离标记 50 格以内时, 从地图上移除该标记. 若关闭, 请在地图上右键点击标记将其移除

UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerLabel_tooltip.en: Show under each marker which event the radio reported, and the day and hour
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerLabel_tooltip.ch: 在每個標記下方顯示收音機播報的是哪種事件, 以及第幾天、幾點
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerLabel_tooltip.cn: 在每个标记下方显示收音机播报的是哪种事件, 以及第几天、几点

UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerSize_tooltip.en: Size of the markers on the map, in pixels
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerSize_tooltip.ch: 地圖上標記的大小, 以像素為單位
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MapMarkerSize_tooltip.cn: 地图上标记的大小, 以像素为单位

UI_RSE_ModOptions_MarkIntelIcon_tooltip.ch: 顯示「標記情報」選項的圖示
UI_RSE_ModOptions_MarkIntelIcon_tooltip.cn: 显示“标记情报”选项的图标

UI_RSE_ModOptions_SceneMarkerDuration_to.en: How long the indicator stays visible (in seconds) when the player approaches a scene
UI_RSE_ModOptions_SceneMarkerDuration_to.ch: 玩家接近場景時, 指示器保持顯示的時間 (秒)
UI_RSE_ModOptions_SceneMarkerDuration_to.cn: 玩家接近场景时, 指示器保持显示的时间 (秒)

UI_RSE_ModOptions_ShowDistance_tooltip.en: Show under the indicator how far its point is, in meters (1 tile = 1 meter)
UI_RSE_ModOptions_ShowDistance_tooltip.ch: 在指示器下方顯示其指向地點的距離, 單位為公尺 (1 格 = 1 公尺)
UI_RSE_ModOptions_ShowDistance_tooltip.cn: 在指示器下方显示其指向地点的距离, 单位为米 (1 格 = 1 米)

UI_RSE_ModOptions_SoundMarkerDuration_to.en: How long the indicator stays visible (in seconds) when a sound event happens
UI_RSE_ModOptions_SoundMarkerDuration_to.ch: 聲音事件發生時, 指示器保持顯示的時間 (秒)
UI_RSE_ModOptions_SoundMarkerDuration_to.cn: 声音事件发生时, 指示器保持显示的时间 (秒)

UI_RSE_ModOptions_UseColoredIcons_toolti.en: Use colored versions of event icons
UI_RSE_ModOptions_UseColoredIcons_toolti.ch: 使用彩色版本的事件圖示

UI_equipment_options_clean_header_toolti.en: Hide the Equipment text from the window title bar while keeping its buttons.
UI_equipment_options_clean_header_toolti.ch: 隱藏視窗標題列上的「裝備」文字, 但保留其按鈕.
UI_equipment_options_clean_header_toolti.cn: 隐藏窗口标题栏上的“装备”文字, 但保留其按钮.

UI_equipment_options_neat_tooltip.en: Hide the Equipment and Hotbar section headings and move the UI elements upward to save vertical space.
UI_equipment_options_neat_tooltip.ch: 隱藏「裝備」與「快捷欄」區段標題, 並將介面元素上移以節省垂直空間.
UI_equipment_options_neat_tooltip.cn: 隐藏“装备”和“快捷栏”区块标题, 并将界面元素上移以节省垂直空间.

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_ColorPenMapCo.ch: 在地圖上使用四季物語顏色
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_ColorPenMapCo.cn: 在地图上使用四季物语颜色

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_ColorPenMapCo.en:
Adds Shiki Monogatari colors to map symbol and note color choices.
To use a color, you must have the corresponding Shiki Monogatari.
This does not affect Shiki Monogatari items or their spawning.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_ColorPenMapCo.ch:
將四季物語的顏色加入地圖符號與備註的顏色選項.
要使用某個顏色, 必須持有對應的四季物語.
這不會影響四季物語物品或其生成.
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Options_ColorPenMapCo.cn:
将四季物语的颜色添加到地图符号和备注的颜色选项中.
要使用某种颜色, 必须持有对应的四季物语.
这不会影响四季物语物品及其生成.

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Title_P4MovCapsuleToy.ch: 扭蛋機 (四季物語 第 1 卷)
UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Title_P4MovCapsuleToy.cn: 扭蛋机 (四季物语 第 1 卷)

UI_P4MySoCalledToy_Title_P4MovCapsuleToy.cn: 扭蛋机 (四季物语 第 2 卷)

UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPHint.en: Overrides sandbox PvP safety settings only where PvP is enabled. Missing/true forces safety off; false leaves safety optional. New regions default to false. Existing missing values stay unchanged.
UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPHint.ch: 僅在啟用PvP的地方覆蓋沙盒的PvP安全模式設定. 未設定/true 會強制關閉安全模式; false 則讓安全模式可自行選擇. 新區域預設為 false. 既有的未設定值維持不變.
UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPHint.cn: 仅在启用PvP的地方覆盖沙盒的PvP安全模式设置. 未设置/true 会强制关闭安全模式; false 则让安全模式可自行选择. 新区域默认为 false. 现有的未设置值保持不变.

UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPInherit.ch: 繼承類別 / 預設為強制
UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPInherit.cn: 继承类别 / 默认强制

UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPNo.ch: 可選PvP (玩家自行控制安全模式)
UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPNo.cn: 可选PvP (玩家自行控制安全模式)

UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPOnlyEnabled.ch: 僅適用於已啟用PvP的區域
UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPOnlyEnabled.cn: 仅适用于已启用PvP的区域

UI_RMMP_InvalidPopulation.en: Enter valid population values within the displayed ranges. Count and allowance must be whole numbers. Blank fields inherit defaults.
UI_RMMP_InvalidPopulation.ch: 請在顯示的範圍內輸入有效的殭屍數量數值. 數量與額度必須是整數. 空白欄位會繼承預設值.
UI_RMMP_InvalidPopulation.cn: 请在显示的范围内输入有效的僵尸数量数值. 数量和额度必须为整数. 空白字段将继承默认值.

UI_RMMP_PopulationBudgetHint.en: Total successful additions for this region ID, preserved across unloads and restarts. Blank defaults to the effective target. Raising this value permits more additions when replenishment is enabled.
UI_RMMP_PopulationBudgetHint.ch: 此區域 ID 可成功新增殭屍的總次數, 在卸載與重新啟動後仍會保留. 留空則預設為有效目標值. 啟用補充時, 調高此值可允許更多次新增.
UI_RMMP_PopulationBudgetHint.cn: 此区域 ID 可成功添加僵尸的总次数, 在卸载和重启后依然保留. 留空则默认为有效目标值. 启用补充时, 提高此值可允许更多次添加.

UI_RMMP_PopulationDensityHint.en: Region-wide density ceiling on this floor. Effective target is the lower of the count and floor(area x density / 100). Blank inherits; default 1. Zero disables additions.
UI_RMMP_PopulationDensityHint.ch: 此樓層整個區域的密度上限. 有效目標值取數量與 floor(面積 x 密度 / 100) 兩者中較小者. 留空則繼承; 預設 1. 設為 0 則停用新增.
UI_RMMP_PopulationDensityHint.cn: 该楼层整个区域的密度上限. 有效目标值取数量与 floor(面积 x 密度 / 100) 中的较小者. 留空则继承; 默认 1. 设为0则禁用添加.

UI_RMMP_PopulationIntervalHint.en: Minimum real seconds between single-zombie additions. Blank inherits; default 30.
UI_RMMP_PopulationIntervalHint.ch: 每次新增單隻殭屍之間的最短現實秒數. 留空則繼承; 預設 30.
UI_RMMP_PopulationIntervalHint.cn: 每次添加单只僵尸之间的最短现实秒数. 留空则继承; 默认 30.

UI_RMMP_PopulationRespawnHint.en: Uses zombieRespawn for this module only. Enabled permits top-ups within the lifetime allowance; disabled stops permanently once the target is met. Does not override vanilla zombie respawn.
UI_RMMP_PopulationRespawnHint.ch: 僅在此模組中使用 zombieRespawn. 啟用時允許在累計額度內補充殭屍; 停用時一旦達到目標值就永久停止. 不會覆蓋原版的殭屍重生.
UI_RMMP_PopulationRespawnHint.cn: 仅在此模块中使用 zombieRespawn. 启用时允许在累计额度内补充僵尸; 禁用时一旦达到目标值就永久停止. 不会覆盖原版的僵尸重生.

UI_RMMP_PopulationRespawnInherit.ch: 繼承類別 / 預設為停用
UI_RMMP_PopulationRespawnInherit.cn: 继承类别 / 默认禁用

UI_RMMP_PopulationTargetHint.en: Positive count enables population control. Blank inherits category settings; 0 disables additions. The density ceiling also limits this target.
UI_RMMP_PopulationTargetHint.ch: 數量為正數時啟用殭屍數量控制. 留空則繼承類別設定; 0 則停用新增. 密度上限也會限制此目標值.
UI_RMMP_PopulationTargetHint.cn: 数量为正数时启用僵尸数量控制. 留空则继承类别设置; 0 则禁用添加. 密度上限也会限制该目标值.

UI_TrampleSteam_Use3DModels.ch: 以 3D 模型顯示已部署的陷阱
UI_TrampleSteam_Use3DModels.cn: 以 3D 模型显示已部署的陷阱

UI_TrampleSteam_Use3DModels_tooltip.en: Draws placed Trample Steams as real 3D models instead of the pre-rendered sprites. Off by default. Project Viewpoint (first-person view mod) always uses its own 3D models for the trap.
UI_TrampleSteam_Use3DModels_tooltip.ch: 以真正的 3D 模型繪製已放置的踩踏蒸汽彈射器, 而非預先渲染的 2D 圖像. 預設關閉. Project Viewpoint (第一人稱視角模組) 一律使用其自帶的陷阱 3D 模型.
UI_TrampleSteam_Use3DModels_tooltip.cn: 以真正的 3D 模型绘制已放置的踩踏蒸汽弹射器, 而非预渲染的 2D 图像. 默认关闭. Project Viewpoint (第一人称视角模组) 始终使用其自带的陷阱 3D 模型.

UI_MSC_DiagnosticsStallLowOil.ch: 機油壓力過低熄火風險
UI_MSC_DiagnosticsStallLowOil.cn: 机油压力过低熄火风险

UI_options_claimableoutposts_statusPosit.en: Display the nearby outpost's status above your character or directly above the Outposts HUD. Client-side only.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_statusPosit.ch: 在你的角色上方或前哨站 HUD 正上方顯示附近前哨站的狀態. 僅客戶端生效.
UI_options_claimableoutposts_statusPosit.cn: 在你的角色上方或前哨站 HUD 正上方显示附近前哨站的状态. 仅客户端生效.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_MyNotes_tooltip.en: Opens your notes as soon as you are back in the game: up to three, each a title and five lines, shown at the bottom of your briefings in this world.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_MyNotes_tooltip.ch: 回到遊戲後立即開啟你的筆記: 最多三則, 每則有一個標題與五行內容, 會顯示在你這個世界中簡報的底部.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_MyNotes_tooltip.cn: 回到游戏后立即打开你的笔记: 最多三条, 每条包含一个标题和五行内容, 显示在你在这个世界中的简报底部.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_NotesKey_tooltip.en: A key that opens and closes your notes. Unbound by default.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_NotesKey_tooltip.ch: 用來開啟與關閉筆記的按鍵. 預設未綁定按鍵.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_NotesKey_tooltip.cn: 用于打开和关闭笔记的按键. 默认未绑定按键.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_SoundVolume_tooltip.en: Each look has its own sound as the briefing appears and as it fades. 0 switches them off. They also follow the game's own sound volume.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SoundVolume_tooltip.ch: 每種外觀在簡報出現與淡出時都有各自的音效. 設為 0 即關閉音效. 音效也會依照遊戲本身的音效音量.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SoundVolume_tooltip.cn: 每种外观在简报出现和淡出时都有各自的音效. 设为0即可关闭音效. 这些音效也会跟随游戏本身的音效音量.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_showNotes_tooltip.en: Your notes at the bottom of the briefing, except when entering a town or closing the pause menu, so those stay short.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showNotes_tooltip.ch: 在簡報底部顯示你的筆記, 但進入城鎮或關閉暫停選單時除外, 讓這兩種簡報保持簡短.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showNotes_tooltip.cn: 在简报底部显示你的笔记, 但进入城镇或关闭暂停菜单时除外, 让这两种简报保持简短.

UI_QAMARK_MPShareTooltip.en: Multiplayer only. Automatically share NEW building marks through the vanilla map system. Existing marks are unchanged. Manual marks can be shared using the vanilla Share tool. Faction/Safehouse require membership.
UI_QAMARK_MPShareTooltip.ch: 僅限多人遊戲. 經由原版地圖系統自動分享「新的」建築標記. 既有標記不受影響. 手動標記可使用原版的分享工具分享. 陣營/安全屋需具備成員身分.
UI_QAMARK_MPShareTooltip.cn: 仅限多人游戏. 通过原版地图系统自动分享“新的”建筑标记. 现有标记不受影响. 手动标记可使用原版的分享工具分享. 阵营/安全屋需要具备成员身份.

UI_WANTED_ZonesSyncing.ch: 正在與伺服器同步區域…
UI_WANTED_ZonesSyncing.cn: 正在与服务器同步区域…

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindBudget.en: Answers queued path requests until a dedicated time budget is spent instead of vanilla strict 2-request cap, preventing pathing backlogs.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindBudget.ch: 持續回應排隊中的路徑請求, 直到用完專屬的時間預算, 而不是受限於原版嚴格的 2 個請求上限, 以避免尋路請求積壓.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindBudget.cn: 持续响应排队中的路径请求, 直到用完专用的时间预算, 而不是受限于原版严格的 2 个请求上限, 以避免寻路请求积压.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindBudget._note: 2026-10-29 #1150：上游 EN 檔已移除此鍵，Lua 仍以 MPOptim.GetText(鍵, 英文後備) 讀取（MPOptim_UI_Settings.lua），en 取 Lua 後備字串；刪了中文玩家會看到英文。

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindNativeASt.en: Replaces vanilla linear-scan decrease-key with indexed decrease-key in PZPathFind64.dll. Accelerates path search throughput during hordes and complex geometry.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindNativeASt.ch: 將 PZPathFind64.dll 中原版的線性掃描 decrease-key 改為索引式 decrease-key. 可在屍群與複雜地形下提升路徑搜尋的處理量.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindNativeASt.cn: 将 PZPathFind64.dll 中原版的线性扫描 decrease-key 改为索引式 decrease-key. 可在尸群和复杂地形下提升路径搜索吞吐量.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindNativeASt._note: 2026-10-29 #1150：上游 EN 檔已移除此鍵，Lua 仍以 MPOptim.GetText(鍵, 英文後備) 讀取（MPOptim_UI_Settings.lua），en 取 Lua 後備字串；刪了中文玩家會看到英文。

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindSquareMer.en: Collapses repeated square updates within an iteration into the latest state, preventing redundant graph rebuilds and queue spam.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindSquareMer.ch: 將同一次迭代內同一地塊的重複更新合併為最新狀態, 避免多餘的導航圖重建, 以及佇列被大量重複項目塞滿.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindSquareMer.cn: 将同一次迭代内同一地块的重复更新合并为最新状态, 避免多余的导航图重建, 以及队列被大量重复项塞满.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindSquareMer._note: 2026-10-29 #1150：上游 EN 檔已移除此鍵，Lua 仍以 MPOptim.GetText(鍵, 英文後備) 讀取（MPOptim_UI_Settings.lua），en 取 Lua 後備字串；刪了中文玩家會看到英文。

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindVehicleTh.en: Resends vehicle navmesh polygons only when moving 0.25+ tiles or every 250ms, avoiding expensive DLL graph invalidation every micro-turn.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindVehicleTh.ch: 車輛只有在移動 0.25 格以上或每隔 250 毫秒時, 才重新傳送導航網格多邊形, 避免每次細微轉向都讓 DLL 的導航圖失效而付出高昂開銷.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindVehicleTh.cn: 车辆仅在移动 0.25 格以上或每隔 250 毫秒时, 才重新发送导航网格多边形, 避免每次细微转向都让 DLL 的导航图失效而带来高昂开销.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_PathfindVehicleTh._note: 2026-10-29 #1150：上游 EN 檔已移除此鍵，Lua 仍以 MPOptim.GetText(鍵, 英文後備) 讀取（MPOptim_UI_Settings.lua），en 取 Lua 後備字串；刪了中文玩家會看到英文。

UI_ModOptions_JVM_PathfindBudget._note: 2026-10-29 #1150：上游 EN 檔已移除此鍵，Lua 仍以 MPOptim.GetText(鍵, 英文後備) 讀取（MPOptim_UI_Settings.lua），en 取 Lua 後備字串；刪了中文玩家會看到英文。

UI_ModOptions_JVM_PathfindNativeAStar.ch: 原生 A* 快速尋路 (PZPathFind64.dll)
UI_ModOptions_JVM_PathfindNativeAStar.cn: 原生 A* 快速寻路 (PZPathFind64.dll)

UI_ModOptions_JVM_PathfindVehicleThrottl.cn: 车辆导航网格更新限流器
UI_ModOptions_JVM_PathfindVehicleThrottl._note: 2026-10-29 #1150：上游 EN 檔已移除此鍵，Lua 仍以 MPOptim.GetText(鍵, 英文後備) 讀取（MPOptim_UI_Settings.lua），en 取 Lua 後備字串；刪了中文玩家會看到英文。

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_ChunkBudgetMs.en: Maximum time in milliseconds per frame spent ingesting streamed world chunks. Lower values (2-4ms) maximize framerates on high-refresh monitors; higher values (8-16ms) prevent missing road chunks at high driving speeds.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_ChunkBudgetMs.ch: 每個影格用於接收串流載入之世界區塊的最長時間 (毫秒). 較低的值 (2-4ms) 可在高更新率螢幕上獲得最高影格率; 較高的值 (8-16ms) 可避免高速駕駛時道路區塊缺漏.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_ChunkBudgetMs.cn: 每帧用于接收流式加载的世界区块的最长时间 (毫秒). 较低的值 (2-4ms) 可在高刷新率显示器上最大化帧率; 较高的值 (8-16ms) 可避免高速驾驶时出现道路区块缺失.

UI_ModOptions_JVM_ChunkBudgetMs.ch: 區塊載入每影格時間預算
UI_ModOptions_JVM_ChunkBudgetMs.cn: 区块加载每帧时间预算

UI_TSEW_EcouteCalme.en: I can't hear a thing. Must be quiet up there.
UI_TSEW_EcouteCalme.ch: 什麼都聽不到. 上面應該很安靜.

UI_MEE_LegacyVariantNotice.en:
Moodle Effects Explained - DTEM is now a legacy migration entry.

On Build 42.20.2 and later, this variant no longer changes moodle descriptions.
Disable it and enable the main Moodle Effects Explained mod instead.
The main MEE variant detects DTEM automatically and adds its compatible notes.
UI_MEE_LegacyVariantNotice.ch:
Moodle Effects Explained 的這個變體現已改為舊版遷移項目.

在 Build 42.20.2 以後的版本, 這個變體不再修改狀態圖示說明.
請停用它, 改為啟用 Moodle Effects Explained 主 MOD.
主 MOD 會自動偵測對應的 MOD, 並加上相容的說明.
UI_MEE_LegacyVariantNotice.cn:
Moodle Effects Explained 的这个变体现已改为旧版迁移项.

在 Build 42.20.2 及以后的版本, 这个变体不再修改状态图标说明.

UI_TWF_QOL_SLEEP_MODAL_ENABLE_TT.en: Default: On. Centers the sleep confirmation dialog and shows a warning when worn equipment contributes to discomfort at or above the selected level. Off restores the vanilla sleep confirmation.
UI_TWF_QOL_SLEEP_MODAL_ENABLE_TT.ch: 預設: 開啟. 將睡眠確認對話方塊置中, 並在穿戴裝備造成的不適達到或超過所選等級時顯示警告. 關閉則恢復原版的睡眠確認.
UI_TWF_QOL_SLEEP_MODAL_ENABLE_TT.cn: 默认: 开启. 将睡眠确认对话框居中, 并在穿戴装备造成的不适达到或超过所选等级时显示警告. 关闭则恢复原版的睡眠确认.

UI_TWF_QOL_SLEEP_MODAL_WARNING_LEVEL_TT.en: Default: Level 2. Show a warning only if worn gear contributes to projected sleeping discomfort at or above this level. Level 1: 20, Level 2: 40, Level 3: 60, Level 4: 80. Stress can already increase at Level 1; this setting only changes when the warning appears.
UI_TWF_QOL_SLEEP_MODAL_WARNING_LEVEL_TT.ch: 預設: 等級 2. 只有在穿戴裝備造成的預估睡眠不適達到或超過此等級時才顯示警告. 等級 1: 20, 等級 2: 40, 等級 3: 60, 等級 4: 80. 壓力在等級 1 時就可能增加; 此設定只會改變警告出現的時機.
UI_TWF_QOL_SLEEP_MODAL_WARNING_LEVEL_TT.cn: 默认: 等级 2. 仅当穿戴装备造成的预计睡眠不适达到或超过此等级时才显示警告. 等级 1: 20, 等级 2: 40, 等级 3: 60, 等级 4: 80. 压力在等级 1 时就可能增加; 此设置只会改变警告出现的时机.

UI_TWF_SLEEP_STRESS_LEVEL.ch: 預估不適: %1 / 100 (達 %2 時警告)
UI_TWF_SLEEP_STRESS_LEVEL.cn: 预计不适: %1 / 100 (达到 %2 时警告)

UI_TWF_SLEEP_STRESS_WARNING.en: Discomfort from worn gear will increase stress during sleep.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_STRESS_WARNING.ch: 穿戴裝備造成的不適會在睡眠期間增加壓力.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_STRESS_WARNING.cn: 穿戴装备造成的不适会在睡眠期间增加压力.

UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_FAILED.en: Could not put all uncomfortable gear on the floor. Sleep canceled.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_FAILED.ch: 無法將所有不舒適的裝備放到地上. 已取消睡眠.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_FAILED.cn: 无法将所有不舒适的装备放到地上. 已取消睡眠.

UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_MODE.ch: 就寢模式: 卸下不舒適的裝備
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_MODE.cn: 就寝模式: 卸下不舒适的装备

UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_MODE_TT.en: Automatically drop uncomfortable worn items before sleep (including Favorites), then pick up and wear them after waking. Favorite status is preserved. Off by default; saved across sessions.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_MODE_TT.ch: 睡前自動丟下會造成不適的穿戴物品 (包括收藏的物品), 醒來後再撿起並穿上. 收藏狀態會保留. 預設關閉; 設定會保留到之後的遊戲.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_MODE_TT.cn: 睡前自动丢下会造成不适的穿戴物品 (包括收藏的物品), 醒来后再捡起并穿上. 收藏状态会保留. 默认关闭; 设置会保留到之后的游戏.

UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_NOT_RESTORED.en: Some gear could not be put back on; check the floor.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_NOT_RESTORED.ch: 部分裝備無法穿回; 請檢查地面.
UI_TWF_SLEEP_BEDTIME_NOT_RESTORED.cn: 部分装备无法穿回; 请检查地面.

UI_SMA_JiuJitsuDescription.en: Control an arm, break balance, throw and disengage. The throw causes a knockdown, not health damage. Mastery lowers its stamina cost. Space or Esc releases the hold.
UI_SMA_JiuJitsuDescription.ch: 控制手臂、破壞平衡、摔投後脫離. 摔投會擊倒目標, 但不會造成生命傷害. 精通度會降低其耐力消耗. 按空白鍵或 Esc 可解除擒抱.
UI_SMA_JiuJitsuDescription.cn: 控制手臂、破坏平衡、投摔后脱身. 投摔会将目标击倒, 但不会造成生命值伤害. 精通度会降低其耐力消耗. 按空格键或 Esc 可解除擒抱.

UI_SMA_JiuJitsuTarget.en: Move close in front of an upright zombie. Both fighters need clear ground.
UI_SMA_JiuJitsuTarget.ch: 靠近一隻站立殭屍的正前方. 雙方腳下都需要淨空的地面.
UI_SMA_JiuJitsuTarget.cn: 移动到一只站立僵尸的正前方近处. 双方脚下都需要空旷的地面.

UI_SMA_PakMeiClawFlurryDesc.en: Two rapid claw strikes at close range. Requires mastery 5 and at least 30% endurance.
UI_SMA_PakMeiClawFlurryDesc.ch: 在近距離快速打出兩記爪擊. 需要精通度 5, 且至少有 30%% 耐力.
UI_SMA_PakMeiClawFlurryDesc.cn: 在近距离快速打出两记爪击. 需要精通度5, 且至少有30%%耐力.

UI_SMA_PakMeiCounterDesc.en: Evade an incoming attack without taking damage, then counter the same enemy within 0.55 seconds. Face the enemy and return to striking range. No cooldown or invulnerability.
UI_SMA_PakMeiCounterDesc.ch: 閃避來襲的攻擊且不受傷害, 然後在 0.55 秒內反擊同一名敵人. 需面向敵人並回到打擊距離. 沒有冷卻時間, 也沒有無敵效果.
UI_SMA_PakMeiCounterDesc.cn: 闪避来袭的攻击且不受伤害, 然后在0.55秒内反击同一个敌人. 需面向敌人并回到打击距离. 没有冷却时间, 也没有无敌效果.

UI_SMA_PakMeiPalmDesc.en: Two palm strikes from your current position. Requires a close target and at least 15% endurance.
UI_SMA_PakMeiPalmDesc.ch: 從目前位置打出兩記掌擊. 需要近距離目標, 且至少有 15%% 耐力.
UI_SMA_PakMeiPalmDesc.cn: 从当前位置打出两记掌击. 需要近距离目标, 且至少有15%%耐力.

UI_SMA_PakMeiSweepDesc.en: A committed low sweep against a standing enemy. Requires at least 25% endurance.
UI_SMA_PakMeiSweepDesc.ch: 對站立的敵人全力施展低掃腿. 至少需要 25%% 耐力.
UI_SMA_PakMeiSweepDesc.cn: 对站立的敌人全力施展低扫腿. 至少需要25%%耐力.

UI_SMA_StyleDesc_pakmei.en: Explosive close-range kung fu: compact hand strikes, palms, sweeps and timed evasive counters.
UI_SMA_StyleDesc_pakmei.ch: 爆發性的近距離功夫: 緊湊的手部打擊、掌擊、掃腿與看準時機的閃避反擊.
UI_SMA_StyleDesc_pakmei.cn: 爆发性的近距离功夫: 紧凑的手部打击、掌击、扫腿以及把握时机的闪避反击.

UI_SMA_WR_Identity.en: Punch combos, kicks, slams and a two-hit ground sweep. Aim at a downed target to strike; committed attacks leave you exposed.
UI_SMA_WR_Identity.ch: 組合拳、踢擊、摔擊, 以及兩段攻擊的地面掃腿. 瞄準倒地目標即可攻擊; 全力出招會讓你露出破綻.
UI_SMA_WR_Identity.cn: 组合拳、踢击、摔击, 以及两段攻击的地面扫腿. 瞄准倒地目标即可攻击; 全力出招会让你露出破绽.

UI_SMA_WR_Space.en: Throw unavailable: need open-air, level space and an upright target. Use a standing strike.
UI_SMA_WR_Space.ch: 無法摔投: 需要露天平坦的空間與站立的目標. 請改用站立打擊.
UI_SMA_WR_Space.cn: 无法投摔: 需要露天平坦的空间和站立的目标. 请改用站立打击.

UI_SMA_WR_Target.en: Face an upright zombie at close range. Standing strikes remain available.
UI_SMA_WR_Target.ch: 在近距離面向一隻站立的殭屍. 仍可使用站立打擊.
UI_SMA_WR_Target.cn: 在近距离面对一只站立的僵尸. 仍可使用站立打击.

UI_SMA_WR_bodylockThrow_Help.en: Costs 16% stamina on commitment; requires at least 24%. Up to 2.33s rooted and vulnerable. Face one upright zombie at close range, in open-air level space with room for both bodies. Melee/shove cancels; damage, interruption, death or disconnect releases the hold. Cancellation does not refund stamina. Damage lands only at the source slam. Standing attacks remain usable when a throw is unavailable.
UI_SMA_WR_bodylockThrow_Help.ch: 出招時消耗 16%% 耐力; 至少需要 24%% 耐力. 最多 2.33 秒無法移動且容易受到攻擊. 需在近距離面向一隻站立的殭屍, 並位於露天、平坦且足以容納雙方身體的空間. 近戰/推擠會取消; 受到傷害、被打斷、死亡或斷線會解除擒抱. 取消不會退還耐力. 傷害只會在原始摔擊動作的落地瞬間造成. 無法摔投時仍可使用站立攻擊.
UI_SMA_WR_bodylockThrow_Help.cn: 出招时消耗16%%耐力; 至少需要24%%耐力. 最多2.33秒无法移动且易受攻击. 需在近距离面对一只站立的僵尸, 并处于露天、平坦且能容纳双方身体的空间. 近战/推搡会取消; 受到伤害、被打断、死亡或断线会解除擒抱. 取消不会返还耐力. 伤害只会在原始摔击动作的落地瞬间造成. 无法投摔时仍可使用站立攻击.

Cancellation does not refund stamina. Damage lands only at the source slam. Standing attacks remain usable when a throw is unavailable.

UI_SMA_WR_risingHands_Help.en: A powerful close-range rising strike. Requires 20% stamina; high attack endurance cost. No clinch target needed. Includes the full recovery and leaves you vulnerable to interruption.
UI_SMA_WR_risingHands_Help.ch: 強力的近距離上挑擊. 需要 20%% 耐力; 攻擊耐力消耗高. 不需要纏抱目標. 包含完整的收招時間, 期間容易被打斷.

UI_SMA_WR_screwPiledriver_Help.cn: 出招时消耗24%%耐力; 至少需要32%%耐力. 最多3.67秒无法移动且易受攻击. 需在近距离面对一只站立的僵尸, 并处于露天、平坦且能容纳双方身体的空间. 近战/推搡会取消; 受到伤害、被打断、死亡或断线会解除擒抱. 取消不会返还耐力. 伤害只会在原始摔击动作的落地瞬间造成. 无法投摔时仍可使用站立攻击.

UI_Injectors_Note_ZombieInfectionAmount.ch: 每 tick 的感染變化量
UI_Injectors_Note_ZombieInfectionAmount.cn: 每 tick 的感染变化量

UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeEndurance.ch: 控制耐力的恢復或消耗. (範圍: 0-1)
UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeEndurance.cn: 控制耐力的恢复或消耗. (范围: 0-1)

UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeFoodSickness.ch: 控制食物中毒程度. (範圍: 0-100)
UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeFoodSickness.cn: 控制食物中毒程度. (范围: 0-100)

UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeIntoxication.ch: 隨時間控制酒醉程度. (範圍: 0-100)
UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeIntoxication.cn: 随时间控制醉酒程度. (范围: 0-100)

UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeOverdose.ch: 隨時間施加藥物過量懲罰.
UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeOverdose.cn: 随时间施加药物过量惩罚.

UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeZombieInfection.ch: 控制殭屍感染進程. (範圍: 0-100)
UI_Injectors_Notes_ChangeZombieInfection.cn: 控制僵尸感染进程. (范围: 0-100)

UI_Injectors_Notes_MendBleeding.en: Reduces bleeding time on affected body parts.
UI_Injectors_Notes_MendBleeding.ch: 縮短受影響身體部位的流血時間.
UI_Injectors_Notes_MendBleeding.cn: 缩短受影响身体部位的流血时间.

UI_Injectors_Notes_MendDeepWound.en: Reduces deep wound healing time on affected body parts.
UI_Injectors_Notes_MendDeepWound.ch: 縮短受影響身體部位的深傷口癒合時間.
UI_Injectors_Notes_MendDeepWound.cn: 缩短受影响身体部位的深伤口愈合时间.

UI_Injectors_OverdoseBlocked.en: I can't take any more of this right now.
UI_Injectors_OverdoseBlocked.ch: 我現在承受不了更多了.
UI_Injectors_OverdoseBlocked.cn: 我现在承受不了更多了.

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessDenied.en: You cannot change that in this claim.
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessDenied.ch: 你無法在此認領中變更該項.
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessDenied.cn: 你无法在此认领中更改该项.

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessHintDefault.en: Applies to every member who has not been given rights of their own, including members added later. Manage is never a default.
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessHintDefault.ch: 套用於所有未個別設定權限的成員, 包括之後加入的成員. 「管理」永遠不會是預設權限.
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessHintDefault.cn: 适用于所有未单独设置权限的成员, 包括之后添加的成员. “管理”永远不会是默认权限.

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessHintMember.en: A member can always enter the claim. To keep someone out, remove them.
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessHintMember.ch: 成員一律可以進入認領範圍. 若要不讓某人進入, 請將其移除.
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessHintMember.cn: 成员始终可以进入认领范围. 若要不让某人进入, 请将其移除.

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_build.en: You may not build in this claim
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_build.ch: 你不能在此認領中建造
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_build.cn: 你不能在此认领中建造

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_containers.en: You may not use containers in this claim
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_containers.ch: 你不能使用此認領中的容器
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_containers.cn: 你不能使用此认领中的容器

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_destroy.en: You may not destroy anything in this claim
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_destroy.ch: 你不能破壞此認領中的任何東西
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNoRight_destroy.cn: 你不能破坏此认领中的任何东西

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessNotMember.en: %1 is not a member of this claim.

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_build.en: Build - construct, move furniture, barricade, set up generators
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_build.ch: 建造 - 興建、搬動家具、加固門窗、架設發電機
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_build.cn: 建造 - 修建、搬动家具、加固门窗、架设发电机

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_containers.en: Use containers - take, store, craft from them, run generators
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_containers.ch: 使用容器 - 拿取、存放、用其中物品製作、運轉發電機
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_containers.cn: 使用容器 - 拿取、存放、用其中物品制作、运行发电机

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_destroy.ch: 破壞 - 拆解、用大錘敲毀、拆毀家具
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_destroy.cn: 破坏 - 拆解、用大锤砸毁、拆毁家具

UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_manage.en: Manage - invite and remove members, set their rights, public entry
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_manage.ch: 管理 - 邀請與移除成員、設定其權限、公開進入
UI_JeevesClaims_AccessRight_manage.cn: 管理 - 邀请和移除成员、设置其权限、公开进入

UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntryHint.en: Visitors are never members: they cannot build, destroy, set a respawn point here or keep the claim from expiring. They are shown as Visitor in the member list while they are inside.
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntryHint.ch: 訪客永遠不會是成員: 他們不能建造、破壞、在此設定重生點, 也無法讓認領免於過期. 訪客待在裡面時, 會在成員清單中顯示為「訪客」.
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntryHint.cn: 访客永远不会是成员: 他们不能建造、破坏、在此设置重生点, 也无法使认领免于过期. 访客待在里面时, 会在成员列表中显示为“访客”.

UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntrySaved_contain.en: Claim open to visitors, containers included.
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntrySaved_contain.ch: 認領已對訪客開放, 包括容器.
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntrySaved_contain.cn: 认领已对访客开放, 包括容器.

UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_containers.en: Open - anyone may walk in and use containers
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_containers.ch: 開放 - 任何人都可以走進來並使用容器
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_containers.cn: 开放 - 任何人都可以走进来并使用容器

UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_enter.en: Open - anyone may walk in, but not touch anything
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_enter.ch: 開放 - 任何人都可以走進來, 但不能碰任何東西
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_enter.cn: 开放 - 任何人都可以走进来, 但不能碰任何东西

UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_off.ch: 關閉 - 只有成員可以進入
UI_JeevesClaims_PublicEntry_off.cn: 关闭 - 只有成员可以进入

UI_JeevesClaims_RespawnNotMember.en: You can only respawn inside a claim you belong to.
UI_JeevesClaims_RespawnNotMember.ch: 你只能在自己所屬的認領內重生.
UI_JeevesClaims_RespawnNotMember.cn: 你只能在自己所属的认领内重生.

UI_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DGround_tooltip.en: Off: the ground snow in Viewpoint's 3D view is flat for you, whatever the sandbox says. With the 3D snow on vehicles off too, there is no 3D snow anywhere. Only with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DGround_tooltip.ch: 關閉: 無論沙盒如何設定, 你在 Viewpoint 3D 視角中看到的地面積雪都是平的. 若同時關閉車輛 3D 積雪, 就完全沒有 3D 積雪. 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DGround_tooltip.cn: 关闭: 无论沙盒设置如何, 你在 Viewpoint 3D 视角中看到的地面积雪都是平的. 若同时关闭车辆 3D 积雪, 就完全没有 3D 积雪. 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组.

UI_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DVehicles_tooltip.en: Off: the snow on vehicles in Viewpoint's 3D view is flat for you (no snow caps on top), whatever the sandbox says. With the 3D snow on the ground off too, there is no 3D snow anywhere. Only with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DVehicles_tooltip.ch: 關閉: 無論沙盒如何設定, 你在 Viewpoint 3D 視角中看到的車輛積雪都是平的 (上方沒有隆起的雪頂). 若同時關閉地面 3D 積雪, 就完全沒有 3D 積雪. 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_Snow3DVehicles_tooltip.cn: 关闭: 无论沙盒设置如何, 你在 Viewpoint 3D 视角中看到的车辆积雪都是平的 (上方没有隆起的雪顶). 若同时关闭地面 3D 积雪, 就完全没有 3D 积雪. 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组.

UI_ImmersiveSnow_SnowSlowdown_tooltip.en: Off: the 3D snow does not slow you down. In multiplayer the server alone decides, this switch does nothing there. Only with the Immersive Snow - Viewpoint add-on.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_SnowSlowdown_tooltip.ch: 關閉: 3D 積雪不會拖慢你. 多人遊戲中完全由伺服器決定, 此開關在多人遊戲中沒有作用. 僅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模組.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_SnowSlowdown_tooltip.cn: 关闭: 3D 积雪不会减慢你的速度. 多人游戏中完全由服务器决定, 此开关在多人游戏中不起作用. 仅限搭配 Immersive Snow - Viewpoint 附加模组.

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRDynamic.en: Dynamically adjusts FSR render scale based on real-time frametime headroom against target FPS (down to 65% or chosen scale) to absorb sudden horde or weather spikes.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRDynamic.ch: 依據即時影格時間相對於目標 FPS 的餘裕, 動態調整 FSR 渲染比例 (最低 65%% 或所選比例), 以吸收屍群或天氣造成的突發負載尖峰.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRDynamic.cn: 根据实时帧时间相对目标 FPS 的余量, 动态调整 FSR 渲染比例 (最低 65%% 或所选比例), 以消化尸群或天气带来的突发负载峰值.

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSREnabled.en: Renders the 3D world at performance scale and reconstructs it with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (EASU + RCAS) while UI text stays native. Massive FPS boost on 1440p, 4K, and handhelds.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSREnabled.ch: 以效能比例渲染 3D 世界, 再用 AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (EASU + RCAS) 重建畫面, 介面文字則維持原生解析度. 在 1440p、4K 與掌機上可大幅提升 FPS.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSREnabled.cn: 以性能比例渲染 3D 世界, 再用 AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (EASU + RCAS) 重建画面, 界面文字则保持原生分辨率. 在 1440p、4K 和掌机上可大幅提升 FPS.

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRScale.en: Upscaling render resolution preset. Ultra Quality (77%) provides near-native image clarity with 30-50%+ FPS gains; Performance (50%) provides maximum boost.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRScale.ch: 放大用的渲染解析度預設. Ultra Quality (77%%) 可提供接近原生的畫面清晰度, 並帶來 30-50%% 以上的 FPS 提升; Performance (50%%) 則提供最大幅度的提升.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRScale.cn: 放大用的渲染分辨率预设. Ultra Quality (77%%) 可提供接近原生的画面清晰度, 并带来 30-50%% 以上的 FPS 提升; Performance (50%%) 则提供最大幅度的提升.

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRSharpness.en: Robust Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening strength (0% = soft, 80% = recommended, 100% = max crispness).
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRSharpness.ch: Robust Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening 強度 (0%% = 柔和, 80%% = 建議值, 100%% = 最銳利).
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_FSRSharpness.cn: Robust Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening 强度 (0%% = 柔和, 80%% = 推荐值, 100%% = 最锐利).

UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey.en: Grab / let go of the nearest cart
UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey.ch: 抓住 / 放開最近的推車
UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey.cn: 抓住 / 放开最近的推车
UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey._note: 2026-10-26 As1 v3.12.0 收錄 FTZ Carts & Trolleys（3815775971）後退役 own 目錄，As1 未收的這鍵遷入本層

UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey_tooltip.en: Picks up the nearest cart on the ground with both hands, or lets go of the cart you are pushing.
UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey_tooltip.ch: 用雙手抓起地上最近的推車, 或放開你正在推的推車.
UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey_tooltip.cn: 用双手抓起地上最近的推车, 或放开你正在推的推车.
UI_FTZCarts_GrabKey_tooltip._note: 2026-10-26 As1 v3.12.0 收錄 FTZ Carts & Trolleys（3815775971）後退役 own 目錄，As1 未收的這鍵遷入本層

UI_bl_say_hypochondriac.en: Is that a fever? That's a fever.
UI_bl_say_hypochondriac.ch: 這是發燒嗎? 是發燒沒錯.
UI_bl_say_hypochondriac.cn: 这是发烧吗? 肯定是发烧.

UI_bl_say_paranoid.en: Someone's out there. I know it.
UI_bl_say_paranoid.ch: 外面有人. 我就知道.
UI_bl_say_paranoid.cn: 外面有人. 我知道的.

UI_bl_say_ptsd.ch: 別又來了. 別又來了.
UI_bl_say_ptsd.cn: 不要再来了. 不要再来了.

UI_bl_say_squeamish.en: Don't look at it. Don't look.

UI_bl_say_tremors.ch: 穩住. 該死, 給我穩住.
UI_bl_say_tremors.cn: 稳住. 该死的, 给我稳住.

UI_bl_say_war_never_ends.ch: 有砲擊… 不. 不對, 很安靜.
UI_bl_say_war_never_ends.cn: 炮火来袭… 不. 不对, 很安静.

UI_profdesc_bl_accountant.en: Spreadsheets, audits, tax season. None of it transfers. Cheap start, clean slate.
UI_profdesc_bl_accountant.ch: 試算表, 稽核, 報稅季. 這些全都派不上用場. 起步成本低, 一切從頭來過.
UI_profdesc_bl_accountant.cn: 电子表格, 审计, 报税季. 这些全都派不上用场. 起步成本低, 一切从头开始.

UI_profdesc_bl_actor.en: Community theater and one regional commercial. You can be anybody.
UI_profdesc_bl_actor.ch: 社區劇場, 外加一支地方廣告. 你可以成為任何人.
UI_profdesc_bl_actor.cn: 社区剧场, 外加一支地方广告. 你可以扮演任何人.

UI_profdesc_bl_architect.en: You designed buildings. Now you fortify them.
UI_profdesc_bl_architect.ch: 你過去設計建築. 現在你負責加固它們.
UI_profdesc_bl_architect.cn: 你曾经设计建筑. 现在你负责加固它们.
