UI_profdesc_bl_barber.en: Thirty years of straight razors and small talk.
UI_profdesc_bl_barber.ch: 三十年來與直剃刀和閒聊為伍.
UI_profdesc_bl_barber.cn: 三十年来与直剃刀和闲聊为伴.

UI_profdesc_bl_bartender.en: Every regular's story, every bottle's pour. You've broken up worse fights than this.
UI_profdesc_bl_bartender.ch: 每位常客的故事, 每瓶酒的倒法, 你都一清二楚. 比這更糟的打架你都勸開過.
UI_profdesc_bl_bartender.cn: 每位熟客的故事, 每瓶酒该怎么倒, 你都了如指掌. 比这更凶的斗殴你都拉开过.

UI_profdesc_bl_beekeeper.en: Patience, smoke, and a healthy respect for things that swarm.
UI_profdesc_bl_beekeeper.ch: 耐心, 煙燻, 以及對成群生物應有的敬畏.
UI_profdesc_bl_beekeeper.cn: 耐心, 烟熏, 以及对成群生物应有的敬畏.

UI_profdesc_bl_bodyguard.en: Paid to stand between someone important and everything else.
UI_profdesc_bl_bodyguard.ch: 受僱擋在重要人物與其他一切之間.
UI_profdesc_bl_bodyguard.cn: 受雇挡在重要人物与其他一切之间.

UI_profdesc_bl_bountyhunter.en: Skip tracing and door kicking. Everybody runs. You were paid to know where.
UI_profdesc_bl_bountyhunter.ch: 追查行蹤, 踹門抓人. 每個人都會跑. 你的工作就是知道他們跑去哪.
UI_profdesc_bl_bountyhunter.cn: 追查下落, 踹门抓人. 每个人都会逃. 你拿钱就是为了知道他们逃去哪.

UI_profdesc_bl_butcher.en: Meat is meat. You've never been squeamish about where it comes from.
UI_profdesc_bl_butcher.ch: 肉就是肉. 你從不在意它從哪來.
UI_profdesc_bl_butcher.cn: 肉就是肉. 你从不介意它来自哪里.

UI_profdesc_bl_carthief.en: Slim jim, screwdriver, forty seconds. Nothing in this county stays locked to you.
UI_profdesc_bl_carthief.ch: 開鎖鐵片, 螺絲起子, 四十秒. 這個縣裡沒有什麼鎖得住你.
UI_profdesc_bl_carthief.cn: 撬锁片, 螺丝刀, 四十秒. 这个县里没有什么锁得住你.

UI_profdesc_bl_cashier.en: Double shifts and exact change. The register's not opening again.
UI_profdesc_bl_cashier.ch: 連上兩班, 找零分毫不差. 收銀機再也不會打開了.
UI_profdesc_bl_cashier.cn: 连上两班, 找零分毫不差. 收银机再也不会打开了.

UI_profdesc_bl_conartist.en: You sold people their own wallets and they thanked you for it.
UI_profdesc_bl_conartist.ch: 你把人家自己的錢包賣回給他們, 他們還向你道謝.
UI_profdesc_bl_conartist.cn: 你把别人自己的钱包卖给他们, 他们还对你感恩戴德.

UI_profdesc_bl_corrections.en: Years walking the tiers. You know how people act when the walls close in.
UI_profdesc_bl_corrections.ch: 多年在監舍各層巡邏. 你知道人在四面高牆逼近時會有什麼反應.
UI_profdesc_bl_corrections.cn: 多年在监区各层巡逻. 你知道人在四壁合围时会作何反应.

UI_profdesc_bl_cultmember.en: You left the compound, or it left you. The gardens were real, at least.
UI_profdesc_bl_cultmember.ch: 你離開了那個大院, 或是大院離開了你. 至少那些菜園是真的.
UI_profdesc_bl_cultmember.cn: 你离开了那个大院, 或者说大院离开了你. 至少那些菜园是真的.

UI_profdesc_bl_dealer.en: You moved product and never got caught holding. Quick, quiet, always watching the corners.
UI_profdesc_bl_dealer.ch: 你負責出貨, 從沒被抓到身上帶貨. 手腳快, 不出聲, 時時盯著街角.
UI_profdesc_bl_dealer.cn: 你负责出货, 从没被抓到身上带货. 手脚快, 不声张, 时刻盯着街角.

UI_profdesc_bl_dentist.en: Precision work in small dark places. Patients feared you before the world ended.
UI_profdesc_bl_dentist.ch: 在狹小陰暗處精細作業. 世界末日之前, 病人就已經怕你了.
UI_profdesc_bl_dentist.cn: 在狭小幽暗处做精细活. 世界末日之前, 病人就已经怕你了.

UI_profdesc_bl_deputy.en: County roads, domestic calls, and a cruiser you'll never fuel again.
UI_profdesc_bl_deputy.ch: 縣道巡邏, 家庭糾紛報案, 還有一輛你再也不會加油的巡邏車.
UI_profdesc_bl_deputy.cn: 县道巡逻, 家庭纠纷出警, 还有一辆你再也不会加油的巡逻车.

UI_profdesc_bl_drifter.en: No fixed address before it was mandatory. You've been rehearsing this your whole life.
UI_profdesc_bl_drifter.ch: 早在大家被迫居無定所之前, 你就沒有固定住址. 你這輩子都在為此預演.
UI_profdesc_bl_drifter.cn: 早在大家被迫居无定所之前, 你就没有固定住址. 你这辈子都在为此预演.

UI_profdesc_bl_enforcer.en: You collected what was owed. People paid because of what happened when they didn't.
UI_profdesc_bl_enforcer.ch: 你負責收債. 人們乖乖付錢, 是因為知道不付會有什麼下場.
UI_profdesc_bl_enforcer.cn: 你负责收债. 人们乖乖还钱, 是因为知道不还会有什么下场.

UI_profdesc_bl_exconvict.en: You did your time. The skills you left with weren't on the rehabilitation brochure.
UI_profdesc_bl_exconvict.ch: 你服完了刑. 但你出獄時帶走的本事, 可不在更生手冊上.
UI_profdesc_bl_exconvict.cn: 你服完了刑. 但你出狱时带走的本事, 可不在改造宣传册上.

UI_profdesc_bl_farmhand.en: Up before the sun, done after it. Work that never once ended.
UI_profdesc_bl_farmhand.ch: 日出前起床, 日落後收工. 工作從來沒有做完過.
UI_profdesc_bl_farmhand.cn: 日出前起床, 日落后收工. 活儿从来没干完过.

UI_profdesc_bl_fence.en: Everything that fell off a truck went through your back room first.
UI_profdesc_bl_fence.ch: 所有「從卡車上掉下來」的東西, 都先經過你的後屋.
UI_profdesc_bl_fence.cn: 所有“从卡车上掉下来”的东西, 都先经过你的后屋.

UI_profdesc_bl_glazier.en: Glass work: storefronts, windshields, the occasional aquarium. Steady hands or stitches.
UI_profdesc_bl_glazier.ch: 玻璃工作: 店面櫥窗, 擋風玻璃, 偶爾還有水族箱. 手不穩就等著縫針.
UI_profdesc_bl_glazier.cn: 玻璃活: 店面橱窗, 挡风玻璃, 偶尔还有鱼缸. 手不稳就等着缝针.

UI_profdesc_bl_gravedigger.en: You buried this county for years. Business has never been worse.
UI_profdesc_bl_gravedigger.ch: 你替這個縣埋了好幾年的人. 生意從沒這麼差過.
UI_profdesc_bl_gravedigger.cn: 你替这个县埋了好几年的人. 生意从来没这么差过.

UI_profdesc_bl_infantry.en: You carried a rifle for a living. Some of it never got put down.
UI_profdesc_bl_infantry.ch: 你靠扛步槍維生. 有些東西從未真正放下.
UI_profdesc_bl_infantry.cn: 你曾以扛步枪为生. 有些东西从未真正放下.

UI_profdesc_bl_janitor.en: Keys to every door in the building and nobody ever looked at you twice.
UI_profdesc_bl_janitor.ch: 你有這棟建築每一扇門的鑰匙, 卻從沒有人多看你一眼.
UI_profdesc_bl_janitor.cn: 你有这栋楼每一扇门的钥匙, 却从没有人多看你一眼.

UI_profdesc_bl_journalist.en: You chased the story. The story caught everyone.
UI_profdesc_bl_journalist.ch: 你一直在追新聞. 結果新聞追上了所有人.
UI_profdesc_bl_journalist.cn: 你一直在追新闻. 结果新闻追上了所有人.

UI_profdesc_bl_lawyer.ch: 異議: 世界末日. 駁回.
UI_profdesc_bl_lawyer.cn: 反对: 世界末日. 反对无效.

UI_profdesc_bl_librarian.en: Quiet, organized, and you know where every book in town lives.
UI_profdesc_bl_librarian.ch: 安靜, 井然有序, 而且你知道鎮上每本書放在哪裡.
UI_profdesc_bl_librarian.cn: 安静, 有条理, 而且你知道镇上每本书在哪里.

UI_profdesc_bl_loanshark.en: Five points a week, and you were your own collections department.
UI_profdesc_bl_loanshark.ch: 每週五分利, 而且催收部門就是你自己.
UI_profdesc_bl_loanshark.cn: 每周五分利, 而且催收部就是你自己.

UI_profdesc_bl_locksmith.en: Every lock is a conversation. You always got the last word.
UI_profdesc_bl_locksmith.ch: 每把鎖都是一場對話. 最後說了算的總是你.
UI_profdesc_bl_locksmith.cn: 每把锁都是一场对话. 最后拍板的总是你.

UI_profdesc_bl_machinist.en: Tolerances in thousandths. The shop floor taught you patience and precision.
UI_profdesc_bl_machinist.ch: 公差精確到千分位. 車間教會了你耐心與精準.
UI_profdesc_bl_machinist.cn: 公差精确到千分位. 车间教会了你耐心与精准.

UI_profdesc_bl_methcook.en: Chemistry degree from a trailer outside town. Your product was the cleanest in three counties.
UI_profdesc_bl_methcook.ch: 化學學位是在鎮外的拖車裡拿到的. 你的貨是方圓三個縣裡最純的.
UI_profdesc_bl_methcook.cn: 化学学位是在镇外的拖车里拿的. 你的货是周边三个县里最纯的.

UI_profdesc_bl_musician.en: Bar gigs and gas money. Quick fingers, thick calluses.
UI_profdesc_bl_musician.ch: 在酒吧表演, 賺點油錢. 手指靈活, 繭也厚.
UI_profdesc_bl_musician.cn: 在酒吧演出, 挣点油钱. 手指灵活, 老茧也厚.

UI_profdesc_bl_panhandler.en: Invisible to everyone, surviving on nothing. Deep experience with both.
UI_profdesc_bl_panhandler.ch: 所有人都對你視而不見, 你靠著一無所有活下來. 這兩件事你都經驗豐富.
UI_profdesc_bl_panhandler.cn: 所有人都对你视而不见, 你靠一无所有活下来. 这两样你都经验丰富.

UI_profdesc_bl_paramedic.en: Lights, sirens, and the worst night of everyone else's life, every night.
UI_profdesc_bl_paramedic.ch: 警示燈, 警笛, 以及別人一生中最糟的一夜, 夜夜如此.
UI_profdesc_bl_paramedic.cn: 警灯, 警笛, 还有别人一生中最糟的一夜, 夜夜如此.

UI_profdesc_bl_pharmacist.en: You know every pill in the county and exactly what it does. So do the people who robbed you.
UI_profdesc_bl_pharmacist.ch: 你認得縣裡每一種藥丸, 也清楚它們的作用. 搶劫你的人也一樣.
UI_profdesc_bl_pharmacist.cn: 你认得县里每一种药片, 也清楚它们的作用. 抢劫你的人也一样.

UI_profdesc_bl_photographer.en: You made a living going unnoticed and framing the shot.
UI_profdesc_bl_photographer.ch: 你靠著不被注意與抓準構圖維生.
UI_profdesc_bl_photographer.cn: 你靠不被注意和把握构图谋生.

UI_profdesc_bl_pi.en: Cheating spouses and insurance fraud. You watch, you wait, you write it down.
UI_profdesc_bl_pi.ch: 外遇的配偶與保險詐欺. 你觀察, 你等待, 你記錄下來.
UI_profdesc_bl_pi.cn: 出轨的配偶和保险欺诈. 你观察, 你等待, 你记录下来.

UI_profdesc_bl_plumber.en: Pipes, pressure, and other people's messes. Honest work, filthy hands.
UI_profdesc_bl_plumber.ch: 水管, 水壓, 還有別人留下的爛攤子. 工作正當, 雙手骯髒.
UI_profdesc_bl_plumber.cn: 管道, 水压, 还有别人留下的烂摊子. 工作正经, 双手肮脏.

UI_profdesc_bl_poacher.en: Out of season, off the books, one shot. Wardens never caught you. Nothing will now.
UI_profdesc_bl_poacher.ch: 非狩獵季, 不留紀錄, 一槍斃命. 獵場管理員從沒抓到你. 現在也沒有什麼抓得到你了.
UI_profdesc_bl_poacher.cn: 非狩猎季, 不留记录, 一枪毙命. 猎场看守从没抓到过你. 现在也没有什么能抓到你了.

UI_profdesc_bl_professor.en: Tenure meant nothing to the dead. At least you're used to hostile audiences.
UI_profdesc_bl_professor.ch: 終身教職對死人毫無意義. 至少你早就習慣充滿敵意的聽眾.
UI_profdesc_bl_professor.cn: 终身教职对死人毫无意义. 至少你早就习惯了充满敌意的听众.

UI_profdesc_bl_psychiatrist.en: You spent a career in other people's heads. Now everyone's diagnosis is terminal.
UI_profdesc_bl_psychiatrist.ch: 你整個職涯都在探究別人的腦袋. 如今每個人的診斷都是末期.
UI_profdesc_bl_psychiatrist.cn: 你整个职业生涯都在钻研别人的脑子. 如今每个人的诊断都是晚期.

UI_profdesc_bl_radiohost.en: Late-night AM, callers and static. You know your way around a transmitter.
UI_profdesc_bl_radiohost.ch: 深夜 AM 廣播, 叩應聽眾與雜訊. 你對發射機瞭若指掌.
UI_profdesc_bl_radiohost.cn: 深夜 AM 广播, 热线听众和杂音. 你对发射机了如指掌.

UI_profdesc_bl_roofer.en: Two stories up in July heat. Heights don't scare you. Falling does, a little.
UI_profdesc_bl_roofer.ch: 七月酷暑中站在兩層樓高. 高處嚇不倒你. 摔下去倒是有點可怕.
UI_profdesc_bl_roofer.cn: 七月酷暑里站在两层楼高处. 高处吓不倒你. 摔下去倒是有点怕.

UI_profdesc_bl_scientist.en: Method, measurement, repeatability. The world stopped being repeatable.
UI_profdesc_bl_scientist.ch: 方法, 量測, 可重複性. 世界已經不再可重複了.
UI_profdesc_bl_scientist.cn: 方法, 测量, 可重复性. 这个世界已经不再可重复了.

UI_profdesc_bl_scrapper.en: Copper, steel, aluminum. One man's wreck was your paycheck.
UI_profdesc_bl_scrapper.ch: 銅, 鋼, 鋁. 別人的廢鐵就是你的薪水.
UI_profdesc_bl_scrapper.cn: 铜, 钢, 铝. 别人的残骸就是你的工资.

UI_profdesc_bl_smuggler.en: River routes, hollow panels, cash on delivery. No questions either direction.
UI_profdesc_bl_smuggler.ch: 河道運輸, 中空夾層, 貨到付款. 雙方都不過問.
UI_profdesc_bl_smuggler.cn: 河道运输, 中空夹层, 货到付款. 双方互不过问.

UI_profdesc_bl_streetpreacher.en: You said the end was coming. Nobody's laughing at the sign now.
UI_profdesc_bl_streetpreacher.ch: 你說過末日將近. 現在沒人再笑你的標語牌了.
UI_profdesc_bl_streetpreacher.cn: 你说过末日将至. 现在没人再笑你的牌子了.

UI_profdesc_bl_surgeon.en: You've had hands inside a human chest. This is not the retirement you planned.
UI_profdesc_bl_surgeon.ch: 你曾把手伸進人的胸腔裡. 這可不是你規劃的退休生活.
UI_profdesc_bl_surgeon.cn: 你曾把手伸进人的胸腔. 这可不是你计划的退休生活.

UI_profdesc_bl_swat.en: Breach, clear, repeat. Trained for the worst day. It came.
UI_profdesc_bl_swat.ch: 破門, 清除, 重複. 你為最糟的那一天受訓. 那一天來了.
UI_profdesc_bl_swat.cn: 破门, 清场, 重复. 你为最糟的那一天受训. 那一天来了.

UI_profdesc_bl_tattooartist.en: Steady needle, clean lines, and more anatomy than most nurses.
UI_profdesc_bl_tattooartist.ch: 針法穩定, 線條俐落, 懂的解剖學比多數護士還多.
UI_profdesc_bl_tattooartist.cn: 针法稳定, 线条利落, 懂的解剖学比大多数护士还多.

UI_profdesc_bl_taxidriver.en: You know the streets and you've heard everybody's worst opinions.
UI_profdesc_bl_taxidriver.ch: 你熟悉大街小巷, 也聽過每個人最糟糕的高見.
UI_profdesc_bl_taxidriver.cn: 你熟悉大街小巷, 也听过每个人最糟糕的高见.

UI_profdesc_bl_trapper.en: Lines checked at dawn. The woods feed the ones who pay attention.
UI_profdesc_bl_trapper.ch: 黎明時巡一遍陷阱. 森林會餵飽用心留意的人.
UI_profdesc_bl_trapper.cn: 黎明时巡一遍陷阱. 森林会养活用心留意的人.

UI_profdesc_bl_truckdriver.en: Long hauls, short sleep, and every backroad in Kentucky memorized.
UI_profdesc_bl_truckdriver.ch: 長途運輸, 睡眠短少, 肯塔基州的每條鄉間小路都記在腦中.
UI_profdesc_bl_truckdriver.cn: 长途运输, 睡眠不足, 肯塔基州的每条乡间小路都记在脑子里.

UI_profdesc_bl_veterinarian.en: Large animal practice. If it bleeds, you can probably stitch it.
UI_profdesc_bl_veterinarian.ch: 專看大型動物. 只要會流血, 你大概都縫得起來.
UI_profdesc_bl_veterinarian.cn: 专看大型动物. 只要会流血, 你多半都能缝上.

UI_profdesc_bl_welder.en: Sparks, steel, and a steady bead. You built things meant to outlast you.
UI_profdesc_bl_welder.ch: 火花, 鋼鐵, 平穩的焊道. 你打造的東西本就要比你活得更久.
UI_profdesc_bl_welder.cn: 火花, 钢铁, 平稳的焊缝. 你打造的东西本就要比你活得更久.

UI_trait_bl_abandonment_issuesdesc.en: Everyone leaves. Being alone with that thought costs you, at random.
UI_trait_bl_abandonment_issuesdesc.ch: 每個人都會離開. 獨處時被這念頭纏上會讓你付出代價, 隨機發作.
UI_trait_bl_abandonment_issuesdesc.cn: 每个人都会离开. 独处时被这个念头缠上会让你付出代价, 随机发作.

UI_trait_bl_alcoholicdesc.en: Dry is not an option. Withdrawal builds misery, stress, and shakes until you drink.
UI_trait_bl_alcoholicdesc.ch: 戒酒不在選項之內. 戒斷會不斷累積憂鬱, 壓力與顫抖, 直到你喝酒為止.
UI_trait_bl_alcoholicdesc.cn: 戒酒不在考虑之列. 戒断会不断累积忧郁, 压力和颤抖, 直到你喝酒为止.

UI_trait_bl_anxiety_disorderdesc.en: The dread doesn't need a reason. Panic and stress rise steadily on their own.
UI_trait_bl_anxiety_disorderdesc.ch: 恐懼不需要理由. 恐慌與壓力會自行持續上升.
UI_trait_bl_anxiety_disorderdesc.cn: 恐惧不需要理由. 恐慌和压力会自行持续上升.

UI_trait_bl_arthritisdesc.en: Your joints are twenty years older than the rest of you. Weaker grip, and working outdoors wears you out and wears on you.
UI_trait_bl_arthritisdesc.ch: 你的關節比身體其他部位老了二十歲. 握力較弱, 在戶外工作既讓你疲累, 也讓你心煩.
UI_trait_bl_arthritisdesc.cn: 你的关节比身体其他部位老了二十岁. 握力较弱, 在户外干活既让你疲惫, 也让你烦闷.

UI_trait_bl_backyard_mechanicdesc.en: Three project cars, one that ran. You learned on rust and swearing.
UI_trait_bl_backyard_mechanicdesc.ch: 三台改裝車, 只有一台跑得動. 你是在鏽蝕與咒罵中學會的.
UI_trait_bl_backyard_mechanicdesc.cn: 三辆改装车, 只有一辆能开. 你是在锈迹和咒骂中学会的.

UI_trait_bl_bad_backdesc.en: Lifting wrong once was all it took. Constant extra fatigue.
UI_trait_bl_bad_backdesc.ch: 只是一次搬重物姿勢不對. 持續額外疲勞.
UI_trait_bl_bad_backdesc.cn: 只是一次搬东西姿势不对. 持续额外疲劳.

UI_trait_bl_bipolardesc.en: Long lows broken by manic surges of energy and mood - and every surge crashes harder a few hours later.
UI_trait_bl_bipolardesc.ch: 漫長的低潮之間穿插著精力與情緒的躁狂高漲, 而每次高漲後幾小時都會摔得更重.
UI_trait_bl_bipolardesc.cn: 漫长的低潮之间穿插着精力和情绪的躁狂高涨, 而每次高涨几小时后都会跌得更狠.

UI_trait_bl_bum_kneedesc.en: It gave out in '89 and never forgave you. Extra fatigue on your feet outdoors.
UI_trait_bl_bum_kneedesc.ch: 它在 89 年壞掉, 從此再也沒原諒你. 在戶外站立或行走時額外疲勞.
UI_trait_bl_bum_kneedesc.cn: 它在 89 年罢工, 从此再也没原谅你. 在户外站立或行走时额外疲劳.

UI_trait_bl_cannerdesc.en: Rows of jars in the cellar. Grandma's method, zero botulism to date.
UI_trait_bl_cannerdesc.ch: 地窖裡一排排罐子. 奶奶傳下的方法, 至今零肉毒桿菌中毒.
UI_trait_bl_cannerdesc.cn: 地窖里一排排罐子. 奶奶传下来的方法, 至今零肉毒杆菌中毒.

UI_trait_bl_catatonic_episodesdesc.en: Sometimes you just stop. Rare, sudden, crushing waves of exhaustion.
UI_trait_bl_catatonic_episodesdesc.ch: 有時你就這樣停住了. 罕見, 突然且壓倒性的疲憊感會一波波襲來.
UI_trait_bl_catatonic_episodesdesc.cn: 有时你就这样停住了. 罕见, 突然且压倒性的疲惫会一阵阵袭来.

UI_trait_bl_chain_smokerdesc.en: Two packs a day, minimum. You smoke like anyone else who smokes - but the craving comes back twice as fast, and only a cigarette answers it. Starts with smokes.
UI_trait_bl_chain_smokerdesc.ch: 一天至少兩包. 你抽菸的方式跟其他菸民一樣, 但菸癮回來的速度快一倍, 而且只有香菸能解. 開局附帶香菸.
UI_trait_bl_chain_smokerdesc.cn: 一天至少两包. 你抽烟的方式和其他烟民一样, 但烟瘾回来的速度快一倍, 而且只有香烟能解. 开局自带香烟.

UI_trait_bl_chronic_paindesc.en: It never fully stops hurting. Steady fatigue and a permanent drag on your mood.
UI_trait_bl_chronic_paindesc.ch: 疼痛從未完全停止. 持續疲勞, 心情也長期受到拖累.
UI_trait_bl_chronic_paindesc.cn: 疼痛从未完全停止. 持续疲劳, 心情也长期受到拖累.

UI_trait_bl_clinical_depressiondesc.en: The heaviest kind of tired. Unhappiness climbs relentlessly without something to hold it down.
UI_trait_bl_clinical_depressiondesc.ch: 最沉重的那種疲憊. 若沒有東西壓住, 憂鬱會無情地不斷攀升.
UI_trait_bl_clinical_depressiondesc.cn: 最沉重的那种疲惫. 如果没有东西压住, 忧郁会无情地持续攀升.

UI_trait_bl_dead_shotdesc.en: You hit what you look at. Always have.
UI_trait_bl_dead_shotdesc.ch: 看哪打哪. 一向如此.
UI_trait_bl_dead_shotdesc.cn: 指哪打哪. 一直如此.

UI_trait_bl_death_wishdesc.en: Nothing left to lose burns clean: far less stress, far more darkness.
UI_trait_bl_death_wishdesc.ch: 一無所有反而燒得乾淨: 壓力大幅減少, 陰暗大幅增加.
UI_trait_bl_death_wishdesc.cn: 一无所有反而烧得干净: 压力大大减少, 阴暗大大增加.

UI_trait_bl_deer_hunterdesc.en: Tree stand at 4 AM, one shot at first light.
UI_trait_bl_deer_hunterdesc.ch: 凌晨 4 點爬上樹架, 天一亮就一槍解決.
UI_trait_bl_deer_hunterdesc.cn: 凌晨 4 点爬上树架, 天刚亮就一枪解决.

UI_trait_bl_dirt_poor_raiseddesc.en: You grew up fixing what couldn't be replaced. Scarcity is your native language.
UI_trait_bl_dirt_poor_raiseddesc.ch: 你從小就在修補無法替換的東西. 匱乏是你的母語.
UI_trait_bl_dirt_poor_raiseddesc.cn: 你从小就在修补无法替换的东西. 匮乏是你的母语.

UI_trait_bl_dissociativedesc.en: You float away when it gets bad. Less stress, more melancholy. You're not all the way here.
UI_trait_bl_dissociativedesc.ch: 情況一糟你就神遊天外. 壓力較少, 憂鬱較多. 你從不完全在場.
UI_trait_bl_dissociativedesc.cn: 情况一糟你就神游物外. 压力较少, 忧郁较多. 你从不完全在场.

UI_trait_bl_epilepticdesc.en: Rare, sudden seizures: crushing fatigue and stress, wherever you happen to be standing.
UI_trait_bl_epilepticdesc.ch: 罕見且突然的癲癇發作: 無論你身在何處, 都會帶來壓倒性的疲勞與壓力.
UI_trait_bl_epilepticdesc.cn: 罕见且突然的癫痫发作: 无论你身在何处, 都会带来压倒性的疲劳和压力.

UI_trait_bl_even_keeldesc.en: Slow to anger, slow to rattle. Stress drains steadily.
UI_trait_bl_even_keeldesc.ch: 不易動怒, 不易慌亂. 壓力會穩定消退.
UI_trait_bl_even_keeldesc.cn: 不易动怒, 不易慌乱. 压力会稳定消退.

UI_trait_bl_faithfuldesc.en: Whatever you believe, it's load-bearing. Stress drains slowly.
UI_trait_bl_faithfuldesc.ch: 無論你信什麼, 它都撐住了你. 壓力會緩慢消退.
UI_trait_bl_faithfuldesc.cn: 无论你信什么, 它都撑着你. 压力会缓慢消退.

UI_trait_bl_field_medic_coursedesc.en: Combat lifesaver certified. Tourniquets, pressure, don't die.
UI_trait_bl_field_medic_coursedesc.ch: 持有戰鬥救生員證照. 止血帶, 加壓止血, 別死.
UI_trait_bl_field_medic_coursedesc.cn: 持有战斗救生员资格. 止血带, 加压止血, 别死.

UI_trait_bl_foragerdesc.en: You see food where others see weeds.
UI_trait_bl_foragerdesc.ch: 別人眼中的雜草, 在你眼中都是食物.
UI_trait_bl_foragerdesc.cn: 别人眼里的杂草, 在你眼里都是食物.

UI_trait_bl_functional_addictdesc.en: Years of practice holding it together. Alcohol, pill and opioid withdrawal hits you at half strength. Does not blunt a meth crash - nothing does.
UI_trait_bl_functional_addictdesc.ch: 多年來硬撐著過日子早已成了習慣. 酒精, 藥丸與鴉片類藥物的戒斷對你只有一半效力. 但無法減輕冰毒藥效退去後的崩潰, 什麼都擋不住.
UI_trait_bl_functional_addictdesc.cn: 多年来硬撑着过日子早已习以为常. 酒精, 药片和阿片类药物的戒断对你只有一半效力. 但无法减轻冰毒药效退去后的崩溃, 什么都挡不住.

UI_trait_bl_gambling_addictdesc.en: The itch never left. Stress builds, and the losses replay at random.
UI_trait_bl_gambling_addictdesc.ch: 那股手癢從未消失. 壓力會累積, 輸錢的回憶也會隨機重播.
UI_trait_bl_gambling_addictdesc.cn: 那股心痒从未消失. 压力会累积, 输钱的回忆也会随机重现.

UI_trait_bl_glass_case_of_emotiondesc.en: Everything hits you at full volume. Frequent spikes of panic, misery, and stress.
UI_trait_bl_glass_case_of_emotiondesc.ch: 一切都以最大音量衝擊著你. 恐慌, 憂鬱與壓力頻繁飆升.
UI_trait_bl_glass_case_of_emotiondesc.cn: 一切都以最大音量冲击着你. 恐慌, 忧郁和压力频繁飙升.

UI_trait_bl_green_thumbdesc.en: Things grow for you. Always have.
UI_trait_bl_green_thumbdesc.ch: 植物在你手中就是長得好. 一向如此.
UI_trait_bl_green_thumbdesc.cn: 东西在你手里就是长得好. 一直如此.

UI_trait_bl_grill_masterdesc.en: Smoke rings and secret rubs. Meat obeys you.
UI_trait_bl_grill_masterdesc.ch: 煙燻紅圈與獨門醃料. 肉都聽你的.
UI_trait_bl_grill_masterdesc.cn: 烟熏红圈和秘制香料. 肉都听你的.

UI_trait_bl_gun_nutdesc.en: Safe full of iron, opinions to match. You know weapons.
UI_trait_bl_gun_nutdesc.ch: 保險箱裡塞滿了槍, 意見也一樣多. 你懂武器.
UI_trait_bl_gun_nutdesc.cn: 保险柜里塞满了枪, 意见也一样多. 你懂武器.

UI_trait_bl_handloaderdesc.en: You rolled your own ammunition at the kitchen table. Powder, primer, patience.
UI_trait_bl_handloaderdesc.ch: 你在廚房餐桌上自己裝填彈藥. 火藥, 底火, 耐心.
UI_trait_bl_handloaderdesc.cn: 你在厨房餐桌上自己复装弹药. 火药, 底火, 耐心.

UI_trait_bl_hardy_stockdesc.en: Your people don't get sick and don't stay down. Good genes, mean grandmother.
UI_trait_bl_hardy_stockdesc.ch: 你們家的人不生病, 倒下了也會爬起來. 基因好, 奶奶兇.
UI_trait_bl_hardy_stockdesc.cn: 你们家的人不生病, 倒下了也会爬起来. 基因好, 奶奶凶.

UI_trait_bl_herb_loredesc.en: Which leaf soothes and which one kills. Passed down, not taught.
UI_trait_bl_herb_loredesc.ch: 哪種葉子能舒緩, 哪種會致命. 這是代代相傳, 而非課堂教的.
UI_trait_bl_herb_loredesc.cn: 哪种叶子能舒缓, 哪种会致命. 这是代代相传, 不是课上教的.

UI_trait_bl_hotheaddesc.en: Zero to swinging in four words. Random stress flares.
UI_trait_bl_hotheaddesc.ch: 四個字就能讓你從平靜到揮拳. 壓力會隨機爆發.
UI_trait_bl_hotheaddesc.cn: 四个字就能让你从平静到动手. 压力会随机爆发.

UI_trait_bl_hypochondriacdesc.en: Every itch is the infection. Random stress spikes, especially inconvenient in this economy.
UI_trait_bl_hypochondriacdesc.ch: 每處發癢都是感染. 壓力隨機飆升, 在這種世道下尤其不是時候.
UI_trait_bl_hypochondriacdesc.cn: 每处发痒都是感染. 压力随机飙升, 在这种世道下尤其不是时候.

UI_trait_bl_iron_lungsdesc.en: Deep tank, slow burn. You can run and keep running.
UI_trait_bl_iron_lungsdesc.ch: 肺活量大, 消耗緩慢. 你能跑, 而且能一直跑下去.
UI_trait_bl_iron_lungsdesc.cn: 肺活量大, 消耗缓慢. 你能跑, 而且能一直跑下去.

UI_trait_bl_junkiedesc.en: Chronic opioid habit. Four hours past your last painkiller the misery, stress and exhaustion set in, and stay until you find another. The habit itself never fades. Starts with one bottle.
UI_trait_bl_junkiedesc.ch: 長期依賴鴉片類藥物. 距離上次服用止痛藥四小時後, 憂鬱, 壓力與疲憊便會襲來, 直到你再找到一顆為止. 這個癮本身永遠不會消退. 開局附帶一瓶.
UI_trait_bl_junkiedesc.cn: 长期依赖阿片类药物. 距离上次服用止痛药四小时后, 忧郁, 压力和疲惫便会袭来, 直到你再找到一颗为止. 这个瘾本身永远不会消退. 开局自带一瓶.

UI_trait_bl_keen_nosedesc.en: You smell rain, rot, and trouble before anyone else.
UI_trait_bl_keen_nosedesc.ch: 你比任何人都更早嗅到雨水, 腐爛與麻煩.
UI_trait_bl_keen_nosedesc.cn: 你比任何人都更早闻到雨水, 腐烂和麻烦.

UI_trait_bl_knife_fighterdesc.en: Close, fast, and personal. You learned where it counts.
UI_trait_bl_knife_fighterdesc.ch: 貼身, 迅速, 近在咫尺. 你是在真正要緊的地方學會的.
UI_trait_bl_knife_fighterdesc.cn: 贴身, 迅速, 近在咫尺. 你是在真正要紧的地方学会的.

UI_trait_bl_marathon_runnerdesc.cn: 26.2 贴纸都是辛辛苦苦跑出来的.

UI_trait_bl_medicated_stabledesc.en: The prescription works. Steady stress and mood recovery. Pray the pharmacies hold out. Starts with a bottle.
UI_trait_bl_medicated_stabledesc.ch: 處方藥有效. 壓力穩定緩解, 心情穩定好轉. 祈禱藥局的存貨撐得住吧. 開局附帶一瓶.
UI_trait_bl_medicated_stabledesc.cn: 处方药有效. 压力稳定缓解, 心情稳定好转. 祈祷药店的存货撑得住吧. 开局自带一瓶.

UI_trait_bl_meth_addictdesc.en: You start hooked, hard. Withdrawal hits fast and mean without a fix. Comes with your works.
UI_trait_bl_meth_addictdesc.ch: 你一開局就重度成癮. 沒有毒品可吸時, 戒斷會來得又快又兇. 開局附帶你的吸毒器具.
UI_trait_bl_meth_addictdesc.cn: 你一开局就重度成瘾. 没有毒品可吸时, 戒断会来得又快又凶. 开局自带你的吸毒用具.

UI_trait_bl_migrainesdesc.en: White light and a vice behind the eyes, at random. Stress and fatigue spikes.
UI_trait_bl_migrainesdesc.ch: 眼前一片白光, 眼睛後方像被虎鉗夾住, 隨機發作. 壓力與疲勞飆升.
UI_trait_bl_migrainesdesc.cn: 眼前一片白光, 眼睛后面像被台钳夹住, 随机发作. 压力和疲劳飙升.

UI_trait_bl_missing_fingersdesc.en: The saw, the door, the fight. What's left of the hand never grips like it used to.
UI_trait_bl_missing_fingersdesc.ch: 鋸子, 門, 打架. 殘缺的手再也無法像以前那樣握緊.
UI_trait_bl_missing_fingersdesc.cn: 锯子, 门, 打架. 残缺的手再也无法像以前那样握紧.

UI_trait_bl_moonshinerdesc.en: Copper coil, creek water, family recipe. Distillation is chemistry with better outcomes.
UI_trait_bl_moonshinerdesc.ch: 銅製冷凝管, 溪水, 家傳配方. 蒸餾就是結果更美好的化學.
UI_trait_bl_moonshinerdesc.cn: 铜制冷凝管, 溪水, 祖传配方. 蒸馏就是结果更美好的化学.

UI_trait_bl_narcolepticdesc.en: Sleep takes you without asking. Sudden waves of exhaustion at random.
UI_trait_bl_narcolepticdesc.ch: 睡意不請自來. 突如其來的疲憊會隨機一波波襲來.
UI_trait_bl_narcolepticdesc.cn: 睡意不请自来. 突如其来的疲惫会随机一阵阵袭来.

UI_trait_bl_night_terrorsdesc.en: You wake screaming most nights. Heavy fatigue and violent panic spikes after dark.
UI_trait_bl_night_terrorsdesc.ch: 你幾乎每晚都尖叫著醒來. 入夜後會嚴重疲勞, 恐慌也會劇烈飆升.
UI_trait_bl_night_terrorsdesc.cn: 你几乎每晚都尖叫着醒来. 入夜后会严重疲劳, 恐慌也会剧烈飙升.

UI_trait_bl_ocddesc.en: Check the door. Check it again. Constant background stress from a brain that won't sign off.
UI_trait_bl_ocddesc.ch: 檢查門. 再檢查一次. 腦袋始終停不下來, 背景壓力持續不斷.
UI_trait_bl_ocddesc.cn: 检查门. 再检查一次. 大脑始终无法下班, 持续带来背景压力.

UI_trait_bl_old_scarsdesc.en: Some history is written on you. A quiet, permanent weight on your mood.
UI_trait_bl_old_scarsdesc.ch: 有些過往就刻在你身上. 無聲且永久地壓著你的心情.
UI_trait_bl_old_scarsdesc.cn: 有些过往就刻在你身上. 无声且永久地压着你的心情.

UI_trait_bl_pain_tolerancedesc.en: Pain is information, not an argument. Slight stress recovery; nothing rattles you easily.
UI_trait_bl_pain_tolerancedesc.ch: 疼痛只是資訊, 不是爭論. 壓力略有緩解; 沒什麼能輕易動搖你.
UI_trait_bl_pain_tolerancedesc.cn: 疼痛只是信息, 不是争论. 压力略有缓解; 没什么能轻易动摇你.

UI_trait_bl_panic_attacksdesc.en: Out of nowhere: chest tight, vision narrow, heart slamming. Severe random panic spikes.
UI_trait_bl_panic_attacksdesc.ch: 毫無預兆: 胸口發緊, 視野變窄, 心臟狂跳. 恐慌會隨機劇烈飆升.
UI_trait_bl_panic_attacksdesc.cn: 毫无征兆: 胸口发紧, 视野变窄, 心脏狂跳. 恐慌会随机剧烈飙升.

UI_trait_bl_paranoiddesc.en: They are watching. Constant stress, and sudden certainty that something's out there.
UI_trait_bl_paranoiddesc.ch: 他們在監視你. 壓力持續不斷, 還會突然確信外面有什麼東西.
UI_trait_bl_paranoiddesc.cn: 他们在监视你. 压力持续不断, 还会突然确信外面有什么东西.

UI_trait_bl_pill_popperdesc.en: A bottle-a-week habit. Eight hours without a dose and the misery and stress start climbing. Stay dry for a week and it loosens its grip. Starts with a stash.
UI_trait_bl_pill_popperdesc.ch: 一週一瓶的習慣. 八小時沒吃藥, 憂鬱與壓力就開始攀升. 戒藥一週後, 它對你的控制就會放鬆. 開局附帶一批存貨.
UI_trait_bl_pill_popperdesc.cn: 一周一瓶的习惯. 八小时不服药, 忧郁和压力就开始攀升. 戒药一周后, 它对你的控制就会放松. 开局自带一批存货.

UI_trait_bl_psychopathdesc.en: Nothing touches you. Panic, stress, and grief bleed away on their own. People notice the eyes.
UI_trait_bl_psychopathdesc.ch: 沒有什麼能觸動你. 恐慌, 壓力與悲傷都會自行消散. 人們會注意到你的眼神.
UI_trait_bl_psychopathdesc.cn: 没有什么能触动你. 恐慌, 压力和悲伤都会自行消散. 人们会注意到你的眼神.

UI_trait_bl_ptsddesc.en: Constant background stress. Flashbacks strike at random: panic, cold sweat, gone again.
UI_trait_bl_ptsddesc.ch: 背景壓力持續不斷. 創傷記憶會隨機閃現: 恐慌, 冷汗, 然後又消失.
UI_trait_bl_ptsddesc.cn: 背景压力持续不断. 闪回会随机发作: 恐慌, 冷汗, 然后又消失.

UI_trait_bl_quick_handsdesc.en: Cards, locks, knots. Your hands finish before your brain does.
UI_trait_bl_quick_handsdesc.ch: 紙牌, 鎖頭, 繩結. 你的手總比腦袋先完成.
UI_trait_bl_quick_handsdesc.cn: 纸牌, 锁头, 绳结. 你的手总比脑子先完成.

UI_trait_bl_schizophrenicdesc.en: The voices didn't end with the world. Constant stress and violent random episodes.
UI_trait_bl_schizophrenicdesc.ch: 那些聲音並沒有隨著世界一起終結. 壓力持續不斷, 還會隨機劇烈發作.
UI_trait_bl_schizophrenicdesc.cn: 那些声音并没有随着世界一起终结. 压力持续不断, 还会随机剧烈发作.

UI_trait_bl_seamstressdesc.en: A machine in the spare room and a thousand hems behind you.
UI_trait_bl_seamstressdesc.ch: 空房間裡有台縫紉機, 你已縫過上千道摺邊.
UI_trait_bl_seamstressdesc.cn: 空房间里有台缝纫机, 你已经缝过上千道卷边.

UI_trait_bl_second_winddesc.en: When everyone else is done, you find another gear. Fatigue recovers faster.
UI_trait_bl_second_winddesc.ch: 當別人都撐不下去時, 你還能再提一檔. 疲勞恢復較快.
UI_trait_bl_second_winddesc.cn: 当别人都撑不住时, 你还能再提一档. 疲劳恢复更快.

UI_trait_bl_shade_tree_welderdesc.ch: 焊道很醜, 但永遠撐得住.
UI_trait_bl_shade_tree_welderdesc.cn: 焊缝很丑, 但永远撑得住.

UI_trait_bl_short_fusedesc.en: Everything is a provocation. Stress builds fast.
UI_trait_bl_short_fusedesc.ch: 什麼都像挑釁. 壓力累積得很快.
UI_trait_bl_short_fusedesc.cn: 什么都像挑衅. 压力累积得很快.

UI_trait_bl_slow_twitchdesc.en: Built for the long haul, useless in a sprint. You start out of condition and stay that way.
UI_trait_bl_slow_twitchdesc.ch: 天生適合長途耐力, 衝刺則毫無用處. 你開局狀態就不好, 而且一直都會如此.
UI_trait_bl_slow_twitchdesc.cn: 天生适合长途耐力, 冲刺则毫无用处. 你开局体能就不佳, 而且会一直如此.

UI_trait_bl_sociopathdesc.en: Other people are furniture. Stress and unhappiness slide off you.
UI_trait_bl_sociopathdesc.ch: 其他人不過是家具. 壓力與憂鬱都從你身上滑落.
UI_trait_bl_sociopathdesc.cn: 其他人不过是家具. 压力和忧郁都从你身上滑走.

UI_trait_bl_split_personalitydesc.en: There's someone else in here, and you don't always get a vote. RP trait with random stress.
UI_trait_bl_split_personalitydesc.ch: 這裡面還有另一個人, 而你不一定有表決權. 角色扮演特質, 會隨機產生壓力.
UI_trait_bl_split_personalitydesc.cn: 这里面还有另一个人, 而你不一定有投票权. 角色扮演特质, 会随机产生压力.

UI_trait_bl_squeamishdesc.en: Blood, guts, and gristle turn you gray. It catches up with you at the worst moments.
UI_trait_bl_squeamishdesc.ch: 血液, 內臟與軟骨會讓你臉色發白. 它總在最糟的時候找上你.
UI_trait_bl_squeamishdesc.cn: 血液, 内脏和软骨会让你脸色发白. 它总在最糟的时候找上你.

UI_trait_bl_stone_colddesc.en: Flat, calm, unbothered. Panic and stress both bleed down over time.
UI_trait_bl_stone_colddesc.ch: 平淡, 冷靜, 不受干擾. 恐慌與壓力都會隨時間逐漸消退.
UI_trait_bl_stone_colddesc.cn: 平淡, 冷静, 不受打扰. 恐慌和压力都会随时间逐渐消退.

UI_trait_bl_stray_magnetdesc.en: Animals find you and stay. Always have.
UI_trait_bl_stray_magnetdesc.ch: 動物總會找上你, 而且留下來. 一向如此.
UI_trait_bl_stray_magnetdesc.cn: 动物总会找上你, 并且留下来. 一直如此.

UI_trait_bl_street_smartdesc.en: You read rooms, corners, and people fast, because you had to.
UI_trait_bl_street_smartdesc.ch: 你能迅速看穿場面, 街角與人心, 因為你不得不如此.
UI_trait_bl_street_smartdesc.cn: 你能迅速看穿场面, 街角和人心, 因为你不得不这样.

UI_trait_bl_survivor_guiltdesc.en: Everyone else is gone and you're not. Persistent sadness that ambushes you.
UI_trait_bl_survivor_guiltdesc.ch: 其他人都不在了, 你卻還在. 揮之不去的悲傷會突然襲來.
UI_trait_bl_survivor_guiltdesc.cn: 其他人都不在了, 你却还在. 挥之不去的悲伤会突然袭来.

UI_trait_bl_thick_neckdesc.en: Built like a fireplug. Collars fear you.
UI_trait_bl_thick_neckdesc.ch: 壯得像根消防栓. 衣領都怕你.
UI_trait_bl_thick_neckdesc.cn: 壮得像个消防栓. 衣领都怕你.

UI_trait_bl_tourettesdesc.en: Tics and outbursts you don't choose. Frequent, minor, exhausting.
UI_trait_bl_tourettesdesc.ch: 不由自主的抽動與爆發. 頻繁, 輕微, 卻令人疲憊.
UI_trait_bl_tourettesdesc.cn: 不由自主的抽动和发作. 频繁, 轻微, 却令人疲惫.

UI_trait_bl_tremorsdesc.en: Your hands shake. Coffee, nerves, genetics, does it matter? Fighting them wears you down, and the bad ones come out of nowhere.
UI_trait_bl_tremorsdesc.ch: 你的手會抖. 咖啡, 緊張, 遺傳, 重要嗎? 跟它對抗會讓你身心俱疲, 而嚴重的發作總是毫無預兆.
UI_trait_bl_tremorsdesc.cn: 你的手会抖. 咖啡, 紧张, 遗传, 有区别吗? 与它对抗会让你身心俱疲, 而严重的发作总是毫无征兆.

UI_trait_bl_trivia_championdesc.en: Tuesday nights at the bar, undefeated. Full of facts, some useful. RP trait.
UI_trait_bl_trivia_championdesc.ch: 週二晚上的酒吧問答, 從未敗過. 滿腦子知識, 有些還挺有用. 角色扮演特質.
UI_trait_bl_trivia_championdesc.cn: 周二晚上的酒吧问答, 从未输过. 满脑子知识, 有些还挺有用. 角色扮演特质.

UI_trait_bl_varsity_athletedesc.en: Letter jacket, two sports, knees still mostly fine.
UI_trait_bl_varsity_athletedesc.ch: 校隊夾克, 兩項運動, 膝蓋大致還好.
UI_trait_bl_varsity_athletedesc.cn: 校队夹克, 两项运动, 膝盖大体还行.

UI_trait_bl_war_never_endsdesc.en: Nights are the worst. Stress climbs after dark and the incoming fire follows you into the quiet.
UI_trait_bl_war_never_endsdesc.ch: 夜晚最難熬. 入夜後壓力攀升, 來襲的砲火聲一路跟著你進入寂靜.
UI_trait_bl_war_never_endsdesc.cn: 夜晚最难熬. 入夜后压力攀升, 来袭的炮火声一路跟着你进入寂静.

UI_trait_bl_will_to_livedesc.en: Something in you refuses to quit. Unhappiness recovers on its own.
UI_trait_bl_will_to_livedesc.ch: 你心裡有股力量拒絕放棄. 憂鬱會自行消退.
UI_trait_bl_will_to_livedesc.cn: 你心里有股力量拒绝放弃. 忧郁会自行消退.

UI_trait_bl_woods_wisedesc.en: The forest is a pantry, a pharmacy, and a hiding place, if you know it. You know it.
UI_trait_bl_woods_wisedesc.ch: 只要你懂得森林, 它就是食物櫃, 藥局與藏身處. 而你懂.
UI_trait_bl_woods_wisedesc.cn: 只要你了解森林, 它就是食品柜, 药房和藏身之处. 而你了解它.

UI_BPE_ClimbLog.ch: 將夜魔攀爬紀錄寫入 console.txt
UI_BPE_ClimbLog.cn: 将夜魔攀爬记录写入 console.txt

UI_BPE_ClimbLog_tooltip.en: For bug reports. Writes what volatiles decide at fences to console.txt. On a server, admins also turn on the server log.
UI_BPE_ClimbLog_tooltip.ch: 供回報錯誤使用. 將夜魔在圍欄前的判斷寫入 console.txt. 在伺服器上, 管理員也會一併開啟伺服器日誌.
UI_BPE_ClimbLog_tooltip.cn: 用于报告错误. 将夜魔在栅栏前的判断写入 console.txt. 在服务器上, 管理员也会一并开启服务器日志.

UI_RadioTraders_BankBoxAmbushWarning.en: Raiders are coming for your money!

UI_RadioTraders_BankBoxDeposited.ch: 已存入 $%1, 分裝於 %2 個箱子
UI_RadioTraders_BankBoxDeposited.cn: 已存入 $%1, 分装在 %2 个箱子中

UI_RadioTraders_NoGoldBarToDeposit.en: You don't have any Gold or valuables to deposit.
UI_RadioTraders_NoGoldBarToDeposit.ch: 你沒有任何可存入的黃金或貴重物品.
UI_RadioTraders_NoGoldBarToDeposit.cn: 你没有任何可存入的黄金或贵重品.

UI_Fletcher_Diag_InGame.en: Load a game first, then equip a bow and press Check compatibility again.
UI_Fletcher_Diag_InGame.ch: 請先載入遊戲, 裝備弓之後再按一次「檢查相容性」.
UI_Fletcher_Diag_InGame.cn: 请先加载游戏, 装备弓之后再按一次“检查兼容性”.

UI_Fletcher_Diag_Where.en: Full report: %1 (in your Zomboid folder; also in console.txt, lines starting [Fletcher diag]). Share it in a comment on Fletcher's Workshop page.
UI_Fletcher_Diag_Where.ch: 完整報告: %1 (位於你的 Zomboid 資料夾; 也記錄在 console.txt 中以 [Fletcher diag] 開頭的行). 請在 Fletcher 的創意工坊頁面留言分享.
UI_Fletcher_Diag_Where.cn: 完整报告: %1 (位于你的 Zomboid 文件夹; 也记录在 console.txt 中以 [Fletcher diag] 开头的行). 请在 Fletcher 的创意工坊页面留言分享.

UI_Fletcher_Option_AdvancedLob.en: Advanced lob shots (power by draw time)
UI_Fletcher_Option_AdvancedLob.ch: 進階拋射 (依拉弓時間決定力道)
UI_Fletcher_Option_AdvancedLob.cn: 进阶抛射 (按拉弓时间决定力度)

UI_Fletcher_Option_AdvancedLob_tooltip.en: Lob shots get their power from you: hold the Lob Shot key (controller: D-pad up) while aiming and the power builds (a meter shows it by the reticle). More power sends the arrow higher and steeper onto the same spot, longer in the air; too little falls short of the white mark. In first / third person (ViewPoint), tap the key (controller: D-pad down) on a spot to mark it, then look up: the meter's green band is the power that lands there. Your Archery level steadies the power, and a stronger lob hits harder. Off: Fletcher picks the arc for you.
UI_Fletcher_Option_AdvancedLob_tooltip.ch: 拋射的力道由你掌控: 瞄準時按住拋射鍵 (控制器: 方向鍵上), 力道就會累積 (準星旁會有量表顯示). 力道越大, 箭飛得越高, 以越陡的角度落在同一點, 滯空時間也越長; 力道太小則會落在白色標記之前. 在第一/第三人稱 (ViewPoint) 下, 對著某個位置輕按該鍵 (控制器: 方向鍵下) 即可標記, 接著抬頭看: 量表上的綠色區段就是能落到該處的力道. 射箭等級能讓力道更穩定, 而力道越強的拋射傷害越高. 關閉時: 由 Fletcher 替你選擇弧線.
UI_Fletcher_Option_AdvancedLob_tooltip.cn: 抛射的力度由你掌控: 瞄准时按住抛射键 (手柄: 十字键上), 力度就会累积 (准星旁会有量表显示). 力度越大, 箭飞得越高, 以越陡的角度落在同一点, 滞空时间也越长; 力度太小则会落在白色标记之前. 在第一/第三人称 (ViewPoint) 下, 对着某个位置轻按该键 (手柄: 十字键下) 即可标记, 然后抬头看: 量表上的绿色区段就是能落到该处的力度. 射箭等级能让力度更稳定, 而力度越强的抛射伤害越高. 关闭时: 由 Fletcher 替你选择弧线.

UI_Fletcher_Option_CheckCompat_tooltip.en: Bow invisible, wrong animations, stuck after a shot? Equip a bow, then press this: Fletcher checks what it needs from the game and your other mods, shows what it found, and writes a report to Zomboid/Lua/Fletcher_diagnostics.txt to share with the mod author.
UI_Fletcher_Option_CheckCompat_tooltip.ch: 弓看不見、動畫錯誤、射擊後卡住? 先裝備弓, 再按這個按鈕: Fletcher 會檢查它需要從遊戲與你的其他模組取得的內容, 顯示檢查結果, 並把報告寫入 Zomboid/Lua/Fletcher_diagnostics.txt, 方便分享給模組作者.
UI_Fletcher_Option_CheckCompat_tooltip.cn: 弓不显示、动画错误、射击后卡住? 先装备弓, 再按这个按钮: Fletcher 会检查它需要从游戏和你的其他模组获取的内容, 显示检查结果, 并把报告写入 Zomboid/Lua/Fletcher_diagnostics.txt, 方便分享给模组作者.

UI_Fletcher_Option_LightArrowKey_tooltip.en: Lights the fire arrow on your bow (with a lighter or matches). Tapping the reload key again does the same.
UI_Fletcher_Option_LightArrowKey_tooltip.ch: 點燃弓上的火焰箭矢 (需要打火機或火柴). 再按一下裝填鍵也有相同效果.
UI_Fletcher_Option_LightArrowKey_tooltip.cn: 点燃弓上的火焰箭矢 (需要打火机或火柴). 再按一下装填键效果相同.

UI_Fletcher_Option_LobKey_tooltip.en: Hold while you shoot a bow or crossbow: the arrow goes up and over what's in the way (a tall fence, a wall, a car) and comes down on the spot under your reticle. K is a free key (vanilla leaves it unbound). Controllers: hold the Controller Lob Button (D-pad up unless you change it below) while aiming.
UI_Fletcher_Option_LobKey_tooltip.ch: 用弓或十字弩射擊時按住: 箭會向上越過擋路的東西 (高圍欄、牆壁、車輛), 落在準星下方的位置. K 是空閒的按鍵 (原版未綁定). 控制器: 瞄準時按住「控制器拋射按鈕」 (除非你在下方更改, 否則為方向鍵上).
UI_Fletcher_Option_LobKey_tooltip.cn: 用弓或十字弩射击时按住: 箭会向上越过挡路的东西 (高围栏、墙壁、汽车), 落在准星下方的位置. K 是空闲的按键 (原版未绑定). 手柄: 瞄准时按住“手柄抛射按钮” (除非你在下方更改, 否则为十字键上).

UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowGuide_tooltip.en: While aiming, a dashed line shows where your arrow would go if you shot now (without the shot's spread): white for a normal shot, blue through an upstairs window, orange for a lob. A red mark where it would stop, green on a zombie. A practice and testing aid: off by default.
UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowGuide_tooltip.ch: 瞄準時, 一條虛線會顯示你現在射出時箭的去向 (不計散布): 白色為一般射擊, 藍色為穿過樓上窗戶, 橘色為拋射. 箭會停下的位置顯示紅色標記, 落在殭屍身上則為綠色. 用於練習與測試的輔助功能: 預設關閉.
UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowGuide_tooltip.cn: 瞄准时, 一条虚线会显示你现在射出时箭的去向 (不计散布): 白色为普通射击, 蓝色为穿过楼上窗户, 橙色为抛射. 箭会停下的位置显示红色标记, 落在僵尸身上则为绿色. 用于练习和测试的辅助功能: 默认关闭.

UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowTrails_tooltip.en: The streak and the thin line that follow a flying arrow. Turn off to see the arrow alone. Only changes what you see.
UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowTrails_tooltip.ch: 跟在飛行箭矢後方的光跡與細線. 關閉後只會看到箭本身. 只影響畫面顯示.
UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowTrails_tooltip.cn: 跟在飞行箭矢后方的光迹和细线. 关闭后只会看到箭本身. 仅影响画面显示.

UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowXpGains_tooltip.en: A note over your character each time you gain Archery XP (a hit, a kill, target practice, a tape), with the amount you really got. Skills without a boost from your profession or traits gain a quarter of the XP.
UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowXpGains_tooltip.ch: 每次獲得射箭經驗時 (命中、擊殺、標靶練習、錄影帶), 角色頭上會顯示提示, 標出實際獲得的數量. 沒有職業或特質加成的技能只能獲得四分之一的經驗.
UI_Fletcher_Option_ShowXpGains_tooltip.cn: 每次获得射箭经验时 (命中、击杀、标靶练习、录像带), 角色头顶会显示提示, 标明实际获得的数值. 没有职业或特质加成的技能只能获得四分之一的经验.

UI_Fletcher_Option_padLob_tooltip.en: On a controller, hold this while you aim a bow or crossbow to lob the shot. It only takes the button while you aim a Fletcher launcher; the rest of the time it does what it always did. Pick another button if you use the D-pad while aiming for something else, or Off.
UI_Fletcher_Option_padLob_tooltip.ch: 使用控制器時, 用弓或十字弩瞄準時按住此鍵即可拋射. 只有在你用 Fletcher 的弓弩瞄準時才會占用此按鈕; 其他時候按鈕維持原本的功能. 如果你瞄準時會用方向鍵做其他事, 請改選其他按鈕, 或選「關閉」.
UI_Fletcher_Option_padLob_tooltip.cn: 使用手柄时, 用弓或十字弩瞄准时按住此键即可抛射. 只有在你用 Fletcher 的弓弩瞄准时才会占用此按钮; 其他时候按钮保持原有功能. 如果你瞄准时要用十字键做别的事, 请改选其他按钮, 或选“关闭”.

UI_Fletcher_Option_padMark_tooltip.en: On a controller with advanced lob shots in ViewPoint's view: tap this while aiming to mark the spot under the crosshair (tap at the sky to clear it). Only taken while you aim a Fletcher launcher. If it's the same as the lob button, the lob button wins.
UI_Fletcher_Option_padMark_tooltip.ch: 使用控制器並在 ViewPoint 視角下啟用進階拋射時: 瞄準時輕按此鍵可標記準星下的位置 (對著天空輕按即可清除). 只有在你用 Fletcher 的弓弩瞄準時才會占用. 若與拋射按鈕相同, 以拋射按鈕優先.
UI_Fletcher_Option_padMark_tooltip.cn: 使用手柄并在 ViewPoint 视角下启用进阶抛射时: 瞄准时轻按此键可标记准星下的位置 (对着天空轻按即可清除). 只有在你用 Fletcher 的弓弩瞄准时才会占用. 若与抛射按钮相同, 以抛射按钮优先.

UI_trait_FletcherArcherDesc.en: Grew up shooting a bow and making their own arrows. Draws, steadies and nocks faster from day one.
UI_trait_FletcherArcherDesc.ch: 從小就會射弓, 也會自己做箭. 從第一天起拉弓、穩定瞄準與搭箭都更快.
UI_trait_FletcherArcherDesc.cn: 从小射弓长大, 还会自己做箭. 从第一天起拉弓、稳住瞄准和搭箭都更快.

UI_RAKS_AllDisabled.en: All active cheats have been disabled.
UI_RAKS_AllDisabled.ch: 所有啟用中的作弊已停用.
UI_RAKS_AllDisabled.cn: 所有已启用的作弊均已禁用.

UI_RAKS_AutoSaveHint.en: Once per in-game day at noon (or on the first update after noon), save both character progress and equipment. Restore them separately. Single player.
UI_RAKS_AutoSaveHint.ch: 每個遊戲日中午 (或中午過後的第一次更新) 儲存一次角色進度與裝備. 兩者可分別恢復. 僅限單人模式.
UI_RAKS_AutoSaveHint.cn: 每个游戏日中午 (或中午过后的第一次更新) 保存一次角色进度与装备. 两者可分别恢复. 仅限单人模式.

UI_RAKS_AutoSaved.ch: 角色快照與裝備快照已儲存.
UI_RAKS_AutoSaved.cn: 角色快照与装备快照已保存.

UI_RAKS_Help_AddTuning.en: Best-effort installation of all optional armor, racks, bars, bumpers and other tuning parts exposed by the selected vehicle mod.
UI_RAKS_Help_AddTuning.ch: 盡可能安裝選取的車輛模組所提供的全部選配裝甲、置物架、護桿、保險桿與其他改裝零件.
UI_RAKS_Help_AddTuning.cn: 尽可能安装选中的车辆模组所提供的全部可选装甲、行李架、护杠、保险杠和其他改装零件.

UI_RAKS_Help_AutoSave.en: Every in-game day at 12:00 the menu automatically updates the saved skills and character statistics.
UI_RAKS_Help_AutoSave.ch: 每個遊戲日 12:00, 選單會自動更新已儲存的技能與角色統計資料.
UI_RAKS_Help_AutoSave.cn: 每个游戏日 12:00, 菜单会自动更新已保存的技能与角色统计数据.

UI_RAKS_Help_Barricade.en: LMB or Z applies the selected wood/metal barricade to doors/windows on the square. Set material and plank count in Brush settings.
UI_RAKS_Help_Barricade.ch: 按左鍵或 Z 會在該方格的門/窗上安裝選取的木質/金屬路障. 請在「材料與筆刷設定」中設定材料與木板數量.
UI_RAKS_Help_Barricade.cn: 按左键或 Z 会在该方格的门/窗上安装选中的木质/金属路障. 请在“材料与笔刷设置”中设置材料与木板数量.

UI_RAKS_Help_BrushTool.en: Opens the advanced brush tool, if available.
UI_RAKS_Help_BrushTool.ch: 開啟進階筆刷工具 (若可用).
UI_RAKS_Help_BrushTool.cn: 打开高级笔刷工具 (如果可用).

UI_RAKS_Help_Creative.en: Creative unlocks build and craft actions. Each action receives its own temporary full material kit and required skill levels; vanilla uses that kit, then any leftovers are removed.
UI_RAKS_Help_Creative.ch: 創造模式會解鎖建造與製作動作. 每個動作都會獲得專屬的臨時全套材料與所需技能等級; 原版流程會使用這套材料, 之後剩餘的部分會被移除.
UI_RAKS_Help_Creative.cn: 创造模式会解锁建造与制作动作. 每个动作都会获得专属的临时全套材料和所需技能等级; 原版流程会使用这套材料, 之后剩余部分会被移除.

UI_RAKS_Help_DeleteMode.en: Remove non-floor objects from the pointed square. Protection options are in Brush settings. Back up your save.
UI_RAKS_Help_DeleteMode.ch: 移除游標所指方格上地板以外的物件. 保護選項位於「材料與筆刷設定」. 請備份存檔.
UI_RAKS_Help_DeleteMode.cn: 移除光标所指方格上地板以外的物体. 保护选项位于“材料与笔刷设置”. 请备份存档.

UI_RAKS_Help_DisableAll.en: Turns off all active cheat modes from this menu.
UI_RAKS_Help_DisableAll.ch: 關閉此選單中所有啟用中的作弊模式.
UI_RAKS_Help_DisableAll.cn: 关闭此菜单中所有已启用的作弊模式.

UI_RAKS_Help_FireMode.en: LMB or N starts fire; F extinguishes. Fire can spread. Esc / RMB returns to the menu.
UI_RAKS_Help_FireMode.ch: 按左鍵或 N 起火; 按 F 撲滅. 火勢可能蔓延. 按 Esc / 右鍵返回選單.
UI_RAKS_Help_FireMode.cn: 按左键或 N 点火; 按 F 扑灭. 火势可能蔓延. 按 Esc / 右键返回菜单.

UI_RAKS_Help_Fly.en: Changes elevation using the up/down arrow keys. Use on a backed-up save.
UI_RAKS_Help_Fly.ch: 用上/下方向鍵改變高度. 請在已備份的存檔上使用.
UI_RAKS_Help_Fly.cn: 用上/下方向键改变高度. 请在已备份的存档上使用.

UI_RAKS_Help_ForgetRecipes.ch: 移除所有已學會的配方.
UI_RAKS_Help_ForgetRecipes.cn: 移除所有已学会的配方.

UI_RAKS_Help_FreezeTime.en: Freeze the current clock and calendar date in single player. This is not pause: characters and actions keep moving. Applying a new date/time updates the frozen point. Unfreeze to resume time.
UI_RAKS_Help_FreezeTime.ch: 在單人模式中凍結目前的時鐘與日曆日期. 這不是暫停: 角色與動作仍會繼續進行. 套用新的日期/時間會更新凍結點. 解除凍結即可恢復時間流動.
UI_RAKS_Help_FreezeTime.cn: 在单人模式中冻结当前的时钟与日历日期. 这不是暂停: 角色与动作仍会继续进行. 应用新的日期/时间会更新冻结点. 解除冻结即可恢复时间流动.

UI_RAKS_Help_Ghost.en: Toggles ghost mode so zombies ignore the player.
UI_RAKS_Help_Ghost.ch: 切換幽靈模式, 讓殭屍無視玩家.
UI_RAKS_Help_Ghost.cn: 切换幽灵模式, 让僵尸无视玩家.

UI_RAKS_Help_God.en: Enables native God Mode and the legacy death-prevention health guard under one switch. If native invulnerability is unavailable, the guard repairs health and injuries on updates and damage events. Instant engine-level death can still bypass the fallback.
UI_RAKS_Help_God.ch: 以單一開關同時啟用原生無敵模式與舊版的防止死亡健康保護. 若無法使用原生無敵, 保護機制會在更新與受傷事件時修復健康與傷勢. 引擎層級的即死仍可能繞過此備援機制.
UI_RAKS_Help_God.cn: 用一个开关同时启用原生无敌模式和旧版的防止死亡健康保护. 如果原生无敌不可用, 保护机制会在更新和受伤事件时修复健康和伤势. 引擎层级的即死仍可能绕过此后备机制.

UI_RAKS_Help_Heal.en: Fully heals the current character right away.
UI_RAKS_Help_Heal.ch: 立即完全治癒目前的角色.
UI_RAKS_Help_Heal.cn: 立即完全治愈当前角色.

UI_RAKS_Help_HealthControl.ch: 啟用進階健康編輯工具.
UI_RAKS_Help_HealthControl.cn: 启用高级健康编辑工具.

UI_RAKS_Help_InstantActions.en: Speeds up finite timed actions and each batch of inventory transfers in single player. Walking and indefinite actions are unchanged. Normal transfer checks, capacity limits and recipe requirements remain in effect.
UI_RAKS_Help_InstantActions.ch: 在單人模式中加快有固定時長的計時動作, 以及每一批物品轉移. 行走與無限期動作不受影響. 一般的轉移檢查、容量限制與配方需求仍然有效.
UI_RAKS_Help_InstantActions.cn: 在单人模式中加快有固定时长的计时动作, 以及每一批物品转移. 行走和无限期动作不受影响. 常规的转移检查、容量限制和配方需求依然有效.

UI_RAKS_Help_ItemQty.en: How many copies of the selected item to spawn.
UI_RAKS_Help_ItemQty.ch: 要生成幾個選取的物品.
UI_RAKS_Help_ItemQty.cn: 要生成多少个选中的物品.

UI_RAKS_Help_ItemSearch.en: Search by display name or full item ID.
UI_RAKS_Help_ItemSearch.ch: 依顯示名稱或完整物品 ID 搜尋.
UI_RAKS_Help_ItemSearch.cn: 按显示名称或完整物品 ID 搜索.

UI_RAKS_Help_LuaEditor.ch: 開啟內建的 Lua 編輯器.
UI_RAKS_Help_LuaEditor.cn: 打开内置的 Lua 编辑器.

UI_RAKS_Help_MaxAll.en: Sets every listed skill to the maximum level.
UI_RAKS_Help_MaxAll.ch: 將列出的所有技能設為最高等級.
UI_RAKS_Help_MaxAll.cn: 将列出的所有技能设为最高等级.

UI_RAKS_Help_NoClip.en: Allows the character to pass through world obstacles. Disable after use.
UI_RAKS_Help_NoClip.ch: 讓角色能穿過世界中的障礙物. 使用後請停用.
UI_RAKS_Help_NoClip.cn: 让角色能穿过世界中的障碍物. 使用后请禁用.

UI_RAKS_Help_NoReload.en: Removes the equipped ranged weapon's shot delay, not all ammunition or reload requirements.
UI_RAKS_Help_NoReload.ch: 移除手持遠距離武器的射擊延遲, 但不會移除所有彈藥或裝填需求.
UI_RAKS_Help_NoReload.cn: 移除手持远程武器的射击延迟, 但不会移除所有弹药或装填需求.

UI_RAKS_Help_RefillAmmo.en: Refills ammo in the equipped weapon.

UI_RAKS_Help_RemoveTuning.en: Removes optional armor and tuning parts while leaving core mechanical parts in place.
UI_RAKS_Help_RemoveTuning.ch: 移除選配裝甲與改裝零件, 保留核心機械零件.
UI_RAKS_Help_RemoveTuning.cn: 移除可选装甲与改装零件, 保留核心机械零件.

UI_RAKS_Help_RemoveZombies.en: Deletes all zombies in the current loaded area.
UI_RAKS_Help_RemoveZombies.ch: 刪除目前已載入區域內的所有殭屍.
UI_RAKS_Help_RemoveZombies.cn: 删除当前已加载区域内的所有僵尸.

UI_RAKS_Help_RepairEquipped.en: Repairs the currently equipped weapon or tool.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairEquipped.ch: 修復目前手持的武器或工具.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairEquipped.cn: 修复当前手持的武器或工具.

UI_RAKS_Help_RepairInventory.en: Repairs every repairable item in the inventory.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairInventory.ch: 修復背包中所有可修復的物品.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairInventory.cn: 修复背包中所有可修复的物品.

UI_RAKS_Help_RepairVehicle.en: Repairs the vehicle the player is currently inside.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairVehicle.ch: 修復玩家目前所在的車輛.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairVehicle.cn: 修复玩家当前所在的车辆.

UI_RAKS_Help_RepairWorn.en: Repairs all clothing currently worn by the player.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairWorn.ch: 修復玩家目前穿著的所有衣物.
UI_RAKS_Help_RepairWorn.cn: 修复玩家当前穿着的所有衣物.

UI_RAKS_Help_ResetAll.en: Resets all listed skills to zero.
UI_RAKS_Help_ResetAll.ch: 將列出的所有技能重置為零.
UI_RAKS_Help_ResetAll.cn: 将列出的所有技能重置为零.

UI_RAKS_Help_RestoreSkills.en: Restores only skills from the saved snapshot.
UI_RAKS_Help_RestoreSkills.ch: 只從已儲存的快照恢復技能.
UI_RAKS_Help_RestoreSkills.cn: 仅从已保存的快照恢复技能.

UI_RAKS_Help_RestoreSnapshot.en: Restores skills, recipes and tracked statistics from the saved snapshot.
UI_RAKS_Help_RestoreSnapshot.ch: 從已儲存的快照恢復技能、配方與追蹤的統計資料.
UI_RAKS_Help_RestoreSnapshot.cn: 从已保存的快照恢复技能、配方与跟踪的统计数据.

UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSkills.en: Saves the current skill profile into the character snapshot.
UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSkills.ch: 將目前的技能配置儲存到角色快照.
UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSkills.cn: 将当前的技能配置保存到角色快照.

UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSkillsBase.en: Saves the current skill profile into the character snapshot.
UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSkillsBase.ch: 將目前的技能配置儲存到角色快照.
UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSkillsBase.cn: 将当前的技能配置保存到角色快照.

UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSnapshot.en: Saves the current character skills, learned recipes and tracked statistics.
UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSnapshot.ch: 儲存目前角色的技能、已學會的配方與追蹤的統計資料.
UI_RAKS_Help_SaveSnapshot.cn: 保存当前角色的技能、已学会的配方与跟踪的统计数据.

UI_RAKS_Help_Spawn.en: Spawns the selected item into your inventory.
UI_RAKS_Help_Spawn.ch: 將選取的物品生成到您的背包.
UI_RAKS_Help_Spawn.cn: 将选中的物品生成到您的背包.

UI_RAKS_Help_SpawnVehicle.en: Spawns the selected vehicle near the player using the chosen setup.
UI_RAKS_Help_SpawnVehicle.ch: 依所選配置在玩家附近生成選取的車輛.
UI_RAKS_Help_SpawnVehicle.cn: 按所选配置在玩家附近生成选中的车辆.

UI_RAKS_Help_StatsImmune.en: Protects against negative hunger, fatigue, thirst and similar status loss.
UI_RAKS_Help_StatsImmune.ch: 防止飢餓、疲勞、口渴等狀態出現負面變化.
UI_RAKS_Help_StatsImmune.cn: 防止饥饿、疲劳、口渴等状态出现负面变化.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Combat.en: Ammo, damage, durability and weapon maintenance shortcuts.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Combat.ch: 彈藥、傷害、耐久度與武器維護的快捷功能.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Combat.cn: 弹药、伤害、耐久度与武器维护的快捷功能.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Health.en: Quick healing and protection from negative moodles and status loss.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Health.ch: 快速治療, 並防止負面狀態與狀態下降.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Health.cn: 快速治疗, 并防止负面状态与状态下降.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Items.en: Search any registered item and spawn the required amount.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Items.ch: 搜尋任何已註冊的物品並生成所需數量.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Items.cn: 搜索任何已注册的物品并生成所需数量.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Player.en: Player toggles, god/ghost modes and character progress snapshot.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Player.ch: 玩家開關、無敵/幽靈模式與角色進度快照.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Player.cn: 玩家开关、无敌/幽灵模式与角色进度快照.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Skills.en: Edit skill levels, then save or restore them on another character.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Skills.ch: 編輯技能等級, 然後儲存, 或在另一個角色上恢復.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Skills.cn: 编辑技能等级, 然后保存, 或在另一个角色上恢复.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Terrain.en: Delete, fire and terraforming tools for map editing.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Terrain.ch: 用於地圖編輯的刪除、火焰與地形改造工具.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Terrain.cn: 用于地图编辑的删除、火焰与地形改造工具.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Tools.ch: 輔助工具與配方相關功能.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Tools.cn: 辅助工具与配方相关功能.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Vehicles.en: Spawn vehicles, preview them and manage vehicle cheats.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Vehicles.ch: 生成車輛、預覽車輛並管理車輛作弊.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Vehicles.cn: 生成车辆、预览车辆并管理车辆作弊.

UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Zombies.en: Zombie brush and emergency zombie removal.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Zombies.ch: 殭屍筆刷與緊急清除殭屍.
UI_RAKS_Help_Tab_Zombies.cn: 僵尸笔刷与紧急清除僵尸.

UI_RAKS_Help_Terraform.en: Paint the selected ground/floor tile with LMB or X. Choose material in Brush settings. Esc / RMB returns to the menu.
UI_RAKS_Help_Terraform.ch: 按左鍵或 X 塗刷選取的地面/地板圖塊. 請在「材料與筆刷設定」中選擇材料. 按 Esc / 右鍵返回選單.
UI_RAKS_Help_Terraform.cn: 按左键或 X 涂刷选中的地面/地板图块. 请在“材料与笔刷设置”中选择材料. 按 Esc / 右键返回菜单.

UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleGod.en: Toggles vehicle god mode for the current vehicle.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleGod.ch: 切換目前車輛的車輛無敵模式.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleGod.cn: 切换当前车辆的车辆无敌模式.

UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleHotwire.en: Hotwiring bypasses the ignition lock so the selected car can start without its key. It does not repair the engine or add fuel.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleHotwire.ch: 搭線點火會繞過點火鎖, 讓選取的車輛不用鑰匙也能發動. 不會修復引擎, 也不會補充燃料.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleHotwire.cn: 搭线点火会绕过点火锁, 让选中的车辆不用钥匙也能启动. 不会修复引擎, 也不会补充燃料.

UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleModeBasic.en: Basic: a plain spawned vehicle without extra tuning.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleModeBasic.ch: 基本: 生成的普通車輛, 不加裝額外改裝件.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleModeBasic.cn: 基础: 生成的普通车辆, 不加装额外改装件.

UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleModeMax.en: Maximum: a fully repaired and prepared vehicle with best-effort extra parts and fuel.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleModeMax.ch: 完整: 完全修復並整備好的車輛, 盡可能附帶額外零件與燃料.
UI_RAKS_Help_VehicleModeMax.cn: 完整: 完全修复并整备好的车辆, 尽可能附带额外零件与燃料.

UI_RAKS_ItemPreviewHint.en: Select an item. Clothing is shown on a 3D preview of your character.
UI_RAKS_ItemPreviewHint.ch: 請選擇一個物品. 衣物會顯示在您角色的 3D 預覽上.
UI_RAKS_ItemPreviewHint.cn: 请选择一个物品. 衣物会显示在您角色的 3D 预览上.

UI_RAKS_LastSaveNever.en: No character snapshot has been saved yet.
UI_RAKS_LastSaveNever.ch: 尚未儲存任何角色快照.
UI_RAKS_LastSaveNever.cn: 尚未保存任何角色快照.

UI_RAKS_PartInstall.ch: 安裝第一個相容的零件
UI_RAKS_PartInstall.cn: 安装第一个兼容的零件

UI_RAKS_PreviewModeNote.en: Preview shows the vehicle script model. Actual tuning is applied to the spawned/selected vehicle.
UI_RAKS_PreviewModeNote.ch: 預覽顯示的是車輛指令碼所定義的模型. 實際改裝會套用到已生成/選取的車輛上.
UI_RAKS_PreviewModeNote.cn: 预览显示的是车辆脚本所定义的模型. 实际改装会应用到已生成/选中的车辆上.

UI_RAKS_TerrainHint.en: Delete and brush tools work on the selected world tile. Turn them off when you are done.
UI_RAKS_TerrainHint.ch: 刪除與筆刷工具會作用於選取的世界圖塊. 用完後請關閉.
UI_RAKS_TerrainHint.cn: 删除与笔刷工具会作用于选中的世界图块. 用完后请关闭.

UI_RAKS_VehiclePreviewHint.en: Mouse wheel over the preview to zoom.
UI_RAKS_VehiclePreviewHint.ch: 在預覽上滾動滑鼠滾輪即可縮放.
UI_RAKS_VehiclePreviewHint.cn: 在预览上滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放.

UI_RAKS_VehicleSpawnedBasic.ch: 已以基本配置生成車輛.
UI_RAKS_VehicleSpawnedBasic.cn: 已以基础配置生成车辆.

UI_RAKS_VehicleSpawnedMax.ch: 已以完整配置生成車輛.
UI_RAKS_VehicleSpawnedMax.cn: 已以完整配置生成车辆.

UI_RAX_AdminOnly.ch: 需要伺服器管理員權限
UI_RAX_AdminOnly.cn: 需要服务器管理员权限

UI_RAX_BrushHint.en: Choose a ground/floor tile and press Use tile. The menu hides and its auto-pause is released. Left-click or drag over the map; Esc / right-click returns to the menu. X also paints/removes, Z places barricades, N starts fire, F extinguishes it. The brush works on loaded squares on your floor. Back up the save before editing.
UI_RAX_BrushHint.ch: 選擇地面/地板圖塊, 然後按「使用選取的圖塊」. 選單會隱藏, 並解除其自動暫停. 在地圖上左鍵點選或拖曳; 按 Esc / 右鍵返回選單. X 也能塗刷/移除, Z 放置路障, N 起火, F 撲滅. 筆刷作用於您所在樓層的已載入方格. 編輯前請備份存檔.
UI_RAX_BrushHint.cn: 选择地面/地板图块, 然后按“使用选中的图块”. 菜单会隐藏, 并解除其自动暂停. 在地图上左键点击或拖动; 按 Esc / 右键返回菜单. X 也能涂刷/移除, Z 放置路障, N 点火, F 扑灭. 笔刷作用于您所在楼层的已加载方格. 编辑前请备份存档.

UI_RAX_DeleteWarning.en: Deletes the selected vehicle and its stored contents. This cannot be undone.
UI_RAX_DeleteWarning.ch: 刪除選取的車輛及其中存放的物品. 此操作無法復原.
UI_RAX_DeleteWarning.cn: 删除选中的车辆及其中存放的物品. 此操作无法撤销.

UI_RAX_ExitVehicleFirst.en: Exit the vehicle before deleting it

UI_RAX_Failed.ch: 操作失敗; 請檢視 console.txt
UI_RAX_Failed.cn: 操作失败; 请查看 console.txt

UI_RAX_InvalidCoordinates.en: The destination is outside the loaded map definitions
UI_RAX_InvalidCoordinates.ch: 目的地超出已載入的地圖定義範圍
UI_RAX_InvalidCoordinates.cn: 目的地超出已加载的地图定义范围

UI_RAX_InvalidNumber.en: Enter a number within the specified range
UI_RAX_InvalidNumber.ch: 請輸入指定範圍內的數字
UI_RAX_InvalidNumber.cn: 请输入指定范围内的数字

UI_RAX_InvalidSprite.en: Unknown sprite ID; use a name such as blends_natural_01_0
UI_RAX_InvalidSprite.ch: 未知的貼圖 ID; 請使用像 blends_natural_01_0 這樣的名稱
UI_RAX_InvalidSprite.cn: 未知的贴图 ID; 请使用类似 blends_natural_01_0 的名称

UI_RAX_LanguageHint.en: Menu language only. AUTO follows the game; Russian, English, French, Spanish and simplified Chinese can be selected explicitly.
UI_RAX_LanguageHint.ch: 僅限選單語言. 「使用遊戲語言」會跟隨遊戲; 也可以明確選擇俄文、英文、法文、西班牙文與簡體中文.
UI_RAX_LanguageHint.cn: 仅限菜单语言. “使用游戏语言”会跟随游戏; 也可以明确选择俄语、英语、法语、西班牙语和简体中文.

UI_RAX_LocalOnly.en: This operation is available in single-player only

UI_RAX_LocationHint.en: Locations from the supplied Reloaded catalogue. Their coordinates may differ on custom maps.
UI_RAX_LocationHint.ch: 地點取自隨附的 Reloaded 目錄. 在自訂地圖上座標可能不同.
UI_RAX_LocationHint.cn: 地点取自附带的 Reloaded 目录. 在自定义地图上坐标可能不同.

UI_RAX_LuaHint.en: Executes Lua in the game client. Only run code you trust. Saved editor text is local to this mod.
UI_RAX_LuaHint.ch: 在遊戲的本機端執行 Lua. 請只執行您信任的程式碼. 儲存的編輯器文字僅供本模組使用.
UI_RAX_LuaHint.cn: 在游戏客户端中执行 Lua. 请只执行您信任的代码. 保存的编辑器文本仅供本模组使用.

UI_RAX_NoSpawnSpace.en: No clear square near the player. Move to an open area.
UI_RAX_NoSpawnSpace.ch: 玩家附近沒有空的方格. 請移動到開闊的地方.
UI_RAX_NoSpawnSpace.cn: 玩家附近没有空的方格. 请移动到开阔的地方.

UI_RAX_PlayerPreviewHint.en: Live appearance: worn clothes, blood and visible injuries. Updated after actions and changes.
UI_RAX_PlayerPreviewHint.ch: 即時外觀: 穿著的衣物、血跡與可見的傷勢. 會在動作與變更後更新.
UI_RAX_PlayerPreviewHint.cn: 实时外观: 穿着的衣物、血迹与可见的伤势. 会在动作与更改后更新.

UI_RAX_PreviewConfigUnavailable.en: This vehicle cannot be configured in the preview renderer. Spawn settings still apply.
UI_RAX_PreviewConfigUnavailable.ch: 此車輛無法在預覽渲染器中配置. 生成設定仍然有效.
UI_RAX_PreviewConfigUnavailable.cn: 此车辆无法在预览渲染器中配置. 生成设置仍然有效.

UI_RAX_PreviewDrag.en: Drag to rotate. Use + / - to adjust the view.
UI_RAX_PreviewDrag.ch: 拖曳以旋轉. 使用 + / - 調整視角.
UI_RAX_PreviewDrag.cn: 拖动以旋转. 使用 + / - 调整视角.

UI_RAX_PreviewScriptOnly.en: Catalogue model — not a configuration preview
UI_RAX_PreviewScriptOnly.ch: 目錄模型 — 不是配置預覽
UI_RAX_PreviewScriptOnly.cn: 目录模型 — 并非配置预览

UI_RAX_PreviewUnavailable.en: 3D preview is unavailable. Check the selected model and console.txt.
UI_RAX_PreviewUnavailable.ch: 無法使用 3D 預覽. 請檢查選取的模型與 console.txt.
UI_RAX_PreviewUnavailable.cn: 3D 预览不可用. 请检查选中的模型和 console.txt.

UI_RAX_Search.ch: 依名稱或 ID 搜尋
UI_RAX_Search.cn: 按名称或 ID 搜索

UI_RAX_SelectMapHint.en: Click a vehicle in the world. The menu will reopen after selection.
UI_RAX_SelectMapHint.ch: 在世界中點選一輛車. 選擇後選單會重新開啟.
UI_RAX_SelectMapHint.cn: 在世界中点击一辆车. 选择后菜单会重新打开.

UI_RAX_SelectVehicle.en: Select a vehicle from the list

UI_RAX_SelectedRequired.en: Select a vehicle on the map first
UI_RAX_SelectedRequired.ch: 請先在地圖上選擇車輛
UI_RAX_SelectedRequired.cn: 请先在地图上选择车辆

UI_RAX_SkillBarHint.en: Click a segment to set level 1–10. Click immediately to the left of the first segment to set 0.
UI_RAX_SkillBarHint.ch: 點選分段可將等級設為 1–10. 點選第一個分段緊鄰的左側可設為 0.
UI_RAX_SkillBarHint.cn: 点击分段可将等级设为 1–10. 点击第一个分段紧邻的左侧可设为 0.

UI_RAX_SurvivalHint.en: Changes this character's survival statistic, not the world's date.
UI_RAX_SurvivalHint.ch: 變更此角色的生存時間統計, 而非世界日期.
UI_RAX_SurvivalHint.cn: 更改此角色的生存时间统计, 而不是世界日期.

UI_RAX_TeleportHeightHint.en: Check the destination and its floor before teleporting. A wrong height can cause a fall.
UI_RAX_TeleportHeightHint.ch: 傳送前請確認目的地與其樓層. 高度錯誤可能導致摔落.
UI_RAX_TeleportHeightHint.cn: 传送前请确认目的地及其楼层. 高度错误可能导致摔落.

UI_RAX_TimeHint.en: Changes the world's calendar and clock. Make a save backup before large jumps.
UI_RAX_TimeHint.ch: 變更世界的日曆與時鐘. 大幅跳轉前請先備份存檔.
UI_RAX_TimeHint.cn: 更改世界的日历与时钟. 大幅跳转前请先备份存档.

UI_RAX_TryOnHint.en: Only the selected item is fitted. Your actual equipment is not changed.
UI_RAX_TryOnHint.ch: 只會試穿選取的物品. 您實際的裝備不會改變.
UI_RAX_TryOnHint.cn: 只会试穿选中的物品. 您实际的装备不会改变.

UI_RAX_TuningHint.en: Only recognized optional part slots are changed. Custom vehicle scripts may need their own adapter.
UI_RAX_TuningHint.ch: 只會變更已辨識的選配零件欄位. 自訂車輛指令碼可能需要專用的適配程式.
UI_RAX_TuningHint.cn: 只会更改已识别的可选零件槽位. 自定义车辆脚本可能需要专门的适配器.

UI_RAX_Unavailable.en: This operation is not available in this game build
UI_RAX_Unavailable.ch: 此遊戲版本無法使用此操作
UI_RAX_Unavailable.cn: 此游戏版本不支持此操作

UI_RAX_WeatherHint.en: Moving a slider automatically enables its override. Switch it off to return to natural weather. This panel releases only the menu's automatic pause; the world stays live. Storms develop over game time: disable Freeze time to watch them. Starting/stopping an event clears manual rain, fog, wind, clouds, temperature and humidity, but keeps cosmetic light settings.
UI_RAX_WeatherHint.ch: 移動滑桿會自動啟用對應的覆寫. 關閉覆寫即可恢復自然天氣. 此面板只會解除選單的自動暫停; 世界仍會持續運作. 風暴會隨遊戲時間發展: 請停用「凍結時間」以便觀察. 開始/停止事件會清除手動設定的雨、霧、風、雲、溫度與溼度, 但會保留純外觀的光線設定.
UI_RAX_WeatherHint.cn: 移动滑块会自动启用对应的覆盖. 关闭覆盖即可恢复自然天气. 此面板只会解除菜单的自动暂停; 世界仍会持续运行. 风暴会随游戏时间发展: 请禁用“冻结时间”以便观察. 开始/停止事件会清除手动设置的雨、雾、风、云、温度和湿度, 但会保留纯外观的光照设置.

UI_RX25_AnimalPreviewHint.en: Preview only: no animal is placed in the world. Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom.
UI_RX25_AnimalPreviewHint.ch: 僅供預覽: 不會在世界中放置動物. 拖曳以旋轉, 滾輪縮放.
UI_RX25_AnimalPreviewHint.cn: 仅供预览: 不会在世界中放置动物. 拖动以旋转, 滚轮缩放.

UI_RX25_AnimalUnavailable.en: Unable to render this animal. See trainer diagnostics.
UI_RX25_AnimalUnavailable.ch: 無法渲染此動物. 請檢視修改器診斷.
UI_RX25_AnimalUnavailable.cn: 无法渲染此动物. 请查看修改器诊断.

UI_RX25_IntegrationUnavailable.en: The required settings API is not available.
UI_RX25_IntegrationUnavailable.ch: 無法使用所需的設定 API.
UI_RX25_IntegrationUnavailable.cn: 所需的设置 API 不可用.

UI_RX25_IntegrationsHint.en: Settings for other mods by Rax. Only active compatible mods are shown. Disabling hardcore restores the prior profile; multiplayer settings belong to the server.
UI_RX25_IntegrationsHint.ch: Rax 其他模組的設定. 只會顯示已啟用且相容的模組. 停用硬核會恢復先前的設定檔; 多人模式的設定由伺服器決定.
UI_RX25_IntegrationsHint.cn: Rax 其他模组的设置. 只显示已启用且兼容的模组. 禁用硬核会恢复之前的配置; 多人模式的设置由服务器决定.

UI_RX25_LanguageHint.en: Only the trainer language changes. The game and other mods keep their language. Language packs may register additional entries.
UI_RX25_LanguageHint.ch: 只會變更修改器的語言. 遊戲與其他模組會保留各自的語言. 語言包可能會註冊額外的項目.
UI_RX25_LanguageHint.cn: 只会更改修改器的语言. 游戏与其他模组会保留各自的语言. 语言包可能会注册额外的条目.

UI_RX25_LogApiMissing.en: The native Lua error list is unavailable in this session. Use trainer diagnostics or import console.txt.
UI_RX25_LogApiMissing.ch: 本次遊戲無法使用原生 Lua 錯誤清單. 請使用修改器診斷或匯入 console.txt.
UI_RX25_LogApiMissing.cn: 本次游戏无法使用原生 Lua 错误列表. 请使用修改器诊断或导入 console.txt.

UI_RX25_LogMissing.en: No imported console snapshot. Run Support/WatchConsole.ps1 or use Lua errors / trainer diagnostics.
UI_RX25_LogMissing.ch: 沒有已匯入的控制台快照. 請執行 Support/WatchConsole.ps1, 或使用「Lua 錯誤」/「修改器診斷」.
UI_RX25_LogMissing.cn: 没有已导入的控制台快照. 请运行 Support/WatchConsole.ps1, 或使用“Lua 错误”/“修改器诊断”.

UI_RX25_LogsHint.en: Read-only viewer. Lua errors and trainer diagnostics work in game. console.txt uses the optional local Support/WatchConsole.ps1 importer; no files are sent anywhere. At most 800 lines are retained.
UI_RX25_LogsHint.ch: 唯讀檢視器. 「Lua 錯誤」與「修改器診斷」可在遊戲中使用. console.txt 需使用選用的本機匯入工具 Support/WatchConsole.ps1; 不會將任何檔案傳送到任何地方. 最多保留 800 行.
UI_RX25_LogsHint.cn: 只读查看器. “Lua 错误”与“修改器诊断”可在游戏中使用. console.txt 需使用可选的本地导入工具 Support/WatchConsole.ps1; 不会把任何文件发送到任何地方. 最多保留 800 行.

UI_RX25_NightHint.en: Local green illumination and phosphor overlay. Does not change world weather.
UI_RX25_NightHint.ch: 局部綠色照明與磷光疊加層. 不會改變世界天氣.
UI_RX25_NightHint.cn: 局部绿色照明与磷光叠加层. 不会改变世界天气.

UI_RX25_NoIntegrations.ch: 未找到已啟用的受支援模組.
UI_RX25_NoIntegrations.cn: 未找到已启用的受支持模组.

UI_RX25_OpacityHint.en: Changes panel backgrounds, not text. 100% is opaque; 35% is most transparent.
UI_RX25_OpacityHint.ch: 只改變面板背景, 不影響文字. 100%% 為不透明; 35%% 為最透明.
UI_RX25_OpacityHint.cn: 只改变面板背景, 不影响文字. 100%% 为不透明; 35%% 为最透明.

UI_RX25_PauseHint.en: Only in single player. Closing restores the previous speed only if this menu paused it. Selecting a world target temporarily releases our pause.
UI_RX25_PauseHint.ch: 僅限單人模式. 只有在本選單造成暫停時, 關閉後才會恢復先前的速度. 選擇世界中的目標時會暫時解除本選單的暫停.
UI_RX25_PauseHint.cn: 仅限单人模式. 只有在本菜单造成暂停时, 关闭后才会恢复之前的速度. 选择世界中的目标时会暂时解除本菜单的暂停.

UI_RX25_PreviewUnavailable.en: Equipment preview unavailable; see trainer diagnostics.
UI_RX25_PreviewUnavailable.ch: 無法預覽裝備; 請檢視修改器診斷.
UI_RX25_PreviewUnavailable.cn: 无法预览装备; 请查看修改器诊断.

UI_RX25_SessionOnly.en: This developer toggle is session-only in the original mod.
UI_RX25_SessionOnly.ch: 此開發者開關在原模組中僅限本次遊戲.
UI_RX25_SessionOnly.cn: 此开发者开关在原模组中仅限本次游戏.

UI_RX25_SinglePlayerOnly.en: Controlled by the server in multiplayer.
UI_RX25_SinglePlayerOnly.ch: 多人遊戲中由伺服器控制.
UI_RX25_SinglePlayerOnly.cn: 多人游戏中由服务器控制.

UI_RX26_BoostAlready.en: Book XP boost is already active
UI_RX26_BoostAlready.ch: 書籍經驗加成已在生效中

UI_RX26_BoostDisabled.en: XP boost disabled; matching skill book reset
UI_RX26_BoostDisabled.ch: 經驗加成已停用; 對應的技能書已重置
UI_RX26_BoostDisabled.cn: 经验加成已禁用; 对应的技能书已重置

UI_RX26_BoostUnavailable.en: No book XP boost at maximum level
UI_RX26_BoostUnavailable.ch: 技能已達最高等級, 沒有書籍經驗加成
UI_RX26_BoostUnavailable.cn: 技能已达最高等级, 没有书籍经验加成

UI_RX26_SkillBoost.en: Apply book XP boost (x5 for the next two skill levels)
UI_RX26_SkillBoost.ch: 套用書籍經驗加成 (接下來兩個技能等級 x5)
UI_RX26_SkillBoost.cn: 应用书籍经验加成 (接下来两个技能等级 x5)

UI_RX26_SkillBoostHint.en: Empty box: no bonus. Triple arrow: boosted (including read books). Click to toggle; disabling also resets the matching skill book.
UI_RX26_SkillBoostHint.ch: 空框: 無加成. 三箭頭: 已加成 (包含已讀的書籍). 點選即可切換; 停用時也會重置對應的技能書.
UI_RX26_SkillBoostHint.cn: 空框: 无加成. 三箭头: 已加成 (包括已读的书籍). 点击即可切换; 禁用时也会重置对应的技能书.

UI_RX28_BlockedSquare.en: Choose a free square with ground or a floor.
UI_RX28_BlockedSquare.ch: 請選擇有地面或地板的空方格.
UI_RX28_BlockedSquare.cn: 请选择有地面或地板的空方格.

UI_RX28_BrushApplied.ch: 已套用; 已變更 / 已生成
UI_RX28_BrushApplied.cn: 已应用; 已更改 / 已生成

UI_RX28_BrushControls.en: LMB: paint / drag. Esc or RMB: return to menu.
UI_RX28_BrushControls.ch: 左鍵: 塗刷 / 拖曳. Esc 或右鍵: 返回選單.
UI_RX28_BrushControls.cn: 左键: 涂刷 / 拖动. Esc 或右键: 返回菜单.

UI_RX28_BrushRange.en: Paint within 100 tiles, on your current floor.
UI_RX28_BrushRange.ch: 在您目前的樓層 100 格內塗刷.
UI_RX28_BrushRange.cn: 在您当前的楼层 100 格内涂刷.

UI_RX28_FireRejected.en: Fire cannot be placed here; check fire restrictions.
UI_RX28_FireRejected.ch: 無法在此處放火; 請檢查火焰限制.
UI_RX28_FireRejected.cn: 无法在此处放火; 请检查火焰限制.

UI_RX28_MechanicsScope.en: Player-wide mechanics cheat, not a setting of the selected car.
UI_RX28_MechanicsScope.ch: 作用於玩家整體的機械作弊, 不是選取車輛的設定.
UI_RX28_MechanicsScope.cn: 作用于玩家整体的机械作弊, 不是选中车辆的设置.

UI_RX28_NoBarricadeTarget.en: No barricadable door or window on this square.
UI_RX28_NoBarricadeTarget.ch: 此方格上沒有可架設路障的門或窗戶.
UI_RX28_NoBarricadeTarget.cn: 此方格上没有可设置路障的门或窗户.

UI_RX28_PartialChange.en: Some changes were applied, but another operation failed. Check the log.
UI_RX28_PartialChange.ch: 部分變更已套用, 但另一項操作失敗. 請檢查日誌.
UI_RX28_PartialChange.cn: 部分更改已应用, 但另一项操作失败. 请检查日志.

UI_RX28_PopBuildingsHint.en: Show building outlines recorded in the world map data.
UI_RX28_PopBuildingsHint.ch: 顯示世界地圖資料中記錄的建築輪廓.
UI_RX28_PopBuildingsHint.cn: 显示世界地图数据中记录的建筑轮廓.

UI_RX28_PopCellInfoHint.en: Display diagnostic information for world cells.
UI_RX28_PopCellInfoHint.ch: 顯示世界地圖單元的診斷資訊.
UI_RX28_PopCellInfoHint.cn: 显示世界地图单元的诊断信息.

UI_RX28_PopChunkBordersHint.en: Show boundaries of map chunks in the collision data.
UI_RX28_PopChunkBordersHint.ch: 顯示碰撞資料中地圖區塊的邊界.
UI_RX28_PopChunkBordersHint.cn: 显示碰撞数据中地图区块的边界.

UI_RX28_PopDensityHint.en: Show the zombie-intensity distribution used by the simulation.
UI_RX28_PopDensityHint.ch: 顯示模擬所使用的殭屍強度分布.
UI_RX28_PopDensityHint.cn: 显示模拟所使用的僵尸强度分布.

UI_RX28_PopGrid256Hint.en: Display a 256 by 256 tile reference grid.
UI_RX28_PopGrid256Hint.ch: 顯示 256×256 格的參考網格.
UI_RX28_PopGrid256Hint.cn: 显示 256×256 格的参考网格.

UI_RX28_PopGrid300Hint.en: Display the 300 by 300 tile world-cell grid.
UI_RX28_PopGrid300Hint.ch: 顯示 300×300 格的世界地圖單元網格.
UI_RX28_PopGrid300Hint.cn: 显示 300×300 格的世界地图单元网格.

UI_RX28_PopLoadedZombiesHint.en: Show real zombies currently loaded in the world.
UI_RX28_PopLoadedZombiesHint.ch: 顯示世界中目前已載入的真實殭屍.
UI_RX28_PopLoadedZombiesHint.cn: 显示世界中当前已加载的真实僵尸.

UI_RX28_PopMovingZombiesHint.en: Show the moving population layer. This does not issue movement orders.
UI_RX28_PopMovingZombiesHint.ch: 顯示移動中的族群圖層. 這不會下達移動指令.
UI_RX28_PopMovingZombiesHint.cn: 显示移动中的种群图层. 这不会下达移动指令.

UI_RX28_PopObstaclesHint.en: Show collision obstacles used when calculating paths.
UI_RX28_PopObstaclesHint.ch: 顯示計算路徑時使用的碰撞障礙物.
UI_RX28_PopObstaclesHint.cn: 显示计算路径时使用的碰撞障碍物.

UI_RX28_PopOtherLayerHint.en: An additional renderer layer. Its original identifier is below; no world state is changed.
UI_RX28_PopOtherLayerHint.ch: 其他渲染器圖層. 原始識別碼顯示於下方; 不會改變任何世界狀態.
UI_RX28_PopOtherLayerHint.cn: 其他渲染器图层. 原始标识符显示在下方; 不会改变任何世界状态.

UI_RX28_PopRoomsHint.en: Show room regions in the collision data.
UI_RX28_PopRoomsHint.ch: 顯示碰撞資料中的房間區域.
UI_RX28_PopRoomsHint.cn: 显示碰撞数据中的房间区域.

UI_RX28_PopSoundsHint.en: Show world-sound markers used by the simulation; not an audio-volume control.
UI_RX28_PopSoundsHint.ch: 顯示模擬所使用的世界聲音標記; 不是音量控制.
UI_RX28_PopSoundsHint.cn: 显示模拟所使用的世界声音标记; 不是音量控制.

UI_RX28_PopStandingZombiesHint.en: Show the stationary population layer. This does not freeze zombies.
UI_RX28_PopStandingZombiesHint.ch: 顯示靜止的族群圖層. 這不會凍結殭屍.
UI_RX28_PopStandingZombiesHint.cn: 显示静止的种群图层. 这不会冻结僵尸.

UI_RX28_PopVehiclesHint.en: Show vehicle markers on the overview.
UI_RX28_PopVehiclesHint.ch: 在總覽上顯示車輛標記.
UI_RX28_PopVehiclesHint.cn: 在总览上显示车辆标记.

UI_RX28_ServerTimeout.en: No server reply. Check that the same mod is installed on the server. The request was not retried; inspect the map before repeating it.
UI_RX28_ServerTimeout.ch: 伺服器沒有回應. 請確認伺服器也安裝了同一模組. 此請求未重試; 重複操作前請先檢查地圖.
UI_RX28_ServerTimeout.cn: 服务器没有响应. 请确认服务器也安装了同一模组. 该请求未重试; 重复操作前请先检查地图.

UI_RX28_SpawnRejected.en: No zombies were created. Check the square and population restrictions.
UI_RX28_SpawnRejected.ch: 未生成任何殭屍. 請檢查方格與族群限制.
UI_RX28_SpawnRejected.cn: 未生成任何僵尸. 请检查方格与种群限制.

UI_RX28_TooFast.en: The server is rate-limiting brush requests.
UI_RX28_TooFast.ch: 伺服器正在限制筆刷請求的頻率.
UI_RX28_TooFast.cn: 服务器正在限制笔刷请求的频率.

UI_RX28_WaitServer.en: Waiting for the server to confirm the previous action.
UI_RX28_WaitServer.ch: 正在等待伺服器確認上一個操作.
UI_RX28_WaitServer.cn: 正在等待服务器确认上一个操作.

UI_RX28_WeatherRejected.en: The weather system rejected the event; check the log and other weather mods.
UI_RX28_WeatherRejected.ch: 天氣系統拒絕了此事件; 請檢查日誌與其他天氣模組.
UI_RX28_WeatherRejected.cn: 天气系统拒绝了该事件; 请检查日志与其他天气模组.

UI_RX28_ZombieBrushHint.en: Choose 1–100 zombies per click (default: 1). Start the brush, then left-click a loaded free square or drag across squares. Random outfits; no duplicate spawn on mouse release. Esc / RMB returns to the menu. In multiplayer, server admin and this mod on the server are required.
UI_RX28_ZombieBrushHint.ch: 每次點選可生成 1–100 個殭屍 (預設: 1). 啟動筆刷後, 左鍵點選已載入的空方格, 或拖曳經過多個方格. 服裝隨機; 放開滑鼠時不會重複生成. Esc / 右鍵返回選單. 多人遊戲中需要伺服器管理員身分, 且伺服器也需安裝此模組.
UI_RX28_ZombieBrushHint.cn: 每次点击可生成 1–100 个僵尸 (默认: 1). 启动笔刷后, 左键点击已加载的空方格, 或拖动经过多个方格. 服装随机; 松开鼠标时不会重复生成. Esc / 右键返回菜单. 多人游戏中需要服务器管理员身份, 且服务器也需安装此模组.

UI_RX29_GodOffRejected.en: Protection is still active; it could not be fully disabled. Check the log.
UI_RX29_GodOffRejected.ch: 保護仍在生效中; 無法完全停用. 請檢查日誌.
UI_RX29_GodOffRejected.cn: 保护仍然有效; 无法完全禁用. 请检查日志.

UI_RX29_GodRejected.en: Protection could not be enabled. Check the log.
UI_RX29_GodRejected.ch: 無法啟用保護. 請檢查日誌.
UI_RX29_GodRejected.cn: 无法启用保护. 请检查日志.

UI_RX29_Kill50Hint.en: Kills loaded living zombies within a 50-tile circle around you, on all floors. Uses normal death, leaving bodies and their items. Players and animals are excluded. The menu closes after a successful action to let death animations finish; manual pause is not cancelled.
UI_RX29_Kill50Hint.ch: 殺死您周圍半徑 50 格圓形範圍內所有樓層已載入的存活殭屍. 採用一般死亡方式, 會留下屍體及其物品. 不包含玩家與動物. 操作成功後選單會關閉, 讓死亡動畫播完; 手動暫停不會被取消.
UI_RX29_Kill50Hint.cn: 杀死您周围半径 50 格圆形范围内所有楼层已加载的存活僵尸. 采用正常死亡方式, 会留下尸体及其物品. 不包括玩家与动物. 操作成功后菜单会关闭, 让死亡动画播放完毕; 手动暂停不会被取消.

UI_RX29_NoZombieList.en: Could not read the loaded zombies. Check the log.
UI_RX29_NoZombieList.ch: 無法讀取已載入的殭屍. 請檢查日誌.
UI_RX29_NoZombieList.cn: 无法读取已加载的僵尸. 请检查日志.

UI_RX29_Pending.en: Wait for the previous server request.
UI_RX29_Pending.ch: 請等待上一個伺服器請求完成.
UI_RX29_Pending.cn: 请等待上一个服务器请求完成.

UI_RX29_RemoveLoadedHint.en: Deletes zombies without creating bodies. Single-player: currently loaded zombies, not the entire world. Multiplayer: loaded zombies within 50 tiles of the server-side player. Existing corpses and map objects stay. Respawn and migration settings are unchanged.
UI_RX29_RemoveLoadedHint.ch: 刪除殭屍且不留下屍體. 單人模式: 目前已載入的殭屍, 而非整個世界. 多人遊戲: 伺服器端玩家 50 格內已載入的殭屍. 現有的屍體與地圖物件會保留. 重生與遷移設定不變.
UI_RX29_RemoveLoadedHint.cn: 删除僵尸且不留下尸体. 单人模式: 当前已加载的僵尸, 而非整个世界. 多人游戏: 服务器端玩家 50 格内已加载的僵尸. 现有的尸体与地图对象会保留. 重生与迁移设置不变.

UI_RX29_RemoveZombieBrushHint.en: Deletes all zombies on the highlighted tile of your current floor. LMB or drag to delete; X also works. Esc / RMB returns to the menu. Does not delete corpses, animals, players or map objects. Multiplayer requires server admin and the same mod on the server.
UI_RX29_RemoveZombieBrushHint.ch: 刪除您目前樓層上反白方格中的所有殭屍. 按左鍵或拖曳即可刪除; 也可按 X. Esc / 右鍵返回選單. 不會刪除屍體、動物、玩家或地圖物件. 多人遊戲需要伺服器管理員身分, 且伺服器也需安裝同一模組.
UI_RX29_RemoveZombieBrushHint.cn: 删除您当前楼层上高亮方格中的所有僵尸. 按左键或拖动即可删除; 也可按 X. Esc / 右键返回菜单. 不会删除尸体、动物、玩家或地图对象. 多人游戏需要服务器管理员身份, 且服务器也需安装同一模组.

UI_RX29_Sent.en: Request sent; waiting for the server.
UI_RX29_Sent.ch: 請求已送出; 正在等待伺服器.
UI_RX29_Sent.cn: 请求已发送; 正在等待服务器.

UI_RX29_Timeout.en: No server reply. The operation was not retried. Check the world before repeating it and install the same mod version on the server.
UI_RX29_Timeout.ch: 伺服器沒有回應. 此操作未重試. 重複操作前請先檢查世界狀況, 並在伺服器安裝相同版本的模組.
UI_RX29_Timeout.cn: 服务器没有响应. 该操作未重试. 重复操作前请先检查世界状况, 并在服务器上安装相同版本的模组.

UI_RX29_TooFast.en: Wait a moment before repeating a mass action.
UI_RX29_TooFast.ch: 請稍等片刻再重複大範圍操作.
UI_RX29_TooFast.cn: 请稍等片刻再重复大范围操作.

UI_RX29_ZombiePartial.en: Only part of the operation succeeded.

UI_RX29_ZombieScope.en: Loaded zombies only. Radius: a 50-tile circle on all floors. Tile brush: your floor only.
UI_RX29_ZombieScope.ch: 僅限已載入的殭屍. 半徑: 所有樓層上半徑 50 格的圓形範圍. 方格筆刷: 僅限您所在的樓層.
UI_RX29_ZombieScope.cn: 仅限已加载的僵尸. 半径: 所有楼层上半径 50 格的圆形范围. 方格笔刷: 仅限您所在的楼层.

UI_RX60_CraftCount.en: Number of crafts: 1–100. Building places one object per click.
UI_RX60_CraftCount.ch: 製作次數: 1–100. 建造時每次點選放置一個物件.
UI_RX60_CraftCount.cn: 制作次数: 1–100. 建造时每次点击放置一个对象.

UI_RX60_CreativeHint.en: Creative unlocks build and craft actions. Each action receives its own temporary full material kit and required skill levels; vanilla uses that kit, then any leftovers are removed.
UI_RX60_CreativeHint.ch: 創造模式會解鎖建造與製作動作. 每個動作都會獲得專屬的臨時全套材料與所需技能等級; 原版流程會使用這套材料, 之後剩餘的部分會被移除.
UI_RX60_CreativeHint.cn: 创造模式会解锁建造与制作动作. 每个动作都会获得专属的临时全套材料和所需技能等级; 原版流程会使用这套材料, 之后剩余部分会被移除.

UI_RX60_Extinguish.ch: 撲滅所有已載入的車輛火災
UI_RX60_Extinguish.cn: 扑灭所有已加载的车辆火灾

UI_RX60_FireDisabled.en: Vehicle fire or world fire is disabled in sandbox settings.
UI_RX60_FireDisabled.ch: 沙盒設定中已停用車輛火災或世界火災.
UI_RX60_FireDisabled.cn: 沙盒设置中已禁用车辆火灾或世界火灾.

UI_RX60_FireHint.en: Requires Vehicle Fire. Ignites the full footprint of the nearest vehicle within 50 tiles on the same floor, without waiting for spread. The menu closes and releases its own pause. Extinguish affects loaded vehicle fires, not burn damage. Single-player.
UI_RX60_FireHint.ch: 需要 Vehicle Fire. 點燃同一樓層 50 格內最近一輛車的整個佔地範圍, 不必等待火勢蔓延. 選單會關閉並解除本選單的暫停. 「撲滅」只作用於已載入的車輛火災, 不處理燃燒損壞. 僅限單人模式.
UI_RX60_FireHint.cn: 需要 Vehicle Fire. 点燃同一楼层 50 格内最近一辆车的整个占地范围, 无需等待火势蔓延. 菜单会关闭并解除本菜单的暂停. “扑灭”只作用于已加载的车辆火灾, 不处理燃烧损坏. 仅限单人模式.

UI_RX60_FireRejected.en: The nearest vehicle cannot ignite: it may be burnt out, excluded by the mod or in a no-fire area.
UI_RX60_FireRejected.ch: 最近的車輛無法點燃: 可能已燒燬、被模組排除或位於禁火區域.
UI_RX60_FireRejected.cn: 最近的车辆无法点燃: 可能已烧毁、被模组排除或位于禁火区域.

UI_RX60_FireUnavailable.en: Vehicle Fire's ignition API is unavailable. Enable the supported mod and reload the save.
UI_RX60_FireUnavailable.ch: Vehicle Fire 的點火 API 無法使用. 請啟用受支援的模組並重新載入存檔.
UI_RX60_FireUnavailable.cn: Vehicle Fire 的点火 API 不可用. 请启用受支持的模组并重新加载存档.

UI_RX60_HotkeyHint.en: Default: F6. Rebind here or in Keyboard shortcuts. Right-click access stays available. Typing in chat or a text field does not open the menu.
UI_RX60_HotkeyHint.ch: 預設: F6. 可在此處或「鍵盤快捷鍵」中重新綁定. 仍可透過右鍵開啟. 在聊天或文字欄位中輸入時不會開啟選單.
UI_RX60_HotkeyHint.cn: 默认: F6. 可在此处或“键盘快捷键”中重新绑定. 仍可通过右键打开. 在聊天或文本框中输入时不会打开菜单.

UI_RX60_MapHint.en: Left-click a destination to teleport to ground level. Drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Esc or right-click cancels. Check that the destination is safe.
UI_RX60_MapHint.ch: 左鍵點選目的地即可傳送至地面層. 拖曳可平移, 滾輪可縮放. Esc 或右鍵取消. 請確認目的地安全.
UI_RX60_MapHint.cn: 左键点击目的地即可传送至地面层. 拖动可平移, 滚轮可缩放. Esc 或右键取消. 请确认目的地安全.

UI_RX60_MapUnavailable.en: The normal world map is unavailable. Check the world's map settings.
UI_RX60_MapUnavailable.ch: 一般世界地圖無法使用. 請檢查此世界的地圖設定.
UI_RX60_MapUnavailable.cn: 常规世界地图不可用. 请检查该世界的地图设置.

UI_RX60_NoCar.en: No loaded vehicle within 50 tiles on this floor.
UI_RX60_NoCar.ch: 此樓層 50 格內沒有已載入的車輛.
UI_RX60_NoCar.cn: 此楼层 50 格内没有已加载的车辆.

UI_RX60_NoRoom.en: The destination bag has no room or rejects this item.
UI_RX60_NoRoom.ch: 目標袋子沒有空間或不接受此物品.
UI_RX60_NoRoom.cn: 目标袋子没有空间或不接受此物品.

UI_RX60_PlaceHint.en: Choose a valid tile and left-click. Normal building rotation applies. Esc cancels.
UI_RX60_PlaceHint.ch: 選擇有效的方格並按左鍵. 一般的建造旋轉規則照常適用. Esc 取消.
UI_RX60_PlaceHint.cn: 选择有效的方格并按左键. 常规建造旋转照常适用. Esc 取消.

UI_RX60_PlayerOnly.en: Transfer only into your own inventory or carried bags.
UI_RX60_PlayerOnly.ch: 只能轉移到您自己的背包或攜帶的袋子.
UI_RX60_PlayerOnly.cn: 只能转移到您自己的背包或携带的袋子.

UI_RX60_PressKey.en: Press a new key. Esc cancels. Ctrl/Alt combinations are not assigned here.
UI_RX60_PressKey.ch: 請按下新按鍵. Esc 取消. 此處不會指定 Ctrl/Alt 組合鍵.
UI_RX60_PressKey.cn: 请按下新按键. Esc 取消. 此处不会指定 Ctrl/Alt 组合键.

UI_RX60_RevealHint.en: Marks map areas as known. This is persistent exploration data, not a temporary visibility toggle. It does not load remote terrain.
UI_RX60_RevealHint.ch: 將地圖區域標記為已知. 這是永久的探索資料, 不是暫時的可見度開關. 不會載入遠處的地形.
UI_RX60_RevealHint.cn: 将地图区域标记为已知. 这是永久的探索数据, 不是临时的可见度开关. 不会加载远处的地形.

UI_RX60_SelectLoot.en: Select an item to see its original container and coordinates.
UI_RX60_SelectLoot.ch: 選擇物品即可檢視其原本所在的容器與座標.
UI_RX60_SelectLoot.cn: 选择物品即可查看其原本所在的容器与坐标.

UI_RX60_SpecialRecipe.en: This recipe produced no standalone item without inputs. Transformation, fluid or custom recipes may require the normal crafting process.
UI_RX60_SpecialRecipe.ch: 此配方在沒有投入材料時沒有產出獨立物品. 轉換、液體或自訂配方可能需要透過一般製作流程.
UI_RX60_SpecialRecipe.cn: 该配方在没有投入材料时没有产出独立物品. 转换、液体或自定义配方可能需要通过常规制作流程.

UI_RX60_Stale.en: The item moved, disappeared or is now outside the radius. Refresh the search.
UI_RX60_Stale.ch: 該物品已移動、消失或已超出半徑範圍. 請重新整理搜尋.
UI_RX60_Stale.cn: 该物品已移动、消失或已超出半径范围. 请刷新搜索.

UI_RX60_TransferResult.ch: 物品已轉移 / 已請求
UI_RX60_TransferResult.cn: 物品已转移 / 已请求

UI_RX60_VanillaHint.en: Adds a Rax icon to the vanilla loot panel. Drag from it into your inventory or carried bags. This is a read-only combined view, not a new storage container. Does not require Proximity Inventory.
UI_RX60_VanillaHint.ch: 在原版搜刮面板新增 Rax 圖示. 可從中拖曳物品到您的背包或攜帶的袋子. 這是唯讀的合併檢視, 不是新的儲物容器. 不需要 Proximity Inventory.
UI_RX60_VanillaHint.cn: 在原版搜刮面板添加 Rax 图标. 可从中拖动物品到您的背包或携带的袋子. 这是只读的合并视图, 不是新的储物容器. 不需要 Proximity Inventory.

UI_RX60_WideHint.en: Scans loaded containers, corpses, bags and vehicle storage within a 50-tile circle, on all loaded floors. Single-click selects; double-click takes the real item. Single-player only. Scanning is incremental.
UI_RX60_WideHint.ch: 掃描半徑 50 格圓形範圍內所有已載入樓層中已載入的容器、屍體、袋子與車輛儲物空間. 按一下選取; 按兩下取走實際物品. 僅限單人模式. 掃描會逐步進行.
UI_RX60_WideHint.cn: 扫描半径 50 格圆形范围内所有已加载楼层中已加载的容器、尸体、袋子与车辆储物空间. 单击选中; 双击取走实际物品. 仅限单人模式. 扫描会逐步进行.

UI_RX61_FireGeometry.en: The vehicle footprint is unavailable or too large.
UI_RX61_FireGeometry.ch: 無法取得車輛佔地範圍, 或範圍過大.
UI_RX61_FireGeometry.cn: 无法获取车辆占地范围, 或范围过大.

UI_RX61_FirePartial.en: Some cells could not be ignited.

UI_RX61_InstantOffFailed.en: The game did not disable native instant actions.
UI_RX61_InstantOffFailed.ch: 遊戲未停用原生即時動作.
UI_RX61_InstantOffFailed.cn: 游戏未禁用原生即时动作.

UI_RX61_RepairPartial.en: Some items could not be repaired. See the console.
UI_RX61_RepairPartial.ch: 部分物品無法修復. 請檢視控制台.
UI_RX61_RepairPartial.cn: 部分物品无法修复. 请查看控制台.

UI_RX61_ThemeHint.en: Saved between launches. Vanilla keeps native widget styling; compatibility with UI skins depends on the other mod.
UI_RX61_ThemeHint.ch: 重新啟動遊戲後仍會保留. 「原版」會保持原生元件樣式; 與介面外觀模組的相容性取決於該模組.
UI_RX61_ThemeHint.cn: 重新启动游戏后仍会保留. “原版”会保持原生控件样式; 与界面皮肤模组的兼容性取决于该模组.

UI_RX61_Toolbar.ch: 開啟 / 關閉 Rax 作弊選單 2.0
UI_RX61_Toolbar.cn: 打开 / 关闭 Rax 作弊菜单 2.0

UI_RX62_DevHint.en: Developer mode uses the Burning Vehicles native settings. Shift+I opens the test panel.
UI_RX62_DevHint.ch: 開發者模式使用 Burning Vehicles 的原生設定. 按 Shift+I 開啟測試面板.
UI_RX62_DevHint.cn: 开发者模式使用 Burning Vehicles 的原生设置. 按 Shift+I 打开测试面板.

UI_RX63_ClassicHint.en: A nostalgic interface for fans of the original Cheat Menu. Main commands become right-click submenus; spawners and detailed editors retain their own dialogs. Turn this off under Settings to restore the main window.
UI_RX63_ClassicHint.ch: 為原作 Cheat Menu 愛好者打造的懷舊介面. 主要指令會變成右鍵子選單; 生成器與詳細編輯器保留各自的對話方塊. 在「模組設定」中關閉此選項即可恢復主視窗.
UI_RX63_ClassicHint.cn: 为原作 Cheat Menu 爱好者打造的怀旧界面. 主要命令会变成右键子菜单; 生成器与详细编辑器保留各自的对话框. 在“模组设置”中关闭此选项即可恢复主窗口.

UI_RX63_HideIconHint.en: Hide the sidebar shortcut. Right-click and the configured hotkey remain available. The icon is visible by default.
UI_RX63_HideIconHint.ch: 隱藏側邊欄捷徑. 右鍵與已設定的快捷鍵仍可使用. 圖示預設為顯示.
UI_RX63_HideIconHint.cn: 隐藏侧边栏快捷方式. 右键与已设置的快捷键仍可使用. 图标默认显示.

UI_RX64_ModernInterfaceHint.en: Switch to the modern window immediately.

UI_RX66_GearAlreadyRestored.en: Already restored this equipment snapshot for this character.
UI_RX66_GearAlreadyRestored.ch: 此角色已恢復過這份裝備快照.
UI_RX66_GearAlreadyRestored.cn: 该角色已恢复过这份装备快照.

UI_RX66_GearMissing.en: Some item types are unavailable. Restore cancelled.
UI_RX66_GearMissing.ch: 部分物品類型無法使用. 已取消恢復.
UI_RX66_GearMissing.cn: 部分物品类型不可用. 已取消恢复.

UI_RX66_GearRestoreHint.en: Recover saved equipment after death. Adds items without deleting existing possessions. Once per character per snapshot. Modded item internals may be incomplete.
UI_RX66_GearRestoreHint.ch: 死亡後取回已儲存的裝備. 只新增物品, 不會刪除現有持有物. 每個角色每份快照限用一次. 模組物品的內部資料可能不完整.
UI_RX66_GearRestoreHint.cn: 死亡后找回已保存的装备. 只添加物品, 不会删除现有持有物. 每个角色每份快照限用一次. 模组物品的内部数据可能不完整.

UI_RX66_GearRestorePartial.en: Equipment partially restored. Check missing slots and the console.
UI_RX66_GearRestorePartial.ch: 裝備已部分恢復. 請檢查缺少的欄位與控制台.
UI_RX66_GearRestorePartial.cn: 装备已部分恢复. 请检查缺少的槽位与控制台.

UI_RX66_GearSaveHint.en: Save all carried items, bag contents, worn clothes, hands and attached items to an independent backup. Replaces previous equipment snapshot.
UI_RX66_GearSaveHint.ch: 將所有攜帶的物品、袋內物品、穿著衣物、手持物品與掛載物品儲存為獨立備份. 會取代先前的裝備快照.
UI_RX66_GearSaveHint.cn: 将所有携带的物品、包内物品、穿着衣物、手持物品与挂载物品保存为独立备份. 会替换之前的装备快照.

UI_RX66_GearTooLarge.ch: 物品過多, 無法儲存.
UI_RX66_GearTooLarge.cn: 物品过多, 无法保存.

UI_RX66_NoClipDenied.en: Game refused noclip. For multiplayer, server permissions are required.
UI_RX66_NoClipDenied.ch: 遊戲拒絕了穿牆. 多人遊戲需要伺服器權限.
UI_RX66_NoClipDenied.cn: 游戏拒绝了穿墙. 多人游戏需要服务器权限.

UI_RX66_NoRepairTarget.en: No damaged repairable objects on this tile.
UI_RX66_NoRepairTarget.ch: 此方格上沒有受損的可修復物件.
UI_RX66_NoRepairTarget.cn: 此方格上没有受损的可修复对象.

UI_RX66_RepairWorldHint.en: Click or paint over existing damaged doors, windows, barricades and other repairable constructions. Restores health and glass when supported. Cannot recreate completely missing objects. Single player.
UI_RX66_RepairWorldHint.ch: 點選或塗刷現有受損的門、窗戶、路障及其他可修復的建築. 在支援時恢復耐久度與玻璃. 無法重建完全消失的物件. 僅限單人模式.
UI_RX66_RepairWorldHint.cn: 点击或涂刷现有受损的门、窗户、路障及其他可修复的建筑. 在支持时恢复耐久度与玻璃. 无法重建完全消失的对象. 仅限单人模式.

UI_RX67_AutoSavePartial.en: Could not save both snapshots. Auto-save will retry; see the console.
UI_RX67_AutoSavePartial.ch: 無法儲存兩份快照. 自動存檔會重試; 請檢視控制台.
UI_RX67_AutoSavePartial.cn: 无法保存两份快照. 自动存档会重试; 请查看控制台.

UI_RX67_TimeFailed.en: Could not freeze the clock. The mode was disabled; see the console.
UI_RX67_TimeFailed.ch: 無法凍結時鐘. 此模式已停用; 請檢視控制台.
UI_RX67_TimeFailed.cn: 无法冻结时钟. 该模式已禁用; 请查看控制台.

UI_RXE_AdminConfirm.ch: 確認對選取玩家的操作
UI_RXE_AdminConfirm.cn: 确认对选中玩家的操作

UI_RXE_AdminDone.en: Remote action confirmed by the target client.
UI_RXE_AdminDone.ch: 目標客戶端已確認遠端操作.
UI_RXE_AdminDone.cn: 目标客户端已确认远程操作.

UI_RXE_AdminFailed.en: Remote action failed or was rejected.
UI_RXE_AdminFailed.ch: 遠端操作失敗或遭拒絕.
UI_RXE_AdminFailed.cn: 远程操作失败或被拒绝.

UI_RXE_AdminFreshness.ch: 讓選取玩家的食物變新鮮
UI_RXE_AdminFreshness.cn: 让选中玩家的食物变新鲜

UI_RXE_AdminHere.ch: 將選取的玩家帶到此處
UI_RXE_AdminHere.cn: 将选中的玩家带到此处

UI_RXE_AdminHint.en: Server-player actions. Only the actual server administrator can request remote actions. Existing Rax heal/skill/repair handlers are reused on the target client; the module must be installed on both sides.
UI_RXE_AdminHint.ch: 伺服器玩家操作. 只有真正的伺服器管理員可以請求遠端操作. 目標客戶端會沿用現有的 Rax 治療/技能/修復處理常式; 雙方都必須安裝此模組.
UI_RXE_AdminHint.cn: 服务器玩家操作. 只有真正的服务器管理员才能请求远程操作. 目标客户端会复用现有的 Rax 治疗/技能/修复处理程序; 双方都必须安装此模组.

UI_RXE_AdminOffline.en: Player administration is available in multiplayer. Other tabs keep working in single-player.
UI_RXE_AdminOffline.ch: 玩家管理只能在多人遊戲中使用. 其他分頁在單人模式下仍可正常使用.
UI_RXE_AdminOffline.cn: 玩家管理仅在多人游戏中可用. 其他标签页在单人模式下仍可正常使用.

UI_RXE_AdminOnly.en: This panel requires the server administrator role.
UI_RXE_AdminOnly.ch: 此面板需要伺服器管理員身分.
UI_RXE_AdminOnly.cn: 此面板需要服务器管理员身份.

UI_RXE_AdminRate.ch: 請稍候再送出下一個請求.
UI_RXE_AdminRate.cn: 请稍候再发送下一个请求.

UI_RXE_AdminSkills.ch: 將選取玩家的技能全部滿級
UI_RXE_AdminSkills.cn: 将选中玩家的技能全部满级

UI_RXE_AdminTimeout.en: No confirmation received. The server and target may be missing this mod, or the connection was interrupted.
UI_RXE_AdminTimeout.ch: 未收到確認. 伺服器與目標可能未安裝此模組, 或連線已中斷.
UI_RXE_AdminTimeout.cn: 未收到确认. 服务器与目标可能未安装此模组, 或连接已中断.

UI_RXE_AdminTo.ch: 傳送到選取的玩家身邊
UI_RXE_AdminTo.cn: 传送到选中的玩家身边

UI_RXE_AdminUsage.ch: 補滿選取玩家的可清空物品
