UI_MPOptim_V2_ProfilerSummary.cn: %%d个模组, %%d个事件钩子, %%.1fMB Lua内存

UI_MPOptim_V2_ProfilerTip.en: Estimates how much Lua memory each mod holds and which game events it listens to. Heaviest first. Select a mod for details.
UI_MPOptim_V2_ProfilerTip.ch: 估算每個模組佔用多少 Lua 記憶體, 以及監聽哪些遊戲事件. 佔用最多的排在最前面. 選擇模組可檢視詳細資訊.
UI_MPOptim_V2_ProfilerTip.cn: 估算每个模组占用多少Lua内存, 以及监听哪些游戏事件. 占用最多的排在最前面. 选择模组可查看详情.

UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingHighDesc.en: Frequent update hooks. Noticeable cost while playing.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingHighDesc.ch: 頻繁觸發的更新掛鉤. 遊玩時有明顯負擔.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingHighDesc.cn: 频繁触发的更新钩子. 游玩时有明显开销.

UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingLightDesc.en: Few or light event hooks. Hardly any cost per frame.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingLightDesc.ch: 事件掛鉤少或很輕量. 每個影格幾乎沒有負擔.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingLightDesc.cn: 事件钩子少或很轻量. 每帧几乎没有开销.

UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingModerateDesc.en: Some periodic or per-action hooks. Small cost.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingModerateDesc.ch: 有一些定期或逐動作觸發的掛鉤. 負擔小.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingModerateDesc.cn: 有一些定期或逐动作触发的钩子. 开销小.

UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingVeryHighDesc.en: Runs code every frame or holds a lot of memory. Likely to cost FPS.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingVeryHighDesc.ch: 每個影格都執行程式碼, 或佔用大量記憶體. 很可能降低 FPS.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RatingVeryHighDesc.cn: 每帧都执行代码, 或占用大量内存. 很可能降低FPS.

UI_MPOptim_V2_ResetConfirm.en: Every setting goes back to its default. Saved presets are kept.
UI_MPOptim_V2_ResetConfirm.ch: 所有設定都會回到預設值. 已儲存的預設組會保留.
UI_MPOptim_V2_ResetConfirm.cn: 所有设置都会恢复为默认值. 已保存的预设会保留.

UI_MPOptim_V2_ResetDone.en: All settings are back to their defaults.
UI_MPOptim_V2_ResetDone.ch: 所有設定已回到預設值.
UI_MPOptim_V2_ResetDone.cn: 所有设置已恢复为默认值.

UI_MPOptim_V2_SavePresetBody.en: Name for this preset. Saving under an existing name replaces it.
UI_MPOptim_V2_SavePresetBody.ch: 為此預設組命名. 使用已存在的名稱儲存會將其取代.
UI_MPOptim_V2_SavePresetBody.cn: 为此预设命名. 使用已存在的名称保存会将其覆盖.

UI_MPOptim_V2_UpdateAvailableTip.en: A newer PZO Java engine is on GitHub. Click to open the download page.
UI_MPOptim_V2_UpdateAvailableTip.ch: GitHub 上有更新版的 PZO Java 引擎. 點選即可開啟下載頁面.
UI_MPOptim_V2_UpdateAvailableTip.cn: GitHub上有更新版的PZO Java引擎. 点击即可打开下载页面.

UI_MPOptim_V2_UpdatedTitle.ch: 最佳化器已更新至 v%%s

UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB1.ch: 減少遠處殭屍的動畫運算, 戰鬥更流暢
UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB1.cn: 减少远处僵尸的动画运算, 战斗更流畅

UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB2.ch: 每個地塊最多 4 個血跡, 看起來沒有差別
UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB2.cn: 每个地块最多4个血迹, 看起来没有差别

UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB3.en: Cleanups spread over many frames so they do not stutter
UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB3.ch: 清理分散到多個影格執行, 不會造成卡頓
UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB3.cn: 清理分散到多帧执行, 不会造成卡顿

UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB4.en: Texture compression and fewer fly swarms to save video memory
UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB4.ch: 材質壓縮並減少蒼蠅群, 以節省顯示記憶體
UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeB4.cn: 纹理压缩并减少苍蝇群, 以节省显存

UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeIntro.cn: 你的游戏已在使用以下优化:

UI_MPOptim_V2_WelcomeTitle.cn: 欢迎使用僵尸毁灭工程优化器

UI_SurvivorBriefing_SideOffset.en: Move in from the side (% of screen)
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SideOffset.ch: 從側邊往內移 (螢幕寬度 %%)
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SideOffset.cn: 从侧边向内移 (屏幕宽度 %%)

UI_SurvivorBriefing_SideOffset_tooltip.en: For wide screens: moves a briefing in a corner towards the middle by this much of the screen's width. 0 keeps it in the corner. The centred positions stay where they are.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SideOffset_tooltip.ch: 適用於寬螢幕: 將位於角落的簡報往中間移動螢幕寬度的這個比例. 0 會讓簡報留在角落. 置中的位置維持不變.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SideOffset_tooltip.cn: 适用于宽屏: 将位于角落的简报向中间移动屏幕宽度的这一比例. 0 表示保持在角落. 居中的位置保持不变.

UI_SurvivorBriefing_waitAway.en: Wait for me when I'm away

UI_SurvivorBriefing_waitAway_tooltip.en: If you haven't touched anything for a while when a briefing comes up (loading into a busy server, for one), it stays on screen until you move, press a key or click, and then for its usual time. The Show briefing key closes it at any time.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_waitAway_tooltip.ch: 如果簡報出現時你已經一段時間沒有任何操作 (例如載入人多的伺服器時), 它會一直留在螢幕上, 直到你移動、按下按鍵或點選, 之後再停留平常的時間. 「顯示簡報」鍵隨時都能關閉它.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_waitAway_tooltip.cn: 如果简报出现时你已有一段时间没有任何操作 (例如加载人多的服务器时), 它会一直留在屏幕上, 直到你移动、按键或点击, 之后再停留通常的时长. “显示简报”键可随时关闭它.

UI_LNPCMedLab_NeedsBulletTool.en: Tweezers or a suture needle holder required

UI_AuthenticZ_GlowstickThrow_Keybind_Too.ch: 進入螢光棒投擲瞄準模式.
UI_AuthenticZ_GlowstickThrow_Keybind_Too.cn: 进入荧光棒投掷瞄准模式.

UI_AuthenticZ_Hotbar_HideSlots_Tooltip.en: Hides Authentic Z backpack attachment slots from the on-screen hotbar. Attachment functionality is unchanged.
UI_AuthenticZ_Hotbar_HideSlots_Tooltip.ch: 在畫面上的快捷欄中隱藏 Authentic Z 背包的掛載槽位. 掛載功能不受影響.
UI_AuthenticZ_Hotbar_HideSlots_Tooltip.cn: 在屏幕上的快捷栏中隐藏 Authentic Z 背包的挂载槽位. 挂载功能不受影响.

UI_MPOptim_SetHint_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.en: Smaller loads less of the world around you.
UI_MPOptim_SetHint_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.ch: 數值越小, 載入你周圍的世界範圍越小.
UI_MPOptim_SetHint_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.cn: 数值越小, 加载你周围的世界范围越小.

UI_MPOptim_SetNote_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.en: Applies the next time a world loads. Zoomed far out, the screen edges may show black.
UI_MPOptim_SetNote_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.ch: 下次載入世界時生效. 視角拉得很遠時, 螢幕邊緣可能會出現黑色.
UI_MPOptim_SetNote_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.cn: 下次加载世界时生效. 视角拉得很远时, 屏幕边缘可能会显示黑色.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.en: How many chunks around you are kept loaded and simulated. Auto is the game's own size for your screen (19 by 19 chunks at 1080p and above). Smaller saves CPU and memory while travelling and near hordes; zombies outside the loaded area stay inactive until you come closer.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.ch: 你周圍保持載入並模擬的區塊數量. 「自動」是遊戲依你的螢幕自行決定的大小 (1080p 以上為 19 乘 19 個區塊). 數值越小, 移動途中與屍群附近越省 CPU 和記憶體; 載入範圍外的殭屍會保持不活動, 直到你靠近為止.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ChunkLoadDistance.cn: 你周围保持加载并模拟的区块数量. “自动”是游戏根据你的屏幕自行决定的大小 (1080p及以上为19乘19个区块). 数值越小, 移动途中和尸群附近越省CPU和内存; 加载范围外的僵尸会保持不活动, 直到你靠近为止.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_CrowdEdgeMemo.en: When zombies in a crowd push each other apart, the wall, door and window check between two squares is worked out once per frame instead of once per zombie. Any door or wall change clears it at once. Same movement.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_CrowdEdgeMemo.ch: 屍群中的殭屍互相推開時, 兩個地塊之間的牆壁、門與窗戶判定改為每個影格計算一次, 而不是每隻殭屍各算一次. 任何門或牆壁有變動都會立即清除這份結果. 移動結果不變.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_CrowdEdgeMemo.cn: 尸群中的僵尸互相推开时, 两个地块之间的墙体、门和窗户判定改为每帧计算一次, 而不是每只僵尸各算一次. 任何门或墙体变化都会立即清除该结果. 移动结果不变.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_FarThumpCadence.en: Zombies more than 20 tiles from you look for a door, window or fence ahead of them every other frame instead of every frame. They reach it at most one frame later. Zombies near you are unchanged.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_FarThumpCadence.ch: 距離你超過 20 格的殭屍, 改為每隔一個影格才尋找前方的門、窗或圍欄, 而不是每個影格都找. 它們最多只會晚一個影格抵達. 你附近的殭屍不受影響.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_FarThumpCadence.cn: 距离你超过20格的僵尸改为每隔一帧才寻找前方的门、窗或围栏, 而不是每帧都找. 它们最多只会晚一帧到达. 你附近的僵尸不受影响.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_NoiseSweep.en: Noises zombies can hear are listed in every chunk they reach. Those lists are now cleaned only in a frame where a noise actually ran out, instead of checking every loaded chunk every frame. Same noises.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_NoiseSweep.ch: 殭屍聽得見的噪音, 會登記在噪音所及的每個區塊中. 現在只在確實有噪音結束的影格才清理這些清單, 而不是每個影格檢查所有已載入的區塊. 噪音不變.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_NoiseSweep.cn: 僵尸能听到的噪音会登记在噪音波及的每个区块中. 现在只在确实有噪音结束的那一帧才清理这些列表, 而不是每帧检查所有已加载的区块. 噪音不变.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_SilentZombieAudio.en: A zombie that is not making any sound no longer recalculates its sound settings (floor material, distance, inside or out) every frame. They are worked out fresh the moment it makes a sound. Same sounds.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_SilentZombieAudio.ch: 沒有發出任何聲音的殭屍, 不再每個影格重新計算聲音參數 (地板材質、距離、室內或室外). 它一發出聲音就會立刻重新計算. 聲音不變.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_SilentZombieAudio.cn: 没有发出任何声音的僵尸不再每帧重新计算声音参数 (地面材质、距离、室内或室外). 它一发出声音就会立即重新计算. 声音不变.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ZombieArrivalPacin.en: When an area next to a horde loads, its zombies are created over a few frames instead of all in one long frame. Zombies within 25 tiles of you, and every zombie while you drive, still appear at once; none waits longer than half a second, and all are created before the game saves.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ZombieArrivalPacin.ch: 屍群旁的區域載入時, 其中的殭屍會分散在數個影格中生成, 而不是全部擠在一個漫長的影格裡. 距離你 25 格內的殭屍, 以及你駕駛時的所有殭屍, 仍會立即出現; 每隻殭屍最多只等半秒, 且全部會在遊戲存檔前生成完畢.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ZombieArrivalPacin.cn: 尸群旁的区域加载时, 其中的僵尸会分散到几帧内生成, 而不是全部挤在一个漫长的帧里. 距离你25格内的僵尸, 以及你驾驶时的所有僵尸, 仍会立即出现; 每只僵尸最多只等半秒, 且全部会在游戏存档前生成完毕.

UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ZombieTravelStats.en: The distance zombies walk, crawl and run is added to the game's statistics once per frame instead of once per zombie, which also checks the achievements once instead of thousands of times. Same totals.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ZombieTravelStats.ch: 殭屍行走、爬行與奔跑的距離, 改為每個影格統一計入遊戲統計一次, 而不是每隻殭屍各計一次; 成就也因此只檢查一次, 而不是數千次. 總計不變.
UI_MPOptim_SetTip_JVM_ZombieTravelStats.cn: 僵尸行走、爬行和奔跑的距离改为每帧统一计入游戏统计一次, 而不是每只僵尸各计一次; 成就也因此只检查一次, 而不是数千次. 总数不变.

UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_CrowdEdgeMemo.ch: 屍群推擠牆壁判定快取
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_CrowdEdgeMemo.cn: 尸群推挤墙体判定缓存

UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_FarThumpCadence.en: Far Zombies Check Doors Every Other Frame
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_FarThumpCadence.ch: 遠處殭屍隔一影格檢查門

UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_NoiseSweep.en: Clear Old Noises Only When One Expires
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_NoiseSweep.ch: 僅在有噪音過期時清理舊噪音
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_NoiseSweep.cn: 仅在有噪音过期时清理旧噪音

UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_SilentZombieAudio.ch: 安靜的殭屍略過聲音更新
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_SilentZombieAudio.cn: 安静的僵尸跳过声音更新

UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_ZombieTravelStats.en: Zombie Travel Statistics Once a Frame
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_ZombieTravelStats.ch: 殭屍移動統計每影格一次
UI_MPOptim_Set_JVM_ZombieTravelStats.cn: 僵尸移动统计每帧一次

UI_MPOptim_V2_RecommendedApplied.en: %d settings changed to this PC's recommendations.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RecommendedApplied.ch: 已將 %d 項設定改為此電腦的建議值.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RecommendedApplied.cn: 已将%d项设置改为此电脑的推荐值.

UI_MPOptim_V2_RecommendedLeftCleanup.en: Corpse and debris cleanup left for you to choose.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RecommendedLeftCleanup.ch: 屍體與雜物清理交由你自行決定.
UI_MPOptim_V2_RecommendedLeftCleanup.cn: 尸体和杂物清理交由你自行决定.

UI_quick_tip_LGU_01.en: Le Gourmet Ultimate: Wear leather gloves or keep needle-nosed pliers in your inventory when fishing.
UI_quick_tip_LGU_01.ch: Le Gourmet Ultimate: 釣魚時請戴上皮手套, 或在物品欄中放一把尖嘴鉗.
UI_quick_tip_LGU_01.cn: Le Gourmet Ultimate: 钓鱼时请戴上皮手套, 或在物品栏中携带尖嘴钳.

UI_quick_tip_LGU_02.en: Le Gourmet Ultimate: You can use fishing magnets to find sunken treasures.
UI_quick_tip_LGU_02.ch: Le Gourmet Ultimate: 你可以用釣魚磁鐵尋找沉沒的寶藏.
UI_quick_tip_LGU_02.cn: Le Gourmet Ultimate: 你可以用钓鱼磁铁寻找沉没的宝藏.

UI_quick_tip_LGU_03.en: Le Gourmet Ultimate: Be careful when carrying hydrochloric acid, wear an appropriate suit.
UI_quick_tip_LGU_03.ch: Le Gourmet Ultimate: 攜帶鹽酸時要小心, 請穿上合適的防護服.
UI_quick_tip_LGU_03.cn: Le Gourmet Ultimate: 携带盐酸时要小心, 请穿上合适的防护服.

RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.cn: 嘿嘿, 大家今天过得如何?

RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.en: What do we need? First - Let's Heat some water
RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.ch: 我們需要什麼? 首先 - 把水加熱
RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.cn: 我们需要什么? 首先 - 把水加热

RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.en: There! Most of our work's done, all we need now is patience!
RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.ch: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 現在只需要一點耐心!
RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.cn: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 现在只需要一点耐心!

RM_7882f5ee-271a-4051-bac9-8eac5e425618.en: The best start of our mornings!

RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.en: And it's as easy as that! Some Hot Brewed Coffee!
RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.ch: 就是這麼簡單! 一杯熱騰騰的沖泡咖啡!
RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.cn: 就是这么简单! 一杯热腾腾的冲泡咖啡!

RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.en: Let that Hot Water slowly Brew our Coffee!
RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.ch: 讓熱水慢慢沖泡出我們的咖啡!
RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.cn: 让热水慢慢冲泡出我们的咖啡!

RM_909bad9d-b7ff-42d5-b60c-1857be5598b9.ch: VHS: Sapph 的烹飪秀 EP1 (咖啡)
RM_909bad9d-b7ff-42d5-b60c-1857be5598b9.cn: VHS: Sapph 的烹饪秀 EP1 (咖啡)

RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.en: Hope you all enjoyed it - see you all, next time~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.ch: 希望大家喜歡 - 我們下次見~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.cn: 希望大家喜欢 - 我们下次见~[img=music]

RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.en: Second - Get some Coffee Beans, Grind it on a Grinder like this!
RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.ch: 接著 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像這樣用研磨機磨碎!
RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.cn: 接着 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像这样用研磨机磨碎!

RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.en: and... There! Now, we just need some paper or cloth filters.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.ch: …好了! 現在, 我們只需要一些濾紙或濾布.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.cn: …好了! 现在, 我们只需要一些滤纸或滤布.

RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.en: <Noises> Or if you're bold, you can even use a Mortar and Pestle...<Noises>
RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.ch: <Noises> 或者你夠大膽的話, 甚至可以用研缽和杵…<Noises>
RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.cn: <Noises> 或者你够大胆的话, 甚至可以用研钵和杵…<Noises>

RM_ef323d59-b334-4635-9969-d0a404c1d578.ch: 今天我們要沖泡的是… 咖啡
RM_ef323d59-b334-4635-9969-d0a404c1d578.cn: 今天我们要冲泡的是… 咖啡

RM_VPS_Extra.en: Ebenezer Missionary Baptist Church - Rosewood, Kentucky - 1982
RM_VPS_Extra.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會 - 肯塔基州羅斯伍德 - 1982
RM_VPS_Extra.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会 - 肯塔基州罗斯伍德 - 1982

RM_VPS_T1_01.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T1_01.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T1_02.en: This is the Lord's day, and we are recording.
RM_VPS_T1_02.ch: 今天是主日, 我們正在錄音.
RM_VPS_T1_02.cn: 今天是主日, 我们正在录音.

RM_VPS_T1_03.en: Thirty of us bought that camera together.
RM_VPS_T1_03.ch: 我們三十個人合錢買了那台攝影機.
RM_VPS_T1_03.cn: 我们三十个人凑钱买了那台摄像机.

RM_VPS_T1_04.en: I hope you know what that cost.
RM_VPS_T1_04.ch: 我希望你們知道那花了多少錢.
RM_VPS_T1_04.cn: 我希望你们知道那花了多少钱.

RM_VPS_T1_05.en: Tommy Culver, I can see you.
RM_VPS_T1_05.ch: 湯米·卡爾弗, 我看得見你.
RM_VPS_T1_05.cn: 汤米·卡尔弗, 我看得见你.

RM_VPS_T1_06.en: Turn with me to Genesis, chapter four.
RM_VPS_T1_06.ch: 跟我一起翻到創世記第四章.
RM_VPS_T1_06.cn: 跟我一起翻到创世记第四章.

RM_VPS_T1_07.en: Verse two first. It is a small verse.
RM_VPS_T1_07.ch: 先看第二節. 那是很短的一節.
RM_VPS_T1_07.cn: 先看第二节. 那是很短的一节.

RM_VPS_T1_08.en: "And Abel was a keeper of sheep,

RM_VPS_T1_09.en: but Cain was a tiller of the ground."

RM_VPS_T1_10.en: Hold onto the farmer. We will want him.
RM_VPS_T1_10.ch: 記住那個種地的. 我們以後會用到他.
RM_VPS_T1_10.cn: 记住那个种地的. 我们以后会用到他.

RM_VPS_T1_11.ch: 不是今天. 但還是把他記著.
RM_VPS_T1_11.cn: 不是今天. 但还是把他记着.

RM_VPS_T1_13.en: "And it came to pass, when they were in the field,

RM_VPS_T1_14.en: that Cain rose up against Abel his brother,
RM_VPS_T1_14.ch: 該隱起來打他兄弟亞伯,
RM_VPS_T1_14.cn: 该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯,

RM_VPS_T1_17.en: Not in a temple. Not before a judge.
RM_VPS_T1_17.ch: 不在殿裡. 不在審判官面前.
RM_VPS_T1_17.cn: 不在殿里. 不在审判官面前.

RM_VPS_T1_18.en: Where there was nobody to see it.
RM_VPS_T1_18.ch: 在沒有一個人看得見的地方.
RM_VPS_T1_18.cn: 在没有一个人看得见的地方.

RM_VPS_T1_19.en: No court out there. No witness. No sentence.
RM_VPS_T1_19.ch: 那外頭沒有法庭. 沒有見證人. 沒有判決.
RM_VPS_T1_19.cn: 那外头没有法庭. 没有见证人. 没有判决.

RM_VPS_T1_20.en: Somebody had to do all of it.
RM_VPS_T1_20.ch: 這一切, 都得有人自己動手.
RM_VPS_T1_20.cn: 这一切, 都得有人自己动手.

RM_VPS_T1_21.ch: 該隱把自己立成了[col=191,102,255]行刑的人[/].
RM_VPS_T1_21.cn: 该隐把自己立成了[col=191,102,255]行刑的人[/].

RM_VPS_T1_22.en: He took an office he was never given.
RM_VPS_T1_22.ch: 他擔起了一個從來沒有交給他的職分.
RM_VPS_T1_22.cn: 他担起了一个从来没有交给他的职分.

RM_VPS_T1_23.en: That is what murder is, church -
RM_VPS_T1_23.ch: 教會啊, 殺人就是這麼一回事 -
RM_VPS_T1_23.cn: 教会啊, 杀人就是这么一回事 -

RM_VPS_T1_24.en: a man doing God's work for Him, badly,
RM_VPS_T1_24.ch: 一個人替神做祂的工, 做得一塌糊塗,
RM_VPS_T1_24.cn: 一个人替神做他的工, 做得一塌糊涂,

RM_VPS_T1_26.en: The Lord asks where his brother is.
RM_VPS_T1_26.ch: 主問他, 你兄弟在哪裡.
RM_VPS_T1_26.cn: 主问他, 你兄弟在哪里.

RM_VPS_T1_28.ch: 我豈是看守我兄弟的嗎? 」
RM_VPS_T1_28.cn: 我岂是看守我兄弟的吗? ”

RM_VPS_T1_30.en: And the Lord does not argue with him.

RM_VPS_T1_33.en: the voice of thy brother's[col=217,31,31] blood[/]

RM_VPS_T1_34.en: crieth unto me from the ground."

RM_VPS_T1_37.en: and I have never once gotten past that line.
RM_VPS_T1_37.ch: 卻從來沒有一次能越過這一句.
RM_VPS_T1_37.cn: 却从来没有一次能越过这一句.

RM_VPS_T1_40.en: But[col=102,191,255] savagery[/] is not the sin the Lord names.
RM_VPS_T1_40.ch: 但[col=102,191,255]兇殘[/]不是主指出來的那個罪.
RM_VPS_T1_40.cn: 但[col=102,191,255]凶残[/]不是主指出来的那个罪.

RM_VPS_T1_41.en: He does not say thou hast killed.

RM_VPS_T1_42.en: He says what hast thou done.
RM_VPS_T1_42.ch: 祂說的是, 你做了甚麼事呢.
RM_VPS_T1_42.cn: 他说的是, 你做了什么事呢.

RM_VPS_T1_43.en: The killing was the smaller part.
RM_VPS_T1_43.ch: 殺人是其中比較小的那一半.
RM_VPS_T1_43.cn: 杀人是其中比较小的那一半.

RM_VPS_T1_44.en: Cain thought that field was empty.
RM_VPS_T1_44.ch: 該隱以為那片田是空的.
RM_VPS_T1_44.cn: 该隐以为那片田是空的.

RM_VPS_T1_45.en: He thought a thing done where nobody looks
RM_VPS_T1_45.ch: 他以為在沒有人看的地方做的事,
RM_VPS_T1_45.cn: 他以为在没有人看的地方做的事,

RM_VPS_T1_46.en: is a thing that did not happen.

RM_VPS_T1_48.en: Verse eleven: the earth opened her mouth.
RM_VPS_T1_48.ch: 第十一節: 地開了口.
RM_VPS_T1_48.cn: 第十一节: 地开了口.

RM_VPS_T1_49.en: It took what he gave it, and it kept it.
RM_VPS_T1_49.ch: 地接了他所給的, 而且留住了.
RM_VPS_T1_49.cn: 地接了他所给的, 而且留住了.

RM_VPS_T1_51.en: Cain ate his supper and slept. It did not.
RM_VPS_T1_51.ch: 該隱吃了晚飯, 睡了覺. 它沒有.
RM_VPS_T1_51.cn: 该隐吃了晚饭, 睡了觉. 它没有.

RM_VPS_T1_52.en: My grandmother had a word for a thing
RM_VPS_T1_52.ch: 我祖母對一樣東西有個說法,
RM_VPS_T1_52.cn: 我奶奶对一样东西有个说法,

RM_VPS_T1_53.en: that will not be reasoned with.
RM_VPS_T1_53.ch: 就是那種怎麼講道理都講不通的東西.
RM_VPS_T1_53.cn: 就是那种怎么讲道理都讲不通的东西.

RM_VPS_T1_54.en: She called a deed like that[col=191,102,255] fell[/].
RM_VPS_T1_54.ch: 她管那樣的行為叫[col=191,102,255]狠絕[/].
RM_VPS_T1_54.cn: 她管那样的行为叫[col=191,102,255]狠绝[/].

RM_VPS_T1_55.en: It does not only mean wicked.

RM_VPS_T1_56.en: It means it has already made up its mind.
RM_VPS_T1_56.ch: 那意思是, 它早已下定了決心.
RM_VPS_T1_56.cn: 那意思是, 它早已下定了决心.

RM_VPS_T1_57.en: Now hear the part I came to say.
RM_VPS_T1_57.ch: 現在聽我今天真正要說的那一段.
RM_VPS_T1_57.cn: 现在听我今天真正要说的那一段.

RM_VPS_T1_59.en: Cain never heard a thing. Not one thing.
RM_VPS_T1_59.ch: 該隱甚麼也沒聽見. 一點也沒有.
RM_VPS_T1_59.cn: 该隐什么也没听见. 一点也没有.

RM_VPS_T1_60.en: He walked out of that field in the quiet.
RM_VPS_T1_60.ch: 他在一片安靜裡走出了那片田.
RM_VPS_T1_60.cn: 他在一片安静里走出了那片田.

RM_VPS_T1_62.en: and the only ear in all creation
RM_VPS_T1_62.ch: 而在一切受造之物中, 唯一
RM_VPS_T1_62.cn: 而在一切受造之物中, 唯一

RM_VPS_T1_63.en: tuned to hear it was the ear of God.
RM_VPS_T1_63.ch: 聽得見那聲音的耳朵, 是神的耳朵.
RM_VPS_T1_63.cn: 听得见那声音的耳朵, 是神的耳朵.

RM_VPS_T1_65.en: Some of you have done things in a field.
RM_VPS_T1_65.ch: 你們有些人在田裡做過事.
RM_VPS_T1_65.cn: 你们有些人在田里做过事.

RM_VPS_T1_67.en: You are just not the one who can hear it.
RM_VPS_T1_67.ch: 只是你不是那個聽得見的人.
RM_VPS_T1_67.cn: 只是你不是那个听得见的人.

RM_VPS_T1_68.en: Verse fifteen, and then the sister sings.
RM_VPS_T1_68.ch: 第十五節, 然後請姊妹起唱.
RM_VPS_T1_68.cn: 第十五节, 然后请姊妹起唱.

RM_VPS_T1_69.en: "And the LORD set a mark upon Cain,
RM_VPS_T1_69.ch: 「耶和華就給該隱立一個記號,
RM_VPS_T1_69.cn: “耶和华就给该隐立一个记号,

RM_VPS_T1_70.en: lest any finding him should kill him."

RM_VPS_T1_71.en: God marked the murderer to keep him alive.
RM_VPS_T1_71.ch: 神給那殺人的立記號, 是為了留他的命.
RM_VPS_T1_71.cn: 神给那杀人的立记号, 是为了留他的命.

RM_VPS_T1_72.en: Next time there is a mark on a door in Egypt.
RM_VPS_T1_72.ch: 下一次, 記號是在埃及的一扇門上.
RM_VPS_T1_72.cn: 下一次, 记号是在埃及的一扇门上.

RM_VPS_T1_73.en: The Lord is merciful to the sinner,

RM_VPS_T1_74.en: and He is[col=191,102,255] merciless[/] to the sin,

RM_VPS_T1_75.en: and He is both at once,
RM_VPS_T1_75.ch: 而祂在同一刻是這兩樣,
RM_VPS_T1_75.cn: 而他在同一刻是这两样,

RM_VPS_T1_76.en: and that is the hardest thing I know.
RM_VPS_T1_76.ch: 這是我所知道最難的一件事.
RM_VPS_T1_76.cn: 这是我所知道最难的一件事.

RM_VPS_T1_77.ch: 姊妹 - 你來給我們起頭領唱.
RM_VPS_T1_77.cn: 姊妹 - 你来给我们起头领唱.

RM_VPS_T1_78.en: If this word has blessed you, write to us.
RM_VPS_T1_78.ch: 若這道使你得了福, 就寫信給我們.
RM_VPS_T1_78.cn: 若这道使你得了福, 就写信给我们.

RM_VPS_T1_80.ch: 郵政信箱 41 號, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T1_80.cn: 邮政信箱 41 号, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T1_81.en: Tape one of three. The Lord willing, a two.
RM_VPS_T1_81.ch: 三卷中的第一卷. 主若許可, 還有第二卷.
RM_VPS_T1_81.cn: 三卷中的第一卷. 主若许可, 还有第二卷.

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN1.en: [img=music] There is a fountain filled with[col=217,31,31] blood[/] [img=music]

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN2.ch: [img=music] 從以馬內利的血脈湧出 [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN2.cn: [img=music] 从以马内利的血脉涌出 [img=music]

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.en: [img=music] And sinners plunged beneath that flood [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.ch: [img=music] 罪人投身在那洪流之下 [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.cn: [img=music] 罪人投身在那洪流之下 [img=music]

RM_VPS_T2_01.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會, 羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T2_01.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会, 罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T2_03.en: Three weeks ago I left you in a field.
RM_VPS_T2_03.ch: 三週前, 我把你們留在一片田地裡.
RM_VPS_T2_03.cn: 三周前, 我把你们留在一片田地里.

RM_VPS_T2_04.en: Some of you have not slept right since.
RM_VPS_T2_04.ch: 從那之後, 你們有些人就沒睡好.
RM_VPS_T2_04.cn: 从那之后, 你们有些人就没睡好.

RM_VPS_T2_06.en: I left you with a mark, as well.
RM_VPS_T2_06.ch: 我也留給了你們一個銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_06.cn: 我也留给了你们一个铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_07.en: God set one on Cain to keep him breathing.
RM_VPS_T2_07.ch: 神在該隱身上立了一個, 為要讓他繼續呼吸.
RM_VPS_T2_07.cn: 神在该隐身上立了一个, 为要让他继续呼吸.

RM_VPS_T2_08.en: This morning we put one on a door.
RM_VPS_T2_08.ch: 今天早上, 我們把一個抹在門上.
RM_VPS_T2_08.cn: 今天早上, 我们把一个抹在门上.

RM_VPS_T2_10.en: Now Pharaoh has been asked nine times.
RM_VPS_T2_10.ch: 如今, 法老已經被求過九次.
RM_VPS_T2_10.cn: 如今, 法老已经被求过九次.

RM_VPS_T2_13.en: Scripture says he hardened his own heart.
RM_VPS_T2_13.ch: 聖經說, 是他自己硬著心.
RM_VPS_T2_13.cn: 圣经说, 是他自己硬着心.

RM_VPS_T2_14.en: Scripture says the Lord hardened it.
RM_VPS_T2_14.ch: 聖經也說, 是主使他的心剛硬.
RM_VPS_T2_14.cn: 圣经也说, 是主使他的心刚硬.

RM_VPS_T2_15.en: Don't you go smoothing that over.
RM_VPS_T2_15.ch: 你們可別把這事給抹平了.
RM_VPS_T2_15.cn: 你们可别把这事给抹平了.

RM_VPS_T2_16.en: A man can want a thing long enough
RM_VPS_T2_16.ch: 一個人可以想要一樣東西, 想得夠久,
RM_VPS_T2_16.cn: 一个人可以想要一样东西, 想得够久,

RM_VPS_T2_17.en: that God stops taking it away from him.
RM_VPS_T2_17.ch: 久到神不再從他手裡拿走.
RM_VPS_T2_17.cn: 久到神不再从他手里拿走.

RM_VPS_T2_18.en: That is the Lord honoring it, not breaking it.
RM_VPS_T2_18.ch: 那是主看重那意願, 不是折斷它.
RM_VPS_T2_18.cn: 那是主看重那意愿, 不是折断它.

RM_VPS_T2_22.en: Not one firstborn has died yet,

RM_VPS_T2_23.en: and God has already changed what year it is.
RM_VPS_T2_23.ch: 神就已經改了這是哪一年.
RM_VPS_T2_23.cn: 神就已经改了这是哪一年.

RM_VPS_T2_24.en: He dates it from the[col=217,31,31] blood[/], not the leaving.
RM_VPS_T2_24.ch: 祂從那[col=217,31,31]血[/]算起, 不從離開埃及算起.
RM_VPS_T2_24.cn: 他从那[col=217,31,31]血[/]算起, 不从离开埃及算起.

RM_VPS_T2_25.en: Verse seven. Take a lamb. Take the[col=217,31,31] blood[/].
RM_VPS_T2_25.ch: 第七節. 取一隻羊羔. 取那[col=217,31,31]血[/].
RM_VPS_T2_25.cn: 第七节. 取一只羊羔. 取那[col=217,31,31]血[/].

RM_VPS_T2_26.en: "And strike it on the two side posts

RM_VPS_T2_27.en: and on the upper door post of the houses."

RM_VPS_T2_29.en: The Lord Himself passes through Egypt tonight.
RM_VPS_T2_29.ch: 今夜, 主親自要走過埃及.
RM_VPS_T2_29.cn: 今夜, 主亲自要走过埃及.

RM_VPS_T2_33.en: A token. A mark on the door.
RM_VPS_T2_33.ch: 一個記號. 門上的一道銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_33.cn: 一个记号. 门上的一道铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_34.en: That[col=217,31,31] blood[/] did not stop the destroyer
RM_VPS_T2_34.ch: 那[col=217,31,31]血[/]攔住滅命的, 並不是因為
RM_VPS_T2_34.cn: 那[col=217,31,31]血[/]拦住灭命的, 并不是因为

RM_VPS_T2_36.en: There is no strength in[col=217,31,31] blood[/] on a doorframe.
RM_VPS_T2_36.ch: 門框上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]裡沒有一點力量.
RM_VPS_T2_36.cn: 门框上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]里没有一点力量.

RM_VPS_T2_37.en: A child could wash it off.
RM_VPS_T2_37.ch: 一個孩子就能把它洗掉.
RM_VPS_T2_37.cn: 一个孩子就能把它洗掉.

RM_VPS_T2_38.en: It stopped him because it said
RM_VPS_T2_38.ch: 它攔住了他, 是因為它說明了
RM_VPS_T2_38.cn: 它拦住了他, 是因为它说明了

RM_VPS_T2_40.en: It said: this one is spoken for.
RM_VPS_T2_40.ch: 它說: 這一家已經有主了.
RM_VPS_T2_40.cn: 它说: 这一家已经有主了.

RM_VPS_T2_41.en: Verse twenty-three calls him the destroyer.
RM_VPS_T2_41.ch: 第二十三節稱他為滅命的.
RM_VPS_T2_41.cn: 第二十三节称他为灭命的.

RM_VPS_T2_42.en: Not an accident. Something sent, with work to do.
RM_VPS_T2_42.ch: 不是意外. 是被差來的, 帶著要辦的事.
RM_VPS_T2_42.cn: 不是意外. 是被差来的, 带着要办的事.

RM_VPS_T2_43.en: That was[col=191,102,255] destruction[/] with an order on it.

RM_VPS_T2_44.en: Every house in Egypt got what was coming.
RM_VPS_T2_44.ch: 埃及每一戶都得了該得的.
RM_VPS_T2_44.cn: 埃及每一户都得了该得的.

RM_VPS_T2_45.en: The marked houses got what was coming
RM_VPS_T2_45.ch: 帶著銘印的那些房子, 該來的
RM_VPS_T2_45.cn: 带着铭印的那些房子, 该来的

RM_VPS_T2_47.en: Now the knife that took that lamb was sharp.
RM_VPS_T2_47.ch: 取了那羊羔性命的刀, 是鋒利的.
RM_VPS_T2_47.cn: 取了那羊羔性命的刀, 是锋利的.

RM_VPS_T2_48.en: Somebody knew how to do it quick,

RM_VPS_T2_49.en: because a dull blade makes a thing suffer,
RM_VPS_T2_49.ch: 因為鈍刃會讓一條性命受苦,
RM_VPS_T2_49.cn: 因为钝刃会让一条性命受苦,

RM_VPS_T2_50.en: and they were not permitted to make it suffer.
RM_VPS_T2_50.ch: 而他們不被允許讓牠受苦.
RM_VPS_T2_50.cn: 而他们不被允许让它受苦.

RM_VPS_T2_51.en: And that lamb had done nothing.
RM_VPS_T2_51.ch: 而那羊羔什麼也沒做過.
RM_VPS_T2_51.cn: 而那羊羔什么也没做过.

RM_VPS_T2_52.en: What was done to it was an[col=191,102,255] execution[/].
RM_VPS_T2_52.ch: 對牠所做的, 是一場[col=191,102,255]處決[/].
RM_VPS_T2_52.cn: 对它所做的, 是一场[col=191,102,255]处决[/].

RM_VPS_T2_53.en: It is not a sacrifice if nothing dies.
RM_VPS_T2_53.ch: 若沒有東西死去, 那就不是獻祭.
RM_VPS_T2_53.cn: 若没有东西死去, 那就不是献祭.

RM_VPS_T2_54.en: There was a cost. There is always a cost.
RM_VPS_T2_54.ch: 這是有代價的. 從來都有代價.
RM_VPS_T2_54.cn: 这是有代价的. 从来都有代价.

RM_VPS_T2_55.en: Somebody's hands were not clean that night.
RM_VPS_T2_55.ch: 那一夜, 有人的手是不乾淨的.
RM_VPS_T2_55.cn: 那一夜, 有人的手是不干净的.

RM_VPS_T2_56.ch: 希伯來書第九章第二十二節.
RM_VPS_T2_56.cn: 希伯来书第九章第二十二节.

RM_VPS_T2_60.en: There is no other door. There never was.
RM_VPS_T2_60.ch: 沒有別的門. 從來沒有.
RM_VPS_T2_60.cn: 没有别的门. 从来没有.

RM_VPS_T2_61.en: You do not get bound to a thing for free.
RM_VPS_T2_61.ch: 你不可能白白就與一樣東西結下羈絆.
RM_VPS_T2_61.cn: 你不可能白白就与一样东西结下羁绊.

RM_VPS_T2_62.en: And while we are stood in Hebrews nine -
RM_VPS_T2_62.ch: 既然我們還站在希伯來書第九章 -
RM_VPS_T2_62.cn: 既然我们还站在希伯来书第九章 -

RM_VPS_T2_63.en: verse fourteen. Put a finger in it.
RM_VPS_T2_63.ch: 第十四節. 用手指夾住這一頁.
RM_VPS_T2_63.cn: 第十四节. 用手指夹住这一页.

RM_VPS_T2_65.en: offered himself without spot to God..."
RM_VPS_T2_65.ch: 將自己無瑕無疵獻給神…"
RM_VPS_T2_65.cn: 将自己无瑕无疵献给神…"

RM_VPS_T2_68.en: I am not ready and neither are you.
RM_VPS_T2_68.ch: 我還沒預備好, 你們也沒有.
RM_VPS_T2_68.cn: 我还没预备好, 你们也没有.

RM_VPS_T2_69.en: Leave the finger in. We come back.
RM_VPS_T2_69.ch: 手指別拿開. 我們會回來.
RM_VPS_T2_69.cn: 手指别拿开. 我们会回来.

RM_VPS_T2_70.en: Now some of you are in a[col=217,31,31] covenant[/],
RM_VPS_T2_70.ch: 你們有些人正在一個[col=217,31,31]盟約[/]裡,
RM_VPS_T2_70.cn: 你们有些人正在一个[col=217,31,31]盟约[/]里,

RM_Tikitown_ProximaVHS_Name.en: VHS - Proxima Medical: First Aid Certification
RM_Tikitown_ProximaVHS_Name.ch: VHS: Proxima醫療 - 急救認證
RM_Tikitown_ProximaVHS_Name.cn: VHS: Proxima医疗 - 急救认证

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.en: Welcome to Proxima Medical, and congratulations on joining the team.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.ch: 歡迎加入Proxima醫療, 也恭喜你成為團隊的一員.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.cn: 欢迎来到Proxima医疗, 恭喜你加入这个团队.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.en: This tape covers your First Aid certification. Every associate completes it before working the floor.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.ch: 這卷帶子是你的急救認證課程. 每位員工正式上工前都必須完成這門課程.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.cn: 这盒录像带是你的急救认证课程. 每位员工上岗前都必须完成这门课程.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.en: Keep your handbook open to section four and follow along at your own pace.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.ch: 把手冊翻到第四節放在旁邊, 照自己的步調跟著做.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.cn: 把手册翻到第四节放在旁边, 按自己的节奏跟着做.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.en: Safety comes first here. The techniques on this tape have saved lives, including some of our own.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.ch: 在這裡安全第一. 這卷帶子裡的技術救過人命, 其中也包括我們自己的同事.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.cn: 在这里安全第一. 这盒录像带里的技术救过人命, 其中也包括我们自己的同事.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.en: Retrieve the training dummy at your station. Module one: wound dressing. Wrap firm and even, and follow along.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.ch: 去拿你工作站上的練習假人. 第一單元: 傷口包紮. 纏得紮實均勻, 跟著做.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.cn: 去取你工位上的练习假人. 第一单元: 伤口包扎. 缠得紧实均匀, 跟着做.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.en: Take your time with each drill. Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.ch: 每個演練都慢慢來. 慢就是穩, 穩就是快.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.cn: 每个练习都慢慢来. 慢就是稳, 稳就是快.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.en: When you finish, your supervisor will have a sign-off sheet to confirm your certification.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.ch: 做完之後, 你的主管手上有一張簽核表, 用來確認你的認證.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.cn: 完成之后, 你的主管手上有一张签字确认表, 用来确认你的认证.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.en: Module two: the sterile field. Always disinfect before you dress a wound. A clean wound heals faster.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.ch: 第二單元: 無菌區. 包紮傷口前一定要先消毒. 乾淨的傷口好得更快.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.cn: 第二单元: 无菌区. 包扎伤口前一定要先消毒. 干净的伤口愈合更快.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.en: Excellent, all clean. Proxima was founded on a simple idea: good medicine should reach the people who need it.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.ch: 很好, 都乾淨了. Proxima創立的理念很簡單: 好的醫療應該送到需要的人手上.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.cn: 很好, 都干净了. Proxima创立的理念很简单: 好的医疗应该送到需要的人手里.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.en: Module three: foreign body removal. Use tweezers, keep your hands steady, and clear the site before closing.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.ch: 第三單元: 取出異物. 用鑷子, 手要穩, 縫合前先把傷口清乾淨.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.cn: 第三单元: 取出异物. 用镊子, 手要稳, 缝合前先把伤口清理干净.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.en: If a step doesn't click the first time, rewind and run it again. Repetition is how this becomes second nature.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.ch: 某個步驟第一次沒抓到訣竅, 就倒帶重看一次. 反覆練習才能變成本能.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.cn: 某个步骤第一次没掌握, 就倒带重看一遍. 反复练习才能变成本能.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.en: You're doing well. Most associates find the second half easier once the basics settle in.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.ch: 你表現得很好. 多數員工把基礎練熟之後, 都覺得後半段輕鬆多了.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.cn: 你表现得很好. 多数员工把基础掌握牢之后, 都觉得后半段轻松多了.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.en: Module four: immobilization. A proper splint keeps an injured limb stable until you can get help.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.ch: 第四單元: 固定. 正確的夾板能讓受傷的肢體保持穩定, 撐到你找到援助.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.cn: 第四单元: 固定. 正确的夹板能让受伤的肢体保持稳定, 撑到你找到救援.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.en: Our associates take real pride in looking out for one another. That starts with knowing this material.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.ch: 我們的員工很自豪能彼此照應. 而這要從熟悉這些內容開始.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.cn: 我们的员工很自豪能互相照应. 而这要从熟悉这些内容开始.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.en: Module five: suturing. Even spacing, steady tension, and a clean close. Practice until it feels routine.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.ch: 第五單元: 縫合. 針距均勻, 張力穩定, 收口乾淨. 練到變成習慣動作為止.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.cn: 第五单元: 缝合. 针距均匀, 张力稳定, 收口干净. 练到成为习惯动作为止.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.en: Almost there. One more module, and it's the one that ties everything together.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.ch: 快到了. 還剩一個單元, 而它會把前面全部串起來.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.cn: 快到了. 还剩一个单元, 而它会把前面所有内容串起来.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.en: Keep your skills sharp, this will be an annual re-training requirement for continued employment at Proxima.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.ch: 保持技術純熟, 這門課是在Proxima繼續任職的年度複訓要求.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.cn: 保持技术熟练, 这门课是在Proxima继续任职的年度复训要求.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.en: Module six: full trauma response. Every technique in sequence, performed perfectly now and under pressure. This is what it all builds toward.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.ch: 第六單元: 完整創傷處置. 所有技術依序操作, 現在要做到完美, 壓力下也要做到. 前面所有課程都是為了這一關.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.cn: 第六单元: 完整创伤处理. 所有技术按顺序操作, 现在要做到完美, 有压力时也一样. 前面所有课程都是为了这一关.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.en: That completes the practical portion. Please turn your supervisor signed certification with Human Resources on the second floor.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.ch: 實作部分到此結束. 請把主管簽好的認證繳交到二樓的人力資源部.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.cn: 实操部分到此结束. 请把主管签好的认证交到二楼的人力资源部.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.en: Welcome to Proxima Medical. We're glad to have you. See your supervisor for your floor assignment.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.ch: 歡迎加入Proxima醫療. 很高興有你加入. 去找你的主管確認你的樓層工作分配.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.cn: 欢迎来到Proxima医疗. 很高兴你能加入. 去找你的主管确认你的楼层岗位分配.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000002.ch: 第 01 卷: GX-9 發電機操作
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000002.cn: 第 01 卷: GX-9 发电机操作

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000003.en: The Ark is powered by two GX-9 generators.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000003.ch: 方舟由兩台 GX-9 發電機供電.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000003.cn: 方舟由两台 GX-9 发电机供电.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004.en: One unit serves as the primary generator.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004.ch: 其中一台作為主發電機.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004.cn: 其中一台作为主发电机.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000005.en: The second unit acts as backup power.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000006.en: Generator systems are monitored by the NOAH central computer.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000006.ch: 發電機系統由 NOAH 中央電腦監控.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000006.cn: 发电机系统由 NOAH 中央计算机监控.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000007.en: Fuel levels and operational condition can be checked through NOAH terminals.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000007.ch: 燃料存量與運作狀況可透過 NOAH 終端機檢查.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000007.cn: 燃料存量和运行状况可通过 NOAH 终端检查.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008.en: Fuel is supplied through the external surface inlet system.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008.ch: 燃料經由地面外部注油口系統供應.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008.cn: 燃料通过地面外部加注口系统供应.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000009.en: Refueling operations should be performed carefully.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-00000000000a.en: VHS: PROJECT OASIS, ENGINEERING INSTRUCTION SERIES, TAPE 01: GX-9 GENERATOR OPERATION
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-00000000000a.ch: VHS: 綠洲計畫, 工程教學系列, 第 01 卷: GX-9 發電機操作
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 工程教学系列, 第 01 卷: GX-9 发电机操作

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-00000000000c.ch: 第 01 卷: GX-9 發電機操作
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-00000000000c.cn: 第 01 卷: GX-9 发电机操作

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000011.ch: 疏於保養的系統可能會無預警故障.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000011.cn: 疏于保养的系统可能会意外故障.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000012.ch: 潤滑劑能減少機械磨損.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000012.cn: 润滑剂能减少机械磨损.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000014.ch: 冷卻液能提升散熱效率.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000014.cn: 冷却液能提高散热效率.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015.en: Proper coolant levels reduce fuel consumption.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015.ch: 適當的冷卻液量能降低燃料消耗.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015.cn: 适当的冷却液量能降低燃料消耗.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000016.en: Monitor generators for abnormal noise or smoke.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000016.ch: 留意發電機是否有異常噪音或冒煙.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000016.cn: 留意发电机是否有异常噪音或冒烟.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000017.ch: 受損的發電機會消耗更多燃料.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000017.cn: 受损的发电机会消耗更多燃料.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018.en: Qualified personnel may repair generators using spare parts.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018.ch: 合格人員可使用備用零件修理發電機.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018.cn: 合格人员可使用备用零件修理发电机.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019.en: Technical skill is required for advanced repairs.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019.ch: 進階維修需要技術能力.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019.cn: 高级维修需要技术能力.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020.en: Do not operate heavily damaged systems.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020.ch: 請勿操作嚴重受損的系統.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020.cn: 请勿操作严重受损的系统.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021.en: Loss of generator power may compromise Ark survival.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021.ch: 失去發電機電力可能危及方舟的存續.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021.cn: 失去发电机电力可能危及方舟的存续.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000001.cn: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000002.en: TAPE 03: DEEP WOUNDS AND BULLET REMOVAL
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000002.ch: 第 03 卷: 深層傷口與取出子彈
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000002.cn: 第 03 卷: 深度伤口与取出子弹

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000005.en: If bleeding is severe, apply pressure.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000005.ch: 如果出血嚴重, 請加壓止血.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000005.cn: 如果出血严重, 请加压止血.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000006.ch: 檢查是否有異物卡在傷口內.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000006.cn: 检查是否有异物卡在伤口内.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000007.en: If a bullet is present, remove it carefully.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000007.ch: 如果有子彈, 請小心取出.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000007.cn: 如果有子弹, 请小心取出.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000009.en: Ensure the object is fully extracted.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列, 第 03 卷: 深度伤口与取出子弹

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-00000000000c.en: TAPE 03: DEEP WOUNDS AND BULLET REMOVAL
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-00000000000c.ch: 第 03 卷: 深層傷口與取出子彈
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-00000000000c.cn: 第 03 卷: 深度伤口与取出子弹

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000012.en: Use a suture needle if available.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000012.ch: 如果有縫合針, 請使用縫合針.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000012.cn: 如果有缝合针, 请使用缝合针.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000013.en: In emergencies, use a clean needle and thread.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000013.ch: 緊急情況下, 可使用乾淨的針線.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000013.cn: 紧急情况下, 可使用干净的针线.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000018.ch: 如果有止痛藥, 請服用.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000018.cn: 如果有止痛药, 请服用.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000019.ch: 如果有抗生素, 請服用.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000019.cn: 如果有抗生素, 请服用.

RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000023.ch: 妥善照護才能確保存活.
RM_7fbeacb8-0620-4b8f-9638-000000000023.cn: 妥善护理才能确保存活.

RM_d3950c33-4eec-4477-b032-000000000004.en: Assess the severity of the burn.
RM_d3950c33-4eec-4477-b032-000000000004.ch: 評估燒燙傷的嚴重程度.

RM_d3950c33-4eec-4477-b032-000000000005.en: Cool the affected area with clean water.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000001.en: If you are watching this, it means that events have unfolded exactly as projected.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000001.ch: 如果你正在看這段影片, 就表示事態的發展完全如預測所料.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000001.cn: 如果你正在看这段视频, 就说明事态的发展完全如预测所料.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000002.en: Using decades of data modeling, socio-technological forecasting and collapse pattern analysis,
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000002.ch: 運用數十年的資料建模, 社會科技預測與崩潰模式分析,
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000002.cn: 运用数十年的数据建模, 社会技术预测与崩溃模式分析,

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000003.en: You are now one of the few individuals inducted into Project OASIS.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000003.ch: 你現在是少數獲選加入綠洲計畫的人之一.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000003.cn: 你现在是少数入选绿洲计划的人之一.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000004.en: As part of Project OASIS, you will need to come to terms with your situation underground,
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000004.ch: 作為綠洲計畫的一員, 你需要接受自己身處地底的處境,
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000004.cn: 作为绿洲计划的一员, 你需要接受自己身处地下的处境,

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000005.en: And learn all the crucial systems of the Ark before going above ground.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000005.ch: 並在前往地面之前, 熟悉方舟所有的關鍵系統.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000005.cn: 并在前往地面之前, 熟悉方舟所有的关键系统.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000007.en: The Ark comes with many systems that ensure survivors will be comfortable and safe.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000007.ch: 方舟配備許多系統, 確保倖存者舒適又安全.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000007.cn: 方舟配备许多系统, 确保幸存者舒适又安全.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000008.en: Each Ark is built on top of an oligocene aquifer which provides unlimited water.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000008.ch: 每座方舟都建在漸新世含水層之上, 能提供無限的水.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000008.cn: 每座方舟都建在渐新世含水层之上, 能提供无限的水.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000009.en: And each Ark has two diesel Voltek GX-9 generators that will keep the lights on.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000009.ch: 每座方舟還有兩台 Voltek GX-9 柴油發電機, 讓燈光永不熄滅.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000009.cn: 每座方舟还有两台 Voltek GX-9 柴油发电机, 让灯光永不熄灭.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000010.en: And finally, the Circuair HE-3 ventilation system that will keep the air safe and warm, deep underground.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000010.ch: 最後是 Circuair HE-3 通風系統, 能讓深處地底的空氣保持安全與溫暖.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000010.cn: 最后是 Circuair HE-3 通风系统, 能让深处地下的空气保持安全与温暖.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000011.en: All of these are controlled by a central computer, NOAH that will automate a great deal of your work.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000011.ch: 這些系統全都由中央電腦 NOAH 控制, 它能替你自動處理大量工作.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000011.cn: 这些系统全都由中央计算机 NOAH 控制, 它能替你自动处理大量工作.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000012.en: But these systems require maintenance, and as selected individuals who have been...
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000012.ch: 但這些系統需要維護, 而身為獲選的人, 你們已經…
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000012.cn: 但这些系统需要维护, 而作为被选中的人, 你们已经…

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013.en: Inducted into Project Oasis, your specialized skills will become crucial in the days ahead.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013.ch: 加入了綠洲計畫, 你的專業技能在未來的日子裡將至關重要.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013.cn: 加入了绿洲计划, 你的专业技能在未来的日子里将至关重要.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014.en: Generators require lubrication and coolant, and may need repairs.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014.ch: 發電機需要潤滑劑與冷卻液, 也可能需要維修.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014.cn: 发电机需要润滑剂和冷却液, 也可能需要维修.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015.en: The water pump will require charcoal to filter the water to ensure potability.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015.ch: 抽水機需要木炭來過濾水源, 確保水可以飲用.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015.cn: 水泵需要木炭来过滤水源, 确保水可以饮用.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016.en: And the decontamination system required NBC tablets to ensure maximum safety.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016.ch: 而除汙系統需要核生化錠劑, 以確保最高安全.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016.cn: 而洗消系统需要核生化药片, 以确保最高安全.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017.en: But first, take your first steps to read through the pamphlets the Department have left behind.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017.ch: 但首先, 請先踏出第一步, 仔細閱讀部門留下的小冊子.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017.cn: 但首先, 请先迈出第一步, 仔细阅读部门留下的小册子.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018.en: These will outline in greater detail what you will need to do, and the steps...
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018.ch: 這些冊子會更詳細地說明你需要做的事, 以及…
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018.cn: 这些册子会更详细地说明你需要做的事, 以及…

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019.en: You will need to take in the dark times ahead of you.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019.ch: 在前方的黑暗時期裡你必須採取的步驟.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019.cn: 在前方的黑暗时期里你必须采取的步骤.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020.en: When in doubt, check NOAH for the latest situation within and without.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020.ch: 有疑問時, 請檢視 NOAH, 了解內外的最新狀況.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020.cn: 有疑问时, 请查看 NOAH, 了解内外的最新状况.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001.en: TAPE 01: NUCLEAR EXPOSURE SURVIVAL - FEAT. DEAN PORCH
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001.ch: 錄影帶 01: 核輻射暴露求生 - 主講: 迪恩·波奇
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001.cn: 录像带 01: 核辐射暴露求生 - 主讲: 迪恩·波奇

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003.en: I'm Dean, and this tape is being recorded for the US Government.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003.ch: 我是迪恩, 這卷錄影帶是為美國政府錄製的.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003.cn: 我是迪恩, 这盘录像带是为美国政府录制的.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004.en: Now, I'm sure you've all been out in winter time, but let me tell you,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004.ch: 我相信各位都在冬天出過門, 不過讓我告訴你們,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004.cn: 我相信各位都在冬天出过门, 不过让我告诉你们,

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005.en: Nuclear winter is so, so much worse.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005.ch: 核子冬天可是糟糕得太多、太多了.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005.cn: 核冬天可是糟糕得太多、太多了.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006.en: Now it's not all doomsday, you can survive out there.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006.ch: 不過也不全是世界末日, 你在外面還是活得下去的.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006.cn: 不过也不全是世界末日, 你在外面还是活得下去的.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000007.en: But you're going to need to be prepared.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008.en: First off, the most important thing is your NBC suit.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008.ch: 首先, 最重要的是你的 NBC 防護服.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008.cn: 首先, 最重要的是你的 NBC 防护服.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009.en: This is the Type C suit. It's a thick rubberized suit, lined with charcoal,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009.ch: 這是 C 型防護服. 它是一件厚實的橡膠防護服, 內襯活性碳,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009.cn: 这是 C 型防护服. 它是一件厚实的橡胶防护服, 内衬活性炭,

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-00000000000a.ch: VHS: 綠洲計畫, 暴露求生
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 暴露求生

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010.en: Combined with your gas mask will keep you safe and the bad stuff out.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010.ch: 搭配你的防毒面具, 就能保護你的安全, 把有害物質擋在外面.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010.cn: 配合你的防毒面具, 就能保护你的安全, 把有害物质挡在外面.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011.en: Before you get ready to go out into the winter wonderland, make sure you check your suit.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011.ch: 在你準備踏進冬季仙境之前, 務必檢查你的防護服.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011.cn: 在你准备踏进冬季仙境之前, 务必检查你的防护服.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012.en: And make sure you check your filters too! You won't have time to swap them.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012.ch: 也務必檢查你的濾罐! 到時候你可沒時間更換.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012.cn: 也务必检查你的滤罐! 到时候你可没时间更换.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013.en: If you think you've come in contact with radiation, pop those potassium iodine pills.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013.ch: 如果你覺得自己接觸到了輻射, 趕快吞下那些碘化鉀藥片.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013.cn: 如果你觉得自己接触到了辐射, 赶紧吞下那些碘化钾药片.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014.en: Another thing is going to be the cold, you'll want to stay warm. So layer up!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014.ch: 另一件事是寒冷, 你得保持溫暖. 所以多穿幾層!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014.cn: 另一件事是寒冷, 你得保暖. 所以多穿几层!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015.en: Long john's, long sleeve shirts, button up shirts, every layer counts!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015.ch: 長袖衛生衣褲、長袖上衣、排扣襯衫, 每一層都很重要!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015.cn: 秋衣秋裤、长袖上衣、纽扣衬衫, 每一层都很重要!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016.en: If they give you Nikethamide, that'll help stave of the worst effects of hypothermia.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016.ch: 如果他們發給你尼可剎米, 那能幫你抵擋失溫最嚴重的影響.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016.cn: 如果他们发给你尼可刹米, 那能帮你抵挡失温最严重的影响.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017.en: And finally, make sure you thoroughly decontaminate afterwards.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017.ch: 最後, 事後一定要徹底除汙.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017.cn: 最后, 事后一定要彻底洗消.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018.en: These decon tablets smell like strawberry, but don't drink or eat it!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018.ch: 這些除汙錠聞起來像草莓, 但千萬別喝也別吃!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018.cn: 这些洗消片闻起来像草莓, 但千万别喝也别吃!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019.en: It'll make you sick or worse!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019.ch: 那會讓你生病, 甚至更糟!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019.cn: 那会让你生病, 甚至更糟!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020.en: Remember, we're all in it together out there.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020.ch: 記住, 在外面我們都是同舟共濟.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020.cn: 记住, 在外面我们都是同舟共济.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021.en: Keep your head on straight, and you'll come back alive.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021.ch: 保持頭腦清醒, 你就能活著回來.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021.cn: 保持头脑清醒, 你就能活着回来.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001.en: State your name and the facility from which you escaped.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001.ch: 說出你的姓名, 以及你逃出的機構.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001.cn: 说出你的姓名, 以及你逃出的机构.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002.en: Man, name don’t even matter. Y’all already know where I was — Kentucky State, out near Rosewood.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002.ch: 老兄, 名字根本不重要. 你們早就知道我待在哪了——肯塔基州立監獄, 就在羅斯伍德那邊.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002.cn: 老兄, 名字根本不重要. 你们早就知道我待在哪了——肯塔基州立监狱, 就在罗斯伍德那边.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003.en: Life sentence. Caught a murder charge — first degree. No appeal, no parole, no damn hope.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003.ch: 無期徒刑. 背了一條謀殺罪——一級謀殺. 不能上訴, 不能假釋, 一點他媽的希望都沒有.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003.cn: 无期徒刑. 背了一条谋杀罪——一级谋杀. 不能上诉, 不能假释, 一点他妈的希望都没有.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004.en: Then Day Six came, and everything flipped.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004.ch: 然後第六天來了, 一切都翻轉了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004.cn: 然后第六天来了, 一切都翻转了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005.en: Describe the condition of the prison prior to the incident.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005.ch: 描述事件發生前監獄的狀況.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005.cn: 描述事件发生前监狱的状况.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006.en: You ever sit in a box so long, the walls start talkin’ to you? That shit’ll eat you alive slow.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006.ch: 你有沒有在一個箱子裡關到牆壁開始跟你講話? 那鬼玩意會慢慢把你活活吞掉.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006.cn: 你有没有在一个箱子里关到墙壁开始跟你说话? 那鬼玩意会慢慢把你活活吞掉.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007.en: Then outta nowhere — boom — it felt like Christmas came early.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007.ch: 結果突然間——砰——感覺就像聖誕節提早到了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007.cn: 结果突然间——砰——感觉就像圣诞节提前到了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008.en: We started noticing somethin’ off ‘round Day Four.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008.ch: 我們大概第四天就開始發現不對勁了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008.cn: 我们大概第四天就开始发现不对劲了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009.en: Folks coughin’, not regular sick — nah, this was deep. Wet. Like they lungs was tryna crawl out they chest.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009.ch: 大家都在咳, 不是一般的生病——不, 這咳得很深. 有痰. 好像肺要從胸口爬出來一樣.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009.cn: 大家都在咳, 不是一般的生病——不, 这咳得很深. 有痰. 好像肺要从胸口爬出来一样.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010.en: But who gives a fuck when inmates get sick, right?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010.ch: 可是囚犯生病了, 誰他媽在乎啊, 對吧?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010.cn: 可是囚犯生病了, 谁他妈在乎啊, 对吧?

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011.en: Then Day Five hit. Shit got wild.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011.ch: 然後第五天到了. 事情整個失控.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011.cn: 然后第五天到了. 事情彻底失控.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012.en: Some dude in C Block lost his damn mind — beat his cellie to death barehanded.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012.ch: C 區有個傢伙突然他媽的發瘋——赤手空拳把他的室友活活打死.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012.cn: C 区有个家伙突然他妈的发疯——赤手空拳把他的狱友活活打死.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013.en: Face looked like it went through a blender.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013.ch: 那張臉看起來像被丟進果汁機攪過.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013.cn: 那张脸看起来像被扔进搅拌机搅过.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014.en: At first, we thought it was just stress. Maybe some bad shit the guards were sneakin’ in.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014.ch: 一開始, 我們以為只是壓力太大. 也許是獄警偷偷帶進來的什麼爛貨.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014.cn: 一开始, 我们以为只是压力太大. 也许是狱警偷偷带进来的什么烂货.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015.en: But then it happened again. Another body. Same mess.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015.ch: 但後來又發生了. 又一具屍體. 一樣的慘狀.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015.cn: 但后来又发生了. 又一具尸体. 一样的惨状.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016.en: We ain’t stupid. We could feel it in the air.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016.ch: 我們又不笨. 我們感覺得到空氣中的不對勁.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016.cn: 我们又不傻. 我们感觉得到空气中的不对劲.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017.en: Guards stopped runnin’ their mouths. Got quiet. Real tight.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017.ch: 獄警不再耍嘴皮子. 變得很安靜. 繃得很緊.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017.cn: 狱警不再耍嘴皮子. 变得很安静. 绷得很紧.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018.en: No more transfers. No more movement. Doors stayed shut.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018.ch: 不再轉監. 不再移動. 門一直關著.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018.cn: 不再转监. 不再走动. 门一直关着.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019.en: Continue with the events of Day Six.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019.ch: 繼續講述第六天發生的事.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019.cn: 继续讲述第六天发生的事.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020.en: Middle of the night — maybe 3 a.m. — I wake up to this bangin’.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020.ch: 半夜——大概凌晨 3 點——我被一陣撞擊聲吵醒.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020.cn: 半夜——大概凌晨 3 点——我被一阵撞击声吵醒.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021.en: Not no regular knockin’. I mean full-body slammin’. Over and over.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021.ch: 不是普通的敲門聲. 我是說整個身體在撞. 一次又一次.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021.cn: 不是普通的敲门声. 我是说整个身子在撞. 一次又一次.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022.en: Metal screamin’, skin smackin’, bones crackin’.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022.ch: 金屬在尖叫, 皮肉在拍打, 骨頭在碎裂.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022.cn: 金属在尖叫, 皮肉在拍打, 骨头在碎裂.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023.en: Cats was hittin’ they cell doors with everything they had — heads, shoulders, fists.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023.ch: 那些傢伙用他們所有的部位去撞牢門——頭、肩膀、拳頭.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023.cn: 那些家伙用他们所有的部位去撞牢门——头、肩膀、拳头.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024.en: Blood all over. Fingers broke. Bones pokin’ through.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024.ch: 到處都是血. 手指斷了. 骨頭都戳出來了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024.cn: 到处都是血. 手指断了. 骨头都戳出来了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025.en: But they ain’t stop. Didn’t even feel it.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025.ch: 但他們沒停下來. 根本感覺不到痛.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025.cn: 但他们没停下来. 根本感觉不到痛.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026.en: They wasn’t mad. They was just... gone. Empty.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026.ch: 他們不是在發怒. 他們只是… 失去神智了. 空了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026.cn: 他们不是在发怒. 他们只是… 没了. 空了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027.en: Then we hear the alarms. Riot squad rushin’ in — black armor, masks, lookin’ like stormtroopers.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027.ch: 接著我們聽到警報. 鎮暴隊衝進來——黑色護甲、面罩, 看起來像帝國風暴兵.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027.cn: 接着我们听到警报. 防暴队冲进来——黑色护甲、面罩, 看起来像帝国冲锋队.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028.en: One of ‘em shoutin’ somethin’ ‘bout a 'containment breach.'
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028.ch: 其中一個在吼什麼「收容失效」.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028.cn: 其中一个在吼什么“收容失效”.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029.en: But man... that shit was already done. It was over.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029.ch: 但老兄… 那事早就完了. 已經結束了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029.cn: 但老兄… 那事早就完了. 已经结束了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030.en: Did the riot police open the cells?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030.ch: 鎮暴警察有打開牢房嗎?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030.cn: 防暴警察有打开牢房吗?

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031.en: Not on purpose. But when folks started screamin’, one of them officers dropped his belt — keys, baton, radio — whole kit.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031.ch: 不是故意的. 但大家開始尖叫的時候, 其中一個警官的腰帶掉了——鑰匙、警棍、無線電——整套裝備.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031.cn: 不是故意的. 但大家开始尖叫的时候, 其中一个警官的腰带掉了——钥匙、警棍、对讲机——整套装备.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032.en: Poor bastard. Think somethin’ ripped his throat out.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032.ch: 可憐的混蛋. 好像有什麼東西把他的喉嚨扯了出來.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032.cn: 可怜的混蛋. 好像有什么东西把他的喉咙扯了出来.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033.en: Blood sprayed the wall like a damn art piece.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033.ch: 血噴得滿牆都是, 像他媽的一件藝術品.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033.cn: 血喷得满墙都是, 像他妈的一件艺术品.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034.en: I grabbed the keys. My cellmates ran one way — I dipped the other.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034.ch: 我抓了鑰匙. 我的室友往一邊跑——我往另一邊溜.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034.cn: 我抓了钥匙. 我的狱友往一边跑——我往另一边溜.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035.en: I knew that prison better than I know my own damn face.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035.ch: 我對那座監獄比對我自己這張臉還熟.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035.cn: 我对那座监狱比对我自己这张脸还熟.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037.en: Hell yeah. This wasn’t no group project. I saw an opening, I took it.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037.ch: 當然啊. 這又不是什麼分組作業. 我看到機會, 就抓住了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037.cn: 当然啊. 这又不是什么小组作业. 我看到机会, 就抓住了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039.en: I ran past at least a hundred fools — fightin’, screamin’, bitin’ each other like animals.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039.ch: 我跑過至少一百個蠢蛋——在打架、在尖叫、像動物一樣互咬.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039.cn: 我跑过至少一百个蠢货——在打架、在尖叫、像动物一样互咬.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040.en: Couldn’t tell who was infected, who was just pissed off. Didn’t matter.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040.ch: 分不出誰被感染了, 誰只是氣瘋了. 也無所謂.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040.cn: 分不出谁被感染了, 谁只是气疯了. 也无所谓.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041.en: I seen one dude chewin’ on a CO’s face like it was fried chicken.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041.ch: 我看到一個傢伙在啃一個獄警的臉, 好像在吃炸雞.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041.cn: 我看到一个家伙在啃一个狱警的脸, 好像在吃炸鸡.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042.en: Another had his brother pinned up, tryin’ to choke him out.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042.ch: 另一個把他兄弟壓在牆上, 想把他掐昏.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042.cn: 另一个把他兄弟按在墙上, 想把他掐晕.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043.en: Prison teach you one thing — don’t look too hard at anything. That came in real handy.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043.ch: 監獄教會你一件事——什麼都別看太仔細. 這招那時可真派上用場.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043.cn: 监狱教会你一件事——什么都别看太仔细. 这招那时可真派上用场.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044.en: Gunshots everywhere. At first it was quick bursts. Then longer. Then… silence.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044.ch: 到處都是槍聲. 一開始是短點放. 然後變長. 然後… 一片死寂.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044.cn: 到处都是枪声. 一开始是短点射. 然后变长. 然后… 一片死寂.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045.en: I slipped through the service tunnel by the dock. Found a back room, climbed up through the roof hatch.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045.ch: 我從碼頭旁的維修通道溜了出去. 找到一間後面的房間, 從屋頂的艙口爬了上去.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045.cn: 我从码头旁的检修通道溜了出去. 找到一间后面的房间, 从屋顶的舱口爬了上去.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046.en: After that, it was just fences and timing.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046.ch: 之後, 就只剩圍籬跟時機了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046.cn: 之后, 就只剩围栏和时机了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048.en: Yeah. Found some house, on the edge of town. Quiet. Empty.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048.ch: 對. 在鎮的邊上找到一間房子. 很安靜. 沒人.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048.cn: 对. 在镇子边上找到一间房子. 很安静. 没人.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049.en: Snatched some clothes out the dryer, cleaned up, crashed on the couch.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049.ch: 從烘衣機裡抓了幾件衣服, 清理了一下, 就倒在沙發上睡了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049.cn: 从烘干机里抓了几件衣服, 收拾了一下, 就倒在沙发上睡了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050.en: That was the best sleep I had in years. Even with the planes flyin’ low like the world was about to end for real.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050.ch: 那是我這幾年睡得最好的一覺. 就算飛機飛得很低, 好像世界真的要完蛋了也一樣.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050.cn: 那是我这几年睡得最好的一觉. 就算飞机飞得很低, 好像世界真的要完蛋了也一样.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052.en: Fortunate? I was buried alive in that place. Waitin’ to die slow and quiet.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052.ch: 幸運? 我在那地方等於被活埋了. 等著慢慢地、安靜地死掉.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052.cn: 幸运? 我在那地方等于被活埋了. 等着慢慢地、安静地死掉.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053.en: Then the world goes to shit — and somehow, that’s what saved me?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053.ch: 然後世界整個爛掉了——結果不知怎麼的, 那竟然救了我?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053.cn: 然后世界整个烂掉了——结果不知怎么的, 那居然救了我?

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054.en: Call it luck. Call it God. Call it whatever. Prison’s gone. Guards dead. Doors wide open.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054.ch: 說是運氣也好. 說是上帝也好. 隨便你怎麼說. 監獄沒了. 獄警死了. 大門敞開.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054.cn: 说是运气也好. 说是上帝也好. 随便你怎么说. 监狱没了. 狱警死了. 大门敞开.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055.en: And for the first time in forever… I got a say in where I go next.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055.ch: 而且這麼久以來第一次… 我能決定自己接下來要去哪.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055.cn: 而且这么久以来第一次… 我能决定自己接下来要去哪.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057.en: Hold up… what you mean by that? You said y’all was lettin’ me go!
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057.ch: 等等… 你這話什麼意思? 你們說過會放我走的!
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057.cn: 等等… 你这话什么意思? 你们说过会放我走的!

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000001.ch: 綠洲計畫, 醫療教學系列
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000001.cn: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000002.ch: 第 04 卷: 骨折治療
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000002.cn: 第 04 卷: 骨折治疗

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000006.ch: 不要施加不必要的力量.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000006.cn: 不要施加不必要的力量.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000009.en: Head and torso fractures cannot be splinted.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000009.ch: 頭部和軀幹骨折無法上夾板.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000009.cn: 头部和躯干骨折无法上夹板.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000a.en: VHS: PROJECT OASIS, MEDICAL INSTRUCTION SERIES, TAPE 04: FRACTURE TREATMENT
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000a.ch: VHS: 綠洲計畫, 醫療教學系列, 第 04 卷: 骨折治療
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列, 第 04 卷: 骨折治疗

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000c.ch: 第 04 卷: 骨折治療
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000c.cn: 第 04 卷: 骨折治疗

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000015.ch: 骨折需要很長的癒合時間.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000015.cn: 骨折需要很长的愈合时间.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000018.ch: 如果有止痛藥, 請服用.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000018.cn: 如果有止痛药, 请服用.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000021.ch: 可以的話, 尋求協助.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000021.cn: 可以的话, 寻求帮助.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000023.ch: 妥善照護才能確保存活.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000023.cn: 妥善护理才能确保存活.

RM_04d026ab-634c-51ae-b0e0-68175887f2d6.ch: 我是雷·鄧巴, 今天就到這裡.
RM_04d026ab-634c-51ae-b0e0-68175887f2d6.cn: 我是雷·邓巴, 今天就到这里.

RM_0b36334f-37d0-52d9-abb4-fde08b45c591.en: Thanks for watching. Now go shoot.
RM_0b36334f-37d0-52d9-abb4-fde08b45c591.ch: 感謝收看. 現在就去射幾箭吧.
RM_0b36334f-37d0-52d9-abb4-fde08b45c591.cn: 感谢收看. 现在就去射几箭吧.

RM_128baba8-01c8-5311-8750-e3c4dd948cd6.en: Always string it with your legs, not your arms. You'll thank me when your back doesn't go out.
RM_128baba8-01c8-5311-8750-e3c4dd948cd6.ch: 上弦一定要用腿出力, 別用手臂. 等你的腰沒閃到, 你就會感謝我了.
RM_128baba8-01c8-5311-8750-e3c4dd948cd6.cn: 上弦一定要靠腿发力, 别用胳膊. 哪天你的腰没闪到, 你就会感谢我了.

RM_17a5d2c7-165f-5247-bd79-01165f8600cf.en: I'm Ray Dunbar. Shoot straight, and I'll see you next time.
RM_17a5d2c7-165f-5247-bd79-01165f8600cf.ch: 我是雷·鄧巴. 射得準一點, 我們下次見.
RM_17a5d2c7-165f-5247-bd79-01165f8600cf.cn: 我是雷·邓巴. 射得准一点, 咱们下次见.

RM_19839b9f-e800-5842-acad-2f7b1534e0a3.en: Fifty arrows a day, every day, and you'll be surprised how fast it comes.
RM_19839b9f-e800-5842-acad-2f7b1534e0a3.ch: 每天五十支箭, 天天不間斷, 你會驚訝自己進步得有多快.
RM_19839b9f-e800-5842-acad-2f7b1534e0a3.cn: 每天射五十支箭, 天天坚持, 你会惊讶自己进步得有多快.

RM_1d0037f8-562f-5470-9696-199c8210b0fa.en: Don't yank the string loose. Just relax your fingers and let the bow do the work.
RM_1d0037f8-562f-5470-9696-199c8210b0fa.ch: 別猛扯弓弦放箭. 只要放鬆手指, 讓弓自己出力就好.
RM_1d0037f8-562f-5470-9696-199c8210b0fa.cn: 别猛地扯开弓弦. 只要放松手指, 让弓自己发力就行.

RM_1d8ac2dd-5c90-5ca1-8cdd-ee4166a23347.en: Every good shot is the same shot. Same stance, same draw, same anchor, same release.
RM_1d8ac2dd-5c90-5ca1-8cdd-ee4166a23347.ch: 好的每一箭, 都是同樣的一箭. 同樣的站姿, 同樣的拉弓, 同樣的靠位, 同樣的放箭.
RM_1d8ac2dd-5c90-5ca1-8cdd-ee4166a23347.cn: 每一记好箭, 都是同样的一箭. 一样的站姿, 一样的拉弓, 一样的靠位, 一样的放箭.

RM_2aa4042c-2c32-5c89-8855-1251eab6a5fb.en: Behind the shoulder, not the head. The big target is the sure target.
RM_2aa4042c-2c32-5c89-8855-1251eab6a5fb.ch: 瞄肩膀後方, 不是瞄頭. 越大的目標越有把握.
RM_2aa4042c-2c32-5c89-8855-1251eab6a5fb.cn: 瞄肩膀后面, 别瞄头. 目标越大越有把握.

RM_2e23d41a-ed5c-5dd2-bedb-20e388002493.en: Kentucky bowhunter Ray Dunbar walks you through your first season with a bow: picking one, stringing it, and making that first clean shot.
RM_2e23d41a-ed5c-5dd2-bedb-20e388002493.ch: 肯塔基弓獵手雷·鄧巴帶你度過用弓的第一個獵季: 挑一把弓、為它上弦, 再射出乾淨俐落的第一箭.
RM_2e23d41a-ed5c-5dd2-bedb-20e388002493.cn: 肯塔基弓猎手雷·邓巴带你度过用弓的第一个狩猎季: 挑一把弓、给它上弦, 再射出干净利落的第一箭.

RM_303febd3-f89c-5c57-8929-8125c0fecc71.en: Three fingers on the string: one above the arrow, two below. That's your Mediterranean draw.
RM_303febd3-f89c-5c57-8929-8125c0fecc71.ch: 三根手指扣弦: 一根在箭上方, 兩根在下方. 這就是地中海式拉弓.
RM_303febd3-f89c-5c57-8929-8125c0fecc71.cn: 三根手指勾弦: 一根在箭上面, 两根在下面. 这就是地中海式拉弓.

RM_31a4e33d-e774-58e7-91c5-db5783b200e7.en: Ray Dunbar returns for the advanced course: shooting at range, moving targets, broadheads, and making every arrow count.
RM_31a4e33d-e774-58e7-91c5-db5783b200e7.ch: 雷·鄧巴回來開進階課程了: 遠距離射擊、移動目標、寬刃箭頭, 以及如何讓每一箭都不白費.
RM_31a4e33d-e774-58e7-91c5-db5783b200e7.cn: 雷·邓巴回归, 带来进阶课程: 远距离射击、移动目标、宽刃箭头, 以及怎样让每一箭都不白费.

RM_3af55764-e6d1-5d45-9b98-b80ab1249bb2.en: Go find your arrows after. Good arrows are worth walking for.
RM_3af55764-e6d1-5d45-9b98-b80ab1249bb2.ch: 射完記得去把箭找回來. 好箭值得你多走幾步.
RM_3af55764-e6d1-5d45-9b98-b80ab1249bb2.cn: 射完记得去把箭捡回来. 好箭值得你多走几步.

RM_3e708c44-4b99-5e40-8e1c-c87561ae4f12.en: Howdy, folks. Ray Dunbar here, and today we're going bowhunting.
RM_3e708c44-4b99-5e40-8e1c-c87561ae4f12.ch: 各位, 大家好. 我是雷·鄧巴, 今天我們要去弓獵啦.
RM_3e708c44-4b99-5e40-8e1c-c87561ae4f12.cn: 各位, 大家好. 我是雷·邓巴, 今天咱们去弓猎.

RM_4f4178ad-6338-5819-985e-f30ec44cc5da.en: VHS: Traditional Archery: Form and Release
RM_4f4178ad-6338-5819-985e-f30ec44cc5da.ch: VHS: 傳統射箭: 姿勢與放箭
RM_4f4178ad-6338-5819-985e-f30ec44cc5da.cn: VHS: 传统射箭: 姿势与放箭

RM_5d06a0dd-80dd-56b0-b46c-aabb23019bb1.en: Missed? Don't move. Nock another one, nice and slow. A quiet miss is a second chance.
RM_5d06a0dd-80dd-56b0-b46c-aabb23019bb1.ch: 射偏了? 別動. 再搭一支箭, 慢慢來. 安靜的失手就是第二次機會.
RM_5d06a0dd-80dd-56b0-b46c-aabb23019bb1.cn: 没射中? 别动. 再搭一支箭, 慢慢来. 悄无声息的失手就是第二次机会.

RM_5de18836-5184-50e8-a61f-dbff975e7f9e.en: Stand sideways to the target. Feet about shoulder width. Like you're waiting for a bus.
RM_5de18836-5184-50e8-a61f-dbff975e7f9e.ch: 側身對著目標站. 雙腳大約與肩同寬. 就像你在等公車一樣.
RM_5de18836-5184-50e8-a61f-dbff975e7f9e.cn: 侧身对着目标站. 双脚大约与肩同宽. 就像在等公交车一样.

RM_72fc59da-71f5-5d4e-be83-c57ee154d7c7.ch: 傳統射箭: 姿勢與放箭
RM_72fc59da-71f5-5d4e-be83-c57ee154d7c7.cn: 传统射箭: 姿势与放箭

RM_79f4faeb-eda7-5ae2-824d-2936b370ab5d.en: Watch the bow arm here in slow motion. Locked, but not stiff. The elbow rolls out of the string's way.
RM_79f4faeb-eda7-5ae2-824d-2936b370ab5d.ch: 看這段慢動作裡的持弓手臂. 伸直, 但不僵硬. 手肘向外轉開, 讓出弓弦的路徑.
RM_79f4faeb-eda7-5ae2-824d-2936b370ab5d.cn: 看这段慢动作里的持弓手臂. 伸直, 但不僵硬. 手肘向外转开, 给弓弦让路.

RM_863fd89e-30b9-58a4-9770-fbf57eda7be9.en: Ray Dunbar again. If you've watched the first tape, you're ready for the hard part.
RM_863fd89e-30b9-58a4-9770-fbf57eda7be9.ch: 又是我, 雷·鄧巴. 如果你看過第一卷錄影帶, 就可以來學困難的部分了.
RM_863fd89e-30b9-58a4-9770-fbf57eda7be9.cn: 又是我, 雷·邓巴. 如果你看过第一盘录像带, 就可以学难的部分了.

RM_8fa4fc3a-2637-503c-beaa-3d634d49caa4.en: Moving target? Lead it. Swing with the animal and release while you're still swinging.
RM_8fa4fc3a-2637-503c-beaa-3d634d49caa4.ch: 移動目標? 打提前量. 跟著獵物擺動弓身, 在擺動中放箭.
RM_8fa4fc3a-2637-503c-beaa-3d634d49caa4.cn: 移动目标? 打提前量. 跟着猎物一起摆动, 在摆动的同时放箭.

RM_9be1e731-d2d9-50c7-9540-05eccc0d1174.en: A gun gets one shot before every critter in the county knows where you are. A bow gets as many as you've got arrows.
RM_9be1e731-d2d9-50c7-9540-05eccc0d1174.ch: 用槍只能開一槍, 之後全郡的動物都知道你在哪了. 用弓的話, 你有幾支箭就能射幾次.
RM_9be1e731-d2d9-50c7-9540-05eccc0d1174.cn: 用枪只能开一枪, 然后全县的动物都知道你在哪儿了. 用弓的话, 你有几支箭就能射几次.

RM_a06b47a4-1103-5a8c-b614-f690b43c63cf.en: That's the beauty of a bow, folks. Quiet as a church mouse.
RM_a06b47a4-1103-5a8c-b614-f690b43c63cf.ch: 各位, 這就是弓的美妙之處. 安靜得像教堂裡的老鼠.
RM_a06b47a4-1103-5a8c-b614-f690b43c63cf.cn: 各位, 这就是弓的妙处. 安静得像教堂里的老鼠.

RM_a11e06de-fb3f-5efd-860a-fd4f9172c53e.en: [Slow-motion footage of an arrow flexing as it leaves the bow]
RM_a11e06de-fb3f-5efd-860a-fd4f9172c53e.ch: [慢動作畫面: 箭離弓時彎曲抖動]
RM_a11e06de-fb3f-5efd-860a-fd4f9172c53e.cn: [慢动作画面: 箭离弦时弯曲颤动]

RM_a51fa50b-01c5-56dc-80d0-5e8d33ad2915.en: A good stave of hickory or ash, a sound string, and some patience. That's a bow.
RM_a51fa50b-01c5-56dc-80d0-5e8d33ad2915.ch: 一根上好的山核桃木或白蠟木弓胚, 一條堪用的弓弦, 再加上一點耐心. 這就是一把弓.
RM_a51fa50b-01c5-56dc-80d0-5e8d33ad2915.cn: 一根上好的山核桃木或白蜡木弓胚, 一根结实的弓弦, 再加点耐心. 这就是一把弓.

RM_a60de3ac-b570-53d0-9a3a-f2e572fc2bd9.en: If your arm is shaking at full draw, let down. A tired shot is a wasted arrow.
RM_a60de3ac-b570-53d0-9a3a-f2e572fc2bd9.ch: 如果滿弓時手臂在抖, 就收弓. 疲憊時射出的箭, 就是浪費的箭.
RM_a60de3ac-b570-53d0-9a3a-f2e572fc2bd9.cn: 满弓时胳膊发抖的话, 就收弓. 累了还硬射, 只会白白浪费一支箭.

RM_ae4129f5-0c7a-55e1-b437-ec23d6167234.en: VHS: Bowhunting Basics with Ray Dunbar
RM_ae4129f5-0c7a-55e1-b437-ec23d6167234.ch: VHS: 雷·鄧巴的弓獵入門
RM_ae4129f5-0c7a-55e1-b437-ec23d6167234.cn: VHS: 雷·邓巴的弓猎入门

RM_af26cf52-a5c8-50c7-a8ad-c40ead958944.en: Broadheads hit hard but they fly different. Practice with what you hunt with.
RM_af26cf52-a5c8-50c7-a8ad-c40ead958944.ch: 寬刃箭頭打得很重, 但飛行方式不一樣. 打獵用什麼箭, 練習就用什麼箭.
RM_af26cf52-a5c8-50c7-a8ad-c40ead958944.cn: 宽刃箭头威力大, 但飞行特性不一样. 打猎用什么箭, 练习就用什么箭.

RM_b23aa2c3-9ac9-5d9d-9105-5d6eac61abdb.en: Hold your form until the arrow lands. Peeking early pulls the shot.
RM_b23aa2c3-9ac9-5d9d-9105-5d6eac61abdb.ch: 保持姿勢直到箭落地. 太早探頭看會把箭帶偏.
RM_b23aa2c3-9ac9-5d9d-9105-5d6eac61abdb.cn: 保持姿势直到箭落地. 过早抬头张望会让箭射偏.

RM_b7a7ff08-45e8-5df3-a58b-30fde4ed1f77.ch: 無聲獵人: 進階弓獵
RM_b7a7ff08-45e8-5df3-a58b-30fde4ed1f77.cn: 无声猎人: 进阶弓猎

RM_bdd42d3c-371b-52a2-8e03-027aff399a1e.en: Check every arrow when you pick it up. A cracked shaft can come apart on the string.
RM_bdd42d3c-371b-52a2-8e03-027aff399a1e.ch: 每撿起一支箭都要檢查. 有裂痕的箭桿可能會在弦上斷開.
RM_bdd42d3c-371b-52a2-8e03-027aff399a1e.cn: 每捡起一支箭都要检查. 开裂的箭杆可能在弦上崩开.

RM_bded21b4-ddf5-5c06-af4e-68e6837156f5.en: Draw with your back, not your bicep. Squeeze those shoulder blades together.
RM_bded21b4-ddf5-5c06-af4e-68e6837156f5.ch: 用背部拉弓, 不是用二頭肌. 把肩胛骨往中間夾緊.
RM_bded21b4-ddf5-5c06-af4e-68e6837156f5.cn: 用背部拉弓, 而不是用二头肌. 把肩胛骨往中间夹紧.

RM_bef77899-cb28-512f-9c21-03168b1c2553.en: A tight grip torques the bow, and the arrow goes left. Every time.
RM_bef77899-cb28-512f-9c21-03168b1c2553.ch: 握得太緊會扭轉弓身, 箭就會往左偏. 每次都一樣.
RM_bef77899-cb28-512f-9c21-03168b1c2553.cn: 握得太紧会让弓身扭转, 箭就会往左偏. 次次如此.

RM_c15199a8-2685-5b97-9439-fd475814dbf3.en: Now, a lot of fellas think you need a two-hundred dollar bow to get started. You don't.
RM_c15199a8-2685-5b97-9439-fd475814dbf3.ch: 好啦, 很多老兄以為要先買一把兩百美元的弓才能入門. 其實不用.
RM_c15199a8-2685-5b97-9439-fd475814dbf3.cn: 好, 很多哥们以为得先买一把两百美元的弓才能入门. 其实不用.

RM_c1794482-d618-5a32-846a-48c54cd200ba.en: That's it for the advanced course. Stay patient, stay quiet, and you'll eat well.
RM_c1794482-d618-5a32-846a-48c54cd200ba.ch: 進階課程就到這裡. 保持耐心, 保持安靜, 你就能吃得飽飽的.
RM_c1794482-d618-5a32-846a-48c54cd200ba.cn: 进阶课程就到这里. 保持耐心, 保持安静, 你就不愁吃.

RM_c61e05ed-2ac8-5918-b515-245aeb2dfbb4.en: Welcome. I'm Linda Pryor, and this tape is about one thing: a repeatable shot.
RM_c61e05ed-2ac8-5918-b515-245aeb2dfbb4.ch: 歡迎. 我是琳達·普萊爾, 這卷錄影帶只講一件事: 可重複的射擊.
RM_c61e05ed-2ac8-5918-b515-245aeb2dfbb4.cn: 欢迎. 我是琳达·普赖尔, 这盘录像带只讲一件事: 可重复的射击.

RM_d2d894de-ae94-5144-b36e-1e5e4b2b414f.en: Beginners grip the bow like a hammer. Let it sit in the web of your hand instead.
RM_d2d894de-ae94-5144-b36e-1e5e4b2b414f.ch: 初學者握弓像握鐵鎚. 應該讓弓靠在虎口上.
RM_d2d894de-ae94-5144-b36e-1e5e4b2b414f.cn: 新手握弓就像握锤子. 应该让弓落在虎口上.

RM_d5668edd-5cdf-5076-af30-cebdd0d12fe1.en: Coach Linda Pryor of the Louisville Archery Club breaks down the shot, from stance to follow-through, with slow-motion footage.
RM_d5668edd-5cdf-5076-af30-cebdd0d12fe1.ch: 路易斯維爾射箭俱樂部的琳達·普萊爾教練透過慢動作畫面, 從站姿到收勢逐步拆解射擊動作.
RM_d5668edd-5cdf-5076-af30-cebdd0d12fe1.cn: 路易斯维尔射箭俱乐部的琳达·普赖尔教练借助慢动作画面, 从站姿到收势逐步拆解射击动作.

RM_d82f0d7e-40a5-53b4-a554-82665aad98ab.en: Pull back to the same spot on your face every single time. Corner of the mouth works for me.
RM_d82f0d7e-40a5-53b4-a554-82665aad98ab.ch: 每一次都要拉到臉上的同一個位置. 我習慣拉到嘴角.
RM_d82f0d7e-40a5-53b4-a554-82665aad98ab.cn: 每一次都要拉到脸上的同一个位置. 我习惯拉到嘴角.

RM_da4db67f-7fbf-5053-b250-99640abd6130.en: That spot's called your anchor. No anchor, no accuracy. Simple as that.
RM_da4db67f-7fbf-5053-b250-99640abd6130.ch: 那個位置就叫靠位. 沒有靠位, 就沒有準度. 就這麼簡單.
RM_da4db67f-7fbf-5053-b250-99640abd6130.cn: 那个位置就叫靠位. 没有靠位, 就没有准头. 就这么简单.

RM_dc081a76-97db-514e-922e-004c3e83d055.en: Wind in your face. Always. They can't hear you, but they sure can smell you.
RM_dc081a76-97db-514e-922e-004c3e83d055.ch: 風一定要迎面吹來. 永遠如此. 牠們聽不到你, 但肯定聞得到你.
RM_dc081a76-97db-514e-922e-004c3e83d055.cn: 一定要迎着风. 永远如此. 它们听不见你, 但肯定闻得到你.

RM_de32ae67-e268-5b0d-a541-caebcb4a8d71.en: See that? No bang, no echo. The deer two trees over didn't even look up.
RM_de32ae67-e268-5b0d-a541-caebcb4a8d71.ch: 看到沒? 沒有巨響, 沒有回音. 隔兩棵樹的那頭鹿連頭都沒抬.
RM_de32ae67-e268-5b0d-a541-caebcb4a8d71.cn: 看到没? 没有巨响, 没有回声. 隔着两棵树的那头鹿连头都没抬.

RM_df71a872-fb3c-5ea8-9656-83d73006e343.en: Now the release. The string hand moves straight back, past your ear. That's your follow-through.
RM_df71a872-fb3c-5ea8-9656-83d73006e343.ch: 接下來是放箭. 扣弦手直直往後移, 經過耳朵. 這就是收勢.
RM_df71a872-fb3c-5ea8-9656-83d73006e343.cn: 接下来是放箭. 勾弦手径直向后, 划过耳边. 这就是收势.

RM_e0c9acbb-a64a-5720-bc6a-bbdcf74f46ac.en: VHS: The Silent Hunter: Advanced Bowhunting
RM_e0c9acbb-a64a-5720-bc6a-bbdcf74f46ac.ch: VHS: 無聲獵人: 進階弓獵
RM_e0c9acbb-a64a-5720-bc6a-bbdcf74f46ac.cn: VHS: 无声猎人: 进阶弓猎

RM_ecc4e436-7e07-5ef9-9667-376113535e13.en: Out past twenty yards, that arrow is dropping. Aim a touch high and learn your bow.
RM_ecc4e436-7e07-5ef9-9667-376113535e13.ch: 超過二十碼, 箭就會開始下墜. 瞄高一點, 好好摸熟你的弓.
RM_ecc4e436-7e07-5ef9-9667-376113535e13.cn: 超过二十码, 箭就开始下坠. 瞄高一点, 摸透你的弓.

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 老兄… 這貨還真不賴.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 老兄… 这货还真不赖.

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Man, I am like... totally baked right now.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 天啊, 我現在整個… 茫翻了.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 天啊, 我现在整个… 嗨翻了.

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 豬頭, 我的十字弓咧?
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 伙计, 我的十字弓呢?

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl4.en: I can see through time, man. Also there are zombies.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 老兄, 我能看穿時間. 而且還有殭屍.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 老兄, 我能看穿时间. 而且还有僵尸.

Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 讓它停下來. 拜託, 讓它停下來.
Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 让它停下来. 拜托, 让它停下来.

Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: THIS IS THE WORST THING EVER

Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.en: You're the best. You can do anything
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 你最強了. 沒有你辦不到的事
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你最强了. 没有你办不到的事

Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl3.en: It's only you. You can do whatever you want.
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 世界只有你. 你想做什麼都行.
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 世界只有你. 你想做什么都行.

Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl4.en: I AM THE KING OF THE WORLD

Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel so goood and energetic
Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 你感覺超級爽, 精力全開
Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你感觉超级爽, 精力全开

Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 你從沒這麼精力充沛過
Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你从没这么精力充沛过

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: You wouldn't mind having a little something.

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: You really want some. Real bad.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你真的很想來一點. 非常想.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你真的很想来一点. 非常想.

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: You can't stop thinking about it.

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: You'd do anything for a hit right now.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 現在只要能來一口, 你什麼都肯做.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 现在只要能来一口, 你什么都肯做.

Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Everything starts to turn around you..

Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.en: You have no repairs. The hell is happening
Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 你徹底暈頭轉向了. 這他媽是怎麼回事
Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 你彻底晕头转向了. 这他妈是怎么回事

Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You're feeling more concentrated than usual
Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 你比平常更能集中注意力
Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你比平常更能集中注意力

Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 顏色更鮮豔, 聲音更清晰.
Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 颜色更鲜艳, 声音更清晰.

Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 我即一切, 亦即虛無
Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 我即一切, 亦即虚无

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Your head is a little fuzzy.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Your head is pounding. Why did you do this.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你頭痛欲裂. 你當初到底在想什麼.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你头痛欲裂. 你当初到底在想什么.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Everything hurts and you're still drunk.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 渾身都痛, 而且你還醉著.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 浑身都痛, 而且你还醉着.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: Never again. I mean it this time.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 再也不喝了. 這次是說真的.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 再也不喝了. 这次是说真的.

Moodles_KDLoosened_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Life seems not so bad now.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: You feel a bit out of place

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Things around you are strange but not in a positive way.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 周遭的一切变得怪异, 而且不是好的那种.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: You starting to feel really uncomfortable

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 一股舒服的暖意流遍全身.

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your eyelids feel heavy... so heavy.

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 你飘在此处与虚无之间.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Something doesn't feel right in your body.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 你的身体感觉不太对劲.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel strangely calm and sleepy.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl4.en: You can barely keep your eyes open.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 一股前所未有的能量冲上脑门.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your mind is racing. You can't stop moving.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的思绪狂奔. 停不下来.
