MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3.cn: 喝多了. 身体不协调了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.en: 'Iss you an' me 'gainst the wurld. I love you. I LOVE YOU.'
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.ch: 「你…和我…一起對抗…這世界. 我愛你. 我愛你!」
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.cn: “你…和我…一起对抗…这世界. 我爱你. 我爱你!”

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.en: Hard to run or swing a weapon. Why not have a rest in a comfy chair?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.ch: 難以奔跑或揮舞武器. 為什麼不在舒服的椅子上休息一會兒?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.cn: 难以奔跑或挥舞武器. 为什么不在舒服的椅子上休息一会儿?

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.en: Can barely jog or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.ch: 幾乎無法奔跑或揮舞武器.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.cn: 几乎无法奔跑或挥舞武器.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.en: Can barely walk or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.ch: 幾乎無法走動或揮舞武器.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.cn: 几乎无法走动或挥舞武器.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.en: Can barely move or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.ch: 幾乎無法移動或揮舞武器.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.cn: 几乎无法移动或挥舞武器.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.en: Gnawing hunger entirely absent. For now.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.ch: 不再感到飢餓了. 至少暫時如此.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.cn: 不再感到饥饿了. 至少暂时如此.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.en: Tummy full. Goodness making its way through your system.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.ch: 肚子飽飽. 營養對你的身體有幫助.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.cn: 肚子饱饱. 营养对你的身体有帮助.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.en: Stomach contented. You feel healthier and stronger.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.ch: 肚子好撐. 力量和生命恢復提升.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.cn: 肚子好撑. 力量和生命恢复提升.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl4.en: Couldn't manage another single, solitary bite.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.en: Sneezing and coughing. You feel sick and slow.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.ch: 伴隨打噴嚏和咳嗽. 你感到不適且行動遲緩.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.cn: 打喷嚏和咳嗽. 你感觉病了且行动迟缓.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.en: Continually coughing and sneezing. You'd better look after yourself.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.ch: 不斷咳嗽和打噴嚏. 你最好照顧好自己.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.cn: 不断咳嗽和打喷嚏. 你得照顾好自己.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.en: Carrying too much. You're slowed by the weight.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.ch: 拿得太多了. 因負重而減速.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.cn: 背得太多了. 因负重而减速.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.en: Carrying far too much. You can barely move.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.ch: 拿得實在太多了. 快動不了了.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.cn: 背得实在太多了. 快动不了了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.en: Can't take much more! You're going to hurt yourself carrying all that.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.ch: 不能再拿了! 拿這麼多會傷到自己的.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.cn: 不能再带了! 背这么多东西会伤到自己的.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl1.en: Could do with a bite to eat.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.en: Could eat a horse right now. Growing weaker.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.ch: 餓到可以吞下一整匹馬. 身體逐漸虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.cn: 饿得能吞下一整匹马. 身体逐渐虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.en: Just a crumb, a berry, a cockroach, anything...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.ch: 一點麵包屑, 一顆漿果, 一隻蟑螂, 啥都行…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.cn: 一点面包屑, 一颗浆果, 一只蟑螂, 啥都行…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.en: Consider wearing less clothing. You feel thirstier.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 考慮脫掉一些衣服. 更易口渴.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 考虑脱掉一些衣服. 更易口渴.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 口渴. 出汗. 過度暴露在陽光下.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 口渴. 出汗. 过度暴露在阳光下.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.en: Nauseous, unable to concentrate, and desperate for liquids.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 噁心想吐, 無法集中精神, 急需喝水.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 恶心想吐, 无法集中精神, 急需喝水.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.en: Delirious. The heat is melting your life away. Get somewhere colder!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 神智不清. 高溫正在消磨你的生命. 快去涼快的地方!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 神志不清. 高温正在消磨你的生命. 快去凉快的地方!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl.en: It feels a bit nippy round here...
You need to find ways to keep warm.
Man alive, it is SO cold.
You're going out. You may be some time.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl.ch: 你得出去了, 可能要很久才會回來.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl.cn: 你得出去了, 可能要很久才会回来.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl2.ch: 因受傷或疾病而感到虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl2.cn: 因受伤或疾病而感到虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.en: Severely weakened by injuries or illness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.ch: 因受傷或疾病而感到十分虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.cn: 因受伤或疾病而感到十分虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.en: Not going gently into that good night...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.ch: 不願溫順地走進那良夜…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.cn: 不愿温和地走进那良夜…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 哎呀, 有東西發出難聞的氣味.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 哎呀, 有东西发出难闻的气味.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 真噁心, 有東西發出刺鼻的臭味.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 真恶心, 有东西发出刺鼻的臭味.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.en: A vile stink makes you feel ill.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 一種令人作嘔的惡臭讓你感到不適.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 一种令人作呕的恶臭让你感到不适.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.en: You can't breathe. Get away from here!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 你無法呼吸. 快離開這裡!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 你无法呼吸. 快离开这里!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.en: Throbbing pain. It's hard to keep focused.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.ch: 陣陣抽痛. 很難保持注意力.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.cn: 阵阵疼痛. 很难保持注意力.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.en: The pain brings tears to your eyes. It's hard to go on.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.ch: 疼出了眼淚. 堅持不下去了.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.cn: 疼出了眼泪. 坚持不下去了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.en: Searing pain shoots through your body. It's hard to even think.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.ch: 灼痛感傳遍全身. 無法思考.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.cn: 剧痛贯穿你的全身. 甚至无法思考.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl1.en: Do your best to remain calm.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl2.ch: 焦慮不已, 手在發抖.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl2.cn: 焦虑不已. 手在发抖.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl3.ch: 很虛弱, 非常不舒服.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl3.cn: 很虚弱, 非常不舒服.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.en: Increasing danger of becoming rat food.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.ch: 被老鼠吃掉的危險越來越高.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.cn: 沦为老鼠食物的危险越来越高.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl2.ch: 心在狂跳. 思維混亂.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl2.cn: 心在狂跳. 思维混乱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.en: Shaking hands. Impossible to think straight. Make it stop!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.ch: 手在發抖, 無法正常思考. 快冷靜下來!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.cn: 手在发抖, 无法正常思考. 快冷静下来!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.en: You're at your limit! This can't go on...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.ch: 到達極限了! 不能再這樣下去了…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.cn: 到达极限了! 不能再这样下去了…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.en: It's well past your bedtime. Growing weak with tiredness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.ch: 已經過了平時睡覺的時間了. 開始因睏倦而虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.cn: 已经过了平时睡觉的时间了. 开始因困倦而虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.en: Can barely think straight. Weak with tiredness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.ch: 快不能思考了. 因睏倦而虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.cn: 快不能思考了. 因困倦而虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.en: So weak and tired. Desperately, inhumanly tired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.ch: 又虛弱又睏倦. 累到絕望, 累到不像人.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.cn: 又虚弱又困倦. 累到绝望, 累到不像人.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.en: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you uncomfortable and unhappy.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.ch: 你的衣服, 環境或其他東西讓你感到不舒服和不開心.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.cn: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到不舒服和不开心.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.en: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you very uncomfortable and unhappy.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.ch: 你的衣服, 環境或其他東西讓你感到非常不舒服和不開心.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.cn: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到非常不舒服和不开心.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.en: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you extremely uncomfortable and unhappy.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.ch: 你的衣服, 環境或其他東西讓你感到極度不舒服和不開心.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.cn: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到极度不舒服和不开心.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.en: Having a hard time lately. Seek some way to forget your troubles.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.ch: 最近壓力很大. 找些事幹, 忘掉煩惱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.cn: 最近压力很大. 找些事做来忘掉烦恼.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.en: You always feel on the edge of tears. Nothing seems to go your way.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.ch: 你總是在快哭出來的邊緣. 似乎一切都不順.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.cn: 你总是处在快哭出来的边缘. 似乎一切都不顺.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.en: Ravaged by mourning and desperation. You're losing hope...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.ch: 被哀悼與絕望摧殘. 你正在失去希望…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.cn: 被哀悼与绝望摧残. 你正在失去希望…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.en: What's the point in going on? Nothing good will ever happen...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.ch: 繼續下去有什麼意義? 永遠不會有好事發生…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.cn: 继续下去有什么意义? 永远不会有好事发生…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.en: Slightly damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.ch: 因為雨水、汗水或其他東西而有點潮濕…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.cn: 因为雨水、汗水或其他东西而有点潮湿…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.en: Damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.ch: 因為雨水、汗水或其他東西而潮濕…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.cn: 因为雨水、汗水或其他东西而潮湿…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl4.en: You're going to catch a cold!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl1.en: The wind's making it feel a little colder.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl2.en: The wind's making it feel somewhat colder.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl3.en: The wind's making it feel a lot colder.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.en: The wind feels like you're being stabbed with icicles.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.ch: 風吹起來像被冰柱刺穿一樣.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.cn: 风吹起来像被冰锥刺穿一样.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.en: Sudden attraction to gunshots, house alarms, and human flesh.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.ch: 突然被槍聲、住宅警報器和人肉吸引.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.cn: 突然被枪声、住宅警报器和人肉吸引.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Your child may need attention soon.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 你的孩子可能很快就需要關心了.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 你的孩子可能很快就需要关心了.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Your child has a rising care need.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你的孩子越來越需要照顧.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的孩子越来越需要照顾.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 你的孩子需要家人的關心.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 你的孩子需要家人的关心.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: Your child has an urgent need.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 你的孩子有急迫的需求.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your child feels close and comforted.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 你的孩子感到親近, 也得到了安慰.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的孩子感到亲近, 也得到了安慰.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Your child feels secure with family nearby.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 家人就在身邊, 你的孩子很有安全感.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 家人就在身边, 你的孩子很有安全感.

Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl4.en: Your child feels deeply safe and bonded.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 你的孩子感到無比安全, 與家人緊緊相繫.
Moodles_WolfBondChildhood_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 你的孩子感到无比安全, 与家人紧紧相依.

Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc1.ch: 你的指甲開始讓你不舒服了.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc1.cn: 你的指甲开始让你不舒服了.

Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc2.en: Your fingernails are too long for gloves.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc2.ch: 你的指甲太長, 戴不了手套.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc2.cn: 你的指甲太长, 戴不了手套.

Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc3.en: Manual work may hurt your hands.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc3.ch: 用手做事可能會弄傷你的手.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc3.cn: 用手做事可能会伤到你的手.

Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc4.en: You need clippers or scissors before wearing gloves.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc4.ch: 你需要先用指甲剪或剪刀修剪, 才能戴手套.
Moodles_WolfBondOvergrownNails_Bad_desc4.cn: 你需要先用指甲刀或剪刀修剪, 才能戴手套.

Moodles_Anger_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: Going to break something, or someone.
Moodles_Anger_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 想砸爛點什麼, 或揍個人.
Moodles_Anger_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 想砸烂点什么, 或者揍个人.

Moodles_Anger_Good_desc_lvl4.en: Going to break something, or someone.
Moodles_Anger_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 想砸爛點什麼, 或揍個人.
Moodles_Anger_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 想砸烂点什么, 或者揍个人.

Moodles_HPCalentura_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 每小時增加壓力和無聊.
Moodles_HPCalentura_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 每小时增加压力和无聊.

Moodles_HPCalentura_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Constant nerves, sadness and slower reading. Goes away when you relieve yourself.

Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl1.en: Zombies move at 0.30x. You run 25%% and attack 50%% faster, with +15%% melee damage. The longer it stays on, the more momentum.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 殭屍移動速度降為 0.30x. 你獲得奔跑速度 +25%%、攻擊速度 +50%%、近戰傷害 +15%% 的加成. 啟動時間越長, 衝勁越強.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 僵尸移动速度降为 0.30x. 你获得奔跑速度 +25%%、攻击速度 +50%%、近战伤害 +15%% 的加成. 开启时间越长, 冲劲越强.

Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Zombies at 0.25x. You run 35%% and attack 75%% faster, +15%% melee damage. Momentum adds up to +10%% running, +25%% attack speed.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 殭屍速度降為 0.25x. 你獲得奔跑速度 +35%%、攻擊速度 +75%%、近戰傷害 +15%% 的加成. 衝勁最多額外提供奔跑速度 +10%%、攻擊速度 +25%% 的加成.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 僵尸速度降为 0.25x. 你获得奔跑速度 +35%%、攻击速度 +75%%、近战伤害 +15%% 的加成. 冲劲最多额外提供奔跑速度 +10%%、攻击速度 +25%% 的加成.

Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Zombies at 0.20x. You run 40%% and attack 100%% faster, +15%% melee damage. Momentum adds up to +10%% running, +25%% attack speed.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 殭屍速度降為 0.20x. 你獲得奔跑速度 +40%%、攻擊速度 +100%%、近戰傷害 +15%% 的加成. 衝勁最多額外提供奔跑速度 +10%%、攻擊速度 +25%% 的加成.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 僵尸速度降为 0.20x. 你获得奔跑速度 +40%%、攻击速度 +100%%、近战伤害 +15%% 的加成. 冲劲最多额外提供奔跑速度 +10%%、攻击速度 +25%% 的加成.

Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl4.en: Peak power: zombies slowed to half their already reduced speed, +40%% running, +100%% attack speed, +50%% damage. Then the collapse: stagger and neural load and rejection spikes.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 力量巔峰: 殭屍速度在已降低的基礎上再減半, 你獲得奔跑速度 +40%%、攻擊速度 +100%%、傷害 +50%% 的加成. 隨後崩潰: 踉蹌, 神經負荷與排斥急遽上升.
Moodles_SandevistanActive_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 力量巅峰: 僵尸速度在已降低的基础上再减半, 你获得奔跑速度 +40%%、攻击速度 +100%%、伤害 +50%% 的加成. 随后崩溃: 踉跄, 神经负荷和排斥急剧上升.

Moodles_SandevistanAntidep_Good_desc_lvl.en: Neural load decays 1.5x faster; hallucinations, glitches, screams and spontaneous nosebleeds are halved. It does not cure cyberpsychosis.
Moodles_SandevistanAntidep_Good_desc_lvl.ch: 神經負荷以 1.5x 速度衰減; 幻覺、故障、尖叫與自發性流鼻血減半. 無法治癒賽博精神病.
Moodles_SandevistanAntidep_Good_desc_lvl.cn: 神经负荷以 1.5x 速度衰减; 幻觉、故障、尖叫和自发性流鼻血减半. 无法治愈赛博精神病.

Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.en: You have spent 25%% of the stamina you had but it is not charged yet. It is all taken when the implant goes off; while it is on, natural regeneration pays part of it back.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 你已用掉原有耐力的 25%%, 但還沒扣除. 植入物關閉時會一次扣清; 啟動期間, 自然恢復會償還一部分.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 你已用掉原有耐力的 25%%, 但还没扣除. 植入物关闭时会一次性扣清; 开启期间, 自然恢复会偿还一部分.

Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.en: Half of what you had at activation is already owed. Watch it: with the debt near the top, turning off leaves you out of breath.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 已透支啟動時耐力的一半. 小心: 透支額接近上限時, 關閉植入物會讓你喘不過氣.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 已透支启动时耐力的一半. 小心: 透支额接近上限时, 关闭植入物会让你喘不过气.

Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.en: Three quarters owed. The next Overdrive will not cover it: cut now while you still have some air to pay with.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 已透支四分之三. 下一次超限也補不回來: 趁還有點氣可以償還, 現在就關閉.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 已透支四分之三. 下一次超限也补不回来: 趁还有点气可以偿还, 现在就关掉.

Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.en: The debt already equals what you had at activation. Turning off now leaves you gasping: stagger and no sprint. Past 35%% more, the implant cuts out by itself.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 透支額已等於啟動時的耐力. 現在關閉會讓你喘不過氣: 踉蹌且無法衝刺. 再超出 35%%, 植入物會自行斷電.
Moodles_SandevistanBorrowed_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 透支额已等于启动时的耐力. 现在关闭会让你喘不过气: 踉跄且无法冲刺. 再超出 35%%, 植入物会自行断电.

Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.en: Under 12 hours of coverage left. Rejection is held back, neural load decays twice as fast and each use adds less load. Take another dose before it runs out.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.ch: 剩餘覆蓋不到 12 小時. 排斥受到抑制, 神經負荷衰減速度加倍, 每次使用增加的負荷也較少. 在藥效結束前再用一劑.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.cn: 剩余覆盖不足 12 小时. 排斥受到抑制, 神经负荷衰减速度翻倍, 每次使用增加的负荷也更少. 在药效结束前再用一剂.

Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.en: 12 to 36 hours left. Clinical and homemade doses stop rejection, herbal ones cut it to a quarter. Neural load decays twice as fast.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.ch: 剩餘 12 到 36 小時. 臨床與自製藥劑會止住排斥, 草藥則降至四分之一. 神經負荷衰減速度加倍.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.cn: 剩余 12 到 36 小时. 临床和自制药剂会止住排斥, 草药则降至四分之一. 神经负荷衰减速度翻倍.

Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.en: 36 to 60 hours of coverage. Rejection is held back and neural load decays twice as fast.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.ch: 覆蓋 36 到 60 小時. 排斥受到抑制, 神經負荷衰減速度加倍.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.cn: 覆盖 36 到 60 小时. 排斥受到抑制, 神经负荷衰减速度翻倍.

Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.en: More than 60 hours of coverage (cap 72). Rejection is held back and neural load decays twice as fast.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.ch: 覆蓋超過 60 小時 (上限 72). 排斥受到抑制, 神經負荷衰減速度加倍.
Moodles_SandevistanCoverage_Good_desc_lv.cn: 覆盖超过 60 小时 (上限 72). 排斥受到抑制, 神经负荷衰减速度翻倍.

Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.en: Neural load never drops below 50 and rises twice as fast while the implant is on. The only way out: 5 days without any implant. Under 60 the hallucinations stay quiet.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.ch: 神經負荷不會低於 50, 植入物啟動時上升速度加倍. 唯一出路: 5 天不裝任何植入物. 低於 60 時幻覺不會出現.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.cn: 神经负荷不会低于 50, 植入物开启时上升速度翻倍. 唯一出路: 5 天不装任何植入物. 低于 60 时幻觉不会出现.

Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.en: You hear things that are not there: footsteps, whispers, bangs. The dilation stutters. Neural load rises twice as fast with the implant on.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.ch: 你聽見不存在的聲音: 腳步聲、低語、碰撞聲. 時間膨脹斷斷續續. 植入物啟動時神經負荷上升速度加倍.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.cn: 你听见不存在的声音: 脚步声、低语、撞击声. 时间膨胀断断续续. 植入物开启时神经负荷上升速度翻倍.

Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.en: Sudden screams (up to once an hour) draw zombies from 25 tiles. Cybernetic fury: more melee damage and speed, no panic. Overdrive risks a deep chest cut.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.ch: 突發尖叫 (最多每小時一次) 會吸引 25 格內的殭屍. 賽博狂暴: 近戰傷害和速度提高, 不會恐慌. 超限可能造成胸口深傷口.
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.cn: 突发尖叫 (最多每小时一次) 会吸引 25 格内的僵尸. 赛博狂暴: 近战伤害和速度提高, 不会恐慌. 超限可能造成胸口深伤口.

Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.en: Blackouts, tunnel vision and reflex misfires: the implant may fire by itself. Each Overdrive risks a deep chest cut (20%%) and death (1%%).
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.ch: 失神、視野狹窄與反射誤觸發: 植入物可能自行啟動. 每次超限都有風險造成胸口深傷口 (20%%) 與死亡 (1%%).
Moodles_SandevistanCyberpsychosis_Bad_de.cn: 失神、视野狭窄和反射误触发: 植入物可能自行启动. 每次超限都有风险造成胸口深伤口 (20%%) 和死亡 (1%%).

Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv.en: The Sandevistan burned out from rejection. It has to be surgically removed (First Aid 7) before a new one can be installed.
Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 斯安威斯坦因排斥而燒毀. 必須先以手術摘除 (急救 7), 才能安裝新的.
Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 斯安威斯坦因排斥而烧毁. 必须先通过手术摘除 (急救 7), 才能安装新的.

Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv.en: The Sandevistan burned out from rejection. It has to be surgically removed (First Aid 7) before a new one can be installed.
Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 斯安威斯坦因排斥而燒毀. 必須先以手術摘除 (急救 7), 才能安裝新的.

Moodles_SandevistanDestroyed_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 斯安威斯坦因排斥而燒毀. 必須先以手術摘除 (急救 7), 才能安裝新的.

Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Heat builds while the Sandevistan runs and drains once it is off. Switch it off before the top of the bar to avoid a thermal cutoff.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 斯安威斯坦運作時熱量會累積, 關閉後會逐漸消退. 在量條到頂前關閉, 以免過熱斷電.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 斯安威斯坦运行时热量会累积, 关闭后会逐渐消退. 在进度条到顶前关闭, 以免过热断电.

Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: From 60%% of your Heat ceiling the screen edges glow red. At the ceiling (100 unless thermally scarred) the implant cuts out by itself: 1 s stagger, rejection +2 to +4 (less with adaptation, none at stable) and locked until it cools.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 從熱量上限的 60%% 起, 螢幕邊緣會泛紅. 到達上限 (若無熱疤痕則為 100) 時植入物會自行斷電: 踉蹌 1 秒, 排斥 +2 到 +4 (有適應時較少, 穩定適應時不增加), 並鎖定到冷卻為止.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 从热量上限的 60%% 起, 屏幕边缘会泛红. 到达上限 (若无热疤痕则为 100) 时植入物会自行断电: 踉跄 1 秒, 排斥 +2 到 +4 (有适应时较少, 稳定适应时不增加), 并锁定直到冷却.

Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Warning beeps have started. Cut it manually now: a manual cutoff is free, a thermal cutoff staggers you and adds rejection (less the more adapted you are).
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 警告嗶聲已響起. 現在就手動關閉: 手動關閉沒有代價, 過熱斷電則會讓你踉蹌並增加排斥 (適應越高越少).
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 警告蜂鸣已响起. 现在就手动关闭: 手动关闭没有代价, 过热断电则会让你踉跄并增加排斥 (适应越高越少).

Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: The implant is about to shut itself down. If you armed the override (hold Z) you will enter Overdrive instead of cutting out.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 植入物即將自行關閉. 若你已預備安全超控 (按住 Z), 就會進入超限, 而不是斷電.
Moodles_SandevistanHeat_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 植入物即将自行关闭. 若你已预备安全超控 (按住 Z), 就会进入超限, 而不是断电.

Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.en: Immunosuppressants lowered your defenses. Wounds get infected a little more and heal a little slower.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 免疫抑制劑降低了你的免疫力. 傷口稍微容易感染, 癒合也稍慢.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 免疫抑制剂降低了你的免疫力. 伤口稍微更容易感染, 愈合也稍慢.

Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.en: Disinfect and cleanly bandage every wound. Colds and spoiled food hit harder.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 每個傷口都要消毒並用乾淨繃帶包紮. 感冒和腐壞食物的影響更嚴重.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 每个伤口都要消毒并用干净绷带包扎. 感冒和变质食物的影响更严重.

Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.en: A dirty wound gets infected easily and takes long to close. Stay warm, eat well and avoid corpses.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 骯髒的傷口很容易感染, 也要很久才會癒合. 注意保暖、吃好, 並避開屍體.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 脏伤口很容易感染, 也要很久才能愈合. 注意保暖、吃好, 并远离尸体.

Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.en: Your immune system is almost shut down. Any open wound is a serious risk; antibiotics help.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 你的免疫系統幾乎停擺. 任何開放性傷口都有嚴重風險; 抗生素有幫助.
Moodles_SandevistanImmunodep_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 你的免疫系统几乎停摆. 任何开放性伤口都是严重风险; 抗生素有帮助.

Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.en: The homemade Kerenzikov crash is almost over. Fatigue and breathlessness are fading.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 自製克倫齊科夫的藥效崩落即將結束. 疲勞和喘不過氣的感覺正在消退.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 自制克伦齐科夫的药效崩落即将结束. 疲劳和喘不过气的感觉正在消退.

Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.en: Heavy limbs and a foggy head: fatigue rises and stamina is capped. It wears off with time.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 四肢沉重, 腦袋昏沉: 疲勞上升, 耐力受限. 會隨時間消退.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 四肢沉重, 脑袋昏沉: 疲劳上升, 耐力受限. 会随时间消退.

Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.en: You can barely keep your eyes open. Fatigue rises and stamina stays capped until the crash ends (2 in-game hours in total).
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 你幾乎睜不開眼. 疲勞上升, 耐力持續受限, 直到藥效崩落結束 (總共遊戲內 2 小時).
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 你几乎睁不开眼. 疲劳上升, 耐力持续受限, 直到药效崩落结束 (共计游戏内 2 小时).

Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.en: The crash has just started: high fatigue and stamina capped at the first exertion level for up to 2 in-game hours. Rest.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 藥效崩落剛開始: 疲勞很高, 耐力被限制在第一級勞累程度, 最長持續遊戲內 2 小時. 休息吧.
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 药效崩落刚开始: 疲劳很高, 耐力被限制在第一级劳累程度, 最长持续游戏内 2 小时. 休息吧.

Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_lvl4.ch: 嚴重克倫齊科夫藥效崩落
Moodles_SandevistanKereCrash_Bad_lvl4.cn: 严重克伦齐科夫药效崩落

Moodles_SandevistanKerenzikov_Good_desc_.en: Stamina boost and regeneration, immune to light stagger; tachycardia. Lasts 30 min (military) or 10 (homemade, then a 2 h crash). While the Sandevistan is on, Heat builds 20%% slower.
Moodles_SandevistanKerenzikov_Good_desc_.ch: 耐力提升並加速恢復, 不受輕微踉蹌影響; 心搏過速. 持續 30 分鐘 (軍用) 或 10 分鐘 (自製, 之後有 2 小時藥效崩落). 斯安威斯坦啟動時, 熱量以慢 20%% 的速度累積.
Moodles_SandevistanKerenzikov_Good_desc_.cn: 耐力提升并加速恢复, 不受轻微踉跄影响; 心动过速. 持续 30 分钟 (军用) 或 10 分钟 (自制, 之后有 2 小时药效崩落). 斯安威斯坦开启时, 热量以慢 20%% 的速度累积.

Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 斯安威斯坦在過熱斷電、緊急斷電或超限後正在冷卻. 熱量降到 0 之前無法啟動.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 斯安威斯坦在过热断电、紧急断电或超限后正在冷却. 热量降到 0 之前无法启动.

Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 斯安威斯坦在過熱斷電、緊急斷電或超限後正在冷卻. 熱量降到 0 之前無法啟動.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 斯安威斯坦在过热断电、紧急断电或超限后正在冷却. 热量降到 0 之前无法启动.

Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 斯安威斯坦在過熱斷電、緊急斷電或超限後正在冷卻. 熱量降到 0 之前無法啟動.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 斯安威斯坦在过热断电、紧急断电或超限后正在冷却. 热量降到 0 之前无法启动.

Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: The Sandevistan is cooling after a thermal cutoff, emergency stop or Overdrive. It cannot be activated until Heat is 0.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 斯安威斯坦在過熱斷電、緊急斷電或超限後正在冷卻. 熱量降到 0 之前無法啟動.
Moodles_SandevistanLockout_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 斯安威斯坦在过热断电、紧急断电或超限后正在冷却. 热量降到 0 之前无法启动.

Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.en: Neural load is building up, still without symptoms. After 2 hours without using the implant it decays 0.5 per hour. Adaptation lowers the load each use adds (up to -25%%).
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.ch: 神經負荷正在累積, 尚無症狀. 停用植入物 2 小時後, 每小時衰減 0.5. 適應能降低每次使用增加的負荷 (最多 -25%%).
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.cn: 神经负荷正在累积, 尚无症状. 停用植入物 2 小时后, 每小时衰减 0.5. 适应能降低每次使用增加的负荷 (最多 -25%%).

Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.en: Risk zone: Heat builds 10%% faster and rest only lowers the load 0.25 per hour. Immunosuppressants and antidepressants speed it up.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.ch: 風險區: 熱量累積速度加快 10%%, 休息每小時只能降低 0.25 負荷. 免疫抑制劑和抗憂鬱藥能加快下降.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.cn: 风险区: 热量累积速度加快 10%%, 休息每小时只能降低 0.25 负荷. 免疫抑制剂和抗抑郁药能加快下降.

Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.en: Critical zone: screen glitches, nosebleeds, Heat +20%% and chronic rejection. From 60 whispers, distant footsteps and night terrors begin.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.ch: 危急區: 畫面故障、流鼻血、熱量 +20%% 以及慢性排斥. 從 60 開始出現低語、遠處腳步聲和夜驚.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.cn: 危急区: 画面故障、流鼻血、热量 +20%% 以及慢性排斥. 从 60 开始出现低语、远处脚步声和夜惊.

Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.en: At 80 cyberpsychosis sets in and the screaming starts. Stop using the implant; rest and treatment lower the load.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.ch: 達到 80 時賽博精神病開始發作, 尖叫也隨之出現. 停止使用植入物; 休息和治療能降低負荷.
Moodles_SandevistanNeuralLoad_Bad_desc_l.cn: 达到 80 时赛博精神病开始发作, 尖叫也随之出现. 停止使用植入物; 休息和治疗能降低负荷.

Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.en: The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.ch: 更換韌體後植入物正在重新校準: 滿一小時前, 熱量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物分頁會顯示剩餘時間.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.cn: 更换固件后植入物正在重新校准: 满一小时前, 热量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物标签页会显示剩余时间.

Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.en: The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.ch: 更換韌體後植入物正在重新校準: 滿一小時前, 熱量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物分頁會顯示剩餘時間.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.cn: 更换固件后植入物正在重新校准: 满一小时前, 热量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物标签页会显示剩余时间.

Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.en: The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.ch: 更換韌體後植入物正在重新校準: 滿一小時前, 熱量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物分頁會顯示剩餘時間.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.cn: 更换固件后植入物正在重新校准: 满一小时前, 热量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物标签页会显示剩余时间.

Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.en: The implant is recalibrating after a firmware change: Heat rises 10%% faster until the hour is up. The Implant tab shows the time left.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.ch: 更換韌體後植入物正在重新校準: 滿一小時前, 熱量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物分頁會顯示剩餘時間.
Moodles_SandevistanRecalibrating_Bad_des.cn: 更换固件后植入物正在重新校准: 满一小时前, 热量以快 10%% 的速度上升. 植入物标签页会显示剩余时间.

Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.en: The withdrawal is over. Between 2 and 3 days left without any implant until the cyberpsychosis fades. Installing one restarts the count.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.ch: 戒斷已結束. 還需要 2 到 3 天不裝任何植入物, 賽博精神病才會消退. 安裝植入物會重新計時.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.cn: 戒断已结束. 还需要 2 到 3 天不装任何植入物, 赛博精神病才会消退. 安装植入物会重新计时.

Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.en: Between 1 and 2 days left without any implant until the cyberpsychosis fades. Installing one restarts the count.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.ch: 還需要 1 到 2 天不裝任何植入物, 賽博精神病才會消退. 安裝植入物會重新計時.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.cn: 还需要 1 到 2 天不装任何植入物, 赛博精神病才会消退. 安装植入物会重新计时.

Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.en: Less than a day left (12 to 24 hours) until the cyberpsychosis fades. Installing an implant restarts the count.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.ch: 距離賽博精神病消退不到一天 (12 到 24 小時). 安裝植入物會重新計時.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.cn: 距离赛博精神病消退不到一天 (12 到 24 小时). 安装植入物会重新计时.

Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.en: Under 12 hours left until the cyberpsychosis fades. Do not install an implant now: it restarts the count.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.ch: 距離賽博精神病消退不到 12 小時. 現在別安裝植入物: 會重新計時.
Moodles_SandevistanRecovery_Good_desc_lv.cn: 距离赛博精神病消退不到 12 小时. 现在别安装植入物: 会重新计时.

Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.en: A stiff, sore back: an early warning. Rejection climbs until adaptation is stable (lab 5, military 7) unless immunosuppressants cover you.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 背部僵硬痠痛: 這是早期前兆. 除非有免疫抑制劑覆蓋, 否則排斥會持續上升, 直到達到穩定適應 (實驗室 5, 軍用 7).
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 背部僵硬酸痛: 这是早期前兆. 除非有免疫抑制剂覆盖, 否则排斥会持续上升, 直到达到稳定适应 (实验室 5, 军用 7).

Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.en: Fever (from 37.8) and constant lumbar pain. Passive adaptation XP stops. Immunosuppressants halt the climb; sleeping halves it.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 發燒 (37.8 起) 且腰部持續疼痛. 被動適應經驗停止. 免疫抑制劑能止住上升; 睡眠能讓上升減半.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 发烧 (37.8 起) 且腰部持续疼痛. 被动适应经验停止增长. 免疫抑制剂能止住上升; 睡眠能让上升减半.

Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.en: Spasms and blurred vision. The Sandevistan cannot be activated while rejection is 75 or higher. Take an immunosuppressant.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 痙攣與視線模糊. 排斥達到 75 以上時無法啟動斯安威斯坦. 服用免疫抑制劑吧.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 痉挛和视线模糊. 排斥达到 75 或以上时无法启动斯安威斯坦. 服用免疫抑制剂吧.

Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.en: Neurogenic shock: you keep losing health and wake up if asleep. At 100 the implant is expelled with massive bleeding and destroyed.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 神經性休克: 你會持續失去生命值, 睡著也會被驚醒. 達到 100 時植入物會伴隨大量出血被排出並損毀.
Moodles_SandevistanRejection_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 神经性休克: 你会持续损失生命值, 睡着也会被惊醒. 达到 100 时植入物会伴随大量出血被排出并损毁.

Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.en: Herbal immunosuppressants are building up. Each dose adds 25 and it falls 2.5 per hour.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 草藥免疫抑制劑正在體內累積. 每劑增加 25, 每小時下降 2.5.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 草药免疫抑制剂正在体内累积. 每剂增加 25, 每小时下降 2.5.

Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.en: Nausea grows with the level. Avoid another herbal dose until it drops below 25.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 噁心感隨等級加重. 降到 25 以下前, 別再服用草藥劑.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 恶心感随等级加重. 降到 25 以下之前, 别再服用草药剂.

Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.en: Strong nausea. Switch to another immunosuppressant or wait: more herbs make it worse.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 強烈噁心. 改用其他免疫抑制劑或等待: 再用草藥只會更糟.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 强烈恶心. 改用其他免疫抑制剂或等待: 再用草药只会更糟.

Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.en: Critical poisoning with heavy nausea. It only falls 2.5 per hour. No more herbal doses.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.ch: 危急中毒, 伴隨嚴重噁心. 每小時只下降 2.5. 別再服用草藥劑.
Moodles_SandevistanToxicity_Bad_desc_lvl.cn: 危急中毒, 伴随严重恶心. 每小时只下降 2.5. 别再服用草药剂.

Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.en: Less than a day of withdrawal left: stress and fatigue still creep up a little. Antidepressants halve it. The Implant tab shows the exact time.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.ch: 戒斷剩不到一天: 壓力和疲勞仍會慢慢上升一點. 抗憂鬱藥能減半. 植入物分頁會顯示確切時間.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.cn: 戒断剩不到一天: 压力和疲劳仍会慢慢上升一点. 抗抑郁药能减半. 植入物标签页会显示确切时间.

Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.en: Your brain misses the speed: stress and fatigue creep up for the first two days after losing the implant (more than a day left). Antidepressants halve it.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.ch: 你的大腦懷念那種速度: 失去植入物後的頭兩天, 壓力和疲勞會慢慢上升 (剩餘超過一天). 抗憂鬱藥能減半.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.cn: 你的大脑怀念那种速度: 失去植入物后的头两天, 压力和疲劳会慢慢上升 (剩余超过一天). 抗抑郁药能减半.

Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.en: Your brain misses the speed: stress and fatigue creep up for the first two days after losing the implant (more than a day left). Antidepressants halve it.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.ch: 你的大腦懷念那種速度: 失去植入物後的頭兩天, 壓力和疲勞會慢慢上升 (剩餘超過一天). 抗憂鬱藥能減半.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.cn: 你的大脑怀念那种速度: 失去植入物后的头两天, 压力和疲劳会慢慢上升 (剩余超过一天). 抗抑郁药能减半.

Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.en: Your brain misses the speed: stress and fatigue creep up for the first two days after losing the implant (more than a day left). Antidepressants halve it.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.ch: 你的大腦懷念那種速度: 失去植入物後的頭兩天, 壓力和疲勞會慢慢上升 (剩餘超過一天). 抗憂鬱藥能減半.
Moodles_SandevistanWithdrawal_Bad_desc_l.cn: 你的大脑怀念那种速度: 失去植入物后的头两天, 压力和疲劳会慢慢上升 (剩余超过一天). 抗抑郁药能减半.

description.en: As of now, there is only one challenge spawn. This spawn location will place you on top of the roof of Megurigaoka Private High School. Zombies will spawn inside. Have fun!

description.cn: 目前只有一个挑战出生点。此出生点会把你放在巡之丘私立高中的屋顶上。僵尸会在校内生成。祝你玩得开心！

description.en: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> SHELTER IN PLACE ALERT FOR MEGURIGAOKA CITY <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> BREAKING - MEGURIGAOKA OVERRUN <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Kanagawa Newspaper | 10 April 2012 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> On the morning of 10 April 2012, riots and violent outbreaks began in the city of Megurigaoka in the Kanagawa prefecture. While the root cause is still unknown, public officials believe it to be some form of mass hysteria brought about by some form of illness.  <LINE> <LINE> The same public officials recommend locking your doors and STAYING INSIDE. Do not leave your homes at any cost, and if you find yourself with others, stay together, and STAY INSIDE. Do not attempt to flee, do not retrieve your children from school. <LINE> <LINE> Stay indoors, the prefectural police will have this situation under control, you will be safe. More information will be made available soon.
description.ch: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 巡之丘市就地避難警報 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 突發——巡之丘淪陷 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 神奈川新聞 | 2012年4月10日 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 2012年4月10日上午，神奈川縣巡之丘市開始發生暴動與暴力事件。雖然根本原因仍不明朗，官方認為這是某種疾病引發的集體歇斯底里。 <LINE> <LINE> 官方建議市民鎖好門窗並留在室內。無論如何都不要離開家中；若身邊有其他人，請待在一起，並留在室內。不要試圖逃離，也不要前往學校接回您的孩子。 <LINE> <LINE> 請待在室內，縣警將控制住局勢，您會安全的。更多資訊將於稍後公布。
description.cn: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 巡之丘市就地避难警报 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 突发——巡之丘沦陷 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 神奈川新闻 | 2012年4月10日 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 2012年4月10日上午，神奈川县巡之丘市开始发生暴动与暴力事件。虽然根本原因仍不明朗，官方认为这是某种疾病引发的集体癔症。 <LINE> <LINE> 官方建议市民锁好门窗并留在室内。无论如何都不要离开家中；若身边有其他人，请待在一起，并留在室内。不要试图逃离，也不要前往学校接回您的孩子。 <LINE> <LINE> 请待在室内，县警将控制住局势，您会安全的。更多信息将于稍后公布。

description.en: Typically, Student and Teacher professions will spawn in schools on other spawns, but if you want to bypass that and play any profession in the school, use this spawn. <LINE> <LINE> Also, in the current B42 build while writing this, custom professions' spawns don't properly spawn the player in the correct location. To spawn in the school in MP, spawn here.
description.ch: 通常情況下，選擇學生或教師職業時，角色會在其他出生點的學校中出生；如果你想跳過這個限制、讓任何職業都能在學校出生，請使用此出生點。 <LINE> <LINE> 另外，在撰寫本文時的 B42 版本中，自訂職業的出生點無法正確地把玩家放到指定位置。若要在多人遊戲中於學校出生，請在此出生。
description.cn: 通常情况下，选择学生或教师职业时，角色会在其他出生点的学校中出生；如果你想跳过这个限制、让任何职业都能在学校出生，请使用此出生点。 <LINE> <LINE> 另外，在撰写本文时的 B42 版本中，自定义职业的出生点无法正确地把玩家放到指定位置。若要在多人游戏中于学校出生，请在此出生。

description.en: "<IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/TikitownMapPreview.png,800,450><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:large>TIKITOWN<LINE><TEXT>Tikitown is a thriving mid-sized city nestled between Riverside and Westpoint of Rosewood. Once a humble rural town, it has grown into a bustling urban hub<LINE><LINE>Its transformation was fueled by an influx of commuters drawn to its quiet landscape following the opening of Tikitown's commuter rail station.<LINE><LINE>he addition of a Kentucky University satellite campus and the expansion of the city's docks further cemented its status as an economic powerhouse in this once-sleepy bend of the Ohio River.
description.ch: <IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/TikitownMapPreview.png,800,450><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:large>提基鎮<LINE><TEXT>提基鎮是一座繁榮的中型城市, 坐落於河畔鎮與羅斯伍德的西點之間. 這裡曾是個樸實的鄉村小鎮, 如今已發展成熱鬧的都市中心<LINE><LINE>提基鎮通勤鐵路車站啟用後, 寧靜的景致吸引大批通勤族湧入, 推動了這座城市的轉變.<LINE><LINE>肯塔基大學分校的設立與城市碼頭的擴建, 更進一步鞏固了它在俄亥俄河這段昔日沉寂河灣上的經濟重鎮地位.
description.cn: <IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/TikitownMapPreview.png,800,450><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:large>提基镇<LINE><TEXT>提基镇是一座繁荣的中型城市, 坐落于河畔镇与罗斯伍德的西点之间. 这里曾是一个朴素的乡村小镇, 如今已发展成繁华的城市中心<LINE><LINE>提基镇通勤铁路车站开通后, 宁静的风光吸引了大批通勤者涌入, 推动了这座城市的蜕变.<LINE><LINE>肯塔基大学分校的设立和城市码头的扩建, 进一步巩固了它在俄亥俄河这段曾经沉寂的河湾上的经济重镇地位.

title.cn: 肯塔基州, 泰勒斯维尔

description.en: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> TAYLORSVILLE <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> A small town located south on the Ohio River, west of West Point. Taylorsville's friendly Southern hospitality makes it the perfect place to come for a relaxing visit and an even better place to call "home." Come and see for yourself, all that Taylorsville has to offer!
description.ch: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 泰勒斯維爾 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 位於俄亥俄河以南、西點鎮以西的小鎮. 泰勒斯維爾友善的南方人情味, 讓這裡成為放鬆小旅行的絕佳去處, 更是讓人想稱之為「家」的好地方. 快來親身看看泰勒斯維爾能帶給你的一切吧!
description.cn: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 泰勒斯维尔 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 位于俄亥俄河以南、西点镇以西的小镇. 泰勒斯维尔友善的南方式热情好客, 让这里成为放松游玩的完美去处, 更是可以称之为“家”的好地方. 快来亲眼看看泰勒斯维尔能带给你的一切吧!

RD_0054cd7f-dfa2-4ff6-b82e-f447910d59ba.en: Guide us, Lord, to recognize the opportunities that arise from adversity

RD_00a20923-38db-4034-badb-cd324cdb8a3d.en: This subjective lens through which we view the world extends to our faith journey as well
RD_00a20923-38db-4034-badb-cd324cdb8a3d.ch: 我們看待世界的這種主觀視角, 同樣延伸到我們的信仰旅程

RD_00a25208-9390-4dbf-8e71-58eb304818c0.en: In this reflection, we're reminded that our identity is not solely tied to our outward appearance or societal roles
RD_00a25208-9390-4dbf-8e71-58eb304818c0.ch: 這段反思提醒我們, 我們的身分並不只取決於外表或社會角色

RD_0118e19b-e405-4549-908d-385b79528976.en: and guide them back to us, if it be your will
RD_0118e19b-e405-4549-908d-385b79528976.ch: 若這是祢的旨意, 求祢引領他們回到我們身邊
RD_0118e19b-e405-4549-908d-385b79528976.cn: 若这是你的旨意, 求你引领他们回到我们身边

RD_014c3466-85a5-4433-9352-2de1ad7ebd04.en: In the boundless expanse of existence

RD_014c3466-85a5-4433-9352-2de1ad7ebd04.cn: 在存在那无边无际的广袤之中

RD_0152ffdf-ead0-477d-8be3-b4b7dc284d62.en: it is an active force that propels us forward when all seems lost
RD_0152ffdf-ead0-477d-8be3-b4b7dc284d62.ch: 它是一股主動的力量, 在一切看似絕望時推著我們前進

RD_015f0c81-f04a-4270-84a5-d3022a202beb.en: Until such time instructions arrives, we shall continue to operate under the fine leadership of Premier Irving.
RD_015f0c81-f04a-4270-84a5-d3022a202beb.ch: 在指示下達之前, 我們將繼續在歐文省長的卓越領導下運作.
RD_015f0c81-f04a-4270-84a5-d3022a202beb.cn: 在指示下达之前, 我们将继续在欧文省长的英明领导下开展工作.

RD_0161a335-cbb2-4904-8403-d6561b882c95.ch: 那裡存在著另一種本質的生命
RD_0161a335-cbb2-4904-8403-d6561b882c95.cn: 那里存在着另一种本质的生命

RD_01d3744a-9fff-4a7e-a6f8-48db7200024d.en: In the face of relentless darkness and despair
RD_01d3744a-9fff-4a7e-a6f8-48db7200024d.ch: 面對無止盡的黑暗與絕望
RD_01d3744a-9fff-4a7e-a6f8-48db7200024d.cn: 面对无休无止的黑暗与绝望

RD_01d5d90d-3c39-4f04-a7cd-d97f9efbdd47.cn: 面对看似无法克服的威胁

RD_0210d019-d2e9-4525-b7a4-82f0af91d0d6.en: We often hear that faith should be reasonable
RD_0210d019-d2e9-4525-b7a4-82f0af91d0d6.ch: 我們常聽人說, 信仰應該合乎理性
RD_0210d019-d2e9-4525-b7a4-82f0af91d0d6.cn: 我们常听人说, 信仰应该合乎理性

RD_02275fff-4993-4cc7-a1fa-cacc6c2ee62f.en: with a profound awareness of our interdependence
RD_02275fff-4993-4cc7-a1fa-cacc6c2ee62f.ch: 深刻體認到我們彼此相依
RD_02275fff-4993-4cc7-a1fa-cacc6c2ee62f.cn: 深刻认识到我们彼此相依

RD_024a4f5f-dc5d-43c0-aaee-bc06d27e67dc.en: I would just like to reassure the great people of New Brunswick that we are working tirelessly to restore order.
RD_024a4f5f-dc5d-43c0-aaee-bc06d27e67dc.ch: 我只想向新伯倫瑞克省偉大的人民保證, 我們正不眠不休地努力恢復秩序.
RD_024a4f5f-dc5d-43c0-aaee-bc06d27e67dc.cn: 我只想向新不伦瑞克省伟大的人民保证, 我们正不知疲倦地努力恢复秩序.

RD_02722d81-7673-4cf0-8b73-74b689d50470.en: Just as these afflicted beings lack awareness of their surroundings
RD_02722d81-7673-4cf0-8b73-74b689d50470.ch: 正如這些受苦的存在對周遭渾然不覺
RD_02722d81-7673-4cf0-8b73-74b689d50470.cn: 正如这些受苦的存在对周遭浑然不觉

RD_02a062c3-f9e7-40b6-82c1-c87d7c13aa99.ch: 希西家禱告之後, 先知以賽亞帶來了希望的訊息
RD_02a062c3-f9e7-40b6-82c1-c87d7c13aa99.cn: 希西家祷告之后, 先知以赛亚带来了希望的信息

RD_03ba4a57-2703-406a-ab5f-1c05e171807d.en: Grant me the courage to lead with compassion and empathy
RD_03ba4a57-2703-406a-ab5f-1c05e171807d.ch: 賜我勇氣, 以憐憫與同理心來領導
RD_03ba4a57-2703-406a-ab5f-1c05e171807d.cn: 赐我勇气, 以怜悯与同理心来领导

RD_03f2bcc5-e4ea-49b3-b7a4-c7903d0533e0.en: Do you think this could be related?
RD_03f2bcc5-e4ea-49b3-b7a4-c7903d0533e0.ch: 你覺得這可能有關聯嗎?
RD_03f2bcc5-e4ea-49b3-b7a4-c7903d0533e0.cn: 你觉得这可能有关联吗?

RD_04273f3f-db26-4026-9a68-c56bce274ddd.en: I know the good people of New Brunswick are able to follow the rules.
RD_04273f3f-db26-4026-9a68-c56bce274ddd.ch: 我知道新伯倫瑞克省的好百姓都能遵守規定.
RD_04273f3f-db26-4026-9a68-c56bce274ddd.cn: 我知道新不伦瑞克省的好百姓都能遵守规定.

RD_0433ef83-17be-474e-839a-589ea189eaf2.en: In the grand theater of existence
RD_0433ef83-17be-474e-839a-589ea189eaf2.ch: 在存在這座宏大的劇場裡
RD_0433ef83-17be-474e-839a-589ea189eaf2.cn: 在存在这座宏大的剧场里

RD_044d6965-bc75-4dff-83fc-589f4d9db3d5.en: Ephesians 6:13 reminds us to put on the whole armor of God
RD_044d6965-bc75-4dff-83fc-589f4d9db3d5.ch: 以弗所書 6:13 提醒我們要穿戴上帝所賜的全副軍裝
RD_044d6965-bc75-4dff-83fc-589f4d9db3d5.cn: 以弗所书 6:13 提醒我们要穿戴上帝所赐的全副军装

RD_044e9622-b97c-4742-a5f8-eba50a745380.en: Do not leave your shelter for any reason until the all clear has sounded, or unless it is safe to do so
RD_044e9622-b97c-4742-a5f8-eba50a745380.ch: 在解除警報響起之前, 或除非確定安全, 無論如何都不要離開你的避難所
RD_044e9622-b97c-4742-a5f8-eba50a745380.cn: 在解除警报响起之前, 或除非确定安全, 无论如何都不要离开你的避难所

RD_0450bab8-7e52-449e-a2d9-f54243fc9f30.en: Blessed are they who seek me. In seeking me, their long period of forgetfulness is coming to an end
RD_0450bab8-7e52-449e-a2d9-f54243fc9f30.ch: 尋求我的人有福了. 在尋求我的過程中, 他們漫長的遺忘即將結束
RD_0450bab8-7e52-449e-a2d9-f54243fc9f30.cn: 寻求我的人有福了. 在寻求我的过程中, 他们漫长的遗忘即将结束

RD_045f8748-a47b-4c41-a461-ab3357173cef.en: In the scriptures, we learn about the parable of the lost souls
RD_045f8748-a47b-4c41-a461-ab3357173cef.ch: 在經文中, 我們讀到迷失靈魂的比喻
RD_045f8748-a47b-4c41-a461-ab3357173cef.cn: 在经文中, 我们读到迷失灵魂的比喻

RD_04c11ac2-6df1-4901-b408-b13c90735a40.en: We're still alive folks, and we hope you are too.
RD_04c11ac2-6df1-4901-b408-b13c90735a40.ch: 各位, 我們還活著, 也希望你們都還活著.
RD_04c11ac2-6df1-4901-b408-b13c90735a40.cn: 各位, 我们还活着, 也希望你们都还活着.

RD_04c223d4-3440-4430-a1b0-038a13b321af.en: Our capacity to adapt, learn, and innovate is a testament to our resilience
RD_04c223d4-3440-4430-a1b0-038a13b321af.ch: 我們適應、學習與創新的能力, 證明了我們的韌性
RD_04c223d4-3440-4430-a1b0-038a13b321af.cn: 我们适应、学习与创新的能力, 证明了我们的韧性

RD_04dcec16-9c1d-48e4-a0b7-b4c77891fbea.en: When your hopes are dashed, when your dreams remain unfulfilled
